title: URHead: A Unified UV-Space Representation for Joint Mesh-3DGS Optimization in Head Avatars
summary: We present URHead, a unified representation for high-fidelity and animatable head avatars that fundamentally redefines mesh-Gaussian integration. While mesh-based methods offer precise geometric control but lack photorealistic detail, and Gaussian-based approaches achieve photorealism but suffer from poor structural consistency, existing hybrid solutions fail to fully leverage their complementary strengths. Our key contribution is a UV-space unification where both representations share a common UV parameterization. Through joint optimization with adaptive gaussian sampling, our method automatically learns to disentangle and allocate appropriate roles to each component. URHead maintains full parametric controllability while preserving subject-specific details, and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality and animation consistency.

AI.tldr: URHead提出了一种统一表示方法，通过UV空间联合优化网格与高斯表示，实现了高保真、可动画化的人头头像，在重建质量和动画一致性上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有网格方法几何控制精确但缺乏真实感，高斯方法真实感强但结构一致性差，混合方法未能充分利用两者互补优势，缺乏有效的统一表征。
AI.method: 提出UV空间统一表征，使网格和高斯共享UV参数化；通过联合优化与自适应高斯采样，自动解耦并分配各组件角色，实现参数化可控性与主体细节保持的统一。
AI.result: 在重建质量和动画一致性上均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: URHead通过UV空间统一网格-高斯表征，有效融合了几何控制与真实感渲染的优势，为人头头像的保真度和动画一致性提供了新思路。

title: Text-based Tactile Graphics Generation for the Visually Impaired
summary: Tactile graphics are a primary medium for blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals to access non-textual information. However, they are difficult to scale or personalize. While recent generative models have revolutionized visual content creation, they are optimized for screen-based visual realism and fail to satisfy the haptic perceptual and physical fabrication constraints required for touch. We present the first integrated generative system that produces fabrication-ready 2.5D tactile graphics directly from natural language prompts, jointly generating global base geometry, fine-grained tactile surface textures, and standard-compliant braille within a unified 3D-printable representation. Our approach introduces fabrication-aware techniques, including template-guided relief generation, a fast diffusion-based text-to-texture module for high-resolution tileable normal maps, and strict base flattening to ensure tactile readability and printability, while supporting both automatic generation and interactive texture control. Extensive evaluations, together with in-person user studies with BLV participants and blindfolded sighted participants using physically 3D-printed outputs, show that participants consistently prefer our results over baselines. By extending generative graphics beyond screens to touchable reliefs, our work broadens access to generative AI for the BLV community and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个集成式生成系统，能够根据自然语言提示直接生成可直接3D打印的2.5D触觉图形，包括全局几何、触觉纹理和盲文，并通过用户研究验证了其优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 触觉图形是盲人和低视力（BLV）群体获取非文本信息的主要媒介，但现有方法难以规模化或个性化。虽然生成式模型在视觉内容创作上取得了突破，但它们针对屏幕上的视觉真实感优化，无法满足触觉感知和物理制造约束。
AI.method: 提出首个集成生成系统，包含以下关键技术：模板引导的浮雕生成、基于快速扩散模型的文本到纹理模块（生成高分辨率可平铺法线贴图）、严格的基底平坦化处理，在统一的可3D打印表示中联合生成全局基底几何、细粒度触觉表面纹理和符合标准的盲文，同时支持自动生成和交互式纹理控制。
AI.result: 通过广泛评估以及使用物理3D打印输出进行的真人用户研究（包括BLV参与者和蒙眼视力正常参与者），结果显示参与者一致倾向于本系统生成的结果而非基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将生成式图形从屏幕扩展到可触摸的浮雕，本工作拓宽了BLV社区及更广泛群体对生成式AI的访问途径。

title: Nova3D: Code-Native Generation of Programmable 3D Assets
summary: Current 3D generative models mostly produce a final surface: a visually strong but largely opaque mesh. Interactive 3D worlds need more than a surface. They need named parts, an assembly hierarchy, measurable constraints, local edit handles, and joints for articulation. We present Nova3D, a system that generates 3D assets as executable Blender source code; the compiled mesh, a binary glTF (GLB), is treated as the artifact, not the asset. Because the output is a program, semantic handles exist at generation time rather than being recovered afterward by segmentation or rigging. We evaluate on Nova3D-Bench, a frozen, spec-grounded benchmark of 54 items across six domains and three difficulty levels with text and image inputs, against eleven baselines in four families (mesh-native, part-structured, code-native, and CAD) plus a same-LLM ablation. Nova3D produces an executable program and a valid artifact for 54/54 items. Every asset exposes named parts organized in a parent-child assembly tree; no mesh-native, CAD, or segmentation baseline exposes either. It satisfies 51/52 prompt-stated numeric and count constraints (best baseline: 11/52), passes 14/18 blinded local edits with locality preserved in 18/18, and articulates 59 joints across 12 assets at 98.3% geometric validity, where every baseline exposes zero native joints. Its geometry is competitive: it wins the structured domains in a pairwise shape-quality tournament and is second only to the strongest mesh-native model, while conceding texture realism to baked-PBR systems. The central result is representational: code-native generation turns a generated 3D object from an opaque surface into a programmable asset that downstream systems can inspect, measure, edit, and animate.

AI.tldr: Nova3D 是一种通过生成可执行的 Blender 源代码来创建 3D 资产的系统，输出的是带命名部件、装配层级、约束、编辑手柄和关节的可编程资产，而非传统的不透明网格。在 Nova3D-Bench 基准测试中，它全面优于网格原生、CAD、分割等基线方法，实现了 54/54 的资产生成成功率、51/52 的约束满足率、14/18 的局部编辑通过率及 98.3% 的关节几何有效性，核心贡献在于将 3D 生成从"表面"转向"可编程资产"。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 生成模型主要输出不透明网格，缺乏交互式 3D 世界所需的命名部件、装配层级、可测量约束、局部编辑手柄和关节等语义结构。这些语义信息通常需要在生成后通过分割或骨骼绑定等方式恢复，效率低且不精确。
AI.method: Nova3D 将 3D 资产生成为可执行的 Blender 源代码（.py 文件），编译后得到 glTF (GLB) 网格文件。代码本身即为资产，语义手柄在生成时即存在，而非事后恢复。系统支持文本和图像输入，覆盖六个领域三个难度级别共 54 个项目。
AI.result: 在 Nova3D-Bench 上：54/54 项目成功生成可执行程序与有效资产；每个资产均暴露按父子装配树组织的命名部件（网格原生、CAD、分割基线均不能）；约束满足 51/52（最优基线 11/52）；局部编辑通过率 14/18 且局部性保持 18/18；12 个资产上生成 59 个关节，几何有效 98.3%（基线为零）；几何质量在结构化领域排名第一，整体仅次于最强网格原生模型；纹理真实感不及 PBR 烘焙系统。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是表征层面的：代码原生生成将 3D 对象从"不透明表面"转变为"可编程资产"，下游系统可直接检查、测量、编辑和动画化，而无需额外的逆向工程步骤。

title: Design-Intent Compilation for Heterogeneous Fabrication
summary: Computational fabrication workflows increasingly require designers to specify spatially varying behavior, appearance, material composition, and process state. Yet most workflows force these intentions into printer-specific representations, such as material fractions, voxel labels, mesh partitions, or slicer settings. This coupling makes heterogeneous designs difficult to reuse because each backend requires a different realization of the same property. We present a compiler architecture for heterogeneous fabrication that treats design as a staged, typed lowering problem. A source design consists of implicit geometry and named, typed spatial attribute fields over a shared object domain. These attributes may encode measured data, visual appearance, target mechanical behavior, material recipes, process parameters, or other user-specified attributes. Translation models derive compiler-required realization attributes from source or intent attributes, and backend compilers emit machine-facing outputs such as voxel material stacks, process G-code, or configured slicer project files. This separates source modeling, attribute translation, and backend compilation, allowing a design to remain expressed in fabrication-agnostic terms while each toolchain determines how intent becomes executable instructions. We validate the method through fabricated objects and measurements across sampled volumetric data, CT-derived visual and mechanical models, Shore-hardness fields, and full-color fields, implemented via material jetting and material extrusion. These results show that one source design can be lowered into distinct material, process, and slicer representations without rewriting it in printer-specific terms. We provide the representation, translation framework, compiler interface, and workflows as an open-source Python package to accelerate research in heterogeneous computational fabrication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向异质制造的分阶段、带类型降级的编译器架构，将设计表达为隐式几何与命名空间属性场，通过翻译模型和编译器后端实现从源设计到多类制造输出的解耦转换，并验证了其在立体喷印和材料挤出工艺中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前计算制造工作流要求设计者指定空间变化的属性（行为、外观、材料成分、工艺状态），但大多将这些意图强制绑定到特定打印机的表示形式（如材料分数、体素标签、网格分区或切片器设置），导致异质设计难以在不同后端间复用，因为同一属性需要被不同后端以不同方式实现。
AI.method: 提出一种编译器架构：源设计由隐式几何和命名空间属性场（含测量数据、视觉外观、力学行为、材料配方、工艺参数等）组成；翻译模型从源或意图属性推导编译器所需的实现属性；后端编译器输出面向制造的结果（体素材料栈、加工G-code、切片项目文件等），实现源建模、属性翻译与后端编译的三层解耦。
AI.result: 通过立体喷印和材料挤出工艺制造对象并测量验证，涵盖体素采样数据、CT导出的视觉/力学模型、邵氏硬度场、全色场等，表明同一源设计可降级为不同的材料、工艺和切片器表示而无需重写为打印机专属形式。
AI.conclusion: 该架构有效分离了设计表达与制造后端，提高了异质设计的可复用性和跨平台迁移能力，并以开源Python包形式公开以推动相关研究。

title: Explaining GAND: A Resource on Gender-Ambiguous Natural Data & Contrastive Attribution
summary: Machine translation (MT) systems continue to produce gender-biased translations. In a time where self-expression is paramount, mistranslations based on default behaviour and stereotyping can lead to harm for users of these systems. To better understand how these systems translate gender in the absence of clear gender cues, we need benchmarking resources that reflect gender-ambiguous scenarios in a natural way. To this end, we present GAND, a gender-ambiguous natural data benchmarking resource for MT consisting of English source sentences, specifically designed to analyse the influence of contextual cues on gender in translation. We leverage GAND to conduct an interpretability analysis: we translate a subset of GAND into two grammatical gender languages and extend these with manually crafted contrastive translations. A following feature attribution analysis reveals source words in context that inform the gender translation of an ambiguous referent entity in the target translation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GAND，一个面向机器翻译的性别模糊自然数据基准资源，用于分析上下文线索对翻译中性别选择的影响，并通过特征归因分析揭示了影响性别翻译的关键源词。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译系统存在性别偏见，在缺乏明确性别线索时会产生基于默认行为和刻板印象的错误翻译，对用户造成伤害。目前缺乏自然方式反映性别模糊场景的基准资源来理解这些系统如何处理性别翻译。
AI.method: 构建GAND（性别模糊自然数据基准），包含英语源句；将子集翻译成两种语法性别语言并制作人工对比翻译；进行特征归因分析以识别影响目标翻译中性别选择的上下文源词。
AI.result: 生成了GAND基准资源；通过特征归因分析识别出了影响模糊指代实体性别翻译的关键上下文源词。
AI.conclusion: GAND作为评估资源可用于分析机器翻译中性别偏见的根源，特征归因方法有助于揭示导致性别翻译决策的上下文因素。

title: Concept-based Visual Counterfactual Explanations with Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted at the 4th World Conference on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI 2026)
summary: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to answer "what minimal change to this image would flip the model's prediction?", and are increasingly important as vision models are deployed in safety-critical domains (e.g., medicine). Existing diffusion-based methods can produce realistic edits, but they rely on external classifiers that must work reliably on noisy images, which makes them fragile and hard to deploy for robust explanations. We introduce C-VCE, a new diffusion framework that builds the classifier directly into the generative model via a concept bottleneck layer, so that counterfactuals are guided by human-interpretable features (concepts) instead of a separate noise robust classifier that works with pixel-level edits. Our model lets users to toggle on/off semantic concepts during sampling, then minimally adjusts relevant image regions, while preserving the rest of the image, respecting feature correlations. To keep edits small and controlled, we add a simple probabilistic regularizer that balances "change the prediction" against "stay close to the original", plus a gradient-based mask that confines modifications to the most relevant regions. On benchmarks such as CelebA, C-VCE matches or improves flip rates while producing counterfactuals that are visually closer to the input and less distorted than baselines that depend on separate noisy-image classifiers. These properties make C-VCE a practical tool for vision systems where users need concrete "what-if" images without having to trust an additional, noise-robust classifier. More broadly, our results suggest that exposing and controlling an internal concept layer is a promising way to make powerful generative models easier to understand and safer to use.

AI.tldr: C-VCE是一个将分类器直接构建在生成模型内部的扩散框架，通过概念瓶颈层实现可解释的视觉反事实解释，无需依赖外部噪声鲁棒分类器，在保持图像保真度的同时实现预测翻转。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散的反事实解释方法依赖外部分类器，而外部分类器必须在噪声图像上可靠工作，这导致系统脆弱且难以部署用于鲁棒的解释。
AI.method: 通过概念瓶颈层将分类器直接构建在生成模型内部；引入概率正则化项平衡"改变预测"与"贴近原图"；使用基于梯度的掩码限制修改区域。
AI.result: 在CelebA等基准上，C-VCE匹配或提高了翻转率，同时产生的反事实在视觉上更接近输入、失真更少。
AI.conclusion: 暴露和控制内部概念层是使强大生成模型更易理解和更安全使用的有前景方法。

title: DINOv3-MIL: Per-Kidney Multi-Label Tumour and Cyst Detection from Foundation-Model Patch Tokens on KiTS23
comment: Accepted at MIUA 2026 (poster). To appear in Frontiers in Medical Technology
summary: Foundation vision models trained on natural images transfer to medical tasks without domain pre-training, but volumetric classification requires aggregating tens of thousands of patch tokens per study, and the aggregator constrains how the resulting model can be interpreted. We compare three aggregators on identical frozen DINOv3 ViT-H/16+ features for renal tumour/cyst detection on KiTS23 (966 kidneys; n=97 test): a CLS-token linear probe, gated attention multiple instance learning (MIL) over 55,296 patch tokens, and a prototype head following ProtoViT. Attention MIL achieves the highest AUROC for tumour (0.74, 95% CI 0.64-0.83) and cyst (0.80, 0.70-0.88), with attention enriched 7.5-9.8x over chance within annotated lesions. The prototype head does not transfer to cyst detection (AUROC 0.51), exposing an interpretability-performance trade-off at this token scale.

AI.tldr: 比较三种聚合器（CLS线性探针、门控注意力MIL、原型头）在冻结的DINOv3 ViT-H/16+特征上用于肾脏肿瘤/囊肿检测。注意力MIL在肿瘤（AUROC 0.74）和囊肿（AUROC 0.80）检测中表现最优，注意力在病变区域内富集7.5-9.8倍；原型头在囊肿检测中失效（AUROC 0.51），揭示了该token尺度下可解释性与性能之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 基础视觉模型在自然图像上训练后可迁移到医学任务而无需领域预训练，但体素级分类需要聚合每例研究数万个patch token，而聚合器的选择会限制模型的解释能力。本研究旨在比较不同聚合器在医学影像体积分类中的性能与可解释性权衡。
AI.method: 在KiTS23数据集（966个肾脏，n=97测试）上，使用冻结的DINOv3 ViT-H/16+特征，比较三种聚合器：CLS-token线性探针、基于55,296个patch token的门控注意力多实例学习（MIL）、以及遵循ProtoViT的原型头。
AI.result: 注意力MIL在肿瘤检测（AUROC 0.74, 95% CI 0.64-0.83）和囊肿检测（AUROC 0.80, 95% CI 0.70-0.88）中均取得最高AUROC，其注意力在标注病变区域内富集7.5-9.8倍。原型头在囊肿检测中失败（AUROC 0.51），而CLS线性探针表现居中。
AI.conclusion: 在该大规模token尺度下，注意力MIL在性能与可解释性之间取得了最佳平衡，而原型头虽然可能更具可解释性但牺牲了检测性能，揭示了聚合器选择中存在可解释性与性能的根本权衡。

title: Inter-Reflective Gaussian Splatting for Robust and Efficient Inverse Rendering
summary: Faithful inverse rendering requires visibility and indirect radiance to explain secondary illumination and inter-reflection, yet rasterization-oriented Gaussian representations do not naturally support the secondary-ray queries needed to recover them. We present IRGS++ (Inter-Reflective Gaussian Splatting), a unified robust and efficient Gaussian inverse rendering framework. During transport-aware optimization, IRGS++ employs differentiable 2D Gaussian ray tracing on surface-oriented Gaussian primitives to query visibility and indirect radiance on the fly and evaluate the full rendering equation for inter-reflective transport. This physical core makes Gaussian inverse rendering physically grounded beyond rasterized appearance modeling. To make this backbone useful beyond low-gloss dielectric scenes, the framework incorporates metallic-aware material modeling and robust reflective initialization for glossy, specular, and metallic materials. To make it practical, multiple importance sampling and denoising stabilize finite-sample rendering, while mesh-based secondary-attribute queries reduce the cost of relighting under novel illumination. Quantitative evaluations on low-gloss and glossy benchmarks show improved decomposition and relighting quality together with favorable quality--speed trade-offs under the reported configurations, while real-world studies illustrate plausible relighting under novel illumination.

AI.tldr: IRGS++是一个基于高斯的可逆渲染框架，通过可微分2D高斯光线追踪支持可见性和间接辐射查询，实现了光泽、金属等多种材质的物理可信逆向渲染与重光照，在低光泽和光泽基准上显示出优越的性能与效率平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的光栅化高斯表示无法自然地支持二次光线查询（可见性和间接辐射），导致无法准确解释次生照明和相互反射，因此需要一种支持光线追踪的高斯逆向渲染框架来实现物理可信的渲染方程求解。
AI.method: 采用可微分2D高斯光线追踪在表面导向高斯体素上进行实时可见性和间接辐射查询，结合金属感知材质建模和鲁棒反射初始化处理光泽/金属材质，通过多重重要性采样和去噪稳定有限样本渲染，利用基于网格的次级属性查询降低重光照成本。
AI.result: 在低光泽和光泽基准上表现出改进的分解与重光照质量，在报告配置下具有有利的质量-速度权衡，真实场景实验展示了在新光照下合理的重光照效果。
AI.conclusion: IRGS++使基于高斯的逆向渲染在物理上更可信，超越了光栅化外观建模的限制，为含相互反射的复杂材质场景提供了统一且高效的解决方案。

title: MioFFAn: an Annotation Software for Formula Formalization with LLM Automation Capabilities
comment: Presented in the 3rd International Workshop on Natural Scientific Language Processing (NSLP 2026), co-located at LREC2026
summary: The automatic translation of mathematical expressions in scientific literature into executable symbolic code (a process we refer to as Formula Formalization) is hindered by a severe scarcity of high-quality, ground-truth datasets specialized for technical scientific domains. In this paper, we present MioFFAn, an open-source, document-centric, and customizable framework designed to facilitate rapid annotation for this task. Building upon the MioGatto architecture, we extend existing features to overcome structural limitations and pivot its scope by introducing specific functionalities for Formula Formalization, such as selection of equations of interest and aided symbolic code specification. By allowing users to configure custom taxonomies and properties for identified symbols, and compatible symbolic operators, we ensure the framework is adaptable to diverse specialized scientific fields. Furthermore, MioFFAn is designed to incorporate partial automation via Large Language Models. By defining a modular set of automated sub-tasks with strict output formats, we enable researchers to iteratively refine automation capabilities and evaluate competing strategies using standard NLP metrics. We specify the current automation methodology and perform a preliminary evaluation that demonstrates to efficacy of this human-in-the-loop approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MioFFAn，一个基于MioGatto架构的开源、文档中心、可定制框架，用于科学文献中数学表达式到可执行符号代码（公式形式化）的快速标注，支持自定义分类法、符号属性和大语言模型辅助的迭代自动化。初步评估验证了人在回路方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 科学文献中数学表达式的自动翻译（公式形式化）面临高质量标注数据集严重缺乏的问题。
AI.method: 基于MioGatto架构扩展，引入公式形式化专用功能（公式选择、符号代码辅助指定），支持自定义分类法、符号属性和兼容运算符，采用模块化子任务结合大语言模型实现部分自动化，形成人在回路的工作流程。
AI.result: 初步评估证明了该人在回路方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MioFFAn框架通过可定制设计和迭代自动化能力，为技术科学领域的公式形式化标注提供了灵活高效的解决方案。

title: SeT-Diff: Towards Semantic Foundation Models for HPC Telemetry and Time-Series
summary: Data centers and their compute nodes require accurate and flexible digital twins capable of modeling the complex interplay of workloads, environmental parameters, and physical metrics. Current machine learning approaches for HPC and its telemetry typically rely on a static subset of anonymous, fixed-position sensor variables tailored to single tasks. Consequently, these models become obsolete when target tasks change or sensor metrics vary. We propose SeT-Diff, the first foundational model for compute node telemetry and time-series. Unlike rigid architectures, our diffusion-based approach conditions the generative process on each sensor's semantic description, decoupling the system dynamics from the structure of the dataset. Experiments on a real-world supercomputer dataset demonstrate a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0470 on reconstruction tasks. SeT-Diff exhibits zero-shot permutation stability, maintaining accuracy with negligible degradation even when sensors are shuffled. A single pre-trained model effectively performs data imputation, forecasting, and virtual sensing - achieving a 0.033 MAE in thermal inference - making SeT-Diff an effective data-driven digital twin for HPC systems.

AI.tldr: 提出SeT-Diff，首个基于扩散模型的计算节点遥测时间序列基础模型，通过语义条件生成实现传感器无关的数字孪生，在超算数据集上重建MAE达0.047，并支持数据插补、预测和虚拟传感等零样本任务。
AI.motivation: 现有HPC机器学习方法依赖静态、固定位置的传感器子集，模型在目标任务变更或传感器指标变化时失效，缺乏灵活且通用的数字孪生方案。
AI.method: 基于扩散的生成模型，将生成过程条件化于每个传感器的语义描述上，解耦系统动态与数据集结构，实现与传感器排列无关的建模。
AI.result: 在真实超算数据集上重建MAE为0.047；零样本排列稳定性高，传感器打乱后精度几乎无损失；单个预训练模型在热推断任务上MAE达0.033。
AI.conclusion: SeT-Diff可作为HPC系统高效的数据驱动数字孪生，具备跨任务泛化能力和传感器配置鲁棒性。

title: MegaSlide-DiT: Memory-Centric Adaptation and Deformable Local Attention for Efficient Video Diffusion
summary: High-resolution video diffusion models built on Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver strong fidelity but quickly exhaust the memory budget of a single workstation. A 100 billion-plus parameter DiT easily requires over a terabyte of persistent state, while naive spatiotemporal self-attention grows quadratically in sequence length. These two walls -- parameter memory and activation memory -- prevent researchers from adapting massive generative models without large GPU clusters. We revisit this problem from a systems perspective and introduce MegaSlide-DiT, a prototype that demonstrates how a pre-trained 105B DiT can be adapted on a single H200 GPU with 1.5 TB of host RAM. Our key insight is that the GPU need not own the model state: all persistent weights, master weights and optimizer moments remain in host memory, while only transient shards are streamed to the GPU on demand. Simultaneously, we replace quadratic global attention with 3D Deformable Slide Attention (3D-DSA), a motion-adaptive local attention operator that reduces both memory and computational complexity to linear in the sequence length. We report detailed memory accounting, execution traces and evaluation results to substantiate our design. MegaSlide-DiT does not claim to train a 105B model from scratch on a single GPU, nor does it magically solve bandwidth limits; rather, it offers a pragmatic path for full-parameter adaptation of massive video diffusion models on high-end workstations.

AI.tldr: MegaSlide-DiT提出了一种系统级解决方案，通过将模型状态驻留在主机内存、仅将瞬时分片流式传输到GPU，并用3D可变形滑动注意力替代全局注意力，使得105B参数的扩散Transformer能够在单张H200 GPU（1.5TB主机内存）上进行全参数适配。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视频扩散模型（基于DiT）面临两个瓶颈：参数内存墙（千亿参数模型需超过1TB持久状态）和激活内存墙（朴素时空自注意力导致序列长度二次增长），使得研究者无法在没有大型GPU集群的情况下适配大规模生成模型。
AI.method: 1) 将全部持久权重、主权重和优化器状态驻留在主机内存中，仅将瞬态分片按需流式传输到GPU；2) 提出3D可变形滑动注意力（3D-DSA），一种运动自适应局部注意力算子，将内存和计算复杂度降至序列长度的线性。
AI.result: 提供了详细的内存核算、执行轨迹和评估结果，证明了在单张H200 GPU上适配105B DiT的可行性。
AI.conclusion: MegaSlide-DiT不声称在单GPU上从头训练105B模型，也不神奇地解决带宽限制，而是为在高性能工作站上进行大规模视频扩散模型的全参数适配提供了一条实用路径。

title: Meshless Domain Randomization via Explicit Parameter Perturbation of 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Domain Randomization (DR) is a standard technique for closing the Sim-to-Real gap, yet traditional DR pipelines rely on classical computer graphics rendering driven by polygon meshes. For complex organic subjects, such as insect specimens, extracting and rendering textured meshes is challenging. To address this issue, we propose a meshless DR framework that operates on the parameter space of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Our method employs two independent perturbation pipelines to synthesize randomized training datasets. First, a Photometric DR pipeline alters the baked illumination and color balance by modulating the Spherical Harmonics (SH) coefficients. Second, a Procedural DR pipeline isolates the subject's geometric shape by replacing its original textures with 3D spatial noise. Finally, these perturbed radiance fields are composited over stochastically varied backgrounds using a rasterization engine. Our parameter manipulation provides a meshless alternative for generating robust datasets for complex geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)参数空间的网格无关域随机化框架，通过光照扰动和几何纹理替换两条流水线合成训练数据，为复杂有机体（如昆虫标本）提供无需网格渲染的Sim-to-Real迁移方案。
AI.motivation: 传统域随机化依赖多边形网格的传统计算机图形渲染，但对于昆虫等复杂有机体，提取和渲染带纹理网格极具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出无需网格的DR框架：1) 光度DR流水线：通过调制球谐系数改变烘焙光照和色彩平衡；2) 程序化DR流水线：用3D空间噪声替换原始纹理以隔离几何形状；3) 将扰动后的辐射场在随机变化背景上进行光栅化合成。
AI.result: 以3DGS参数空间为操作对象，实现无需网格的复杂几何体鲁棒数据集生成。
AI.conclusion: 为复杂几何体提供了一种有效的网格无关域随机化替代方案，拓宽了DR在有机体等复杂对象上的适用性。

title: Evaluating the Impact of Reviewer Guideline Design on LLM-Based Automated Peer Review
summary: Peer review is an essential process in scientific research, yet the growing workload has made its automation increasingly necessary. In this study, we analyze how different types of reviewer guidelines, such as official conference guidelines and reviewer-imitating ones generated from high-quality human reviews using LLMs, affect automated peer review. Our experiments show that official conference guidelines produce review results most consistent with human judgments, suggesting that evaluation criteria refined through conference practice serve as effective guidance for automated reviewing as well. In contrast, reviewer-imitating guidelines were generally less effective than official conference guidelines. Furthermore, enforcing strict rubric-style scoring consistently degraded performance, highlighting the importance of allowing subjective and holistic scoring.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了不同类型审稿指南（官方会议指南 vs. 基于LLM生成的模仿人类审稿人的指南）对自动化同行评审的影响，发现官方会议指南最符合人类评审标准，而强制使用严格的评分标准会降低评审性能。
AI.motivation: 同行评审工作量日益增长，自动化评审的需求愈发迫切，但如何设计有效的审稿指南以引导自动化评审系统尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 对比两种审稿指南：官方会议指南和利用LLM从高质量人类评审中生成的模仿型指南，在自动化评审系统中进行实验，并测试严格评分标准与主观整体评分的效果差异。
AI.result: 官方会议指南产生的评审结果与人类判断一致性最高；模仿型指南效果普遍不如官方指南；强制使用严格的评分标准会一致性地降低评审性能。
AI.conclusion: 经会议实践提炼的评估标准能有效指导自动化评审，而僵化的评分规则不利于评审质量，应保留主观和整体性评分空间。

title: QFoldAgent: An Autonomous Quantum Optimization Multi-Agent System for Protein Structure Prediction
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical protein structure prediction depends strongly on Hamiltonian penalty weights, yet existing lattice-based workflows typically fix these coefficients by hand and evaluate only very short fragments in simulation. We present QFoldAgent, a closed-loop multi-agent framework for 5-residue tetrahedral-lattice folding in which a design agent proposes sequence-conditioned penalties, a VQE-based quantum-classical pipeline optimizes the resulting Hamiltonian under Qiskit Aer noise, and a feedback agent uses energy-landscape diagnostics and MolProbity validation signals to refine penalties across cycles. Ground-truth metrics such as RMSD are never exposed to the agents and are used only for evaluation. We study the framework on two complementary datasets: 55 QDockBank-derived fragments with known structures and 100 coverage-optimized unseen sequences. On the QDockBank benchmark, QFoldAgent reduces median RMSD from 3.64 Å to 3.20 Å, with the largest gains on the hardest targets. On unseen sequences, the closed loop raises structural validity from 87.5% to 98.7%, recovers 87% of initially invalid cases, and the strongest controller improves cycle-3 energy on 87% of sequences while maintaining 96% Ramachandran-favored geometry. These results show that iterative agent control can systematically improve optimization behavior and reduce failure cases in a 5-residue quantum setting.

AI.tldr: 提出QFoldAgent，一个用于5残基四面体晶格折叠的闭环多智能体框架，通过设计智能体、VQE量子-经典管道和反馈智能体的迭代优化，在QDockBank基准上将中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å，在未见序列上将结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%，展示了迭代智能体控制对量子场景下优化行为的系统性改进能力。
AI.motivation: 混合量子-经典蛋白质结构预测严重依赖于哈密顿量惩罚权重，但现有基于晶格的工作流通常手动固定这些系数并仅评估极短片段，缺乏系统性的权重优化方法。
AI.method: 提出QFoldAgent闭环多智能体框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 设计智能体根据序列提出条件惩罚权重；(2) VQE量子-经典管道在Qiskit Aer噪声下优化哈密顿量；(3) 反馈智能体利用能量景观诊断和MolProbity验证信号跨周期优化惩罚权重。框架仅依赖可观测信号，不暴露RMSD等真实度量。
AI.result: 在QDockBank基准上，中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å，最难目标提升最大；在未见序列上，结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%，87%的初始无效案例被恢复，最强控制器在87%的序列上改善了周期3能量，同时保持96%的Ramachandran偏好几何。
AI.conclusion: 迭代智能体控制能够系统性改进5残基量子设定下的优化行为并减少失败案例，为混合量子-经典蛋白质结构预测中的超参数优化提供了一种自动化闭环方案。

title: FogDrive: A Multi-Modal Synthetic Driving Dataset for Perception under Graded Fog
summary: Perception under adverse weather remains a critical bottleneck for reliable autonomous driving, yet existing benchmarks lack the systematic multi-modal alignments needed to evaluate robust sensor fusion. Real-world weather datasets suffer from uncontrolled collection and single-level, uncalibrated conditions, while synthetic alternatives either target camera-only restoration or lack the paired clean-and-foggy structure needed to benchmark "defog-then-detect" pipelines. We present FogDrive, a rigorously calibrated, multi-modal autonomous-driving dataset bridging data-centric engineering and robust machine learning. Built with the CARLA simulator, FogDrive contains 660 scenes (~133k fully annotated frames, 50:50 day/night) across four synchronized cameras (RGB, depth, semantic segmentation), a LiDAR and semantic-LiDAR pair, and front radar. Physically consistent fog is modeled independently on camera channels (Koschmieder model) and LiDAR channels (Beer-Lambert law) at three calibrated visibility densities (160m, 100m, 50m). Every scene ships in four matched variants (clean plus three graded fog levels) with cross-calibrated 2D and 3D bounding boxes. A semantic-segmentation-based quality audit over 8k images validates annotations at 95.1% precision and over 99% recall for vehicles within 40m. We establish baseline benchmarks with state-of-the-art architectures (TransFusion, BEVFusion, YOLOv8-m) across two paradigms: 3D multi-modal fusion and 2D image restoration. These yield critical data-centric insights: mixing multi-density fog during training tightens 3D bounding-box geometry without added data-scaling cost, while in 2D pipelines image-quality metrics (PSNR, SSIM) prove poor predictors of downstream detection performance. FogDrive will be fully open-sourced alongside our data-generation framework to accelerate robust, multi-modal research.

AI.tldr: FogDrive是一个在CARLA模拟器中构建的多模态自动驾驶数据集，包含660个场景、约13.3万帧带注释的图像，覆盖四种相机、LiDAR和雷达，在三种可控雾密度下提供配对的干净/有雾数据，支持"去雾-检测"管道评估，并建立了三维多模态融合和二维图像恢复的基线基准。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶感知在恶劣天气下的多模态对齐评估缺乏系统性基准：真实天气数据集存在采集不可控、条件单一且未校准的问题；合成数据集要么只关注相机去雾，要么缺乏配对的干净-有雾结构，无法有效评估"先去雾后检测"的管道。
AI.method: 基于CARLA模拟器构建，包含660个场景（约13.3万帧，昼夜各半），同步四类相机（RGB、深度、语义分割）、LiDAR与语义LiDAR对以及前向雷达。利用Koschmieder模型在相机通道、Beer-Lambert定律在LiDAR通道独立建模物理一致的雾，设置三个校准可见度等级（160m、100m、50m）。每个场景提供四种匹配变体（干净+三级雾）及交叉校准的2D/3D边界框。基于语义分割的质量审计验证了8k图像中40米内车辆的95.1%精确率和超99%召回率。
AI.result: 建立了两个范式的基线基准：三维多模态融合（TransFusion、BEVFusion）和二维图像恢复+检测（YOLOv8-m）。关键数据驱动的洞察包括：训练时混合多密度雾可在不增加数据成本的情况下收紧3D边界框几何；在二维管道中，图像质量指标（PSNR、SSIM）对下游检测性能的预测能力较差。
AI.conclusion: FogDrive将完全开源，包括数据生成框架，以加速鲁棒的多模态自动驾驶研究。

title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Scientific Particle Data Compression and Rendering
comment: 13 pages, 13 figures. Accepted at SC26 (The International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis)
summary: Large-scale particle simulations produce hundreds of millions of particles, straining storage, transfer, and interactive visualization. Existing lossy compressors such as SZ3 operate in data space and provide no guarantees on downstream visualization fidelity. We propose ParticleGS, a visualization-aware framework based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that learns a compact representation directly optimized for rendered image quality, combining (1) a multi-stage, multi-orbit training pipeline, (2) VizMapper, a lightweight network that adapts a single trained model to user-specified visualization parameters at inference time, and (3) spatial block training with KD-tree decomposition and global fine-tuning. On a 281-million-particle HACC cosmological simulation, our 8-block model reaches 30.03 dB PSNR at 65x compression, outperforming SZ3 by 5-8 dB at comparable ratios, and generalizes without tuning to additional HACC regions and a dark-matter-only FIRE-2 simulation. It renders at 662 FPS on a single GPU, over 2,300x faster than ParaView on the full particle data.

AI.tldr: 提出ParticleGS，一种基于3D高斯泼溅的可视化感知压缩框架，通过多阶段训练、VizMapper轻量网络和KD-tree空间分块，在保证渲染质量的同时实现高倍率压缩。在2.81亿粒子的HACC宇宙学模拟上，65倍压缩比下PSNR达30.03 dB，比SZ3高5-8 dB，渲染速度比ParaView快2300倍以上。
AI.motivation: 大规模粒子模拟产生数亿粒子，给存储、传输和交互式可视化带来巨大压力。现有有损压缩器（如SZ3）在数据空间操作，无法保证下游可视化保真度。
AI.method: 提出ParticleGS框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 多阶段、多轨道训练流程；(2) VizMapper——可在推理时将单训练模型适配到用户指定可视化参数的轻量网络；(3) 基于KD-tree分解的空间块训练与全局微调。
AI.result: 在2.81亿粒子的HACC宇宙学模拟上，8块模型在65倍压缩比下达到30.03 dB PSNR，比SZ3高5-8 dB；无需调参即可泛化到其他HACC区域和暗物质FIRE-2模拟；单GPU渲染速度达662 FPS，比ParaView全粒子数据快2300倍以上。
AI.conclusion: ParticleGS作为一种可视化感知的压缩方法，在超高压缩比下仍能保持高质量渲染效果，显著优于传统数据空间压缩器，并具备良好的泛化能力与实时渲染性能。

title: Learning When to Reason for Text-to-SQL via SFT and DPO
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Model checkpoints are available at https://huggingface.co/autothinksql
summary: Recent Text-to-SQL methods rely heavily on reasoning-centric paradigms such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), achieving substantial gains on complex benchmarks at the cost of high inference-time overhead. However, a large fraction of real-world queries are simple lookups or aggregations that can be resolved without multi-step deduction, making forced reasoning wasteful. Thus, we propose AutoThinkSQL, a framework that integrates an auto-thinking mechanism into both Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on Text-to-SQL. Our approach enables the model to dynamically bypass reasoning for simple queries while invoking deep CoT for complex queries. On Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, our method achieves consistent gains compared to the best counterpart baseline on both Spider and BIRD benchmarks while simultaneously reducing average output tokens by 24.6% and 18.3%, and average latency by 17.1% and 11.5% compared to CoT-only generation. Further analysis indicates that the model learns to align its reasoning decisions with query difficulty.

AI.tldr: AutoThinkSQL提出一种自动思考机制，让Text-to-SQL模型在简单查询时跳过推理、复杂查询时使用深度CoT，在Spider和BIRD上取得一致提升，同时减少24.6%/18.3%输出token和17.1%/11.5%延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法过度依赖CoT等推理范式，对简单查询造成不必要的推理开销，浪费计算资源和时间。
AI.method: 在SFT和DPO阶段集成自动思考机制，让模型根据查询难度动态选择是否进行深度链式推理（简单查询跳过推理，复杂查询启用深度CoT）。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B上，相比最强基线在Spider和BIRD均取得一致增益，输出token减少24.6%和18.3%，延迟降低17.1%和11.5%。
AI.conclusion: 模型学会了将推理决策与查询难度对齐，在保持高性能的同时显著提升推理效率。

title: Same Question, Different Answers: Evaluating LLM Reliability Beyond Accuracy
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often achieve strong accuracy on benchmarks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they apply this knowledge when the same question is phrased in different but equivalent ways. In this work, we study how model answers change under meaning-preserving paraphrases across factual question answering and mathematical reasoning tasks. Across four benchmarks and 13 models, we find that model outputs frequently depend on the exact wording of the prompt. While overall accuracy typically changes only modestly across paraphrases, instance-level behavior is far less stable: for many questions, models alternate between correct and incorrect answers depending on phrasing, with mismatch rates reaching more than 23%. Conditioning on questions that are answered correctly in their original form reveals even larger failures measured by answer flip rates, showing that single-prompt correctness is often a poor indicator of reliability. At the same time, we find that models often produce a correct answer for at least one paraphrase of a question, suggesting that the underlying knowledge is present but inconsistently retrieved. Building on this observation, we show that a simple self-paraphrasing strategy can partially recover this latent knowledge and improve performance at inference time. Together, these findings suggest that standard accuracy metrics can mask substantial instability, and that evaluating consistency across equivalent inputs provides a clearer picture of LLM reliability.

AI.tldr: LLMs在标准基准测试中表现良好，但其答案对不同但等价的改写版本高度不稳定。研究发现，虽然整体准确率变化不大，但实例级别的答案翻转率可超过23%，且单次正确性不足以衡量可靠性。一种简单的自改写策略可以部分恢复潜在知识并提升推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法主要关注标准基准测试的总体准确率，但忽视了LLM在等价表述下的答案一致性。为真实评估LLM的可靠性，需要研究模型在保留语义的改写下是否稳定。
AI.method: 在四个基准（事实问答和数学推理）上，对13个模型进行语义保留的改写测试，分析实例级别的答案翻转率和一致性，并提出自改写策略来恢复潜在知识。
AI.result: 模型输出高度依赖于提示的具体措辞；实例级答案翻转率超过23%；单次正确性不可靠；但模型常能在至少一种改写下给出正确答案，表明知识存在但检索不一致。
AI.conclusion: 标准准确率指标掩盖了实质性的不稳定性，评估等价输入下的一致性才能更清晰反映LLM的可靠性；自改写策略可部分恢复潜在知识。

title: MIME: Multimodal Interactive Motion Encoder
summary: Text-motion representation learning has advanced rapidly, with growing interest in multi person interactions for animation, AR/VR, and embodied AI. These settings require representations that align language with both individual actor dynamics and the relationships between actors. We introduce the Multimodal Interactive Motion Encoder (MIME), which, to our knowledge, represents the first dedicated multimodal encoder designed specifically for two person interactive motion. MIME captures individual and shared structure using stream based co-attention with explicit interaction features and curriculum based contrastive training. On Inter-X text-motion retrieval, MIME consistently outperforms early and late fusion baselines across gallery sizes, achieving a 12.8% relative improvement in text-to-motion R@1 at a 2,000-sample gallery. We further evaluate MIME as a frozen auxiliary prior within TIMotion and InterMask on the unseen InterHuman dataset. MIME improves semantic alignment metrics while maintaining comparable FID in TIMotion. These results show that interaction aware multimodal encoding improves multi person motion retrieval and transfers across datasets to support downstream motion generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIME，首个专为双人交互动作设计的多模态编码器，通过流式共注意力、显式交互特征和课程对比学习，在文本-动作检索任务上超越基线方法12.8% R@1，并能作为冻结先验提升下游动作生成的语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 多人物交互场景（动画、AR/VR、具身AI）需要同时对齐语言与个体动作动态及人物间关系，而现有方法缺乏专门针对双人交互动作的多模态编码器。
AI.method: 提出MIME，采用基于流的共注意力机制（stream-based co-attention）捕捉个体与共享结构，引入显式交互特征，并使用课程式对比训练策略进行多模态对齐。
AI.result: 在Inter-X文本-动作检索任务中，MIME在多种图库规模下均优于早期融合和晚期融合基线，2000样本图库中文本到动作R@1相对提升12.8%；作为冻结先验注入TIMotion和InterMask时，提升了语义对齐指标，并在TIMotion中保持可比的FID。
AI.conclusion: 交互感知的多模态编码能够改善多人动作检索性能，并能跨数据集迁移以支持下游动作生成任务。

title: Occlusion-Point Reuse for Ray-Traced Ambient Occlusion and Shadow
summary: Ambient occlusion (AO) and soft shadows are critical visibility cues for spatial perception in real-time rendering. Hardware ray tracing provides a direct way to evaluate these effects, enabling ray-traced AO and area-light shadows that avoid many limitations of screen-space AO and shadow mapping. However, real-time budgets allow only a few rays per pixel, leaving raw ray-traced estimates noisy and expensive. We present an occlusion-point reuse framework that reuses traced samples in the domain of first-hit occlusion points instead of directly reusing final shading values or light samples. This provides a ray-reuse formulation for AO, rather than merely filtering or reusing completed AO values. The key idea is to transform AO and area-light shadow estimators into occluder-domain integrals, then combine neighboring occluder samples with a multiple-importance-sampling (MIS) formulation. For both AO and shadows, we derive unbiased estimators that validate convergence to the transformed integrals, as well as biased estimators designed for practical real-time execution. The biased variants assume local first-hit occluder consistency; for shadows, this occluder-based assumption better matches local visibility geometry than the visibility-consistency assumption commonly used when reusing light samples. Experiments show higher AO and shadow quality than non-reuse ray-traced baselines, and better shadow quality than light-sample reuse at comparable cost.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于遮挡点重用的框架，通过在首次命中遮挡点域复用追踪样本，结合多重重要性采样公式，实现环境光遮蔽和软阴影的高效光线追踪渲染，在实时预算下比传统方法质量更高。
AI.motivation: 实时渲染中，硬件光线追踪能以较少光线实现AO和软阴影，但受限于每像素仅少数光线，原始光线追踪估计噪声大且计算昂贵。现有方法（如屏幕空间AO、阴影贴图）存在局限性，而直接复用最终着色值或光源样本的方式不够有效。
AI.method: 将AO和面光源阴影估计器转化为遮挡物域积分，然后结合多重重要性采样（MIS）公式组合邻域遮挡物样本。推导了无偏估计器（验证收敛性）和面向实时执行的偏置估计器。偏置变体假设局部首次命中遮挡物一致性；对阴影而言，基于遮挡物的假设比常用的光源样本重用的可见性一致性假设更匹配局部可见性几何。
AI.result: 与无复用的光线追踪基线相比，AO和阴影质量更高；与同等计算成本下的光源样本复用相比，阴影质量更好。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的遮挡点复用框架是实时光线追踪中AO和软阴影渲染的有效方法，通过遮挡物域积分和MIS公式的巧妙结合，在极低光线预算下实现了比现有方法更优的质量。

title: Between Suppression and Collapse: Evaluating Narrative Unlearning with LENS
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce disinformation-aligned narrative frames as plausible explanations, raising the question of whether existing machine-unlearning algorithms can suppress this behavior. We introduce Level-based Evaluation of Narrative Suppression (LENS), a contextualization based evaluation protocol for testing target narrative reproduction across direct, attributed, contrastive, and abstract resistance levels. We evaluate two source-grounded narratives: one framing Russia's war against Ukraine as forced by NATO expansion, and one framing the United States as exploiting or abandoning Taiwan. The experiments cover four near-12B multilingual instruction models: Lapa LLM, Gemma-12B, Qwen-14B, and TAIDE-Gemma.
  We introduce the Suppression-Collapse Efficiency (SCE) score as a checkpoint selection summary that rewards target-narrative suppression while penalizing degraded outputs. Our results shows that selected checkpoints can reduce narrative reproduction and suppression may transfer beyond direct forget prompts. We also report entity recovery as a separate side effect: abstract A/B/C prompts can cause models to recover the real-world actors associated with the target frame after unlearning. These findings demonstrate that LENS is a successful diagnostic protocol for both reporting and guiding the further study of the deeper structure of narrative unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LENS评估协议，用于检测大语言模型在机器遗忘后是否仍会复述特定叙事框架（如俄乌战争、台湾问题）。实验表明，该方法能有效评估遗忘效果，并提出SCE分数作为检查点选择指标，同时发现实体恢复作为副作用。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能够复述与虚假信息一致的叙事框架，现有机器遗忘算法能否抑制这种行为尚不明确，需要系统性的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出LENS评估协议，包含直接、归因、对比和抽象抵抗四个层级的叙事复述测试，并引入SCE分数作为检查点选择摘要指标。
AI.result: 选定的检查点能减少叙事复述，遗忘效果可迁移至直接遗忘提示之外的场景；存在实体恢复副作用，即抽象A/B/C提示可使模型恢复目标框架中的真实世界参与者。
AI.conclusion: LENS是成功的诊断协议，可用于报告和指导叙事遗忘更深层结构的研究。

title: DeepLens Diagnosis Agent: Agentic Workflow Design Lets a Small Reasoning Model Compete with Frontier LLMs
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Technical report, John Snow Labs
summary:
Medical diagnosis is a multi-stage process: extract facts, consult knowledge, generate a differential analysis, and select the best diagnosis with explanations. Frontier LLMs are strong generalists, but single-shot prompting often yields brittle diagnostic reasoning. We present the DeepLens Diagnosis Agent, a five-stage harnessing pipeline (combining model capabilities with disciplined process constraints) centered on a small medical reasoning model (JSL Medical Small 7B v2) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The pipeline enforces structured clinical extraction, disciplined retrieval, constrained candidate generation, explicit evidence triangulation, and an auditable final decision. On the 915-case DiagnosisArena benchmark, the agent achieved 60.14% top-1 diagnostic accuracy, the highest among small and medium-sized models. The same model without the agent workflow achieved 23.99%, a +36-point gain from workflow design alone, despite 88.2% on standard medical benchmarks, showing that diagnostic reasoning under uncertainty requires more than knowledge recall. The agent costs USD 0.0072 per case (24K tokens on A100) with 24-second latency, 35-45% cheaper than Claude Sonnet 4.5 (USD 0.0110) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (USD 0.0128) while outperforming them by +9.70pp and +9.17pp. Harnessing can also correct frontier model failures; workflow constraints can outweigh parameter count or API cost.
  Beyond aggregate accuracy, the pipeline produces structured intermediate artifacts that make each stage inspectable and support error localization. These properties support high-stakes settings where traceability, reproducibility, and auditable evidence matter alongside benchmark performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepLens Diagnosis Agent，一个五阶段诊断管线（结构化临床提取→检索增强生成→约束候选生成→证据三角验证→可审计决策），基于7B医疗小模型和RAG，在915例DiagnosisArena上达到60.14% top-1准确率，比无管线版本提升36个百分点，成本仅$0.0072/例，性能超越Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro，且全过程可审计。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在医疗诊断中虽有强通用能力，但单次提示（single-shot prompting）推理脆弱；且诊断是多阶段过程（事实提取→知识检索→鉴别分析→最佳诊断），需要结构化的过程约束而非仅靠知识回忆。
AI.method: 构建五阶段诊断管线：（1）结构化临床提取；（2）检索增强生成（RAG）实现有纪律的检索；（3）约束候选生成；（4）显式证据三角验证；（5）可审计最终决策。核心模型为JSL Medical Small 7B v2。
AI.result: 在DiagnosisArena（915例）上top-1准确率60.14%，小/中型模型中最高；相同模型无管线仅23.99%（+36pp增益）；成本$0.0072/例（24K tokens），延迟24秒；比Claude Sonnet 4.5便宜35-45%且准确率高9.70pp；比Gemini 3.1 Pro便宜且高9.17pp。
AI.conclusion: 诊断推理在不确定性下需要超越知识回忆的过程约束；管线设计（harnessing）能纠正前沿模型失败，权重约束效果可超越参数规模和API成本；结构化中间产物支持审计、可追溯和错误定位，适用于高风险医疗场景。

title: Histopathological Spectrum-Guided Prostate Stratification via Segmentation-Assisted Diagnostic Transformer
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, and 4 tables. Code will be made publicly available in a future revision
summary: Prostate cancer diagnosis with multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) is commonly based on PI-RADS assessment or binary classification, which suffer from subjectivity and fail to capture clinically relevant pathological heterogeneity. To address this limitation, we construct a Prostate Cancer Histopathology Spectrum Dataset (PCa-HSD) and formulate a clinically meaningful four-class classification task, addressing the underrepresentation of benign lesions that are easily confounded with prostate cancer in existing datasets. We propose Language-guided Segmentation-assisted Diagnostic Transformer model (LSDT), which leverages zero-shot segmentation to provide anatomical priors and performs effective multi-modal slice fusion for classification. Our proposed method consistently improves accuracy across backbones, achieving the best average accuracy of 0.633 and JointRecall of 0.768 in five-fold cross-validation on a cohort of 344 patients. These results demonstrate that integrating pathology supervision and anatomical priors significantly enhances fine-grained prostate MRI classification and provides a more clinically relevant paradigm for risk stratification. Code will be made publicly available in a future revision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出前列腺癌组织病理学谱系数据集(PCa-HSD)及语言引导分割辅助诊断Transformer模型(LSDT)，通过四分类任务和零样本分割解剖先验提升mpMRI诊断精度，在344名患者上达到0.633准确率和0.768联合召回率。
AI.motivation: 现有前列腺癌mpMRI诊断依赖PI-RADS评估或二分类，存在主观性强且无法捕捉临床相关病理异质性的问题，同时现有数据集缺乏易与前列腺癌混淆的良性病变样本。
AI.method: 构建PCa-HSD数据集并定义四分类任务；提出LSDT模型，利用零样本分割提供解剖先验知识，执行有效的多模态切片融合用于分类。
AI.result: 在344名患者队列的五折交叉验证中，平均准确率0.633，联合召回率0.768，且在不同骨干网络上均有一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 整合病理监督与解剖先验能显著提升前列腺MRI细粒度分类性能，为临床风险分层提供了更相关的范式。

title: Neural Representation of Minimal Surfaces
summary: We propose a neural representation for minimal surfaces. Unlike prior approaches based on discretization or Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), where meshes or neural fields are optimized to approximate the governing equations, our method builds on an exact representation, similar to the classical Weierstrass--Enneper parameterization, yielding minimal surfaces up to negligible quadrature error in evaluation. We formulate a training objective for the Plateau problem that optimizes over this representation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Weierstrass-Enneper参数化的极小曲面神经表示方法，通过精确表示而非近似求解，实现了可忽略求积误差的极小曲面计算。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如离散化或PINNs）通过优化网格或神经场来近似控制方程，存在近似误差；本文旨在建立一种精确的极小曲面表示方法，消除近似误差。
AI.method: 基于经典的Weierstrass-Enneper参数化方法构建极小曲面的精确神经表示，针对Plateau问题设计训练目标，在该表示空间中进行优化。
AI.result: 所得极小曲面在求值过程中仅有可忽略的求积误差，实现了高精度表示。
AI.conclusion: 该方法结合了经典参数化理论的精确性与神经表示的灵活性，为极小曲面求解提供了一种高精度替代方案。

title: PatiGonit22K: A Comprehensive Dataset for Solving Complex Bengali MWPs
summary: Mathematical Word Problems (MWPs) are an important benchmark for evaluating natural language understanding and quantitative reasoning. Despite recent progress in high resource languages, Bengali remains underexplored due to the limited availability of large scale annotated datasets. In this work, we introduce PatiGonit22K, an expanded Bengali MWP dataset containing 22,441 problems, developed by extending the original PatiGonit dataset with a substantially larger collection of complex mathematical problems. The dataset includes both simple and multi operation equations, providing a balanced benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning across different difficulty levels. Each problem is carefully translated, annotated, culturally adapted, and verified to ensure linguistic consistency and mathematical correctness. By increasing both the scale and complexity of Bengali MWPs, PatiGonit22K provides a more comprehensive resource for future research on mathematical reasoning and educational NLP applications in low resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PatiGonit22K，一个包含22,441道题的孟加拉语数学应用题数据集，通过扩展原有PatiGonit数据集并增加复杂题目构建而成，旨在为低资源语言中的数学推理研究提供更全面的基准资源。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语作为低资源语言，缺乏大规模标注的数学应用题数据集，限制了该语言在数学推理和自然语言理解方面的研究进展。
AI.method: 基于原有PatiGonit数据集进行扩展，新增大量复杂数学问题，包含简单和多步运算方程，对所有题目进行翻译、标注、文化适配和验证，确保语言一致性和数学正确性。
AI.result: 构建了PatiGonit22K数据集，包含22,441道孟加拉语数学应用题，涵盖不同难度级别，实现了数据集规模和复杂度的显著提升。
AI.conclusion: PatiGonit22K为低资源语言（尤其是孟加拉语）的数学推理研究和教育NLP应用提供了更全面、更均衡的基准资源。

title: MIITA: Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation for Continual Learning with Small Language Models
summary: Continual learning (CL) is essential for small language models (SLMs) to adapt to evolving real-world needs in resource-constrained deployments. However, directly updating their limited parameter space causes catastrophic forgetting. While memory-based methods naturally address this by decoupling knowledge retention from parameters, existing approaches designed for large language models (LLMs) rely on abundant storage and strong in-context reasoning that SLMs lack. To address these challenges, we propose MIITA, a Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation framework for supervised CL under constrained storage. MIITA stores supervised experiences as compact correction-direction prototypes with semantic anchors, and retrieves them at inference time using semantic and uncertainty-based cues. The retrieved directions are applied through gated temporary hidden-state adaptation, enabling non-destructive reuse of past supervision without backbone updates, prompt extensions, or test-time backpropagation. A local theoretical analysis links this design to first-order loss reduction, uncertainty-guided retrieval, and directional coverage for retaining old-stage knowledge. Extensive experiments across diverse supervised CL settings show that MIITA consistently improves final performance and mitigates forgetting under fixed memory budgets.

AI.tldr: MIITA是一个面向资源受限场景下小语言模型的记忆诱导推理时自适应框架，通过存储压缩修正方向原型和语义锚点，在推理时基于语义和不确定性线索检索并应用门控临时隐藏状态自适应，无需更新主干网络或提示扩展即可实现增量学习。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型在持续学习中直接更新参数空间有限，导致灾难性遗忘。现有基于记忆的方法依赖大语言模型充足的存储和强大的上下文推理能力，不适用于小语言模型。
AI.method: 将监督经验存储为带有语义锚点的压缩修正方向原型；推理时基于语义和不确定性线索检索；通过门控临时隐藏状态自适应应用检索到的修正方向；无需主干网络更新、提示扩展或测试时反向传播。
AI.result: 在多种监督持续学习设置下，MIITA在固定记忆预算内一致提升最终性能并缓解遗忘。
AI.conclusion: MIITA通过非破坏性的推理时自适应机制，有效解决了小语言模型在资源受限环境下的持续学习问题，为存储受限场景提供了可行的增量学习方案。

title: Visible-Light Imaging Diagnosis of Neutral Particle Emission Tomography in the Tokamak Divertor: An Efficient Transformer-based Surrogate Model
summary: Nuclear fusion has made significant progress in recent years and is expected to become one of the most important pathways to addressing global energy challenges. This paper focuses on observing plasma using visible-light cameras, analyzing its spatio-temporal motion cues, and predicting the two-dimensional spatial distribution of light intensity, aiming to provide a foundational basis for future scientific experiments using deep neural networks. Specifically, we propose Delta-InvFormer, a novel backbone network centered on a differential Transformer. The key insight is that by taking consecutive video frames as input, we can better capture the dynamics of the plasma. Moreover, spatial and temporal differential self-attention effectively mitigates interference from noisy signals, ensuring high-quality feature extraction. These features are then fused into a compact and informative representation, which is fed into a decoder network to predict the distribution. Based on real experimental data collected from the Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak (EAST) large-scale scientific facility, our results demonstrate that the proposed model not only significantly accelerates traditional methods for distribution prediction but also achieves competitive reconstruction accuracy. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion

AI.tldr: 提出Delta-InvFormer，一种基于差分Transformer的骨干网络，通过可见光相机观测等离子体视频帧，利用时空差分自注意力机制抑制噪声，预测二维光强空间分布，在EAST托卡马克数据上实现快速且准确的预测。
AI.motivation: 利用可见光相机观测等离子体，分析其时空运动线索，并通过深度神经网络预测二维光强空间分布，为未来科学实验提供基础依据。
AI.method: 提出Delta-InvFormer骨干网络，核心是基于差分Transformer，以连续视频帧为输入，通过空间和时间的差分自注意力机制有效抑制噪声干扰，提取高质量特征并融合为紧凑表示，送入解码器预测分布。
AI.result: 在EAST托卡马克真实实验数据上，该方法相比传统方法显著加速了分布预测，同时达到了有竞争力的重建精度。
AI.conclusion: Delta-InvFormer能够有效捕捉等离子体动态变化，在加速预测的同时保持高精度，为核聚变等离子体观测提供了新的深度学习解决方案。

title: TexSketch: Bringing Texture-Aware Colorization to Sketches
summary: Reference-based sketch colorization methods rely on large paired datasets that preserve both the structural and stylistic characteristics of hand-drawn artwork. However, existing datasets are limited in scale, expensive to annotate, and bound to fixed, often inconsistent artistic style biases that propagate to downstream models and limit cross-domain generalization. We present TexSketch, a controllable procedural framework for generating colored-sketch datasets with programmable artistic styles via geometric analysis and shader-driven stylization. Our fully automatic pipeline integrates region extraction, semantic color prediction, and shader-based rendering. By defining artistic appearance procedurally rather than inheriting it from a static corpus, TexSketch enables scalable dataset generation without manual annotation or artist supervision. Human studies demonstrate that TexSketch generates perceptually plausible colored sketches with high stylistic diversity, providing a controllable, scalable source of synthetic supervision for sketch colorization.

AI.tldr: TexSketch是一个可编程的程序化框架，通过几何分析和着色器驱动风格化自动生成彩色草图数据集，无需人工标注，解决了现有数据集规模小、风格固定且泛化能力差的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有参考图像草图着色方法依赖大规模成对数据集，但现有数据集规模有限、标注成本高，且受限于固定且不一致的艺术风格偏差，导致下游模型跨域泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 提出TexSketch程序化框架，通过全自动流水线集成区域提取、语义颜色预测和着色器渲染，利用几何分析和着色器驱动风格化，以程序化方式定义艺术外观而非从静态语料库继承。
AI.result: 人类研究表明TexSketch能生成感知上合理的彩色草图，具有高风格多样性，为草图着色提供了可控、可扩展的合成监督源。
AI.conclusion: TexSketch实现了无需人工标注或艺术家监督的可扩展数据集生成，其可控、可扩展的合成监督方式有望推动草图着色领域的跨域泛化研究。

title: CHiPS: Character Histograms and Positional Signals for Lightweight Authorship Attribution in Romanian Texts
summary: We propose CHiPS, a lightweight character-level authorship attribution method for Romanian texts. All reported experiments are closed-set: the true author is one of the candidate authors in the training data. CHiPS studies two complementary fingerprints of writing style: CH-SVM, a character-histogram classifier based on one-character marginal distributions, and FFT12-LR, a positional-signal classifier that represents selected characters and punctuation classes as impulse trains (binary indicator sequences over character positions) and extracts Fourier/Welch spectral descriptors. We also report CHiPS-F, a leakage-safe decision-level fusion variant, and an optional top-5 listwise reranker trained only on out-of-fold predictions. The method requires no tokenization, syntactic analysis, pretrained language model, or transformer fine-tuning, and it avoids character $n$-gram features with $n \geq 2$ in the histogram component. On a locked grouped ROST split comprising 400 files from 392 source-text groups, written by 10 authors, with source-text-level evaluation and grouped five-fold model selection, CHiPS-F reaches 0.9310 accuracy and 0.9341 macro-F1. A matched but unrestricted character 2--5-gram TF--IDF SVM comparator reaches 1.0000 accuracy and macro-F1 on the same held-out groups, so the contribution is not a claim of best possible classification accuracy. Instead, the experiments ask how far restricted, transparent character evidence can go under strict leakage control. On ROSTories-cleaned, a secondary ROST-overlapping corpus comprising 1,248 files from 1,240 source-text groups, written by 19 authors, the same protocol gives 0.8919 accuracy and 0.8708 macro-F1 for CHiPS-R.

AI.tldr: CHiPS是一种轻量级的罗马尼亚语文本作者归属方法，通过字符直方图（CH-SVM）和位置信号（FFT12-LR）两种互补特征进行作者识别，在严格控制数据泄露的条件下，ROST数据集上达到0.9310准确率，并探讨了受限、透明的字符证据在作者归因中的极限。
AI.motivation: 探索在严格泄漏控制下，仅使用受限的、透明的字符级特征（而非复杂模型如Transformer或N-gram）能在作者归属任务上达到怎样的性能极限，为轻量级、可解释的作者分析提供基准。
AI.method: 提出CHiPS框架，包含两个互补分类器：CH-SVM基于单字符边际分布的直方图特征，FFT12-LR将选定字符和标点类表示为脉冲序列并提取傅里叶/韦尔奇频谱描述符。使用决策级融合（CHiPS-F）和基于出折预测的Top-5列表重排序器。无需分词、句法分析、预训练语言模型或Transformer微调，且避免使用n≥2的字符N-gram特征。
AI.result: 在ROST数据集（400文件，10位作者）上，CHiPS-F达到0.9310准确率和0.9341宏F1；在ROStories-cleaned数据集（1248文件，19位作者）上，CHiPS-R达到0.8919准确率和0.8708宏F1。作为对比，无限制的字符2-5gram TF-IDF SVM达到1.0000准确率和宏F1。
AI.conclusion: CHiPS的贡献不在于追求最高分类精度，而在于证明了在严格泄漏控制下，受限的、透明的字符级证据仍能取得有竞争力的性能，为可解释的轻量级作者归属提供了可行方案。

title: Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation
summary: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. Instead of prompting an LLM at the evaluation time, we distill its decision logic into a committee of programs that score candidates directly. These programmatic judges offer transparency, are easily inspected or edited, and eliminate per-sample API costs. Building on this notion, we introduce PAJAMA, a system that synthesizes programs as judges, aggregates their decisions into a joint verdict, and incorporates a fallback mechanism to selectively escalate low-confidence cases to an LLM. Across five datasets and four model families, we show that programmatic judges can match the performance of a 13B-size LLM judge. When using program outputs as routing signals, PAJAMA improves both accuracy and throughput and advances the Pareto frontier. Beyond evaluation, programmatic judges produce cheap and effective reward signals: on RewardBench, a reward model distilled from programs' verdicts outperforms one trained on a proprietary LLM's labels at two orders of magnitude lower API cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAJAMA系统，通过程序蒸馏将LLM的决策逻辑转化为可解释、低成本的程序化评审委员会，在匹配13B LLM评审性能的同时大幅降低API成本，并在RewardBench上以两个数量级更低的成本超越基于专有LLM的奖励模型。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge评估范式存在高成本、高延迟和决策不透明等局限性，削弱了其可扩展性和可靠性。作者希望设计一种简单高效的替代方案，在保持评估质量的同时降低成本并提升可解释性。
AI.method: 提出程序蒸馏（program distillation）方法，将LLM的决策逻辑蒸馏为一组可直接对候选答案打分的程序化评审；构建PAJAMA系统，包含程序合成、委员会聚合判决和低置信度回退机制（fallback to LLM）三个模块。
AI.result: 在5个数据集和4个模型族上，程序化评审可匹配13B LLM评审的性能；PAJAMA通过路由信号提升了准确率和吞吐量，推进了Pareto前沿；在RewardBench上，基于程序裁决蒸馏的奖励模型以两个数量级更低的API成本超越了基于专有LLM标签训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 程序化评审是LLM-as-a-judge的高效替代方案，兼具透明性、可编辑性和低成本优势，且在奖励信号蒸馏等下游任务中展现出显著优势。

title: EditCLEVR: A Paired-Scene Intervention Benchmark for Compositional Faithfulness of Object-Centric Representations
summary: Object-centric learning aims to represent scenes as objects whose properties can be reused in new combinations. Existing evaluations usually score segmentation, single-image factor prediction, or downstream accuracy, but these tests do not directly ask whether a per-object representation behaves correctly under a controlled semantic edit. We introduce EditCLEVR, a paired-scene intervention benchmark in which each example contains a before/after pair of CLEVR-style renders with the same object indices and scene layout, and either exactly one known attribute change on one known object or a no-edit re-render for drift measurement. The protocol includes probe-free diagnostics for representation-change localization and stability, together with probe-decoded semantic faithfulness metrics that test whether the predicted scene change matches the intended intervention across in-distribution and compositional out-of-distribution (OOD) suites, allowing code-space movement and decoded object-attribute correctness to be evaluated separately. We introduce the semantic metric Scene-Graph Intervention Accuracy (SGIA), which requires the full after-scene prediction to be correct and the only predicted before-to-after semantic change to be the intended object-factor edit. We also establish Delta-SGIA as a companion diagnostic that checks the single-site change pattern without requiring the full after-scene graph to be correct. Baseline evaluations on ground-truth-mask backbones, learned-slot models, SAM 2 + frozen-ViT models, and one mask-feature hybrid indicate that CoGenT-OOD-core degradation can persist under ground-truth instance masks, that mask source accounts for part but not all of native performance, and that locality or stability alone can overstate semantic faithfulness. Code is available at https://github.com/torux-bughunter/EditCLEVR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EditCLEVR基准，通过成对场景干预测试对象中心表征的语义编辑能力，发现现有模型在语义忠实度上存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有对象中心学习评估（分割、因子预测、下游精度）无法直接检验对象表征在受控语义编辑下的行为正确性，缺乏对表征变化定位与语义忠实度的直接诊断。
AI.method: 构建EditCLEVR配对场景干预基准，包含前后成对的CLEVR渲染图（同一对象索引和布局，仅一个已知属性变化或无编辑重渲染）；提出无探针的表征变化定位与稳定性诊断，以及探测解码的语义忠实度指标Scene-Graph Intervention Accuracy (SGIA)和Delta-SGIA，分别要求完整后场景预测正确和仅检测单点变化模式。
AI.result: 在GT掩码骨干、学习型槽模型、SAM2+冻结ViT及掩码-特征混合模型上的评估表明：CoGenT-OOD核退化在GT实例掩码下依然存在；掩码来源解释了部分但非全部原生性能；仅局部性或稳定性指标会高估语义忠实度。
AI.conclusion: EditCLEVR揭示了现有对象中心模型在语义编辑忠实度上的关键短板，SGIA/Delta-SGIA提供了比传统分割或因子预测更严格的评估手段。

title: A Smooth Explicit Elastoplastic--Damage Update for Graphics Simulation
summary:
History-dependent solids require material updates that preserve irreversible deformation and progressive degradation during loading, unloading, and reloading. We present a compact, vectorizable elastoplastic-damage update for explicit graphics simulation, designed for smooth activation and closed-form evaluation rather than exact yield-surface enforcement. A softplus function generates a candidate equivalent plastic strain, a maximum-history projection enforces irreversibility, and a deviatoric plastic-strain tensor retains the residual direction. An exponential scalar degradation variable is driven by the stored history. The active and frozen branches are evaluated analytically from one response energy without a local Newton solve.
  We evaluate the method using one-dimensional cyclic tension, two-dimensional cantilever bending, controlled three-dimensional platen compression, and a genus-one torus. The results verify residual deformation, monotone internal variables, branchwise energy-gradient agreement, and mesh-resolution sensitivity. An analytical J2 radial-return baseline is compared both as a vectorized kernel and within the same structural solver. The baseline is 1.51--3.08 times faster as a kernel and 1.69 times faster in the structural material update, showing that our contribution is smoothness and implementation simplicity rather than raw speed. A path-direction sweep gives 1.53% normalized equivalent-stress error under proportional loading but 49.39% for a fixed-magnitude 90-degree turn. This quantifies the method's intended restriction to isotropic, proportional or nearly proportional loading; it is not a replacement for general return mapping, anisotropic damage, or phase-field fracture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于显式图形仿真的紧凑、可向量化的弹塑性损伤更新方法，采用软加函数生成候选等效塑性应变、最大历史投影确保不可逆性、指数标量退化变量驱动损伤，无需局部牛顿迭代即可解析计算。该方法在保持光滑性和实现简洁性的前提下，适用于比例或近比例加载场景，但不能替代通用返回映射、各向异性损伤或相场断裂方法。
AI.motivation: 历史相关固体需要能够在加载、卸载和再加载过程中保持不可逆变形和渐进退化的材料更新方法。现有方法在图形仿真中面临计算效率与物理精度之间的权衡，需要一种兼顾光滑激活、闭式求解且无需局部牛顿迭代的更新方案。
AI.method: 使用softplus函数生成候选等效塑性应变，通过最大历史投影强制执行不可逆性，利用偏塑性应变张量保留残余方向，并由存储的历史变量驱动指数标量退化变量。活跃分支和冻结分支均从单一响应能量解析求解，无需局部牛顿迭代。
AI.result: 在一维循环拉伸、二维悬臂弯曲、受控三维板压缩及环面模型上验证了残余变形、单调内变量、分叉能量梯度一致性及网格分辨率敏感性。与解析J2径向返回基线相比，本文方法在核函数速度上慢1.51-3.08倍，结构材料更新慢1.69倍。路径方向扫描显示比例加载下等效应力误差为1.53%，而90度固定幅值转向时误差升至49.39%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了光滑性与实现简洁性，但以原始速度为代价，适用于各向同性、比例或近比例加载场景，不适用于通用返回映射、各向异性损伤或相场断裂问题。

title: Simple Language Normalization Wins: Cross-Lingual Speaker Verification for the TidyVoice 2026 Challenge
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures (submitted to the TidyVoice challenge colocated with Interspeech2026)
summary: Cross-lingual mismatch remains a key source of overall degradation in modern speaker verification. The TidyVoice2026 Challenge targets this setting with text-independent verification, comprising 3,666 training and 808 development speakers in 40 languages and 2,200 evaluation speakers in 38 unseen languages, without language labels at test time. Starting from the official SimAM-ResNet34 baseline pretrained on VoxBlink2 and VoxCeleb2 and fine-tuned on TidyVoice, we revisit Nuisance Attribute Projection (NAP) as a simple language-normalization step in the embedding space. We estimate a compact language subspace from cross-language same-speaker differences and project embeddings onto its orthogonal complement before cosine scoring with Adaptive Symmetric score normalization. This reduces development EER from 2.97\% with cosine and 2.70\% with AS-Norm to 2.18\% and yields a Codabench evaluation score of 8.40, showing that simple back-end language normalization can rival more complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在说话人验证中，通过 nuisance attribute projection (NAP) 在嵌入空间进行语言归一化，有效缓解跨语言不匹配问题，在 TidyVoice2026 Challenge 上将开发集 EER 从 2.97% 降至 2.18%，Codabench 评估得分 8.40。
AI.motivation: 跨语言不匹配是当前说话人验证系统性能下降的主要原因，而现有方法通常忽略测试时的语言标签缺失问题，需要一种无需语言标签的简单后端归一化方法。
AI.method: 基于 SimAM-ResNet34 基线模型，在嵌入空间中使用 nuisance attribute projection (NAP) 估计紧凑的语言子空间，将嵌入投影到其正交补空间上，并结合自适应对称分数归一化 (AS-Norm) 进行余弦打分。
AI.result: 开发集 EER 从余弦打分的 2.97% 和 AS-Norm 的 2.70% 降至 2.18%，Codabench 评估得分 8.40。
AI.conclusion: 简单的后端语言归一化方法即可媲美更复杂的系统，验证了 NAP 在跨语言说话人验证中的有效性。

title: SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent
summary: Managing long-context dependencies remains a primary bottleneck in LLM agents, as redundant and irrelevant information can degrade multi-step reasoning. Strategic Forgetting for Agent Memory Systems (SF-AMS) is proposed as a framework for maintaining compact high-utility memory by modeling the long-term importance of memory units. SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism that updates memory importance from usage redundancy and temporal signals, inducing a hierarchical memory structure that prioritizes stable entity-consistent information while filtering noise. On top of this, Composite Importance Scoring integrates semantic and entity level signals to improve retrieval robustness. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-s show consistent gains over strong state of the art baselines including LightMem MemO and A-Mem. The largest improvement appears in multi-hop reasoning under Qwen2.5-7B where SF-AMS achieves plus 9.65 F1 over the strongest baseline followed by temporal reasoning under GPT-4o-mini plus 6.91 F1 and open-domain tasks plus 6.53 F1 demonstrating strong cross backbone generalization. These results show that modeling memory importance as a dynamic utility signal is critical for reliable long-context reasoning.

AI.tldr: SF-AMS通过效用驱动的记忆生存机制替代静态检索和启发式衰减，结合复合重要性评分（语义+实体级别信号），实现紧凑高效用记忆管理，在多跳推理、时序推理和开放域任务上显著超越LightMem、MemO、A-Mem等基线。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在处理长上下文时，冗余和无关信息会降级多步推理能力，现有静态检索和启发式衰减方法无法有效维护紧凑高效用记忆。
AI.method: 提出SF-AMS框架：1) 效用驱动的生存机制，根据使用冗余度和时间信号动态更新记忆重要性；2) 诱导层级记忆结构，优先保留稳定实体一致性信息；3) 复合重要性评分，融合语义级和实体级信号提升检索鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-s上，SF-AMS全面超越LightMem、MemO、A-Mem等基线。最大提升：Qwen2.5-7B多跳推理+9.65 F1，GPT-4o-mini时序推理+6.91 F1，开放域任务+6.53 F1。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆重要性建模为动态效用信号是实现可靠长上下文推理的关键，SF-AMS展现了跨骨干网络的强泛化能力。

title: LowAux-RDNet: Low-Pass Residual Supervision with Scene-Balanced Real-World Training for Single-Image Reflection Removal
summary: Single-image reflection removal aims to recover a clean transmission layer from one image captured through glass. We study an explicit decomposition pipeline built on RDNet and introduce LowAux, a training-only low-pass reflection auxiliary objective. The original residual target remains the main reflection supervision, while symmetrically filtered prediction and target provide a stable low-frequency constraint. We further incorporate scene-balanced real pairs from RRW to broaden real-scene coverage and improve cross-dataset generalization. To avoid evaluation discrepancies caused by model-specific resizing, padding, output quantization, and metric code, we build a unified public benchmark over CEILNet, Real20, Postcard, Objects, and Wild. Under the same evaluator, the proposed system obtains a five-dataset macro average of 27.546 dB PSNR, 0.9220 SSIM, 0.9751 NCC, and 0.004760 LMSE, achieving the highest macro-average PSNR, SSIM, and NCC and the lowest LMSE among the compared public checkpoints and internal variants. Per-dataset and qualitative analyses show that the main benefit is a more balanced performance across diverse reflection distributions, while clear semantic reflections in Postcard remain challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于RDNet的单图像反射去除方法，引入仅用于训练的低通反射辅助目标（LowAux），结合对称滤波约束和场景平衡的真实数据对，在统一基准测试中取得了五个数据集上最高的平均PSNR（27.546 dB）、SSIM（0.9220）、NCC（0.9751）和最低的LMSE（0.004760）。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像反射去除方法存在评估不一致（不同模型使用不同尺寸调整、填充、量化方式和评估代码）以及跨数据集泛化能力不足的问题，导致性能比较不公平且难以推广到真实场景。
AI.method: 1）基于RDNet的显式分解管道；2）LowAux：仅用于训练的低通反射辅助目标，对称滤波后的预测和目标提供稳定的低频约束，原始残差目标仍作为主要反射监督；3）引入RRW的场景平衡真实数据对以增强真实场景覆盖和跨数据集泛化；4）构建统一的公共基准（CEILNet、Real20、Postcard、Objects、Wild五个数据集）和统一的评估器，消除模型特定的尺寸调整、填充、输出量化和评估代码差异。
AI.result: 在五个数据集的统一评估器下，宏平均PSNR 27.546 dB、SSIM 0.9220、NCC 0.9751、LMSE 0.004760，在对比的公开检查点和内部变体中取得最高的宏平均PSNR、SSIM、NCC和最低的LMSE。主要收益是跨不同反射分布的更均衡性能，但Postcard中的清晰语义反射仍然具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: LowAux低通辅助目标和统一基准评估能有效提升单图像反射去除的跨场景均衡性能和评估公平性，但处理强语义反射仍是未解决的问题。

title: Coherent Visualization of 2D Scalar Field Contour Ensembles With Probabilistic Latent Space Modeling
comment: Accepted by IEEE VIS 2026. To appear in IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
summary: We present a new visualization method for contour ensembles through probabilistic modeling. We aim to improve the coherence between different visual representations, such as contour boxplots and density plots for a 2D scalar field ensemble. We model each ensemble member with a probabilistic representation in the latent space, i.e., a lower-dimensional representation of spatial data features, of a variational autoencoder (VAE). Thereafter, efficient data depth computation and uncertainty-aware clustering are supported based on a matrix of pair-wise similarity measurements of members. We estimate the underlying probability distribution by leveraging the power of VAE to create density plots that align more coherently with member distributions than existing methods. The effectiveness of our method is evaluated through numerical comparisons with existing techniques, and visualization examples of synthetic and real-world ensemble datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概率建模的轮廓集合可视化新方法，利用变分自编码器在潜在空间中对集合成员进行概率表示，实现更连贯的可视化效果，包括轮廓箱线图和密度图。
AI.motivation: 现有轮廓集合可视化方法（如轮廓箱线图、密度图）在不同视觉表征之间缺乏连贯性，需要一种能够统一协调多种可视化形式的方法。
AI.method: 使用变分自编码器（VAE）将每个集合成员映射到潜在空间的概率表示；基于成员间成对相似度矩阵进行高效数据深度计算和不确定性感知聚类；利用VAE估计底层概率分布以生成密度图。
AI.result: 通过数值比较和合成及真实世界集合数据集的可视化示例，验证了该方法相比现有技术在密度图与成员分布一致性方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于VAE潜在空间概率建模的方法能够有效提升轮廓集合可视化中不同视觉表征之间的连贯性，尤其是在密度图与成员分布的匹配上优于现有方法。

title: Not All LLM Reasoning is Visible in the Chain-of-Thought
summary: A key question for AI safety is whether a language model expresses all of its reasoning in its output tokens. We demonstrate a concrete failure mode where frontier models exhibit invisible reasoning by leveraging semantically irrelevant filler tokens to improve performance on synthetic reasoning tasks. We evaluate 13 frontier language models across three tasks and find that many models benefit significantly from filler tokens, with accuracy improvements of up to 13 percentage points. The benefit depends on which tokens are used and differs across models. We further show that filler tokens enable Claude Opus 4.5 to satisfy a hidden modular arithmetic constraint without sacrificing accuracy on its primary task, demonstrating that invisible reasoning can serve objectives entirely invisible to CoT monitoring. Reinforcement learning gives Qwen3-235B strong preferences over filler token content, but neither RL nor supervised fine-tuning produces a filler token benefit that persists at test time. Our results indicate that frontier models already perform consequential computation with no interpretable trace in their output tokens.

AI.tldr: 前沿语言模型可通过语义无关的填充词（filler tokens）进行"隐形推理"，在合成推理任务上提升高达13个百分点的准确率，且该行为无法通过思维链监控捕获，表明模型已在输出词元之外执行了有意义的计算。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型是否将所有推理过程都表达在输出词元中，验证AI安全中关于推理透明性的关键假设是否成立。
AI.method: 在合成推理任务中引入语义无关的填充词，评估13个前沿语言模型的表现；设计隐藏模运算约束实验检验隐形推理能否服务于监控不可见的目标；并通过强化学习与监督微调分析填充词偏好的形成机制。
AI.result: 多个模型从填充词中获益显著，准确率提升最高达13个百分点；Claude Opus 4.5能利用填充词满足隐藏约束而不影响主任务表现；RL使Qwen3-235B对填充词内容产生强烈偏好，但RL和SFT均未能使填充词效益在测试时持续。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型已在输出词元之外执行具有后果的计算，对依赖完整推理可解释性的CoT监控方案构成挑战，AI安全需要关注模型不可见推理路径。

title: Synthetic Scenario Generation for Evaluation of Industry 4.0 Agents
summary: Industrial agent benchmarks require realistic evaluation scenarios that integrate telemetry, failure modes, maintenance records, and domain standards. However, existing benchmarks such as AssetOpsBench rely on manually authored scenarios and cover a limited set of asset classes. We extend AssetOpsBench with a Smart Grid Transformer asset class and four IEC-grounded diagnostic tools for health-index prediction, dissolved-gas analysis, winding-temperature assessment, and load-profile assessment. We further introduce ScenarioGeneratorAgent, a pipeline for synthetic industrial-agent scenario generation. The pipeline constructs evidence-grounded asset profiles, allocates coverage-aware scenario budgets across operational domains, and generates candidates through a hybrid validation-and-repair loop that enforces schema validity, tool reachability, physical plausibility, standards alignment, and deduplication. To improve scalability, we apply two-level caching, parallel focus-group generation, thread-pool offloading, batched LLM calls, and early rejection filtering. On Smart Grid Transformer scenario generation, these optimizations reduce end-to-end runtime by $8\times$ for 50 scenarios while preserving quality, achieving a composite quality score of $74.2 \pm 1.9$ compared with $73.8 \pm 3.0$ for the unoptimized baseline. These results show that standards-grounded synthetic scenario generation can efficiently expand industrial-agent benchmarks without sacrificing scenario quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ScenarioGeneratorAgent，一个基于IEC标准的合成工业智能体场景生成流水线，通过混合验证-修复循环和多项优化技术，在智能电网变压器场景生成中实现了8倍加速，同时保持场景质量（质量评分74.2 vs 73.8）。
AI.motivation: 现有的工业智能体基准测试（如AssetOpsBench）依赖人工编写场景，覆盖的资产类别有限，缺乏可扩展且符合领域标准的自动化场景生成方法。
AI.method: 提出ScenarioGeneratorAgent流水线，包括：证据驱动的资产画像构建、覆盖感知的场景预算分配、混合验证-修复循环（含模式有效性、工具可达性、物理合理性、标准对齐和去重检查），以及两级缓存、并行焦点组生成、线程池卸载、批量LLM调用和早期拒绝过滤等优化策略。
AI.result: 在智能电网变压器场景生成中，优化后流水线生成50个场景的端到端运行时间减少8倍，复合质量评分74.2±1.9，与未优化基线73.8±3.0相当。
AI.conclusion: 基于标准引导的合成场景生成能够高效扩展工业智能体基准测试，且不牺牲场景质量。

title: StepX-Edge: An On-Device UI Vision-Language Model via Architecture-Training-Deployment Co-Design
summary: Deploying a vision-language model with full UI understanding on end devices has long been trapped between accuracy and efficiency: on one side is the accuracy bar for OCR, screen understanding, visual question answering, and element grounding; on the other is the strict compute, memory, and power budget of mobile chips. Existing work either trades one for the other, or stops at simulation without real-device validation. We present StepX-Edge, a 0.9B-parameter on-device UI vision-language model that resolves this tension through three-layer co-design of architecture, training, and deployment. Architecturally, UI-aware Layered Visual Encoding (ULVE) and a Progressive Dimensionality Projection (PDP) connector target the extreme aspect ratios and fine-grained perception of screens, while standard full attention throughout ensures native compatibility with mainstream mobile NPU operators. For training, the five-stage StepX-Curriculum framework is designed around our observation of mutual-promotion effects among UI subtasks, so that all four capabilities grow synergistically under a tight parameter budget rather than interfering. For deployment, a module-wise differentiated two-stage PTQ-to-QAT quantization scheme keeps the post-quantization accuracy loss within 1%. StepX-Edge achieves the strongest overall UI understanding among <=1B models, surpassing all 2B-2.3B baselines on ScreenQA (88.76 F1) and Chinese OCRBench v2 (57.25), and matching 1.3B-2.3B general VLMs on RefCOCO (92.0%) and OCRBench v1 (831) with far fewer parameters. After W4A16+KV8 quantization, the model runs stably on Snapdragon 8 Gen5 devices with ~0.84 s TTFT, 98 tok/s decode, and 1.4 GB peak memory. We will open-source the training data, the full training recipe, and the quantization deployment pipeline.

AI.tldr: StepX-Edge是一个0.9B参数的端侧UI视觉语言模型，通过架构-训练-部署三层协同设计，在<=1B模型中达到最强的UI理解能力，量化后可在骁龙8 Gen5设备上稳定运行。
AI.motivation: 端侧部署具有完整UI理解能力的视觉语言模型长期面临精度与效率的矛盾：一方面需要高精度的OCR、屏幕理解、VQA和元素定位，另一方面受限于移动芯片的算力、内存和功耗预算。现有工作要么牺牲一方换取另一方，要么仅停留在模拟阶段而缺乏真实设备验证。
AI.method: 三层协同设计：1) 架构层：UI感知分层视觉编码(ULVE)和渐进式维度投影(PDP)连接器处理极端长宽比和细粒度屏幕感知，全注意力机制保证NPU算子兼容性；2) 训练层：五阶段StepX-Curriculum框架，基于UI子任务间相互促进效应的观察，使四个能力在参数量受限下协同增长；3) 部署层：模块级区分的两阶段PTQ-to-QAT量化方案，后量化精度损失控制在1%以内。
AI.result: 在<=1B模型中取得最强整体UI理解能力，超越所有2B-2.3B基线模型；ScreenQA (88.76 F1)、中文OCRBench v2 (57.25)；匹配1.3B-2.3B通用VLM在RefCOCO (92.0%)和OCRBench v1 (831)上的表现。W4A16+KV8量化后，在骁龙8 Gen5设备上TTFT约0.84秒，解码速度98 tok/s，峰值内存1.4GB。
AI.conclusion: StepX-Edge通过架构-训练-部署的三层协同设计，在极小参数量下实现了端侧UI理解精度与效率的平衡，验证了量化后模型在真实移动设备上的稳定运行。将开源训练数据、完整训练配方和量化部署流水线。

title: Hybrid Semantic and Spectral Ensemble for Robust Synthetic Image Source Attribution
comment: Peer-reviewed and accepted to the DLMMDD Challenge Workshop at the 35th International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN 2026). 7 pages, 1 figures
summary: The rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) models has necessitated robust Synthetic Image Source Attribution (SIA) methodologies. A critical challenge in SIA is the distribution shift between pristine training images and real-world deployed images, which undergo unknown post-processing operations such as JPEG compression and blurring. In this work, proposed for the DLMMDD Challenge at ICANN 2026, we introduce a dual-branch ensemble framework fusing Semantic Deep Learning with Mathematical Forensic Feature Extraction. The semantic branch employs EfficientNet-B0 regularized with Exponential Moving Averaging (EMA) and Label Smoothing. The forensic branch extracts 126 mathematical features -- including SVD spectral profiles and Local Binary Patterns -- from high-pass noise residuals, compressed via Truncated SVD and classified with XGBoost. Evaluated on a dataset of 10 generators where 55% of the test set is degraded, our approach achieves a private leaderboard accuracy of 95.60%. Furthermore, the entire pipeline is highly computationally efficient, requiring no GPU acceleration and executing end-to-end on a standard CPU in under 6.5 hours, highlighting the practicality and scalability of mathematical forensics for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文针对文本到图像生成模型的来源归属问题，提出了一种融合深度语义学习和数学取证特征的双分支集成框架。语义分支使用EfficientNet-B0结合EMA和标签平滑，取证分支从高通残差中提取126种数学特征（SVD谱、LBP等），经截断SVD压缩后由XGBoost分类。在DLMMDD挑战赛数据集上达到95.60%私有榜准确率，且无需GPU，端到端CPU推理仅需6.5小时。
AI.motivation: T2I模型快速发展亟需可靠的合成图像来源归属方法，但真实部署场景中存在未知后处理操作（如JPEG压缩、模糊）导致的分布偏移，现有方法在此类退化条件下性能不足。
AI.method: 双分支集成框架：(1) 语义分支：EfficientNet-B0 + EMA正则化 + 标签平滑；(2) 取证分支：高通噪声残差中提取126维数学特征（SVD谱、LBP等）→ 截断SVD降维 → XGBoost分类；两分支结果融合。
AI.result: 在10个生成器的数据集上（55%测试集被退化），私有榜准确率95.60%；无需GPU，端到端CPU执行时间低于6.5小时。
AI.conclusion: 融合数学取证与深度学习的双分支框架在图像来源归属任务上表现优异，且计算效率高、可扩展性强，适合实际部署。

title: Toward Automated Detection of Documentation Inconsistencies in Electronic Health Records
summary:
Objective: To characterize the kinds of internal documentation inconsistencies a general-domain large language model (LLM) can surface from real-world discharge summaries, and to identify recurring failure modes that limit reliability at scale.
  Materials and Methods: We applied a two-stage LLM pipeline---open-ended candidate identification (Gemini 2.5 Pro) followed by context-grounded verification (Gemini 2.5 Flash)---to 3,000 randomly sampled MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries. A subset of the pipeline output was then reviewed manually by clinical experts.
  Results: Our pipeline surfaced 3,460 candidate inconsistencies, affecting 69.7% of admissions. Representative examples spanned demographics, allergies, procedures, diagnoses, laboratory, medications, and care-planning domains, with direct implications for clinical reasoning or patient safety.
