Expert review also revealed recurring failure modes that arise when verification requires temporal reasoning, evolving-diagnosis context, or knowledge of outpatient-prescribing conventions the model does not natively possess.
  Discussion: Detection is highly context-dependent: many flagged pairs require anchoring each statement to its source section and clinical domain, then assessing whether the conflict reflects a true contradiction or missing context. We propose a graded ontology spanning strict contradiction and ambiguity, with a schema characterizing each flagged case by category, section, domain, and inconsistency axis.
  Conclusion: This formative study establishes a methodological foundation and conceptual framework to guide subsequent validated, large-scale EHR-inconsistency analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用两阶段LLM流水线（Gemini 2.5 Pro + Gemini 2.5 Flash）对3,000份MIMIC-IV-Note出院小结进行分析，发现3,460个候选不一致（影响69.7%的入院记录），涵盖人口学、过敏史、手术、诊断、实验室、用药和护理计划等多个领域。专家评审揭示了时间推理、诊断演变和门诊处方知识缺失等失败模式，并提出了一个分级本体论用于分类不一致性。
AI.motivation: 表征通用大语言模型能从真实世界出院小结中发现哪些内部文档不一致性，并识别限制大规模可靠性的重复性失败模式。
AI.method: 采用两阶段LLM流水线：第一阶段使用Gemini 2.5 Pro进行开放式候选不一致识别，第二阶段使用Gemini 2.5 Flash进行基于上下文的验证。对3,000份随机抽样的MIMIC-IV-Note出院小结进行处理，并对部分流水线输出进行人工专家评审。
AI.result: 流水线发现3,460个候选不一致，影响69.7%的入院记录。专家评审发现时间推理、诊断演变背景和门诊处方知识缺失等重复性失败模式。提出了一个分级本体论（严格矛盾与歧义），按类别、章节、领域和不一致轴对每个案例进行分类。
AI.conclusion: 这项形成性研究建立了方法论基础和概念框架，用于指导后续经过验证的大规模电子健康记录不一致性分析。

title: Loss-Aware Feature-Map Pruning in Convolutional Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: Convolutional neural networks often contain redundant feature maps that increase storage and inference cost. This paper presents a loss-aware feature-map pruning framework using multi-armed bandits. Feature-map pruning is structured because it removes complete convolutional output channels and their producing filters rather than isolated scalar weights. Each candidate feature map is treated as an arm. At each play time, one map is temporarily masked and evaluated on a sampled mini-batch; the map is then restored and the observed loss change is converted into a safe-removal reward. After a fixed play budget, candidate maps are ranked by learned scores and the top-k maps are permanently removed with their filters, biases and corresponding next-layer input-channel kernels. The study evaluates UCB1 and Thompson Sampling, compares them with direct/oracle-style evaluation on LeNet/MNIST, and extends the evaluation to MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, CUB-200-2011 and Oxford Flowers 102. Results show that UCB1 and Thompson Sampling preserve accuracy close to unpruned models while removing feature maps and reducing convolutional computation. Friedman and Nemenyi tests show that UCB1 obtains the highest mean rank, followed by Thompson Sampling; both significantly outperform greedy and magnitude-based pruning while remaining statistically comparable to the original unpruned model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多臂老虎机的损失感知特征图剪枝框架，将每个候选特征图视为一个臂，通过临时掩码评估损失变化并转化为安全移除奖励，利用UCB1和Thompson Sampling选择要永久移除的特征图及其对应的滤波器、偏置和下一层输入通道核，在多个数据集上验证了该方法在保持模型精度的同时有效减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 卷积神经网络中常存在冗余特征图，导致存储和推理成本增加，因此需要一种有效的结构化剪枝方法来移除冗余特征图及其对应的滤波器，以降低计算开销而不显著损害模型精度。
AI.method: 提出损失感知的特征图剪枝框架：将每个候选特征图视为一个臂，每次选择一个特征图进行临时掩码并在小批量数据上评估，记录损失变化作为安全移除奖励；经过固定预算后，根据学习到的分数永久移除top-k特征图及其对应滤波器、偏置和下一层输入通道核。使用UCB1和Thompson Sampling作为臂选择策略。
AI.result: 在LeNet/MNIST上与直接评估和oracle评估对比；在MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN、CUB-200-2011和Oxford Flowers 102上扩展验证。UCB1和Thompson Sampling在移除特征图并减少卷积计算的同时，保持了与未剪枝模型相近的精度。Friedman和Nemenyi检验显示UCB1获得最高平均秩，Thompson Sampling次之，两者均显著优于贪心方法和基于幅度的剪枝，且与原始未剪枝模型统计上无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 基于多臂老虎机的损失感知剪枝框架能够有效识别并移除冗余特征图，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持模型精度，其中UCB1表现最佳，Thompson Sampling次之，两者均优于传统贪心和基于幅度的剪枝方法。

title: RMS@CC-MMD 2026: Multimodal Misogyny Detection via Geometric Interaction and Multi-View Consensus
comment: Accepted for the CC-MMD Grand Challenge at the 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction (ICMI 2026)
summary: The proliferation of internet memes has introduced new complexities to automated content moderation, particularly in detecting misogyny. Memes often rely on a semantic clash between visual and textual modalities, where hateful intent is implicit and culturally grounded. This paper presents GeoMVC (Geometric Interaction and Multi-View Consensus), developed for the CC-MMD Grand Challenge at ICMI 2026. To address the limitations of static feature concatenation, a Geometric Interaction Layer is proposed that models cross-modal alignment via Hadamard products and cosine similarity between frozen visual and textual embeddings. We further mitigate distribution shifts caused by noisy OCR and code-mixed transliteration through a Multi-View Consensus strategy, aggregating predictions across raw, length-filtered, and English-translated text views. The system achieved Rank 2 in the Malayalam partition (Macro F1: 0.892) and Rank 3 in the Chinese partition (Macro F1: 0.895) on Task A, while securing Rank 5 in the Tamil partition (Macro F1: 0.521). A detailed error analysis on the development partition highlights open challenges in modeling localized transliteration and code-mixed sarcasm across Dravidian and Chinese cultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoMVC系统，通过几何交互层（Hadamard积+余弦相似度）对齐多模态特征，并采用多视角共识策略（聚合原始、长度过滤、英文翻译三种文本视图）解决OCR噪声和代码混合问题，在ICMI 2026 CC-MMD挑战赛中分别获得马拉雅拉姆语（Macro F1: 0.892）和中文（Macro F1: 0.895）子任务的第二名和第三名。
AI.motivation: 网络模因的泛滥给自动内容审核带来新挑战，特别是在检测厌女内容方面。模因往往依赖视觉和文本模态之间的语义冲突，其仇恨意图含蓄且植根于文化语境。现有静态特征拼接方法无法有效建模跨模态对齐，且OCR噪声和代码混合音译导致的分布偏移问题亟待解决。
AI.method: 提出GeoMVC框架，包含两个核心组件：1）几何交互层（Geometric Interaction Layer），利用冻结的视觉和文本嵌入之间的Hadamard积和余弦相似度建模跨模态对齐；2）多视角共识策略（Multi-View Consensus），聚合原始文本、长度过滤文本和英文翻译文本三种视图的预测结果，以缓解分布偏移。
AI.result: 在ICMI 2026 CC-MMD挑战赛Task A中，马拉雅拉姆语分区排名第2（Macro F1: 0.892），中文分区排名第3（Macro F1: 0.895），泰米尔语分区排名第5（Macro F1: 0.521）。
AI.conclusion: 详细的错误分析揭示了在德拉维达语系和中文文化语境中，建模本地化音译和代码混合讽刺仍面临开放挑战，表明目前的模型在处理文化特异性语言现象方面存在局限。

title: GNM Head: A Generative aNthropometric Model of the human head
comment: The GNM is publicly available at: https://github.com/google/GNM
summary: Parametric models of the human head are essential tools traditionally used in computer vision and graphics for animation, rendering, and reconstruction. More recently, they serve as crucial conditioning signals within generative large vision models, allowing for tight spatial control of generated imagery. However, existing publicly available models are typically limited in anatomical scope, modeling only outer geometry while ignoring intra-oral and ocular structures, and frequently suffer from reduced geometric quality stemming from low-fidelity input datasets. In this report we introduce a new parametric model dubbed Generative aNthropometric Model (GNM), named as a homophone of the human genome. GNM encompasses the head, face, neck, eyeballs, teeth, and tongue, and it is built on an extensive database of high-resolution 3D scans combined with high-quality anatomy specific artist-made samples. This report details the data provenance, the model architecture including the specialized sub-models for the ocular and intra-oral structures, and shows its SotA performance on fitting target 3D face scans. To foster community innovation, the complete GNM framework is made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了生成式人体测量模型（GNM），一个涵盖头部、面部、颈部、眼球、牙齿和舌头的全新参数化3D模型，基于高分辨率扫描与艺术家制作样本构建，在3D人脸拟合上达到SOTA性能，并已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有公开的人头参数化模型在解剖范围上有限（仅建模外部几何，忽略口腔和眼部结构），且因输入数据集保真度低而导致几何质量下降。因此需要一个新的模型来弥补这些不足。
AI.method: 基于大规模高分辨率3D扫描数据库和高质量解剖学专家制作的样本构建；模型架构包含头部、面部、颈部、眼球、牙齿和舌头的整体模型，并设有针对眼部和口腔结构的专用子模型。
AI.result: 在目标3D人脸扫描拟合任务上达到了SOTA（最先进）性能。
AI.conclusion: GNM模型在解剖覆盖范围、几何质量和拟合精度上均优于现有模型，且完全开源以推动社区创新。

title: Beyond Direct Answering: Aligning Educational LLMs as Socratic Guides via Heuristic Reinforcement Learning
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables; includes an appendix
summary: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in educational settings often behave as direct answerers: they disclose target concepts in the opening turn instead of guiding students through progressive inquiry, as Socratic pedagogy prescribes. We present HeuristicEdu, a two-phase pipeline that aligns Qwen2.5-7B toward Socratic tutoring via supervised warm-up and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Training uses SocraticEdu, 797 multi-turn Chinese children's science dialogues reconstructed from a live platform, with a heuristic reward over cognitive depth (R_cog), curiosity engagement (R_eng), and directness (R_dir), together with a K_query correction for student-introduced terms. We introduce Scaffolding Effectiveness (SE) and Conversation Depth (CD) to evaluate outcomes beyond surface fluency. On 30 held-out questions, the best GRPO variant improves SE from 30.0% to 63.3% and lowers keyword leakage from 30.0% to 13.3%. Notably, this best variant omits the directness penalty during optimization, suggesting that explicit anti-leakage terms can conflict with gradient-based behavioral alignment. An unaligned Qwen-72B baseline reaches 0% SE and 96.7% leakage, showing that scale alone does not induce Socratic behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HeuristicEdu两阶段流水线，通过监督热身和GRPO将Qwen2.5-7B对齐为苏格拉底式辅导教师。在797轮中文儿童科学对话数据上训练，使用好奇心、认知深度和直接性启发式奖励。最佳变体将支架有效性从30%提升至63.3%，关键词泄露从30%降至13.3%，且发现显式防泄露惩罚与梯度对齐冲突。未对齐的Qwen-72B基准SE为0%、泄露率96.7%，表明规模本身无法诱导苏格拉底行为。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在教育场景中往往直接给出答案（"直接回答者"），而非遵循苏格拉底教学法通过渐进式提问引导学生思考。这种直接揭示目标概念的行为不利于学生深度学习。
AI.method: 提出HeuristicEdu两阶段流水线：(1) 监督热身微调；(2) GRPO强化学习。训练数据为SocraticEdu（797轮多轮中文儿童科学对话）。设计启发式奖励函数包含三个维度：认知深度(R_cog)、好奇心参与度(R_eng)、直接性(R_dir)，并加入K_query修正机制处理学生引入术语。引入支架有效性(SE)和对话深度(CD)作为评估指标。
AI.result: 在30个保留问题上，最佳GRPO变体将SE从30.0%提升至63.3%，关键词泄露从30.0%降至13.3%。最优变体在优化过程中省略了直接性惩罚项。未对齐的Qwen-72B基线SE为0%、泄露率96.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过专门设计的奖励函数和训练策略，可以对LLM进行有效的苏格拉底式教学行为对齐，且模型规模本身不足以产生该行为。显式的防泄露惩罚项与基于梯度的行为对齐可能存在冲突，需要更精细的设计。

title: DSTFView: Multi-View Cloud-Edge Workload Forecasting with Dual-Input Spatio-Temporal-Frequency Modeling
summary: With the widespread deployment of edge-side AI inference, edge platforms are increasingly required to support latency-sensitive, highly concurrent, and reliability-critical applications. However, existing methods often struggle to balance multidimensional feature modeling and forecasting efficiency in collaborative cloud-edge environments. To address this issue, we propose DSTFView, a dual-input spatio-temporal-frequency multi-view workload forecasting framework for collaborative cloud-edge environments. It jointly models closeness and period dependencies and extracts spatial, temporal, and frequency-domain dependencies. Besides, it designs an adaptive fusion mechanism and adjusts the contribution of each view to capture abrupt changes. Experimental results on the CPU and TP datasets demonstrate that DSTFView consistently outperforms representative baselines across multiple forecasting horizons and evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出DSTFView框架，通过双输入时空频多视图建模，在云边协同环境下实现了更优的工作负载预测性能。
AI.motivation: 边缘AI推理广泛部署后，边缘平台需支持延迟敏感、高并发、高可靠应用，现有方法难以在云边协同环境中平衡多维特征建模与预测效率。
AI.method: 提出DSTFView，一种双输入时空频多视图工作负载预测框架，联合建模邻近性和周期性依赖，提取空间、时间、频域依赖，设计自适应融合机制动态调整各视图贡献以捕捉突变。
AI.result: 在CPU和TP数据集上，DSTFView在多个预测范围和评估指标上 consistently 优于代表性基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DSTFView通过多视图融合有效提升了云边协同环境下工作负载预测的准确性和鲁棒性。

title: scMIR: a vision-language foundation model for single-cell light microscopy image representation
summary: Single-cell light microscopy images have become an important data source for characterizing cell phenotypes, but their complexity and heterogeneity pose challenges to high-throughput automated analysis. Existing representation learning methods mostly rely on task-oriented modeling, which is limited by specific datasets and predefined tasks, making them difficult to generalize across different cell types and microscopy modalities, and experimental conditions. Although general-purpose methods have improved the generalization ability of image representation in recent years, their limited utilization of experimental background and biological context information still poses challenges in complex phenotypic analysis. Here, we propose scMIR, a vision-language foundation model for single-cell light microscopy image representation. By synergistically combining self-supervised image reconstruction with text-guided cross-modal alignment, scMIR can simultaneously encode morphological and biological semantic information in a unified representation space. scMIR is pre-trained on 207,957 image-text pairs, covering various cell types, microscopy modalities, and perturbation conditions. scMIR outperforms existing general models and task-oriented methods as systematically evaluated on various complex tasks using 16 benchmark datasets, including cell classification, clustering, phenotype inference, and batch effect correction tasks. Furthermore, scMIR shows a strong generalization ability across various tasks without requiring task-specific fine-tuning. With its unique advantages, we envision scMIR may promote the standardization and automation of high-throughput phenotyping workflows through supporting various downstream analysis tasks.

AI.tldr: scMIR是一种针对单细胞光学显微镜图像的视觉-语言基础模型，通过自监督图像重建与文本引导的跨模态对齐，在统一表征空间中编码形态和生物语义信息。该模型在207,957个图像-文本对上进行预训练，覆盖多种细胞类型、显微镜模态和扰动条件，在16个基准数据集的细胞分类、聚类、表型推断和批次效应校正等任务上优于现有通用模型和任务导向方法，且无需特定任务微调即可跨任务泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有单细胞显微镜图像的表征学习方法存在两个主要局限：一是任务导向型方法受限于特定数据集和预定义任务，难以跨细胞类型、显微镜模态和实验条件泛化；二是通用型方法虽然提升了图像表征的泛化能力，但对实验背景和生物学上下文信息的利用不足，在复杂表型分析中仍面临挑战。
AI.method: scMIR采用视觉-语言基础模型架构，通过自监督图像重建与文本引导的跨模态对齐的协同组合，实现形态学信息和生物学语义信息在统一表征空间中的联合编码。模型在207,957个图像-文本对上预训练，涵盖多种细胞类型、显微镜模态和扰动条件。
AI.result: 在16个基准数据集上，scMIR在细胞分类、聚类、表型推断和批次效应校正等多种复杂任务中均优于现有通用模型和任务导向方法，且展现出无需特定任务微调的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: scMIR凭借其独特优势，有望通过支持多种下游分析任务，推动高通量表型工作流程的标准化和自动化。

title: Head Avatars with Dynamic Explicit Hair
summary: We present DynHair, a novel method for tracking and modeling dynamic hair for human head avatars. From video input, we reconstruct a dynamic head avatar with an explicit strand-based hair representation using structured 3D Gaussian Splatting. In contrast to the face region of human head avatars, which can be modeled with 3D Gaussians that are attached or generated with respect to some expressive 3D head model, hair is particularly challenging as it exhibits dynamic motion effects. Therefore, we present a novel method that models the dynamic deformations of the hair strands using a temporal network that is conditioned on angular velocity and acceleration of the head, as well as relative gravity. Specifically, an LSTM encodes the motion history and modulates per-point strand features via FiLM conditioning which further used by MLP to produce physically plausible displacements to canonical hairstyle. We jointly optimize this motion and appearance representation of the hair, with a 3DGS-based representation of the face-region, via differentiable Gaussian splatting with photometric, geometric, and physics-based supervision. As a result of our method, we retrieve hair tracking of the training video data and an animatable head avatar with controllable hair dynamics. In our experiments, we demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in terms of hair dynamics, temporal consistency, and generalization across subjects.

AI.tldr: DynHair是一种从视频输入中重建动态头发头像的方法，采用结构化3D高斯喷溅的显式发丝表示，通过LSTM和FiLM条件调制网络建模头发动态形变，联合优化头发与面部区域，实现可控头发动态的动画化头部虚拟形象。
AI.motivation: 头部头像的面部区域可通过附着于3D头模的高斯模型进行表达，但头发因具有动态运动效果而极具挑战性，现有方法难以有效建模头发的动态形变。
AI.method: 使用结构化3D高斯喷溅的显式发丝表示；采用LSTM编码运动历史，通过FiLM条件调制逐点特征，MLP预测物理上合理的位移；联合优化头发运动与外观表示及面部区域3DGS表示；通过光度、几何和基于物理的监督进行可微高斯喷溅训练。
AI.result: 在头发动态效果、时间一致性和跨主体泛化方面达到最先进性能；实现了训练视频数据的头发跟踪和可控头发动态的动画化头部虚拟形象。
AI.conclusion: DynHair通过结合显式发丝表示、时序网络建模和物理约束，成功实现了动态头发的跟踪与建模，生成了具有真实头发动态效果的可动画头部虚拟形象。

title: Speech Signals Complement LLMs for Predicting Interpersonal Attraction in Speed Dating
comment: Accepted at the 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction (ICMI 2026). 16 pages total, including a 7-page supplementary appendix
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can predict interpersonal attraction from conversation transcripts, but it remains unclear what a speech predictor can add beyond transcript-only LLM prediction. Using Japanese speed-dating conversations, we combine predictions from a transcript-only LLM and a supervised speech predictor to estimate participants' reported liking of their partners. We show that speech can complement transcript-only LLM prediction, but that this complementarity is conditional rather than universal. Combining the two predictions significantly improves pairwise ranking accuracy over the transcript-only LLM alone in all evaluated conditions. By contrast, gains in per-participant Pearson $r$ vary across conversation rounds and rating directions, with none significant after correction. Retrospectively, these $r$ gains are concentrated among participants for whom the speech predictor is more accurate. Speech can therefore retain predictive value even when an LLM predicts attraction from transcripts. The relevant question is not simply whether speech helps, but where its complementarity emerges.

AI.tldr: 结合文本LLM和语音预测器能提升人际吸引力预测的排序准确率，但相关性提升仅在语音预测器本身更准确的参与者中显著，表明语音的补充价值是有条件的而非普适的。
AI.motivation: 探究在已有文本（对话转录）LLM预测人际吸引力的基础上，语音预测器能否提供额外的补充信息，以及这种补充性是否具有普遍性。
AI.method: 使用日语速配对话数据，分别通过纯文本LLM和有监督语音预测器预测参与者对搭档的喜欢程度，然后将两者预测结果进行组合，比较组合模型与纯文本LLM在排序准确率和皮尔逊相关系数上的表现。
AI.result: 组合模型在所有条件下均显著提升了配对排序的准确性；但在每参与者的皮尔逊r上，提升幅度随对话轮次和评分方向变化，且均未达到统计显著性。事后分析发现，这些r值提升集中在语音预测器本身更准确的参与者中。
AI.conclusion: 语音在文本LLM预测吸引力时仍能保留预测价值，但补充性是条件性的而非普适的——关键问题不在于语音是否"有帮助"，而在于其补充性在何种条件下涌现。

title: MedLoCoMo: A Long-Context Multi-Session Medical Dialogue Benchmark for Large Language Models
summary: MedLoCoMo is a Medical Long-Context Memory benchmark for patient-specific clinical reasoning over multi-admission medical dialogue. Existing medical QA benchmarks largely test short context knowledge or single document grounding, leaving open whether LLMs can use, connect, and abstain over longitudinal patient histories. We build MedLoCoMo from deidentified MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-IV-Note records by constructing admission-level clinical packets, synthesizing grounded doctor-patient conversations, and generating evidence linked QA items over single-admission, cross-admission, and adversarial unanswerable settings. The benchmark contains 100 patient timelines averaging 1,669.8 turns, 29.7 sessions, and 74,512.2 tokens per conversation. Across the evaluated baselines, cross-admission reasoning is consistently harder than localized evidence use, even when models have long context windows or use external memory or retrieval methods. The code and MedLoCoMo benchmark release is available at https://github.com/leozzy13/MedLoCoMo for use and reproducibility.

AI.tldr: MedLoCoMo是一个专为多入院医疗对话场景设计的患者特异性临床推理长上下文记忆基准，包含100个患者时间线，每个对话平均1669.8轮、29.7个会话、74,512.2个token，涵盖单入院、跨入院及对抗性不可回答三种问题类型，实验发现跨入院推理始终比局部证据使用更难。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗QA基准大多测试短上下文知识或单文档推理，缺乏评估LLMs在纵向患者病史中进行使用、连接和拒答能力的基准，因此需要构建长上下文临床记忆基准。
AI.method: 基于去标识化的MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-IV-Note数据，构建入院级临床包，合成医患对话，生成基于证据的QA项目，包含单入院、跨入院和对抗性不可回答三种场景。
AI.result: 构建了100个患者时间线，平均每对话1669.8轮、29.7个会话、74,512.2个token；跨入院推理一致性地比局部证据使用更难，即使模型具有长上下文窗口或使用外部记忆/检索方法。
AI.conclusion: MedLoCoMo揭示了现有LLMs在长上下文临床推理中的不足，特别是跨入院场景下的挑战，为未来医疗长上下文模型评估提供了标准化基准。

title: Real-Time Semantic Segmentation with Optimized RetinaNet Architectures for Embedded Automotive Systems
summary: Real-time perception is a foundational requirement for advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous vehicles, yet embedded automotive platforms impose severe constraints on compute, memory, and power. This paper presents an optimized semantic segmentation architecture derived from the RetinaNet detection framework, adapted for dense pixel-wise prediction and tailored for deployment on resource-constrained embedded hardware. The proposed architecture, termed Opt-RetinaSeg, replaces the standard ResNet-50 backbone with a hybrid lightweight feature extractor, restructures the Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) to reduce redundant multi-scale computation, and introduces a compact segmentation head guided by focal-loss-inspired class balancing to address the severe foreground-background imbalance common in road scenes. We further apply a three-stage optimization pipeline consisting of structured channel pruning, post-training INT8 quantization, and knowledge distillation from a high-capacity teacher network. Evaluated on the Cityscapes and BDD100K datasets and deployed on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX and a Qualcomm QCS610 automotive SoC, the proposed model achieves 73.9% mIoU at 70.4 FPS, representing a 7.4x inference speedup and a 4x reduction in model size relative to the ResNet-50 baseline, with less than 3% accuracy degradation. These results indicate that RetinaNet-derived architectures, when systematically optimized, are viable candidates for real-time semantic segmentation in embedded automotive perception pipelines

AI.tldr: 本文提出Opt-RetinaSeg，一种从RetinaNet检测框架衍生的优化语义分割架构，通过轻量级骨干网络、重构FPN、紧凑分割头及三阶段优化流水线（结构化剪枝、INT8量化、知识蒸馏），在嵌入式汽车平台上实现73.9% mIoU和70.4 FPS，相对ResNet-50基线获得7.4倍加速和4倍模型缩减，精度损失小于3%。
AI.motivation: 实时感知是ADAS和自动驾驶的基础需求，但嵌入式汽车平台对计算、内存和功耗有严格限制，现有语义分割模型难以在资源受限硬件上实现实时性能。
AI.method: 提出Opt-RetinaSeg架构：1) 用混合轻量级特征提取器替换ResNet-50骨干网络；2) 重构FPN减少冗余多尺度计算；3) 引入基于focal loss的紧凑分割头处理前景-背景不平衡；4) 三阶段优化流水线：结构化通道剪枝、训练后INT8量化、知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 在Cityscapes和BDD100K数据集上，NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX和Qualcomm QCS610平台实现73.9% mIoU / 70.4 FPS，相对基线7.4倍推理加速、4倍模型尺寸缩减，精度下降<3%。
AI.conclusion: 经系统优化的RetinaNet衍生架构是嵌入式汽车感知流水线中实时语义分割的可行候选方案。

title: MMOE: Modernizing Diffusion Transformers with Efficient Expert Design
summary: Modern large language models scale successfully by pairing capacity growth with efficiency, keeping per-token and deployment costs under control as capacity grows. AIGC Foundation Models (AFMs), especially diffusion-transformer backbones, have begun to adopt sparse experts, but recent efforts mostly enlarge total parameter counts and sparsity ratios without importing the efficiency mechanisms that made LLM scaling practical, so generation quality is seldom balanced against training and deployment cost. This raises a natural question: can the architectural principles behind efficient LLM scaling be adapted to AFMs in a more balanced way? We introduce ModernMOE (MMOE), a modernization of SiT-style diffusion transformers that systematically adapts routed experts, shared and lightweight experts, gate-residual routing, and attention-residual information reuse to AIGC generation. Rather than treating MoE as a single plug-in replacement, MMOE studies how different modern expert components affect convergence, efficiency, and generation quality when composed inside a diffusion transformer. Every experiment in this paper is trained on a single eight-GPU H100 node with batch size 256 for 400k steps, an accessible single-machine budget. Under matched training and sampling protocols and at this budget, MMOE reaches lower FID at every recorded checkpoint, that is, it converges faster per training step, than dense and intermediate sparse-expert baselines, and among the sparse variants it attains the best quality-cost balance. Routing analysis further shows stable expert specialization across depth, substantial use of lightweight routes, and modest step-to-step routing changes during denoising. These results suggest that AFMs can follow the balanced scaling path of LLMs by importing proven efficiency designs, rather than by simply increasing total parameters and sparsity ratios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ModernMOE（MMOE），通过系统地将高效LLM扩展中的路由专家、共享专家、门控残差路由和注意力残差信息复用等机制适配到扩散Transformer中，在单节点8卡H100预算下，实现了比稠密和稀疏基线更快的收敛速度和更好的生成质量-成本平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGC基础模型（特别是扩散Transformer）虽然开始采用稀疏专家，但主要关注增大参数量和稀疏比，缺乏LLM扩展中行之有效的效率机制，导致生成质量与训练/部署成本失衡。作者希望将LLM高效扩展的架构原理以更平衡的方式适配到AIGC生成模型中。
AI.method: ModernMOE对SiT风格的扩散Transformer进行现代化改造，系统集成路由专家、共享专家和轻量级专家、门控残差路由、注意力残差信息复用等多种MoE组件。在单节点8卡H100、batch size 256、400k步的预算下进行全部实验。
AI.result: 在匹配的训练和采样协议下，MMOE在每步检查点均达到更低的FID（收敛更快）；在稀疏变体中实现最佳质量-成本平衡。路由分析显示专家在深度上稳定专业化、轻量级路由得到充分使用、去噪过程中步间路由变化适度。
AI.conclusion: AIGC基础模型可以通过引入LLM中已被验证的效率设计来走平衡扩展路径，而非简单增加总参数量和稀疏比。

title: ADAGE: A Language-Agnostic Pipeline for Analogical Reasoning Evaluation
summary: Multilingual reasoning evaluation overwhelmingly relies on translating English benchmarks, a practice that introduces linguistic artifacts and fails to test culturally-grounded reasoning. We introduce ADAGE (Analogical Difficulty-by-design Assessment for Grounded Evaluation), a language-agnostic pipeline that combines native-speaker curation with LLM-assisted generation to construct challenging, translation-free benchmarks for abstract analogical reasoning. We validate ADAGE by constructing benchmarks for Arabic, Amharic, and Japanese. Evaluating 14 open-weight models, we find a consistent cultural reasoning gap: models that perform well on English proverb reasoning struggle substantially on all three native benchmarks, with accuracy dropping by 12--52 percentage points relative to English. We release the pipeline, all three benchmarks, and the full evaluation suite.

AI.tldr: 提出ADAGE流水线，用于构建无翻译的多语言抽象类比推理基准，发现模型在母语谚语推理上表现显著低于英语（准确率下降12-52个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言推理评估依赖翻译英文基准，引入语言伪影且无法测试基于文化的推理能力。
AI.method: ADAGE：结合母语者筛选与LLM辅助生成的语言无关流水线，构建无翻译的抽象类比推理基准；在阿拉伯语、阿姆哈拉语和日语上验证。
AI.result: 14个开源模型在母语基准上的准确率比英语下降12-52个百分点，存在一致的文化推理差距。
AI.conclusion: 翻译型基准存在文化偏误，ADAGE能有效评估模型的跨文化推理能力，揭示了当前模型在非英语文化推理中的系统性缺陷。

title: Keyword Matters: Unveiling the Energy Sensitivity of On-Device LLM Prompting
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed on mobile and embedded devices to improve privacy and reduce network latency. Yet on-device inference faces a fundamental constraint: high energy consumption on battery-powered, resource-limited hardware. While model compression and runtime acceleration have been widely studied, the effect of \emph{prompt design} on energy efficiency remains underexplored. This paper presents an empirical study of the relationship between prompt wording and energy consumption for on-device LLMs. Using real power measurements collected on a smartphone, we quantify how linguistic features, particularly imperative keywords and instruction structure, affect decoding length and total energy. Our results show consistent energy differences across verbs and tasks, indicating that prompt engineering is a lightweight lever for improving energy efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文通过智能手机上的真实功耗测量，实证研究了提示词（prompt）的措辞如何影响设备端大语言模型的能耗，发现动词选择和指令结构会导致解码长度和总能耗的显著差异，提示工程可作为提升能效的轻量化手段。
AI.motivation: 设备端LLM面临电池供电和资源受限的能耗瓶颈，现有研究集中于模型压缩和运行时加速，但提示词设计对能效的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在智能手机上进行真实功耗测量，通过改变提示词中的关键动词和指令结构，量化不同语言特征对解码长度和总能耗的影响。
AI.result: 不同动词和任务之间在能耗上存在一致的显著差异，提示措辞直接影响解码长度和总能耗。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程可以作为提升设备端LLM能效的一种轻量级、无需修改模型或硬件的有效手段。

title: Child-Oriented AIGC Video Risk Reviewing: A Benchmark and Knowledge-Supported Iterative Reasoning Framework
summary: The rapid growth of Artificial Intelligence-generated content (AIGC) is reshaping video production and circulation, exposing children to an increasing volume of AIGC videos. Unlike traditionally produced videos, AIGC videos often exhibit greater uncertainty in visual details, narrative coherence, and content expression, which may introduce developmentally inappropriate risks for children. However, existing video safety research is largely designed for general violation detection from an adult perspective and remains insufficient for identifying the fine-grained, implicit, and context-dependent risks that children may encounter when viewing AIGC videos. To address this gap, we study child-oriented AIGC video reviewing, making three contributions. First, we construct CAVSR, a benchmark of 605 real-world videos collected from multiple platforms, and develop a hierarchical risk taxonomy comprising 6 top-level categories and 26 fine-grained labels to support systematic evaluation of children's viewing risks. Second, we propose QVRS-E, a knowledge- and experience-augmented video reviewing framework that combines multi-agent collaboration with expert and experiential knowledge to support targeted evidence acquisition and fact-grounded reviewing decisions. Third, extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly enhances the reviewing of child-related risks integrated with vision-language models, and yields more robust review reports.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AIGC视频对儿童可能带来的细粒度、隐式且依赖上下文的观看风险，构建了包含605个真实视频的CAVSR基准数据集和层级风险分类体系，提出了结合多智能体协作与专家经验知识的QVRS-E视频审核框架，实验证明该方法显著提升了儿童相关风险的审核效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频安全研究多从成人视角设计，用于检测通用违规内容，难以识别AIGC视频中儿童可能遇到的细粒度、隐式且依赖上下文的特殊风险。
AI.method: 构建CAVSR基准（605个真实视频，6大类26细粒度的层级风险分类），提出QVRS-E框架（多智能体协作+专家与经验知识增强，支持定向证据获取和基于事实的审核决策）。
AI.result: QVRS-E方法显著提升了与视觉语言模型集成的儿童相关风险审核效果，生成了更鲁棒的审核报告。
AI.conclusion: 面向儿童AIGC视频审核需专门的基准和框架，知识增强的多智能体方法优于通用违规检测方案。

title: Attention-Guided Layer Selection for Contrastive Decoding in Large Language Models
summary: Contrastive decoding methods such as DoLa improve the factuality of Large Language Models (LLMs) by contrasting the output distributions of mature and premature layers. However, DoLa's dynamic layer selection relies solely on divergences in output vocabulary distributions. In this work, we propose three attention-guided strategies: Attention-JSD, Attention-Entropy-Max, and Attention-Entropy-Min, which leverage structural information carried by internal self-attention mechanisms as a signal for layer selection. Experimental results on TruthfulQA demonstrate that our strategies, particularly Attention-JSD and Attention-Entropy-Min, consistently outperform the original DoLa. We observe significant gains on multi-answer metrics (MC2 and MC3), suggesting that attention distributions can provide a more sensitive signal for resolving factual knowledge than output vocabulary distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三种基于注意力机制的对比解码策略（Attention-JSD、Attention-Entropy-Max、Attention-Entropy-Min），通过利用自注意力结构的信号替代原有DoLa方法中仅依赖输出词汇分布进行层选择的方式，在TruthfulQA上提升了LLM的事实性。
AI.motivation: DoLa方法在对比解码中仅依赖输出词汇分布的差异进行动态层选择，未充分利用模型内部自注意力的结构信息，导致层选择信号不够敏感。
AI.method: 提出三种注意力引导的层选择策略：Attention-JSD（基于注意力分布的JSD散度）、Attention-Entropy-Max（最大化注意力熵）、Attention-Entropy-Min（最小化注意力熵），利用自注意力机制的内部结构信号替代原有的词汇分布差异信号来选择成熟层与未成熟层。
AI.result: 在TruthfulQA数据集上，所提策略特别是Attention-JSD和Attention-Entropy-Min在多项指标（MC2和MC3）上持续优于原始DoLa方法。
AI.conclusion: 注意力分布相比输出词汇分布能提供更敏感的层选择信号，有助于更好地解析事实知识，提升对比解码的事实性。

title: Execution-Grounded Security Testing for Coding Agents in Software Engineering Pipelines
summary: Coding agents are increasingly integrated into system operations, where their tool use can directly modify project artifacts, execution environments, and the underlying system. For example, if a coding agent inserts a hook into a system startup or configuration script, that change can persist after the interaction, be triggered later, and abuse delegated user or system privileges to modify the system. This makes security testing a system problem: the key question is not only what the agent says, but what it actually does to the surrounding environment. We present an execution-grounded red-team testing framework for probing this execution-layer security boundary using observable sandbox evidence, including tool invocations, runtime traces, and file-system diffs. Our framework embeds target unsafe operations into routine software engineering workloads, including unit testing, regression testing, crash reproduction, and validation, and uses an execution oracle to guide refinement when an initial probe is rejected or fails. Across multiple agent frameworks and model backbones, our red-team workload reformulation substantially increases verified unsafe execution, reaching 73.61% on code carriers and 53.93% on text carriers. These results show that coding agents in system operations remain insecure under task disguise: once risky intent is hidden inside plausible engineering tasks, the agent can be induced to carry out unsafe actions on the surrounding system. More broadly, coding agents in system operations still demand stronger security testing and safeguards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于执行层证据的红队测试框架，通过将不安全操作嵌入常规软件工程任务（如单元测试、回归测试）中，测试编码代理在执行环境中的安全性。实验发现，编码代理在系统运维中容易被伪装任务诱导执行危险操作，在代码载体和文本载体上分别达到73.61%和53.93%的验证不安全执行率。
AI.motivation: 编码代理在系统运维中可以直接修改项目工件、执行环境和底层系统，其工具使用具有持久性影响（如插入系统启动脚本的钩子会持续生效并滥用权限）。现有安全测试主要关注代理的"言语"而非其在执行层的实际行为，缺乏对执行层安全边界的系统性测试。
AI.method: 提出执行层红队测试框架：1) 将目标不安全操作嵌入常规软件工程工作负载（单元测试、回归测试、崩溃复现、验证）；2) 利用可观察沙箱证据（工具调用、运行时轨迹、文件系统差异）作为判定依据；3) 通过执行预言机在初始探针被拒或失败时引导细化改进。跨多个代理框架和模型骨干进行测试。
AI.result: 在代码载体上达到73.61%的验证不安全执行率，在文本载体上达到53.93%。表明编码代理在系统运维中在任务伪装下仍然不安全，一旦危险意图隐藏在合理的工程任务中，代理可能被诱导对周围系统执行不安全操作。
AI.conclusion: 编码代理在系统运维中仍需要更强的安全测试和安全保障机制。当前代理在任务伪装场景下存在严重安全漏洞。

title: Visual Token Compression Enhances Robustness of MLLMs
comment: 20 pages, 16 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. Code: https://github.com/Eurek001/OOD-VTP
summary: In this paper, we show for the first time that visual token pruning enhances the robustness of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), mitigating vulnerabilities such as jailbreak attacks and hallucinations. Given that vision and language modalities cannot be perfectly aligned, the misaligned visual tokens might act as out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, leading to unpredictable outputs and introducing potential vulnerabilities. Building on this insight, we aim to enhance model robustness against jailbreaks and hallucinations by reducing OOD visual tokens at robust-pruning layers, while also reducing inference cost as a side benefit. Specifically, we measure the distance between each visual token and the language feature space. Then, visual tokens with large distances are identified as OOD tokens, which can be iteratively pruned. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, we evaluate it on seven diverse popular benchmarks. Notably, our method yields an average improvement of 13.29\% in defending jailbreak attacks, consistently achieves competitive performance in mitigating hallucinations, and maintains strong results on general datasets like MME.

AI.tldr: 本文首次证明视觉令牌剪枝可以增强多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的鲁棒性，缓解越狱攻击和幻觉等脆弱性。通过剪枝视觉模态与语言模态之间对齐不良的OOD视觉令牌，该方法在降低推理成本的同时，在越狱防御、幻觉缓解和通用任务上均取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 视觉与语言模态无法完美对齐，不对齐的视觉令牌可能作为分布外（OOD）输入，导致不可预测的输出并引入潜在脆弱性（如越狱攻击和幻觉）。因此，作者旨在通过减少OOD视觉令牌来增强模型鲁棒性。
AI.method: 测量每个视觉令牌与语言特征空间的距离，将距离大的视觉令牌识别为OOD令牌，并在鲁棒剪枝层中迭代剪枝这些令牌。
AI.result: 在7个多样化基准上评估，越狱攻击防御平均提升13.29%，在缓解幻觉方面持续取得有竞争力的性能，并在MME等通用数据集上保持良好结果。
AI.conclusion: 视觉令牌剪枝不仅能提升MLLMs的鲁棒性（防御越狱攻击和缓解幻觉），还能附带降低推理成本，是一种有效的多模态安全优化方法。

title: LoRA for Gender-Inclusive Rewriting and Activation Steering for Counter-Narrative Generation
summary: Gender-inclusive language generation seeks to transform biased text into inclusive alternatives while preserving semantic meaning and contextual coherence. This paper presents the IHLC system for the LT-EDI 2026 Shared Task, addressing both gender-inclusive rewriting and counter-narrative generation. For gender-inclusive rewriting, we employ parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning, achieving an official score of 80.00%. Our primary contribution is a compute-efficient inference-time representation engineering approach for counter-narrative generation. We derive a principal steering direction from contrastive hidden-state activations using principal component analysis (PCA) and inject it into the intermediate representations of Gemma-3-4B-it during inference, enabling behavioral steering toward inclusive responses without modifying model weights. Combined with constrained prompting, this approach produces polite and contextually appropriate counter-narratives, achieving an official score of 78.12%. We further present a manual analysis of steering behavior, identifying key failure modes including semantic drift, residual bias leakage, layer sensitivity, over-steering, and text degeneration. Our findings highlight both the practical potential and current limitations of activation steering as a lightweight alternative to parameter updates for controllable and socially aligned language generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IHLC系统，采用LoRA微调进行性别包容性改写（80.00%），并创新性地使用基于PCA的表示工程方法（激活引导）生成反叙事（78.12%），同时分析了该方法的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 将存在性别偏见的文本转化为包容性表述，同时保持语义和上下文连贯性，并探索计算高效的轻量级方法来实现可控的文本生成。
AI.method: 1) 性别包容性改写：采用参数高效的LoRA微调；2) 反叙事生成：使用PCA从对比隐状态激活中提取主引导方向，注入到Gemma-3-4B-it的中间表示中，结合约束提示实现行为引导，无需修改模型权重。
AI.result: 性别包容性改写官方得分80.00%；反叙事生成官方得分78.12%。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导作为一种轻量级替代参数更新的方法，在可控和社会对齐的文本生成中具有实际潜力，但存在语义漂移、残余偏见泄漏、层敏感性、过度引导和文本退化等局限性。

title: Reference Feature Atlases for Mechanistic Auditing of Language Models
summary:
Auditing a new language model usually means relearning and reinterpreting its internal features from scratch. We propose a reference feature atlas: a sparse feature library trained once on a reference panel and reused for new targets, which attach by fitting only a linear decoder. This yields two complementary views. The atlas channel reads the target on already interpreted panel features, providing a stable coordinate system across models. The residual channel learns features only from what the atlas fails to reconstruct, making "outside the reference panel" an explicit audit signal.
  We train leave-one-out atlases over five 7-9B instruction-tuned models and audit held-out Mistral and Qwen targets. On three controlled LoRA hidden objectives injected into both targets, the residual channel makes the planted mechanism perfectly controllable at runtime while matched controls stay unaffected and recovers the planted objective as the top-ranked latent across both targets; on Mistral, where the per-target SAE and pairwise crosscoder baselines are retrained for a head-to-head benchmark, both baselines fail to do so. On Qwen-2.5, the same channel additionally reveals a panel-relative political-framing cluster; steering it shifts the audited framing metrics while out-of-domain controls remain unchanged.

AI.tldr: 提出参考特征图谱：先在参考模型上训练稀疏特征库，新模型仅需拟合线性解码器即可复用。通过图谱通道（已有特征）和残差通道（新特征）实现跨模型审计，残差通道能检测到参考集外的信号。实验表明该方法能可控检测隐藏目标，优于传统SAE和交叉编码器基线。
AI.motivation: 审计新语言模型通常需要从头学习并重新解释其内部特征，效率低下且缺乏跨模型的统一坐标系。作者希望构建一个可复用的参考特征库，使新模型只需轻量适配即可进行可解释性分析。
AI.method: 在参考模型集上训练稀疏特征库（图谱），对新目标模型仅训练线性解码器进行特征映射。通过图谱通道（直接读取已有特征）和残差通道（学习图谱无法重构的新特征）提供互补视图。采用留一法在5个7-9B指令微调模型上训练，在Mistral和Qwen两个目标模型上审计。
AI.result: 在Mistral和Qwen目标模型中注入三个LoRA隐藏目标，残差通道使植入机制完全可控且不影响对照组，并能将植入目标恢复为最高排名潜变量。对比实验中，目标特定SAE和配对交叉编码器基线均无法实现。在Qwen-2.5上，残差通道还发现了与参考模型相关的政治框架聚类，对其进行干预可改变审计框架指标而域外控制组不变。
AI.conclusion: 参考特征图谱提供了一种跨模型可复用的审计框架，残差通道能有效检测参考集外的新特征，在隐藏目标检测和模型偏差审计方面优于现有方法。

title: TOM-GS: Editable Video Representation via Temporal Opacity Modulation of Static 3D Gaussians
summary: While Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) and dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieve impressive results in video processing, they often fall short of producing representations that are easily editable. Recent methods address this by introducing complex spatial deformations or folded distributions, which constrain optimization and reduce flexibility for downstream editing. In this paper, we introduce TOM-GS, an editable video representation that forgoes complex deformations in favor of regular 3D Gaussians equipped with a continuous temporal opacity formulation. By assigning a learnable temporal mean and scale to the opacity of each Gaussian, our model enables static 3D spatial components to fade smoothly in and out of the scene. Grounded by robust, off-the-shelf pose estimation, our approach maintains a static spatial geometry that naturally supports a wide range of manual and physics-based edits. TOM-GS outperforms prior editable video representations in visual fidelity, while its reliance on standard 3D Gaussians ensures seamless compatibility with established 3D editing tools.

AI.tldr: TOM-GS提出一种可编辑视频表示方法，通过为每个3D高斯的透明度分配可学习的时间均值和尺度，替代复杂的空间变形，利用连续时间透明度公式和现成姿态估计，实现高质量、易编辑的视频表示。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式神经表示和动态3D高斯溅射在视频处理中虽表现优异，但难以生成易于编辑的表示；近期方法引入复杂空间变形或折叠分布，限制了优化灵活性和下游编辑能力。本文旨在设计一种兼顾视觉质量与可编辑性的视频表示方法。
AI.method: TOM-GS采用常规3D高斯结合连续时间透明度公式，为每个高斯的透明度分配可学习的时间均值和尺度，使静态3D空间分量能够平滑淡入淡出场景；利用现成的鲁棒姿态估计维持静态空间几何。
AI.result: TOM-GS在视觉保真度上优于先前的可编辑视频表示方法，且由于依赖标准3D高斯，能够无缝兼容已有的3D编辑工具。
AI.conclusion: TOM-GS通过简洁的时间透明度公式替代复杂形变，成功在保持高质量视觉表现的同时实现了灵活的视频编辑能力，为可编辑视频表示提供了新思路。

title: Interview with Kalle Lyytinen on "Implications of Theories of Language for Information Systems"
summary: Over fourty years after the initial publication of "Implications of Theories of Language for Information Systems" in MIS Quaterly, Lyytinen reflects about the origins of his publication and the developments in this area of research over the past decades. In the here presented interview, Lyytinen discusses the linguistic core of information systems also in light of recent trends and developments in the field, especially with regards to large language models and generative AI. Future research directions following a linguistic perspective on Information Systems (IS) research are outlined.

AI.tldr: Lyytinen回顾其40多年前在MIS Quarterly发表的关于语言理论对信息系统影响的论文，讨论了信息系统语言核心的起源与发展，并结合大语言模型和生成式AI等最新趋势，提出了未来研究方向的访谈文章。
AI.motivation: 反思并追溯Lyytinen最初发表论文的起源，以及过去几十年该研究领域的发展演变，特别是从语言学视角审视信息系统研究的核心问题。
AI.method: 采用访谈（Interview）的形式，由Lyytinen本人进行回顾性讨论和分析。
AI.result: 讨论了信息系统语言核心的起源，结合大语言模型和生成式AI等最新趋势进行了分析。
AI.conclusion: 从语言学视角出发，为信息系统（IS）研究的未来发展方向提出了建议和展望。

title: SCAIR: Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning for Enterprise Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG) enables natural language interaction with structured enterprise knowledge, yet existing agentic approaches that perform well on public benchmarks often fail to generalize to real-world enterprise Knowledge Graphs (KGs), which are dense, schema-driven, and operationally constrained. To address these limitations, we propose SCAIR (Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning), a training-free framework that integrates structured planning with controlled iterative reasoning by injecting schema-conditioned structural priors and enforcing schema-aware traversal during multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on an enterprise-oriented benchmark constructed from a real-world Configuration Management DataBase (CMDB) demonstrate that SCAIR substantially improves performance over existing KG-RAG methods. Crucially, our study highlights that reliable enterprise graph reasoning cannot rely on generic agentic designs; instead, it must explicitly incorporate the target domain's structural and operational constraints into the reasoning process. We demonstrate that by aligning agent design with business logic, substantial performance gains can be achieved without the need for costly model retraining.

AI.tldr: SCAIR是一个无需训练的框架，通过注入模式条件结构先验和强制执行模式感知遍历，解决了现有KG-RAG方法在真实企业知识图谱（密集、模式驱动、操作受限）上泛化能力差的问题。在基于真实CMDB构建的企业基准测试中，SCAIR显著优于现有方法，表明企业图推理必须显式结合目标领域的结构和操作约束。
AI.motivation: 现有基于智能体的KG-RAG方法在公共基准上表现良好，但在真实企业知识图谱（密集、模式驱动、操作受限）上泛化失败，亟需一种能结合领域结构和操作约束的推理方法。
AI.method: 提出SCAIR框架，一种无需训练的智能体迭代推理方法，核心思想是注入模式条件结构先验（schema-conditioned structural priors）并在多跳推理中强制执行模式感知遍历（schema-aware traversal），将结构化规划与受控迭代推理相结合。
AI.result: 在从真实世界CMDB构建的企业导向基准上，SCAIR显著优于现有KG-RAG方法。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的企业图推理不能依赖通用的智能体设计，必须显式地将目标领域的结构和操作约束纳入推理过程；通过与业务逻辑对齐的智能体设计，无需昂贵模型重训即可实现显著性能提升。

title: DAMamba-UNet3D: A Parameter-Efficient Mamba State Space U-Net with Dynamic Adaptive Scan for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: We propose parameter-efficient SSM-based U-Net architectures for 3D medical image segmentation. Convolutional U-Nets afford O(n) local mixing per layer but lack explicit global context; transformers provide global reasoning at O(n^2) cost in sequence length $n$. State-space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, offer $O(n)$ global propagation per block. Yet, existing medical SSM segmenters rely on fixed scan patterns and large parameter budgets. Dynamic Adaptive Scan (DAS), which learns data-dependent reordering before selective scan, has not been applied to medical imaging or extended to 3D volumes. We propose DAMamba-UNet3D, a hybrid encoder-decoder that integrates tri-plane 3D-DAS blocks at encoder stages E2-E4 while retaining convolutions elsewhere (~5.3M parameters). On BraTS 2020 five-fold cross-validation, DAMamba-UNet3D achieves mean Dice 0.815+/-0.013 (full-volume per-case evaluation) at ~13x lower parameter cost than SegMamba (0.824+\-0.014, ~70M). At comparable scale, DAMamba-L (~70M), a wide DAS-native variant with encoder-only DAMamba and a convolutional bottleneck, reaches 0.829+\-0.012, surpassing retrained SegMamba by 0.5pt. Component ablations show that encoder-only DAS placement is critical as bottleneck and decoder SSM blocks lower Dice. Together, the results suggest that learned tri-plane DAS in a hybrid U-Net is competitive with, and under our large-scale design may improve upon, SegMamba's fixed Tri-orientated Mamba (ToM) scanning on BraTS 2020. Code: https://github.com/marafathussain/DAMamba-UNet3D.

AI.tldr: 提出DAMamba-UNet3D，一种参数高效的混合U-Net架构，通过三平面动态自适应扫描（3D-DAS）模块替代固定扫描模式的状态空间模型，在BraTS 2020上以约5.3M参数达到0.815 Dice，而大尺度变体（~70M）达到0.829 Dice，优于SegMamba。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像SSM分割器依赖固定扫描模式和大参数预算；动态自适应扫描（DAS）尚未被应用于医学影像或扩展到3D体积；需要在保持参数高效的同时引入全局上下文建模能力。
AI.method: 提出DAMamba-UNet3D混合编码器-解码器，在编码器阶段E2-E4集成三平面3D-DAS块（学习数据依赖的重排序），其余部分保留卷积，支持从轻量级（~5.3M）到大规模（~70M）的参数缩放。
AI.result: BraTS 2020五折交叉验证：DAMamba-UNet3D（~5.3M参数）平均Dice 0.815±0.013，比SegMamba（~70M参数，0.824±0.014）参数少约13倍；大规模DAMamba-L（~70M）达到0.829±0.012，超过SegMamba 0.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 学习型三平面DAS在混合U-Net中与SegMamba的固定三方向Mamba扫描具有竞争力，且在大尺度设计下优于后者；编码器DAS放置是关键，瓶颈和解码器SSM模块会降低性能。

title: Beyond a Global Norm: Personalizing Toxicity Sensitivity in Language Models Without Retraining
summary: Reducing toxicity is often framed as a global alignment problem, yet perceptions of harmful language are subjective and context-dependent. We present the first comparative evaluation of training-free methods for aligning language generation to user-specific toxicity sensitivities across three inference-time intervention stages: pre-decoding (prompt conditioning and rewriting), in-decoding (token, logit, and representation steering), and post-decoding (candidate re-ranking). Evaluated against toxicity sensitivity targets derived from the PRISM dataset, all methods reduce alignment error by 28-47%. However, the results reveal a fundamental trade-off between alignment effectiveness, personalization, and general language quality, showing how toxicity sensitivity alignment is an inherently multi-objective problem.

AI.tldr: 本文首次比较评估了无需训练的方法（预解码、解码中、后解码三个阶段的干预技术）在将语言生成与用户特定的毒性敏感度对齐时的效果。基于PRISM数据集，所有方法均将对齐误差降低了28-47%，但揭示了对齐效果、个性化和语言质量之间的根本性权衡，表明毒性敏感度对齐本质上是一个多目标优化问题。
AI.motivation: 毒性降低通常被视为全局对齐问题，但有害语言的感知是主观且依赖上下文的。现有方法缺乏针对用户特定毒性敏感度的对齐评估，因此需要探究无需训练的推理时干预方法是否能够实现个性化毒性对齐。
AI.method: 选取三种推理时干预阶段：预解码（提示条件化与重写）、解码中（token、logit和表示空间引导）、后解码（候选重排序）。使用PRISM数据集中的毒性敏感度目标进行评估，比较各方法在无需重新训练模型的前提下对齐用户特定毒性偏好的能力。
AI.result: 所有方法均能将对齐误差降低28-47%，但存在对齐效果、个性化和语言质量三者之间的权衡，说明该问题本质上是多目标的。
AI.conclusion: 毒性敏感度对齐是一个多目标优化问题，而非单一的全局对齐任务，不同推理时干预方法各有优劣，需根据具体需求权衡选择。

title: Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL): Live Schema Grounding and Hallucination Validation for Oracle NL2SQL
summary: Large language models can generate fluent SQL from natural language, but on real enterprise Oracle databases they frequently fail at execution time: columns and aliases are hallucinated and dialect-specific syntax is missed, leading to ORA-00904 invalid-identifier errors. In this setting, failures are primarily due to missing schema grounding: the model cannot know which tables and columns actually exist. This paper introduces Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL), a lightweight middleware layer for Oracle NL2SQL that requires no model retraining. SAL queries Oracle's USER_TAB_COLUMNS catalog to build a live schema map, selects a relevant table subset for each question (falling back to the full schema for multi-table queries), and injects this ground-truth context into the LLM prompt. Generated SQL is then checked by the Hallucination Index (Hidx), which validates every alias.column reference against the live catalog, automatically rewrites predictable prefix errors, and otherwise triggers a structured retry with itemised corrections. We evaluate SAL on 500 TPC-H natural language questions executed against a live Oracle Autonomous Database 23c instance using GPT-4o-mini. Without any schema grounding, execution-grounded truth (EGT; executes and matches the reference result set) is 2.2% (12/500). A hand-written static schema hint brings EGT to 62.0%. SAL, with no manual schema curation, achieves 62.6% EGT (96% simple, 95% medium, 40.7% complex) while reducing execution failures from 97.6% to 2.6%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL)，一种面向Oracle NL2SQL的轻量级中间件，通过实时查询Oracle数据字典构建模式地图、选择相关表子集注入LLM提示，并利用Hallucination Index (Hidx)校验和修正别名/列引用，在不重新训练模型的情况下，将TPC-H数据集上的执行接地准确率从无模式接地时的2.2%提升至62.6%，执行失败率从97.6%降至2.6%。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在真实企业Oracle数据库上将自然语言转换为SQL时，常因列名和别名的幻觉以及方言特定语法缺失导致执行失败（如ORA-00904错误），根本原因在于模型缺乏对实际数据库模式的认知。现有方法依赖手工编写的静态模式提示，难以扩展。
AI.method: SAL包含三个关键组件：(1) 实时查询Oracle的USER_TAB_COLUMNS数据字典构建动态模式地图；(2) 针对每个问题选择相关表子集（多表查询回退至全模式）注入LLM提示；(3) Hallucination Index (Hidx)对生成的SQL进行后校验，验证每个alias.column引用，自动重写可预测的前缀错误，必要时触发带具体修正的结构化重试。
AI.result: 在500个TPC-H自然语言问题上，针对Oracle Autonomous Database 23c使用GPT-4o-mini评估：无模式接地时EGT仅2.2%（12/500）；手工静态模式提示提升至62.0%；SAL无需手动模式筛选达到62.6% EGT（简单96%、中等95%、复杂40.7%），执行失败率从97.6%降至2.6%。
AI.conclusion: SAL作为无需模型重新训练的轻量级中间件，通过动态模式感知和自动错误修正，显著提升LLM在真实Oracle数据库上的SQL生成可靠性，且效果优于手工静态模式提示。

title: $γ$-Bridge: A Look-Parametric Diffusion Bridge
summary: Multiplicative Gamma noise is a signal-dependent degradation in coherent imaging; synthetic aperture radar (SAR) despeckling is its most prominent real-world instance. Existing diffusion denoisers parameterize their forward process by abstract signal-to-noise schedules rather than by the physical look number $L$, so different deployment scenarios typically require separately trained models, and transfer from synthetic Gamma training to real SAR remains challenging without clean ground truth. We introduce $γ$-Bridge, a look-parametric bridge whose schedule $L(t)$ connects the noisy observation at $L_{obs}$ to the clean limit through exact multiplicative Gamma marginals. Its closed-form Gamma--Lévy reverse posterior admits both stochastic and deterministic processes, while observation conditioning and a two-step consistency loss stabilize multi-step inference in the low-SNR single-look regime. Because bridge time directly represents $L$, one conditioned network can smart-start from any admissible input look and stop at a target look number. These two orthogonal controls enable zero-shot restoration over the full admissible grid after training only at $L_{obs} = 1$ on natural images with synthetic Gamma corruption. Combined with a homogeneous-patch look estimator, $γ$-Bridge processes data from six spaceborne and airborne SAR sensors without sensor-specific fine-tuning, achieving leading results on standard synthetic benchmarks while providing physically interpretable input and output controls absent from prior denoisers. Codes are released \href{https://github.com/Teriri1999/GammaBridge}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出γ-Bridge，一种基于物理视角数L参数化的伽马噪声扩散桥模型，通过精确的乘性伽马边缘分布连接噪声观测与干净极限，实现零样本SAR图像去斑，在六种不同传感器数据上无需微调即达到领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散去噪器使用抽象的SNR调度而非物理视角数L参数化前向过程，导致不同部署场景需分别训练模型，且从合成伽马噪声到真实SAR的迁移困难。需要一种能够物理可解释、参数统一且支持零样本迁移的去噪方法。
AI.method: 提出γ-Bridge：1）设计视角数参数化的桥接调度L(t)，通过精确乘性伽马边缘分布连接噪声观测与干净极限；2）推导闭式Gamma-Lévy反向后验，支持随机和确定性过程；3）引入观测条件化和两步一致性损失，稳定低SNR单视角模式下的多步推理；4）利用桥接时间直接对应L的特性，实现单一网络从任意输入视角数智能启动并在目标视角数停止。
AI.result: 在仅以L_obs=1在自然图像上训练的条件下，即可在全可容许网格上实现零样本恢复。结合均匀块视角估计器，无需传感器特定微调即可处理六种星载和机载SAR传感器数据，在标准合成基准上达到领先结果。
AI.conclusion: γ-Bridge提供了物理可解释的输入/输出控制，这是以往去噪器所不具备的，展示了参数化物理先验在扩散模型中的有效性。

title: IndicTalk: A Large-Scale Persona-Based Multilingual Conversational Corpus for Indic Languages
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed conversational AI, yet high-quality multilingual code-mixed dialogue resources remain scarce, particularly for Indic languages where speakers naturally alternate between English and their native language in both native-script and Romanized forms. We present IndicTalk, one of the largest multilingual Indic code-mixed conversational corpora, comprising over 13,28,604 event-grounded multi-turn conversations across 18 language varieties covering 9 Indic languages. The corpus is generated through a fully automated pipeline that combines real-world news grounding, persona-conditioned dialogue generation using multilingual LLMs, and automatic quality validation. Extensive linguistic, automatic, and human evaluations demonstrate that IndicTalk produces fluent, coherent, and naturally code-mixed conversations across both script variants. We will release IndicTalk to support the development and evaluation of multilingual conversational AI for underrepresented Indic languages. The dataset is available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingoIITGN/IndicTalk .

AI.tldr: IndicTalk是一个大规模多语言印度语代码混合对话语料库，包含超过130万条多轮对话，涵盖9种印度语言的18种语言变体，通过自动化流程结合新闻基础、人物条件生成和质量验证构建，支持低资源印度语言的对话AI研究。
AI.motivation: 高质量的多语言代码混合对话资源稀缺，尤其是印度语言中用户自然地在英语和母语（包括原始文字和罗马化形式）之间切换，现有资源无法满足需求。
AI.method: 采用全自动化流水线：结合真实世界新闻作为对话基础、使用多语言LLM进行人物条件对话生成、以及自动质量验证，构建了包含13,28,604个多轮对话的语料库。
AI.result: 生成了覆盖9种印度语言、18种语言变体的大规模代码混合对话语料，经过语言学家评估、自动评估和人工评估，表明对话流畅、连贯且自然地进行代码混合。
AI.conclusion: IndicTalk将作为公开资源支持低资源印度语言的多语言对话AI的发展与评估，数据集已在Hugging Face发布。

title: PhononBench-MP40: a spectrum-resolved benchmark dataset for phonon stability
summary: Imaginary phonon modes remain a practical bottleneck in computational materials screening because otherwise plausible structures can be locally dynamically unstable under a chosen workflow. Here we present PhononBench-MP40, a spectrum-resolved benchmark dataset of Materials Project-derived crystals for workflow-defined phonon stability. The dataset starts from 47,969 MP40 workflow tasks and provides 46,899 completed records with paired stability labels and local phonopy YAML spectra, including 16,683 Stable records and 30,216 completed-phonon unstable records. A further 1,067 relaxation failures are reported separately rather than merged into the completed phonon denominator. The release centers on the local YAML spectrum: the stability label, the lowest sampled frequency and any threshold-dependent relabeling are derived from that spectrum. The dataset is openly available through Science Data Bank at https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.38735. A companion GitHub repository provides the calculation code and lightweight access utilities. PhononBench-MP40 provides an auditable reference for workflow-defined stability classification, minimum-frequency analysis, threshold studies and failure-aware triage, while keeping the reference workflow, data schema and interpretation boundaries explicit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PhononBench-MP40，一个基于Materials Project的声子稳定性基准数据集，包含46,899条完整记录（16,683条稳定，30,216条不稳定）及1,067条弛豫失败记录，提供可审计的局部声子谱与稳定性标签，用于工作流定义的声子稳定性分类、最低频率分析、阈值研究和失败分类。
AI.motivation: 虚声子模式是计算材料筛选中的实际瓶颈，导致看似合理的结构在选定工作流下存在局部动力学不稳定性，但目前缺乏系统性的基准数据集来评估和标准化工作流定义的声子稳定性分类。
AI.method: 从Materials Project的47,969个MP40工作流任务出发，通过phonopy计算获取局部YAML声子谱，基于谱图导出稳定性标签、最低采样频率及阈值相关重标签，并将弛豫失败的1,067个记录单独分离处理。
AI.result: 构建了包含46,899条完整记录的基准数据集，其中16,683条为稳定记录，30,216条为完成声子计算但不稳定的记录，另有1,067条弛豫失败记录单独报告。
AI.conclusion: PhononBench-MP40为工作流定义的稳定性分类、最低频率分析、阈值研究和失败感知分类提供了可审计的参考基准，明确了参考工作流、数据模式和解释边界。

title: An Interactive Vision Language Platform for Cognitive Remediation in Schizophrenia
summary: Cognitive remediation tasks often require patients to perform structured actions involving object manipulation and sequential reasoning. For patients diagnosed with schizophrenia, these tasks are crucial for addressing severe cognitive deficits. However, evaluating the correctness of these physical actions generally relies on manual observation by clinicians, which introduces subjectivity and limits the scalability of therapeutic interventions. In this paper, we propose an automated framework based on Vision-Language Models for action verification in cognitive remediation tasks tailored for schizophrenia rehabilitation. The proposed system relies on a camera-monitored tabletop environment composed of structured miniature scenes including roads, a roundabout, a park, and toy vehicles. Patients receive audio instructions describing goal-oriented spatial actions to perform by manipulating a toy vehicle. These interactive physical activities are specifically designed to stimulate targeted cognitive functions, such as sustained attention, motor coordination, spatial navigation, and cognitive flexibility. To verify the correctness of the performed actions without requiring continuous clinical oversight, the system analyzes the video feed tracking the patient's hand and toy movements. A fine-tuned Vision-Language Model interprets the recorded video sequences and generates semantic descriptions of the observed activities, enabling high-level verification of the executed actions with respect to the initial textual instructions. A dedicated dataset of 4634 tabletop cognitive remediation video scenarios was collected to evaluate the proposed approach. Experimental results demonstrate that our specialized framework effectively bridges low-level physical telemetry with high-level clinical feedback, presenting a scalable and objective solution for advanced cognitive rehabilitation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于视觉语言模型的自动化动作验证框架，用于精神分裂症患者的认知矫正任务。系统通过摄像头监控桌面场景（包含道路、环岛、公园和玩具车），分析患者执行音频指令时的操作视频，利用微调的视觉语言模型生成语义描述从而实现动作正确性验证。在4634个视频样本上评估，证明该方法可扩展且客观。
AI.motivation: 传统认知矫正任务中，患者的结构化动作评估依赖临床医生手动观察，存在主观性强、可扩展性差的问题，限制了治疗干预的规模化应用。
AI.method: 构建摄像头监控的桌面环境（含微型道路、环岛、公园和玩具车）；患者接收音频指令进行目标导向的空间操作；微调视觉语言模型分析视频序列，生成动作的语义描述，并与初始文本指令进行高层次验证匹配。
AI.result: 收集了4634个桌面认知矫正视频场景数据集，实验结果表明该框架能有效将底层物理遥测与高层临床反馈连接起来，提供可扩展且客观的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该自动化框架实现了无需持续临床监督的动作正确性验证，为高级认知康复提供了客观、可扩展的替代方案，弥补了当前评估方法的不足。

title: Co-Evolving Graph and Text Memory for Training-Free Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop question answering requires coordinating relational and textual evidence across reasoning steps, a combination neither a text corpus nor a knowledge graph can supply alone. Prior work often emphasizes only part of this loop: graph-augmented RAG retrieves from a pre-built or query-updated graph, KGQA systems search within topic-centered subgraphs, and memory-augmented agents maintain evolving memories without continuously reconciling graph memory with textual context. We propose Co-E, a training-free system built around synchronized bidirectional graph-text working memory. A synchronization cycle consolidates textual memory, extracts relational triples into graph memory, and injects graph facts back into the generation context. Because both memories are maintained, they shape subsequent retrieval and generation. Evaluated on six multi-hop QA benchmarks, Co-E improves over comparable training-free open-backbone baselines and is competitive with larger or trained systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Co-E，一种无需训练的系统，通过同步双向图-文本工作记忆来增强多跳问答，在多个基准测试上优于同类方法。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答需要协调关系和文本证据跨越推理步骤，但单一文本语料库或知识图谱都难以单独提供完整的支持，现有方法往往只强调了这个循环的一部分。
AI.method: 提出Co-E，一种训练无关的系统，构建了同步双向图-文本工作记忆。同步周期包括：整合文本记忆、提取关系三元组到图记忆、将图事实注入生成上下文，两种记忆共同塑造后续检索和生成过程。
AI.result: 在六个多跳问答基准测试上，Co-E优于同类无需训练的开源基线方法，并与更大规模或有训练的系统具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 双向同步的图-文本工作记忆能够有效增强多跳问答能力，无需额外训练即可达到有竞争力的性能。

title: Too much evidence, too little time: From text to actionable recommendations through multi-objective evidence reasoning
summary: Evidence-based clinical decision making requires specialists to identify, evaluate and synthesize relevant scientific literature. However, PubMed searches for complex clinical cases often return hundreds of publications that cannot be reviewed manually under time constraints. This study proposes SCEPTER (Single-Case Evidence-driven PubMed-To-rEcommendation Reasoner), a framework for transforming clinical case descriptions into evidence-based recommendations. SCEPTER combines PubMed retrieval, PubMedBERT semantic ranking, large language model (LLM)-based claim extraction, evidence-level weighting, contradiction detection, consensus analysis and multi-objective Pareto claim selection. The framework generates structured evidence syntheses and grounded actionable recommendations. A Paper Q&A module further enables interactive exploration of selected publications. The proposed framework introduces multi-objective reasoning model that integrates literature support, contradiction analysis and interactive literature interrogation into a unified clinical decision-support pipeline. Evaluation on 150 case studies demonstrated that the framework reduced an average search space of 576 papers to 53 retained papers, 7 Pareto-optimal claims and 3 final recommendations, corresponding to an overall compression ratio of 192:1. Despite this reduction, the retained evidence maintained high diversity (entropy=0.901). The ablation study showed that Pareto-based selection increased evidence diversity and recommendation utility compared with conventional ranking approaches.

AI.tldr: SCEPTER是一个将临床病例描述转化为循证推荐意见的框架，通过结合PubMed检索、语义排序、大语言模型、证据分级、矛盾检测、共识分析和多目标帕累托选择，将平均576篇文献压缩为3条推荐（压缩比192:1），同时保持高证据多样性（熵=0.901）。
AI.motivation: 临床决策需要专家识别、评估和综合相关科学文献，但PubMed检索复杂临床病例常返回数百篇文献，无法在时间限制下人工审阅。
AI.method: SCEPTER框架整合了PubMed检索、PubMedBERT语义排序、基于大语言模型的声明提取、证据等级加权、矛盾检测、共识分析和多目标帕累托声明选择；还包含论文问答模块支持交互式文献探索。
AI.result: 在150个病例研究中，平均检索空间从576篇缩减至53篇保留论文、7条帕累托最优声明和3条最终推荐，总压缩比192:1；保留证据多样性高（熵=0.901）；消融实验表明帕累托选择优于传统排序方法。
AI.conclusion: SCEPTER将文献支持、矛盾分析和交互式文献查询整合为统一的临床决策支持流程，在保持证据多样性的同时实现了大幅度压缩，为循证临床决策提供了高效工具。

title: A New Kind of Adversarial Example: Measuring the Human-Model Gap, and Its Relationship to OOD Detection
summary: Almost all adversarial attacks add an imperceptible perturbation to fool a model. We instead study the opposite: a large, clearly visible perturbation that causes the model to keep its original, correct prediction, even though a human would no longer recognize the image. Prior work showed such examples can be generated at scale but left three questions untested: whether humans really perform worse than the model, whether standard out-of-distribution (OOD) detection and calibration tools catch it, and whether existing defenses mitigate it. We answer all three on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet. (i) An independent recognizer proxy drops to ~49% on CIFAR-10 while the model stays at 100% -- a gap a small human pilot (N=5) corroborates directly and that is not explained by signal loss (a matched-magnitude Gaussian control degrades recognizability faster); a CLIP zero-shot proxy confirms the gap at ImageNet scale too. (ii) Confidence- and energy-based OOD detectors and calibration are structurally blind (0% detection, ECE ~= 0), while a feature-space Mahalanobis detector flags 100% -- but is evaded by an adaptive attacker at no cost to success. (iii) No classical defense, including adversarial training (45% robust accuracy), reduces attack success (correlation with large-epsilon_l resistance r ~= 0). A mechanistic analysis further shows the attack destroys low-level texture far faster than edge/shape structure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种“明显可见但不会改变模型正确分类”的对抗性扰动（即大尺度、人眼可辨的扰动），并在MNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNet上系统验证了三个问题：人类识别能力是否显著低于模型、标准OOD检测和校准工具是否失效、现有防御是否有效。结果表明人类识别率大幅下降而模型保持100%准确率，OOD检测和校准存在结构性盲点，经典防御（包括对抗训练）几乎无效。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击研究几乎都关注“微小不可见扰动”导致模型误分类，作者反其道而行之，探索“大尺度可见扰动”下模型仍保持正确分类这一反直觉现象，并填补了前人工作中三个关键未验证的问题：人类对比表现、OOD检测与校准工具的有效性、现有防御的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNet三个数据集上，使用大尺度可见扰动生成对抗样本；通过独立识别器代理（CIFAR-10上约49%识别率）、小规模人类实验（N=5）和CLIP零样本代理（ImageNet）评估人类识别能力；测试置信度/能量基OOD检测器、校准（ECE）和特征空间马氏距离检测器；评估包括对抗训练在内的经典防御方法，并进行机制分析（纹理vs边缘/形状结构的破坏速率）。
AI.result: （i）CIFAR-10上独立识别器降至~49%，模型保持100%，高斯控制实验表明这种差距并非信号损失导致；ImageNet上CLIP零样本代理确认了该差距。（ii）置信度和能量基OOD检测器及校准完全失效（0%检测率，ECE≈0），而特征空间马氏检测器能100%检测但被自适应攻击者零代价绕过。（iii）所有经典防御均无效，对抗训练鲁棒准确率仅45%，攻击成功率与对大epsilon_l的抵抗性几乎无关（r≈0）。机制分析表明攻击对低层纹理的破坏远快于边缘/形状结构。
AI.conclusion: 大尺度可见扰动下模型仍能保持正确分类这一现象具有普遍性，现有OOD检测、校准和防御工具对这种攻击存在结构性盲点，需要新的防御思路来应对这种人类与模型感知不一致的威胁。

title: BHARATI: Morphology-Aware Tokenizers for Classical Indian Languages with Subword Fertility Analysis
summary: Standard subword tokenization algorithms such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) and SentencePiece are trained predominantly on modern language corpora and produce inefficient segmentations when applied to classical Indian languages. Sanskrit, Tamil, and other classical Indic languages exhibit agglutinative morphology, productive sandhi (phonological fusion at word boundaries), and domain-specific vocabularies absent from general-purpose training data. This paper presents BHARATI, a set of SentencePiece BPE tokenizers trained on a balanced 781 MB corpus spanning seven languages (English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam) with native script support for all languages. We describe three successive tokenizer versions: v1 (English and Sanskrit only, with broken byte-fallback for Tamil), v2 (four-language support with byte-level fallback for southern languages), and v3 (full seven-language native subword coverage). Subword fertility analysis demonstrates that v3 averages 2.6 tokens per Indian Knowledge System (IKS) technical term, compared to 5.25 tokens per term with GPT-2's tokenizer and 3.75 tokens with the multilingual SentencePiece baseline, with the largest gains on a set of reserved IKS terms that are represented as single tokens by construction. On a held-out test set of 490 IKS-domain sentences (70 per language across seven languages, released with the measurement script), v3 reduces sequence length by roughly 90% relative to GPT-2 and byte-level encoding (which lack native Indic subwords) and by approximately 25% relative to the mBART-50 multilingual baseline, averaged across the six Indic languages, directly translating to increased effective context length for downstream language models. The tokenizer models (32,000 vocabulary), training scripts, and evaluation benchmarks are released under open licenses.

AI.tldr: BHARATI是一套针对古典印度语言优化的SentencePiece BPE分词器，在七语言混合语料上训练，相比GPT-2和mBART-50等基线，在IKS术语的子词生育率上降低了50%以上，序列长度缩短约90%（相对GPT-2）和25%（相对mBART-50），直接提升了下游语言模型的有效上下文长度。
AI.motivation: 标准子词分词算法（如BPE、SentencePiece）主要基于现代语言语料库训练，对古典印度语言（如梵语、泰米尔语）分词效率低下，因为这些语言具有黏着形态、音韵融合（sandhi）和领域特定词汇，导致序列过长、有效上下文受限。
AI.method: 构建了781 MB的七语言平衡语料库（英语、印地语、梵语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语），训练了三版SentencePiece BPE分词器：v1（仅英梵，泰米尔语用退化字节回退）、v2（四语言支持，南部语言用字节级回退）、v3（全七语言原生子词覆盖），词汇量32,000。
AI.result: v3在IKS技术术语上平均子词生育率2.6（GPT-2为5.25，多语言SentencePiece基线为3.75）；在490句IKS测试集上，v3相比GPT-2和字节级编码序列长度减少约90%，相比mBART-50基线减少约25%（六种印度语言平均）。
AI.conclusion: BHARATI v3有效解决了古典印度语言的分词效率问题，显著缩短序列长度，提高下游模型的有效上下文长度，所有模型、训练脚本和评估基准均已开源发布。

title: Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models
summary: Human episodic memory supports the retrieval of experiences that unfold over extended timescales, yet the computational mechanisms underlying this ability remain debated due to the limited mechanistic accessibility in long-term memory experiments in humans. Long-context LLMs may offer promising ways to reveal plausible computational mechanisms that drive this type of retrieval. Here, we investigate whether and how LLMs capture the core behavioral signatures of episodic memory via a temporal order memory task. Using a new dataset of human behavior based on memory of a full-length novel, we show that models exhibit the same characteristic distance effect observed in humans on this task. We next apply long-context mechanistic interpretability analyses to uncover how models solve this task, and find that model performance relies on a one-dimensional temporal code that is reinstated during retrieval by a single time-reinstatement attention head. These findings support temporal context reinstatement as an important mechanism for episodic-like temporal-order memory in LLMs, offering new insights into how temporal aspects of long-term episodic memory may be instantiated in both artificial and biological systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）能否以及如何捕捉人类情景记忆的核心行为特征。通过使用基于完整小说的人类行为数据集进行时间顺序记忆任务，发现LLMs表现出与人类相同的距离效应。通过长上下文机制可解释性分析，发现模型依赖一个一维时间编码，该编码在检索时由一个单一的时间恢复注意力头重新激活。这些结果支持时间上下文恢复是LLMs中类情景时间顺序记忆的重要机制。
AI.motivation: 人类情景记忆能够检索长时间跨度内展开的经历，但其计算机制因长期记忆实验中机制可及性有限而存在争议。长上下文LLMs可能为揭示这类检索的计算机制提供新途径。
AI.method: 使用基于完整小说的人类行为新数据集进行时间顺序记忆任务；比较人类与LLMs的行为表现；应用长上下文机制可解释性分析揭示模型内部计算机制。
AI.result: LLMs在与人类相同的时间顺序记忆任务中表现出特征性的距离效应；模型性能依赖于一维时间编码，该编码在检索时由一个单一的时间恢复注意力头重新激活。
AI.conclusion: 时间上下文恢复是LLMs中类情景时间顺序记忆的重要机制，为理解人工和生物系统中长时情景记忆的时间维度实现提供了新见解。

title: Visual Information Extraction from Documents via Classification-Guided Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual information extraction (VIE) from visually rich documents remains challenging due to high layout variability and real-world impairments. Existing methods typically rely on sequential OCR pipelines or end-to-end models requiring extensive labeled data and layout-specific training, limiting their scalability.We propose a classification-guided large vision-language model (LVLM) framework for multi-type VIE that achieves high accuracy with minimal supervision. The approach decouples document-type classification from content extraction and employs in-context learning (ICL)-based dynamic prompt engineering to inject task-specific knowledge, enabling robust zero-shot inference across diverse layouts. From a theoretical perspective, the proposed method can be viewed as a form of conditional computation that reduces task uncertainty and improves information efficiency during prompt-based inference. Evaluated on a real-world bidding dataset with 16 certificate types, our zero-shot method (based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B) outperforms a strong supervised baseline by 18.35 percentage points in F1-score (86.43\% vs. 68.08\%) and 0.23 in normalized edit distance (0.90 vs. 0.67). Optional domain-specific fine-tuning further improves performance to 93.65\% F1 and 0.93 NED, demonstrating superior robustness against seals, watermarks, and low contrast. The framework offers an efficient, scalable solution for complex document understanding in office automation. Code is available at https://github.com/FairmeHIT/Multi-VIE, and fine-tuned models at https://huggingface.co/fairme/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-SFT.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于分类引导的大视觉语言模型框架用于多类型视觉信息提取，通过解耦文档类型分类与内容提取、结合上下文学习的动态提示工程，在零样本场景下超越强监督基线18.35个百分点的F1分数（86.43% vs 68.08%），可选微调后达到93.65% F1，实现对印章、水印和低对比度等干扰的鲁棒提取。
AI.motivation: 现有VIE方法依赖顺序OCR管线或端到端模型，需要大量标注数据和特定布局训练，扩展性受限，难以应对高布局变异性与真实场景中的干扰（印章、水印、低对比度）。
AI.method: 1) 将文档类型分类与内容提取解耦，先分类后提取；2) 采用基于上下文学习（ICL）的动态提示工程注入任务特定知识；3) 从理论视角将方法视为条件计算，降低任务不确定性并提升提示推理的信息效率；4) 可选领域特定微调进一步提升性能。使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B作为基础模型。
AI.result: 在16种证书类型的真实招投标数据集上，零样本方法F1达86.43%（超越监督基线18.35pp），归一化编辑距离0.90（超越0.23）；领域微调后F1达93.65%，NED达0.93；对印章、水印、低对比度具有强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架通过解耦与动态提示实现了高效、可扩展的文档理解方案，为办公自动化中复杂文档处理提供了实用解决方案。

title: IKS-Instruct: A 24,000-Example Multilingual Dataset for Teaching Language Models Indian Knowledge Systems
summary: Instruction tuning has become the standard method for adapting large language models to follow human intent, yet existing instruction datasets are dominated by English-language general-knowledge tasks and lack coverage of specialized pedagogical domains. This paper presents IKS-Instruct, a dataset of 24,795 instruction-response pairs for teaching language models to deliver educational content grounded in Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS). The dataset spans seven languages (English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam), covers 41 pedagogical techniques from the Vedic oral and mathematical traditions, and is aligned with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) curriculum for classes 6 through 12. The pairs are derived from six source types: classical text corpora (Bhagavad Gita, Thirukkural, Sangam literature, Vedic texts), curriculum-aligned pedagogical templates, Vedic mathematical sutra demonstrations, bilingual instruction pairs, technique-grounded multi-turn dialogues, and cross-tradition comparative analyses. Quality is assessed through a multi-judge evaluation framework in which independent language models score responses on 12 dimensions including technique fidelity, pedagogical quality, factual accuracy, and IKS cultural depth. Under a uniform five-judge external panel (median aggregation over 1,201 stratified items), the strongest IKS-Instruct fine-tune of a compact 7B model reaches a median judge score of 6.39, within 0.15 of a strong general-purpose reference model (Nemotron-Nano at 6.54) at a fraction of its deployment cost, while the base model without IKS fine-tuning scores near zero on the IKS-specific dimensions. Model quality does not increase monotonically with data curation, a result we report together with the corresponding data-quality gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IKS-Instruct数据集，包含24,795个指令-响应对，用于教导语言模型基于印度知识体系（IKS）提供教育内容。数据集涵盖7种语言、41种吠陀教学技术，与CBSE课程对齐，并通过多裁判评估框架验证质量。在7B模型上微调后，IKS特定维度得分从接近零提升至6.39（接近强通用模型6.54），且模型质量不随数据筛选单调提升。
AI.motivation: 现有指令数据集主要由英文通用知识任务主导，缺乏专门教育学领域的覆盖，特别是非西方知识体系（如印度知识体系）的教学内容。
AI.method: 构建IKS-Instruct数据集，从6种来源（经典文本语料库、课程对齐教学模板、吠陀数学公式演示、双语指令对、基于教学技术的多轮对话、跨传统比较分析）生成24,795个指令-响应对，涵盖7种语言和41种吠陀教学技术，并使用5裁判多维度评估框架（12个维度）进行质量评估。
AI.result: 在7B模型上微调后，IKS-Instruct在IKS特定维度上得分6.39（5裁判中位数聚合），接近Nemotron-Nano的6.54，部署成本大幅降低；未微调的基础模型在IKS维度上得分接近零。数据筛选不导致模型质量单调提升。
AI.conclusion: IKS-Instruct能有效提升语言模型在印度知识体系教育内容生成方面的能力，以较低成本达到接近强通用模型的性能，但数据质量与模型质量之间不存在单调关系。

title: cMoLLM at Scale: Horizontal Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-LLMs
summary: Scaling large language models (LLMs) has driven their success, yet dense Transformers couple capacity and computation: every parameter is activated for every token, making training and inference costs grow linearly with model size-a critical bottleneck as models approach trillion-parameter regimes. We aim to scale capacity through MoE-style mixture throughout the LLM pipeline rather than only the FFN. Prior pipeline-level approaches include ParaScale, which introduces virtual tokens and parallel streams but incurs substantial overhead and suffers from homogenized routing and gradient collapse, and AltUp, which uses an auxiliary prediction branch but offers limited adaptivity and slow convergence. We establish that MoE-style mixture layers can be reformulated as variable-kernel dynamic convolutions, where each expert corresponds to a $1{\times}1$ convolutional kernel and routing implements input-conditioned kernel aggregation. Building on this equivalence, we introduce cMoLLM: a convolutionally gated mixture-of-LLMs that routes over end-to-end streams through fully differentiable dynamic convolution. In GPT-2-style models trained on FineWeb, cMoLLM improves language modeling perplexity and downstream GLUE and SQuAD accuracy under matched compute, with better stream utilization, more stable optimization, and favorable scaling compared to ParaScale- and AltUp-style baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出cMoLLM，一种基于卷积门控的混合大语言模型架构，通过将MoE混合层重新表述为可变核动态卷积，实现端到端流路由，在匹配计算量下相比ParaScale和AltUp基线在困惑度、GLUE和SQuAD上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 传统密集Transformer随着模型规模增长，计算成本与参数量线性增长，成为万亿参数模型的瓶颈。现有混合管道方法（如ParaScale、AltUp）存在路由同质化、梯度崩溃、适应性有限等问题，亟需更高效的混合架构方案。
AI.method: 将MoE风格混合层重新表述为可变核动态卷积，每个专家对应1×1卷积核，路由实现输入条件化的核聚合；在此基础上提出cMoLLM，采用卷积门控机制实现端到端流的完全可微动态卷积路由。
AI.result: 在基于FineWeb数据集训练的GPT-2风格模型上，cMoLLM在匹配计算量下提升了语言建模困惑度以及下游GLUE和SQuAD准确率，并实现了更好的流利用率、更稳定的优化和更有利的扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 动态卷积门控的混合管道架构能有效替代传统MoE的FFN-only混合方式，缓解路由同质化与梯度崩溃问题，在大规模LLM扩展中具有良好前景。

title: Structural Preservation Governs Data Augmentation in Deep Learning-Based Laser Speckle Material Classification
comment: Copyright 2026 IEEE. This is the author's version of the work that has been Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE 2025 Intelligent Methods, Systems, and Applications (IMSA). Final published version will be available on IEEE Xplore
summary: Data augmentation is routinely used to improve generalization in image classification, but the assumptions underlying standard policies are poorly matched to coherent imaging. Laser speckle patterns are not generic textures; they arise from coherent interference, and their discriminative content is carried by structured stochastic spatial and frequency statistics. This study examines how controlled augmentation perturbations influence speckle-based material classification on the SensiCut dataset. We train ResNet18 and EfficientNet-B0 under a parametric augmentation framework comprising rotation, Gaussian blur, independent Gaussian noise, spatially correlated speckle-aware noise, intensity jitter, and spatial masking, and evaluate test performance using macro F1-score averaged over three random seeds. Separate ordinary least squares models link augmentation parameters to performance for each architecture. Across both models, Gaussian blur exerts a strong negative effect (p < 0.001), indicating that low-pass filtering suppresses high-frequency structure that is informative for material discrimination. Independent pixel-wise noise is likewise harmful (p = 0.003 for EfficientNet-B0 and p = 0.001 for ResNet18), consistent with disruption of local spatial coherence. In contrast, spatially correlated perturbations yield significant positive coefficients (p = 0.004 for EfficientNet-B0 and p = 0.001 for ResNet18), showing that variability can improve robustness when it preserves speckle organization. The fitted models explain a substantial fraction of performance variation (R2 = 0.796 for EfficientNet-B0 and R2 = 0.879 for ResNet18). These results show that, in laser speckle imaging, augmentation effectiveness is determined primarily by structural preservation rather than perturbation magnitude. The findings motivate physics-aware augmentation design for coherent optical sensing.

AI.tldr: 本研究探究不同数据增强策略对基于激光散斑的材料分类任务的影响，发现保持散斑空间结构的相关性扰动能提升模型鲁棒性，而破坏高频信息的模糊和独立噪声则显著损害性能，表明增强设计应遵循物理感知原则。
AI.motivation: 传统图像分类中的数据增强方法假设图像为自然纹理，忽略了激光散斑图像特有的相干干涉物理特性。散斑图像的判别信息蕴藏在结构化的随机空间和频率统计中，因此需要专门研究何种增强策略能有效提升散斑图像的分类泛化性能。
AI.method: 以ResNet18和EfficientNet-B0为骨干网络，在SensiCut数据集上采用参数化增强框架（包括旋转、高斯模糊、独立高斯噪声、空间相关散斑感知噪声、强度抖动和空间掩蔽），通过普通最小二乘回归建立增强参数与性能（宏F1-score）之间的关联模型。
AI.result: 高斯模糊对两种模型均有极显著负效应（p<0.001）；独立像素噪声同样有害（p=0.003/EfficientNet-B0, p=0.001/ResNet18）；空间相关扰动则产生显著正效应（p=0.004/EfficientNet-B0, p=0.001/ResNet18）。模型解释力较高（R²=0.796和0.879）。
AI.conclusion: 在激光散斑成像中，增强策略的有效性主要由是否保留散斑组织结构决定，而非扰动幅度大小。该发现为相干光学传感领域的物理感知增强设计提供了依据。

title: BERT-based Models vs. Large Language Models for Low-Resource Named Entity Recognition: A Comparative Study on Marathi
summary: Named Entity Recognition (NER) for low-resource languages such as Marathi remains a challenging task due to limited annotated resources and linguistic complexity. Although recent Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of natural language processing tasks, their effectiveness for language-specific NER in low-resource settings remains uncertain. In this study, we fine-tune MahaBERT-v2 on different variants of the MahaNER dataset and systematically compare the performance of these models with an existing MahaNER baseline and prominent general-purpose LLMs, including Gemini, LLaMA-3.3-70B, and Gemma models. All models are evaluated on a Marathi NER test dataset using standard metrics of precision, recall, and F1-score. The experimental results show that the fine-tuned MahaBERT-based models consistently outperform both the baseline and all evaluated LLMs, with the fine-tuned models achieving F1-scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.91, surpassing the existing MahaNER model (0.8843) and significantly exceeding the performance of LLM-based approaches, whose F1-scores range from 0.57 to 0.69. These findings demonstrate that task-specific, language-focused models trained on domain-relevant data remain more effective than general-purpose LLMs for Marathi NER, highlighting the continued importance of specialized architectures for low-resource language processing.

AI.tldr: 针对低资源语言马拉地语的NER任务，微调MahaBERT-v2模型（F1=0.88-0.91）显著优于通用LLM（F1=0.57-0.69）及现有基线，证明任务专用模型在低资源场景下仍更具优势。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（如马拉地语）的NER面临标注资源稀缺和语言复杂性挑战，虽然通用LLM在多种NLP任务中表现强劲，但其在低资源语言NER中的效果尚不明确。
AI.method: 在MahaNER数据集的不同变体上微调MahaBERT-v2，并与现有MahaNER基线及Gemini、LLaMA-3.3-70B、Gemma等通用LLM进行系统比较，使用精确率、召回率和F1分数在马拉地语NER测试集上评估。
