AI.result: 微调后的MahaBERT模型F1达0.88-0.91，超过基线MahaNER（0.8843），而LLM方法F1仅为0.57-0.69。
AI.conclusion: 面向特定任务和语言、在领域相关数据上训练的模型在低资源语言NER中仍比通用LLM更有效，凸显了专用架构对低资源语言处理的重要性。

title: HeraSys: Collaborative Serving of Multiple LLM Workflows via Fine-Grained End-to-End Optimization
summary: The proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has shifted serving systems from processing isolated requests to orchestrating high-concurrency, multi-tenant agentic workflows. However, existing solutions typically prioritize intra-workflow optimization, largely neglecting the significant potential for inter-workflow optimization. In this paper, we propose HeraSys, an LLM serving system designed to optimize the end-to-end performance of concurrent workflows. Through fine-grained orchestration, HeraSys eliminates cross-workflow computational redundancy via structural node merging and reuse. Furthermore, HeraSys introduces a load-aware joint scheduling policy that dynamically manages execution order by evaluating both inter- and intra-query priorities. By integrating a resource skewing mechanism with adaptive batching and pipeline decomposition, HeraSys effectively mitigates tail latency while maintaining low average latency, thereby substantially improving system throughput. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HeraSys reduces P99 latency by up to 2.17$\times$ and increases serving throughput by up to 1.85$\times$ under strict latency guarantees.

AI.tldr: HeraSys是一个面向高并发、多租户LLM agentic工作流的推理服务系统，通过细粒度编排的跨工作流节点合并与复用、负载感知的联合调度策略以及资源倾斜机制，实现了P99延迟降低2.17倍、吞吐量提升1.85倍的显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM服务系统主要关注工作流内部（intra-workflow）优化，忽视了工作流之间（inter-workflow）的计算冗余和优化潜力，无法有效支持高并发多租户的agentic工作流场景。
AI.method: 1) 细粒度编排：通过结构级节点合并与复用消除跨工作流计算冗余；2) 负载感知联合调度：综合评估查询间和查询内优先级动态管理执行顺序；3) 资源倾斜机制：结合自适应批处理和流水线分解，在保持低平均延迟的同时缓解尾部延迟。
AI.result: P99延迟降低2.17倍，服务吞吐量提升1.85倍（在严格延迟保证下）。
AI.conclusion: HeraSys通过跨工作流优化范式，有效解决了高并发多租户agentic工作流的端到端性能瓶颈，为LLM服务系统设计提供了新的方向。

title: PCA: Persistence-Aware Compression and Aggregation for Fast Video Large Language Models
summary: Despite advances in Video Large Language Models (VLLMs) that have displayed promising outcomes in video understanding, the redundancy in the long-duration frames remains a hindrance to efficient reasoning. This paper introduces a training-free $\mathbf{P}$ersistence-Aware $\mathbf{C}$ompression and $\mathbf{A}$ggregation (PCA) method designed to preserve high-fidelity raw visual information before the encoding stage. PCA can be built on arbitrary VLLMs and consists of two modules: 1) A Dynamic Downsampling (DD) module that adaptively removes redundant frames by analyzing frame-wise similarity. 2) A Persistence-Aware Motion Enhancement (PAME) module that enriches each selected keyframe by aggregating the temporal context of its neighbors, ensuring that essential information is preserved even after aggressive frame reduction. Our approach substantially reduces the computation of long-context modeling, while enhancing the performance of the baseline model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PCA consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in both efficiency and accuracy, achieving a speedup of 1.8$\times$ to 2.5$\times$ compared to the baseline VLLM. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/Heisenberg10110/PCA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的视频帧压缩与聚合方法（PCA），通过动态降采样和运动增强模块，在保持高保真视觉信息的同时，显著提升视频大语言模型的推理效率（1.8-2.5倍加速），并在精度上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 长视频帧序列中存在大量冗余信息，导致视频大语言模型推理效率低下，现有方法在压缩帧时容易丢失关键视觉信息。
AI.method: 提出训练无关的PCA方法，包含两个模块：1）动态降采样模块，通过帧间相似度分析自适应移除冗余帧；2）持久感知运动增强模块，通过聚合邻域时序上下文信息丰富关键帧，在剧烈帧压缩下仍保留关键信息。
AI.result: PCA方法可实现1.8倍至2.5倍的推理加速，在效率和精度上均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种即插即用的视频帧压缩聚合方法，无需额外训练即可提升任意VLLM的长视频推理效率，并保持或提升模型性能。

title: Joint Optimization for Greedy Longest-match Tokenization
summary: Recent work has shown that subword vocabularies can be trained to optimize compression for a specific inference rule rather than relying on greedy heuristics such as Byte Pair Encoding (BPE). We extend this approach to greedy left-to-right longest-match decoding, the fast and widely used inference rule underlying WordPiece. We introduce Joint Optimization for Greedy Longest-Match Tokenization (JOLT), which formulates vocabulary learning as an integer program over vocabulary-selection and segmentation-choice variables. Greedy-consistency constraints ensure that each optimized segmentation exactly matches the segmentation produced by longest-match decoding under the selected vocabulary, aligning the training objective with deployment-time tokenization. To scale the optimization, we solve a linear programming relaxation and selectively introduce higher-order segmentations only for unresolved pretokens. The resulting relaxation is nearly integral: rounded solutions fall within 0.008 - 0.176 % of the LP lower bound on the training scope. The bound also shows that BPE is already within 1 - 2 % of the best achievable compression under greedy longest-match decoding, while JOLT closes 89.6 - 99.4 % of the remaining gap. On held-out validation data across four training scopes and vocabulary sizes of 32,000 and 64,000, JOLT produces up to 0.78 % fewer tokens than BPE, with improvements generally increasing as the training scope grows. These results demonstrate that inference-aligned vocabulary optimization can recover most of the limited compression headroom left by BPE while providing a certificate of near-optimality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JOLT方法，将词汇表学习形式化为整数规划问题，通过贪心一致性约束确保训练与部署时的分词对齐，在保持接近最优压缩率的同时，证明BPE已接近理论最优，JOLT可弥合89.6%-99.4%的剩余差距。
AI.motivation: 现有子词词汇表学习多依赖BPE等贪心启发式方法，缺乏与推理规则（特别是WordPiece使用的贪心最长匹配解码）的对齐，导致训练目标与部署时的分词不一致，存在压缩率优化空间。
AI.method: 将词汇表学习建模为整数规划，包含词汇表选择变量和分词选择变量；引入贪心一致性约束确保优化后的分词与最长匹配解码结果一致；通过线性规划松弛求解，仅对未解析的预标记选择性引入高阶分词，实现可扩展优化。
AI.result: 松弛解几乎为整数，与LP下界偏差仅0.008%-0.176%；BPE距离理论最优压缩率仅1%-2%，JOLT可弥合89.6%-99.4%的剩余差距；在验证集上，JOLT比BPE最多减少0.78%的token数，且改进幅度随训练范围增大而增加。
AI.conclusion: 推理对齐的词汇表优化能恢复BPE留下的有限压缩空间的大部分，同时提供接近最优性的证书。

title: Multi-Objective Structured Pruning of LLMs for Latency and Model Size Optimization
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved widespread adoption because of their strong reasoning and query-response capabilities. However, deploying them in embedded and edge computing environments remains challenging because of strict latency, memory, and energy constraints. Their large parameter counts and computational demands hinder efficient execution on resource-constrained platforms. Although model pruning has emerged as a viable solution for reducing scale while preserving performance, jointly optimizing layers, attention heads, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) dimensions remains highly complex. Exhaustively exploring this combined design space is computationally expensive and often leads to local optima or unstable configurations. To address these limitations, we propose a hardware-aware, multi-objective structured pruning framework. The proposed two-stage method explicitly targets latency and model size for efficient deployment on edge devices. In the coarse-grained stage, multi-objective depth pruning removes entire attention and MLP blocks to reduce computational load and memory usage. In the subsequent fine-grained stage, Parallel Bayesian Optimization (PBO) searches for the optimal layer-wise pruning ratios for pruning under latency constraints, while importance-based strategies rank the specific components to be pruned within each layer's allocated budget. Experimental results show that our approach reduces model complexity with minimal impact on commonsense reasoning tasks and zero-shot performance. Our method achieves a favorable trade-off among accuracy, latency, and model size, making it suitable for edge deployment. Across multiple LLMs at 37.5% and 50% pruning ratios, the proposed approach achieves better performance on commonsense reasoning tasks than existing methods while significantly reducing inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向边缘设备部署的硬件感知多目标结构化剪枝框架，通过粗粒度深度剪枝（移除完整注意力/MLP模块）和细粒度并行贝叶斯优化（PBO）搜索最优层剪枝比，在保持推理性能的同时显著降低模型延迟和内存占用。
AI.motivation: LLMs在嵌入式和边缘计算环境中部署面临严格的延迟、内存和能耗约束，现有剪枝方法在联合优化层数、注意力头和MLP维度时存在计算开销大、易陷入局部最优或不稳定配置的问题。
AI.method: 两阶段结构化剪枝框架：(1) 粗粒度阶段：多目标深度剪枝，移除整个注意力/MLP块以降低计算和内存；(2) 细粒度阶段：采用并行贝叶斯优化(PBO)在延迟约束下搜索逐层最优剪枝比，结合重要性排序策略在每层预算内确定具体剪枝组件。
AI.result: 在37.5%和50%剪枝率下，该方法的常识推理任务性能优于现有方法，同时显著降低推理成本，在精度、延迟和模型大小之间实现了良好的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够有效减少模型复杂度且对常识推理任务和零样本性能影响极小，适合边缘设备部署。

title: Trustworthy Medical Segmentation: Uncertainty-Aware U-Net Evaluation Under Clinical Image Degradation
summary: Medical image segmentation models often report high benchmark accuracy under ideal imaging conditions, yet their failures under clinical degradation can be quiet: sensor noise, patient motion, low- resolution acquisition, and contrast variability may all alter model behavior without producing an obvious warning. We present a reproducible framework for evaluating uncertainty-aware segmentation under con- trolled clinical degradation. Our experiments use a synthetic multimodal brain tumor MRI cohort generated with a biophysical phantom simulator that follows the BraTS protocol. We train U-Net and Attention U-Net baselines for multi-class tumor sub-region segmentation and augment both models with Monte Carlo dropout to estimate per-voxel uncertainty. Across eight clinically motivated corruption types at five severity levels, we measure segmentation accuracy, calibration, failure detection, and selective prediction coverage. On clean data, Attention U-Net achieves a whole-tumor Dice of 0.990; under severe Gaussian noise, its performance falls to 0.089. Predictive uncertainty rises with degradation and tracks segmentation error (Pearson r = 0.53 under severity-3 Gaussian noise), allowing us to flag failures with an AUROC of 0.843. These results argue for uncertainty-aware inference as a practical safety layer in physician-in-the-loop radiology workflows. We release the code, trained models, and evaluation protocol to support direct reproduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可复现的框架，用于评估临床退化条件下医学图像分割模型的不确定性。通过合成多模态脑肿瘤MRI数据集，使用U-Net和Attention U-Net结合蒙特卡洛dropout，在8种临床退化类型和5个严重级别下评估分割精度、校准、故障检测和选择性预测覆盖。结果表明预测不确定性随退化升高并与分割误差相关，可作为医师参与放射学工作流程中的安全层。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割模型在理想条件下表现良好，但在临床退化（传感器噪声、患者运动、低分辨率采集、对比度变化等）下可能无声失败，缺乏明显的预警信号。现有研究对此类故障缺乏系统评估和不确定性感知的解决方案。
AI.method: 使用生物物理幻影模拟器生成遵循BraTS协议的多模态脑肿瘤MRI合成数据集；训练U-Net和Attention U-Net基线模型进行多类肿瘤子区域分割；通过蒙特卡洛dropout增强模型以实现逐体素不确定性估计；在8种临床退化类型和5个严重级别下进行全面评估。
AI.result: 清洁数据下Attention U-Net的全肿瘤Dice达到0.990；严重高斯噪声下性能降至0.089。预测不确定性随退化程度升高，与分割误差相关（严重度3高斯噪声下Pearson r=0.53），故障检测AUROC达0.843。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知推理可作为医师参与放射学工作流中的实用安全层，有助于在临床退化条件下自动标记模型失败案例。代码、训练模型和评估协议已开源以支持直接复现。

title: When Activation Oracles Learn Not to Read: Concept-Specific Blind Spots in Fine-Tuned Oracles
summary: Activation Oracles (AOs) are language models trained to answer natural-language questions about another model's internal activations. They offer a flexible interface for reading hidden information from model states, especially when relevant information is internally represented but absent or incomplete in visible behavior. However, AOs are themselves learned systems: their answers are shaped by training data, objectives, and learned reporting behavior, rather than being neutral readouts of represented information. We study this in a controlled Taboo Word Guessing setting, where subject models are fine-tuned to internally use a hidden concept while avoiding direct disclosure. Contrary to the expectation that an AO trained on such a subject becomes a specialist reader, we find that fine-tuned AOs can become concept-specific anti-readers: they selectively fail to recover the concept persistently present during their own training. This failure is not simply explained by absence of the concept from the subject or oracle representations: the target remains decodable inside the oracle, while LogitLens and layer-ablation analyses indicate that the failure arises in the AO readout pathway. Our results show that behavioral leakage, representation-level decodability, and AO-verbalizability can come apart, raising a reliability concern for learned interpretability interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了激活预言机（AOs）的可信性问题，发现经过微调的AOs可能成为特定概念的“反阅读器”——即使目标概念在内部表示中仍然可解码，AOs也会选择性失败，揭示了行为泄露、表示可解码性和AO可表达性三者可能分离。
AI.motivation: 激活预言机（AOs）被广泛用于读取模型内部隐藏信息，但作为学习系统，其输出受训练数据和目标影响，并非中性的信息读取器。本文旨在探究AOs的可信度边界，尤其是在受控场景下AO是否会系统性失效。
AI.method: 在Taboo Word Guessing受控设定下，对被试模型进行微调使其内部使用隐藏概念但避免直接披露；然后训练AOs读取该隐藏概念，通过LogitLens和层消融分析定位失效原因。
AI.result: 经微调的AOs会变成概念特异性的"反阅读器"，对自身训练中持续存在的概念选择性失败；失败原因不在表示层面（目标概念仍可解码），而在于AO的读出路径（readout pathway）。
AI.conclusion: 行为泄露、表示级可解码性和AO可表达性三者可以分离，这表明基于学习的可解释性接口存在可靠性问题，不能被视为中立的内部信息读取工具。

title: Source-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Reliability Prior Approach
summary: Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines rank retrieved documents by semantic similarity alone, without accounting for source provenance or credibility. This work evaluates a simple and interpretable modification to RAG retrieval ranking that incorporates domain-informed source reliability priors. Each document is assigned a prior lambda(s) based on its source type, and retrieval scores are reweighted using score(q, d) = sim(q, d) * lambda(s). The framework is evaluated against a similarity-only baseline on a 120-document health-domain corpus. In this controlled setting, source-aware reranking improves Precision@5 from 0.48 to 0.72 and reduces average adversarial document retrieval under the evaluated threat model, where low-credibility sources are identifiable via metadata. All experiments were executed on Rosie, the high-performance computing cluster at the Milwaukee School of Engineering, which provided the GPU-accelerated infrastructure necessary to run the full experimental pipeline reliably and reproducibly. These results suggest a potential mitigation strategy for source quality degradation in RAG pipelines, within the limits of the experimental setup described.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种简单可解释的RAG检索排序改进方法，通过引入基于来源类型的先验可信度权重（lambda(s)），将检索得分重写为相似度与来源权重的乘积。在120篇健康领域文档的受控实验中，该方法将Precision@5从0.48提升至0.72，并显著降低了对抗性文档的检索率。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG流水线仅依赖语义相似度进行检索排序，忽视了文档来源出处和可信度，导致低质量或低可信度来源的文档可能被检索出来影响生成质量。
AI.method: 为每个文档基于其来源类型分配先验可信度权重lambda(s)，将检索得分重写为 score(q,d) = sim(q,d) * lambda(s)，在检索排序阶段融合来源可信度信息。
AI.result: 在120篇健康文档的受控实验中，来源感知重排序将Precision@5从0.48提升至0.72，并减少了对抗性文档的检索率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在实验设定范围内为缓解RAG管道中来源质量退化问题提供了一种潜在的缓解策略。

title: CrossSpine: Multi-scale Cross-sequence Attention with Anatomical Priors for Automated Pfirrmann Grading
summary: Automated grading of Lumbar Disc Degeneration is essential for the objective quantification of structural changes associated with low back pain. Observing that baseline models underperformed on our data, we propose a framework designed to overcome these limitations. First, we present the Cross-sequence Attention Spine (CrossSpine) framework, a novel architecture that employs a cross-sequence attention mechanism to adaptively fuse features from different MRI sequences at multiple spa- tial scales. Second, we contribute a meticulously curated dataset aimed at automated Pfirrmann grading. Finally, we introduce an IVD-aware classification technique that integrates anatomical disc-level information, enabling the model to learn level-specific degeneration priors. Our experi- ments demonstrate the superiority of this approach: CrossSpine achieved a relative improvement exceeding 125% in the Macro F1 score, while boosting the Mean AUPRC by 99% and the Mean AUROC by 36% com- pared to the baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出CrossSpine框架用于腰椎间盘退变的自动分级，通过跨序列注意力机制融合不同MRI序列特征，结合IVD感知分类技术，在Macro F1上提升超过125%。
AI.motivation: 基线模型在腰椎间盘退变自动分级数据上表现不佳，需要克服现有方法的局限性，以实现更客观的退行性变化量化。
AI.method: 1）CrossSpine框架：跨序列注意力机制在不同空间尺度上自适应融合MRI多序列特征；2）构建了用于自动Pfirrmann分级的精细标注数据集；3）IVD感知分类技术：整合解剖椎间盘层面信息，学习层面特异性退变先验。
AI.result: 相比基线，Macro F1相对提升超过125%，Mean AUPRC提升99%，Mean AUROC提升36%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的跨序列注意力融合与层面感知分类方法在腰椎间盘退变分级任务上显著优于基线模型。

title: LA-RL: Label-Aware Self-Reflection for Reinforcement Learning in Information Extraction
summary: Large language models show strong promise for information extraction (IE), but existing reflection-based correction methods are often misaligned with structured extraction outputs. Free-form self-reflection can flag an error, yet it rarely identifies whether the failure is a missing span, wrong label, boundary mismatch, invalid relation type, or reversed argument order. We introduce LA-RL (Label-Aware Reflective Reinforcement Learning), an outcome-supervised framework that guides IE self-correction with task-grounded diagnostic labels. A single backbone first predicts an extraction, diagnoses task-specific error labels, and then revises its output conditioned on the diagnosis. Training starts from diagnostic data labeled by an annotation model for cold-start supervised fine-tuning and proceeds through two GRPO stages that reward final extraction quality, format validity, and first-pass correctness, without a process reward model. Experiments on named entity recognition, relation extraction, and event extraction show consistent same-backbone gains over SFT, including 6.83 average F1 on SciER relation extraction, about 20 F1 on out-of-distribution relation extraction, and 14.80 trigger F1 plus 17.50 argument F1 on DuEE1.0. Ablations show that reflection structure is task-sensitive: stronger constraints benefit relation extraction, whereas named entity recognition needs less restrictive correction under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 提出LA-RL框架，通过任务特定的诊断标签引导信息抽取的自我纠错，结合监督微调和两阶段GRPO强化学习，在NER、关系抽取和事件抽取任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于反思的纠错方法与结构化抽取输出不对齐，自由形式的自我反思虽然能标记错误，但很少能识别失败的具体类型（如缺失跨度、错误标签、边界不匹配、无效关系类型或参数顺序反转），需要更精细的纠错引导机制。
AI.method: LA-RL框架包含：1) 单一骨干模型先预测抽取结果，诊断任务特定错误标签，然后根据诊断结果修正输出；2) 训练分两个阶段：先用标注模型生成诊断数据进行冷启动监督微调，再通过两阶段GRPO强化学习优化，奖励最终抽取质量、格式有效性和首次预测正确性，无需过程奖励模型。
AI.result: 在NER、关系抽取和事件抽取任务上，相对SFT有持续同骨干网络增益：SciER关系抽取平均F1提升6.83，跨域关系抽取约提升20 F1，DuEE1.0上触发词F1提升14.80、论元F1提升17.50。
AI.conclusion: 反射结构对任务敏感：关系抽取需要更强的约束，而NER在领域迁移下需要限制较少的修正方式。

title: The Scaffold Effect in Coding Agents: Harness Choice as a Hidden Variable in Coding-Agent Evaluation
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Preliminary work; under review at the 5th DL4C Workshop @ ICML 2026
summary: Public leaderboards for coding agents typically rank systems by model name and pass rate, while the surrounding harness (the scaffold that issues tools, manages context, and decides when to stop) is often under-specified. Model-to-model comparison is valid when the harness is fixed; when it varies, performance and efficiency conflate model and scaffold effects. We evaluate Qwen 3.6 Plus and MiniMax M2.5 across three open-source harnesses (Goose, OpenCode, OpenHands-SDK) on a stratified 50-task subset of Terminal-Bench Pro. Harness choice induces up to a 40x difference in tokens per solved task, while paired within-model pass-rate differences remain 0-8 percentage points (95% paired-task bootstrap CIs include zero except for the largest gap). Failure fingerprints replicate across models (REASON for Goose, VERIFY/MAX_TURNS for OpenHands-SDK, idle-loop/TIME for OpenCode), indicating harness-level biases that are largely model-independent. For human-centered coding-agent evaluation, model name alone is an incomplete comparison unit: harness-model pairs determine real-world cost, latency, and oversight burden; no-action turns are a per-task wait tax, not just a token tax. We therefore recommend selecting harness-model pairs by pass rate under token/latency budgets, and reporting token usage, latency, and full harness specifications alongside any model comparison. We release anonymized configs, raw trial logs, aggregated snapshots, and analysis scripts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验发现，编码智能体的评测结果不仅取决于模型，还高度依赖于所使用的基础框架(harness)。不同框架导致单任务token消耗差异高达40倍，而相同模型在不同框架下的通过率差异可达8个百分点。框架层面的偏差(如失败模式)跨模型复现，表明模型名称单独不足以作为比较单位，建议采用框架-模型对进行评测并报告完整的系统规格。
AI.motivation: 当前编码智能体排行榜通常仅按模型名称和通过率排序，而基础框架(harness)的规格常被忽略。当框架不同时，性能和效率的差异可能同时来自模型和框架两方面，导致比较不公平。作者旨在量化框架选择对评测结果的影响，并揭示框架层面的系统性偏差。
AI.method: 在两个模型(Qwen 3.6 Plus和MiniMax M2.5)上，使用三个开源框架(Goose、OpenCode、OpenHands-SDK)在Terminal-Bench Pro的50个分层子集上进行评估。对比各框架下的通过率差异、token消耗效率，并通过bootstrap置信区间检验统计显著性，同时分析失败模式的一致性。
AI.result: 框架选择导致单任务token消耗差异高达40倍；相同模型在不同框架下的通过率差异为0-8个百分点(95% bootstrap置信区间除最大差异外均包含零)；失败模式(如Goose的REASON、OpenHands-SDK的VERIFY/MAX_TURNS、OpenCode的idle-loop/TIME)跨模型复现，表明框架存在模型无关的系统性偏差。
AI.conclusion: 模型名称是不完整的比较单位，应使用框架-模型对进行评估；建议在token/延迟预算下选择最优框架-模型对，并报告token消耗、延迟和完整框架规格；无操作回合是一种每任务等待税，而非仅token税。

title: Open Your Model's Eyes: Video and Context-Aware Multimodal Backchannel Prediction
summary: Backchannels, which signal listener states like empathy and understanding, are fundamental to natural human interaction. However, current approaches rely solely on audio and text. This omits crucial visual cues, such as facial expressions and gestures, as well as broader conversational contexts, which are necessary for accurate prediction. In this paper, we introduce Context-Aware Multimodal Alignment for Backchannel Prediction (CAMA-BC), a novel framework that leverages visual information through Multi-Layer Multimodal Alignment (MMA). Our alignment process comprises two stages. First, Context Alignment (MMA-CA) utilizes unlabeled dialogues with videos to capture conversational contexts. Next, Backchannel Alignment (MMA-BA) fine-tunes the representations specifically for backchannel prediction. Experimental results show that CAMA-BC significantly outperforms both existing methods and simple multimodal baselines, with particular effectiveness in recognizing complex backchannels such as empathy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CAMA-BC框架，通过多模态对齐（视觉+音频+文本）来预测对话中的后向通道信号（如共情），显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有后向通道预测方法仅依赖音频和文本，忽略了面部表情、手势等视觉线索以及更广泛的对话上下文，而这些对于准确预测至关重要。
AI.method: 提出CAMA-BC框架，包含两阶段多模态对齐：1) 上下文对齐（MMA-CA），利用未标注的视频对话捕获对话上下文；2) 后向通道对齐（MMA-BA），微调表示以专门用于后向通道预测。
AI.result: CAMA-BC显著优于现有方法和简单的多模态基线，特别是在识别共情等复杂后向通道方面效果突出。
AI.conclusion: 引入视觉信息并通过多层级多模态对齐可以有效提升后向通道预测性能，为更自然的人机交互提供了新思路。

title: Reasoning or Memorization: Can LLMs Understand and Generate Chinese Xiehouyu Riddles?
comment: 20 pages; exp 3 is work in progress
summary: In this paper, we push the boundary of LLM reasoning by testing them in a Chinese language game, xiehouyu, with novel xiehouyu created by linguists that had not existed before to avoid data contamination. We use multiple-choice questions (MCQ), free-form explanation generation, and new xiehouyu creation to evaluate LLMs' ability to understand and create xiehouyu. In MCQ, we use the delta of accuracy ($Δ_{acc}$) between existing but low-frequency xiehouyu and novel ones as an index for memorization. $Δ_{acc}$ for native speakers is very low, suggesting similar processing mechanisms. However, we found that frontier Chinese models have on average a $Δ_{acc}$ of 23.6\%, while English-centric models tested have a mean $Δ_{acc}$ of 5.1\%, suggesting that frontier Chinese models are likely trained with much larger Chinese data, thus memorizing more low-frequency xiehouyu. For novel xiehouyu, Gemini 3.1 Pro demonstrated remarkable ability with acc 92.6, which is 24\% higher than human accuracy. In xiehouyu creation, those created by LLMs receive much worse ratings than those by humans. These results suggest that claims about the reasoning abilities of LLMs may need careful re-examination considering the data contamination issue, and that LLMs' creativity in language-related tasks may still be behind human experts, at least in Chinese xiehouyu.

AI.tldr: 本文通过中文歇后语测试评估LLM推理能力，发现前沿中文模型因数据污染存在记忆偏差，而Gemini在新型歇后语上超越人类，但LLM的创造性仍不及人类专家。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理能力评估存在数据污染问题，模型可能依赖记忆而非真实推理。作者通过使用语言学家创造的全新歇后语（确保训练数据中不存在）来规避数据污染，从而更准确地评估LLM的理解与推理能力。
AI.method: 采用三项任务：（1）多项选择（MCQ），通过已有低频歇后语与新型歇后语的准确率差值（Δ_acc）衡量记忆程度；（2）自由形式解释生成；（3）新型歇后语创作。对比中文模型、英文模型和人类表现。
AI.result: 中文前沿模型Δ_acc平均23.6%（显示严重记忆），英文模型仅5.1%（更依赖推理）；Gemini 3.1 Pro在新型歇后语上准确率92.6%，比人类高24%；LLM创作的歇后语评分远低于人类。
AI.conclusion: LLM推理能力结论需谨慎重新审视数据污染问题；LLM在语言创造性任务上仍落后于人类专家，至少在中文歇后语领域如此。

title: MM-ShiftKV: Decode-Aware Prefill-Stage KV Selection for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Key-Value (KV) caching is essential for efficient inference in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its memory footprint grows linearly with context length and becomes a major bottleneck due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent prefill-stage KV selection methods estimate KV importance from prefilling statistics, implicitly assuming that prefilling-time queries are representative of those encountered during decoding. We show that this assumption breaks down in multimodal inference, where decoding-time queries exhibit substantially larger variance than prefilling-stage representations, leading to unstable KV importance estimation under tight cache budgets. As a result, small ranking errors can disproportionately discard semantically critical visual tokens and degrade grounding and reasoning performance. We propose MM-ShiftKV, a training-free, decode-aware and strictly prefill-only KV selection method. MM-ShiftKV approximates decoding-time query behavior during prefilling by constructing variance-expanded query proxies and estimates prompt KV importance based on their aggregated attention mass. Experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that MM-ShiftKV consistently outperforms existing methods under strict KV-cache budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/MM-ShiftKV.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态大模型推理中KV缓存内存瓶颈问题，本文提出MM-ShiftKV方法，通过预填充阶段构造方差扩展的查询代理来模拟解码阶段的查询行为，从而更稳定地估计视觉token的重要性，在严格缓存预算下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有预填充阶段KV选择方法假设预填充时的查询能代表解码阶段，但多模态推理中解码阶段查询方差更大，导致在严格缓存预算下KV重要性估计不稳定，易丢弃关键的视觉token，损害定位和推理性能。
AI.method: 提出MM-ShiftKV，一种免训练、解码感知且严格在预填充阶段执行的KV选择方法。通过在预填充阶段构造方差扩展的查询代理来近似解码阶段的查询行为，并基于聚合注意力质量估计提示KV重要性。
AI.result: 在多模态基准测试上，MM-ShiftKV在严格KV缓存预算下 consistently 优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: MM-ShiftKV通过解码感知的预填充KV选择，有效缓解了多模态推理中视觉token的内存瓶颈问题，为高效推理提供了新方案。

title: Calibration-Free 3D Multi-Camera People Tracking for Indoor Environment
summary: Multi-Camera People Tracking (MCPT) traditionally relies on precise intrinsic and extrinsic camera calibration to project 2D detections into a unified 3D world coordinate system.However, manual calibration constitutes a major bottleneck in large-scale dataset generation from unconstrained video archives.  This work proposes a unified calibration-free 3D MCPT framework that infers geometric structure directly from visual data using deep foundation models.  The system integrates anchor-free detection (YOLOX), robust tracking (BoT-SORT), omni-scale appearance embedding (OsNet), pose estimation (HRNet via MMPose), and transformer-based geometric reconstruction using the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT). A pose-guided 3D lifting strategy projects head keypoints onto a reconstructed manifold, eliminating dependence on ground-plane homography. Global identity association is formulated as hierarchical agglomerative clustering under a joint appearance-geometry cost with strict velocity gating. Evaluation on the AI City Challenge 2024 demonstrates a HOTA score of 53.13% without access to ground-truth calibration matrices, establishing a strong baseline for purely vision-based 3D tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需相机标定的三维多目标跟踪（MCPT）框架，通过深度基础模型直接从视觉数据中推理几何结构，集成YOLOX检测、BoT-SORT跟踪、OsNet外观嵌入、HRNet姿态估计及VGGT变压器几何重建，在AI City Challenge 2024上达到53.13% HOTA分数，建立纯视觉三维跟踪的强基线。
AI.motivation: 传统多相机人物跟踪依赖精确的内外参标定将2D检测投影到统一3D坐标系，但人工标定是大型数据集生成的瓶颈，尤其在非结构化视频档案中。
AI.method: 提出统一的无标定3D MCPT框架：使用YOLOX进行无锚检测，BoT-SORT进行鲁棒跟踪，OsNet提取全尺度外观嵌入，HRNet估计人体姿态，VGGT变压器网络进行几何重建；通过姿态引导的3D提升策略将头部关键点投影到重建流形上，消除地平面单应性依赖；全局身份关联采用层次凝聚聚类，联合外观-几何代价并施加严格速度门控。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge 2024上，无需真实标定矩阵即达到53.13%的HOTA分数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了纯视觉驱动的3D跟踪强基线，验证了无标定范式在大规模MCPT中的可行性。

title: Do LLM Debates Repeat Arguments Differently Across Languages?
summary: LLM debate is usually evaluated by final answers, but transcripts also reveal whether later turns develop new argumentative content or return to earlier claims in new wording. We study this process with \textit{prior-argument similarity}, an aggregate diagnostic comparing extracted argument units with earlier units in the same debate. In controlled eight-turn debates over 71 motions, six languages, and four model agents, Chinese is the only tested language with a consistently positive gap relative to English across three multilingual embedding models. The gap persists across agents, turn positions, regression adjustment, metric variants, extraction-length controls, a second-extractor subset, and cross-encoder tail rescoring. Manual calibration shows weak item-level alignment but a high-similarity tail enriched for substantive repetition. A diversity-aware prompt lowers prior-argument similarity across languages, yet does not significantly narrow the Chinese--English gap. These findings suggest that multilingual debate evaluation should measure argumentative development over time and report mitigation effects in both average and gap terms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"先前论点相似度"诊断指标，用于评估多轮辩论中论点的新颖性。在71个议题、6种语言、4个模型智能体的8轮辩论实验中，中文是唯一在所有三种多语言嵌入模型上相对于英文持续存在正向差距的语言，表明中文辩论中更倾向于重复先前论点。该差距在各种条件下稳健，且多样性提示无法显著缩小这一差距。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM辩论评估通常仅关注最终答案，而忽略了辩论过程中论点是否真正发展出新内容，还是以新措辞重复早期主张。作者希望建立一种可量化的诊断方法来评估辩论中论点的新颖性程度。
AI.method: 提出"先前论点相似度"（prior-argument similarity）聚合诊断指标，将辩论中提取的论点单元与同一辩论中更早的论点单元进行相似度比较。在71个议题、6种语言（含中文、英文等）、4种模型智能体上进行8轮控制辩论实验，使用三种多语言嵌入模型。进行包括回归调整、指标变体、提取长度控制、第二提取器子集、交叉编码器尾部修正等多种稳健性检验，以及人工校准和多样性提示干预实验。
AI.result: 中文是唯一在所有三种多语言嵌入模型上相对于英文持续存在正向差距的语言。该差距在多种智能体、轮次位置、回归调整、指标变体、提取长度控制等条件下保持稳健。人工校准显示弱项目级对齐，但高相似度尾部富含有实质意义的重复。多样性提示虽能降低跨语言的先前论点相似度，但无法显著缩小中英文差距。
AI.conclusion: 多语言辩论评估应测量随时间推移的论点发展情况，并以平均值和差距两种维度报告缓解效果。中文辩论中论点重复倾向更为显著，现有多样性提示方法不足以弥合这一语言间差距。

title: TriSP: Tri-Signal Structured Pruning for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse tasks but their deployment is constrained by the memory and compute cost of their parameters. Structured pruning addresses this by removing entire structures such as attention heads and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) neurons to produce smaller dense models that run efficiently on standard hardware. However, existing methods rely on either gradient-based importance estimation, which is memory-prohibitive, or activation-based statistical proxies, which do not directly measure the effect of removal on the loss. Furthermore, the interaction between the importance criterion and the post-pruning recovery strategy has not been systematically studied. We propose TriSP (Tri-Signal Structured Pruning), an importance metric that combines weight magnitude scaled by activation norm with first-order gradient sensitivity via a geometric mean, producing a channel-level score that captures both structural and loss-sensitivity signals. Combined with adaptive per-layer budget allocation and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) recovery, TriSP achieves the lowest perplexity and highest zero-shot accuracy across all tested configurations, reaching 6.80 WikiText-2 perplexity at 20% pruning on LLaMA-7B. Inference throughput improves by 82% at 50% pruning, while still maintaining competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 提出TriSP结构化剪枝方法，通过结合权重幅度、激活范数和梯度敏感性的几何平均作为重要性度量，配合自适应逐层预算分配和LoRA恢复，在LLaMA-7B上实现20%剪枝时WikiText-2困惑度6.80，50%剪枝时推理吞吐量提升82%。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法要么依赖内存开销大的梯度估计，要么使用不直接衡量移除对损失影响的激活统计代理，且重要性准则与剪枝后恢复策略之间的交互尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出TriSP重要性度量，通过几何平均融合权重幅度（经激活范数缩放）和一阶梯度敏感性，生成通道级分数；结合自适应逐层预算分配和LoRA微调恢复。
AI.result: 在所有测试配置下达到最低困惑度和最高零样本准确率，LLaMA-7B在20%剪枝时WikiText-2困惑度6.80，50%剪枝时推理吞吐量提升82%且保持竞争性能。
AI.conclusion: TriSP通过三信号融合的剪枝度量配合自适应预算分配和LoRA恢复，有效解决了LLM结构化剪枝中效率和效果之间的权衡。

title: Generative Augmentation for EEG Motor Imagery Classification: A Class-Conditional VAE with Cycle-Consistent Decoder Refinement
summary: We investigate whether a generative model can supply useful synthetic motor-imagery (MI) electroencephalography (EEG) trials that improve the accuracy of independent downstream classifiers. We train a class-conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) with an integrated latent classifier on the Zhou motor-imagery dataset, using the learned per-class prior as a generator: sampling the prior for a given label and decoding it into a synthetic, label-consistent signal. A constraint on the covariance matrix of the generated data encourages preservation of covariance structure, and the model is trained with a schedule that alternates ordinary VAE training with a decoder-focused phase that sharpens the generative pathway used for augmentation. We measure the effect of adding synthetic trials to the training set under two evaluation protocols -- within-user (pooled 60/20/20 split across subjects) and cross-user (leave-one-subject-out, LOSO) -- across four representative EEG classification pipelines: Common Spatial Patterns with Linear Discriminant Analysis (CSP+LDA), tangent-space features with a Support Vector Machine (TGSP+SVM), Minimum Distance to Riemannian Mean (MDM), and a neural network based on EEGNetv4 (henceforth EEGNet). Results are aggregated across independent augmentation draws, random seeds (within-user), or leave-one-subject-out folds (cross-user), with uncertainty reported as 95\% confidence intervals (Student's $t$-distribution) computed over per-seed/per-fold averages. We find that synthetic EEG from the CVAE is most credible as a source of class-structured, covariance-like data rather than as a substitute for real raw EEG: it can raise the point estimate for MDM, but the broader augmentation claim remains conservative -- observed gains are small and classifier-dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用类条件变分自编码器（CVAE）生成合成运动想象脑电图（MI-EEG）数据，并评估其对下游分类器性能的影响。在周数据集上训练，通过约束协方差矩阵和交替训练策略提升生成质量。在四种分类器（CSP+LDA、TGSP+SVM、MDM、EEGNet）和两种评估协议（用户内、跨用户）下测试，发现合成数据能小幅提升MDM分类器性能，但整体增益有限且依赖具体分类器。
AI.motivation: 探究生成模型是否能提供有用的合成运动想象脑电图（MI-EEG）样本，以提高独立下游分类器的准确率，解决真实EEG数据稀缺问题。
AI.method: 使用类条件变分自编码器（CVAE）在周运动想象数据集上训练，集成潜在分类器。通过对生成数据的协方差矩阵施加约束来保持协方差结构，并采用交替训练策略：普通VAE训练与解码器聚焦阶段交替进行，以锐化用于数据增强的生成路径。
AI.result: 合成EEG数据在四种分类器（CSP+LDA、TGSP+SVM、MDM、EEGNet）和两种协议（用户内、跨用户）下测试，发现仅对MDM分类器的点估计有提升，但整体增益较小且依赖分类器类型，不确定性通过95%置信区间报告。
AI.conclusion: CVAE生成的合成EEG最有价值的是作为具有类别结构的类协方差数据，而非替代真实原始EEG；其数据增强效果有限且保守，仅对特定分类器有微弱提升。

title: Do Small Models Use the Law You Give Them? Context-Injected Fine-Tuning for Legal QA in Bangladesh
summary: A small language model can receive the governing statutory provision and still answer incorrectly. We test whether fine-tuning on examples containing relevant law improves later use of retrieved law. We curate 2{,}165 bilingual QA records from six Bangladeshi acts and three schedules, then fine-tune Qwen3.5 at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B. Evaluation uses the 2022 and 2023 Bangladesh Bar Council exams in Bangla and machine-translated English, with no retrieval, BM25, or FAISS, scored by strict consistency over three seeded runs. At 0.8B, fine-tuning raises the 2022 English FAISS score from 2 to 34 of 100. Gains at 0.8B and 2B survive paired testing, but the 4B model has no detectable net gain: Bangla improves while several English conditions regress. Fine-tuning also reduces answers that drift from Bangla into mostly English from 44.0--53.2\% to 0.2--0.7\%, with adjusted $p<.001$ at every scale. Retrieval quality is therefore not the only bottleneck. Small bilingual legal models also differ in how they use supplied law and whether they answer in the requested language. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/momahadi/bangladesh-legal-qa-dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了小规模法律语言模型在提供相关法条后仍回答错误的问题。通过在孟加拉国法律QA数据集上微调Qwen3.5（0.8B/2B/4B），发现微调能显著提升0.8B和2B模型的检索利用能力和语言一致性，但4B模型未见净收益，且微调有效抑制了语言漂移（从44-53%降至0.2-0.7%）。表明检索质量并非唯一瓶颈，小模型如何利用法条和保持目标语言回答同样关键。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型即使接收到相关的法定条文，仍可能回答错误，说明仅提供检索到的法律信息不足以保证正确回答，需要探索微调是否能改善模型对检索到的法律的利用能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含2,165条双语QA记录的数据集，涵盖6部孟加拉国法案和3个附表；在Qwen3.5的0.8B、2B和4B三个规模上微调；使用2022和2023年孟加拉律师资格考试题目评估，涵盖孟加拉语和机器翻译英语，采用BM25和FAISS检索方式，以三次不同种子运行的严格一致性分数作为评价指标。
AI.result: 0.8B模型微调后，2022年英语FAISS评分从2分提升至34分（满分100）；0.8B和2B的提升具有统计显著性；4B模型无净收益（孟加拉语提升但英语条件下降）；微调将语言漂移（从孟加拉语漂移到英语）从44-53%降至0.2-0.7%，所有规模下调整后p<0.001。
AI.conclusion: 检索质量并非唯一瓶颈，小规模双语法律模型在如何利用提供的法律条文以及是否以请求的语言回答方面存在显著差异，微调可以改善这两个方面。

title: ParBench: A Benchmark for Reliable Evaluation of LLM Parallel Code Translation
summary:
Modern compute-intensive software must migrate across a changing ecosystem of accelerators, programming APIs, compiler stacks, and portability layers, including CUDA, OpenMP, OpenCL, and OpenMP target offload. Large language models and autonomous coding agents are increasingly proposed for such migration, but the field lacks reliable ways to measure whether they preserve the low-level parallel semantics that make translations behaviorally valid, including thread indexing, synchronization, memory management, host-device coordination, and API-specific execution structure.
  We present ParBench, a kernel-centric benchmark framework for evaluating LLM-based parallel API translation under executable, reproducible conditions. ParBench fixes the surrounding build, run, and verification infrastructure through declarative benchmark specifications and asks models to translate only the computational kernels. It draws on multiple open-source HPC suites and covers representative cross-API translation directions among CUDA, OpenMP, OpenCL, and OpenMP target offload. To test whether success reflects robust translation rather than surface-form memorization, ParBench includes AST-driven, intended behavior-preserving, baseline-validated source augmentation. Evaluations on state-of-the-art open and proprietary LLMs show persistent barriers to reliable parallel code translation, including direction asymmetry, multi-file coordination, incomplete API adaptation, and uneven robustness to source-level perturbations. Code is available at https://github.com/Scientific-Computing-Lab/ParBench.

AI.tldr: ParBench是一个用于评估大语言模型在并行API翻译任务中正确性的基准测试框架，通过内核级翻译、可执行验证和AST驱动源码增强，系统性地评估了多种LLM在CUDA、OpenMP、OpenCL和OpenMP target offload之间翻译的完整性与鲁棒性，揭示了方向不对称、多文件协调、API适配不完整和源码扰动鲁棒性差等关键问题。
AI.motivation: 当前计算密集型软件需在多种并行编程API（CUDA、OpenMP、OpenCL等）间迁移，LLM和自主编码代理被用于此类迁移任务，但缺乏可靠的方法衡量其是否保留了低层级并行语义（如线程索引、同步、内存管理、主机-设备协调等），导致翻译的行为有效性无法保证。
AI.method: ParBench采用内核中心（kernel-centric）的基准框架：通过声明式规范固定构建、运行和验证基础设施，仅让模型翻译计算内核；涵盖多种开源HPC套件中的跨API翻译方向；引入AST驱动的、意图保持的、基线验证的源码增强（source augmentation）来区分真正的翻译能力与表面形式的记忆。
AI.result: 对最先进的开源和商业LLM的评估显示，在可靠并行代码翻译方面存在持续障碍，包括方向不对称（某些翻译方向更难）、多文件协调问题、API适配不完整、以及对源码层面扰动的鲁棒性不均匀。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在并行API翻译任务中远未达到可靠水平，ParBench为这一领域提供了系统化、可复现的评估框架，代码已开源。

title: Fast Fourier Convolutional GAN for 30 m Clear-Sky Land Surface Temperature Gap-Free Reconstruction
summary: Satellite-derived Land Surface Temperature (LST) provides spatially comprehensive data that ground stations cannot match. However, its utility is frequently limited by severe data gaps due to the presence of clouds. As LST is essential for understanding land-atmosphere interactions, numerous methods have been proposed to address this challenge. Yet, the development of a scalable and adaptable pipeline for generating gap-free LST datasets and reconstructing cloud-contaminated pixels remains challenging. Moreover, the reconstruction of extensive missing regions in fine-spatial-resolution observations is particularly difficult. To address this challenge, we propose a Multimodal Fast Fourier Convolutional GAN for reconstructing cloud-contaminated pixels in fine-resolution (30 m) Landsat imagery to generate gap-free clear-sky LST products. The method leverages Fast Fourier Convolution to enable a global receptive field across the image, and is guided by a stack of data consisting of satellite observations and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data. Across all LST quantiles, the interquartile range of scene-averaged RMSE (computed over reconstructed pixels) is consistently between 0.8 K and 1.8 K. The proposed approach enables the recovery of extensive missing regions, including scenes with more than 70% cloud-induced gaps, while relying on auxiliary data that are readily available at a near-global scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多模态快速傅里叶卷积生成对抗网络（MFFC-GAN）的方法，用于重建Landsat精细分辨率（30米）地表温度影像中的云污染像元，生成无间隙的晴空LST产品。该方法利用快速傅里叶卷积实现全局感受野，并融合卫星观测与合成孔径雷达（SAR）数据作为引导，能够在超过70%云覆盖的场景下有效恢复大范围缺失区域，场景平均RMSE四分位距稳定在0.8K至1.8K之间。
AI.motivation: 卫星衍生的LST数据虽具有空间全覆盖优势，但云覆盖导致严重的数据间隙，限制了其实际应用。现有方法缺乏可扩展且自适应的处理流程，尤其难以重建精细分辨率观测中大面积缺失区域。
AI.method: 提出多模态快速傅里叶卷积生成对抗网络（MFFC-GAN），核心创新在于采用快速傅里叶卷积实现全局感受野，并融合卫星光学观测与合成孔径雷达（SAR）多模态数据作为引导信息，从而有效重建云污染像元。
AI.result: 在所有LST分位数上，重建像素的场景平均RMSE四分位距稳定在0.8K至1.8K之间；该方法能够恢复超过70%云覆盖的大面积缺失区域。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法实现了对精细分辨率LST影像中云污染像元的有效重建，依赖的辅助数据在全球尺度易获取，具备良好的可扩展性和泛化能力。

title: Two Regimes of Chain-of-Thought Unfaithfulness: Behavioral Detection Fails Where Models Are Wrong
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) explanations support oversight only if they are faithful: the stated reasoning must actually produce the answer. Auditing black-box (behavioral) detection of unfaithful CoT against FaithCoT-Bench's human annotations, we find answer correctness structures the problem at every level. Answer incorrectness alone (an oracle diagnostic, not a deployable detector) outperforms every purpose-built signal (AUROC 0.696), because 69% of annotated unfaithfulness occurs on incorrect answers. Stratifying by correctness splits detection into two regimes: on correct answers, behavioral signals moderately separate faithful from post-hoc reasoning (0.63-0.67); on incorrect answers, where most unfaithfulness lives, no tested signal is detectably above chance (replicated on all four models for benchmark-wide signals). The standard step-removal metric anti-correlates with human labels; this inversion reproduces on the benchmark's released scores and on hint-dependent counterfactually labeled traces. Linear probes decode the behaviorally blind regime in Llama-3.1-8B and the correct-answer regime in Qwen-2.5-7B, with no shared, positively aligned direction detected across regimes; instructed answer-first traces (7 models) transfer to neither annotated regime, while hint-induced unverbalized answer flips do, in model- and source-dependent settings. We also independently verify and resolve a documentation-data mismatch in the benchmark's label semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文发现答案正确性是影响思维链忠实度检测的核心因素：大多数不忠实发生在错误答案上，现有检测信号在正确答案区域表现一般，在错误答案区域完全失效，且标准评估指标与人工标注呈反相关。
AI.motivation: 现有思维链忠实度检测方法（行为层面的黑盒检测）效果有限，缺乏对问题结构的深入理解。本文旨在系统性地分析答案正确性如何影响忠实度检测，并揭示当前检测方法的根本局限。
AI.method: 基于FaithCoT-Bench人工标注数据，通过对答案正确性进行分层分析（正确/错误答案两个区域），评估多种行为检测信号（包括正确性本身作为oracle诊断）、标准step-removal指标、线性探针以及指令诱导的answer-first轨迹等方法在忠实度检测中的表现。
AI.result: 1）答案错误性本身（oracle诊断）AUROC达0.696，超越所有专门设计的检测信号；2）69%的不忠实标注出现在错误答案上；3）在正确答案区域，行为信号只能中等程度区分忠实与事后推理（0.63-0.67）；4）在错误答案区域，所有信号均无显著的检测能力；5）标准step-removal指标与人工标注存在反相关；6）线性探针在不同模型和区域间未发现共享的正向对齐方向；7）发现并解决了数据集的标注文档-数据不匹配问题。
AI.conclusion: 答案正确性是思维链忠实度检测中的关键混淆因素，当前检测方法在大多数不忠实案例所在的错误答案区域完全失效，这揭示了需要重新设计针对错误答案区域的忠实度检测方法。

title: Lexical discovery in unknown environments orchestrated by Large Language Models
summary: Populations of autonomous agents deployed in unknown environments (e.g. planetary or deep-sea exploration) must develop shared vocabularies to refer to entities that have no name in any human language. We propose the Neuro-Symbolic Lexical Discovery (NSLD) framework, in which a population of LLM-based agents plays a referential game over out-of-distribution visual referents, autonomously self-organising a shared alien lexicon. Each agent combines a frozen CLIP vision encoder with a private FAISS vector index and a text-only LLM. Crucially, discovered alien words are anchored to natural language via semantic proximity in the embedding space, enlarging the human vocabulary with new perceptually grounded words. Consensus is reached in simulations with populations of up to twenty agents and ten visual referents. Convergence dynamics are characterised through three analytical models achieving R^2 > 0.95, representing a first step towards pre-deployment planning in autonomous exploration missions.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号词汇发现（NSLD）框架，让LLM智能体群体通过指称游戏自主组织共享的外星词汇，利用CLIP视觉编码器、FAISS向量索引和纯文本LLM，将外星词锚定到自然语言语义空间，在最多20个智能体和10个视觉指称物的模拟中达成共识，并通过三个分析模型（R²>0.95）刻画收敛动力学。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体群体（如行星或深海探测）在未知环境中需为无人类语言名称的实体建立共享词汇，现有方法缺乏在分布外视觉指称物上自主构建全新词汇的能力。
AI.method: NSLD框架：每个智能体结合冻结的CLIP视觉编码器、私有FAISS向量索引和纯文本LLM，通过指称游戏进行交互；利用嵌入空间中的语义邻近性将发现的外星词锚定到自然语言；多个分析模型刻画收敛动力学。
AI.result: 在最多20个智能体和10个视觉指称物的模拟中达成共享词汇共识；三个收敛动力学分析模型达到R²>0.95。
AI.conclusion: NSLD框架有效实现自主智能体群体在未知环境中自组织共享外星词汇，收敛动力学可预测，为自主探索任务部署前规划提供了初步基础。

title: Benchmarking the Domain Gap: Model Selection Instability Under Domain Shift in Video Capsule Endoscopy
summary: Video capsule endoscopy (VCE) classification is typically evaluated within a single dataset, yet clinical deployment demands robustness across acquisition sources, labeling policies, and patient populations. We examine this gap using Kvasir-Capsule, Capsule Vision 2024 (CV2024), and a shared-label subset of Galar. We fine-tune a suite of general-domain pretrained backbones on the official Kvasir-Capsule folds under a standardized protocol and evaluate the same checkpoints on two non-source targets within a documented shared-label decision space. We find that the predictive value of in-domain ranking is target-dependent: Kvasir-Capsule ranking aligns more closely with Galar than with CV2024, while the two non-source targets agree only weakly. Consequently, the strongest in-domain backbone leads on one target yet falls to mid-pack on the other, and no single evaluation target reliably predicts the others. A second CV2024-trained configuration set reproduces this target-dependent instability. We conclude that capsule endoscopy model selection should report cross-target ranking stability rather than peak single-dataset performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视频胶囊内镜（VCE）分类模型在跨数据集（Kvasir-Capsule、Capsule Vision 2024、Galar）的泛化能力，发现模型在源域内的排名无法可靠地预测其在其他目标域上的表现，跨目标排名稳定性差，建议模型选择应关注跨目标排名稳定性而非单一数据集上的峰值性能。
AI.motivation: VCE分类通常在单一数据集上评估，但临床部署需要模型对不同的采集源、标注策略和患者群体具有鲁棒性。现有评估方式与真实部署需求之间存在差距，亟需系统性地考察模型在跨数据集场景下的表现一致性。
AI.method: 使用三个VCE数据集（Kvasir-Capsule、Capsule Vision 2024、Galar共享标签子集），在Kvasir-Capsule官方折上微调多个通用域预训练骨干网络，并在两个非源目标域上进行评估，记录共享标签决策空间。
AI.result: 源域内排名对目标域的预测价值取决于目标：Kvasir-Capsule排名与Galar更一致，与CV2024差异较大；两个非源目标域之间仅弱相关。源域最佳骨干在某一目标域上表现最好，但在另一目标域上仅处于中等水平。第二组CV2024上训练的配置也重复了这种目标依赖的不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 胶囊内镜模型选择应报告跨目标排名稳定性，而非仅关注单一数据集上的峰值性能。

title: Mwando: Leveraging AI to Preserve and Teach shiKomori
summary: This paper presents Mwando, a virtual educational assistant designed to support the teaching and preservation of shiKomori, the language of the Comoros Islands. The system covers the four main dialectal variants (shiNgazidja, shiMwali, shiNdzuani and shiMaore) through a knowledge base constructed from phrases, proverbs, dictionaries and grammar lessons. A multi-agent architecture combining vector search, a knowledge graph and web search fallback enables accurate and context-aware responses. Evaluation on 500 queries demonstrates strong performance on vocabulary lookup and grammar explanations, while qualitative case studies illustrate both capabilities and current limitations. This work represents an initial step toward computational support for shiKomori and provides a blueprint for developing AI-powered educational tools for other low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: Mwando是一个面向科摩罗语shiKomori的虚拟教育助手，采用多智能体架构（向量搜索+知识图谱+网页回退）支持四种方言变体，在500次查询评估中词汇检索和语法解释表现良好，为低资源语言AI教育工具提供了蓝图。
AI.motivation: shiKomori作为科摩罗群岛的低资源语言面临消亡威胁，缺乏计算化支持和教育工具，亟需开发AI驱动的语言保护与教学系统。
AI.method: 构建包含短语、谚语、词典和语法课程的知识库；采用多智能体架构，结合向量搜索、知识图谱和网络搜索回退机制，实现准确且上下文感知的应答。
AI.result: 在500个查询评估中，词汇查找和语法解释任务表现强劲；定性案例研究揭示了系统能力与当前局限性。
AI.conclusion: Mwando是shiKomori计算化支持的第一步，为开发其他低资源语言的AI教育工具提供了可复制的蓝图。

title: Structure Over Scale: Schema-Constrained Causal Graphs for RAG
summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) grounds answers in structured knowledge, but current systems extract entities and relationships exhaustively, producing graphs whose size and construction cost scale with corpus length rather than with the reasoning a query requires. We introduce HCG-RAG (Hierarchical Causal Graph RAG), which replaces open-ended extraction with schema-constrained causal graphs: an automated pipeline distills a corpus into a fixed, typed vocabulary of causal variables and materializes a compact two-tier graph over it. Our schema-constrained graphs match entity-relation baselines on answer quality at a fraction of the cost: 3-20x fewer nodes, 8x-135x fewer build-time LLM calls than the most LLM-intensive baseline (MS-GraphRAG), and graphs compact enough for a domain expert to audit, correct, and extend. On medical and clinical benchmarks, including a neurologist-validated epilepsy dataset, HCG-RAG matches or exceeds the best entity-relation systems. An ablation isolates the causal graph as a structured retrieval filter, contributing +6 percentage points (pp) over embedding-only retrieval. Across all domains with discoverable hierarchical causal structure, only methods imposing higher-level organization outperform flat entity-relation retrieval, indicating that what is placed in the graph matters more than how many nodes it contains.

AI.tldr: HCG-RAG 提出用模式约束的层级因果图代替传统实体-关系图，在保持答案质量的同时将图规模缩小3-20倍、构建成本降低8-135倍，并支持领域专家审计与修正。
AI.motivation: 现有 GraphRAG 系统对实体和关系进行穷举式抽取，导致图规模与构建成本随语料长度线性增长，而非随查询所需的推理复杂度缩放，效率低下且难以审计。
AI.method: 提出 HCG-RAG 框架：用自动化流水线将语料蒸馏为固定、类型化的因果变量词汇表，并在其上构建紧凑的两层因果图（层级因果图），以模式约束替代开放式抽取。
AI.result: 节点数减少3-20倍，构建时LLM调用减少8-135倍；在医学与临床基准上匹配或超越最优实体-关系系统；因果图作为结构化检索过滤器贡献了+6个百分点的提升。
AI.conclusion: 图的组织质量（放入什么）比节点数量更重要；只有施加高层级组织的方法才能超越平面实体-关系检索，说明层级因果结构是提升效率与效果的关键。

title: Cortex: Compact Behavior Cloning for Quake with Frozen Visual Features
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, made with heavy assistance from LLM
summary: We study how far a deliberately simple behavioral-cloning policy can progress in a visually rich first-person game before adding reinforcement learning or explicit memory. Cortex is a compact Quake policy with 10.98 million trainable parameters in a six-layer transformer over a frozen DINOv3 encoder. It is trained on the Quake subset of the public Pixels2Play corpus: 6,849 recordings (about 474.7 hours), represented as 17.09 million cached decision frames with keyboard and mouse actions. One sampled training epoch uses 517,048 four-frame windows and takes 3.3 minutes of policy-head optimization on one RTX 5080, excluding one-time feature extraction. We evaluate two independent batches of 20 stochastic, 120-second episodes on Quake E1M1. Cortex does not complete the level, but every episode reaches the opening door, button room, and gate descent; 19 of 20 episodes in each batch record at least one kill. Under the same time-controlled harness, released P2P-150M and NitroGen checkpoints remain shallower in five matched-duration episodes each. These comparisons are limited by small reference samples and different native interfaces. Ablations show that denser visual tokens improve combat and survival, while longer optimization and naive action history improve offline metrics without consistently improving play. The remaining failures are consistent with covariate shift and motivate targeted corrective data. We release the policy implementation, checkpoint, and a representative rollout.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个简单的行为克隆策略Cortex在视觉效果丰富的第一人称游戏Quake中的表现。Cortex是一个紧凑的Quake策略模型，包含1098万可训练参数，采用六层Transformer架构，基于冻结的DINOv3编码器。模型在Pixels2Play语料库的Quake子集上训练（6849段录音，约474.7小时），评估显示模型虽未完成关卡，但能到达关键区域并有击杀记录。消融实验表明密集视觉token提升战斗和生存能力，剩余失败与协变量偏移一致。
AI.motivation: 探究在添加强化学习或显式记忆之前，一个简单的行为克隆策略在视觉丰富的第一人称游戏中能达到何种程度。
AI.method: Cortex采用六层Transformer架构，基于冻结的DINOv3视觉编码器，共1098万可训练参数。在Pixels2Play语料库的Quake子集上训练，使用6849段录音（约474.7小时），表示为1709万个缓存的决策帧。训练中使用517,048个四帧窗口，在单张RTX 5080上策略头优化需3.3分钟。
AI.result: Cortex未完成关卡，但每个回合都能到达开门、按钮室和闸门下降区域；每批20个回合中有19个至少有一次击杀。与P2P-150M和NitroGen检查点比较，Cortex在相同时间控制下表现更深。消融实验显示密集视觉token提升战斗和生存，更长优化和朴素动作历史改善离线指标但未持续改善游戏表现。
AI.conclusion: 简单行为克隆策略在Quake中能取得一定进展但存在局限，剩余失败与协变量偏移一致，需要针对性的纠正数据来改进。

title: The Cross-Domain Generalization Cost of Offensive Language Detection
summary: Offensive language detection models generally suffer performance degradation when deployed across datasets and across languages, yet most existing studies stop at reporting this phenomenon and lack a systematic methodology for decomposing the causes of degradation into attributable components and quantifying the cost of remediation. This paper proposes a diagnosis and optimization framework composed of three coordinated technical components. First, a zero-shot transfer loss decomposition that separates the performance degradation from OLID to MLMA into two independently measurable components, namely dataset effect and language effect. Second, a controlled fine-tuning protocol that quantifies both adaptation efficiency and the hidden damage inflicted on the source task by comparing few shot learning curves under continued fine-tuning and cold-start starting points. Third, three joint training strategies incorpo rating temperature sampling and experience replay, which offer a controllable Pareto trade-off between improving multilingual capability and preserving source-task performance. Experiments built on this framework show that the dataset effect dominates the zero-shot transfer loss and substantially outweighs the language effect. Few-shot adaptation without a replay mechanism, though data-efficient, inflicts source task damage 4 to 9 times greater than that of the joint training strategies, and its damage magnitude is highly unstable. The three joint training strategies trade 3.2 to 4.1 percentage points of source-task performance for 8.1 to 42.6 percentage points of multilingual capability gain, forming a clear and controllable Pareto trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对攻击性语言检测模型的诊断与优化框架，通过零样本迁移损失分解、受控微调协议和三种联合训练策略，量化了数据集效应和语言效应对性能下降的影响，并实现了源任务性能与多语言能力之间的可控帕累托权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多仅报告攻击性语言检测模型在跨数据集和跨语言部署时存在性能下降现象，但缺乏系统性的方法论来将退化原因分解为可归因的组成部分并量化修复成本。
AI.method: 提出包含三个技术组件的诊断与优化框架：(1) 零样本迁移损失分解，将性能退化分离为数据集效应和语言效应；(2) 受控微调协议，通过少样本学习曲线对比量化适应效率和源任务隐藏损伤；(3) 三种联合训练策略（集成温度采样和经验回放），实现多语言能力与源任务性能之间的可控帕累托权衡。
AI.result: 数据集效应主导零样本迁移损失且显著超过语言效应；无回放机制的少样本适应对源任务造成的损伤是联合训练策略的4-9倍，且损伤幅度极不稳定；三种联合训练策略以3.2-4.1个百分点源任务性能换取8.1-42.6个百分点多语言能力提升，形成了清晰可控的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够系统性地诊断跨数据集/跨语言性能退化原因，并通过可控的联合训练策略在源任务保留与多语言泛化之间实现有效权衡。

title: xMIx: High-Performance Serving-Time Platform for Mechanistic Interpretability Apps
summary:
Mechanistic interpretability (MI) has emerged as a powerful approach for analyzing and intervening in inference computations, with a growing number of applications such as jailbreak attempt detection, truthfulness evaluation, and hallucination detection. Unfortunately, MI deployment in production model-serving systems is currently not practical, as most existing MI frameworks introduce prohibitively high runtime overheads. The fundamental problem is that MI functions do not compose cleanly with served models: they fragment deployment, often force draining requests and rebuilding serving state, and conflict with critical performance optimizations such as continuous batching and CUDA-graph execution, essential for production deployments.
  We present xMIx, a serving-native framework for deploying MI applications in production inference serving environments. xMIx enables attaching MI functions to a predefined set of locations in the model runtime, interposing on activations within the layers and residual streams. xMIx supports conditional invocation of MI functions depending on the outputs in preceding model layers. Multiple MI applications can be deployed in a single model instance. xMIx compiles them all into the serving path but activates them dynamically at runtime only when necessary, with negligible performance cost, and without requiring a separate model instance or alternative execution stack.
  We integrate xMIx with the vLLM serving system and evaluate it across three major models and seven diverse MI applications. xMIx achieves performance comparable to native vLLM execution, incurring a slowdown of 1.3% mean inter-token latency (ITL), 1.2% for tail P99 ITL, 2.6% for mean time to first token (TTFT), and 1.6% for mean total token throughput (TTT).

AI.tldr: xMIx是一个面向生产环境的推理服务框架，能将 mechanistic interpretability (MI) 函数以极低开销（平均 ITL 仅增加 1.3%）集成到 vLLM 等推理系统中，支持条件调用、多 MI 应用共存，无需独立模型实例。
AI.motivation: 现有 MI 框架部署开销过高，无法与生产级推理服务（如 vLLM）中的连续批处理、CUDA-graph 执行等优化兼容，导致请求中断、服务状态重建、部署碎片化等问题，使 MI 在实际生产系统中不可行。
AI.method: xMIx 将 MI 函数以"服务原生"方式附加到模型运行时的预定义位置（如层内激活和残差流），支持基于前序层输出的条件调用，并将多个 MI 应用编译到同一服务路径中，在运行时按需动态激活，无需独立模型实例或替代执行栈。
AI.result: xMIx 与 vLLM 集成后，在三类模型和七种 MI 任务上，平均 ITL 仅增加 1.3%，P99 ITL 增加 1.2%，平均 TTFT 增加 2.6%，平均 TTT 增加 1.6%，性能接近原生 vLLM。
AI.conclusion: xMIx 证明了 MI 可以以极低开销高效集成到生产级推理服务中，为 MI 在实际系统中的应用铺平了道路。

title: A Diagnostic Gap Framework for Evaluating Reconstruction Fidelity in Weakly Supervised Mammography
summary: Weakly supervised pipelines for medical imaging have become increasingly popular over the years. These systems often include multiple stages and components, such as reconstruction, generation, and localization, yet standard evaluation metrics provide limited insight into whether clinically relevant information is preserved across each stage. We present the diagnostic gap framework, a practical evaluation tool that measures decision preservation and explanation preservation as a function of measured reconstruction fidelity. To isolate the effect of reconstruction from localization, we evaluate on curated lesion ROI crops using a fidelity ladder of three class-conditional reconstructors---VQ-VAE-GAN, VAE-GAN, and diffusion (SDEdit)---spanning a twenty-fold range in perceptual distance (LPIPS 0.029--0.584). At autoencoder fidelity, both decision and explanation are preserved: AUC changes remain within $\pm$0.005 and attribution similarity (HiResCAM, Grad-CAM++) stays high. At diffusion fidelity, both collapse: pooled AUC drops by 0.253 and mass-pathology AUC falls below chance. The diagnostic gap is thus a measurable function of reconstruction fidelity rather than an intrinsic cost of reconstruction, and the framework provides an architecture-agnostic instrument for identifying when and where multi-stage pipelines lose diagnostic signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出诊断差距框架，用于评估多阶段医学影像管道（如重建、生成、定位）中临床相关信息是否得以保留。通过三种类条件重建器（VQ-VAE-GAN、VAE-GAN、扩散SDEdit）在病灶ROI裁剪上实验发现，自编码器保真度下决策和解释均得以保留，扩散保真度下两者均崩溃。诊断差距是重建保真度的可测量函数，而非重建的固有代价。
AI.motivation: 现有标准评估指标无法有效衡量多阶段医学影像管道（如重建、生成、定位）中各阶段是否保留了临床相关信息，缺乏评估工具来检测诊断信号在管道中的丢失位置和原因。
AI.method: 提出诊断差距框架，通过决策保留和解释保留两个维度衡量重建保真度对诊断信号的影响。使用三种类条件重建器（VQ-VAE-GAN、VAE-GAN、扩散SDEdit）构建保真度阶梯（LPIPS 0.029-0.584），在病灶ROI裁剪上隔离重建对定位的影响进行评估。
AI.result: 自编码器保真度下，AUC变化保持在±0.005以内，HiResCAM和Grad-CAM++等归因相似度高。扩散保真度下，AUC下降0.253，肿块病理AUC低于随机水平。诊断差距是重建保真度的可测量函数。
AI.conclusion: 诊断差距是重建保真度的可测量函数而非重建的固有代价，该框架提供了一种架构无关的工具，用于识别多阶段管道中诊断信号丢失的位置和原因。

title: Do Diagrams Help Large Language Models Reason? Evidence from Syllogistic Reasoning
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 15th International Conference on the Theory and Application of Diagrams (Diagrams 2026)
summary: Diagrams are widely used to support logical reasoning, and prior studies suggest that representations such as Euler diagrams can improve human reasoning performance. Recent work has also explored their effects on large language models (LLMs). In this paper, we compare four representational conditions for syllogistic reasoning: natural language, logical notation, linear diagrams, and Euler diagrams. Using 285 problems from Ando et al. (2024), we evaluate two contemporary LLMs, Claude 3.5~Sonnet and GPT-4o-mini. Our results show that diagrammatic representations do not consistently improve performance. Although the models perform well on entailment and contradiction problems, they struggle with neutral problems and often make systematic conversion errors. Overall, the results suggest that the tested models gain limited benefit from diagrams in logical reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自然语言、逻辑符号、线性图和欧拉图四种表征条件对大型语言模型（Claude 3.5 Sonnet 和 GPT-4o-mini）在三段论推理任务中的影响。结果表明，图示表征并不能持续提升LLM的推理性能，模型在蕴含和矛盾问题上表现良好，但在中性问题上表现困难且存在系统性转换错误。
AI.motivation: 探究不同表征形式（尤其是图示表征）对大型语言模型逻辑推理能力的影响，验证是否与人类推理中图示能提升表现的现象一致。
AI.method: 使用Ando等人(2024)的285个三段论推理问题，在自然语言、逻辑符号、线性图和欧拉图四种条件下，评估Claude 3.5 Sonnet和GPT-4o-mini两个LLM的推理性能。
AI.result: 图示表征未能持续提升LLM的推理性能；模型在蕴含和矛盾问题上表现良好，但在中性问题上表现较差且存在系统性转换错误。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在逻辑推理任务中从图示表征中获得的收益有限，图示并非提升LLM逻辑推理能力的有效手段。

title: An Agentic Orchestration of Atomistic Simulations
summary: Atomistic simulations are central to materials design, but their execution involves complex, multi-step workflows that require significant human expertise. Here, we present an agent-based system embedded within the URSA (Universal Research and Scientific Agent) framework that automates the design, execution, and validation of atomistic simulations, demonstrated using the Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel Simulator (LAMMPS) tool. Our system autonomously selects interatomic potentials, constructs and runs simulations, and performs iterative error recovery within a closed-loop workflow. We evaluate the scientific reliability of the agent by benchmarking its outputs against LAVA, a high-throughput toolkit for LAMMPS and the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP) calculations. Our framework reduces manual intervention and trial-and-error, thereby improving the rigor, reproducibility, and scalability of atomistic modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于URSA框架的智能代理系统，能够自动化原子模拟的设计、执行与验证流程（以LAMMPS为例），包括自主选择势函数、构建运行模拟及迭代错误恢复，并通过与LAVA工具包对比验证其可靠性，显著减少了人工干预，提高了原子建模的严谨性、可重复性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 原子模拟工作流复杂、多步骤，依赖大量人类专业知识，手动操作耗时且容易出错，亟需自动化方法以提高效率和可靠性。
AI.method: 基于URSA框架构建智能代理系统，集成LAMMPS工具，实现自主势函数选择、模拟构建与执行、闭环迭代错误恢复；通过LAVA（高吞吐LAMMPS/VASP工具包）进行科学可靠性基准测试。
AI.result: 该系统成功实现了原子模拟全流程自动化，减少了人工干预和试错过程，输出结果与LAVA工具包的基准一致，验证了其科学可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该代理系统提升了原子模拟的严谨性、可重复性和可扩展性，为材料设计中的自动化原子模拟提供了可行的解决方案。

title: AI-generated Images Challenge Visual Trust in High-risk Scenarios
summary: Rapid advances in image generation are eroding the evidentiary value of visual content in settings where authenticity can affect public safety and personal reputation. Yet existing detection benchmarks rarely examine synthetic images in public- and individual-safety contexts, where misleading visual content may carry substantial risks. Here we introduce SafeIMG, a safety-oriented benchmark spanning 12 public- and individual-safety scenarios generated using GPT Image 2. Unlike benchmarks centred on generic imagery and image-level labels, SafeIMG evaluates not only whether detectors recognise synthetic images, but also whether their decisions reflect human-identified anomalies. To this end, SafeIMG provides human annotations that localise suspicious regions and explain local artefacts and higher-level commonsense or physical inconsistencies. We evaluate specialized synthetic-image detectors and vision-language models (VLMs), and find that neither provides reliable detection. The strongest VLM identifies only 49.5% of generated images, whereas the best specialised detector identifies 33.1%, compared with 81.7% accuracy for human evaluators. Model explanations cover only 29.8\% of human-annotated anomalies and predominantly capture local defects in text, faces and hands. Their coverage falls to 15.0% for commonsense conflicts and 12.0% for physical inconsistencies, while detection performance deteriorates further after dissemination-induced image degradation. These findings show that current detectors lack the accuracy, explanatory alignment and robustness needed to evaluate AI-generated images reliably across public- and individual-safety settings.

AI.tldr: SafeIMG是一个面向公共与个人安全场景的合成图像检测基准，涵盖12个安全场景。研究发现，当前最强的专用检测器仅能识别33.1%的生成图像，最强VLM识别率仅49.5%，远低于人类的81.7%；模型解释仅覆盖29.8%的人工标注异常，对常识冲突（15.0%）和物理不一致（12.0%）的覆盖率更低，且在图像退化后性能进一步下降。
AI.motivation: 图像生成技术的快速进步正在侵蚀视觉内容的证据价值，影响公共安全和个人声誉。现有检测基准很少在公共和个人安全场景中检验合成图像，而这些场景中误导性视觉内容可能带来重大风险。
AI.method: 构建SafeIMG安全导向基准，涵盖12个公共与个人安全场景，使用GPT Image 2生成。提供人工标注定位可疑区域并解释局部伪影、常识冲突和物理不一致。评估专用合成图像检测器和视觉语言模型（VLMs）的检测性能、解释对齐性和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 最强VLM识别率49.5%，最优专用检测器33.1%，人类81.7%。模型解释覆盖29.8%人工异常，常识冲突覆盖率15.0%，物理不一致12.0%。图像退化后检测性能进一步恶化。
AI.conclusion: 当前检测器缺乏在公共与个人安全场景中可靠评估AI生成图像所需的准确性、解释对齐性和鲁棒性。

title: Novel Claim or Déjà Vu? Rethinking "Contamination-Free'' Dynamic Evaluation for Multimodal Automated Fact-Checking
summary: Multimodal automated fact-checking (MAFC) verifies claims by retrieving and reasoning over external evidence. However, most existing static benchmarks risk contamination: they primarily consist of outdated claims verifiable using an LLM's internal knowledge without external evidence. This can inflate performance estimates and fail to reflect true capability on novel claims that require up-to-date information. To address this, emerging dynamic benchmarks collect claims published after LLMs' knowledge cut-off dates, assuming they are uncontaminated. This work revisits this assumption by empirically studying contamination risks in both the state-of-the-art (SOTA) static AVeriTeC benchmark and our newly constructed dynamic ClaimReview2025Q4 benchmark, as well as their impact on MAFC evaluation. Our experiments yield 16 findings, highlighting three key results: (1) Dynamic evaluation reduces but does not eliminate contamination risks, as 17.09\%--29.30\% of post-cut-off claims remain potentially contaminated; (2) Many newly published claims can be verified either directly or by synthesizing multiple pieces of public knowledge available before the cut-off; and (3) Contamination can induce statistically significant inflation in MAFC performance, increasing Macro-F1 by up to 11.34 points and distorting system rankings. In light of these findings, we re-evaluate SOTA LLMs under a strictly contamination-controlled setting. Our study provides practical guidelines for trustworthy MAFC evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多模态自动事实核查（MAFC）中静态和动态基准的数据污染问题。发现动态基准虽能降低但无法消除污染风险（17.09%-29.30%的发布时间在模型知识截止日期之后的声明仍可能被污染）；许多新声明可通过模型已有知识直接或综合验证；污染可导致MAFC性能显著虚高（Macro-F1最高提升11.34分）并扭曲系统排名。最后提出了严格控制污染下的评估指南。
AI.motivation: 现有的MAFC静态基准存在污染风险（过时声明可通过LLM内部知识验证，无需外部证据），导致性能评估虚高。新兴的动态基准假设发布时间在LLM知识截止日期后即无污染，但该假设缺乏实证验证。本文旨在检验这一假设的可靠性，量化污染对MAFC评估的实际影响。
AI.method: 对比分析静态基准AVeriTeC和新构建的动态基准ClaimReview2025Q4；设计实验检测污染程度（包括直接知识和综合知识的可利用性）；测量污染对Macro-F1和系统排名的影响；提出严格污染控制的评估设置。
AI.result: （1）动态基准中17.09%-29.30%的声明仍存在污染风险；（2）大量新声明可通过模型在知识截止日期前已有的知识直接或综合合成验证；（3）污染导致Macro-F1最多虚高11.34分，并显著改变系统排名顺序。
AI.conclusion: 动态基准不能完全消除污染风险，MAFC评估必须采取更严格的污染控制措施。本文提供了实用指南以实现可信的MAFC评估。

title: HyCE-RAG: Hypergraph Chain-of-Evidence Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop question answering requires systems to retrieve evidence from multiple documents and connect scattered facts into a coherent reasoning process. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mainly relies on semantic similarity between a query and text chunks, and therefore often fails to model structural relations among entities, facts, and evidence units. Graph-based RAG improves this by introducing graph-structured knowledge, but pairwise edges are still limited in representing higher-order associations involving multiple entities and contexts. We propose HyCE-RAG, a Hypergraph Chain-of-Evidence Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework for explainable multi-hop question answering. HyCE-RAG organizes entities, relations, and contextual evidence into hyperedges, builds a query-aware evidence hypergraph, and performs confidence propagation over entity--hyperedge incidence structures. It then uses confidence-guided evidence assembly to select, connect, and rank evidence paths before answer generation. The scoring process jointly considers semantic relevance, entity connectivity, evidence coverage, relation reliability, extraction confidence, and propagated confidence. By providing the language model with structured evidence chains rather than flat retrieved passages, HyCE-RAG supports more faithful and interpretable reasoning. Experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and two GraphRAG-Bench subsets show that HyCE-RAG consistently outperforms standard RAG and graph-based RAG baselines in answer accuracy, context relevance, and faithfulness. These results suggest that hypergraph-based evidence organization is a promising direction for post-retrieval reasoning in complex question answering.

AI.tldr: HyCE-RAG是一个超图链式证据检索增强生成框架，通过构建查询感知的证据超图并在实体-超边关联结构上进行置信度传播，实现可解释的多跳问答，在多个数据集上优于标准RAG和图RAG基线。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG仅依赖语义相似度检索文本块，无法建模实体、事实和证据单元之间的结构关系；图RAG虽引入图结构知识，但成对边仍难以表示涉及多个实体和上下文的高阶关联。
AI.method: 将实体、关系和上下文证据组织为超边，构建查询感知的证据超图；在实体-超边关联结构上进行置信度传播；通过置信度引导的证据组装来选择、连接和排序证据路径；联合考虑语义相关性、实体连通性、证据覆盖率、关系可靠性、提取置信度和传播置信度进行评分。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue和两个GraphRAG-Bench子集上，HyCE-RAG在答案准确性、上下文相关性和忠实度上一致优于标准RAG和图RAG基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于超图的证据组织是复杂问答中检索后推理的一个有前景的方向，能为语言模型提供结构化证据链而非扁平化检索段落，支持更忠实和可解释的推理。

title: Advancing All-Weather Building Damage Mapping to the Instance Level: Outcomes and Insights from the 2026 Bright Challenge
summary: Rapid post-disaster response requires timely, building-level information on whether structures remain intact, are damaged, or are destroyed. Post-event optical imagery, however, may be unavailable because of cloud, smoke, or darkness. The Bright Challenge evaluated all-weather building damage mapping from a submeter-resolution pre-event optical image and a post-event SAR image. Participants were required to detect and delineate each building and assign exactly one of three mutually exclusive damage labels. The challenge extended the globally distributed \textsc{Bright} dataset with instance-level annotations for about 291,000 buildings across 16 disaster events spanning seven disaster types. The final phase was evaluated exclusively on two 2025 events absent from training: a wildfire event in California and a hurricane in Jamaica. A total of 157 participants made 1,289 submissions, and 46 teams entered the final phase. The two winning solutions achieved test mAPs of 0.182 and 0.181, approximately 8.7 times the public baseline of 0.021, but remained far below the best in-domain holdout score of 0.513. Across teams ranked in both phases, performance declined sharply and the rank order changed substantially. The two leading solutions independently favored modality-specific encoding, staged or late optical--SAR fusion, and an optical-dominant separation of building localization from damage recognition. The winning method additionally used scene-aware threshold adjustment and pseudo-label adaptation. These results identify cross-event generalization and stable severity discrimination as the principal remaining challenges. All data, annotations, baseline code, and winning solutions are publicly available at https://github.com/ChenHongruixuan/BRIGHT.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BRIGHT挑战赛，利用灾前高分辨率光学图像和灾后SAR图像进行全天候建筑物损伤测绘，291,000栋建筑、16个灾害事件的数据集，最终获胜方案mAP约0.18（基线0.021），但仍远低于域内最优0.513，表明跨事件泛化和严重程度判别是主要挑战。
AI.motivation: 灾后快速响应需要及时、建筑级别的结构状态信息（完好/受损/毁坏），但灾后光学影像常因云、烟或黑暗而不可用，因此需要开发基于SAR图像的全天候建筑物损伤测绘方法。
AI.method: BRIGHT挑战赛：使用亚米级灾前光学图像和灾后SAR图像进行建筑物检测与三分类（完好/受损/毁坏）损伤标注。数据集扩展了BRIGHT数据集，包含约291,000栋建筑、16个灾害事件（7种灾害类型），最终阶段在两个2025年未见事件（加州野火和牙买加飓风）上评估。
AI.result: 157名参与者提交1,289次，46支队伍进入最终阶段。两个获胜方案测试mAP分别为0.182和0.181，约为公开基线（0.021）的8.7倍，但远低于域内最优（0.513）。跨阶段排名变化显著，性能大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 获胜方案优选模态特定编码、分阶段或晚期光-SAR融合、光学主导的建筑物定位与损伤识别分离架构。跨事件泛化和稳定的严重程度判别是当前主要挑战。所有数据、代码和解决方案已公开。

title: The JEPA Paradox in Language: The Geometry of Linguistic Alternatives
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are effective for images, video, and audio, yet deterministic JEPA-style latent prediction has not become a standard objective for text encoders. We argue that this gap reflects a mismatch between squared-error latent prediction and the conditional structure of language. The key requirement is conditional concentration: given a context and target location, the target representation should lie near a single meaningful point. Local image prediction often satisfies this through spatial continuity, whereas masked text can admit multiple valid token or span completions whose representations need not share a coherent center. We formalize this mismatch through three conditions---predictability, non-collapse, and low conditional variance---and show how their failure creates centroid degeneracy and collapse pressure in text. Matched I-JEPA and T-JEPA experiments reveal the predicted sequence: mutual-information saturation and elevated target variance precede train--validation instability, effective-rank degeneration, cosine collapse, and poor downstream transfer. The same pattern appears across five independent data seeds, indicating that it is not a sampling artifact. These results do not rule out predictive learning for language; they show that text-compatible JEPA objectives must preserve multiple plausible completions rather than compress them into a single latent point.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了确定性JEPA风格潜在预测在文本编码中失效的根本原因：文本的掩码预测允许多种合理补全，而平方误差潜在预测要求条件集中性（即目标表示应位于单一有意义点附近），这在文本中不成立，导致质心退化和坍塌压力。实验验证了从互信息饱和到表示坍塌的完整退化链条。
AI.motivation: 尽管JEPA在图像、视频和音频等模态中表现出色，但确定性JEPA式的潜在预测尚未成为文本编码器的标准目标。作者认为这一差距源于平方误差潜在预测与语言条件结构之间的不匹配，旨在系统性地揭示并形式化这种不匹配的本质。
AI.method: 首先形式化了三个条件（可预测性、非坍塌、低条件方差）来刻画潜在预测的可行性，并通过理论分析指出文本中条件方差的失败导致质心退化和坍塌压力。随后设计了匹配的I-JEPA和T-JEPA对比实验，在训练过程中追踪互信息、目标方差、有效秩、余弦相似度及下游迁移性能等指标的变化轨迹。
AI.result: 实验验证了预测的退化序列：互信息饱和与目标方差升高先于训练-验证不稳定、有效秩退化、余弦坍塌及下游迁移性能下降。该模式在五个独立数据种子上一致复现，排除了采样伪影的可能。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果并不否定语言中预测性学习的可行性，而是表明文本兼容的JEPA目标必须保留多种可能的补全，而非将其压缩到单个潜在点中。

title: Differencing the Diffusion Trajectory toward Uncertain Components for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Diffusion models have become a widely used framework for probabilistic time series forecasting, modeling the distribution of future values given an observed history. In time series forecasting, however, the future continues the observed history, creating an asymmetry the standard diffusion process leaves unaddressed, with slowly-varying content largely determined by the observed continuity while higher-frequency dynamics carry most of the residual uncertainty. Existing diffusion-based forecasters decouple this asymmetry through an external rule before generation, leaving the corruption trajectory blind to which parts of the target the history can already anchor. We propose DiffDiff, a diffusion framework that embeds this predictability asymmetry into the diffusion trajectory itself, so that a single end-to-end diffusion process becomes aware of which parts of the target the history can already anchor. DiffDiff makes the forward operator step-dependent so that the noisy intermediate state progressively shifts from the target itself toward its second-order differenced structure, while a conditioning pathway supplies the denoiser with both value-domain and differential history information balanced by a stage-adaptive gate at each diffusion step. The terminal distribution approaches a standard Gaussian, preserving compatibility with existing samplers. On seven benchmarks across four prediction horizons, DiffDiff outperforms six diffusion baselines, and our analysis confirms that DiffDiff concentrates the diffusion's generative effort on the most uncertain components of the target while relieving it from rebuilding the history-anchored content.

AI.tldr: DiffDiff提出了一种将可预测性不对称性嵌入扩散轨迹本身的时序预测框架，通过步依赖的前向算子使噪声中间状态从目标逐步过渡到其二阶差分结构，并利用阶段自适应门控融合历史和差分信息，在七个基准测试中优于六种扩散基线模型。
AI.motivation: 标准扩散过程忽略时序预测中历史与未来之间的不对称性：低频内容由历史连续性决定，而高频动态承载主要不确定性。现有扩散预测器通过外部规则在生成前解耦这种不对称性，但扩散轨迹本身无法感知历史已确定的部分。
AI.method: 提出DiffDiff框架：(1) 步依赖的前向算子，使噪声中间状态从目标逐步过渡到其二阶差分结构；(2) 条件通路为去噪器提供值域和差分历史信息，并通过阶段自适应门控在不同扩散步骤平衡两种信息；(3) 终端分布保持标准高斯以兼容现有采样器。
AI.result: 在七个基准数据集、四个预测时长上，DiffDiff优于六种扩散基线方法。分析证实DiffDiff将扩散的生成努力集中在最不确定的目标分量上，减少了重建历史锚定内容的负担。
AI.conclusion: 将可预测性不对称性直接嵌入扩散轨迹本身，使端到端的扩散过程能够感知历史已锚定的部分，从而更高效地分配生成资源到不确定性高的成分上。

title: Post-Operative Glioma Segmentation via Loss Stabilization, Normalization and Subspace Attention
comment: Accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN 2026)
summary: Tracking residual tumor after surgery is essential for catching recurrence early, but automating post-operative glioma segmentation remains a difficult task. Although transformer-based architectures, such as SwinUNETR, achieved impressive results, few studies test how well they generalize across clinical protocols. In this paper, we conduct an ablation study on the MU-GLIOMA-POST and UCSF-ALPTDG datasets and show that the standard Generalized Dice Loss (GDL) is unstable under domain shift: the Whole Lesion (WL) Dice drops from 0.88 on the internal validation set to 0.73 on the external UCSF test set. To address this, we pair brain-masked percentile normalization with voxel-level contrastive learning. We also propose a Subspace-Aware Class Attention (SACA) module that re-calibrates the bottleneck features and raises Enhancing Tumor (ET) sensitivity by 8% (9.1% relative improvement) on internal validation. Ensembling these refinements with nnU-Net brings every stable configuration to a WL Dice of 0.94, and the SACA variant ensemble achieves the best boundary error (HD95) of 2.92 mm on MU-GLIOMA-POST.

AI.tldr: 本文针对术后胶质瘤分割任务，发现标准GDL损失在域迁移下不稳定（WL Dice从0.88降至0.73），提出脑掩膜百分位归一化、体素级对比学习以及子空间感知类注意力模块（SACA），集成nnU-Net后WL Dice提升至0.94，HD95达2.92 mm。
AI.motivation: 术后残留肿瘤追踪对早期复发检测至关重要，但自动化术后胶质瘤分割仍具挑战。现有Transformer架构虽表现优异，但跨临床协议的泛化能力缺乏验证，标准GDL损失在域迁移下表现不稳定。
AI.method: 1) 脑掩膜百分位归一化；2) 体素级对比学习；3) 子空间感知类注意力模块（SACA）对瓶颈特征进行重校准；4) 将上述改进与nnU-Net集成。
AI.result: 标准GDL在域迁移下WL Dice从0.88降至0.73；SACA模块使ET敏感性提升8%（相对提升9.1%）；集成后稳定配置WL Dice达0.94，SACA变体集成在MU-GLIOMA-POST上HD95为2.92 mm。
AI.conclusion: 所提归一化、对比学习及SACA模块有效缓解了域迁移下的性能下降，集成策略进一步提升分割精度，实现了术后胶质瘤分割的SOTA性能。

title: Guiding Language Models to Be More Empathetic: Culturally Sensitive Mental Health Advice Generation Through Human-LLM Collaboration
summary: Despite recent advances in large language models (LLMs), their ability to generate empathetic mental health counseling responses in low-resource languages remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we curate 625 authentic mental health cases from three complementary sources: (1) publicly available Facebook posts discussing mental health concerns, (2) transcripts from the Bangladeshi television program "Ami Akhon Ki Korbo", and (3) anonymized student questionnaire responses covering diverse emotional and psychological challenges. Based on these cases, we build an evaluation corpus comprising advice written by licensed clinical psychologists and responses generated by three modern proprietary LLMs: GPT-4o Mini, Claude 4.5 Haiku, and Gemini 2.5 Pro. We further propose the Role-Playing Reflective Chain-of-Thought Advisory Framework (RP-RCAF), a task-specific prompting strategy that combines expert-authored few-shot examples with structured self-reflection to produce supportive, culturally aware, and ethically aligned counseling through a compassionate advisor persona. We also introduce the Grok 4-Based Response Evaluation and Scoring Framework (G-REFS), which integrates automated assessment with expert psychologist validation across emotional sensitivity, cultural appropriateness, linguistic clarity, and ethical soundness. Experimental results show that RP-RCAF consistently outperforms conventional prompting across all evaluated models and produces responses that more closely align with professional psychological counseling.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低资源语言环境下大语言模型生成共情心理健康咨询回应能力不足的问题，构建了包含625个真实心理健康案例的语料库，提出了角色扮演反思链式思维咨询框架（RP-RCAF）和Grok 4评估评分框架（G-REFS），实验表明RP-RCAF在所有评估模型上均优于传统提示策略，生成的回应更接近专业心理咨询。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在低资源语言（如孟加拉语）中生成共情心理健康咨询回应的能力尚未被充分探索，缺乏相应的评估基准和有效提示策略。
AI.method: (1) 从三种互补来源（Facebook帖子、电视节目转录、匿名学生问卷）构建625个真实心理健康案例；(2) 构建包含临床心理学家撰写的建议和三种商业LLM（GPT-4o Mini、Claude 4.5 Haiku、Gemini 2.5 Pro）生成回应的评估语料库；(3) 提出RP-RCAF提示策略，结合专家编写的少样本示例与结构化自我反思，通过共情顾问角色生成回应；(4) 提出G-REFS评估框架，综合自动评估与心理学家验证，涵盖情感敏感性、文化适宜性、语言清晰度和伦理稳健性四个维度。
AI.result: RP-RCAF在所有评估模型上始终优于传统提示策略，生成的回应与专业心理咨询的建议更为一致。
AI.conclusion: 角色扮演反思链式思维提示框架能有效提升低资源语言环境下LLM生成心理健康咨询回应的质量，使其更贴近专业心理学标准。
