title: Chart Deception in Vision-Language Models: From Vulnerability to Mitigation
summary: Information visualizations are widely used to communicate patterns, trends, and outliers, yet deceptive design choices-such as truncated or inverted axes, distorted aspect ratios, inappropriate encodings, and misleading color mappings-can systematically alter interpretation while preserving the underlying data. As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used for chart understanding and analytical reasoning, assessing their robustness to such deceptive visualizations has become critical for trustworthy data analysis. We introduce VisDeception, the first controlled paired benchmark for evaluating the robustness of VLMs to misleading chart designs. The benchmark contains 1,600 paired faithful and misleading charts spanning eight major categories of deceptive visualization tactics, where each misleading chart is paired with a faithful counterpart generated from the same underlying data. To isolate deception-induced reasoning errors from baseline chart-understanding errors, we introduce the Deception Score, a paired evaluation metric that quantifies how misleading visualizations shift model responses away from the faithful interpretation of the data. Across 32,000 responses from 10 state-of-the-art VLMs, we find that even advanced models remain highly vulnerable to deceptive visual manipulations. To improve robustness, we further propose an inference-time multi-agent mitigation framework that grounds reasoning in structured chart metadata extracted from the visualization before answer generation, enabling models to reduce the influence of deceptive visual cues without requiring explicit user instructions. Together, our findings reveal important reliability gaps in current chart-understanding systems and establish benchmark-driven evaluation, deception-aware metrics, and structured reasoning as promising directions for developing more trustworthy VLMs for visual analytics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VisDeception基准，包含1,600对忠实/欺骗性图表，评估VLM对8类欺骗性可视化策略的鲁棒性。引入Deception Score量化欺骗导致的推理偏差。测试10个先进VLM的32,000条响应后发现模型仍高度脆弱；提出多智能体推理框架通过结构化元数据提取减轻欺骗影响。
AI.motivation: 随着VLM被广泛用于图表理解与分析推理，评估其对截断坐标轴、扭曲宽高比、误导性编码等欺骗性可视化设计的鲁棒性，对保证可信数据分析至关重要。
AI.method: 构建VisDeception基准（1,600对图表，涵盖8类欺骗策略）；提出Deception Score配对评估指标；提出基于结构化元数据提取的多智能体推理缓解框架（推理时使用，无需显式用户指令）。
AI.result: 在10个SOTA VLM的32,000条响应测试中，即使先进模型仍高度受欺骗性视觉操纵影响。
AI.conclusion: 当前图表理解系统存在显著可靠性差距，基准驱动评估、欺骗感知指标和结构化推理是开发更可信VLM的有前景方向。

title: Beyond Error-vs-Discard Characteristic: Toward Stable and Reliable Evaluation for Face Image Quality Assessment
summary: Face Image Quality Assessment (FIQA) aims to estimate the utility of facial images for reliable recognition. The evaluation of FIQA methods is predominantly based on the Error-versus-Discard Characteristic (EDC), which evaluates performance by progressively discarding low-quality samples and measuring recognition error on the retained subset. In this work, we demonstrate that the widely used EDC protocol has fundamental limitations: Test-Set Divergence and Threshold Drift, which together limit the reliability and comparability of FIQA methods. To address this, we propose discard-based EDC variants and a rank-based Rank Consistency Evaluation (RCE) metric that operates on the entire test set without discarding samples, using a fixed decision threshold. Extensive experiments on five datasets, four face recognition models, and 15 state-of-the-art FIQA methods demonstrate both the limitations of EDC and the effectiveness of the proposed approaches in enabling a more reliable and comparable evaluation. Despite evaluated on face images only, the limitations arise from the EDC protocol rather than the biometric modality, suggesting a broader applicability to biometric quality assessment in general.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有面部图像质量评估（FIQA）中广泛使用的Error-versus-Discard Characteristic (EDC)评估协议存在测试集漂移和阈值漂移两个根本性缺陷，导致评估结果不可靠且难以比较。为此提出了基于丢弃策略的EDC变体以及基于排名的Rank Consistency Evaluation (RCE)指标。在5个数据集、4个识别模型和15种SOTA方法上的实验验证了EDC的局限性及所提方法的有效性。该问题源于EDC协议本身而非生物特征模态，因此结论可推广至一般生物特征质量评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的EDC评估协议存在测试集漂移（Test-Set Divergence）和阈值漂移（Threshold Drift）两个根本性局限，导致FIQA方法的评估结果不可靠且不同方法间难以公平比较。
AI.method: 提出了两种改进方案：1）基于丢弃策略的EDC变体（discard-based EDC variants）；2）基于排名的Rank Consistency Evaluation (RCE)指标，该指标在固定决策阈值下对整个测试集进行评估，无需丢弃样本。
AI.result: 在5个数据集、4种人脸识别模型和15种SOTA FIQA方法上的大量实验表明，现有EDC协议确实存在所述局限性，而所提方法能够实现更可靠和更具可比性的评估。
AI.conclusion: EDC协议的局限源于评估协议本身而非人脸模态，因此本文的发现和方法可推广至指纹、虹膜等其他生物特征的质量评估领域。

title: Language Shapes Instruction Hierarchy Compliance in Multilingual LLMs
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/g1moon/Language-Shapes-IH
summary: Instruction hierarchy (IH) requires models to prioritize instructions by source, ensuring that higher-priority instructions override lower-priority ones. Despite its importance for safe and controllable deployment, existing evaluations have focused almost exclusively on English, leaving it unclear whether IH compliance remains stable in multilingual settings. We introduce XIH-Bench, a benchmark for multilingual IH evaluation with both same-language and cross-language conflicts across six languages, four domains, and three IH settings. Across models, we find two consistent patterns. First, IH compliance exhibits a clear language-dependent asymmetry: a language that strengthens compliance in the higher-priority position can become disruptive in the lower-priority position. Second, cross-language conflicts yield higher compliance than same-language conflicts, a phenomenon we term the Language Boundary Effect. We further show that language specialization can make lower-priority instructions in model-favored languages harder to override, creating multilingual reliability and security risks.

AI.tldr: 提出了XIH-Bench基准，用于评估多语言环境下指令层级（IH）的遵从性，发现IH遵从存在语言依赖的不对称性和语言边界效应，且模型偏好的语言会带来安全风险。
AI.motivation: 现有IH评估几乎只关注英语，不清楚多语言环境下IH遵从是否稳定，需要系统评估其跨语言表现。
AI.method: 构建XIH-Bench基准，涵盖六种语言、四个领域、三种IH设置，包含同语言和跨语言冲突场景，对多个模型进行系统评测。
AI.result: 发现两个一致模式：1）IH遵从存在语言依赖的不对称性；2）跨语言冲突的遵从性高于同语言冲突（语言边界效应）。此外，模型偏好的语言中低优先级指令更难被覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 多语言环境下IH遵从并非语言无关，存在语言依赖的不对称性和语言边界效应，这对多语言模型的安全可控部署构成可靠性安全风险。

title: DeepLook: Deeper Thinking with Lookahead
summary: Inference-time scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving large language model reasoning, often delivering larger gains on difficult reasoning tasks than parameter scaling alone. However, existing approaches remain inefficient in how compute is allocated within a reasoning trace. Motivated by the observation that reasoning failures often exhibit an early onset of uncertainty before a wrong answer become explicit, we introduce DeepLook, a training-free monitor-and-intervene decoding framework that concentrates lookahead compute at uncertainty bottlenecks. DeepLook aggregates token-level confidence into segment-level signals, triggers when confidence drops relative to recent history, and explores candidate continuations with fixed-horizon lookahead. Branches are ranked by Average Lookahead Confidence (ALC), the average segment-level confidence over rollout continuations, then pruned and aggregated through voting. On four competition-style mathematics benchmarks across DeepSeek-R1-8B, Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B, DeepLook shifts the accuracy--token-cost Pareto frontier: it improves accuracy over DeepConf-low in 11 of 16 settings while reducing dataset-level token generation by 87.3% on average, including gains of +3.1 on AIME25 with Qwen3-32B and +8.8 on BRUMO25 with GPT-OSS-20B. These results show that selective, future-aware intervention yields substantially stronger accuracy--cost trade-offs than uniformly scaling complete reasoning trajectories. Code is available here.

AI.tldr: DeepLook是一种无需训练的监控-干预解码框架，通过在推理过程中的不确定性瓶颈处集中前瞻计算，显著提升了大型语言模型在数学推理任务上的准确率-成本帕累托边界，在11/16设置中提升准确率的同时平均减少87.3%的token生成量。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时间扩展方法在推理轨迹内计算分配效率低下，且推理失败往往在错误答案明确之前就表现出早期不确定性。
AI.method: DeepLook将token级置信度聚合为片段级信号，在置信度下降时触发固定水平前瞻探索，通过平均前瞻置信度(ALC)对候选分支排序，然后进行剪枝和投票聚合。
AI.result: 在四个竞赛级数学基准上、四种模型下，11/16设置提升准确率，数据集级token生成量平均减少87.3%，AIME25上+3.1（Qwen3-32B），BRUMO25上+8.8（GPT-OSS-20B）。
AI.conclusion: 选择性、面向未来的干预相比均匀扩展完整推理轨迹能获得更强的准确率-成本权衡。

title: Real-time Reconstruction of Human Visual Perception from fMRI
summary: Real-time closed-loop neurofeedback based on functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has led to important scientific and clinical advances. However, the sophistication of the analysis methods used in real-time fMRI lags behind the state-of-the-art in fMRI decoding, largely due to computational factors: Most advanced decoding pipelines do not fit within the envelope of real-time processing, where the analysis needs to be conducted in a matter of seconds and without leveraging data acquired later in the session. Here, we present a real-time compatible adaptation of a computationally intensive state-of-the-art pipeline for reconstructing perceived natural images (MindEye2), and we demonstrate that reliable fine-grained decoding is still achievable in this setting. Using RT-Cloud, an open-source, scalable cloud-based platform, we performed a real-time scan where we decoded single-trial visual perception within seconds after an image was shown to the participant. Finally, we use simulated analyses to document the factors driving changes in performance from offline to real-time analysis. This work serves as a proof-of-concept that it is feasible to deploy these powerful fMRI decoding pipelines in real-time analysis, paving the way for their use in brain-computer interfaces for scientific discovery and clinical treatment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将先进fMRI解码管道（MindEye2）适配到实时闭环神经反馈场景的方法，利用RT-Cloud平台实现了单次视觉感知的逐试次解码，并通过模拟分析揭示了从离线到实时分析的性能变化因素，证明了在实时环境中部署强大fMRI解码管道的可行性。
AI.motivation: 实时fMRI神经反馈所使用的分析方法在复杂度上落后于先进的fMRI解码方法，主要原因是计算限制——大多数高级解码管道无法在数秒内完成实时处理，且不能利用后续采集的数据。
AI.method: 1) 对计算密集型的状态-of-the-art管道MindEye2进行实时兼容适配；2) 使用开源可扩展的云平台RT-Cloud执行实时扫描，在图像呈现后数秒内解码单次试次的视觉感知；3) 通过模拟分析记录从离线到实时分析的性能变化驱动因素。
AI.result: 成功在实时环境中实现了可靠的细粒度解码，单次试次视觉感知在图像呈现后数秒内即可完成解码。
AI.conclusion: 本研究作为概念验证，证明了将强大的fMRI解码管道部署到实时分析中的可行性，为将其用于脑机接口、科学发现和临床治疗铺平了道路。

title: GEMCo: A Validated, Ethically Releasable Proxy for Inaccessible Counselling Data
summary: This paper presents GEMCo, a releasable, human-written proxy for inaccessible counselling data: 86 complete German e-mail counselling conversations (728 messages), expert-authored cases and counsellor sessions with trained role-players. It is validated against a held-out reference of 124 real counselling conversations. The proxy and the real conversations are measured against each other in counsellor strategies and client emotions. The gap is detectable but small. A generative validation supports the analysis. The validation method itself generalises to any domain where real data cannot be shared but a human-made proxy can. Privacy and ethics keep real counselling data closed. GEMCo carries none by design and can be released -- a first step toward language research in this domain.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了GEMCo——一个可公开发布、由人类撰写的心理咨询代理数据集（86段完整德语邮件咨询对话，728条消息），经专家和培训演员创作，并与124段真实咨询对话验证，发现代理数据与真实数据在咨询策略和客户情绪上差距虽可检测但很小，验证方法可推广至其他无法共享真实数据的领域。
AI.motivation: 真实心理咨询数据因隐私和伦理问题无法公开共享，阻碍了该领域的语言研究。作者旨在创建一个无隐私风险的代理数据集，作为可发布的替代品。
AI.method: 构建GEMCo数据集（86段完整德语邮件咨询对话，共728条消息），由专家撰写案例和咨询师与受训角色扮演者之间的会话组成。通过与124段真实咨询对话进行对比验证，从咨询策略和客户情绪两个维度测量差距，并辅以生成式验证。
AI.result: 代理数据与真实数据之间的差距可检测但很小，生成式验证支持了该分析结果。
AI.conclusion: GEMCo可作为心理咨询领域语言研究的可发布数据资源，其验证方法可推广至任何真实数据无法共享但可构建人类代理数据的领域。

title: Group Preference Collapse in Personalized Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Personalized multimodal large language models (MLLMs) aim to generate user-specific responses, but existing methods mainly rely on profile-level information and overlook diverse user preferences. We identify group preference collapse, where multi-user personalized MLLMs become insensitive to individual preferences and drift toward dominant population-level choices due to suppressed preference signals and unreliable preference use during generation. We propose PrefMoE, a preference-centric framework that separates stable profile information from preference-related representations. PrefMoE decomposes preferences into shared prototypes and personalized residuals, preserves individualized residuals with imbalance-aware learning, counterfactual pseudo-user augmentation, and residual decorrelation, and routes profile and preference factors through separate LoRA adaptation paths. Experiments across multiple MLLM backbones show that PrefMoE improves preference-sensitive personalization while substantially reducing preference collapse. Project page: https://prefmoe.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 针对多用户个性化多模态大语言模型中存在的群体偏好坍缩问题（模型对个体偏好不敏感，趋向于生成群体级一致响应），提出PrefMoE框架，通过将稳定画像信息与偏好表征分离、将偏好分解为共享原型和个性化残差、结合不平衡学习、反事实伪用户增强和残差解相关等技术保留个性化残差，并采用独立LoRA路径分别路由画像和偏好因子。实验表明PrefMoE显著提升偏好敏感个性化能力并减少偏好坍缩。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化MLLM主要依赖画像层信息，忽视了多样化的用户偏好；多用户场景下由于偏好信号被抑制以及生成时不可靠的偏好利用，模型出现群体偏好坍缩，即对个体偏好不敏感而趋向于群体主导选择。
AI.method: 提出PrefMoE框架：1) 将稳定画像信息与偏好表征分离；2) 将偏好分解为共享原型和个性化残差；3) 通过不平衡感知学习、反事实伪用户增强和残差解相关保留个性化残差；4) 通过独立LoRA适配路径分别路由画像因子和偏好因子。
AI.result: 在多种MLLM骨干上的实验表明，PrefMoE在提升偏好敏感个性化能力的同时，显著减少了偏好坍缩。
AI.conclusion: PrefMoE通过偏好中心化的设计有效解决了多用户个性化MLLM中的群体偏好坍缩问题，实现了更精准的个体偏好建模。

title: Cheap Probes Predict Expensive Training in 3D-CT Vision--Language Models
summary: Picking the frozen image encoder for a 3D~CT vision--language model (VLM), together with the token-compression scheme on top of it, is a search over many candidates. There are several encoders, several ways to compress their tokens, and several token budgets, and the combinations grow fast. Comparing them the usual way means fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on each combination, and running the whole sweep this way needs far more compute than most groups can spend. We ask whether a cheap probe on the encoder's cached embeddings can stand in for that comparison. We build an image-grounded probing benchmark over (encoder $\times$ compression) cells, with clinical attribute families and two validation gates, scale-sanity and probe-separability, that keep each attribute well-scaled and decodable. These gates are the main methodological contribution. On this benchmark we compare a range of read-out heads, and in a preliminary study we pair each probe with its matched downstream task. The early signal is encouraging: the cheap probe orders the candidates in close agreement with expensive fine-tuning, at about $r\approx0.95$ on the cells measured so far. We read this as an ordinal claim, a ranking predictor rather than an exact estimate, and we are explicit about where it stays preliminary. If it holds up, encoder and compression choices can be screened in minutes with frozen-token probes, with full training spent only on the finalists.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种廉价探测方法，通过分析3D CT视觉-语言模型中冻结图像编码器的缓存嵌入，来预测不同编码器与令牌压缩组合在下游任务中的表现排序，初步实验显示排序与昂贵微调结果高度一致（r≈0.95），有望大幅降低模型选择的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 传统方法需要为每种编码器与令牌压缩组合都进行完整的LLM微调，计算成本极高，资源有限的团队难以承受。作者希望找到一种廉价的探测方法，能够替代昂贵的全量训练，快速筛选出最优的编码器和压缩方案组合。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于图像嵌入的探测基准（encoder × compression细胞），包含两个验证门控：scale-sanity（确保属性良好缩放）和probe-separability（确保属性可解码）。在基准上比较多种读出探头，并将探头结果与匹配的下游任务进行配对验证。
AI.result: 廉价探测对候选组合的排序与昂贵微调结果高度一致，在已测量的细胞上Spearman相关系数约为r≈0.95。
AI.conclusion: 如果后续研究验证成立，编码器和压缩方案的选择可以在几分钟内通过冻结令牌探头完成筛选，只有最终入围的少数方案需要全量训练，可大幅降低计算资源需求。

title: EmoTrace: An Emotion Trajectory-Centered Framework for Psychological Support Dialogue Generation
summary: Using large language models (LLMs) to assist psychological counseling is an important task in the field of natural language processing. The construction of high-quality psychological support dialogue corpora serves as a critical foundation for training counseling-oriented conversational models. However, existing data generation approaches generally suffer from several limitations, including emotionally stable seekers, limited variation in emotional dynamics, and a high degree of compliance with counselors' guidance. These issues result in LLM that lack the capability to effectively respond to emotionally unstable scenarios. In addition, counselor responses are typically driven by problem-solving objectives, thereby overlooking the role of emotion-focused interaction, which are essential in psychological counseling. To address these gaps, we propose EmoTrace, a multi-turn dialogue corpus generation framework centered on modeling seekers' emotional trajectories. we construct seekers' cognitive profile and introduce a seeker module with emotional schemas and an associated activation mechanism, a counselor module, and an emotional trajectory control module, thereby enhancing the layering of the seeker's emotional expression and the counselor's targeted empathic expression. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing approaches in terms of emotional richness and empathy quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EmoTrace框架，通过建模来访者情绪轨迹生成多轮心理咨询对话语料，解决了现有数据生成方法中来访者情绪稳定、情绪动态变化有限及过度遵从咨询师引导等问题，并增强了咨询师的情绪导向互动能力。
AI.motivation: 现有心理咨询对话数据生成方法存在来访者情绪过于稳定、情绪动态变化有限、过度遵从咨询师引导等局限，且咨询师回复过于注重问题解决而忽视情绪导向互动，导致LLM无法有效应对情绪不稳定场景。
AI.method: 提出EmoTrace框架，构建来访者认知画像，引入包含情绪图式及激活机制的来访者模块、咨询师模块以及情绪轨迹控制模块，增强来访者情绪表达的层次性和咨询师针对性共情表达。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在情绪丰富度和共情质量方面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: EmoTrace通过建模情绪轨迹有效提升了心理咨询对话语料的情绪真实性和共情质量，为训练咨询导向的对话模型提供了更优质的数据基础。

title: Evaluating LLMs as Interpretable Controllers for Dynamical Systems
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for decision-making and reasoning tasks, yet their potential as controllers for physical systems remains largely unexplored. This work investigates whether LLMs can function as interpretable controllers for a dynamic thermal environment, examining their ability to follow setpoints, interpret natural-language commands, reason about actuator effects, and incorporate prior model-based knowledge. Five LLMs of varying scales are evaluated under multiple scenarios, including settings with penalties on heater or fan usage and cases where the models have access to a physics-based prediction tool. The results show that control performance depends on model complexity: while low- and mid-scale models frequently misinterpret actuator dynamics or generate inconsistent reasoning, high-complexity models such as Qwen-3~14B and GPT-4o achieve accurate temperature tracking, stable actuator usage, and coherent explanations aligned with physical principles. Incorporating a physics-based model significantly improves control smoothness and energy efficiency by enabling anticipatory decision-making. A detailed reasoning taxonomy further reveals a clear progression from causal misinterpretation in smaller models to cohesive and temporally aware reasoning in larger ones. The findings demonstrate that LLMs can act as interpretable controllers when sufficiently capable and appropriately grounded in domain knowledge, highlighting promising opportunities for hybrid model-based and language-driven control strategies that can provide plausible explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文探究了大语言模型（LLMs）作为动态热环境可解释控制器的能力，发现高复杂度模型（如Qwen-3~14B和GPT-4o）能够实现精确的温度跟踪和稳定的执行器控制，而引入基于物理的模型可显著提升控制平滑性和能效，且大模型展现出从因果误读到时间感知推理的渐进式推理能力提升。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs在决策和推理任务中广泛应用，但它们作为物理系统控制器的潜力尚未被充分探索。本文旨在验证LLMs能否作为可解释控制器，并评估其在不同复杂度水平下的控制性能与推理能力。
AI.method: 选取五种不同规模的大语言模型，在动态热环境中进行多场景评估，包括设定点跟踪、自然语言命令解释、执行器效应推理和基于模型的先验知识融入。设置了有无加热器/风扇惩罚、是否接入物理预测工具等条件，并通过详细的推理分类法分析模型的推理模式。
AI.result: 低、中复杂度模型常误判执行器动力学或产生不一致推理；高复杂度模型（Qwen-3~14B, GPT-4o）实现精确温度跟踪、稳定执行器使用和物理原理一致的合理解释。引入物理模型显著提升控制平滑性和能效。推理分类显示从因果误读到时间感知推理的清晰进步。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在具备足够能力并适当融入领域知识时，可以作为可解释控制器。这为混合基于模型和语言驱动的控制策略提供了有前景的方向，能够提供合理的物理解释。

title: An empirical investigation into the properties of standard word embeddings
comment: African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS) - South Africa, University of the Western Cape
summary:
The embedding of word sequences into continuous vector spaces has been one of the most important developments in Natural Language Processing in the recent past. Such embeddings have found application in areas such as Automatic Speech Recognition, Machine Translation, Sentiment Analysis and many more. This essay reviews the various mechanisms that have been proposed for the calculation of word embeddings, investigates popular toolkits and embedding matrices that are available in the public domain, and experiments with one or more selected implementations to better understand their characteristics.
  La représentation vectorielle continue de mots a été l'un des développements les plus importants dans le domaine du traitement automatique du langage naturel au cours des dernières années. Ces représentations ont trouvé application dans des domaines tels que la reconnaissance vocale, la traduction automatique, l'analyse des sentiments, etc. Ce travail passe en revue les différents mécanismes proposés pour le calcul de ces vecteurs de mots, étudie les kits d'outils populaires et les matrices disponibles publiquement en ligne, et expérimente avec une ou plusieurs implémentations sélectionnées pour mieux comprendre leurs caractéristiques.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了词嵌入（word embeddings）的各种计算机制，调研了公开可用的流行工具包和嵌入矩阵，并通过实验选定的实现来更好地理解其特性。
AI.motivation: 词序列的连续向量嵌入是自然语言处理中最重要的进展之一，广泛应用于语音识别、机器翻译、情感分析等领域，因此需要系统性地回顾和比较不同的词嵌入计算方法。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，回顾了词嵌入的多种计算机制，调研了公开可用的流行工具包和嵌入矩阵，并对一个或多个选定的实现进行实验以理解其特性。
AI.result: 文章系统梳理了词嵌入的不同计算方法，汇总了流行的工具包和嵌入矩阵资源，并通过实验揭示了所选实现的特征。
AI.conclusion: 词嵌入是NLP领域的重要发展，各种计算机制和工具包各有特点，通过综述和实验可以更好地理解其应用特性。

title: Tokengeist: Multi-Turn Attribution Tracing in Agentic Conversations
summary: When a language model produces a response in a multi-turn conversation, which tokens from prior turns shaped that answer, and how did those dependencies propagate across prior turns? Existing context attribution methods process the full context in a single pass, recovering surface-level dependencies but missing the layered, non-linear structure of real-world dialogues and multi-step reasoning tasks. We introduce multi-turn context attribution (MTCA): given a target span in a model response, the task of tracing attribution backward across turns to identify not only which prior turns were directly relevant, but also how those turns themselves depended on earlier context. We propose Tokengeist, an attribution-method-agnostic and scalable framework that recovers full dependency paths by casting attribution as a recursive traversal of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) over conversation turns. We will release MTCABench, a benchmark of 3,845 target spans across 665 multi-turn conversations, annotated with gold provenance graphs reaching depths of up to 14, across four dependency types. Across four open-weight models, flat attribution methods fail to recover multi-hop dependencies, achieving under 20% source recall, while Tokengeist reaches 90%. Our results reveal systematic failure modes of single-pass attribution -- which we term provenance collapse -- and motivate attribution methods that reason recursively across turns.

AI.tldr: 提出多轮对话上下文归因任务(MTCA)及框架Tokengeist，通过递归遍历有向无环图恢复跨轮次的依赖路径；构建MTCABench基准测试，发现单次归因方法存在"归因塌陷"问题，源召回率低于20%，而Tokengeist达到90%。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文归因方法仅进行单次全上下文处理，只能恢复表层依赖关系，无法捕捉多轮对话中真正的层级化、非线性依赖结构，尤其在多步推理任务中失效。
AI.method: 提出Tokengeist框架，将归因问题转化为对话轮次上有向无环图的递归遍历，实现归因方法无关的、可扩展的跨轮次依赖路径恢复。同时构建MTCABench基准（665个多轮对话，3845个目标片段，标注有深度达14的黄金来源图，涵盖4种依赖类型）。
AI.result: 在4个开源模型上，平面归因方法的源召回率低于20%，而Tokengeist达到90%。
AI.conclusion: 单次归因方法存在系统性失败模式（归因塌陷），需要采用递归跨轮次推理的归因方法来准确追踪多跳依赖关系。

title: ID-V2V: Identity-Preserving Video Restylization
summary: In visual storytelling, human performances are central to creative intent and narrative meaning. However, preserving human identity and performance while enabling flexible visual edits remains challenging for generative video models. We formalize this challenge as identity-preserving video restylization, which propagates scene, lighting, and style changes specified by an edited keyframe across a source video, while preserving facial likeness and performance, including expressions, eye gaze, and lip synchronization. A key obstacle is the absence of paired training data, as identity-preserving restylized video pairs are rare in real-world settings. To address this, we propose a decoupling of source-grounded identity preservation and edit-driven video synthesis. Our key insight is that facial appearance and expression should remain invariant, with illumination being the primary permissible variation. We therefore cast identity preservation as a video relighting problem, while modeling visual edit propagation as controlled video synthesis guided by the edited keyframe. Building on this formulation, we introduce ID-V2V, a video-to-video generative framework integrating complementary control signals: relit facial regions and facial normal maps tightly constrain facial likeness and performance, while edited keyframes and depth sequences enable flexible and temporally coherent generation. This design enables constructing training pairs from a single video, eliminating the need for scarce paired data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ID-V2V significantly outperforms existing methods in preserving facial likeness and fine-grained facial performance, supports both single- and multi-subject scenarios, and delivers high visual quality, highlighting its potential as a human-centric tool for real-world content production. The code is available at: https://github.com/Eyeline-Labs/ID-V2V.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ID-V2V框架，通过将身份保持解耦为视频重光照问题、将编辑传播建模为受控视频合成问题，无需配对数据即可实现身份保持的视频重风格化，在保持面部特征和表演细节的同时灵活编辑场景、光照和风格。
AI.motivation: 在视觉叙事中，人类表演是创意意图和叙事意义的核心，但现有生成式视频模型难以在灵活编辑的同时保持人类身份和表演（包括表情、视线、唇语同步）。主要障碍是缺乏身份保持的重风格化视频配对训练数据。
AI.method: 提出ID-V2V框架，核心思路是将源视频的身份保持与编辑驱动的视频合成解耦。身份保持被建模为视频重光照问题（面部外观和表情不变，光照是唯一允许变化），编辑传播被建模为受编辑关键帧引导的受控视频合成。框架整合互补控制信号：重光照面部区域和面部法线图约束面部特征和表演，编辑关键帧和深度序列实现灵活且时序一致的生成。通过从单一视频构建训练对，无需配对数据。
AI.result: 实验表明ID-V2V在保持面部特征和细粒度面部表演方面显著优于现有方法，支持单主体和多主体场景，并具有高视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: ID-V2V通过解耦身份保持与编辑传播的创新思路，解决了身份保持视频重风格化中配对数据匮乏的关键问题，为面向真实世界内容生产的人本工具提供了有效方案。

title: Formally Verified Synthesizable Floating-Point Data Types in ARCH HDL
summary: We report the design and end-to-end verification of first-class IEEE-754 binary32 (FP32) and bfloat16 (BF16) arithmetic for ARCH, a hardware description language intended to be generated by language models. Every operator - comparisons, conversions, add, sub, mul, and fused multiply-add (FMA) - is described once against a single bit-vector IR and rendered three ways from one source: synthesizable SystemVerilog, an SMT-LIB model, and a Lean 4 proof model. The three artifacts cannot drift apart structurally, and the residual per-node printer correspondence is machine-checked: a Yosys-to-SMT miter proves the emitted SystemVerilog equivalent to the SMT model for all 24 operators. Verification splits at the solver-tractability frontier: multiplier-free operators (comparisons, add/sub over all 2^64 inputs, conversions, and all binary BF16 arithmetic) are proved exhaustively equivalent to the SMT-LIB FloatingPoint theory; the SAT-hard multiplier-bearing operators (FP32 mul and FMA) are proved correctly rounded in Lean, sorry-free, against a value-level round-to-nearest-even specification over exact dyadic values. Physical characterization exposed the FMA as the timing outlier: its exact-wide 470-bit datapath does not pipeline in our flow. We reimplemented it as a bounded 98-bit guard/round/sticky datapath that pipelines to 268 MHz on Nangate45, and proved, in Lean and over all 2^96 inputs, that it is bit-identical to the exact-wide reference, so it inherits the reference's proven correct rounding. The equivalence is tractable precisely because the shared multiplier appears on both sides and cancels: neither a SAT solver nor the proof ever solves a multiplier equivalence. (The BF16 FMA is deliberately an FP32-accumulating fusion, characterized as exactly that.) All machine-checked claims are pinned to a tagged open-source release.

AI.tldr: 本文在硬件描述语言ARCH中首次实现了IEEE-754 FP32和BF16算术运算的端到端验证，通过单一源码生成SystemVerilog、SMT-LIB和Lean 4三种产物，并利用Yosys-to-SMT严格检查等价性。无乘法器运算（包括所有2^64输入的加减法）被穷举验证，而乘法器密集的FP32乘法和FMA在Lean中证明正确舍入。FMA通过98位守卫/舍入/粘滞数据通路实现，在Lean中证明与精确宽参考逐位一致，且验证因乘法器抵消而变得可行。
AI.motivation: 现有硬件描述语言（HDL）中浮点运算的验证要么不完备（如仅测试），要么验证与实现分离导致可信度不足。ARCH的设计目标是让语言模型能直接生成可信的硬件，因此需要一种从单一描述源自动生成实现、形式化模型和证明的方法，并确保三者结构上永不漂移。
AI.method: 论文提出三位一体架构：1) 单一bit-vector IR描述所有24种运算；2) 从同一源码自动生成可综合SystemVerilog、SMT-LIB模型和Lean 4证明模型；3) 通过Yosys-to-SMT miter检查SystemVerilog与SMT模型的等价性；4) 在可满足性理论求解器处理边界处拆分：无乘法器运算用SMT穷举，乘法器运算在Lean中证明正确舍入；5) 针对FMA时序问题，将精确470位数据通路重设计为98位守卫/舍入/粘滞流水线，并在Lean中证明两者逐位等价。
AI.result: 无乘法器运算（比较、转换、所有BF16算术及所有2^64输入下的加减法）被穷举验证等价于SMT-LIB浮点理论。FP32乘法和FMA在Lean中无公理（sorry-free）证明正确舍入。FMA的98位流水线实现可在Nangate45工艺下达到268 MHz。所有2^96输入下的等价性证明因乘法器在等式两侧抵消而变得可解。所有机器检查的声明均对应一个标记的开源版本。
AI.conclusion: 论文展示了在硬件描述语言中实现完全验证的浮点算术是可行的，关键思路是在验证策略边界（SAT可解与不可解）处拆分，并通过等价性证明将难以验证的精确实现约简到可验证的优化实现。这种方法为AI生成的可靠硬件设计开辟了道路。

title: Decentralized Granular Access Control for Agentic AI Systems in Critical Infrastructure
summary: The deployment of autonomous AI agents in production infrastructure introduces fundamental security challenges that traditional role-based access control (RBAC) models cannot address. Unlike deterministic automation, AI agents exhibit stochastic behavior, making conventional trust models insufficient for governing their access to critical systems. This paper presents a decentralized, multi-layered access control architecture designed specifically for agentic AI systems operating in critical cloud infrastructure. Our framework introduces four key innovations: (1) a compound identity model that binds agent actions to delegated human authority, (2) a hierarchical permission system spanning five granularity levels from global platform access to per-parameter constraints, (3) a decentralized policy ownership model where tool teams independently govern their authorization boundaries, and (4) progressive trust escalation with safety interlocks that prevent autonomous agents from executing high-risk operations. We ground our design in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025) threat taxonomy and demonstrate how each architectural decision mitigates specific attack vectors. Deployed in production at a major cloud provider managing network infrastructure across hundreds of datacenters, the system enforces granular access control for 20+ specialized AI agents and 60+ deterministic playbooks processing thousands of operations daily while maintaining zero unauthorized write operations over eight months of production deployment. We present empirical data on access pattern distributions, denial rates, and the effectiveness of layered authorization in preventing privilege escalation by non-deterministic actors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向自主AI代理的分布式多层访问控制架构，通过复合身份模型、五级层次化权限系统、分布式策略所有权模型和渐进式信任升级机制，解决了传统RBAC无法应对的随机行为安全挑战。在大型云厂商生产环境部署8个月，管理20+AI代理和60+确定性剧本，实现了零未授权写操作。
AI.motivation: 传统基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）模型无法应对AI代理的随机行为特性，确定性自动化与AI代理的随机性之间存在根本性差异，现有信任模型不足以约束AI代理对关键系统的访问。
AI.method: 提出四项关键创新：(1) 复合身份模型，将代理行为绑定到委托的人类权限；(2) 五级层次化权限系统（从全局平台访问到参数级约束）；(3) 分布式策略所有权模型，由工具团队独立治理授权边界；(4) 渐进式信任升级与安全互锁机制，阻止高风险操作。设计基于OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025)威胁分类。
AI.result: 在大型云厂商生产环境部署，覆盖数百个数据中心网络基础设施，管理20+专业AI代理和60+确定性剧本，每天处理数千次操作。8个月生产部署期间实现零未授权写操作，并提供了访问模式分布、拒绝率和分层授权防止特权升级的实证数据。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的分布式多层访问控制架构能够有效保障AI代理在关键云基础设施中的安全运行，通过层次化权限和渐进式信任机制成功防止非确定性行为导致的特权升级。

title: Gaze-Anchored Social Net: Decoding Implicit Relations via Joint Modeling
comment: Accepted by ICPR(The International Conference on Pattern Recognition), Eye Tracking Techniques, Applications and Challenges (ETTAC 2026)
summary: Human gaze does more than point to visual targets; it serves as a subtle indicator of social intent within static images, whereas standard models typically process individuals independently, treating gaze as an i.i.d. quantity or predicting social semantics in isolation. Recent multi-person methods attempt to address this but often treat social relations as rigid, post-hoc classifications decoupled from the gaze estimation process. This oversimplification fails to capture the nuanced nature of social intent, which acts as an underlying driver of gaze behavior rather than a secondary categorical output. We address these limitations by proposing ANCHOR, a target-centric paradigm designed to decode gaze-anchored social intent by modeling the joint distribution of visual attention and latent implicit relations. Our approach surfaces these dependencies as the latent structural scaffolding of gaze behavior. The architecture utilizes a relational attention mechanism to capture fine-grained interpersonal links, leveraging feature-wise modulation for efficient multi-person parsing from a single vision backbone. To stabilize the training of this coupled formulation, we implement an optimization synergy to resolve the inherent conflicts between spatial gaze accuracy and latent social reasoning. This approach ensures robust generalization by seeking stable, flat minima while simultaneously harmonizing competing task gradients. We validate our framework on an extended benchmark featuring dense multi-person annotations and novel social influence rankings. Our results demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and provide the first quantitative evidence that implicit social hierarchies can be robustly disentangled and learned directly from static gaze patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ANCHOR，一种目标中心范式，通过联合建模视觉注意与潜在隐式关系来解码基于注视锚定的社交意图，采用关系注意力机制和特征调制实现多人解析，并通过优化协同解决空间注视精度与潜在社交推理的冲突，在密集多人标注基准上取得SOTA性能，首次定量证明可从静态注视模式中稳健解耦并学习隐式社会层级。
AI.motivation: 现有模型通常独立处理个体，将注视视为独立同分布量或孤立预测社交语义；近期多人方法虽有所改进，但往往将社交关系视为后验刚性分类，与注视估计过程解耦，无法捕捉作为注视行为底层驱动力的社交意图的细微本质。
AI.method: 提出ANCHOR框架：1) 目标中心范式联合建模视觉注意与潜在隐式关系的联合分布；2) 关系注意力机制捕捉细粒度人际链接，利用特征调制从单一视觉骨干实现高效多人解析；3) 优化协同策略解决空间注视精度与潜在社交推理之间的固有冲突，通过寻求稳定平坦极小值并协调竞争任务梯度来确保稳健泛化。
AI.result: 在密集多人标注扩展基准上取得SOTA性能，首次提供定量证据表明隐式社会层级可从静态注视模式中稳健解耦并学习。
AI.conclusion: ANCHOR通过将隐式社交关系作为注视行为的底层结构支撑进行联合建模，有效弥补了现有方法将社交语义与注视估计割裂的不足，证明了从静态图像中学习隐式社会结构的可行性。

title: Zing: Social Mind for LLMs
summary: As large language models move from isolated task solving toward long-term service in human environments, they require social intelligence: the ability to infer mental states, track social relations, reason over norms, and adapt behavior under context. This report presents Zhijing, an integrated framework for measuring, internalizing, and grounding social intelligence. For measurement, we introduce SoMBench, a psychology-grounded benchmark spanning 3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, and 71 task paradigms. It controls question format, narrative perspective, and context length across 284 shared scenarios and 3,481 expert-verified instances. Evaluation of 20 representative LLMs reveals substantial headroom: the best model achieves only 72.08% overall accuracy, and none of the 17 secondary dimensions reaches the 90% near-ceiling band. For internalization, we develop Zing, a diagnosis-driven training recipe combining supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation, and rubric-based reinforcement learning. Across five social-cognition benchmarks, Zing consistently outperforms its base models, with Zing-27B-Stage2 achieving the best average score and Zing-32B-Stage2 remaining competitive with DeepSeek-V4-Pro. For deployment-time grounding, we build Actio, a harness-controlled inference architecture that routes four typed supports into reasoning: PRISM for procedural guidance, Starling for runtime mental-state representation, SAGE for reusable experience, and gated RAG for external social and normative knowledge. Across five base models and three benchmarks, the full harness improves 14 of 15 model-benchmark pairs and is best or tied for best in 8, demonstrating the effectiveness of typed runtime support. Together, these results show that socially intelligent LLMs require coordinated advances in evaluation, parametric internalization, and deployment-time grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Zhijing框架，系统性地解决大语言模型的社会智能问题，包含三个核心组件：SoMBench（心理学驱动的社会智能评测基准）、Zing（基于诊断的训练方案）和Actio（部署时推理增强架构）。实验表明当前最强模型准确率仅72.08%，而所提方法在多维度上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型从孤立任务求解转向长期服务人类环境时，需要具备社会智能（推断心理状态、追踪社会关系、进行规范推理和情境适应行为），但现有模型在这方面的能力严重不足，缺乏系统化的评测、训练和部署方案。
AI.method: 提出三组件框架：1) SoMBench：心理学驱动的评测基准，覆盖3个主维度、17个子维度和71个任务范式，包含284个共享场景和3,481个专家验证实例；2) Zing：诊断驱动的训练方案，结合监督微调、在策略蒸馏和基于rubric的强化学习；3) Actio：部署时推理架构，集成PRISM（过程指导）、Starling（运行时心理状态表征）、SAGE（可复用经验）和门控RAG（外部社会与规范知识）四种类型支持。
AI.result: 20个代表性LLM评测显示最佳模型仅72.08%准确率，17个子维度均未达90%。Zing-27B-Stage2取得最佳平均分，Zing-32B-Stage2与DeepSeek-V4-Pro竞争。Actio在5个基座模型和3个基准上改善14/15个模型-基准对，在8项中达到最佳或并列最佳。
AI.conclusion: 社会智能LLM需要在评测、参数化内化和部署时接地三个方向协同推进；当前模型在这方面存在显著提升空间，所提框架为未来发展提供了系统化的路径。

title: DynaResize: Runtime GPU Reallocation for Disaggregated LLM Post-Training
summary: RL-based LLM post-training increasingly disaggregates Rollout and Training across separate GPU resources, but static GPU partitioning suffers from severe pipeline bubbles under long-tail rollout latency. We present DynaResize, a runtime GPU reallocation system that dynamically switches GPUs between Rollout and Training to balance stage execution times without changing RL semantics. DynaResize decomposes resizing into fine-grained operations and removes non-startup-critical work from the critical path through communicator reuse, bounded state staging, and hysteresis-based resizing. Experimental results show that DynaResize can improve end-to-end throughput by 66.5% and reduce total execution time by 33% over the optimal static configuration, while hiding 27% of role-switching overhead.

AI.tldr: DynaResize是一个运行时GPU重新分配系统，通过动态切换Rollout和Training阶段的GPU资源来消除流水线气泡，在不改变RL语义的情况下提升端到端吞吐量66.5%，减少执行时间33%。
AI.motivation: 基于强化学习的LLM后训练中，Rollout和Training通常被分配到独立的GPU资源上运行，但静态GPU分区策略在面对长尾延迟的Rollout时会导致严重的流水线气泡，造成资源浪费和效率低下。
AI.method: DynaResize将GPU重分配分解为细粒度操作，通过通信器复用（communicator reuse）、有界状态暂存（bounded state staging）和基于滞后的重分配（hysteresis-based resizing）将非启动关键型工作移出关键路径，从而在运行时动态调整GPU在Rollout和Training之间的分配比例。
AI.result: 相比最优静态配置，DynaResize将端到端吞吐量提升66.5%，总执行时间减少33%，并隐藏了27%的角色切换开销。
AI.conclusion: 动态GPU重分配是解决RL后训练中Rollout长尾延迟问题的有效方案，DynaResize在保持RL语义不变的前提下显著提升了系统效率。

title: Robustifying pathology foundation models via fine-tuning
summary: Pathology foundation models (FMs) produce powerful tile-level representations which remain sensitive to scanner and staining variability, undermining deployment across laboratories. We develop a novel fine-tuning recipe that improves the robustness of pathology FMs to acquisition factors. Applied to ten different FMs, our fine-tuning strategy consistently improves robustness for every model as well as downstream performance, with no observed trade-off. On average, it raises the PathoROB robustness index by 23% (from 0.72 to 0.87) and increases the overall cross-benchmark performance by 43% on Patho-Bench, HEST and THUNDER combined, with individual gains reaching up to 72% in robustness (Phikon-v2) and 76% in performance (Midnight-12k). We publicly release the fine-tuned versions of Phikon-v2 (Phaet) and Midnight-12k (Mascaret) at https://huggingface.co/wearewaiv/models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的微调方法，能显著提升病理基础模型对扫描仪和染色变异（即获取因素）的鲁棒性。在10种不同基础模型上验证，该方法平均提升鲁棒性指数23%（从0.72到0.87），跨基准性能提升43%，未观察到性能权衡。公开了微调后的Phikon-v2（Phaet）和Midnight-12k（Mascaret）模型。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型生成的瓦片级表示对扫描仪和染色变异性敏感，这限制了模型在不同实验室间的部署能力，需要提升模型对获取因素的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的微调方案（fine-tuning recipe），专门设计用于改善病理基础模型对获取因素（扫描仪、染色等）的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在10种不同基础模型上应用该策略后，每个模型的鲁棒性和下游性能均一致提升。PathoROB鲁棒性指数平均提升23%（0.72→0.87），跨基准（Patho-Bench、HEST、THUNDER）总体性能提升43%。其中Phikon-v2鲁棒性增益高达72%，Midnight-12k性能增益达76%。
AI.conclusion: 该微调策略能有效且无权衡地提升病理基础模型对获取因素的鲁棒性及下游任务性能，最佳实践是推广到更多病理基础模型中。

title: How Context Attribution Handles What the Model Already Knows
summary: Context attribution methods for large language models (LLMs) identify which input context contributes to the model response. Recent works show the initial success in attributing the con- tributive score of the contexts. However, we observe that when the context overlaps with the training data, these methods can- not disentangle in-context from in-weight (IW) contributions, producing unreliable scores. Based on this observation, in this work, we introduce: 1) an evaluation protocol that relies on four new metrics (base-model context attribution score (BCS), cross-model context attribution consistency (CAC), attribution preservation score (APS), source separation pre- cision (SSP)) and 2) a benchmark dataset (WMDP-Cyber++) with ground-truth provenance labels to systematically assess attribution under IW overlap. In our experiments across four well-known context attribution methods, we demonstrate that they provide unfaithful attribution when the knowledge from the context also exists in the weights. Finally, we adapt these methods for source separation (IW vs. in-context learning (ICL)) and show that they cannot do the disentanglement based on the contributive score

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有上下文归因方法在训练数据与上下文重叠时无法区分上下文贡献和参数贡献，提出了包含4个新指标（BCS、CAC、APS、SSP）的评估协议和基准数据集WMDP-Cyber++，实验证明现有方法归因不可靠，且无法实现源分离。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文归因方法在上下文与训练数据（权重）存在知识重叠时，无法区分上下文贡献（in-context）和参数贡献（in-weight），产生不可靠的归因分数。
AI.method: 1) 提出包含四个新指标（BCS、CAC、APS、SSP）的评估协议；2) 构建带真实来源标签的基准数据集WMDP-Cyber++；3) 在四种主流上下文归因方法上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 现有上下文归因方法在上下文知识与权重知识重叠时提供不可靠的归因；这些方法无法基于贡献分数实现上下文贡献与参数贡献的源分离。
AI.conclusion: 现有上下文归因方法无法有效处理上下文-参数知识重叠问题，需要新的方法来实现可靠的归因和源分离。

title: Opti-Q: A Constraint-Based Optimization Framework for Multi-LLM Question Planning
summary: While large language models (LLMs) enable strong question answering (QA), budgeted deployment is complicated by nondeterminism and heterogeneous resource profiles (cost, latency, and energy). We present OPTI-Q, a database-inspired, cost-based optimizer that implements a plan-before-execute paradigm for multi-LLM orchestration. OPTI-Q models LLM invocations as physical operators in an execution DAG and, for each question, searches for plans that optimize answer quality (QoA) while trading off financial cost, latency, and energy under user-specified resource constraints. Plans can include sequential operators that pass intermediate answers as context and parallel/blend operators that run models concurrently and merge their outputs. To search this space without executing each candidate plan, OPTI-Q uses PERFDB, a statistics catalog populated and refreshed from benchmarks and execution traces, to estimate the QoA and resource costs of both individual operators and composed subplans. Using these estimates, OPTI-Q performs Pareto-frontier search and selects a final plan based on user preferences. On MMLU-Pro and SimpleQA under user-specified budgets, OPTI-Q improves average QoA by ~58% and ~41% over baselines at comparable cost, demonstrating that database-style planning yields better quality-resource trade-offs for multi-LLM QA.

AI.tldr: OPTI-Q是一个受数据库启发的成本优化器，通过"先规划后执行"的范式编排多个LLM，利用统计目录PERFDB估计质量与资源成本，在用户预算约束下搜索帕累托最优执行计划，相比基线在MMLU-Pro和SimpleQA上分别提升约58%和41%的答案质量。
AI.motivation: LLM在预算受限部署中存在非确定性和异构资源特征（成本、延迟、能耗），缺乏有效的多模型编排优化方案。
AI.method: 将LLM调用建模为执行DAG中的物理算子，构建统计目录PERFDB（来自基准测试和执行轨迹）估计QoA与资源成本，基于用户偏好进行帕累托前沿搜索选择最优计划。计划支持顺序（传递中间上下文）、并行/混合（并发运行并合并输出）等算子类型。
AI.result: 在MMLU-Pro和SimpleQA上，OPTI-Q在用户指定预算下分别比基线提升约58%和41%的平均QoA，且成本相当。
AI.conclusion: 数据库风格的查询规划范式能够为多LLM问答系统实现更好的质量-资源权衡。

title: Spatial-IQ: Deconstructing Spatial Intelligence via Hierarchical Capability Tests
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at visual interpretation but fail on spatial reasoning tasks that humans solve reliably. Existing benchmarks evaluate these models as black boxes, limiting their ability to identify the underlying causes of lower performance: when a model fails a spatial reasoning task, it remains difficult to ascertain whether the hurdle is perceptual, such as recognizing object boundaries, or cognitive, such as reasoning about occlusion to infer hidden geometry. We introduce Spatial-IQ, a hierarchical diagnostic framework that decomposes object counting in stacked 3D structures into 9 perceptual and cognitive sub-tasks organized by the developmental stages of human spatial cognition, with mental rotation as an additional target probe. Using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, we procedurally generated a diverse dataset of roughly 80,000 stacked 3D structures with per-task ground truth. We evaluate models across three output formats (free-response text, multiple-choice images, and image editing) alongside a human baseline. The Spatial-IQ framework shows that top-performing models often succeed at the target task (object counting) without succeeding on the lower-level sub-tasks intended to support it, and that models differ in how much of these hierarchical chains they preserve, often revealing shortcut behavior that raw target-task accuracy alone would obscure. Finally, we demonstrate that training models with chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision over our hierarchical sub-tasks, combined with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, significantly improves both spatial consistency across sub-tasks and target-task accuracy, supporting the value of the proposed decomposition as both a diagnostic tool and a training signal.

AI.tldr: 提出Spatial-IQ分层诊断框架，将堆叠3D结构中的物体计数分解为9个感知和认知子任务，以识别MLLM空间推理失败的根源。通过程序化生成的约80,000个3D结构数据集，发现顶级模型常在不掌握底层子任务的情况下完成目标计数任务，存在捷径行为。结合分层子任务的CoT监督和强化学习可显著提升空间一致性和目标任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在空间推理任务上表现不佳，但现有基准仅将其视为黑盒评估，无法区分性能下降的根源是感知层面（如识别物体边界）还是认知层面（如推理遮挡几何）。需要一种能诊断模型在空间推理中具体哪个环节出错的层次化框架。
AI.method: 提出Spatial-IQ分层诊断框架，将堆叠3D结构的物体计数分解为9个感知与认知子任务（按人类空间认知发展阶段组织），并增加心理旋转作为额外探测任务。使用NVIDIA Isaac Sim程序化生成约80,000个堆叠3D结构数据集，提供每个子任务的真实标签。在三种输出格式（自由文本、多选图像、图像编辑）上评估模型，并与人类基线对比。
AI.result: 顶级模型常在目标计数任务上成功，但无法完成支撑该任务的底层子任务，表明存在捷径行为；不同模型保持层次化推理链的程度不同。在分层子任务上使用CoT监督+基于可验证奖励的强化学习训练，显著提升了跨子任务的空间一致性和目标任务准确率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的层次化分解不仅可作为诊断工具揭示模型的空间推理缺陷，还可作为训练信号提升模型性能，验证了该分解框架的双重价值。

title: A Frozen 12B Beats Frontier Models on Verified Work: 100% Accuracy, 0 Tokens, Bit-Exact, Forever
comment: Industry experience report. 14 pages, 8 figures. Public testbench: https://corbenic-galahad-bench.hf.space; companion repository with SHA-256 provenance manifest: https://github.com/corbenicai/galahad-bench
summary: Improving a language model today means retraining it: enormous compute, a new opaque model each cycle, non-deterministic output. We take the opposite path: the model stays frozen, and a persistent memory of verified solutions grows beside it. Once a problem family is solved and has passed an independent verification step that never consults the answer key, every new instance of that family is answered at zero generation tokens, bit-exact, deterministically. Across 180 fresh instances spanning nine problem families, four architectures from four vendors - dense and mixture-of-experts - each score 180/180 at zero generation tokens per answer: execution-bound capability decoupled from parameter scaling. A negative control attributes the capability fully to the memory: emptied, it solves nothing. The same verify-before-store contract holds for open-ended reasoning: 88/88 consistency-gated acceptances across all four models, machine-checked formal proof, and reasoning-method transfer at 77/80. Memory selection takes 1.4 microseconds; a full reuse completes in 6-23 ms at 36 mWh. Approximate similarity retrieval selects the wrong item 94.3% of the time on a 4,500-item verified store where exact addressing makes zero errors. The store also serves as working context at a scale no shipped engine matches: a 6,000,000-token movable window on a single 46 GB GPU at flat memory, where vLLM stops at 30,399 tokens and SGLang silently truncates past 32,000. On published benchmarks, frontier models remain far ahead of any 12B at raw from-scratch reasoning; on everything this system has solved and verified, the comparison inverts: a frontier API call pays a fresh generation pass on every query, forever, while verified reuse costs zero tokens and returns the identical bits every time. A public testbench with free, rate-limited access accompanies this report: https://corbenic-galahad-bench.hf.space

AI.tldr: 提出一种"冻结模型+持久化验证记忆"的推理架构：不重训模型，而是将已验证的求解过程存入记忆库，新实例通过精确匹配直接复用结果，实现零生成token、确定性输出。在9个问题族、180个实例、4种架构上均获满分，而相似度检索在4500条记忆库中错误率94.3%，精确寻址零错误。记忆选择1.4微秒，完整复用6-23毫秒。还支持6百万token可移动上下文窗口（46GB GPU单卡），远超越vLLM和SGLang的限制。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型每次改进都需要重新训练，消耗巨大算力，且每次生成非确定性、不透明。作者希望打破"能力必须依赖参数规模扩展"的范式，探索一种无需重训、可验证、确定性的推理路径。
AI.method: 核心方法：(1) 冻结语言模型参数不变；(2) 构建持久化的已验证解决方案记忆库（verify-before-store）；(3) 对每个问题族，首次求解后独立验证（不查答案），通过后存入记忆；(4) 新实例通过精确寻址（非近似检索）匹配记忆，直接复用结果；(5) 支持大规模可移动上下文窗口作为工作记忆。
AI.result: (1) 9个问题族、180个实例、4种架构（含dense和MoE），均180/180满分，零生成token；(2) 负对照实验：清空记忆库则什么都解不了；(3) 开放推理：88/88一致性门控接受，机器验证形式化证明，推理方法迁移77/80；(4) 记忆选择1.4μs，完整复用6-23ms@36mWh；(5) 近似检索在4500条记忆库中错误率94.3%，精确寻址零错误；(6) 支持6M token可移动窗口（46GB单卡），vLLM仅30,399 token，SGLang在32,000以上静默截断；(7) 在已解决问题的族内，反超前沿模型（后者每次查询都需完整生成）
AI.conclusion: 验证记忆+精确寻址可以完全解耦执行能力与参数规模扩展，在已解决问题的领域实现零成本、确定性、可验证的推理。这挑战了当前"越大越好"的Scaling Law范式，为语言模型提供了一条互补的技术路径。

title: CHS-SQL: A Text-to-SQL approach based on Confidence-Guided Heuristic Search Schema Linking process
summary: Recently, there have been several works in the Text-to-SQL domain that utilize Small Language Models (SLMs) for training. These approaches achieve performance close to that of large models in generating SQL, using only the computational power of a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, while also ensuring data security. Most existing methods filter out redundant tables and columns during Schema Linking to improve Text-to-SQL accuracy. However, they do not consider the precision-recall trade-off when selecting the candidate schema subset. Our research found that both the precision and recall of Schema Linking directly affect the final SQL accuracy. Therefore, we propose a novel framework for efficiently fine-tuning SLMs on Text-to-SQL tasks, CHS-SQL, that not only balances precision and recall but also improves overall performance on Text-to-SQL tasks. Its main innovation lies in the Schema Linking phase, where a heuristic search combined with model internal confidence is employed to achieve an optimal precision-recall trade-off. This elaborated mechanism maximizes the precision of relevant schema candidates for the generated SQL queries while suppressing irrelevant noise. The same strategy is further applied during SQL generation to refine candidate queries while helping the SLM to avoid trapping in a local optimum. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on Text-to-SQL tasks via SLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出CHS-SQL框架，通过在Schema Linking阶段使用启发式搜索结合模型内部置信度来平衡精确率与召回率，从而提升小语言模型在Text-to-SQL任务上的性能，达到SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法在Schema Linking时未考虑精确率与召回率的权衡问题，而两者直接影响最终SQL生成准确率，因此需要一种能平衡二者关系的方法。
AI.method: 提出CHS-SQL框架，核心创新在于Schema Linking阶段采用启发式搜索结合模型内部置信度，实现精确率与召回率的最优权衡；该策略还用于SQL生成阶段以优化候选查询，避免小语言模型陷入局部最优。
AI.result: 在Text-to-SQL任务上通过小语言模型取得了SOTA结果。
AI.conclusion: CHS-SQL通过平衡Schema Linking的精确率与召回率，在仅用单张RTX 4090 GPU的情况下，使小语言模型在Text-to-SQL任务上达到接近大模型的性能，同时保障数据安全。

title: AdaKAN: A dual-branch adaptive Kolmogorov-Arnold network for medical image segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation is a fundamental task in computer-aided diagnosis, yet it remains challenging due to the complexity of anatomical structures and the variability across imaging modalities. In this paper, we propose AdaKAN, an Adaptive Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) that synergistically integrates convolutional operations with a novel efficient KAN (EffiKAN) block, comprised of an efficient attention mechanism and an adaptive KAN (AdaptKAN) module. This module features a dual-branch design: one branch employs a KAN layer with Bernstein polynomial activations for globally smooth and stable function approximation, while the other branch performs channel-wise refinement through projection operations and adaptive scaling. AdaKAN adopts a U-shaped architecture that effectively captures both long-range dependencies and fine-grained local features, overcoming the limitations of conventional convolutional and Transformer-based segmentation models. Skip connections are employed to preserve spatial details during encoding and facilitate accurate reconstruction during decoding. Extensive experiments conducted on diverse medical imaging datasets demonstrate that AdaKAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in segmentation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaKAN，一种自适应KAN网络，通过集成卷积操作与高效KAN模块（EffiKAN），在U形架构中同时捕捉长程依赖和细粒度局部特征，在多种医学影像分割任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割因解剖结构复杂性和不同成像模态间的变异性而具有挑战性，传统卷积模型和Transformer模型在捕捉长程依赖与局部细节方面存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出AdaKAN，包含EffiKAN模块（高效注意力机制+AdaptKAN双分支模块：一支采用Bernstein多项式激活函数的KAN层进行全局平滑函数逼近，另一支通过投影操作和自适应缩放进行通道级精炼），采用U形架构集成卷积操作，通过跳跃连接保留空间细节。
AI.result: 在多个医学影像数据集上的大量实验表明，AdaKAN在分割准确性上达到了最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: AdaKAN通过协同集成卷积与KAN，有效克服了传统CNN和Transformer分割模型的局限，在医学图像分割任务中取得了优越性能。

title: Indic DiarBench: A Multilingual Joint Diarization and ASR Benchmark for Indian Languages
summary: In this work, we introduce Indic DiarBench, a speaker diarization and ASR benchmark dataset spanning all 22 scheduled languages of India. This corpus comprises approximately 108 hours of natural multi-speaker audio from near-field meetings, far-field recordings, and in-the-wild audios. All annotations are human-corrected with time-aligned speaker attributed transcriptions. The dataset captures conversational nuance prevalent in Indian speech, such as English code-mixing, dialectal variation, and frequent speaker overlap. To establish a baseline for joint ASR and diarization capabilities we evaluate leading systems including commercial speech APIs and multimodal large language models. Indic DiarBench is released as an open-access resource to advance inclusive, multilingual speech technology research for Indian languages.

AI.tldr: 提出了Indic DiarBench，一个涵盖印度22种官方语言的多说话人语音数据集，包含约108小时的自然对话音频，用于说话人日志和语音识别基准测试。
AI.motivation: 印度拥有22种官方语言，但缺乏涵盖这些语言的多说话人语音基准数据集，制约了包容性多语言语音技术的发展。
AI.method: 构建了包含近场会议、远场录音和野外音频三种场景的多说话人语料库，所有标注经过人工校正，包含时间对齐的说话人属性转录；评估了商业语音API和多模态大语言模型在联合ASR和说话人日志任务上的表现。
AI.result: 数据集约108小时，覆盖22种印度语言，包含英语代码混合、方言变异和高频说话人重叠等自然对话特征。
AI.conclusion: 该开放数据集为印度语言的多语言语音技术研究提供了标准化基准，有助于推动包容性语音技术的发展。

title: TokenMem: Faithful Knowledge Injection for Frozen LLMs
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, but suffers from knowledge conflicts: when retrieved information contradicts parametric memory, the shared self-attention pathway produces unpredictable outputs. We present TokenMem, a lightweight memory system that injects knowledge into frozen LLMs through a dedicated cross-attention channel, bypassing competition with parametric memory in the residual stream. TokenMem trains only a thin gating adapter ($\sim$3-7M parameters) via a two-phase curriculum: first learning general knowledge utilization, then strengthening faithful compliance under counterfactual knowledge. In controlled experiments on five models spanning three families (Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, OLMo-3-7B), TokenMem achieves 69-70% Knowledge Compliance (KC) on counterfactual benchmarks, compared to 20-52% for vanilla RAG, a gap of up to 49 percentage points. Ablation studies show that the two-phase curriculum is critical: removing Phase 2 collapses KC to near-zero. Mechanistic analysis reveals that the gate adapter learns a conflict-aware, layer-specific injection strategy without explicit supervision.

AI.tldr: TokenMem通过专用交叉注意力通道向冻结的LLM注入知识，采用两阶段课程训练轻量级门控适配器（3-7M参数），在反事实知识场景下实现69-70%的知识遵从率，相比传统RAG提升最高49个百分点。
AI.motivation: RAG系统中检索信息与LLM参数化记忆之间存在知识冲突，共享的自注意力路径在冲突时产生不可预测的输出，需要一种方法在不干扰参数记忆的情况下有效注入外部知识。
AI.method: 提出TokenMem——一种轻量级记忆系统，通过专用交叉注意力通道向冻结的LLM注入知识，绕过残差流中与参数记忆的竞争。仅训练一个薄门控适配器（~3-7M参数），采用两阶段课程学习：第一阶段学习通用知识利用，第二阶段在反事实知识下强化忠诚遵从。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B、LLaMA-3.1-8B、OLMo-3-7B五个模型上，TokenMem在反事实基准上达到69-70%的知识遵从率（KC），而传统RAG仅为20-52%，差距高达49个百分点。消融实验表明两阶段课程学习至关重要，移除第二阶段后KC降至接近零。
AI.conclusion: 门控适配器学习了冲突感知、层特定的注入策略，无需显式监督。该方法为RAG中的知识冲突问题提供了一种高效、轻量的解决方案。

title: Small-Pollinator Detection in Cluttered Field Video
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Code, experiment notebooks, and implementation details: https://github.com/OnurOnal7/buzzspot-pollinator-detection
summary: Detecting pollinators in field video is challenging: targets are small, visually similar, and observed against cluttered vegetation under blur and occlusion. We present a systematic empirical study of small-pollinator detection under a practical single-GPU compute budget. Using the BuzzSpot challenge dataset, we compare YOLO and RF-DETR models across input resolutions and evaluate sliced inference, class-gated fusion, size-routed ensembling, and post-hoc temporal processing. RF-DETR Large at 1344-pixel resolution achieved our best hidden-test result, reaching 0.405 mAP50:95 and outperforming the 1120-pixel model (0.379) and the best single-model YOLO26m baseline (0.366). The strongest gains came from adopting RF-DETR and increasing its input resolution, indicating that detector choice and input resolution were more effective levers than added inference-time complexity; the resolution gain was strongest for small objects and the rarer bumblebee and moth classes. Sliced-inference fusion, size-routed ensembling, and warm-started 1536-pixel continuation did not surpass this result, while post-hoc temporal processing did not improve the leaked diagnostic evaluation. Error analysis identified bee-hoverfly discrimination as the clearest remaining bottleneck: neighboring frames rarely supplied correctly classified hoverfly evidence for post-hoc correction. These findings motivate learned feature-level temporal aggregation before the final classification decision.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统比较了YOLO和RF-DETR在田间视频中检测小型传粉昆虫（蜜蜂、熊蜂、食蚜蝇、蛾类）的性能。RF-DETR Large在1344像素分辨率下达到最佳隐藏测试结果0.405 mAP50:95，优于YOLO26m基线（0.366）和1120像素模型（0.379）。结果表明检测器选择和输入分辨率比增加推理复杂度更有效，而蜜蜂-食蚜蝇的区分是最主要的瓶颈，建议在最终分类决策前学习特征级时间聚合。
AI.motivation: 田间视频中的传粉昆虫检测面临目标小、视觉相似、背景杂乱、模糊和遮挡等挑战，需要系统研究在单GPU计算预算下的有效检测策略。
AI.method: 使用BuzzSpot挑战数据集，对比YOLO和RF-DETR模型在不同输入分辨率下的表现，评估切片推理融合、类别门控融合、尺寸路由集成和后处理时间处理等技术。
AI.result: RF-DETR Large在1344像素分辨率下达到最佳结果0.405 mAP50:95；分辨率提升对小型目标和稀有类（熊蜂、蛾类）增益最大；切片推理融合、尺寸路由集成和1536像素热启动延续未超越此结果；后处理时间处理未能改善诊断评估。
AI.conclusion: 检测器选择和输入分辨率是提升性能最有效的杠杆；蜜蜂-食蚜蝇区分是主要瓶颈；未来应探索在最终分类决策前进行学习式特征级时间聚合。

title: Earnings25: A Comprehensive 500-Hour Speech Benchmark for Finance
summary: We introduce Earnings25, a finance-domain benchmark for evaluating automatic speech recognition (ASR) on English-language earnings calls under realistic conditions. Earnings25 comprises two complementary test sets: (i) testset-full, 498 hours of full English-language S&P 500 earnings calls from Q4 2025, and (ii) testset-segmented, a 46-hour industry-balanced set of 290 segments sampled from English-language U.S. earnings calls in 2025. The benchmark provides aligned transcripts and structured metadata, including speaker roles, industry labels, and call structure, enabling speaker- and industry-aware evaluation beyond aggregate word error rate (WER). We report reproducible baselines for Whisper and Parakeet-TDT using standardized scoring.

AI.tldr: Earnings25是一个面向金融领域的英文财报电话会议ASR基准测试，包含498小时完整会议集和46小时平衡分段集，提供对齐转录与结构化元数据，并报告了Whisper和Parakeet-TDT的可复现基线。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR基准缺乏金融领域（尤其是财报电话会议）的专门评估，且传统WER评估方式忽略了说话人角色、行业差异等结构化信息，无法满足实际应用需求。
AI.method: 构建了两个互补测试集：testset-full（498小时完整S&P 500财报电话会议）和testset-segmented（46小时、290段、行业平衡的采样片段），提供对齐转录与说话人角色、行业标签、会议结构等元数据，支持细粒度评估。
AI.result: 在Whisper和Parakeet-TDT上报告了可复现的标准化评分基线。
AI.conclusion: Earnings25填补了金融领域ASR评估的空白，通过结构化元数据支持超越WER的说话人感知与行业感知评估，为后续研究提供了标准化基准。

title: Masked Distillation: Internalizing the Chain-of-Thought in Language Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) produce long, explicit chains of intermediate steps before generating a final answer at inference time. These intermediate traces dominate latency, memory usage, and serving cost, even though the final answer correctness is not causally related to the trace correctness and the trace length is not a reliable indicator of the problem complexity. This raises a natural question: can the computation expressed in these intermediate tokens be internalized into the parameters of a language model, enabling it to produce answers directly (or with much shorter intermediate traces)? We introduce \textit{masked distillation}, a knowledge-distillation framework in which a student LLM is trained to predict only the solution tokens conditioned on the question, while a reasoning teacher provides feedback on the student's responses after conditioning on the question and its own CoT trace. We instantiate this framework in two settings: (i) a \textit{self-distillation} setting, in which the same model serves as the teacher in thinking mode and as the student in non-thinking mode, and (ii) a \textit{dual-model} setting, in which a larger reasoning teacher supervises a separate smaller non-thinking student over the solution tokens. By treating intermediate tokens as a scaffold which reasoning models use to fit over the solution tokens, We additionally vary the length of intermediate-token scaffolding the student is supervised on, interpolating between full internalization (the student emits only the solution) and no internalization (the student emits the full trace before the answer). We evaluate the framework through controlled experiments on two reasoning domains: GSM8K (grade-school arithmetic) and Countdown (a number-puzzle search task).

AI.tldr: 本文提出掩码蒸馏框架，通过让学生模型仅预测解决方案令牌，将推理模型的中间思维链内化到参数中，在GSM8K和Countdown任务上实现缩短中间推理轨迹的同时保持性能。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在推理时生成长而显式的中间步骤，这些中间轨迹主导了延迟、内存和推理成本，但最终答案的正确性与中间轨迹的正确性并无因果关系，且轨迹长度并非问题复杂度的可靠指标。因此，能否将中间令牌表达的计算内化到语言模型参数中，使其直接生成答案或使用更短的中间轨迹？
AI.method: 提出掩码蒸馏框架：学生LLM仅基于问题预测解决方案令牌，推理教师（在条件化问题及其CoT轨迹后）对学生的响应提供反馈。包含两种设置：(i)自蒸馏：同一模型在思考模式下作为教师，非思考模式下作为学生；(ii)双模型：更大的推理教师监督更小的非思考学生。通过变化中间令牌脚手架的长度，在全内化（学生仅输出解决方案）和无内化（学生输出完整轨迹）之间插值。
AI.result: 在GSM8K（基础算术）和Countdown（数字谜题搜索任务）两个推理领域通过控制实验进行评估。
AI.conclusion: 中间令牌可作为推理模型拟合解决方案令牌的脚手架，通过掩码蒸馏可实现不同程度的推理内化，在缩短推理轨迹的同时保持模型性能。

title: Controlling Embedding Spaces with Text-Conditioned Transformations
summary: Multimodal embedding spaces in models like CLIP enable powerful capabilities such as semantic similarity retrieval and cross-modal zero-shot classification. These embeddings compress high-level semantics into a single vector, which comes at the cost of primarily expressing a dominant semantics like main object while suppressing other important attributes such as camera angle or color tone. We propose a text-conditioned transformation of visual embeddings that makes such attributes explicitly accessible. Given a natural language description of an attribute category (e.g., "color" or "art style"), a network generates an affine transformation that emphasizes the specified attribute. Conditioning on text enables it to learn many attributes simultaneously, accessing them at inference time through an intuitive interface. The network is trained to align transformed embeddings with the frozen latent space, enabling retrieval using existing large-scale embeddings without any re-encoding. When applied to a full set, the same mechanism transforms the latent space for attribute disentanglement tasks such as multi-clustering. By operating directly in latent space, our method provides a unified and efficient framework for controlling embedding spaces, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance across both attribute-based retrieval and multi-attribute organization tasks with near-zero inference cost. Project page: https://joefioresi718.github.io/ControlEmbed_webpage/

AI.tldr: 提出了一种文本条件化的视觉嵌入变换方法（ControlEmbed），通过自然语言描述指定属性类别（如"颜色"或"艺术风格"），生成仿射变换来强调特定属性，无需重新编码即可实现属性基检索和多属性聚类，在近乎零推理成本下达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态嵌入空间（如CLIP）将高层语义压缩为单一向量，导致仅表达主导语义（如主体对象），而抑制了其他重要属性（如相机角度或色调）。现有方法缺乏对特定属性的显式可控访问能力。
AI.method: 提出一种文本条件化的变换网络，输入属性类别的自然语言描述（如"color"），生成仿射变换作用于视觉嵌入，使指定属性显式可访问。训练过程中将变换后的嵌入与冻结的潜在空间对齐，从而无需重新编码即可利用现有大规模嵌入。该方法统一了属性基检索和多属性组织（如多聚类）任务。
AI.result: 在属性基检索和多属性组织任务上均达到SOTA性能，且推理成本近乎为零（无需重新编码）。
AI.conclusion: 通过在潜在空间中直接操作，该方法提供了一种统一高效的嵌入空间控制框架，实现了对多属性的同时学习与推理时通过自然语言接口的直观访问。

title: Understanding Tone-Dependent Inference Cost in Large Language Models
summary: We examine how prompt tone affects both accuracy of the LLM answers and inference cost as reflected in output-token consumption. Experiments were performed to understand the trade-offs between accuracy and inference cost on a 570 Question MMLU dataset for LLM models prompted in seven different tones from sycophantic to threatening. Our results show that the output-token-length variation substantially exceeded accuracy variation across all models. Output-token consumption varied by up to 44.3% across tone conditions. We also analyzed the tradeoff between the accuracy of the answers and the average output token length in the reasoning process. For the ChatGPT models 4o and 5-nano, the rude tone is quite dominant. For the Gemini models 2.5 Flash and 2.5 Flash Lite, the rude and neutral tones are dominant on the Pareto-optimal frontier. We find that prompt tone influences not only answer quality but also the amount of billable inference resources consumed by modern LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了提示语气（从谄媚到威胁共7种）对LLM回答准确性和推理成本（输出token消耗）的影响。实验基于570题MMLU数据集，发现输出token长度变化（最高达44.3%）远超准确率变化，不同模型在帕累托最优边界上表现出不同语气的优势（如ChatGPT的粗鲁语气、Gemini的粗鲁和中性语气）。
AI.motivation: 探究提示语气如何同时影响LLM回答的准确性和推理成本（输出token消耗），理解两者之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 在570题MMLU数据集上，使用7种不同语气（从谄媚到威胁）提示多个LLM模型（ChatGPT 4o、5-nano、Gemini 2.5 Flash、2.5 Flash Lite），测量准确率和输出token长度，分析帕累托最优边界。
AI.result: 输出token长度变化（高达44.3%）远超准确率变化；ChatGPT 4o和5-nano的粗鲁语气占优；Gemini 2.5 Flash和2.5 Flash Lite的粗鲁和中性语气位于帕累托最优前沿。
AI.conclusion: 提示语气不仅影响答案质量，还显著影响LLM的可计费推理资源消耗，存在准确率与成本之间的权衡。

title: VlogReward: Learning Multi-Dimensional Evaluation for Vlog Editing
summary: The rapid rise of vlogs as a personalized storytelling medium has created a demand for automated systems to evaluate and refine vlog editing plans. However, vlog assessment is highly subjective and remains challenging due to a lack of standardized criteria, dataset and benchmark, and effective reward models. To address these challenges, we define a comprehensive vlog evaluation framework guided by professional vlog creators and product managers, establishing a taxonomy of six key dimensions, i.e., Creativity, Consistency, Concept Design, Cinematography, Narration, and Pacing. Subsequently, we curate a large-scale dataset of 100k vlog edits and a dedicated benchmark, VRMBench, to evaluate the vlog rewarding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Finally, we present VlogReward, a robust vlog reward model that can provide both fine-grained multi-dimensional scores and actionable feedback for iterative refinement. Technically, we enhance the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework by introducing an adjustable inter-group comparison reward, which mitigates the "direction blindness" issue of standard GRPO and enables the model to better distinguish varied-quality edits. VlogReward achieves state-of-the-art results that significantly outperform existing MLLMs, including GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Pro. We hope that our study can help vlog creators and foster automated vlog evaluation and refinement systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VlogReward，一个基于GRPO增强的多模态奖励模型，通过六维度评估框架（创造力、一致性、概念设计、 cinematography、叙事、节奏）和大规模数据集VRMBench，实现对vlog编辑计划的主观质量评估与迭代优化，显著优于GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro等现有MLLM。
AI.motivation: vlog评估高度主观，缺乏标准化标准、数据集、基准测试和有效的奖励模型，亟需建立自动化系统来评估和改进vlog编辑计划。
AI.method: 1) 与专业vlog创作者和产品经理合作，构建六维度评估框架（创造力、一致性、概念设计、 cinematography、叙事、节奏）；2) 构建10万条vlog编辑数据集和VRMBench基准；3) 提出VlogReward模型，在GRPO框架中引入可调节的组间比较奖励机制，解决标准GRPO的"方向盲视"问题。
AI.result: VlogReward在vlog奖励建模任务上取得SOTA结果，显著超越包括GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro在内的现有多模态大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文的研究有助于vlog创作者，并推动自动化vlog评估与改进系统的发展。

title: Layering Virtual Try-On
summary: In the real world, fashion is about layering: adding a jacket over a shirt, or a sequence of adding and removing layers, rather than just a single-layer swap. This fundamental real-world task remains a challenge in existing Virtual Try-On (VTON) methods, which excel at single-layer replacement but are not designed to layer or de-layer an existing outfit. This paper proposes Layering Virtual Try-On (LVTON), a layering benchmark and method that preserves an existing outfit while enabling sequential layering. We find that current VTON paradigms are fundamentally ill-equipped for LVTON, as their reliance on cloth-agnostic representations and single-item datasets discards essential layering context. Our key insight is that the LVTON challenge must be disentangled into two distinct competencies: (1) General VTON Priors (e.g., deformation, identity preservation) and (2) Specific Layering Knowledge (e.g., layering order and occlusion reasoning). First, our model obtains general VTON priors by being trained on data produced by an automatic data generation pipeline that synthesizes samples from fashion videos via segmentation and inpainting. Second, the model is fine-tuned on a small, dedicated LVTON dataset to learn the layering logic. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on our LVTON benchmark and demonstrates superior generalizability on traditional VTON benchmarks, setting new state-of-the-art results when fine-tuned and exhibiting zero-shot capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LVTON，一个支持服装分层与脱层的虚拟试穿基准和方法，通过解耦通用VTON先验和特定分层知识，在合成数据上预训练再在小规模分层数据集上微调，实现了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VTON方法仅支持单层替换，无法处理现实世界中多层穿搭（如外套叠加衬衫）的添加、移除和顺序分层任务。
AI.method: 将LVTON解耦为通用VTON先验（变形、身份保持）和特定分层知识（分层顺序、遮挡推理）。先通过自动数据生成流水线（从时尚视频经分割和修复合成数据）训练获得通用先验，再在小规模专用LVTON数据集上微调学习分层逻辑。
AI.result: 在LVTON基准上达到SOTA，在传统VTON基准上微调后取得新SOTA，并展现出零样本能力。
AI.conclusion: 现有VTON范式因依赖服装无关表示和单物品数据集而无法处理分层任务，本文的解耦策略有效解决了这一根本性局限。

title: Tag Questions and the Generational Reversal of Sycophancy Across 45 Language Models
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Data, code, and raw model replies: https://github.com/tap2k/modelun. Interactive explorer: https://tap2k.github.io/modelun/suggestibility/
summary: Appending a two-word confirmation tag to a decision question -- "Is X the better choice?" versus "X is the better choice, right?" -- changes whether a language model endorses the choice. We measure this tag effect on 20 frozen, ground-truth-free decisions between two defensible options, counterbalanced so a model's own preferences cancel, scored by exact match on clamped yes/no replies -- no LLM judge, no embeddings. Across 45 models the effect spans +32% to -32% -- a 64-point swing on one word -- with 5 models significantly sycophantic and 17 significantly resistant (BH-FDR q=.10). The sign is a clock: within model families the effect crosses from positive to negative as generations advance (GPT +4 to -28; Claude +7 to -32; Qwen and Grok likewise), roughly -6 points per year, a reversal robust to vendor tier; one lineage (DeepSeek) never crosses, and two releases during the study window (Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6 Flash) land on the trend out-of-sample. A full-panel ablation localizes the resistance as a double dissociation: a synonym tag reproduces each model's response almost exactly (r=0.89), while planting the same preference without a tag produces resistance in no resistant model (stance effects +6 to +49; r=0.23 with tag effects). The resistance is keyed to the surface construction of a tacked-on agreement bid, not the user's stance -- a pattern-match, not a principle. And the tag's polarity matters more than its presence: swap one word -- "X is the better choice, maybe?" -- and agreement rises above the neutral baseline in 45 of 45 models (+19.6 points), with ten models affirming both mutually exclusive options at 90-100%. Agreement tracks how sure the user sounds, in opposite directions at the two poles. The instrument is one word, one dollar, and judge-free; run per release, it reads the field's anti-sycophancy training directly off model behavior.

AI.tldr: 向决策问题添加一个两词的确认标签（如"X是更好的选择，对吧？"）会显著改变语言模型的回答倾向。跨45个模型，该效应范围从+32%到-32%（64个百分点的波动），且随模型代际更新，效应方向从正转为负（约每年-6个百分点）。该抵抗效应源于对表面语言结构的模式匹配而非原则性立场，而标签的极性（"对吧？"vs"也许？"）比其存在与否影响更大。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型对决策问题中确认标签（如"对吧？"）的敏感性，测量这种表面语言结构如何影响模型的回答倾向，以及随模型代际演化的变化趋势。
AI.method: 在20个无真实答案的二选一决策问题上，对比带确认标签（"X是更好的选择，对吧？"）与不带标签（"X是更好的选择吗？"）的提问方式，使用精确匹配（exact match）对二值回复（yes/no）打分，不依赖LLM裁判或嵌入。跨45个模型进行测量，并进行消融实验验证效应来源。
AI.result: 1) 标签效应范围从+32%到-32%（64个百分点）；2) 5个模型显著奉承（sycophantic），17个显著抵抗（resistant）；3) 效应方向随模型代际从正向负转变（GPT +4到-28；Claude +7到-32），约每年-6个百分点；4) 同义词标签复现效应（r=0.89），而无标签表达同样偏好时不产生抵抗（r=0.23）；5) 极性词替换（"对吧？"→"也许？"）使所有45个模型同意率上升超过基线（+19.6点），10个模型同时以90-100%认可两个互斥选项。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型对确认标签的响应是基于表面结构的模式匹配而非原则性判断；模型对奉承的抵抗与对用户确定性的敏感度呈相反方向；该实验方法简单（一个词、一美元、无需裁判）且可重复，可直接通过行为测试反映模型的抗奉承训练效果。

title: Evolving from Lessons: Skill-Augmented Table Graph Reasoning for Operation-wise Table Question Answering
summary: Table Question Answering (TableQA) aims to reason over tables to answer user queries. Existing research treats all questions uniformly and evaluates solely through overall accuracy, obscuring a critical reality that LLMs excel at simple lookups yet struggle with complex operations like aggregation and arithmetic. To reveal this disparity, we introduce a novel \emph{Operation-wise TableQA} task with a fine-grained question taxonomy and release two datasets named WikiTQ-ow and TabFact-ow for evaluation. As for modeling bottlenecks, existing methods flatten tables into linearized texts, disrupting inherent structures and inducing the ``lost-in-the-middle'' issue, which poses a primary barrier to complex cross-row reasoning. Moreover, they typically reason from scratch, neglecting reusable patterns shared across similar operations. To address these limitations, we propose a Skill-augmented Table Graph Reasoning (SkillTGR) framework for self-evolving structured reasoning. Specifically, SkillTGR represents tables as attributed graphs with explicit row-column-cell structures, where LLMs plan and execute dynamic chains to retrieve evidence subgraphs for graph traversal reasoning. Based on this, SkillTGR builds a hierarchical SkillBank to distill reason trajectories into abstract skills under cognitive heuristics, then hybrid retrieves both successful and failed skills for contrastive augmented table graph reasoning, thereby enabling the continual self-evolution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkillTGR achieves superior performance with an average of 5.91\% overall and 6.03\% operation-wise improvement, also reducing 19.76\% token consumption and 27.64\% inference latency. Our codes and data will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillTGR框架，通过将表格建模为属性图并构建层次化技能库进行自演进的结构化推理，在TableQA任务上实现整体5.91%、操作级6.03%的性能提升，同时减少19.76%的token消耗和27.64%的推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有TableQA研究统一对待所有问题并用整体准确率评估，掩盖了LLM擅长简单查询但难以处理聚合、算术等复杂操作的事实；同时现有方法将表格线性化破坏了结构并导致"lost-in-the-middle"问题，且从头推理忽略了可复用的操作模式。
AI.method: 提出SkillTGR框架：1) 将表格表示为带属性的图结构（行-列-单元格），LLM规划并执行动态链以检索证据子图进行图遍历推理；2) 构建层次化SkillBank，在认知启发下将推理轨迹蒸馏为抽象技能；3) 混合检索成功和失败的技能进行对比增强的图推理，实现持续自演进。
AI.result: 在WikiTQ-ow和TabFact-ow数据集上，SkillTGR在整体准确率上平均提升5.91%，操作级准确率平均提升6.03%，同时token消耗减少19.76%，推理延迟降低27.64%。
AI.conclusion: 通过操作级细粒度评估揭示了LLM在不同表格操作上的能力差异，提出的图结构推理与技能蒸馏框架有效解决了复杂操作推理瓶颈，实现了性能与效率的双重提升。

title: HALLELUAI: A Hallucination-Aware AI System for Ultra-Realistic Image-to-Video Generation at Scale
summary: AI-generated video is increasingly used across marketing, product storytelling, and creative workflows, yet automated; high-precision quality control remains a major constraint to scaling production. We present HALLELUAI, an end-to-end system that moderates and regenerates image-to-video outputs to meet expert-level creative standards and deliver ultra-realistic videos with consistent end-user quality of experience (QoE) at scale. The system integrates a video moderation module that evaluates frame-level aesthetics, temporal motion fidelity, and fine-grained hallucination risks relative to the source image, with an agentic regeneration module that iteratively fixes failures through prompt refinement, controlled camera adjustments, targeted model or image switching, and structured retry strategies. The moderation logic is aligned with domain-specific creative guidelines and produces granular, machine-actionable feedback that directly drives regeneration. In human-in-the-loop evaluations with creative experts, HALLELUAI shows strong alignment and reliably outputs ultra-realistic, production-grade videos suitable for product and marketing placements at scale. This framework advances trustworthy AI generated video content by enforcing visual realism, brand safety, and strict input-image fidelity while enabling image-to-video generation at scale.

AI.tldr: HALLELUAI是一个端到端系统，通过视频审核与智能再生模块，自动将图像生成视频并达到专家级创意标准，实现超写实视频的规模化生产与质量管控。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频在营销和创意工作流中应用广泛，但缺乏自动化、高精度的质量控制手段，成为规模化生产的瓶颈。
AI.method: 系统由两个核心模块组成：(1) 视频审核模块：评估帧级美学、时间运动保真度、针对源图像的细粒度幻觉风险；(2) 智能再生模块：通过提示词优化、相机参数控制、模型/图像切换、结构化重试策略迭代修复失败内容。审核逻辑与领域特定的创意准则对齐，生成可直接驱动再生的细粒度机器可执行反馈。
AI.result: 在人工参与的创意专家评估中，HALLELUAI表现出高度对齐性，能够可靠地输出适合产品展示和营销投放的超写实、生产级视频。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过强制视觉真实性、品牌安全和严格的输入图像保真度，推动了可信AI生成视频内容的发展，同时实现了图像到视频的大规模生成。

title: SyRuP: Enhancing System-Prompt Following via Reward-Guided Prediction in LLM Decoding
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly controlled through system prompts that specify roles, styles, formats, and safety requirements. However, models follow these prompts only implicitly through in-context learning, which can be insufficient for complex or compositional prompts. Existing approaches often require model tuning or response-level reranking, limiting their practicality for lightweight inference-time control. We introduce SyRuP, a decoding-time framework for improving system-prompt adherence while keeping the base LM frozen. SyRuP trains a cross-attention reward head from system-prompt-conditioned preference pairs, treating the system prompt as a separate memory to produce token-level adherence scores. At inference, SyRuP reranks the base LM's top-k candidates by combining base logits with the learned reward signal and an optional contrastive signal capturing system-induced logit shifts. Experiments on system-prompt following benchmarks show that SyRuP consistently outperforms prompting and decoding-time baselines with moderate inference overhead. These results suggest that explicit token-level guidance is an effective and practical mechanism for reliable system-prompt following.

AI.tldr: SyRuP是一个解码时框架，通过训练交叉注意力奖励头来生成token级别的系统提示遵循分数，在推理时结合基础logits和奖励信号对候选序列进行重排序，从而在不冻结基础LLM的情况下提升系统提示遵循能力。
AI.motivation: LLM通常通过系统提示来控制行为，但模型仅通过上下文学习隐式遵循这些提示，对于复杂或组合性提示往往不够充分。现有方法需要模型微调或响应级重排序，限制了轻量级推理时控制的实用性。
AI.method: SyRuP框架包含三个关键组件：1) 训练阶段：从系统提示条件偏好对中训练交叉注意力奖励头，将系统提示作为独立记忆生成token级遵循分数；2) 推理阶段：结合基础logits、学习到的奖励信号以及可选的对比信号（捕捉系统提示引起的logits偏移），对基础LM的top-k候选进行重排序。
AI.result: 在系统提示遵循基准测试上，SyRuP在仅有适度推理开销的情况下，一致优于提示方法和解码时基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式的token级引导是实现可靠系统提示遵循的有效且实用的机制。

title: PRESTO: Prefix-Aligned Tree Drafting for Diffusion Speculative Decoding
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs, generating tokens in parallel. This makes them effective draft models for speculative decoding (SD), producing an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass. Yet existing diffusion-based drafting methods rely on linear drafting, even though dLLMs emit multiple candidate tokens across positions, inducing a large combinatorial space of decoding paths. Consequently, they limit acceptance length and decoding efficiency. To exploit this multi-candidate structure, we apply tree-based drafting to diffusion drafters, enabling exploration of diverse candidate paths. However, we find that naive tree drafting is suboptimal: diffusion marginals are prefix-blind, mismatching the prefix-based AR verification and yielding unreliable path ranking. We propose PRESTO, a principled framework that extends tree-based drafting to diffusion drafters while resolving the fundamental mismatch between diffusion draft confidence and prefix-based AR verification through PREfix-aligned Scoring and priority-based Tree search for diffusion speculative decOding.
