The key principles behind PRESTO are that (1) candidate ranking should align with the prefix-based nature of AR verification, and (2) tree construction should prioritize candidate paths with high verification potential to maximize acceptance length. Extensive experiments show that PRESTO achieves up to an average of $1.5\times$ end-to-end throughput speedup on the state-of-the-art dedicated diffusion drafter SD and an average of $1.12\times$ on self-speculative diffusion LLMs across diverse benchmarks.

AI.tldr: PRESTO是一种面向扩散大语言模型的树形投机解码框架，通过前缀对齐评分和优先级树搜索解决扩散模型边际概率与自回归验证之间的不匹配问题，在多种基准上实现了最高1.5倍端到端吞吐量加速。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的草稿模型采用线性草稿方式，未能充分利用扩散模型在多个位置同时生成多个候选token所形成的巨大组合解码路径空间，导致接受长度受限、解码效率低下。
AI.method: 提出PRESTO框架，核心包括两个原则：(1) 候选排名应与自回归验证的前缀性质对齐（前缀对齐评分）；(2) 树构建应优先选择具有高验证潜力的候选路径以最大化接受长度（优先级树搜索）。
AI.result: 在专用扩散草稿模型SD上实现平均1.5倍端到端吞吐量加速，在自推测扩散LLMs上实现平均1.12倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 将树形草稿扩展到扩散草稿模型时需解决扩散边际概率的前缀盲区问题，PRESTO通过前缀对齐的评分和优先级树搜索有效解决了这一根本性不匹配，显著提升了扩散模型的投机解码效率。

title: mmSimPrior: Learning Simulation Priors for Data-Efficient Real-World Generalizable Radar-Based Human Motion Reconstruction
comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary material. Project page: https://ch3ngguo.github.io/mmsimprior/
summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar offers privacy-preserving and lighting-robust sensing for human motion reconstruction, but learning models that generalize across real deployments require diverse paired radar-motion data that are costly to collect. Simulation provides scalable supervision, yet models trained on clean synthetic signals transfer poorly because of multipath, clutter, response statistics, and resolution degradation. We present mmSimPrior, a simulation-pretrained framework that factorizes transferable knowledge into signal, motion, and radar-to-motion mapping priors. A multi-modal signal encoder is pretrained with a physics-informed domain-randomization curriculum that emulates propagation- and acquisition-level variations, while a joint-temporal tokenizer learns a discrete prior over plausible human motion. A shared mapping prior supports classification over a learned motion codebook for constrained zero-shot reconstruction and continuous regression for flexible limited-data adaptation. We further construct a 4.2M-frame, 31K-sequence dataset suite and introduce a No-Overlap Setting that excludes repeated complete subject-environment-location-motion configurations across adaptation and test. Experiments on mmSimPrior-Real and RT-Pose demonstrate consistent gains: with only 24 paired real sequences, mmSimPrior-Reg reduces MPJPE by 24.7% to 39.0% over the strongest baseline across the three environments, while mmSimPrior-Cls reduces zero-shot MPJPE by 8.5% without finetuning.

AI.tldr: mmSimPrior是一个基于仿真预训练的毫米波雷达人体运动重建框架，通过解耦信号、运动和映射先验知识，结合物理感知域随机化课程和多模态信号编码器，在仅24条真实序列下将MPJPE降低24.7%-39.0%，零样本场景下降低8.5%。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达在人体运动重建中具有隐私保护和光照鲁棒的优点，但真实场景下获取配对雷达-运动数据成本高昂，现有仿真预训练模型由于多径、杂波、响应统计和分辨率退化等问题导致迁移性能差，亟需一种能有效解耦可迁移知识并跨越仿真到真实域鸿沟的方法。
AI.method: 提出mmSimPrior框架，将可迁移知识分解为信号先验、运动先验和映射先验三部分：1）采用物理感知域随机化课程预训练多模态信号编码器，模拟传播级和采集级变化；2）设计联合时间分词器学习离散的人体运动先验；3）共享映射先验支持基于运动码本分类的零样本重建和连续回归的有限数据自适应。此外构建了420万帧、3.1万序列的数据集，并引入无重叠评估设置。
AI.result: 在mmSimPrior-Real和RT-Pose数据集上，仅用24条配对真实序列，mmSimPrior-Reg在三个环境下的MPJPE相比最强基线降低24.7%-39.0%；mmSimPrior-Cls在无需微调的零样本设置下MPJPE降低8.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦先验知识和物理感知域随机化预训练，mmSimPrior有效弥补了仿真到真实毫米波雷达人体运动重建的性能鸿沟，在数据效率、零样本泛化和跨环境迁移方面取得显著提升。

title: MoLGE: Mixture of Language Group Experts for Efficient Scaling of Massively Multilingual Speech Recognition
summary: Massively multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) models covering hundreds of languages must maintain robust performance across diverse linguistic and acoustic conditions. However, these models often encounter the curse of multilinguality, where model capacity is diluted across languages. To address this challenge, we propose Mixture of Language Group Experts (MoLGE), built upon speech self-supervised models (S3Ms). MoLGE assigns dedicated expert modules to clusters of similar languages, reducing the number of required submodules compared to conventional language-specific Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) schemes. It further integrates a hierarchical Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) strategy into the disentangled acoustic and linguistic components of the S3M architecture, enabling efficient modeling of language-specific characteristics while maintaining parameter efficiency. Further, we investigate the impact of language grouping strategies based on both linguistic and data-driven criteria on overall performance, providing an interpretable perspective on how language structure influences scalability in multilingual speech systems. In experiments, we evaluate MoLGE on a multilingual benchmark encompassing 495 languages. Results demonstrate that MoLGE consistently outperforms dense multilingual baselines with a minimal increase in trainable parameters. Notably, these language grouping strategies yield substantial improvements for both phonetic and orthographic aspects of ASR modeling. Our findings suggest that structured language specialization provides an effective pathway for massively scaling language coverage of multilingual ASR.

AI.tldr: 提出混合语言组专家（MoLGE）方法，通过将相似语言聚类并分配专用专家模块，结合分层低秩适应（LoRA）策略，在495种语言的多语言ASR基准上以最少的可训练参数增量实现了优于密集多语言基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模多语言ASR模型面临"多语言诅咒"——模型能力被稀释到各语言中，导致性能下降。现有方法如语言特定的混合专家（MoE）需要过多子模块，效率低下。
AI.method: 提出MoLGE，构建于语音自监督模型（S3Ms）之上：（1）将相似语言聚类，为每个语言组分配专用专家模块，减少子模块数量；（2）在S3M架构中分离的声学和语言组件中集成分层低秩适应（LoRA）策略，高效建模语言特定特征；（3）探索基于语言学和数据驱动的语言分组策略。
AI.result: 在495种语言的多语言基准上评估，MoLGE以最少的可训练参数增量持续优于密集多语言基线；语言分组策略在ASR建模的音系和正字法两方面均带来显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化语言专业化（将相似语言分组并分配专用专家）为大规模扩展多语言ASR的语言覆盖范围提供了有效途径。

title: CallBench: A Benchmark for Dual-Goal Coordination in Phone Call Assistants
summary: Target-oriented dialogue systems have demonstrated strong capabilities in completing user goals through interactive conversations. However, existing studies are primarily designed for single, explicit goal completion, while phone call assistants face a proxy setting that requires coordinating the device owner's explicit preset goal with the caller's implicit and dynamic goal. We introduce \textsc{CallBench}, a Chinese benchmark for evaluating dual-goal coordination in phone call assistants. \textsc{CallBench} contains 50,000 complete multi-turn phone call dialogues across six scenarios: takeout, delivery, taxi, work, life, and harassment. It covers regular presets, emergent presets, and no-preset cases, and includes diverse relations between owner-side and caller-side goals, such as alignment, complementarity, irrelevance, and conflict. We further design a preset-aware turn-level evaluation protocol covering semantic understanding, context use, active guidance, response quality, preset compliance, dialogue rhythm, and safety. Experiments on representative dialogue methods show that existing approaches still struggle with this task, highlighting the need for phone call assistants that can make reliable turn-level decisions between two independent goals under proxy constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出了CallBench，一个用于评估电话助手在代理场景下协调设备所有者预设目标与呼叫者隐含动态目标的中文基准数据集，包含5万条多轮对话，覆盖6个场景和4种目标关系类型。实验表明现有方法在该任务上表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有面向目标的对话系统主要针对单一、明确的目标完成，而电话助手面临代理设置，需要协调设备所有者的明确预设目标与呼叫者的隐含动态目标，这一双重目标协调问题尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 构建了包含50,000条完整多轮电话对话的CallBench基准数据集，覆盖外卖、快递、出租车、工作、生活和骚扰6个场景；设计了预设感知的轮次级评估协议，包括语义理解、上下文使用、主动引导、回复质量、预设遵从、对话节奏和安全性7个维度。
AI.result: 在代表性对话方法上的实验表明，现有方法在处理双重目标协调任务时仍存在困难，特别是在代理约束下在两个独立目标之间做出可靠的轮次级决策。
AI.conclusion: 现有方法在电话助手双重目标协调任务上表现不足，需要能够可靠地协调设备所有者预设目标与呼叫者动态目标的对话系统。

title: Breaking the Synthetic-Real Domain Shortcut for Training-Free Generative Replay-based Class Incremental Learning
summary: Class-incremental learning (CIL) requires models to continuously acquire new knowledge while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. While exemplar replay is effective, it raises concerns regarding privacy and storage. Thus, generative replay has emerged as a viable alternative, synthesizing old data using frozen pretrained text-to-image (T2I) models without any extra training. However, we observe that directly mixing synthetic old-class data with real new-class data during incremental training leads to significant performance degradation. This issue stems from a "domain shortcut", where models rely on domain-discriminative features instead of semantic class cues. To address this, we propose DREAM ($\underline{\mathbf{D}}$omain-$\underline{\mathbf{R}}$egularized $\underline{\mathbf{E}}$xemplar-free $\underline{\mathbf{A}}$lignment $\underline{\mathbf{M}}$odel), which uses a training-free generator to synthesize old-class data and eliminates domain shortcut via subspace rectification and orthogonal projection, while reinforcing semantic alignment through real-anchored prototype regularization. Extensive experiments on 4 datasets demonstrate that DREAM outperforms existing exemplar-free CIL methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our source code is available at https://github.com/Light-ZhangTao/DREAM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DREAM方法，利用冻结的预训练文本到图像模型生成旧类数据，通过子空间矫正和正交投影消除域捷径问题，并采用真实锚定原型正则化增强语义对齐，在无样本类增量学习中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 类增量学习中，样本回放虽有效但存在隐私和存储问题；生成式回放虽可替代，但直接混合生成的旧类数据与真实新类数据会导致严重的性能下降，其根源在于模型依赖域判别特征而非语义类别线索的"域捷径"问题。
AI.method: 提出DREAM模型：1）使用冻结的预训练T2I模型（无需额外训练）合成旧类数据；2）通过子空间矫正和正交投影消除域捷径；3）利用真实锚定原型正则化增强语义对齐。
AI.result: 在4个数据集上的大量实验表明，DREAM优于现有无样本回放的类增量学习方法，达到了最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: DREAM有效解决了生成式回放中合成数据与真实数据混合导致的域偏移问题，为隐私保护下的类增量学习提供了新的有效方案。

title: Pointer-Augmented Autoregressive Generation of Patent Claims with Joint Topology and Content Decoding
summary: Autoregressive decoders emit flat token sequences and cannot enforce hierarchical constraints across output segments, a limitation that becomes acute in patent claim generation, where a claim set forms a dependency forest whose scope must narrow monotonically with depth. Topology and content are mutually dependent: a dependent claim's wording must reflect its parent's scope, yet the parent must be chosen before that wording exists, so neither post-hoc parsing nor grammar-constrained decoding suffices. We propose SPG (Structure-aware Patent Generation), which predicts topology inside the autoregressive pass. A pointer head selects each dependent claim's parent, and its gradients, together with a depth-adaptive scope regularizer, reshape the shared decoder's representations during training. A second stage then applies a violation-weighted preference objective over self-generated deficient candidates, supplying the negative signal that granted-patent corpora lack. On HUPD-DCG, SPG on Llama-3-8B-Instruct recovers 79.0\% of gold parent links, a quantity its training reward never supervises, and raises antecedent consistency from 0.292 to 0.478 over a supervised baseline of equal scale, with expert evaluation corroborating these gains.

AI.tldr: 针对自回归解码器无法施加分层约束的问题，提出SPG方法，在自回归过程中通过指针头预测从属权利要求父节点，结合深度自适应范围正则器和违规加权偏好目标，在专利权利要求生成中实现了79.0%的父链接召回率和0.478的前后一致性得分。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码器生成扁平token序列，无法在输出段落间强制执行层级约束。在专利权利要求生成场景中，权利要求集形成依赖森林且范围随深度单调收窄，拓扑与内容相互依赖：从属权利要求的措辞必须反映其父项的范围，但父项必须在措辞存在之前被选择，因此后验解析和语法约束解码均不充分。
AI.method: 提出SPG框架：1）在自回归解码过程中使用指针头预测每个从属权利要求的父节点，其梯度与深度自适应范围正则器共同重塑共享解码器表示；2）第二阶段对自生成缺陷候选应用违规加权偏好目标，提供授权专利语料库中缺失的负信号。
AI.result: 在HUPD-DCG数据集上，基于Llama-3-8B-Instruct的SPG恢复79.0%的金标准父链接（训练奖励从未监督该指标），前后一致性从0.292提升至0.478，专家评估验证了这些改进。
AI.conclusion: SPG通过将拓扑预测融入自回归过程，有效解决了专利权利要求生成中的层级约束问题，在结构恢复和内容一致性上显著超越同等规模的监督基线。

title: Answering Path Queries under Linear and Guarded Existential Rules
summary: Ontology-mediated query answering is concerned with the problem of answering queries over knowledge bases consisting of a database instance and an ontology. While most work in the area focuses on conjunctive queries (CQs), navigational queries have gained increasing attention. In this paper, we investigate the complexity of answering two-way (conjunctive) regular path queries ((C)RPQs) over knowledge bases whose ontology is given by a set of guarded existential rules. We first consider the subclass of linear existential rules and show that (C)RPQ answering is NL-complete in data complexity, which matches the data complexity of answering RPQs over plain graph databases (i.e., without an ontology). In combined complexity, both tasks are ExpTime-complete in the general case, but RPQ and CRPQ answering drop to PTime-complete and PSpace-complete respectively if there is a bound on predicate arity. For guarded rules, we provide a non-trivial reduction to the linear case, which allows us to show that the complexity of (C)RPQ answering is the same as for CQs, namely 2ExpTime-complete in combined complexity (ExpTime-complete in the bounded-arity case) and PTime-complete in data complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在 guarded 存在规则本体下，回答双向（合取）正则路径查询的复杂性。线性规则下数据复杂度为 NL-完全（与无本体时相同），组合复杂度为 ExpTime-完全（有界谓词元数时 RPQ 为 PTime-完全，CRPQ 为 PSpace-完全）；guarded 规则下数据复杂度为 PTime-完全，组合复杂度为 2ExpTime-完全（有界元数时 ExpTime-完全）。
AI.motivation: 本体介导查询回答中，大多数工作关注合取查询，而导航式查询（如正则路径查询）日益受到关注，但此类查询在 guarded 存在规则本体下的复杂性尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 将 guarded 存在规则下的 (C)RPQ 回答问题通过非平凡归约转化为线性存在规则情形，进而分析不同规则子类下的数据复杂度和组合复杂度。
AI.result: 线性规则：(C)RPQ 数据复杂度为 NL-完全，组合复杂度为 ExpTime-完全（有界元数时 RPQ 为 PTime-完全，CRPQ 为 PSpace-完全）。Guarded 规则：数据复杂度 PTime-完全，组合复杂度 2ExpTime-完全（有界元数 ExpTime-完全）。
AI.conclusion: Guarded 存在规则下 (C)RPQ 回答的复杂性与 CQ 相同；线性规则下复杂度与无本体的图数据库匹配。

title: OmniMate: Open-Ended Real-Time Streaming Audio-Visual Generation for Interactive Avatars
summary: Recent advances in diffusion-based generative models have enabled real-time audio-driven avatar generation and unified audio-visual synthesis, providing a promising foundation for interactive avatar systems. However, extending these models to real-time interactive streaming remains challenging, as the generation horizon is unknown in advance and cross-modal identity consistency gradually degrades during long-term generation. To address these challenges, we propose OmniMate, a unified framework for open-ended real-time interactive audio-visual avatar generation. OmniMate jointly synthesizes visual content, speech, and audio effects in real time, enabling natural and immersive multi-turn interactions. To achieve adaptive response progression, we introduce a Generation Progress Controller (GPC) that explicitly models the generation progress of each streaming chunk, allowing the model to complete responses according to the desired progress and achieve seamless transitions between execution and listening states. To preserve long-term cross-modal identity consistency, we propose a Multi-Reference Conditioning Module (MRCM), which leverages multiple reference images and a reference speech segment to provide persistent visual and speaker identity cues throughout long-duration streaming interactions. Extensive experiments on an interaction-oriented adaptation of VerseBench demonstrate that OmniMate achieves high-quality, low-latency streaming generation while maintaining strong long-term audio-visual consistency. The results further show that OmniMate supports realistic, coherent, and responsive interactive avatar experiences over extended multi-turn conversations.

AI.tldr: OmniMate是一个统一框架，用于开放式实时交互式音视频虚拟人生成，通过生成进度控制器和多参考条件模块实现低延迟、高质量、长时一致的流式多轮对话。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型虽能实现实时音频驱动的虚拟人生成和统一音视频合成，但难以扩展到实时交互流式场景，因为生成范围未知且跨模态身份一致性在长时生成中逐渐退化。
AI.method: 提出OmniMate框架：1）生成进度控制器（GPC），显式建模每个流式块的生成进度，实现自适应响应推进和执行/监听状态的平滑切换；2）多参考条件模块（MRCM），利用多个参考图像和一个参考语音片段，在长时间流式交互中提供持久的视觉和说话人身份线索。
AI.result: 在基于VerseBench改造的交互数据集上，OmniMate实现了高质量、低延迟的流式生成，并保持了长期音视频一致性；支持逼真、连贯且响应式的多轮交互体验。
AI.conclusion: OmniMate有效解决了扩散模型在实时交互流式虚拟人生成中的关键挑战，为实际交互式虚拟人系统提供了可行方案。

title: LLM-Based vs. Lexicon-Based Sentiment Signals for Tail-Risk Detection in Meme Stocks
summary: This paper presents an empirical comparison of lexicon-based and Large Language Model (LLM)-based sentiment analysis for extracting market-relevant signals from social media discourse in highly volatile equity markets. Using Reddit data from r/WallStreetBets and focusing on meme stocks (GME, AMC, NOK), we construct time-aligned sentiment indicators and evaluate their relationship with market returns, with particular attention to extreme positive return events in the upper tail of the return distribution. The LLM-based approach generates multidimensional sentiment representations capturing emotional polarity, bullishness, sarcasm likelihood, and topical relevance, whereas the baseline relies on the VADER lexicon-based model. We evaluate both approaches using lead/lag correlation analysis, OLS regression, ROC-AUC-based directional classification, and a quantile-based early-warning framework. The results indicate that LLM-derived indicators provide a richer multidimensional representation and exhibit stronger asset-specific statistical structure than the lexicon-based baseline. However, their relationship with market movements remains heterogeneous across assets, suggesting that increased linguistic expressiveness does not necessarily translate into stable forecasting performance in retail-driven volatility regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文实证比较了基于词典（VADER）和基于大语言模型（LLM）的情感分析方法，利用Reddit r/WallStreetBets上关于meme股票（GME、AMC、NOK）的数据，构建时间对齐的情感指标，并通过领先/滞后相关分析、OLS回归、ROC-AUC方向分类和分位数早期预警框架评估其与市场回报的关系。结果表明，LLM提供了更丰富的多维情感表征和更强的资产特异性统计结构，但其与市场走势的关系在不同资产间存在异质性，表明更强的语言表现力并不一定能转化为稳定的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 在高波动性股票市场中，社交媒体情绪与资产价格之间存在复杂关联，传统基于词典的情感分析方法（如VADER）在捕捉细微的语义和语境信息方面存在局限。作者希望通过引入LLM进行更精细的多维情感分析，探索是否能提升从社交媒体话语中提取市场相关信号的准确性。
AI.method: 使用Reddit r/WallStreetBets上GME、AMC、NOK三种meme股票的数据，分别构建基于VADER词典和基于LLM（多维情感表征，包括情绪极性、看涨程度、讽刺可能性和主题相关性）的情感指标。通过领先/滞后相关分析、OLS回归、ROC-AUC方向分类以及分位数早期预警框架，系统比较两者与市场回报之间的关系。
AI.result: LLM导出的情感指标提供了更丰富的多维表征，并展现出比基于词典的基线更强的资产特异性统计结构。然而，LLM情感指标与市场走势之间的关系在不同资产间存在显著异质性，在零售驱动的波动性市场中，更强的语言表现力并未稳定转化为预测性能的提升。
AI.conclusion: 虽然LLM在情感表征的丰富性和资产特异性方面优于传统词典方法，但在高波动性零售驱动市场环境下，更强的语言表达能力和更复杂的表征并不必然带来更稳定或更可靠的预测性能，情感分析的实用性仍需结合具体资产和市场条件进行评估。

title: Fast Cross-Scenario Adaptation of CSI Models via Channel Conditional Parameter Generation
summary: Deep learning has shown strong potential for massive multiple-input multiple-output (Massive MIMO) physical-layer tasks, including channel state information (CSI) feedback and channel estimation. However, environmental heterogeneity can severely degrade CSI models in unseen scenarios, while conventional adaptation requires target-domain data and substantial computation. This paper proposes Channel Conditional Parameter Generation (CCPG), an end-to-end pipeline for rapid deployment of CSI models in dynamic wireless environments. CCPG identifies scene-sensitive adaptation bottlenecks through component-freezing experiments and generates only lightweight LoRA weights instead of full model parameters. It compresses high-dimensional channel features into compact latent conditions using cascaded SVD and a Perceiver Resampler. An energy-based canonicalization mechanism mitigates permutation and sign ambiguities in LoRA weights, while a diffusion-based generator incorporates structural information and an asymmetric size-aware loss for topology-aware parameter generation. Experiments on DeepMIMO and WAIR-D for CSI feedback and channel estimation show that CCPG adapts to new scenarios in about 3 seconds with a single forward pass, without target-scenario training or fine-tuning, and achieves cross-domain recovery performance comparable to costly online adaptation. These results demonstrate that CCPG enables efficient deployment of CSI models in large-scale dynamic wireless scenarios for intelligent 6G communications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Channel Conditional Parameter Generation (CCPG)，一种面向动态无线环境的CSI模型快速部署端到端流水线。CCPG通过组件冻结实验识别场景敏感适应瓶颈，仅生成轻量LoRA权重而非完整模型参数；利用级联SVD和Perceiver Resampler将高维信道特征压缩为紧凑潜在条件；设计基于能量的规范化机制解决LoRA权重的排列与符号歧义，并采用扩散生成器结合结构信息与非对称尺寸感知损失实现拓扑感知参数生成。在DeepMIMO和WAIR-D数据集上的CSI反馈与信道估计实验表明，CCPG可在约3秒内通过单次前向传播完成新场景适应，无需目标场景训练或微调，跨域恢复性能与昂贵的在线自适应方法相当。
AI.motivation: 深度学习的Massive MIMO物理层任务（如CSI反馈与信道估计）模型在环境异构性下性能严重退化，传统自适应方法需要目标域数据和大量计算，无法满足动态无线场景的快速部署需求。
AI.method: (1) 通过组件冻结实验识别场景敏感瓶颈，仅生成LoRA权重； (2) 级联SVD+Perceiver Resampler压缩高维信道特征为潜在条件； (3) 能量规范化机制消除LoRA权重的排列和符号歧义； (4) 扩散生成器结合结构信息与非对称尺寸感知损失进行拓扑感知参数生成。
AI.result: 在DeepMIMO和WAIR-D数据集上，CCPG可在约3秒内通过单次前向传播完成新场景适应，无需目标场景训练或微调，跨域恢复性能与昂贵的在线自适应方法相当。
AI.conclusion: CCPG实现了大规模动态无线场景中CSI模型的高效部署，为智能6G通信提供了可行的解决方案。

title: When Less Is More: A Controlled Benchmark of Lightweight CNNs for Satellite Land-Cover Segmentation on DeepGlobe
summary: High-resolution satellite imagery is the backbone of good land-cover classification, and without that, environmental monitoring, urban planning, and sustainable resource management all fall short. Deep learning architectures perform well in semantic segmentation, but the efficiency-accuracy trade-off across classical convolutional encoders is not well quantified under controlled, reproducible conditions. This study compares five architectures VGG16, MobileNetV2, InceptionV3, AlexNet, and CNN on the DeepGlobe Land Cover Classification dataset using three progressively optimized iterations to isolate regularisation, transfer learning, and architectural depth. To ensure performance differentials reflect architectural properties, all experiments used identical preprocessing, hyperparameter, and training protocols without data augmentation or class-imbalance correction. At 24.98 MB, MobileNetV2_v1 had the highest overall accuracy (0.7906) and mean Intersection over Union (0.4625), outperforming deeper alternatives like InceptionV3_v2 (125.17 MB, accuracy 0.7610) and VGG16_v2 (71.13 MB, accuracy 0.7653). Class-wise analysis showed strength in urban, agricultural, and water categories, but rangeland-barren confusion showed that architectural optimization alone cannot optimize spectrally similar minority classes. Strong spatial generalization and crisp boundary delineation were confirmed on held-out test imagery, validating operational applicability. These results show that lightweight, transfer-learned models can match or outperform deeper models in resource-constrained remote-sensing environments, enabling scalable land-cover mapping.

AI.tldr: 本研究在DeepGlobe土地覆盖分类数据集上，在严格的受控条件下系统比较了VGG16、MobileNetV2、InceptionV3、AlexNet和CNN五种架构，通过三次逐步优化迭代来隔离正则化、迁移学习和架构深度的影响。MobileNetV2_v1以24.98 MB的最小模型体积取得了最高总体准确率（0.7906）和平均IoU（0.4625），优于更深的替代方案。轻量级迁移学习模型能够在资源受限的遥感环境中匹配或超越深层模型。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率卫星影像对于土地覆盖分类至关重要，但深度学习架构在语义分割中的效率-准确率权衡尚未在受控、可重复的条件下得到充分量化。现有研究缺乏对经典卷积编码器在统一实验框架下的公平比较。
AI.method: 比较五种架构（VGG16、MobileNetV2、InceptionV3、AlexNet、CNN），通过三次渐进优化迭代分离正则化、迁移学习和架构深度的影响。所有实验使用相同的预处理、超参数和训练协议，不使用数据增强或类别不平衡校正，以确保性能差异反映架构属性。
AI.result: MobileNetV2_v1以24.98 MB的最小体积取得最高总体准确率（0.7906）和平均IoU（0.4625），优于InceptionV3_v2（125.17 MB, 准确率0.7610）和VGG16_v2（71.13 MB, 准确率0.7653）。城市、农业和水体类别表现优异，但牧场-裸地混淆表明架构优化无法单独解决光谱相似的少数类别。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级、迁移学习的模型可以在资源受限的遥感环境中匹配或超越深层模型，实现可扩展的土地覆盖制图。架构优化对光谱相似的少数类别效果有限，需要额外的数据处理策略。

title: BioSentinel at EXIST 2026: Soft-Label Optimization with XLM-RoBERTa for Sexism Intent Classification in Memes
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Accepted for publication in the CLEF 2026 Working Notes (EXIST 2026), Jena, Germany
summary: This paper describes the BioSentinel team's participation in EXIST 2026 Task 2.2: Source Intention in Memes, part of the CLEF 2026 evaluation campaign. The task requires classifying the communicative intent behind memes as direct, judgemental, or no (non-sexist), under a Learning with Disagreement (Le-Wi-Di) paradigm that mandates both hard-label and soft-label (probability distribution) predictions. We present a text-centric approach built on xlm-roberta-base (270M parameters) trained with a composite loss function combining KL divergence on soft annotator distributions and weighted cross-entropy on hard labels. On the official test set, the system achieved an ICM-Soft-Norm of 0.3229 and ICM-Norm of 0.3778, with a hard F1-score of 0.4236, ranking 40th (out of 118 submissions) in the soft-soft evaluation and 49th (out of 187 submissions) in the hard-hard evaluation. We provide an analysis of the dataset characteristics, exploratory larger-architecture runs, and the role of annotator disagreement in shaping model design for subjective NLP tasks. Ablation results show that KL loss improves soft-label metrics, while CE loss improves hard-label accuracy. We also report a separate validation-set temperature analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍BioSentinel团队参与EXIST 2026任务2.2：基于xlm-roberta-base模型，结合KL散度与加权交叉熵的复合损失函数，对推文中性别歧视意图进行分类，在软标签评估中排名第40位（共118个提交），硬标签评估中排名第49位（共187个提交）。
AI.motivation: 应对EXIST 2026中Learning with Disagreement范式下的主观性NLP任务，既要输出硬标签也要输出软标签（概率分布），并探究标注者分歧对模型设计的影响。
AI.method: 采用xlm-roberta-base作为文本编码器，使用复合损失函数：KL散度监督软标签分布 + 加权交叉熵监督硬标签。进行了更大模型架构的探索性实验以及验证集温度分析。
AI.result: ICM-Soft-Norm得分0.3229，ICM-Norm得分0.3778，硬F1为0.4236。软-软评估排名40/118，硬-硬评估排名49/187。消融实验表明KL损失提升软标签指标，CE损失提升硬标签准确率。
AI.conclusion: 复合损失函数在主观NLP任务中有效平衡了软标签与硬标签的预测质量，标注者分歧信息有助于模型设计。

title: TRACE: Business Rule-Grounded Reasoning Curriculum for Knowledge-Preserving Parametric Tool Retrieval in Enterprise LLMs
summary: Parametric retrieval enables LLMs to retrieve tools implicitly by assigning each API a unique virtual token and training the model to generate it via constrained beam search. Toolsense shows that this regime has two critical drawbacks: it destroys parametric tool knowledge during training, and its beam-search decoding is too slow for real-time deployment. We introduce TRACE (Tool Retrieval via Augmented Chain-of-thought and Enterprise rules), a two-stage curriculum that resolves this dissociation. Stage 1 reuses the multi-format memorization SFT from ToolSense to seed tool knowledge with LoRA. Stage 2 is our core contribution: the model is trained to emit a thinking trace before producing a JSON list of tool tokens, using two data sources -- RRB pairs from ToolSense and queries synthesized to target business rules curated by domain experts -- both augmented with reasoning traces. This training objective preserves Stage 1 MCQ and QA probing accuracy while enabling single-beam greedy decoding at production latency. Evaluated on a combined enterprise catalog of 8,300+ tools across two enterprise product lines, TRACE training for Stage 2 not only preserves but improves tool understanding: MCQ accuracy gains +3.2 pp and QA probing gains +9 pp over Stage 1. On retrieval, TRACE achieves ~86% recall on Domain A and ~60% on Domain B -- compared to embedding baseline performance of ~27% & ~52% -- both with single-beam greedy decoding, making it directly deployable at production latency.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个两阶段课程学习方法，通过思维链和业务规则增强的虚拟token检索范式，解决了参数化工具检索中工具知识破坏和束搜索解码速度慢的问题，在8300+企业工具集上实现约86%和60%的召回率，同时保持单波束贪心解码的生产级延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有参数化检索方法（如ToolSense）存在两个关键缺陷：训练过程中破坏参数化工具知识，以及束搜索解码速度过慢无法满足实时部署需求。作者希望解决这种"解离"问题。
AI.method: 提出TRACE两阶段课程：阶段1复用ToolSense的多格式记忆SFT并用LoRA注入工具知识；阶段2（核心贡献）训练模型在输出工具token的JSON列表前先产生思考轨迹（thinking trace），数据来源包括ToolSense的RRB对和领域专家策划的业务规则查询，两者均增强推理轨迹。训练目标保留阶段1的MCQ和QA探测精度，同时支持单波束贪心解码。
AI.result: 在两个企业产品线的8300+工具目录上评估：阶段2相比阶段1，MCQ准确率提升3.2个百分点，QA探测提升9个百分点；检索召回率在Domain A达约86%，Domain B达约60%，远高于嵌入基线（约27%和52%），且使用单波束贪心解码达到生产延迟要求。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过思维链增强的课程学习有效解决了参数化工具检索中的知识破坏与解码效率问题，在保持甚至提升工具理解能力的同时实现了生产级部署的检索速度。

title: Structured Redundancy Modeling for Efficient Visual Token Pruning in High-Resolution MLLMs
summary: Recent high-resolution Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) generate thousands of visual tokens per input, leading to a visual token explosion that introduces severe latency bottlenecks. While token pruning mitigates this issue, state-of-the-art subset-optimization methods typically rely on iterative subset construction to jointly capture visual diversity and instruction relevance. As visual token counts scale, this sequential dependency introduces significant selection overhead, severely limiting the translation of theoretical FLOPs reductions into actual wall-clock speedups. To address this limitation, we propose Single-Forward Pruner (SFPruner), a structural reformulation of visual token pruning that embeds redundancy control directly into the scoring space, bypassing the need for iterative combinatorial optimization. Our non-iterative framework achieves redundancy-aware importance selection in a single forward pass through two complementary mechanisms. First, to attenuate redundancy at the covariance level, we introduce a semantics-guided ridge leverage scheme. By integrating instruction relevance and visual saliency, this mechanism suppresses dominant covariance directions and mitigates representation bias. Second, ranking-based directional masking resolves residual overlap through asymmetric similarity competition, where higher-scoring tokens explicitly suppress redundant lower-scoring alternatives via parallel tensor operations. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach maintains stable selection costs, reducing the token selection process by up to 110 ms, from 112.4 ms to just 2.5 ms at 512 tokens in Qwen2.5-VL. This structural efficiency successfully translates theoretical token reductions into tangible inference speedups while preserving highly competitive performance against state-of-the-art techniques under aggressive compression.

AI.tldr: 提出Single-Forward Pruner (SFPruner)，一种非迭代式视觉token剪枝框架，通过语义引导的岭杠杆机制和排序定向掩码，在单次前向传播中完成冗余感知的重要性选择，消除了迭代子集构建带来的选择延迟瓶颈，将512 token的选择时间从112.4ms降至2.5ms。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率多模态大语言模型产生大量视觉token，导致严重的延迟瓶颈。现有基于子集优化的剪枝方法依赖迭代式子集构建，随着token数量增加，这种顺序依赖性带来了显著的选择开销，限制了理论FLOPs缩减向实际加速的转化。
AI.method: SFPruner是一个非迭代式视觉token剪枝框架，通过两种互补机制实现冗余感知的重要性选择：(1) 语义引导的岭杠杆机制，在协方差层面融合指令相关性和视觉显著性，抑制主导协方差方向并缓解表征偏差；(2) 排序定向掩码，通过非对称相似性竞争，使高分token通过并行张量运算显式抑制冗余的低分候选token。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL上，512 token的选择时间从112.4ms降至2.5ms（降低110ms），在保持与最先进方法相当性能的同时，实现了token缩减向实际推理加速的成功转化。
AI.conclusion: SFPruner通过结构性的非迭代设计解决了视觉token剪枝中的选择延迟瓶颈，在保持竞争性能的前提下将理论上的计算缩减转化为实际的墙钟时间加速，为高分辨率MLLM的高效推理提供了可行方案。

title: Looking for Affect in Spontaneous Finnish Speech through Linguistic Interpretability
comment: Accepted for publication at Interspeech 2026, Sydney, Australia
summary: Existing research on affect in speech has shown how acoustic surface characteristics and content-related linguistic aspects of speech both relate to perceived emotional arousal and valence. However, it is not clear what the relative contributions of these two factors are in the perceptual process. This is especially true for Finnish, for which most existing studies focus on either acoustic-phonetic or text analysis. This paper presents a study where we systematically explore the combinatory role of text- and audio-based features in modeling the human perception of valence and arousal using a newly released affective speech corpus for spontaneous Finnish. We show that the combination of text- and audio-based features improves valence regression results over the individual modalities, whereas for arousal regression the complementary effect is not substantial. The results support prior findings from other languages, providing new data and knowledge on spontaneous Finnish speech.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合文本和音频特征，系统研究了它们在建模芬兰语自发言语中人类对情感效价和唤醒度感知的互补作用。结果显示，文本与音频特征结合能显著提升效价回归效果，但对唤醒度提升不显著。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽已分别从声学表面特征和内容相关语言特征探讨了言语情感感知，但两者在感知过程中的相对贡献尚不明确，尤其是针对芬兰语的研究多集中于单一模态分析，缺乏多模态结合的系统探索。
AI.method: 使用新发布的芬兰语自发性情感语音语料库，系统对比文本特征、音频特征及其组合在建模人类对效价和唤醒度感知中的表现，通过回归任务评估各模态的贡献。
AI.result: 文本与音频特征结合在效价回归任务中优于单模态结果，而在唤醒度回归中模态互补效果不显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持了来自其他语言的已有发现，并为芬兰语自发言语提供了新的数据和知识，表明模态融合对效价感知更为关键，而对唤醒度感知的提升有限。

title: CRAFT: Learn the Schema, Execute the Plan
summary: Enterprise coding agents translate natural-language analytical requests into executable code over proprietary APIs, schemas, and metric definitions. Yet the prevailing deployment pattern injecting exhaustive schema and tool documentation into each prompt increases inference overhead, complicates schema evolution, and undermines reliability in multi-turn analysis. We investigate whether stable schema knowledge and tool-use behavior can instead be acquired through post-training while preserving the consistency required for production-facing analytics. We present CRAFT, a two-stage post-training recipe for schema-grounded coding agents. First, schema-stripped PLAN supervised fine-tuning learns domain-structured plans and executable behaviors from validated trajectories without exhaustive prompt-time schema injection. Second, execution-shaped reinforcement learning aligns the policy for tool selection, code quality, plan-code consistency, and recovery from failed executions. Training trajectories are curated through a Tri-Gate filter combining execution validation, data-integrity checks, and LLM-judge reasoning audit. We evaluate CRAFT for planned rollout in advertising analytics, covering campaign performance analysis, metric drill-downs, entity-level performance analysis, and multi-turn analytical refinement. The enterprise evaluation environment incorporates beta APIs as the agent-facing tool surface and spans 25 schema-linked core entities and 30 agentic workflows. Relative to a schema-stuffed baseline, CRAFT improves composite Agent Score by +9.6 pp, consistency by +4.1 pp, and multi-turn coherence by +4.2 pp, while reducing input-token burden by approximately 9x and schema-discovery loops by up to 5x. We further report deployment tradeoffs, reward-shaping limitations, and training-infrastructure extensions required for multi-turn tool-use reinforcement learning in enterprise settings.

AI.tldr: CRAFT是一种两阶段后训练方法，用于构建模式接地编码代理，在不依赖提示中注入完整模式文档的情况下，通过规划监督微调和执行形强化学习，在广告分析场景中将Agent Score提升9.6个百分点，一致性提升4.1个百分点，多轮连贯性提升4.2个百分点，同时减少约9倍的输入令牌负担和最多5倍的模式发现循环。
AI.motivation: 现有企业编码代理在每次提示中注入详尽的模式与工具文档，导致推理开销增加、模式演变更复杂、多轮分析可靠性下降。亟需一种能通过后训练获取稳定的模式知识与工具使用行为、同时保持生产级分析一致性的方法。
AI.method: 提出CRAFT两阶段后训练：第一阶段为去掉模式的PLAN监督微调，从已验证轨迹中学习领域结构化计划与可执行行为，无需提示时注入模式；第二阶段为执行形强化学习，对齐工具选择、代码质量、计划-代码一致性与执行失败恢复策略。训练轨迹通过三闸过滤器（执行验证、数据完整性检查、LLM推理审计）筛选。
AI.result: 在广告分析场景（25个核心实体、30个代理工作流）中，相比基线方法，CRAFT将复合Agent Score提升9.6个百分点，一致性提升4.1个百分点，多轮连贯性提升4.2个百分点，输入令牌负担减少约9倍，模式发现循环减少最多5倍。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT验证了企业编码代理可以通过后训练高效获取模式知识与工具使用能力，显著降低推理成本与维护复杂度，同时提升多项关键指标。文章还报告了部署权衡、奖励塑形局限及多轮工具使用强化学习所需的训练基础设施扩展。

title: Similarity Is Not Logic: Factored Inference for Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://sultanmo.github.io/factored-vlm Code and benchmark: https://github.com/SultanMo/factored-vlm
summary: Dual-encoder vision-language models (VLMs) expose a similarity interface that enables zero-shot retrieval but fails compositional constraints: queries like "umbrella and no person" retrieve images containing both, even when concept detection is reliable. We trace this to an interface-level Bag-of-Concepts effect, where similarity scores approximate mean pooling of concept evidence regardless of operators. Although operator-dependent signals exist in text embeddings, they are too weak or misaligned to affect rankings. Fine-tuning does not reliably resolve this failure because the dominant bottleneck is how similarity aggregates evidence rather than what encoders represent. We propose factored inference, which separates evidence extraction from constraint execution, and introduce LCSE (Logic-Constrained Score Editing), a training-free method that executes constraints externally using concept scores from frozen encoders. We also introduce FACTOR-Bench, where LCSE achieves 85.5% accuracy versus 73.2% for the best fine-tuned baseline, 90.7% when applied to SigLIP 2, and improves NegBench COCO MCQ accuracy from 27.2% to 65.2% while preserving retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示双编码器视觉-语言模型在组合约束下存在"概念袋"效应——相似度分数对操作符不敏感，即使概念检测准确也无法正确处理"雨伞且无人"等查询。作者提出训练无关的 LCSE 方法，通过外部执行约束来修正分数，在 FACTOR-Bench 上达 85.5% 准确率，远超最佳微调基线（73.2%），并在 SigLIP 2 上提升至 90.7%。
AI.motivation: 双编码器 VLM 在零样本检索中无法正确处理组合约束（如"雨伞且无人"），即使概念检测本身可靠，相似度分数仍会忽略操作符（AND/NOT），将概念证据平均聚合，导致检索结果不符合逻辑约束。
AI.method: 提出因式分解推理框架，将证据提取与约束执行分离；具体方法 LCSE（逻辑约束分数编辑）是训练无关的，利用冻结编码器的概念分数在外部执行约束，无需重新训练模型。
AI.result: LCSE 在 FACTOR-Bench 上达 85.5% 准确率，最佳微调基线仅 73.2%；应用于 SigLIP 2 提升至 90.7%；在 NegBench COCO MCQ 上将准确率从 27.2% 提升到 65.2%，同时保持检索性能不下降。
AI.conclusion: 双编码器 VLM 组合约束失败的根本瓶颈在于相似度聚合方式而非编码器表示本身，训练无关的因式分解推理方法可有效解决该问题。

title: Where Quality Breaks in Compressed Short-Text Generation: Staged Bottleneck Localization
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Published in the Proceedings of FRUCT'39
summary: Compressed short-text generators can fail in two different places: the codec may discard information before generation starts, or the latent generator may produce weak codes. Without separating these failure modes, researchers can spend compute improving the wrong component. We study this problem in a controlled 64-to-16 TinyStories case study built from a hierarchical VQ-VAE-2 codec and a masked discrete diffusion generator (MDLM). We use a staged validation protocol that separates codec reconstruction fidelity, latent generation quality, and auxiliary latent diagnostics under one shared external GPT-2 scorer, while reporting complementary semantic metrics for the geometry study. In the tested configuration, codec reconstruction alone raises median external perplexity from 15.17 to 27.36 (+80.4%) and p95 from 25.10 to 98.91 (+294.1%), showing that the dominant quality loss appears before latent generation begins. Under the same scorer, code-space MDLM remains materially stronger than token-space diffusion, reducing mean, median, and p95 by 32.9%, 30.9%, and 36.6%, respectively. Geometry-aware regularization improves local latent proxies but does not improve decoded-text metrics in the available runs. The contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic: the paper presents a reusable staged diagnosis for one concrete pipeline and shows that, in this setting, codec fidelity rather than latent denoising sets the practical quality ceiling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分层VQ-VAE-2编解码器和掩码离散扩散生成器（MDLM）的64-to-16 TinyStories案例研究，提出了一种分阶段验证协议来分离短文本压缩生成中的编解码器重建损失和潜在生成损失。结果表明，在该配置下，编解码器重建是主要质量瓶颈（外部困惑度上升80.4%），而潜在生成器的改进（代码空间MDLM优于词元空间扩散）无法突破这一上限。
AI.motivation: 压缩短文本生成器可能在编解码器（生成前丢弃信息）或潜在生成器（生成弱代码）两个环节失效。若不分离这两种失败模式，研究者可能将算力浪费在改进错误的组件上。本文旨在建立一种可复用的诊断方法来定位真正瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建64-to-16 TinyStories案例研究，使用分层VQ-VAE-2编解码器+掩码离散扩散生成器（MDLM）。设计分阶段验证协议：在共享GPT-2评估器下分别测量编解码器重建保真度、潜在生成质量和辅助潜在诊断指标，并辅以语义指标进行几何分析。
AI.result: 编解码器重建导致外部困惑度中位数从15.17升至27.36（+80.4%），p95从25.10升至98.91（+294.1%）。代码空间MDLM在均值、中位数和p95上比词元空间扩散分别低32.9%、30.9%和36.6%。几何感知正则化改善了局部潜在代理指标但未提升解码文本指标。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献是方法论而非算法性的：提出了一种可复用的分阶段诊断流程，在该具体场景下证明编解码器保真度而非潜在去噪过程决定了实际质量上限。

title: Reason Before You Retrieve: Agentic Planning for Multi-modal RAG
summary: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (mRAG) aims to answer image-text queries with external knowledge, but most existing systems still retrieve directly from raw multimodal input over a flat evidence space. This design often struggles with two key challenges: the retrieval target is under-specified because the question intent must be grounded to the correct visual referent, and the search space is weakly structured, forcing semantically distinct evidence to compete in a single global ranking step. We propose MM-R2, a multimodal agentic retrieval framework that reasons before retrieval by explicitly modeling both what to retrieve and where to search. MM-R2 first constructs an intent-grounded retrieval state from the image-question pair, capturing the information need, grounded referent, and retrieval constraints. It then performs retrieval over a structured KnowledgeMap, where the agent selects relevant retrieval units before issuing grounded queries within them. To enable this capability, we build MM-R2-Traj, a large-scale trajectory dataset of multi-step retrieval processes, and adopt a two-stage post-training strategy with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO. Experiments on Infoseek and Encyclopedic VQA datasets show that MM-R2 substantially outperforms strong baselines on answer accuracy while also yielding more interpretable and verifiable retrieval trajectories.

AI.tldr: MM-R2提出了一种多模态智能体检索框架，在检索前通过显式建模检索意图和搜索空间来改进多模态检索增强生成，在Infoseek和Encyclopedic VQA数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有mRAG系统直接从原始多模态输入在扁平证据空间中进行检索，面临两个关键挑战：检索目标不明确（问题意图需对应到正确视觉指代物）以及搜索空间缺乏结构化（语义不同的证据在同一全局排序步骤中竞争）。
AI.method: 提出MM-R2框架：1) 从图像-问题对构建意图接地的检索状态，包含信息需求、接地指代物和检索约束；2) 在结构化的KnowledgeMap上进行检索，智能体先选择相关检索单元再在其中执行接地查询。同时构建MM-R2-Traj大规模多步检索轨迹数据集，采用SFT+GRPO的两阶段后训练策略。
AI.result: 在Infoseek和Encyclopedic VQA数据集上，MM-R2在答案准确率上大幅超越强基线方法，同时生成更可解释和可验证的检索轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 通过在检索前进行推理并结构化搜索空间，MM-R2有效解决了mRAG中检索目标不明确和搜索空间弱结构化的问题，提升了检索准确性和可解释性。

title: DishSeg24k: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Food Segmentation with Stochastic Expert Decoding
summary: Food segmentation is essential for applications such as intelligent catering, dietary assessment, and recommendation. However, existing benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of real-world dining scenes. The challenges of dense inter-dish overlap, fine-grained class similarity, and extreme long-tail class distributions exceed the fidelity of current datasets. To fill this gap, we introduce \textbf{DishSeg24k}, a large-scale dish-level segmentation benchmark with 24,096 images, 112,281 instances, and 278 fine-grained categories in real-world dining environments. Based on DishSeg24k, we further propose \textbf{Food Expert-Adaptive Segmentation Transformers (FEAST)} to address these challenges. FEAST models query-based decoding as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), where each decoder layer update is treated as a sequential decision step that explores uncertainty along dish boundaries. We further redesign the decoder with a reinforcement learning (RL)-guided Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) module, in which a dual-critic decoupled optimization scheme separates task-oriented query refinement from structure-aware expert routing. This design promotes expert specialization and prevents expert collapse under long-tail category distributions. Finally, extensive experiments on DishSeg24k demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of FEAST, which outperforms previous methods by {+3.21\%} mIoU, {+3.68\%} mDice, and {+4.00\%} mAcc, respectively. We further validate the effectiveness of FEAST on FoodSeg103. The dataset and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了DishSeg24k——一个包含24,096张图像、112,281个实例和278个细粒度类别的大规模菜肴分割基准数据集，并基于此提出了FEAST模型，该模型将查询解码建模为马尔可夫决策过程，结合强化学习引导的混合专家模块和双评论家解耦优化方案，在菜肴分割任务上实现了SOTA性能（mIoU提升+3.21%，mDice提升+3.68%，mAcc提升+4.00%）。
AI.motivation: 现有食物分割基准无法捕捉真实用餐场景的复杂性，密集的菜肴间重叠、细粒度类别相似性及极端长尾类别分布等挑战超出了当前数据集的能力范围，因此需要构建更真实的大规模菜肴分割基准并提出相应方法解决这些问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建DishSeg24k基准数据集；2) 提出FEAST模型，将基于查询的解码过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），每个解码器层更新视为沿菜肴边界探索不确定性的顺序决策步骤；3) 重新设计解码器，引入强化学习引导的混合专家（MoE）模块；4) 提出双评论家解耦优化方案，将任务导向的查询细化和结构感知的专家路由分离，促进专家专业化并防止长尾类别分布下的专家坍塌。
AI.result: 在DishSeg24k上，FEAST相比先前方法在mIoU、mDice和mAcc上分别提升+3.21%、+3.68%和+4.00%；在FoodSeg103上也验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: DishSeg24k填补了真实用餐场景下菜肴级别分割基准的空白，FEAST通过MDP建模和RL引导的MoE有效解决了密集重叠、细粒度相似性和长尾分布等挑战，取得了最优性能。

title: StanceFlip: A Comprehensive Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Multimodal Conversational Stance Flipping Forecasting
summary: Conversational stance detection has shifted from static text analysis to dynamic multimodal modeling. However, existing benchmarks exhibit three key limitations: failure to capture the dynamic evolution of beliefs, particularly during stance reversals; difficulty in disentangling affective states from logical reasoning; and neglect of the critical role of multimodal cues in resolving pragmatic ambiguities such as sarcasm. To address these limitations, we propose StanceFlip, a benchmark designed for multimodal conversational stance flipping forecasting over multi-turn dialogues across five modalities and multi-scenarios, which includes two novel subtasks: 1) Multimodal Stance Sextuple Extraction, extracting holder, target, emotion, sentiment, stance, and rationale as static state snapshots of dialogue to capture fine-grained cognitive structures. 2) Dynamic Stance Flip Attribution, tracking stance reversals across the conversation and identifying their underlying triggers. Alongside the dataset, we propose a dedicated framework, named ConStaFF, for Multimodal Conversational Stance Flipping Forecasting (MCSFF). Built upon a large language model, ConStaFF performs end-to-end stance reasoning, with a Thought-of-Stance (ToS) reasoning framework and a self-reflective verification mechanism integrated for structured stance modeling and faithful flip attribution. Specifically, ToS decomposes the reasoning process into specialized cognitive personas to formulate target propositions, resolve cross-modal conflicts, and infer historical stance trajectories. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on both sextuple extraction and flip-trigger attribution, outperforming strong multimodal large language model baselines by substantial margins.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StanceFlip基准数据集和ConStaFF框架，用于多模态对话中的立场翻转预测（MCSFF），包含立场六元组提取和动态立场翻转归因两个子任务，通过Thought-of-Stance推理机制和自我反思验证实现结构化立场建模，在多项基准测试中达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有对话立场检测基准存在三个关键局限：无法捕捉信念的动态演变（特别是立场反转）、难以区分情感状态与逻辑推理、忽视多模态线索在解决语用歧义（如讽刺）中的关键作用。
AI.method: 提出StanceFlip基准（五模态、多场景）；定义两个子任务：多模态立场六元组提取（持有者、目标、情感、情绪、立场、理由）和动态立场翻转归因；提出ConStaFF框架，基于大语言模型，包含Thought-of-Stance推理机制（分解为专门认知角色以制定目标命题、解决跨模态冲突、推断历史立场轨迹）和自我反思验证机制。
AI.result: ConStaFF在六元组提取和翻转触发归因两个任务上均达到最先进性能，大幅超越强多模态大语言模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入结构化立场建模和动态翻转归因，该工作有效弥补了现有基准在多模态对话立场预测中的不足，为立场动态演化分析提供了新范式。

title: DocHRL: A Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Framework for Cost-Optimised Document Classification
summary: Real-world document classification pipelines typically apply the same sequence of models to every incoming document, regardless of its complexity or type. This leads to inefficient use of compute and human resources: simple documents are over-processed while difficult ones may not receive enough scrutiny. We introduce DocHRL, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that learns to adaptively and dynamically select the most cost-effective classification policy on a per-document basis. DocHRL formulates document classification as a sequential decision problem with a two-level policy hierarchy: a top-level policy selects among broad options (vision classifiers, LLMs, OCR, and human-in-the-loop review), while option-specific sub-policies choose the concrete model or tool to invoke. The reward signal is the negative total expected cost, which captures inference cost, cost of misclassification, and cost of human labelling. Trained with Proximal Policy Optimisation on the RVL-CDIP benchmark, DocHRL achieves a macro F1 of 0.973 across 16 document classes while reducing average per-document cost to 2.74 normalised units compared to substantially higher costs incurred by fixed standalone classifiers. Our results demonstrate that cost-aware reinforcement learning can simultaneously improve classification performance and operational efficiency in document understanding systems.

AI.tldr: DocHRL提出了一种分层强化学习框架，能够为每个文档自适应地动态选择最具成本效益的分类策略，在RVL-CDIP基准上达到0.973宏F1，同时将平均每文档成本降至2.74标准化单位。
AI.motivation: 真实文档分类管线对所有文档使用相同的模型序列，导致简单文档被过度处理而复杂文档可能未得到充分审核，造成计算和人力资源的低效利用。
AI.method: 将文档分类建模为序贯决策问题，采用双层策略层次结构：顶层策略选择宏观选项（视觉分类器、LLM、OCR、人工审核），子策略选择具体的模型或工具。奖励信号为负总期望成本（包含推理成本、误分类成本和人工标注成本），使用PPO算法训练。
AI.result: 在RVL-CDIP基准上，跨16个文档类别达到0.973宏F1，每文档平均成本仅2.74标准化单位，远低于固定独立分类器。
AI.conclusion: 成本感知的强化学习能够在文档理解系统中同时提升分类性能与运营效率。

title: Inverse Bayesian Inference for Extracting Lesion Dynamics from Longitudinal Spectral CT
summary:
Longitudinal medical imaging captures temporal evolution of lesions, yet extracting the underlying dynamical parameters governing this evolution remains challenging. We propose an inverse Bayesian framework for inferring lesion dynamics from longitudinal spectral CT. We decompose spectral feature ($x$) evolution into three components: \begin{equation*}
  \frac{dx_i}{dt} = A_i x_i + B \cdot n + C \cdot Δx_{\text{sat}} \end{equation*} where $A_i$ captures intrinsic dynamics (lesion-autonomous evolution), $B$ captures local environment tumour burden (organ tumour burden through satellite count coupling), and $C$ captures environment/satellite state change (i.e., whether surrounding lesions move similarly or not).
  We demonstrate the framework on photon-counting NSCLC CT data from metastases, recovering distinct dynamical regimes: lung lesions exhibit significant satellite count coupling ($B=-0.34$, $p<0.05$) suggesting competitive dynamics, while liver lesions show synergistic satellite behaviour coupling ($C\approx+1.0$, $p<0.05$). Synthetic validation confirms parameter recovery, and cross-coupling analysis validates that our method detects non-zero coupling when present.
  This work establishes inverse dynamical inference as a principled methodology for extracting interpretable parameters from longitudinal imaging, moving beyond static feature extraction toward mechanistic characterisation of lesion behaviour. The code and data are available at: https://github.com/lukasf98/inverse-bayesian-inference

AI.tldr: 提出一种逆贝叶斯框架，从纵向能谱CT中推断病灶动力学参数。将病灶特征演化分解为内在动力学、局部肿瘤负荷耦合和环境状态耦合三个成分，并在NSCLC数据中验证了不同器官的差异性动力学模式。
AI.motivation: 纵向医学影像虽能捕获病灶的时间演化，但从中提取控制演化的底层动力学参数仍然困难。现有方法多停留在静态特征提取，缺乏对病灶行为机制的定量刻画。
AI.method: 提出逆贝叶斯推断框架，将光谱特征演化建模为三个成分：内在动力学项(A)、局部肿瘤负荷耦合项(B，通过卫星病灶计数)和环境状态耦合项(C)。在光子计数NSCLC CT转移灶数据上验证，并通过合成数据验证参数恢复能力。
AI.result: 肺部病灶表现出显著的卫星计数耦合(B=-0.34, p<0.05)，提示竞争性动力学；肝脏病灶表现出协同性卫星行为耦合(C≈+1.0, p<0.05)。交叉耦合分析验证了该方法能检测到非零耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了逆动力学推断作为从纵向影像中提取可解释参数的原则性方法，推动从静态特征提取向病灶行为机制表征的转变。

title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
summary: Relevance is a query-dependent estimate of whether a document or excerpt contains useful evidence. Existing retrieval agents use relevance to select top-$k$ content, but document relevance alone cannot localize, compose, or verify the evidence required by complex questions. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) enables such fine-grained operations through grep-style exploration, but its relevance-agnostic search can expose useful clues late and delay convergence. Recent advances use relevance to narrow the corpus into a working space for interaction. Once interaction begins, however, relevance still does not directly guide which documents grep searches first or distinguish informative excerpts from a broad set of matches to let LLMs see them first. We introduce the Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent (RARG), which turns relevance into an execution prior for corpus interaction. RARG provides coarse-to-fine relevance guidance: it orders documents for sequential 'ripgrep' traversal to expose globally relevant clues earlier, initializes promising entry points with query-relevant paragraphs, and reranks grep matches to surface informative excerpts that document-level ranking may otherwise obscure. Across challenging browse question answering and reasoning-intensive retrieval, RARG improves the accuracy--efficiency frontier over retrieval-based and direct-interaction agents. These results demonstrate that relevance-aware interaction enables faster and more reliable search convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RARG（Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent），通过将相关性转化为语料库交互的执行先验，在文档排序、入口点初始化和grep匹配重排序三个阶段提供从粗到细的相关性引导，显著提升了复杂问答和推理密集型检索的准确率与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有检索代理仅依赖文档级相关性选择top-k内容，但文档相关性无法定位、组合或验证复杂问题所需的证据；直接语料库交互（DCI）虽支持细粒度操作，但其忽略相关性的搜索方式导致有用线索暴露较晚，收敛速度慢。
AI.method: RARG将相关性作为语料库交互的执行先验，通过三步粗到细的相关性引导：1）按相关性排序文档以优先遍历全局相关线索；2）用查询相关段落初始化有前景的入口点；3）对grep匹配结果重排序，优先展示文档级排名可能掩盖的信息性摘录。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的浏览问答和推理密集型检索任务中，RARG在准确率-效率前沿上优于基于检索和直接交互的基线代理。
AI.conclusion: 相关性感知的交互能够实现更快、更可靠的搜索收敛，表明将相关性融入语料库交互过程对复杂信息检索任务具有显著价值。

title: Extracting Algorithms in Pre-trained LLMs: A Case on Hidden Markov Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) display a striking ability to predict next observations from Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) via in-context learning (ICL), but the algorithm underlying this capability remains undetermined: prior work has proposed several candidates without consensus, and none has been grounded in the model's internal activations. We close this gap with a three-stage pipeline. First, we empirically compare LLM behavior against a suite of candidate algorithms and narrow the space to three classes -- though no single class explains LLM behavior across all HMM settings and sequence lengths. Second, we derive theoretical connections between the three classes and show how each can be implemented in-context by a Transformer, validating the construction in a small trained Transformer. Third, returning to pre-trained LLMs, we introduce the Principal Activations Probe (PAP), a layer-wise probing and intervention method that isolates algorithmic signals in model activations. PAP reveals low-dimensional linear representations that causally drive model predictions and track empirical ICL performance. PAP further reveals how these representations shift with properties of the underlying HMM regime; distinct computational stages are localized to different layers. Together, our results connect the in-context behavior of pre-trained LLMs to the underlying internal mechanisms and advance our understanding of how LLMs perform ICL on HMMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三阶段流水线，通过候选算法比较、理论推导和激活探测方法（PAP），揭示了预训练LLM在HMM上执行上下文学习时的内部算法机制：三种算法类别在不同设定下解释模型行为，且存在低维线性表征驱动预测，计算阶段在层间分布。
AI.motivation: LLM能从隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）通过上下文学习（ICL）预测下一个观测值，但其内部算法尚不明确——已有多个候选算法但无共识，且未与模型内部激活建立联系。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：(1) 将LLM行为与候选算法进行经验比较，将候选空间缩小至三类；(2) 推导三类算法间的理论联系，并验证Transformer可自注意力实现这些算法；(3) 引入主成分激活探针（PAP），进行逐层探测和干预以隔离算法信号。
AI.result: 三类算法各自在某些HMM设定和序列长度下可解释LLM行为；PAP揭示出低维线性表征因果驱动模型预测且与ICL性能相关；这些表征随HMM参数变化，不同计算阶段定位于不同层。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练LLM在HMM上的上下文学习行为与内部机制联系起来，推进了对ICL工作原理的理解。

title: SHReg: Strictly Rotation-Equivariant Point Cloud Registration via Spherical Harmonics
summary: Point cloud registration critically depends on local features that are both distinctive and robust to arbitrary 3D rotations. Existing learning-based methods typically approximate rotation invariance via fragile local reference frames or extensive data augmentation, providing only empirical invariance and often degrading under unseen rotational transformations. In this paper, we propose SHReg, a strictly rotation-equivariant point cloud registration framework grounded in the representation theory of $SO(3)$. By representing local geometric features as irreducible representations of $SO(3)$, SHReg guarantees exact equivariance under arbitrary rotations without relying on local reference frames. Built upon a spherical-harmonics-based equivariant backbone, SHReg jointly learns rotation-invariant descriptors for robust correspondence matching and rotation-equivariant features that preserve fine-grained orientation information. The preserved equivariant structure enables each correspondence to directly hypothesize a rigid transformation, reducing reliance on large-scale hypothesis sampling in conventional RANSAC-based pipelines and leading to improved robustness under challenging rotational variations. Extensive experiments on 3DMatch, 3DLoMatch, and KITTI demonstrate that SHReg consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in registration accuracy, particularly under large rotational perturbations.

AI.tldr: SHReg提出了一种基于SO(3)表示论的严格旋转等变点云配准框架，通过球谐函数实现局部特征的精确旋转等变性，无需局部参考系或数据增强，在多个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的配准精度。
AI.motivation: 现有学习-based点云配准方法依赖于局部参考系或数据增强来近似旋转不变性，仅能提供经验性的不变性，在未见过的旋转变换下性能显著下降，缺乏严格的旋转等变性保证。
AI.method: 基于SO(3)表示论，将局部几何特征表示为SO(3)的不可约表示，构建基于球谐函数的等变骨干网络，联合学习旋转不变描述子（用于鲁棒的对应匹配）和旋转等变特征（保留细粒度的方向信息），使每个对应点可直接假设刚体变换，减少对RANSAC大量假设采样的依赖。
AI.result: 在3DMatch、3DLoMatch和KITTI数据集上，SHReg在配准精度上持续优于现有最先进方法，尤其是在大旋转扰动场景下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 严格旋转等变框架可有效提升点云配准在任意旋转下的鲁棒性和精度，且通过等变特征保留的方向信息可简化变换假设过程，降低对传统RANSAC后处理的依赖。

title: CAGE: Cognitive Attribution Graphs for Faithful Inline Citation Generation in Long-Form Question Answering
summary: Long-form question answering increasingly relies on retrieved evidence to make LLM outputs verifiable, with inline citations tracing claims to source documents. However, existing systems often attach citations that are topically related but insufficient to support their claims. We identify attribution ambiguity as a structural challenge: end-to-end generation must implicitly resolve combinatorial claim--document assignments, obscuring evidential boundaries and increasing the risk of evidence-boundary overrun, where claims exceed cited support. To address this challenge, we propose CAGE (Cognitive Attribution Graphs for Citation Generation), a two-stage framework that introduces an explicit cognitive attribution map before answer generation. CAGE first trains a plug-and-play Cognitive Map Induction Model to construct answer-centered support subgraphs, aligning each semantic answer unit with supporting documents through explicit relations. A Structured Citation Reasoning Model then realizes these units as sentence-level claims with map-aligned citations. Experiments on ASQA, ELI5, and ExpertQA show that CAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of attribution-space contraction and map-guided citation generation.

AI.tldr: 针对长文本问答中引用归属模糊的问题，提出CAGE两阶段框架，先构建认知归属图再生成带引用的答案，在三个数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有长文本问答系统生成的引用往往在主题上相关但不足以支撑其主张，根本原因在于端到端生成隐式地解决了组合性的主张-文档分配问题，导致证据边界模糊（即"证据边界越界"问题）。
AI.method: 提出CAGE两阶段框架：1) 训练一个即插即用的认知图谱归纳模型(Cognitive Map Induction Model)，构建以答案为中心的支撑子图，将语义答案单元与支撑文档通过显式关系对齐；2) 结构化引用推理模型(Structured Citation Reasoning Model)将这些单元实现为句子级别的主张，并附上与图谱对齐的引用。
AI.result: 在ASQA、ELI5和ExpertQA三个数据集上，CAGE取得了最先进的性能，验证了归属空间收缩和图引导引用生成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入显式的认知归属图作为中间表示，可以有效缓解证据边界越界问题，提升长文本问答中引用的准确性和可验证性。

title: PTStore (Prefix Tensor Store): Distributed Prefix Caching and Replication for High Throughput Inference Serving
summary: Inspired by the design of client caching in Content Delivery Networks (CDNs), PTStore distributes and replicates popular tensors that form reusable KV cache prefixes, which are the main technique used by state of art approaches to accelerate inferences. This reduces the latency of accessing the KV cache and alleviates load imbalance caused by a disproportionately large number of requests on servers containing popular tensors. Furthermore, thanks to decentralization, PTStore allows the expansion of the size of the KV cache for LLM inference by orders of magnitude. As a result, PTStore can execute inferences on long passage Q\&A datasets 5-6 times more efficiently than current baselines, which do not aggregate memory across different nodes and GPUs and therefore require regenerating the KV cache.

AI.tldr: PTStore受CDN客户端缓存启发，通过分布式复制KV缓存中的热门张量（复用前缀），将LLM推理的KV缓存规模扩展数个量级，在长文本问答数据集上比现有基线方案效率提升5-6倍。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理加速方法虽使用可复用KV缓存前缀技术，但存在两大问题：1) 热门张量所在服务器请求过载导致负载不均衡；2) 当前方案未跨不同节点和GPU聚合内存，需反复重新生成KV缓存，无法支持大规模长序列推理。
AI.method: 借鉴CDN客户端缓存设计思想，PTStore将构成可复用KV缓存前缀的热门张量进行分布式分发与复制，通过去中心化架构显著扩展KV缓存容量，缓解热门张量所在服务器的请求压力。
AI.result: 在长文本问答数据集上，PTStore的推理效率比当前基线方案（未聚合跨节点和GPU内存的方案）提升5-6倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过分布式KV缓存复制与去中心化管理，PTStore能有效降低访问延迟、消除负载不均，并实现KV缓存规模的数量级扩展，为长序列LLM推理提供高效支撑。

title: DispatchRAG: Grounding Emergency Dispatch Decisions in Real-World Protocols from Traffic Accident Video
summary: Assessing the severity of a traffic accident scenario is important to decide which emergency service to dispatch. Missing an ambulance dispatch on a pedestrian accident is a fatal issue that can lead to death. Recently, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have been a promising tool for accident reasoning, yet many VLMs are not grounded in real-life accident response protocols, making them not usable in accident severity assessment off-the-shelf. We introduced DispatchRAG, an accident assessor and dispatcher framework grounded in real-life Japanese traffic-accident response protocols, designed to enhance VLMs to generate an appropriate emergency response during an emergency scenario. Utilizing a RAG-based retrieval mechanism to retrieve the most relevant accident protocol and an LLM-powered reasoner to suggest the most proper response. To support evaluation, we introduce Accident Dispatch Dataset, a comprehensive dataset of accident assessment and emergency response according to Japanese accident response protocols adapted from the MM-AU dataset. We validate our framework on the Accident Dispatch Dataset, showing strong performance across various accident scenarios compared to the baseline VLM, pointing toward integration in autonomous vehicles that can automatically report both their own and nearby accidents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DispatchRAG框架，结合RAG检索机制和LLM推理器，基于日本交通事故响应协议，增强视觉语言模型（VLM）在事故严重性评估和应急调度中的能力。同时引入Accident Dispatch Dataset数据集进行验证，实验表明该框架在多种事故场景下优于基线VLM，可集成于自动驾驶车辆实现自动事故报告与调度。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在事故严重性评估中缺乏对真实事故响应协议的 grounding，导致无法直接用于实际应急调度。行人事故中遗漏救护车派遣可能导致致命后果，亟需一种基于真实协议的自动化事故评估与调度框架。
AI.method: 提出DispatchRAG框架，包含两个核心组件：1）基于RAG的检索机制，从事故响应协议库中检索最相关的协议；2）LLM驱动的推理器，根据检索到的协议生成最合适的应急响应。同时构建Accident Dispatch Dataset数据集，基于MM-AU数据集改编并按照日本事故响应协议标注。
AI.result: 在Accident Dispatch Dataset上验证，DispatchRAG在多种事故场景下相比基线VLM表现出更强的性能，能够生成符合真实协议的应急响应。
AI.conclusion: DispatchRAG框架能有效提升VLM在事故严重性评估与应急调度中的实用性，有望集成于自动驾驶车辆，实现自动报告自身及附近事故的应急响应能力。

title: Accuracy Hides How Language Models Fail: Measuring Failure States Under Matched Output Budgets
summary: Language-model benchmarks collapse two distinct measurement questions into a single accuracy score: whether a response reached an evaluable state, and whether its answer was judged correct. We introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separates scorer-independent execution evidence, including termination, answer exposure, parseability, and completion length, from scorer-dependent correctness. Across 2,550 outputs from five fixed Qwen and DeepSeek configurations on MATH and ARC-Challenge, matched 2,048-token limits produce sharply different execution mixtures: 49 of 450 Qwen MATH outputs terminate without a final answer, compared with 5 of 300 DeepSeek MATH outputs and none of the 750 ARC outputs. Among the same 300 DeepSeek MATH question-model pairs, no missing-final length termination is observed at 8,192 tokens. A coverage-audited targeted verification study further shows that candidate-selection and aggregation policies can substantially alter comparative accuracy estimates. These results demonstrate that accuracy conflates execution case mix with verification policy. Evaluations of test-time methods should therefore report pre-intervention execution states, verification coverage, and scorer provenance alongside accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文指出语言模型基准测试将“是否可评估”和“是否回答正确”两个不同问题混为一个准确率分数，提出两层次评估框架分离执行证据（终止、答案暴露、可解析性、完成长度）与正确性判断。在Qwen和DeepSeek配置的2550个输出上，2048令牌限制下执行状态分布差异显著，而准确率混淆了执行案例混合与验证策略的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型基准测试将“回答是否可评估”与“回答是否正确”两个本质不同的问题混为一个准确率分数，导致评估结果失真，需要分离这两个维度以更准确地衡量模型能力。
AI.method: 提出两层次评估框架：（1）第一层衡量与评分者无关的执行证据（终止、答案暴露、可解析性、完成长度）；（2）第二层衡量与评分者相关的正确性。在Qwen和DeepSeek的五个配置上对MATH和ARC-Challenge数据集进行实验，并开展覆盖审核的目标验证研究。
AI.result: 2048令牌限制下不同模型和数据集执行状态差异显著：Qwen MATH输出中49/450未终止且无最终答案，DeepSeek MATH为5/300，ARC数据集为0/750。同一DeepSeek MATH数据在8192令牌下无此现象。候选选择和聚合策略会显著改变比较性准确率估计。
AI.conclusion: 准确率混淆了执行案例混合与验证策略的影响，评估测试时方法应同时报告干预前执行状态、验证覆盖率和评分者来源。

title: STAIF: A Stage-wise Optimization for Complex Instruction Following
summary: Following complex instructions with multiple explicit constraints remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs). Existing alignment methods, such as DPO, optimize holistic reward signals that often underemphasize strict satisfaction of individual constraints, particularly under out-of-distribution or multi-constraint settings. In this paper, we propose STAIF, a stage-wise optimization framework that decouples the alignment of subjective (soft) constraints from the optimization of objectively verifiable (hard) constraints. Stage 1 applies preference optimization with multiple negative samples to sharpen sensitivity to soft constraints, while Stage 2 applies Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to enforce strict compliance with hard constraints. To support this method, we construct STAINSTRUCT, a high-quality bilingual (English, Chinese) dataset of approximately 31,000 complex multi-constraint instructions. Extensive analyses validate the design of STAIF and show state-of-the-art performance on representative benchmarks against strong baselines, as well as genuine generalization.

AI.tldr: STAIF是一种两阶段优化框架，通过解耦软约束（主观偏好）和硬约束（客观可验证）的对齐过程，先利用多负样本偏好优化提升软约束敏感性，再通过可验证奖励强化学习强制执行硬约束，并构建了约31,000条双语多约束指令数据集STAINSTRUCT，在多项基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法（如DPO）优化整体奖励信号，在多个显式约束场景下难以严格满足每条约束，尤其在分布外或多约束设置下表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出STAIF两阶段框架：阶段1使用多负样本偏好优化增强对软约束的敏感性；阶段2使用可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）强制执行硬约束。同时构建了包含约31,000条中英双语复杂多约束指令的STAINSTRUCT数据集。
AI.result: 在代表性基准测试中，STAIF相比强基线取得最佳性能，并展现出真实的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 解耦软硬约束的两阶段优化能有效提升LLM在多约束指令遵循上的表现，且具有良好的泛化性。

title: Towards Dual-Brain Minimal Sufficient Representation for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE) requires an agent to ground language in egocentric observations and plan in unseen scenes. Although recent multimodal large models and world-model-based methods have improved navigation, they often preserve excessive task-irrelevant detail, weakening generalization and increasing computational burden. We propose BrainNav, a navigation framework grounded in the Principle of Minimal Sufficiency. BrainNav consists of three components: a Logical Anchor Model that implements instruction-aware selective perception to suppress environmental noise, a Minimalist Constraint Alignment module that serves as a compact cross-modal bottleneck, efficiently synchronizing discrete linguistic intent with continuous latent dynamics while filtering out redundant information, and a Compression World Model that predicts action-conditioned states within a condensed, low-rank latent space. These modules align semantic intent with spatial perception, enhancing the agent's robustness and efficiency in complex tasks. Experiments show that BrainNav improves over prior SOTA by 2.0 % / 1.0 in SR/SPL on R2R-CE val-unseen and 0.94 % / 0.78 on RxR-CE val-unseen. These results indicate that minimally sufficient world representations provide an effective foundation for robust VLN.

AI.tldr: BrainNav提出基于最小充分性原则的VLN-CE框架，通过逻辑锚点模型、极简约束对齐和压缩世界模型三个模块，在保留关键语义-空间信息的同时滤除冗余，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN-CE方法依赖多模态大模型和世界模型方法，但往往保留过多与任务无关的细节，导致泛化能力下降和计算负担增加。
AI.method: BrainNav包含三个核心模块：(1) 逻辑锚点模型(Logical Anchor Model)实现指令感知的选择性感知，抑制环境噪声；(2) 极简约束对齐(Minimalist Constraint Alignment)作为紧凑的跨模态瓶颈，同步离散语言意图与连续潜在动力学；(3) 压缩世界模型(Compression World Model)在低秩潜在空间中预测动作条件状态。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE val-unseen上SR/SPL分别提升2.0%/1.0，在RxR-CE val-unseen上分别提升0.94%/0.78，超越此前SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 最小充分的世界表征为鲁棒的视觉-语言导航提供了有效基础。

title: INS-ActBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Assessing Professional Actuarial Capability of Large Language Models
comment: 18 pages, including appendices; 11 figures and 12 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in financial reasoning, but existing benchmarks often evaluate domain knowledge, numerical reasoning, long-context understanding, and tool use in separate settings. This limits their ability to assess realistic professional workflows that require auditable, context-grounded, and tool-executable decisions. We introduce \textbf{INS-ActBench}, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating professional actuarial capability in LLMs. INS-ActBench contains 12,050 Q\&A pairs from public exams and sample questions released by 16 actuarial associations. It covers three subsets: \textbf{INS-Act-Know} for standardized actuarial knowledge, \textbf{INS-Act-Case} for long-context insurance case reasoning, and \textbf{INS-Act-Practice} for spreadsheet and R-code tasks with verifiable numerical outputs. Experiments on nine representative LLMs and human actuarial experts reveal a clear capability boundary: frontier LLMs perform strongly on standardized knowledge, but remain much weaker in case reasoning, tool-based workflows, and jurisdiction-sensitive practice. INS-ActBench provides a reproducible foundation for developing actuarial LLMs toward reliable professional assistance. The code is available at https://github.com/FDU-INS/INS-ActBench.

AI.tldr: INS-ActBench是一个评估大语言模型精算专业能力的综合基准，包含12,050个问答对，覆盖标准化知识、长文本案例推理和工具执行三大子集。实验表明前沿LLM在标准化知识上表现强，但在案例推理、工具工作流和司法实践上远弱于人类专家。
AI.motivation: 现有基准将金融推理中的领域知识、数值推理、长文本理解和工具使用分开评估，无法模拟需要可审计、上下文接地和工具可执行决策的真实专业工作流程，因此需要一个综合评估精算专业能力的基准。
AI.method: 从16个精算协会的公开考试和样题中构建12,050个问答对，分为三个子集：INS-Act-Know（标准化精算知识）、INS-Act-Case（长上下文保险案例推理）、INS-Act-Practice（电子表格和R代码任务，输出可验证数值）。在9个代表性LLM和人类精算专家上进行实验评估。
AI.result: 前沿LLM在标准化精算知识上表现强劲，但在案例推理、基于工具的工作流和对司法管辖区敏感的实践任务上明显弱于人类专家，存在清晰的能力边界。
AI.conclusion: INS-ActBench为开发可靠的精算专业LLM助手提供了可复现的基础框架，揭示了当前LLM在专业精算任务上的能力局限，指明了需要加强的方向。

title: ARdena: Scenario-driven control of real-time LLM agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled increasingly capable conversational agents, but reliably controlling their behavior in real-time interactive environments remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches often rely on model fine-tuning or alignment procedures that are difficult to adapt to changing interaction requirements. This paper introduces layered scenario-driven LLM control, a framework that enables runtime behavior control through structured prompting. By combining persistent context with scenario-specific constraints, the approach allows agent behavior to be modified during interaction without changing the underlying model. The framework is implemented in ARDena, a real-time multimodal embodied agent that integrates speech interaction, visual perception, tool use, and avatar-based response generation. The proposed approach is evaluated with respect to control effectiveness, response latency, and operational stability. The results demonstrate that scenario definitions alone can produce substantially different interaction behaviors while maintaining stable real-time operation, highlighting the effectiveness of scenario-driven prompting for controlling LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分层场景驱动的LLM控制框架（ARDena），通过结构化提示词在运行时控制对话代理行为，无需模型微调即可实现实时交互行为调控，实验证明了场景定义对行为控制的有效性和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对话代理依赖微调或对齐流程，难以适应实时交互环境中动态变化的控制需求，亟需一种运行时可控的轻量级行为调控方法。
AI.method: 提出分层场景驱动的LLM控制框架：结合持久化上下文与场景特定约束，通过结构化提示词在推理时调控代理行为，无需修改底层模型；并在ARDena多模态具身代理（集成语音、视觉、工具调用和虚拟形象生成）中实现该框架。
AI.result: 场景定义能够产生显著不同的交互行为；在控制有效性、响应延迟和运行稳定性方面均达到良好效果，实现了稳定的实时操作。
AI.conclusion: 场景驱动的提示词工程是一种有效的LLM代理运行时控制方法，能够在保持模型不变的前提下灵活调控行为，适应动态交互需求。

title: Fashion-3DLR: A Controllable 3D Garment Generation Using Pairwise Fashion Elements for Intelligent Design
summary: AI-generated content (AIGC) has made significant progress, with 2D generative models becoming ready-to-use tools for the digital fashion industry. However, 3D garment generation remains in its nascent stage, where in the realm of fashion, the semantic information of diverse design elements exhibits intricate coupling relationships in 3D representations, posing substantial challenges for generating diverse 3D garments. In this work, to handle the above problem, We introduce Fashion-3DLR, a novel 3D garment generation framework that utilizes diverse design elements to create high-quality, versatile 3D garment assets. Specifically, to bridge the semantic gaps between different fashion elements, we propose a Garment Feature Fusion Diffusion Transformer (GFF-DiT) module to integrate 2D fashion design elements, e.g., sketch and texture, into latent space. Within the latent space, we then employ a rectified flow transformer to generate geometry latents, which can be decoded into various 3D garment representations, including 3D Gaussians and meshes. Furthermore, we integrate Fashion-3DLR into downstream tasks, achieving the 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-driven cloth physical simulation and mesh-based virtual try-on. Experimental results indicate that Fashion-3DLR surpass the previous state-of-the-art methods, which verify that the proposed work can generate well-structured, non-watertight garments capable of physical simulation and virtual try-on, underscoring its potential as a versatile 3D garment design tool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fashion-3DLR框架，通过Garment Feature Fusion Diffusion Transformer (GFF-DiT)模块融合2D设计元素（草图和纹理）到潜空间，再使用整流流变压器生成几何潜码，解码为3D高斯或网格表示，实现高质量、多样化的3D服装生成，并支持物理仿真和虚拟试穿等下游任务，性能超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 3D服装生成仍处初级阶段，2D生成模型虽已成熟，但服装设计元素在3D表示中存在复杂的语义耦合关系，导致生成多样化3D服装面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 提出Fashion-3DLR框架：1) GFF-DiT模块融合2D服装设计元素（草图、纹理）到潜空间；2) 整流流变压器生成几何潜码；3) 解码为3D高斯或网格表示；4) 集成到3DGS驱动的布料物理仿真和基于网格的虚拟试穿等下游任务。
AI.result: Fashion-3DLR超越现有最先进方法，能生成结构良好、非水密的服装，并支持物理仿真和虚拟试穿。
AI.conclusion: Fashion-3DLR可作为多功能3D服装设计工具，生成的服装兼具良好结构和下游任务兼容性，验证了其在数字时尚领域的应用潜力。

title: The Tokenizer Tax: Quantifying and Explaining the Cross-Lingual Cost of Subword Tokenization for Indian Languages
summary: Large language models (LLMs) process text through subword tokenizers rather than directly reading characters or words. Because these tokenizers are trained predominantly on English-centric corpora, they introduce a systematic and often overlooked disadvantage for many non-English languages. In this work, we quantify this tokenizer tax for Indian languages using the FLORES-200 parallel corpus, measuring tokenization fertility across six widely used tokenizers and fourteen languages. Under cl100k_base (used by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4), Indian languages experience an average 8.0x tokenization tax relative to English, reaching 13.0x for Malayalam, reducing the effective context window to as little as 12% of that available to English users for equivalent semantic content. We identify the primary mechanism behind this disparity: failed byte-pair merges that leave text fragmented into single-byte tokens, with merge failure strongly correlating with tokenizer tax (Pearson r = 0.89). We further show that this phenomenon is not an inherent property of Indic scripts but a consequence of tokenizer design. Multilingual tokenizers such as XLM-R and OpenAI's o200k_base reduce the average Indic tokenizer tax by 73%, demonstrating that the disparity is largely remediable. Beyond token statistics, we quantify a practical consequence by showing that, under fixed context budgets, Indian-language documents preserve substantially less original content than equivalent English documents. Finally, we examine the relationship between tokenizer fertility and reading comprehension performance on the Belebele benchmark, finding that the apparent correlation is largely explained by language resource availability rather than tokenizer behavior alone.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了大型语言模型中子词分词器对印度语言造成的"分词税"：在cl100k_base下，印度语言平均分词税是英语的8.0倍（马拉雅拉姆语达13.0倍），有效上下文窗口仅剩英语用户的12%。该现象源于字节对合并失败，但多语言分词器可将此税降低73%。分词税与语言资源可用性共同影响阅读理解性能。
AI.motivation: 子词分词器主要基于英语语料训练，导致非英语语言在处理时处于系统性劣势，但这种"分词税"的影响尚未被充分量化和理解。
AI.method: 使用FLORES-200平行语料库，测量6种广泛使用的分词器在14种印度语言上的分词生育率（tokenization fertility），分析字节对合并失败机制，评估对上下文窗口和内容保留的影响，并在Belebele基准上检验与阅读理解的关系。
AI.result: 印度语言在cl100k_base下平均分词税8.0x，马拉雅拉姆语达13.0x；合并失败与分词税强相关（r=0.89）；多语言分词器可将税降低73%；在固定上下文预算下印度语言内容保留显著少于英语；分词税与阅读理解的相关性主要由语言资源可用性解释。
AI.conclusion: 印度语言的分词劣势并非文字系统固有属性，而是分词器设计缺陷所致，可以通过多语言分词器设计来显著缓解。

title: KG2Code: Bridging Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models via Executable Code for Question Answering
summary: Recent research has explored the integration of knowledge graphs (KGs) with large language models (LLMs) to enhance their performance on downstream knowledge-intensive tasks, particularly knowledge graph question answering (KGQA). Existing approaches primarily combine LLMs with KGs through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based, agent-based, and SPARQL-based methods. Although these methods have achieved notable success, they still suffer from several limitations, including structural information loss, unfaithful reasoning, and limited flexibility and generalization. To address these challenges, this paper proposes KG2Code, a novel approach that transforms knowledge graphs into a code-based representation, preserving structural semantics while naturally aligning with the code-aware pretraining of modern LLMs. Based on KG2Code, KG2Code-QA is further introduced as a KGQA framework that formulates KGQA as a code generation task. This formulation enables the generation of verifiable reasoning traces and executable code, thereby substantially mitigating the impact of hallucinations. In addition, an automated pipeline is developed to construct a large-scale, high-quality code corpus for effectively training open-source LLMs on KG2Code-QA. After training, LLMs are able to perform KGQA in zero-shot scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly outperforms existing KG-enhanced LLM methods for KGQA, while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen KGs. The code and data are available at Github.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KG2Code方法，将知识图谱转化为代码表示，并在此基础上构建KG2Code-QA框架，将知识图谱问答转化为代码生成任务，通过生成可验证的推理轨迹和可执行代码来缓解幻觉问题。实验表明该方法显著优于现有KG增强的LLM方法，且对未见知识图谱具有强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有将知识图谱与大语言模型结合的方法（如RAG、基于智能体、SPARQL方法）存在结构信息丢失、推理不可信、灵活性和泛化性有限等问题，亟需一种新的方法来解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出KG2Code方法将知识图谱转换为基于代码的表示，保留结构语义并与LLM的代码感知预训练对齐；在此基础上构建KG2Code-QA框架，将KGQA形式化为代码生成任务；开发自动化流水线构建大规模高质量代码语料用于训练开源LLM，使模型能够零样本执行KGQA。
AI.result: 实验表明KG2Code方法在KGQA任务上显著优于现有KG增强的LLM方法，并对未见知识图谱展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将知识图谱转化为代码表示并与LLM的代码预训练能力结合，是一种有效且泛化性强的KGQA解决方案，能够减轻幻觉问题并生成可信推理。

title: OmniScope: Modality-Decoupled Token Compression for Omnimodal Large Language Models
summary: Existing token compression methods for omnimodal large language models typically rely on one modality to determine what to retain in the other. We show that this assumption often breaks down: for the same query, audio and video relevance often peaks at different moments. This cross-modal salience mismatch makes unidirectional guidance prone to discarding answer-critical cues under aggressive compression. We propose OmniScope, a training-free token compression framework that uses the query as a shared semantic anchor while estimating relevance separately for audio and video. OmniScope allocates modality-specific token budgets, prunes visual tokens with an anchor-delta strategy that preserves both global context and temporal changes, and merges audio tokens within each second to reduce redundancy while maintaining temporal continuity. Across four audio-video benchmarks and two Qwen2.5-Omni model scales, OmniScope achieves the best average accuracy across all compression settings. At 25% overall token retention, it delivers up to 3.53x prefill speedup and more than 15% GPU memory reduction, with only a 0.35-point drop in average accuracy. These results suggest a simple design principle for OmniLLM inference: share the query across modalities, but not the salience estimates. The code is available at https://github.com/MAC-AutoML/OmniScope.

AI.tldr: OmniScope是一种无需训练的全模态大语言模型token压缩框架，通过以查询为共享语义锚点、分别估计音频和视频的相关性，解决了跨模态显著性不匹配问题。在25% token保留率下实现最高3.53倍预填充加速和15%+显存减少，平均准确率仅下降0.35个点。
AI.motivation: 现有token压缩方法通常依赖单一模态决定另一模态的保留内容，但音频和视频的显著性峰值往往不同步，导致单向引导在激进压缩下丢失关键信息。
AI.method: 以查询为共享语义锚点，分别为音频和视频估计相关性；分配模态特定的token预算；对视觉token采用锚点-差分策略以保留全局上下文和时间变化；对音频token按秒合并以减少冗余同时保持时间连续性。
AI.result: 在4个音视频基准和2种Qwen2.5-Omni规模上，所有压缩设置下平均准确率最优。25% token保留率时：最高3.53倍预填充加速、15%以上显存减少、平均准确率仅下降0.35点。
AI.conclusion: 全模态大模型推理的设计原则是：跨模态共享查询，但不共享显著性估计。

title: Self-Authored Verification Is Unreliable in Heuristic Self-Improving Agents
summary: Self-improving agents accumulate capability by repeatedly rewriting procedural policies, controllers, or heuristic rules. They typically rely on self-authored tests or metrics to decide whether to accept subsequent edits. The agent controls both the optimized object and its verifier. As a result, self-assigned scores can remain near perfect while real deployment performance degrades or stays low. We study this problem through the verifier--deployment gap. This gap refers to the discrepancy between an agent's self-authored verification signal and a sealed deployment evaluation that the agent cannot observe or access. We ask how self-authored verification fails under iterative policy-and-test rewriting, how the failure changes with capability, and how little exogenous trust is sufficient to prevent real regressions from being deployed.
