To address this problem, we introduce a Sealed Exogenous Acceptance Loop (SEAL). SEAL retains self-authored tests but compares each candidate with the incumbent through a fixed harness-side audit. The agent cannot author or inspect the audit, receives only accept/reject, and the whole incumbent state is retained after a clear regression. Our experiments show that this problem often appears in heuristic learning settings. These settings require trial-and-error discovery of the target objective. We further find that failures of self-written verification are stratified by capability. Weaker agents tend to damage previously acquired strategies behind easy self-tests. Stronger agents are more stable, but they still mismeasure the deployment distribution. Standard self-written constraints do not reliably close this gap. In contrast, SEAL outperforms unprotected baselines across six models and three random seeds. Reliable self-improvement need not abandon self-verification, but it requires at least one deployment-acceptance signal outside the agent's control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自我改进智能体在迭代重写策略和验证器时出现的验证器-部署差距问题，并提出了一种密封的外部接受循环（SEAL）方法，通过在智能体外部的固定审计信号来防止真实性能退化。
AI.motivation: 自我改进智能体同时控制优化对象和验证器，导致自我评分接近完美而实际部署性能下降或停滞。作者希望探究这种自我验证失败的原因、与能力的关系，以及需要多少外部信任才能防止真实退化被部署。
AI.method: 提出SEAL（密封外部接受循环）：保留自我编写测试，但通过固定外部审计比较候选策略与当前策略，智能体无法编写或查看审计，只能接收接受/拒绝信号，并在检测到退化时保留原有策略。
AI.result: 自我验证失败与能力水平相关：弱智能体容易在简单自测下破坏已有策略，强智能体更稳定但仍会错误度量部署分布。标准自我约束无法可靠缩小差距。SEAL在六个模型和三个随机种子下均优于无保护的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的自我改进不需要放弃自我验证，但至少需要一个智能体控制之外的部署接受信号。

title: Do Language Models Converge to Themselves? Recursive Self-Refinement as Textual Relaxation
summary:
Large language models are increasingly used in recursive refinement workflows, where an initial draft is repeatedly revised by the same model. Despite their growing use, the long-term dynamics of such workflows remain poorly understood. Does repeated refinement continue to improve outputs indefinitely, or does it converge toward a stable textual form?
  We study recursive self-refinement as a dynamical process in which repeated LLM revision drives text toward a model-preferred soft fixed-point region. Using GPT-5.5, we generate 10-step refinement trajectories for 50 ICML 2025 abstracts under both default-temperature and deterministic decoding, and additionally evaluate 15 ICML 2020 abstracts. We analyze normalized edit distance, exact and approximate fixed points, word-count stability, exponential relaxation, and external LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
  Across all settings, refinement trajectories rapidly saturate. Most edits occur within the first few iterations, after which trajectories enter a soft fixed-point region with only minor surface-level changes. Deterministic decoding reaches exact fixed points earlier and exhibits smaller residual fluctuations than default-temperature decoding, while both achieve universal approximate convergence. The average edit magnitude follows a consistent exponential relaxation pattern, suggesting convergence toward a model-preferred textual equilibrium rather than open-ended optimization. External evaluation indicates that converged abstracts improve clarity, conciseness, and scientific style while preserving technical meaning.
  These findings support a dynamical-systems view of LLM self-refinement and motivate practical stopping criteria based on edit-magnitude saturation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM递归自精炼的动态过程，发现多次迭代后文本会快速饱和并收敛到模型偏好的软不动点区域，而非无限优化。实验表明，编辑幅度呈指数衰减，确定性解码比默认温度解码更快达到不动点，且收敛后的文本在清晰度、简洁性和科学性上有所提升。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM越来越多地被用于递归精炼工作流（同一模型反复修改初稿），但其长期动态特性尚不明确：反复精炼是否会无限提升输出质量，还是会收敛到某种稳定的文本形式？
AI.method: 将递归自精炼视为动力系统过程，使用GPT-5.5对50篇ICML 2025摘要和15篇ICML 2020摘要进行10步精炼轨迹实验（含默认温度解码和确定性解码两种设置），分析归一化编辑距离、精确/近似不动点、词数稳定性、指数松弛模式和LLM-as-a-judge外部评估。
AI.result: 精炼轨迹迅速饱和，大部分编辑发生在前几次迭代中，随后进入仅产生微小表层变化的软不动点区域。确定性解码比默认温度解码更早达到精确不动点且残差波动更小，两种解码方式均实现近似收敛。平均编辑幅度呈现一致的指数松弛模式。外部评估表明收敛后的摘要在清晰度、简洁性和科学性上有所提升，同时保持技术含义不变。
AI.conclusion: LLM自精炼服从动力系统视角，收敛到模型偏好的文本均衡而非无限优化；可基于编辑幅度饱和制定实用的停止准则。

title: Out-of-Length Scene Text Recognition: A Two-Axis Diagnosis and a Training-Free Fix
comment: 39 pages, 10 tables, includes supplementary material (folded in as Appendix S1-S4). Code: https://github.com/zobeirraisi/chunk-decode-stitch
summary: Scene Text Recognition (STR) models are trained almost exclusively on word crops of at most 25 characters, yet real deployments (signage, product labels, dense captions) require reading much longer text. This paper diagnoses that failure and then closes it. The diagnosis separates out-of-length failure into two simultaneously extrapolating axes (the encoder's width axis and the decoder's time axis) and shows that encoder width, not decoder length, is the dominant failure mode. Representation-side fixes bring only partial relief: training-free rotary rescalings recover at most 2-4 points of character error rate (CER), and a weighted fine-tuning recipe recovers 6-8 points while improving standard-benchmark accuracy, yet word accuracy on the Long Text Benchmark (LTB) stays near zero, because the residual gap lies in the decoding mechanism rather than the representation. We then close that gap at inference time, on an unmodified word-level checkpoint: the long image is sliced into overlapping crops at the model's training width, each decoded independently and in-distribution, and the reads stitched by geometry-anchored edit-distance alignment. This procedure reaches 42.79-43.05% bucket-average word accuracy on LTB across two base checkpoints, matching the published state of the art (41.57%) and beating it by 11-12 points on the hardest bucket, at wall-clock parity with plain decoding; applied unchanged to the public PARSeq checkpoint it reaches 47.11%. Once chunking is applied fine-tuning no longer helps: the decoding-side fix alone matches purpose-built architectures. We release the diagnosis harness and implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断并解决了场景文本识别（STR）模型在处理超长文本时的失效问题，发现编码器的宽度轴是主要失败模式。通过推理时的图像切片与几何锚定编辑距离对齐的解码机制，在无需修改预训练检查点的情况下，在长文本基准（LTB）上达到了42.79-43.05%的桶平均词准确率，超越了此前SOTA的41.57%，在最难桶上提高了11-12个百分点，且推理速度与普通解码持平。
AI.motivation: 现有的STR模型几乎仅在最多25字符的词级裁剪图上训练，但实际部署场景（如标识、产品标签、密集字幕）需要识别更长的文本，存在严重的长度外推失败问题。
AI.method: 1）将失败解耦为编码器宽度轴和解码器时间轴两个外推维度，发现编码器宽度是主导失败因素；2）提出推理时的切片-解码-对齐策略：将长图按训练宽度切分为重叠裁剪块，独立解码后通过几何锚定的编辑距离对齐进行拼接。
AI.result: 在LTB上达到42.79-43.05%桶平均词准确率，超越SOTA 41.57%；在最长文本桶上提升11-12个百分点；在公共PARSeq检查点上达到47.11%；推理速度与普通解码持平。
AI.conclusion: 编码器宽度是长文本识别失败的主导因素；推理时的切片解码策略可完全弥合长度外推差距，且无需微调或修改模型架构；一旦应用切片，微调不再带来额外收益。

title: Rethinking the Generation Order of Block Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models enable flexible arbitrary-order generation, but existing sampling methods are mostly designed for early masked diffusion models (MDMs). In this work, we study sampling for recent block diffusion language models (BDLMs). We show empirically and analytically that these models are naturally more aligned with left-to-right decoding than MDMs. Based on this observation, we propose Parallel Autoregressive Decoding (PARD), a simple training-free sampling method that preserves left-to-right unmasking structure while allowing parallel token commitment. Extensive experiments show that PARD consistently outperforms existing parallel samplers in generation quality, while achieving substantial speedups over pure AR decoding with only a small quality gap.

AI.tldr: 针对块扩散语言模型（BDLM）提出了一种无需训练的并行自回归解码方法PARD，在保持从左到右生成结构的同时实现并行解码，显著优于现有并行采样器且速度接近自回归解码。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散语言模型的采样方法主要针对早期掩码扩散模型（MDM）设计，而新的块扩散语言模型（BDLM）具有不同的特性，缺乏针对性的高效采样方法。
AI.method: 通过实验和分析证明BDLM天然更倾向于从左到右解码，提出PARD方法——一种无需训练的并行自回归解码方法，在保留从左到右的去掩码结构的同时支持并行令牌提交。
AI.result: PARD在生成质量上一致优于现有并行采样器，同时相比纯自回归解码实现了显著的加速，仅存在很小的质量差距。
AI.conclusion: BDLM比MDM更适宜从左到右解码，PARD有效平衡了并行解码的效率与自回归解码的质量，是一种适用于BDLM的高效采样方法。

title: MINT-V2X: A Mobility-Integrated Network Trajectory Dataset for Predictive Resource Management
summary: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication systems are based on datasets that not only contain vehicle trajectory data but also wireless network parameters with a realistic level of fidelity, enabling the creation of prediction and optimization models. There is a very critical research infrastructure gap today, and publicly available datasets are likely to be limited to one of the two: mobility or network parameters, and rarely provide a single, integrated view that combines both. This paper introduces MINT-V2X, a comprehensive dataset generated by coupling SUMO traffic dynamics with OMNeT++/Simu5G network simulation. The validation framework is composed of 14 standardized tests based on 3GPP Release 14 (C-V2X), ETSI standards and Shannon capacity theory. The resulting dataset contains 9.87 million synchronized data points from 1,386 vehicles from 15 roadside units (RSUs) during 3 hours of urban traffic simulation. We demonstrate strict algorithmic consistency through network metric correlations (CQI-SINR: 0.993; SINR-PDR: 0.946). Finally, we demonstrate the value of the dataset by conducting an RSU load prediction case study, showing that using trajectory data yields better predictive performance than network-history-only baselines. The dataset, experiments, and complete SUMO configuration files are available in the GitHub repository to facilitate reproduction on alternative simulation stacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MINT-V2X数据集，通过耦合SUMO交通动力学与OMNeT++/Simu5G网络仿真，生成了包含987万个同步数据点（来自1386辆车和15个RSU）的综合V2X数据集，并验证了其算法一致性和应用价值。
AI.motivation: 现有V2X公开数据集往往仅包含交通轨迹数据或无线网络参数中的一种，缺乏融合两者的综合视图，导致研究基础设施存在关键缺口，无法满足V2X预测和优化模型的构建需求。
AI.method: 将SUMO交通仿真与OMNeT++/Simu5G网络仿真进行耦合，生成同步的V2X数据集；基于3GPP Release 14 (C-V2X)、ETSI标准和香农容量理论构建包含14项标准化测试的验证框架；通过RSU负载预测案例研究验证数据集价值。
AI.result: 生成了包含987万同步数据点的MINT-V2X数据集；网络指标相关性验证结果优异（CQI-SINR: 0.993, SINR-PDR: 0.946）；案例研究表明使用轨迹数据比仅使用网络历史数据的基线具有更好的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: MINT-V2X填补了V2X领域缺乏融合交通与网络参数综合数据集的空白，具有严格的算法一致性，且轨迹数据的引入能显著提升预测模型性能。数据集和配置已开源以支持复现。

title: Counterfactual Motion Reliability Learning for Robust UAV Tracking
summary: Infrared unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) tracking is challenging because the target is often small, low-contrast, and easily confused with thermal distractors or cluttered backgrounds. Recent Transformer-based trackers have achieved promising performance by learning strong appearance representations, but their responses can still be dominated by background structures when the target appearance is weak or ambiguous. A natural solution is to introduce temporal motion cues. However, in infrared UAV tracking, motion cues are not always reliable: camera jitter, dynamic backgrounds, sensor noise, and target disappearance may produce temporal variations that are stronger than the true target motion. Therefore, the key challenge is not simply how to use motion, but how to distinguish target-consistent motion from background-induced pseudo motion. To this end, we propose CMRTrack, a counterfactual motion reliability learning framework for robust infrared UAV tracking. CMRTrack first extracts temporal evidence from adjacent search regions using a lightweight motion evidence encoder. During training, a counterfactual target-erased history branch is introduced to construct hard motion references, encouraging the motion encoder to learn reliable target-consistent motion rather than arbitrary temporal changes. The learned motion evidence is then incorporated into a one-stream tracking framework through motion-guided token modulation and reliability-aware score fusion, enabling adaptive feature enhancement and response refinement. Extensive experiments on Anti-UAV410 demonstrate that CMRTrack consistently outperforms representative state-of-the-art trackers and significantly improves the OSTrack baseline, with ablation studies and qualitative analysis verifying the effectiveness of the proposed counterfactual motion reliability learning.

AI.tldr: 针对红外无人机跟踪中目标弱小、低对比度且易与热干扰物混淆的问题，提出CMRTrack框架，通过反事实运动可靠性学习区分目标一致性运动与背景伪运动，将运动证据融入单流跟踪框架，在Anti-UAV410数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 红外无人机跟踪中，目标常因弱小、低对比度导致外观表征弱，Transformer跟踪器的响应易被背景结构主导。引入时序运动线索虽可缓解，但红外场景中相机抖动、动态背景、传感器噪声等会产生比真实目标运动更强的伪运动。因此关键在于区分目标一致性运动与背景诱导的伪运动。
AI.method: 提出CMRTrack框架：1）轻量级运动证据编码器从相邻搜索区域提取时序证据；2）训练时引入反事实目标擦除历史分支构造困难运动参考，强制编码器学习可靠的目标一致性运动而非任意时序变化；3）通过运动引导的标记调制和可靠性感知分数融合将运动证据融入单流跟踪框架。实现自适应特征增强与响应精炼。
AI.result: 在Anti-UAV410数据集上，CMRTrack一致性地优于代表性SOTA跟踪器，并显著提升了OSTrack基线性能。消融实验和定性分析验证了反事实运动可靠性学习的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 反事实运动可靠性学习能有效区分目标一致性运动与背景伪运动，将可靠运动证据融入单流跟踪框架可显著提升红外无人机跟踪的鲁棒性。

title: CONSISTRE: A Unified Consistency-Aware Framework for Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
summary: Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) aims to extract relations among multiple entities across extended contexts while maintaining consistency across predicted triples. Although large language models (LLMs) show remarkable reasoning capabilities in information extraction, their predictions are typically generated independently for each candidate triple and may violate fundamental relational constraints such as transitivity, symmetry, and functional uniqueness, leading to contradictory and unreliable outputs. We propose CONSISTRE, a unified consistency-aware framework for DocRE that addresses this limitation through two complementary tracks. The first operates at inference time for black-box LLMs, combining constraint-aware prompting, constraint-based verification, and iterative self-reflection to refine predictions without task-specific fine-tuning. The second injects consistency knowledge into smaller open-source models via a knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning pipeline: reasoning traces from a powerful teacher are distilled into a student via supervised fine-tuning, followed by GRPO alignment using a composite reward that jointly optimizes extraction performance and relational consistency. Together, the two tracks cover both API-accessible and locally deployable scenarios under a unified consistency formulation. Experiments on DocRED show that both tracks outperform their baselines, with the inference-time track achieving competitive F1 using off-the-shelf black-box LLMs and the training-time track substantially narrowing the gap between 7--8B open-source models and state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs at a fraction of their inference cost. Ablation studies confirm that explicit consistency modeling mitigates relational contradictions and enhances the reliability of LLM-based DocRE across both deployment paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CONSISTRE框架，通过推理时约束感知提示+迭代自反思（黑盒LLM）和训练时知识蒸馏+GRPO对齐（开源小模型）两条路径，显式建模关系一致性（传递性、对称性、功能唯一性）以提升文档级关系抽取的可靠性和一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在文档级关系抽取中对每个候选三元组独立预测，忽视了关系约束（如传递性、对称性、功能唯一性），导致预测矛盾且不可靠。
AI.method: 双轨框架：1）推理时：约束感知提示+约束验证+迭代自反思，无需微调；2）训练时：教师模型推理轨迹经SFT蒸馏至学生模型，再用GRPO进行复合奖励对齐（优化抽取性能与关系一致性）。
AI.result: DocRED上双轨均超越基线：推理轨使用黑盒LLM取得有竞争力的F1；训练轨使7-8B开源模型显著缩小与顶尖闭源LLM的差距且推理成本大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 显式一致性建模能有效缓解关系矛盾，提升LLM在DocRE上的可靠性，适用于API访问和本地部署两种场景。

title: EventOD: Event-Aware OD Flow Generation via LLM-Guided Semantic Modulation
summary: Estimating origin-destination (OD) flows under disruptive events is important for disaster response and urban resilience. Existing deep OD models trained on routine mobility often degrade when extreme events abruptly alter regional functions and population activities, while retraining a new generator for each event is impractical under limited event-time supervision. We propose EventOD, an event-adaptive OD generation framework that steers a pretrained OD generator using structured event semantics. EventOD first uses a large language model to infer region-level functional and demographic control vectors from coarse event observations. It then learns two lightweight adaptation modules, AlphaNet and BetaNet, to calibrate the magnitude of these semantic shifts, and further introduces a retrieval-augmented fallback pathway for scenarios with sparse supervision. The resulting event-conditioned features are injected into a pretrained graph diffusion OD model through input-level modulation, enabling event-aware adaptation without updating generator parameters. Experiments on hurricane- and pandemic-induced mobility across U.S. counties show that EventOD consistently improves both reconstruction accuracy and distributional fidelity over strong baselines. Source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EventOD-5C11/.

AI.tldr: 提出EventOD框架，利用预训练的OD生成模型与事件语义控制向量，通过轻量级适配模块实现突发事件下OD流的高效生成，无需重训模型参数。
AI.motivation: 现有深度OD模型在极端事件下性能退化严重，而逐事件重训生成器在有限事件时监督下不切实际。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型从粗粒度事件观测中推断区域功能和人口控制向量；设计AlphaNet和BetaNet两个轻量适配模块校准时移幅度；引入检索增强回退路径应对稀疏监督场景；通过输入级调制将事件条件特征注入预训练图扩散OD模型。
AI.result: 在美国县级飓风和疫情迁移数据上，EventOD在重建精度和分布保真度上均显著优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: EventOD通过结构化事件语义实现事件自适应的OD流生成，在无需更新生成器参数的前提下有效应对突发事件，提升城市韧性响应能力。

title: BoneAgeTW2: Automated Skeletal Maturation Assessment via the Tanner-Whitehouse 2 Method, Deep Learning, and Clinical Report Generation with Distribution Curves
comment: Thesis research article. Code available at https://github.com/jmmana/BoneAgeTW2
summary: We present BoneAgeTW2, the first fully open-source system to automate the complete Tanner-Whitehouse 2 (TW2) clinical protocol for skeletal maturity assessment end-to-end. The system employs YOLOv8 for precise detection and localization of the 20 TW2 hand bones from radiographic images, and an EfficientNet-B3 backbone with 20 independent classification heads to assign maturation stages (A-I) to each bone simultaneously. From these predictions, the system automatically generates clinical PDF reports including interactive Gaussian distribution curves for all 20 bones, enabling direct comparison with population norms. The model is trained on the public RSNA Pediatric Bone Age Challenge dataset (12,611 hand radiographs) using a pseudo-labeling strategy to derive per-bone stage labels from global bone age annotations. The full codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/jmmana/BoneAgeTW2.

AI.tldr: 提出了BoneAgeTW2，首个完全开源的自动化Tanner-Whitehouse 2 (TW2)骨骼成熟度评估系统，端到端完成从手部X光片检测20块腕骨、分类成熟阶段到生成临床PDF报告的完整流程。
AI.motivation: 现有骨骼成熟度评估方法缺乏完全开源的端到端自动化系统，且TW2临床协议的手动执行耗时且主观性强，亟需一个可复现、公开可用的自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 使用YOLOv8检测和定位20块TW2手骨；采用EfficientNet-B3作为主干网络结合20个独立分类头，并行为每块骨骼分配A-I成熟阶段；通过伪标签策略从RSNA数据集的全局骨龄标注中推导每块骨骼的阶段标签。
AI.result: 在RSNA Pediatric Bone Age Challenge数据集（12,611张手部X光片）上训练，模型能自动生成包含20块骨骼交互式高斯分布曲线的临床PDF报告，支持与人群常模直接比较。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了基于公开数据集和伪标签策略可构建完全开源的TW2协议自动化系统，代码完全公开以促进可复现性和临床推广。

title: Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication for Retrieval-Augmented Generation System
summary: Common chunking strategies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems often create redundant chunks. These redundant chunks make the vector database bigger and slow down retrieval. A common fix is cosine-similarity thresholding. This method reduces each chunk to a single vector, then compares vectors using a similarity score. But a single vector can lose the fine-grained, token-level detail needed to tell a true duplicate apart from a chunk that just shares the same topic. We propose Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication (CACD). CACD checks each new chunk against an in-memory pool of chunks already kept, using a cross-encoder instead of a single pooled vector. This keeps token-level detail all the way to the final comparison. CACD combines three parts: the cross-encoder comparison itself, a New Information Score (NIS) that measures how much of a chunk is not explained by a candidate already kept, and a majority vote across several candidates rather than a single best match. NIS is calculated from the attention entropy of the cross-encoder. We tested CACD against five existing filtering methods, nine chunking strategies, and 18 configurations, all on the full SQuAD 1.1 validation set. In our experiments, CACD removes 9.75% of chunks on average. This drop rate is close to other semantic-level methods, and much higher than exact-match filters, which barely remove anything. In these experiments, CACD also processes each configuration in 51.0 seconds on average, about 27% faster than the strongest baseline, NERExact (69.6s), and about 7x faster than cosine-similarity filtering (356.7s). These results come from a single dataset, so we present them as an early comparison, not a general claim. Code for the baseline evaluation and for CACD is available at https://github.com/lehuyphuong/rag_bench and https://github.com/lehuyphuong/cacd_dedup.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于交叉注意力校准的去重方法（CACD），用于RAG系统中的冗余块检测，通过交叉编码器、新信息分数（NIS）和多数投票机制，在保持与语义级方法相近的去重率的同时，显著提升处理速度（比最强基线快约27%，比余弦相似度过滤快约7倍）。
AI.motivation: RAG系统中常见的分块策略会产生大量冗余块，导致向量数据库膨胀和检索速度下降。现有方法如余弦相似度阈值化将每个块压缩为单个向量进行比较，丢失了token级别的细粒度信息，难以区分真正的重复块与仅主题相似的块。
AI.method: CACD包含三个组成部分：(1) 交叉编码器比较——使用交叉编码器而非单向量池化进行块间比较，保留token级细节；(2) 新信息分数（NIS）——基于交叉编码器的注意力熵计算，衡量一个块中有多少内容不能被已保留的候选块解释；(3) 多数投票——跨多个候选块进行投票，而非仅依赖单个最佳匹配。
AI.result: 在SQuAD 1.1验证集上，CACD平均移除9.75%的块，去重率接近其他语义级方法，远高于精确匹配过滤器。平均处理时间为51.0秒，比最强基线NERExact（69.6秒）快约27%，比余弦相似度过滤（356.7秒）快约7倍。
AI.conclusion: CACD在保持有效去重能力的同时显著提升了处理效率，但结果仅基于单一数据集，属于早期对比，尚不能作为普适性结论。

title: StanceBench: A Benchmark for Audio LLM-Based Interpersonal Stance Evaluation from Speech
summary: Speech-to-speech dialogue models increasingly depend on prosody and interactional nuance to convey social intent, yet benchmarks for these cues remain limited. We introduce StanceBench, a benchmark for measuring interpersonal stance in conversational speech and evaluating audio-capable LLMs as automated judges. Using the Seamless Interaction corpus, StanceBench (1) specifies 9 stance dimensions via role-prompt poles, (2) standardizes single-speaker and interaction-based evaluations, and (3) reports LLM-as-a-judge robustness, bias, and stance inference. Across evaluated stances, empathy and politeness are the easiest. Warmth and assertiveness are moderately separable with positivity skew/asymmetry. Honesty is the hardest and shows high prompt order bias, consistent with needing cross-turn evidence. Attentiveness is separable but aligns weakly with humans. Interaction stances are more context-sensitive, with threshold gaps and high variance, especially conflict regulation.

AI.tldr: StanceBench是一个用于衡量对话语音中人际立场的基准测试，评估了音频LLM作为自动评判器的能力。在9个立场维度中，共情和礼貌最容易判断，诚实最难且受提示顺序影响大，交互立场更具上下文敏感性。
AI.motivation: 语音对话模型越来越依赖韵律和交互细微差别来传达社交意图，但现有针对这些线索的基准测试仍然有限，缺乏系统评估音频LLM在人际立场判断方面的能力。
AI.method: 基于Seamless Interaction语料库，StanceBench (1)通过角色提示极点指定9个立场维度，(2)标准化单说话人和基于交互的评估，(3)报告LLM作为评判器的鲁棒性、偏差和立场推断结果。
AI.result: 共情和礼貌最容易判断；温暖和自信中等可分离但有积极性偏斜/不对称；诚实最难且有高提示顺序偏差；专注可分离但与人类对齐较弱。交互立场更具上下文敏感性，存在阈值差距和高方差，特别是冲突调节维度。
AI.conclusion: StanceBench为评估语音对话模型的人际立场理解提供了系统基准，揭示了不同立场维度的判断难度差异及LLM评判器的偏差特性，对后续改进音频LLM的社交意图理解具有指导意义。

title: A Reconstruction-Based Framework for Caption Evaluation Beyond Reference Captions
summary: Image captioning is a primary task in vision--language research, yet assessing how faithfully a caption preserves image semantics without relying on reference captions remains unsettled. Prevailing evaluations rely on human-annotated references, whose content reflects annotator intent and captioning proficiency. In this paper, we study a reconstruction-based principle for caption evaluation: a caption is as good as its capacity to enable reconstruction of the original image. However, because captioning inherently compresses visual information, it is impossible to recover all details, and pixel-wise comparison between reconstructed and source images is neither feasible nor meaningful. Through our in-depth analysis of the nature of captions, whose fundamental purpose is to transmit the semantic content of an image, we propose a revised principle: a caption is as good as its capacity to enable a reconstruction that is semantically equivalent to the original. To assess semantic equivalence, we test whether the reconstruction matches the original image across a suite of downstream vision--language tasks, yielding a reference-free, task-conditioned caption score. We characterize component-dependent limitations and introduce the lower-cost Captioning Turing Test Dataset (CTTD) surrogate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于重建原理的无参考图像描述评估方法：一个好的描述应能支持重建出与原图语义等价的图像。通过在下游视觉-语言任务上测试重建图像与原图的语义等价性，得到无参考、任务条件的描述评分，并引入低成本替代数据集CTTD。
AI.motivation: 现有图像描述评估依赖人工标注的参考描述，但参考描述的内容受标注者意图和描述水平影响，不能客观反映描述对图像语义的保真度。因此需要一种不依赖参考描述、能直接衡量描述与图像语义一致性的评估方法。
AI.method: 基于重建原理：从图像描述重建图像，评估重建图像与原图在多个下游视觉-语言任务上的语义等价性，得到无参考的任务条件描述评分。同时分析了各组件依赖的局限性，并提出了低成本的CTTD替代数据集。
AI.result: 提出了一种参考自由的描述评估框架，能够在多个下游任务上衡量描述的语义保真度，并验证了重建方法的有效性。CTTD替代方案降低了计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 基于语义等价重建原则的无参考评估方法能有效衡量图像描述的语义保真度，克服了传统依赖人工参考描述的局限，为描述评估提供了新的范式。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models as Components of Cognitive Computing architecture for Regulatory Knowledge Management
summary: The aim of this article is to verify whether integrating large language models (LLMs) with the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture enables their transformation from standalone generative models into components of cognitive computing infrastructure with enhanced epistemic reliability. The study proposes an architectural approach based on locally deployed LLMs operating in on-premises environments without high-end GPU accelerators and examines their applicability in supporting regulatory management processes requiring continuous analysis and interpretation of legal acts. The proposed solution combines local LLMs with external knowledge repositories, creating a hybrid cognitive architecture in which the language model performs semantic interpretation while the RAG layer provides controlled knowledge retrieval, contextualization, and traceability of information sources. The implementation was validated using the Ollama and LM Studio execution environments together with the Polish language models Bielik and PLLuM running on consumer-class hardware. The results demonstrate that augmenting LLMs with RAG significantly improves the factual consistency, domain specificity and normative precision of generated texts while reducing the risk of unsupported content generation. Furthermore, the study shows that integrating RAG introduces auditability, controlled knowledge management and dynamic updating of regulatory information without retraining the language model. The findings indicate that locally deployed LLMs enhanced with RAG should be regarded not merely as text generation tools but as semantic processing modules within cognitive computing infrastructures supporting regulatory compliance and organizational decision-making in environments characterized by high legal and informational volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了将大型语言模型与检索增强生成架构集成，可使其从独立生成模型转变为具有增强认知可靠性的认知计算基础设施组件。研究基于本地部署、无需高端GPU的LLM，结合RAG层实现受控知识检索与溯源，在消费级硬件上使用波兰语模型验证，结果表明该方法显著提升了事实一致性、领域特异性和规范精确性，并实现了可审计性、受控知识管理和动态更新。
AI.motivation: 验证将LLM与RAG架构集成后，能否从独立生成模型转变为具有更高认知可靠性的认知计算基础设施组件，以支持需要持续分析和解释法律文本的监管管理流程。
AI.method: 提出一种混合认知架构：本地部署LLM（无需高端GPU加速器）执行语义解释，RAG层提供受控知识检索、上下文化和信息源可追溯性。在Ollama和LM Studio环境中，使用消费级硬件运行波兰语模型Bielik和PLLuM进行实现验证。
AI.result: RAG增强显著提升了生成文本的事实一致性、领域特异性和规范精确性，降低了无依据内容生成的风险；同时引入了可审计性、受控知识管理以及无需重新训练模型的动态监管信息更新能力。
AI.conclusion: 本地部署的LLM结合RAG不应仅被视为文本生成工具，而应被视作认知计算基础设施中的语义处理模块，用于支持高法律和信息波动性环境下的法规合规与组织决策。

title: TRE: Training-Free Hallucination Detection for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have recently gained increasing attention, yet their reliability is significantly hindered by the hallucination problem. Existing hallucination detection approaches for D-LLMs mainly follow a training-based paradigm, relying on data-driven training to optimize the detector. Such reliance not only limits their generalizability across domains models but also incurs additional training cost and deployment overhead. To address these limitations, we propose TRE, a training-free hallucination detection metric for D-LLMs. TRE is a parameter-free and single-run metric that estimates hallucination risk directly from the entropy signals of a single generation, without requiring any detector training or repeated sampling. TRE extracts entropy signals within the D-LLM decoding process along both the spatial and temporal dimensions. From a token-level spatial perspective, we focus on revealing tokens as the most informative carriers of uncertainty, capturing where uncertainty is actively committed. From a diffusion step-level temporal perspective, we empirically identify the dominance of late-step entropy and hence aggregate these signals with a simple linear weighting scheme to obtain TRE. Extensive experiments on multiple D-LLMs and QA datasets demonstrate that TRE achieves competitive performance, while enjoying strong generalizability, efficiency, and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出TRE，一种无需训练、无参数、单次运行的幻觉检测指标，通过从扩散大语言模型解码过程中的空间（token级）和时间（扩散步级）两个维度提取熵信号来估计幻觉风险，在多个D-LLM和QA数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有D-LLM的幻觉检测方法主要依赖基于训练的范式，这不仅限制了跨领域和跨模型的泛化能力，还带来了额外的训练成本和部署开销。
AI.method: TRE是一种无需训练的参数自由指标，通过单次生成中的熵信号估计幻觉风险。空间维度关注token级熵作为不确定性载体；时间维度识别并加权聚合后扩散步的熵信号。
AI.result: 在多个D-LLM和QA数据集上的实验表明，TRE取得了有竞争力的性能，并具有良好的泛化性、高效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TRE作为一种训练自由的幻觉检测方法，有效解决了现有方法在泛化性和效率上的局限，为D-LLM的可靠性提供了实用方案。

title: SARATR-X-v2: Scale-Aware Structural Pre-Training for SAR Foundation Models
summary: Masked image modeling has become a dominant paradigm for SAR pre-training, yet the design of the reconstruction target remains fundamentally unsettled. This article argues that a SAR pre-training target should satisfy two conditions to produce transferable representations: (i) physics-grounded stability, i.e., approximate invariance of the target operator to multiplicative speckle inherent in coherent imaging; and (ii) semantic scale compatibility, i.e., coverage of the heterogeneous spatial scales that downstream tasks demand. These two conditions are individually achievable but jointly difficult: physics-grounded stability favors fixed operators, while semantic scale compatibility favors data-driven composition. To this end, SARATR-X-v2 reconciles both within a single design. The target is constructed through fixed structural extractors spanning six receptive fields, from blind-spot local aggregation to directional log-ratio region contrast, and fused via learnable weights into one unified supervision signal for masked reconstruction. On twelve SAR benchmarks across classification, detection, and segmentation, SARATR-X-v2 achieves state-of-the-art transfer performance. Under synthetic speckle variation, the proposed target reduces perturbation drift in the learned representation by nearly two orders of magnitude relative to pixel-space supervision. Taken together, these results establish physics-grounded stability and semantic scale compatibility as a principled framework for pre-training target design under coherent imaging, and suggest that effective SAR pre-training is not about reconstructing more signal, but about reconstructing the right structural target.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAR自监督预训练的重建目标应满足两个条件：物理驱动稳定性（对乘性散斑近似不变）和语义尺度兼容性（覆盖多尺度空间特征）。SARATR-X-v2通过固定结构提取器（涵盖6种感受野）与可学习权重融合，在12个SAR基准任务上实现SOTA迁移性能，散斑扰动下表征漂移降低近两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 掩码图像建模已成为SAR预训练的主流范式，但重建目标的设计尚未解决根本性问题。现有目标要么缺乏物理根基（对相干成像固有的乘性散斑不稳定），要么无法兼容下游任务所需的多尺度语义信息，两者难以兼得。
AI.method: 提出两个必要条件：(i)物理驱动稳定性——目标算子对乘性散斑近似不变；(ii)语义尺度兼容性——覆盖异构空间尺度。SARATR-X-v2通过固定结构提取器（盲点局部聚合、方向对数比区域对比等6种感受野）提取多尺度结构特征，再用可学习权重融合为统一监督信号用于掩码重建。
AI.result: 在12个SAR基准（分类、检测、分割）上达到SOTA迁移性能；在合成散斑变化下，表征扰动漂移相比像素空间监督降低近两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 物理驱动稳定性与语义尺度兼容性构成相干成像下预训练目标设计的原理性框架；有效的SAR预训练不在于重建更多信号，而在于重建正确的结构目标。

title: Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory
summary: Long-term memory systems store what a user says in an external store and retrieve it when a related query arrives. This interface rests on an assumption so natural that it is rarely stated: a memory that is needed will resemble the query that needs it. World knowledge breaks the assumption. A tree-nut allergy should change the answer to a macaron request through their almond-flour ingredient, yet the two texts share no cue a retriever can see. We call this failure mode the implicit-association blind spot and introduce InMind, a 125-task, expert-verified benchmark spanning ten life domains, with 113 tasks grounded in citable public sources. Its paired controls separate three explanations that existing evaluations conflate: the fact was never stored, the model lacks the bridging knowledge, or the fact was stored and never surfaced. The verdict is clean. With the decisive memory placed in context, the backbone answers 84.0 percent of indirect queries; when the same memory must be retrieved, six vector, graph, and agentic memory systems reach at most 14.4 percent, even though they recall the same facts on demand at up to 100 percent. An embedding with eight times the dimensionality raises answer-blind target recall for every system yet leaves the gap essentially intact. A minimal diagnostic probe that keeps memory visible before the query arrives recovers most of the gap, locating the failure in the query-conditioned interface itself and pointing to routing, deciding which facts must stay visible, as the open problem InMind is built to score.

AI.tldr: 现有长期记忆系统依赖"记忆与查询相似"的假设，但世界知识（如杏仁粉导致树坚果过敏）会打破这一假设，导致隐式关联盲点。本文提出InMind基准（125个任务），发现即使记忆系统能100%召回事实，面对间接查询时准确率最高仅14.4%，而将记忆直接放入上下文可达84.0%，问题出在查询条件化的接口本身。
AI.motivation: 当前长期记忆系统默认假设"需要的记忆与查询相似"，但世界知识（如树坚果过敏与马卡龙的关系）打破了这一假设，现有评估无法区分"事实未存储"、"模型缺乏桥接知识"和"事实已存储但未检索到"三种情况。
AI.method: 构建InMind基准，包含125个专家验证任务，覆盖10个生活领域，其中113个任务基于可引用公开来源。通过配对对照实验分离三种失败解释，对比6种向量、图和智能体记忆系统，并使用8倍维度嵌入和最小诊断探针进行分析。
AI.result: 记忆在上下文中时准确率84.0%，需检索时最多仅14.4%（尽管直接回忆可达100%）；高维嵌入提升目标召回但对间接查询差距影响甚微；可见记忆探针恢复了大部分差距。
AI.conclusion: 问题根源在于查询条件化的接口本身，而非记忆存储或检索。核心开放问题是路由（routing）——决定哪些事实必须保持可见——这是InMind旨在评估的关键挑战。

title: CuraWeb: Joint Optimization of Quality, Redundancy, and Diversity for Web-Scale Pretraining Data
summary: Open-web corpora curated via highly selective filters, such as FineWeb-Edu and DCLM, constitute the core of LLM pretraining data and have significantly advanced LLM performance. However, these pipelines typically rely on singular optimization objectives, which inevitably narrows distributional diversity and marginalizes long-tail knowledge, thereby restricting data coverage and underutilizing the vast potential of the open web. To address this limitation, we propose a novel curation paradigm that shifts from linear pruning to the joint optimization of quality, redundancy, and diversity. This framework synergizes dual-track cleaning (rule-based and model-driven) with hybrid deduplication (n-gram and semantic), while employing a multi-objective sampler to balance informational quality with distributional breadth. Applying this framework to Common Crawl, we construct CuraWeb, a 2T-token English corpus. Unlike existing resources, CuraWeb establishes an industrial-grade standard for data curation by recovering a more holistic data distribution with enhanced diversity and minimal redundancy, achieving broader coverage of long-tail knowledge across diverse domains. Experimental evaluations at the 3B scale demonstrate that CuraWeb significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, yielding an average performance gain of 1.8\% across a wide range of benchmarks, particularly in knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种从线性剪枝转向质量、冗余和多样性联合优化的新数据策展范式CuraWeb，在Common Crawl上构建了2T token的英语语料库，通过双轨清洗、混合去重和多目标采样，在3B模型规模上平均提升1.8%性能。
AI.motivation: 现有开放网络语料库（如FineWeb-Edu、DCLM）依赖单一优化目标进行高度筛选，导致分布多样性收窄、长尾知识被边缘化，限制了数据覆盖范围和开放网络的潜在价值。
AI.method: 提出联合优化质量、冗余和多样性的新策展范式：双轨清洗（规则驱动+模型驱动）、混合去重（n-gram+语义）、多目标采样器以平衡信息质量和分布广度。
AI.result: 构建了CuraWeb（2T token英语语料库），在3B规模模型上平均性能提升1.8%，尤其在知识密集型和推理任务上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: CuraWeb建立了工业级数据策展标准，通过恢复更全面的数据分布、增强多样性并最小化冗余，实现了对跨领域长尾知识的更广覆盖。

title: WaveZip: Wavelet-Driven Space-Time Decoupling for Video Token Condensation
summary: Existing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) struggle with long-form video understanding due to the quadratic computational cost of visual tokens. While recent efficient methods attempt to compress tokens via hard pruning or uniform merging, they operate strictly in the spatial feature domain, where robust structural context and discriminative semantic details are inherently entangled. In this work, we propose WaveZip, a joint signal-frequency-domain framework for efficient video inference. Driven by the insight that temporal redundancy resides in low-pass approximation scales while spatial saliency strongly correlates with high-frequency components, WaveZip leverages Discrete Wavelet Transforms (DWT) to disentangle these signals. Temporally, it employs 1D DWT to analyze query-frame relevance, and the resulting high-frequency coefficients are further gated by inter-frame differences, with both signals jointly driving the dynamic allocation of a precise frame-level token budget. Spatially, a 2D DWT decomposes features into low-frequency approximations and high-frequency detail components, where the high-frequency coefficients are modulated within query-salient regions to regulate spatial reconstruction. Importantly, WaveZip requires no task-specific training and can be seamlessly integrated into off-the-shelf LVLMs to boost inference efficiency. Extensive experiments on long video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that WaveZip retains 99.6% of the full performance under an extreme 10x compression ratio, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: WaveZip提出了一种基于离散小波变换（DWT）的联合信号-频域框架，通过分离时空冗余与显著性信息，在不需额外训练的情况下实现高效长视频理解，在10倍压缩比下保留99.6%的完整性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLMs在长视频理解中因视觉token的二次方计算成本而效率低下，而现有压缩方法仅在空间特征域操作，难以解耦鲁棒的结构上下文与判别性语义细节。
AI.method: WaveZip采用联合信号-频域框架：时间上使用1D DWT分析查询帧相关性，高频系数经帧间差分门控后动态分配帧级token预算；空间上使用2D DWT分解为低频近似与高频细节，高频系数在查询显著区域内调制以调控空间重建。
AI.result: 在长视频理解基准上，WaveZip在10倍极端压缩比下保留了99.6%的完整性能，一致优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: WaveZip无需任务特定训练，可无缝集成到现有LVLMs中提升推理效率，验证了频域解耦策略在视频token压缩中的有效性。

title: Closed-Loop Validation-Repair for Healthcare Interoperability: A Multi-Model Study of Schema Compliance in Clinical LLMs
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
summary: Healthcare interoperability requires AI systems to produce structured outputs conforming to standardized schemas including ICD-10 for diagnostic coding, CPT for procedure billing, and HL7 FHIR for data exchange. While large language models demonstrate clinical reasoning capabilities, their integration into electronic health record systems faces a critical barrier: schema noncompliance. We evaluate three open-source models, Qwen2.5 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemma2 9B, via local deployment across 320 clinical scenarios spanning ten medical specialties, yielding 960 model-scenario pairs assessed under paired baseline and validation-repair conditions. First, schema noncompliance is consistent across the three model families, with baseline compliance rates ranging from 85.9 to 91.6 percent despite varying architectures and training data, suggesting shared gaps in medical training corpora rather than model-specific limitations. Second, 96 percent of validator-detected failures are representation-level format violations such as alternative medical abbreviations and code prefixes, indicating models follow clinical writing conventions but lack awareness of healthcare IT standards. Third, the validation-repair framework achieves 99.0 percent overall compliance, ranging from 98.4 to 99.4 percent across models, with most errors resolving within one or two iterations. Exact McNemar p-values below 0.001 and absolute improvements of 7.8 to 12.5 percentage points across model sizes confirm statistical significance. These results support closed-loop validation-repair as an effective system-level safeguard for healthcare interoperability, improving schema-level readiness for downstream clinical system integration.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三种开源LLM（Qwen2.5 7B、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemma2 9B）在320个临床场景中生成符合医疗标准（ICD-10、CPT、HL7 FHIR）结构化输出的能力。基线合规率为85.9-91.6%，96%的失败源于表示级格式违规。采用验证-修复框架后，整体合规率提升至99.0%，大多数错误在1-2次迭代内解决，统计显著性检验p<0.001。
AI.motivation: 医疗互操作性要求AI系统生成符合标准化模式（如ICD-10、CPT、HL7 FHIR）的结构化输出，但LLM在融入电子健康记录系统时面临模式不合规这一关键障碍。
AI.method: 本地部署三种开源模型，在320个临床场景（涵盖10个医学专业）上生成960个模型-场景对，分别在基线和验证-修复条件下评估。采用配对McNemar检验进行统计分析。
AI.result: 基线合规率85.9-91.6%，96%的失败为表示级格式违规（如替代缩写、代码前缀）。验证-修复框架将整体合规率提升至99.0%，绝对提升7.8-12.5个百分点，p<0.001。
AI.conclusion: 闭环验证-修复可作为医疗互操作性的有效系统级保障，提升下游临床系统集成的模式级就绪度。

title: Beyond Block Boundaries: Multi-Block Editing for Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Block diffusion has emerged as the dominant paradigm for scaling discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), because decoding text in fixed-size blocks preserves parallel generation within each block while keeping the quadratic attention cost tractable. However, this efficiency comes with a structural limitation: tokens near the end of a block are generated without access to future cross-block context, and once a block is finalized, its uncertain predictions become irreversible context for all subsequent blocks. This creates a block boundary problem, in which uncertainty accumulates toward block boundaries and early mistakes propagate throughout later generation. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Block Editing (MBE), to mitigate this problem by editing decoded tokens based on cross-block context. Following this principle, MBE first proposes a training-free decoding algorithm to edit the decoded tokens in previous blocks, which is achieved by re-opening a full-attention window over selected blocks. Given the mismatched attention mechanism between block diffusion training and MBE inference, MBE further introduces a supervised Fine-tuning strategy, which equips the model with bidirectional attention masks that progressively expands the editing span. Furthermore, it also extends SGLang with a multi-shape CUDA Graph pool and fine-grained KV cache control to make these variable-length editing passes efficient in practice. Experiments on LLaDA2.1-Mini across 13 benchmarks show that training-free MBE outperforms all existing decoding baselines while maintaining comparable throughput, and MBE SFT further brings a performance gain of 2.7. The largest improvements appear on tasks requiring strong long-range consistency, including +13.3 on AIME 2025 and +5.9 on ZebraLogic, demonstrating the effectiveness of MBE.

AI.tldr: 针对块扩散语言模型中存在的块边界问题（边界处不确定性累积和早期错误传播），提出多块编辑（MBE）方法，通过基于跨块上下文编辑已解码令牌来缓解该问题，包含无训练解码算法和监督微调策略，并在LLaDA2.1-Mini上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 块扩散语言模型在解码时，块内令牌无法获取跨块未来上下文，且块一旦确定后其不确定预测会成为后续块的不可逆上下文，导致块边界处不确定性累积和早期错误传播，即块边界问题。现有方法未能有效解决该结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 提出多块编辑（MBE）方法：1）无训练解码算法：通过重新打开选定块上的全注意力窗口来回编辑先前块中已解码的令牌；2）监督微调策略：采用逐步扩展编辑跨度的双向注意力掩码，使模型适应MBE推理时的注意力机制差异；3）工程优化：扩展SGLang，引入多形状CUDA图池和细粒度KV缓存控制，实现变长编辑的高效推理。
AI.result: 在LLaDA2.1-Mini上13个基准测试中，无训练MBE在所有现有解码基线中表现最优且保持可比吞吐量；MBE SFT进一步带来2.7的性能提升。在需要长程一致性的任务上改进最大，包括AIME 2025提升13.3，ZebraLogic提升5.9。
AI.conclusion: MBE有效解决了块扩散语言模型的块边界问题，通过跨块上下文编辑显著提升了长程一致性任务的性能，且训练自由版本在保持效率的同时超越现有解码基线，监督微调版本进一步带来实质性增益。

title: What CLIP Knows but Cannot Say: Recovering Negation from Frozen Intermediate Features
summary: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP map semantically opposite phrases (e.g., "a dog" vs. "not a dog") to nearly identical embeddings, rendering them insensitive to negation. We attribute this failure to a phenomenon we call Representational Collapse: by tracking compositional divergence and visual alignment across the CLIP text encoder, we show that middle layers build compositional syntax, but the final layers collapse this structure as visual alignment rises, producing a syntax-blind final representation. To recover the lost negation signal without altering pretrained weights, we propose PeakPatch, a lightweight post-hoc correction system that intercepts the encoder at its compositional peak. An Embedding Correction Network (ECN) uses cross-attention to extract a negation-specific signal from the peak layer, anchored to a stable baseline, and predicts a deviation vector that re-injects the lost syntax into the final-layer embedding space. A complementary Score Correction Network (SCN) predicts bounded scalar score offsets for discriminative tasks. Both modules are trained jointly end-to-end while all CLIP parameters remain frozen, adding only 5.2M parameters (3.5% of the backbone) and preserving the standard cosine similarity interface. On NegBench, PeakPatch achieves 74.3% on COCO MCQ (+35.1 over CLIP, +17.8 over the best encoder fine-tuning method) and 65.5% on VOC MCQ, while outperforming all fine-tuning baselines on fully out-of-distribution negation retrieval despite training only 3.5% of the parameters. The corrected embeddings also transfer to text-to-image generation (+18.4 negation score) and generalize across ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14, and SigLIP backbones. Project URL: https://stevencylu.github.io/PeakPatch/.

AI.tldr: 本文发现CLIP等对比视觉-语言模型由于"表征坍缩"现象——文本编码器中间层构建了组合语法结构，但最终层在提升视觉对齐时丢失了该结构——导致对否定语义（如"a dog" vs. "not a dog"）不敏感。为此提出PeakPatch，一种轻量级后处理校正系统，通过拦截编码器在组合峰值层的表示，利用嵌入校正网络(ECN)和分数校正网络(SCN)重新注入丢失的否定信号，仅增加3.5%参数即实现否定理解的大幅提升，在NegBench上超越所有微调基线。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉-语言模型无法区分语义相反的短语（如"a dog" vs. "not a dog"），因为它们的嵌入空间中将否定词和原词映射到几乎相同的表示，导致模型对否定结构完全不敏感。
AI.method: 提出PeakPatch：1) 识别文本编码器中的组合峰值层（compositional peak）；2) 嵌入校正网络(ECN)通过交叉注意力从峰值层提取否定特定信号，结合稳定基线预测偏差向量，重新注入最终层嵌入空间；3) 分数校正网络(SCN)预测有界标量分数偏移用于判别任务；4) 所有CLIP参数冻结，仅训练ECN和SCN共5.2M参数（骨干的3.5%），保持标准余弦相似度接口。
AI.result: 在NegBench上，COCO MCQ达74.3%（比CLIP高35.1，比最佳编码器微调方法高17.8），VOC MCQ达65.5%；在全分布外否定检索中超越所有微调基线；校正后的嵌入可迁移至文本到图像生成（否定分数提升18.4）；在ViT-B/32、ViT-L/14和SigLIP骨干上均有效。
AI.conclusion: CLIP的否定不敏感性源于表征坍缩——最终层为提升视觉对齐牺牲了中层构建的组合语法结构。PeakPatch通过轻量级后处理在保持CLIP参数冻结的情况下有效恢复否定信号，证明在冻结模型上的精确干预可以替代昂贵的全模型微调。

title: LEX-EC: A Lexical Evidence-Channel Audit Framework for Zero-Shot LLM Personality Classification in Black-Box Settings
summary: Large language models may easily assign personality labels from text, but model interpretability remains an open problem. To address this gap, we introduce LEX-EC, a reusable black-box audit framework combining prevalence and agreement diagnostics with controlled lexical ablation to distinguish marginal-distribution effects from trait-associated signal recoverable under restricted evidence. Using this framework, we illustrate how various text genres may exhibit sharply different profiles: free-form essay text contains the broadest, but still weak, signal; in graduate student introductions, an observable Extraversion association weakened after masking; and single Facebook statuses yield little stable evidence even in a trait-balanced sample, indicating a possible lower bound of content or length. Masking topical and demographic content weakened some associations while leaving others detectable from function words, affective terms, and cognitive-style vocabulary. Linguistic prompting shifted model self-explanations but did not eliminate topical content. LEX-EC jointly evaluates classification prevalence, item-level association, chance-corrected agreement, persistence under lexical restriction, and prompt sensitivity in model-generated explanations. Across datasets, models, and prompts, LEX-EC characterizes how trait associations may vary with available lexical evidence, introducing a novel application of lexical methods to black-box interpretability in personality labeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEX-EC框架，一种可复用的黑盒审计方法，通过结合流行率诊断、一致性诊断和受控词汇消融，区分边际分布效应与可恢复的特质关联信号。实验发现不同文本体裁的人格信号差异显著：自由作文信号最广但仍微弱；研究生自我介绍中外向性关联在掩码后减弱；单条Facebook状态即使样本平衡也几乎无稳定证据。词汇消融表明功能词、情感词和认知风格词汇保留部分信号，语言提示可改变模型自解释但无法消除主题内容。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能轻易从文本中分配人格标签，但模型可解释性仍是一个开放问题。现有方法难以区分人格分类中的边际分布效应与真实特质关联信号，缺乏系统性的黑盒审计框架。
AI.method: 提出LEX-EC（Lexical Evidence Controlling）可复用黑盒审计框架，包含四个核心组件：(1) 分类流行率诊断 (prevalence diagnostics)；(2) 项目级关联分析 (item-level association)；(3) 机会校正一致性评估 (chance-corrected agreement)；(4) 受控词汇消融 (controlled lexical ablation)，通过掩码（masking）去除特定词汇类别（如主题词、人口统计学词、功能词、情感词、认知风格词汇）来检验信号持续性。同时引入语言提示敏感性分析。
AI.result: (1) 不同体裁人格信号差异巨大：自由作文信号最广但仍微弱；ESSAY数据集中外向性关联经掩码后减弱；单条Facebook状态即使特质平衡样本也难以提取稳定证据。(2) 掩码主题和人口统计学内容削弱部分关联，但功能词、情感词和认知风格词汇仍可保留部分可检测信号。(3) 语言提示改变了模型自解释内容，但未能完全消除主题性内容。
AI.conclusion: LEX-EC框架能够联合评估分类流行率、项目级关联、机会校正一致性、词汇限制下的持久性以及提示敏感性，系统刻画人格特质关联如何随可用词汇证据而变化。该工作将词汇学方法创新性地应用于黑盒可解释性领域，为理解语言模型人格标签分配机制提供了新的分析工具。

title: Obliviate: Efficient Unlearning in Recommender Systems
summary: Machine unlearning is becoming increasingly critical in the context of data privacy regulations, particularly for recommendation systems that are directly trained on user interaction data. The goal of this work is to remove requested interaction data and their downstream influence from trained model while preserving recommendation quality, and to do so without incurring the substantial computational cost of full retraining. Existing approaches exhibit several limitations, including limited unlearning completeness and degradation in recommendation performance, while having substantial computational overhead. In this paper, we propose Obliviate, an efficient two-stage unlearning framework for recommender systems that achieves high unlearning completeness while maintaining good utility. In the first stage, we introduce a Low-Rank Unlearning Adapter (LUA), which employs a lightweight Hessian proxy to enable curvature-aware and efficient unlearning through localized low-rank adapters rather than full parameters. In the second stage, we propose Locality-Aware Calibration (LAC), a lightweight refinement stage that updates only the adapter parameters to improve the performance by enforcing unlearning via ranking-based objectives while preserving utility through knowledge distillation. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that Obliviate achieves high level of forgetting with minimal loss in recommendation quality and at significantly reduced computational cost, offering a practical and scalable solution for large-scale recommender systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Obliviate，一个两阶段高效遗忘学习框架，通过低秩遗忘适配器和局部感知校准，在推荐系统中实现高遗忘完整度与良好推荐质量，同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统的机器遗忘方法存在遗忘不彻底、推荐性能下降和计算开销大等问题，亟需一种高效且性能良好的遗忘学习方案。
AI.method: 分为两个阶段：1) 低秩遗忘适配器(LUA)，利用轻量级Hessian代理实现曲率感知的低秩局部遗忘；2) 局部感知校准(LAC)，通过基于排序的目标函数执行遗忘，并利用知识蒸馏保持效用，仅更新适配器参数。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明Obliviate实现了高水平的遗忘效果，推荐质量损失最小，计算成本显著降低。
AI.conclusion: Obliviate为大规模推荐系统提供了一种实用且可扩展的高效遗忘解决方案。

title: The Gate Always Closes: On Injecting Auxiliary Signals into Frozen Vision-Language Models
summary: Auxiliary signal pathways in VLMs are routinely fitted with learnable gates so the optimiser can decide how much of the signal to admit. We find that the optimiser almost always decides on zero: across five injection designs, every gated pathway becomes behaviourally closed, with accuracy invariant to ablating the pathway at inference even when the gate parameter would nominally pass 30-45% of the signal. We attribute this suppression phenomenon to two regimes, a dead-gradient regime formalised through the caption-invariance of image-derived signals, and a negative-utility regime in which the auxiliary signal actively hurts the loss. Rather than fight suppression, we exploit it: we regularise LoRA fine-tuning with geometric auxiliary losses from hyperbolic visual relational graphs (IoA-driven entailment cones and angular repulsion on the Lorentz manifold), coupled only through the forward pass at training time and dropped at inference. Disaggregating GQA by question type exposes a clean dissociation. Three configurations without geometric losses at inference lose 2.85-3.39pp on relational questions while gaining ~1pp on attribute questions; a fourth that trains with the losses but infers through a soft prompt loses 5.14pp on rel for only +0.23pp on attr, so training-time regularisation alone does not protect relational accuracy without a geometric inference pathway. Configurations that keep the geometric pathway at inference preserve vanilla-level relational accuracy and match the attribute gain. Out of distribution on VSR, the RMS-prefix recipe preserves the spatial signal; stripping the geometric losses (G2) collapses VSR by 4.6pp, isolating them as the OOD source. A secondary result: embedding-norm alignment is necessary for generation-safe prefix injection, and learnable gates should be replaced with fixed, non-optional injection at matched scales.

AI.tldr: 论文发现VLM中可学习的门控通路几乎总是被优化器关闭（即使门控参数显示通过30-45%信号），归因于死梯度与负效用两种机制。作者转而利用这一抑制现象：用双曲视觉关系图（基于IoA的蕴含锥和洛伦兹流形上的角排斥）的几何辅助损失来正则化LoRA微调，仅在训练时前向传播耦合，推理时丢弃。实验在GQA上按问题类型分解发现：无几何损失的配置在关系问题上损失2.85-3.39pp，属性问题增益~1pp；保持几何推理路径的配置保留了完整的关系准确率并匹配属性增益。在VSR的OOD测试中，RMS-prefix配方保留空间信号，去除几何损失（G2）导致VSR下降4.6pp。次要发现：嵌入范数对齐对生成安全的前缀注入是必要的，可学习门控应替换为固定、非可选的匹配尺度注入。
AI.motivation: 揭示VLM中可学习门控通路的抑制现象（优化器总是将门控关闭）及其机制（死梯度与负效用），并利用这一现象设计更有效的正则化方法，提升VLM在关系推理任务上的表现，同时保持属性任务的增益。
AI.method: 1) 实证发现可学习门控的抑制现象，通过caption不变性归因于死梯度机制，以及辅助信号损害损失的负效用机制；2) 提出用双曲视觉关系图的几何辅助损失（IoA驱动的蕴含锥和洛伦兹流形上的角排斥）正则化LoRA微调，仅在训练时耦合前向传播，推理时丢弃；3) RMS-prefix配方用于保持嵌入范数对齐；4) 用固定、非可选的匹配尺度注入替代可学习门控。
AI.result: 1) 无几何损失配置：关系问题下降2.85-3.39pp，属性问题增益~1pp；2) 训练时用几何损失但推理时通过软提示：关系问题下降5.14pp，属性仅+0.23pp；3) 保持几何推理路径的配置：保留完整关系准确率并匹配属性增益；4) VSR OOD测试中，去除几何损失（G2）导致下降4.6pp。
AI.conclusion: 可学习门控存在系统性的抑制现象，应被固定非可选注入替代；基于双曲几何的辅助损失在训练时提供有效正则化，且推理时保留几何路径对关系推理至关重要；RMS-prefix配方能有效保持OOD空间信号。

title: Grounding latent algorithm routing in transformer reasoning
summary: A central question in the in-context learning literature is whether transformers can organize episode-level adaptation around different inductive-bias families. We study this question in a controlled setting through latent algorithm routing: route-like behavior in which the solver-family preference changes with the latent data-generating regime while prompt form is held fixed, remains stable under nuisance perturbations, and is selectively influenced by targeted activation interventions without large losses in answer quality. We introduce ROUTEBENCH, a diagnostic benchmark whose regimes differentially favor global shrinkage, sparsity, robustness, and locality, operationalized by ridge-like, lasso-like, Huber-like, and kNN-like family representatives. Across dense decoder-only transformers trained from scratch at 44M-612M parameters, a 306M model closes 80.9 percent of the oracle-routing gap and achieves route F1 of 84.1. The effect remains substantial under natural-language renderings, shuffled supports, lexical paraphrases, and a unified four-way routing setting. Stronger adaptive alternatives, including an input-conditioned soft mixture and an unsupervised Gumbel router, narrow the gap but remain below the 306M and 612M models on route F1 and OOD performance. Probe controls and matched activation-patching controls further show that route-relevant internal directions are decodable and functionally involved in solver-family-consistent output behavior. These results provide controlled evidence that dense transformers trained on ROUTEBENCH can develop route-like internal variables, but they do not establish universal routing in pretrained language models or unrestricted natural-language reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入ROUTEBENCH诊断基准，证明密集解码器-only Transformer（306M参数）在潜在数据生成机制变化时，能发展出类似“算法路由”的内部变量，以80.9%的间隙缩小率和84.1的路由F1分实现不同归纳偏置族（全局收缩、稀疏性、鲁棒性、局部性）的自适应切换，且该行为在自然语言渲染、扰动和激活干预下保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 探究Transformer在上下文学习中是否能围绕不同归纳偏置族组织episode级别的适应行为，即是否具备“隐式算法路由”能力。
AI.method: 设计ROUTEBENCH诊断基准，包含四种数据生成机制（对应ridge、lasso、Huber、kNN四类算法）。训练来自随机初始化的密集decoder-only Transformer（44M-612M参数），评估其路由行为。通过自然语言渲染、支持集打乱、词汇改写等扰动进行鲁棒性测试。与输入条件软混合、无监督Gumbel路由器等强自适应基线对比。使用探针控制和激活补丁控制验证内部表征的功能参与性。
AI.result: 306M模型以80.9%缩小与oracle路由的差距，路由F1达84.1。该效果在自然语言渲染、打乱支持集、词汇改写及四路统一设定下保持显著。强自适应基线缩小了差距但在路由F1和OOD性能上仍低于306M和612M模型。探针和激活补丁控制表明路由相关的内部方向可解码且在功能上参与一致性的求解器族输出行为。
AI.conclusion: 密集Transformer在ROUTEBENCH上能发展出路由类内部变量，实现归纳偏置自适应切换，但该结果不证明预训练语言模型或无约束自然语言推理中存在通用路由能力。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous Sensor Selection in Maritime Surveillance
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, submitted to the IEEE MetroSea 2026 Conference: Special Session 13: Object Detection, Tracking, and Sensor Fusion for Maritime Situational Awareness
summary: This paper presents an information-gain-guided reinforcement-learning sensor-selection framework for single-vessel tracking in heterogeneous maritime sensor networks. The proposed approach is motivated by information-theoretic sensor management: instead of activating all sensors or repeatedly performing computationally expensive online expected-information-gain evaluation, a learned policy selects one tracking-relevant sensor at each decision epoch. A Bayesian sequential Monte Carlo tracker estimates the vessel state from noisy measurements and provides a belief representation for scheduling under nonlinear and non-Gaussian conditions. A Proximal Policy Optimization agent selects one of five sensors deployed in a georeferenced simulation of the CMMI Smart Marina testbed at Ayia Napa Marina, Cyprus. The agent observes belief-state, detection-history, coverage, sensor-geometry, and realized-information-gain features. The reward is defined as a realized-information-gain term gated by an observability mask. Final-test simulations compare the proposed framework with random single-sensor selection, always-on sensing using all sensors simultaneously, and the expected-information-gain sensor-selection baseline proposed in our previous work. Results show that the learned policy achieves tracking performance close to always-on sensing while activating only one sensor per decision time step and avoiding the computationally expensive online entropy search required by expected-information-gain selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种信息增益引导的强化学习传感器选择框架，用于异构海事传感器网络中的单船跟踪。该框架通过PPO代理学习选择策略，每次仅激活一个传感器，在保持接近全传感器跟踪性能的同时，避免了昂贵的在线期望信息增益计算。
AI.motivation: 传统方法要么激活所有传感器导致资源浪费，要么反复进行计算昂贵的在线期望信息增益评估。本文旨在通过学习策略实现高效传感器选择，在跟踪性能与计算开销之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯序贯蒙特卡洛跟踪器估计船舶状态并生成信念表示；PPO代理基于信念状态、检测历史、覆盖范围、传感器几何和实现信息增益等特征进行决策；每次决策仅选一个传感器，奖励由观测掩码门控的实现信息增益项定义。
AI.result: 在塞浦路斯阿依纳帕码头CMMI智能码头测试床的地参考仿真中，学习策略的跟踪性能接近全传感器同时激活的方式，同时每次仅激活一个传感器，且避免了期望信息增益选择所需的昂贵在线熵搜索。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了信息增益引导的强化学习传感器选择框架在异构海事传感器网络中的有效性，能以极低的计算成本实现接近最优的跟踪性能。

title: Explaining BiomedCLIP with Weighted Banzhaf Interactions Supported by Tree-Gram Parsing
comment: 12 pages, 13 figures. Accepted at EXPLIMED 2026 (Third Workshop on Explainable Artificial Intelligence for the medical domain), IJCAI-ECAI 2026
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are demonstrating significant capabilities in medical tasks like radiology analysis, yet providing faithful and interpretable explanations remains a key consideration for their responsible deployment in clinical settings. However, existing explanation methods, such as the widely used FIxLIP framework, often struggle with the fine-grained nature of modern tokenizers. The tokenization problem fragments clinical concepts---splitting terms like "saddle embolus" into scattered, meaningless subwords---which leads to noisy, semantically incoherent cross-modal attributions. Such fragmentation also results in a combinatorial explosion of interaction possibilities, obscuring the model's true reasoning. To address this, we introduce ParseFIxLIP, an extension that incorporates the Tree-Gram Parsing into the Banzhaf interaction game used by FIxLIP. This semantically informed strategy utilizes dependency parsing trees to define explanation players by grouping related text tokens into semantically coherent units. Our smart_depth grouping strategy, merging tokens according to spaCy token dependency tree, successfully mitigates concept fragmentation, yielding substantially more interpretable cross-modal interactions by unifying complex medical concepts. Quantitatively, while baselines struggled with the high dimensionality of long captions, our parsing approach maintained statistical robustness and semantic parsimony. Qualitative analysis on BiomedCLIP, validated on medical imagery (ROCOv2) and general examples, confirms that the approach accurately captures the synergistic influence of grouped words on model predictions. In conclusion, our work offers intuitive and clinically relevant insights into VLM decision-making, fulfilling the critical need for coherent explanations in the medical domain.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉-语言模型在医学影像分析中因分词器导致的临床概念碎片化（如"saddle embolus"被拆散）及交互组合爆炸问题，提出ParseFIxLIP框架，通过集成树形语法解析（Tree-Gram Parsing）将相关文本标记按依赖树聚合为语义单元，从而在Banzhaf博弈中生成更连贯、可解释的跨模态归因，并在BiomedCLIP模型和ROCOv2数据集上验证了其统计鲁棒性和语义简洁性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLMs医学解释方法（如FIxLIP）受限于现代分词器的细粒度特性，导致临床术语被碎片化为无意义的子词，产生噪声化、语义不连贯的跨模态归因，同时引发交互可能性的组合爆炸，掩盖了模型的真实推理过程。
AI.method: 提出ParseFIxLIP，在FIxLIP的Banzhaf交互博弈中引入Tree-Gram Parsing：利用spaCy依存句法树的smart_depth分组策略，将相关的文本标记合并为语义连贯的单元作为博弈的"玩家"，从而缓解概念碎片化并减少无效组合。
AI.result: 在BiomedCLIP模型和ROCOv2医学图像数据集的实验中，ParseFIxLIP保持统计鲁棒性与语义简洁性，克服了基线方法在高维长字幕上的困难；定性分析显示该方法能准确捕捉分组词汇对模型预测的协同影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为医学领域提供了直观且临床相关的VLM决策解释，满足了连贯性解释的关键需求。

title: SINT-Flow: Schema Integration using Large Language Model Workflows
summary: The goal of schema integration is, given a set of input schemata or tables, to derive a global, unified schema that is able to represent the concepts, attributes, and relationships of all input tables in a coherent fashion. This paper presents SINT-Flow, a schema integration framework composed of five LLM-based operators that can be combined into workflows to perform fully automated, end-to-end schema integration. In contrast to existing approaches, SINT-Flow can process denormalized source tables that contain attributes describing multiple entity types. During the schema integration process, these tables are decomposed into separate entity-specific relations. To evaluate SINT-Flow, we introduce SINT-Bench, a schema integration benchmark comprising 10 schema integration tasks consisting of altogether 93 relational tables, including tables that describe multiple types of entities. We evaluate SINT-Flow using GPT-5.2 as well as the open-weight model Qwen-3.6-27B as alternative backbone models. Using these models, SINT-Flow achieves F1 scores of at least 96% for entity-type detection, 85% for attribute detection, and 83% for schema mapping. Furthermore, we perform an ablation study to prove the utility of the applied self-consistency strategy as well as the inclusion of a review loop into the schema matching operator.

AI.tldr: SINT-Flow是一个基于LLM的自动化模式集成框架，包含五个算子，可处理非规范化的源表并将其分解为实体特定的关系。配合SINT-Bench基准测试（10个任务，93张表），使用GPT-5.2和Qwen-3.6-27B模型，在实体类型检测、属性检测和模式映射上分别达到96%、85%和83%以上的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 现有模式集成方法无法有效处理包含多实体类型属性的非规范化源表，且缺乏全自动端到端的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SINT-Flow框架，包含五个基于LLM的算子（可组合为工作流），将非规范化表分解为实体特定的关系模式；同时构建SINT-Bench基准测试集用于评估。
AI.result: 使用GPT-5.2和Qwen-3.6-27B，实体类型检测F1≥96%，属性检测F1≥85%，模式映射F1≥83%。消融实验验证了自一致性策略和审查循环的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SINT-Flow实现了全自动端到端模式集成，尤其在处理非规范化表方面优于现有方法，且对开源模型也具有良好的适用性。

title: AIR-BENCH Live: An Evolving Safety Benchmark for Foundation Models
summary: Foundation-model safety benchmarks capture the AI risks of their time of publication: as models improve and governments pass new AI-safety legislation, their risk taxonomies become incomprehensive and their attack prompts become ineffective. We present AIR-BENCH Live, a self-evolving successor to AIR-BENCH 2024. An automated update pipeline monitors government regulation and classifies new policies against the current four-tier risk taxonomy, either matching them to existing categories or proposing new granular categories. Then, a multi-agent, persona-driven prompt generation algorithm generates realistic, multilingual prompts with minimal human review, leaving room for improvement with modern jail breaking techniques. This algorithm is used to overhaul legacy prompts and generate prompts for new categories. In our current version, the pipeline has expanded the benchmark from 314 to 335 granular risks, with the 21 new categories drawing from 31 truly novel policy clauses across seven jurisdictions. Evaluating 14 recent models, we find a wide safety spread (from 0.17 to 0.89 among the models judged on their own behavior), that the modernized prompts are on average 0.06 points harder than the 2024 set, with the largest drops concentrated among the most compliant models, and that most models are modestly less safe on non-English prompts. By continuously absorbing new regulation and regenerating prompts, AIR-BENCH Live is designed to evolve alongside a fast-moving field.

AI.tldr: AIR-BENCH Live 是一个自我演进的 AI 安全基准，通过自动化流程持续监控政府法规、更新风险分类（从314类扩展到335类），并利用多智能体提示生成算法产生多语言攻击提示，使基准测试能够随领域发展而同步进化。
AI.motivation: 传统基础模型安全基准只能反映发布时的AI风险状况，随着模型能力提升和新AI安全法规出台，现有风险分类变得不全面，攻击提示也失效，因此需要一种能够持续演进的基准。
AI.method: 采用自动化更新流程：(1) 持续监控政府法规并将新政策匹配到现有四层风险分类或提议新类别；(2) 多智能体、角色驱动的提示生成算法，生成逼真的多语言提示，支持现代越狱技术。将基准从314类扩展至335类，新增21个类别源自7个司法管辖区的31个新政策条款。
AI.result: 评估14个近期模型发现：安全得分范围广（0.17~0.89）；现代化提示平均比2024版难0.06分，得分下降主要集中在最合规的模型上；多数模型在非英语提示上安全性略低。
AI.conclusion: AIR-BENCH Live 通过持续吸收新法规和重新生成提示，设计为能够与快速发展的AI安全领域共同演进，保持基准测试的时效性和有效性。

title: UltraViT: Latency-Optimized On-device Vision Encoder for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) remain bottlenecked by massive computational footprints, precluding their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. While efforts to compress LVLMs focus heavily on vision token reduction or smaller language models, the vision encoder is largely overlooked, typically deployed as a monolithic, computationally heavy feature extractor. Moreover, there is no previous effort that designs a vision encoder for LVLMs directly optimized for on-device latency. In this paper, we present UltraViT, a vision encoder for LVLMs, explicitly designed and optimized for on-device performance. Specifically, by taking into account real on-device latencies, we systematically design a pyramidal architecture that strategically integrates and adapts heterogeneous spatial mixers at the macro-block level. Furthermore, to pre-train UltraViT, we propose a novel two-stage generative pre-training strategy: cultivating rich spatial features via dense distillation, followed by direct generative supervision from a capacity-mixed frozen LLM. Compared to standard contrastive and SSL, we show that our pre-training is much more effective for achieving high-level semantic grounding for UltraViT needed for the subsequent generative multimodal alignment of LVLM training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our on-device latency-informed design combined with our tailored training strategy establishes a new state-of-the-art for efficient LVLM encoding, significantly outperforming existing encoder-centric baselines while operating on-device at nearly 1.7xthe speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UltraViT，一种专为边缘设备优化的LVLM视觉编码器，采用金字塔架构与异构空间混合器设计，并结合两阶段生成式预训练策略（密集蒸馏+生成式监督），在保持1.7倍速度提升的同时显著优于现有编码器基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM压缩工作主要集中在视觉token缩减或小型语言模型上，而视觉编码器作为计算密集型模块被忽视，且缺乏直接针对设备端延迟优化的编码器设计。
AI.method: 系统性地设计金字塔架构，在宏块层面集成和调整异构空间混合器；提出两阶段生成式预训练：第一阶段通过密集蒸馏培养丰富空间特征，第二阶段使用容量混合的冻结LLM进行直接生成式监督。
AI.result: 在设备端以近1.7倍的速度运行，显著优于现有的编码器中心基线，建立了高效LVLM编码的新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 设备端延迟感知的设计结合定制训练策略，为资源受限场景下的LVLM视觉编码提供了更优方案，验证了生成式预训练相比对比学习和自监督学习对语义对齐更有效。

title: Systematic Analysis of Large Language Models and Transformer-Based Machine Translation for English-Tamil and Tamil-English Across Diverse Datasets
summary: The challenge of Machine Translation for low resource languages such as Tamil is primarily caused by the restricted amount of parallel data for these languages, as well as their substantial amount of domain variation and morphological complexity. This research presents the comprehensive evaluation of the performance of several multilingual translation models on English-Tamil and Tamil-English translations across multiple datasets: NTREX, EnTamV2, WikiMatrix and PMIndia. This study evaluates supervised NMT systems, NLLB and mBART, using both the BLEU and chrF metric, and examines how these systems perform on data of different quality levels and domains. This performs an attention-based analysis to increase model interpretability by visualising the alignments of tokens in an English source text and their Tamil translations and vice-versa to provide insight into how they make translations. This study also demonstrates that using in-context prompting can provide an excellent way to perform a few-shot translation of English to Tamil and Tamil-English using a Tamil capable TamilLaMA model, and compare this to supervised approaches qualitatively. These findings show that the quality of the datasets and their alignment with the domain will greatly affect the performance of the model, that attention-based mechanisms can aid in explain ability, and that few-shot large language models can still produce structurally coherent translations of Tamil.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了多种多语言翻译模型（NLLB、mBART、TamilLaMA）在低资源语言泰米尔语上的英-泰和泰-英翻译性能，分析了数据质量、领域匹配、注意力机制可解释性以及少样本提示学习的效果。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（如泰米尔语）的机器翻译面临平行数据匮乏、领域变化大、形态复杂等挑战，亟需系统评估现有模型在这些困难条件下的实际表现与可解释性。
AI.method: 在NTREX、EnTamV2、WikiMatrix、PMIndia四个数据集上，使用BLEU和chrF指标评估监督NMT系统（NLLB、mBART），进行注意力可视化分析以提升可解释性，并利用TamilLaMA模型通过上下文提示（in-context prompting）实现少样本翻译，与监督方法进行定性比较。
AI.result: 数据集质量和领域匹配度显著影响模型性能；注意力机制有助于提升模型可解释性；少样本大语言模型（TamilLaMA）仍能生成结构连贯的泰米尔语翻译。
AI.conclusion: 针对低资源语言翻译，高质量、领域匹配的数据至关重要；注意力可视化是理解模型翻译行为的有效工具；少样本大语言模型可作为监督方法的补充方案。

title: How LLM Task-Adaptation Reshapes Alignment: A Multi-dimensional Study of Behavioral and Representational Drift
summary: Post-training is a key mechanism for adapting large language models to downstream tasks. While prior work suggests that task adaptation can alter a model's pre-existing alignment, especially its safety behavior, its broader effects across alignment domains remain poorly understood. We address this gap through a systematic evaluation of representative task-adaptation methods, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), KL-regularized SFT, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) across 15 alignment aspects spanning six key domains: safety, factuality, stance stability, social harm, controllability, and instructability. Our results reveal that post-training does not reshape alignment uniformly. RLVR improves task performance while inducing comparatively small, but non-zero, metric-specific shifts, while SFT leads to substantially larger alignment drift across domains. KL regularization mitigates this effect: stronger reference-model anchoring reduces alignment drift from the baseline, although KL-SFT still falls short of RLVR in preserving alignment. Representation-level analysis further supports this pattern, with shifts in alignment-relevant representations tracking behavioral drift. Together, these results show that task adaptation is not merely a capability-improving step, but an alignment intervention in its own right, motivating multi-dimensional alignment evaluation as a standard component of post-training pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了后训练（SFT、KL-SFT、RLVR）对LLM在6大领域15个对齐维度上的影响，发现RLVR在提升任务性能的同时对对齐影响最小，SFT导致显著对齐漂移，KL正则化可缓解但效果不如RLVR，表明任务适应本身即是对齐干预。
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注任务适应对安全行为的影响，但对其在更广泛对齐域（如事实性、立场稳定性、社会危害、可控性、可指令性等）中的综合效应缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 系统评估三种代表性后训练方法（SFT、KL正则化SFT、RLVR）在6个关键对齐域共15个对齐维度上的表现，并结合表征层级分析进行验证。
AI.result: RLVR在提升任务性能的同时仅引起较小但非零的指标特异性偏移；SFT导致显著的对齐漂移；KL正则化可缓解该漂移，但效果仍不及RLVR；表征层级的对齐偏移与行为漂移一致。
AI.conclusion: 任务适应本质上是一种对齐干预，而非单纯的能力提升步骤，建议将多维对齐评估作为后训练管道的标准组成部分。

title: Omni-Prune: Query-Aware Unified Token Pruning for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models
summary: Omnimodal large language models (OmniLLMs) are rapidly extending multimodal reasoning to cover synchronized audio and video. However, the resulting audio-video token sequences are long, leading to high prefill latency and GPU memory usage at inference time. Existing token pruning methods, designed mainly for vision-only inputs, miss both the cross-modal links between audio and video and the user query that decides which content matters. To bridge this gap, we present Omni-Prune, a training-free, query-aware audio-visual token pruning framework that jointly removes redundancy from both modalities while keeping task-relevant cross-modal evidence. Specifically, Omni-Prune first splits the token sequence into adaptive time windows placed at audio saliency peaks, then scores audio and video tokens on a single scale that combines encoder attention with text-query relevance, and pairs related audio-video tokens so that they are kept together. Within each window, a final K-medoids step then selects a few representative tokens, adding diverse cues that score-based selection alone would miss. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-Prune outperforms established baseline methods, delivering up to 3.25x prefill speedup and 1.3x memory reduction while retaining over 99% of full-model performance.

AI.tldr: Omni-Prune是一种无需训练、查询感知的音视频令牌剪枝框架，通过自适应时间窗口、联合评分和K-medoids聚类，在保持99%以上性能的同时实现高达3.25倍的预填充加速和1.3倍内存缩减。
AI.motivation: 全模态大语言模型（OmniLLMs）处理同步音视频时产生长令牌序列，导致高预填充延迟和GPU内存消耗。现有令牌剪枝方法主要针对纯视觉输入设计，缺乏跨模态关联和查询感知能力。
AI.method: 1) 将令牌序列分割为基于音频显著性峰值的自适应时间窗口；2) 结合编码器注意力与文本查询相关性，在统一尺度上对音频和视频令牌评分；3) 配对相关的音视频令牌以确保同步保留；4) 在每个窗口内使用K-medoids选择代表性令牌，引入评分选择忽略的多样性线索。
AI.result: 优于现有基线方法，实现3.25倍预填充加速和1.3倍内存缩减，同时保持超过99%的完整模型性能。
AI.conclusion: Omni-Prune通过查询感知的跨模态令牌剪枝，有效解决了OmniLLMs推理效率问题，且无需额外训练。

title: From transcription to semantic corpus analysis: unsupervised learning of sentence representations for ancient languages
summary: Automatic Text Recognition (ATR) now supplies digital humanities with large volumes of unstructured, heterogeneous, and often noisy text in ancient languages. Downstream semantic analysestext reuse identification, alignment, and semantic search-rely on sentence embeddings, yet existing methods transfer poorly to ancient languages: generic multilingual encoders underperform, specialized language models yield anisotropic representation spaces, and labeled similarity data is unavailable. We study two fully unsupervised strategies - TSDAE and contrastive sentence embedding (CSE) - that adapt a specialized token-level language model into a corpus-specific sentence encoder using only raw sentences. On the philologically central case of biblical reuse in patristic literature (2,935 expert-verified parallels in Latin and Ancient Greek, from Augustine, Jerome, and Athanasius), we decompose reuse identification into two separately evaluated tasks-binary detection and correspondence retrieval-and benchmark the adapted encoders against multilingual, specialized, distilled, and supervised fine-tuned baselines, as well as on artificially noised data simulating HTR artifacts and scribal abbreviations. The adapted encoders outperform all baselines on both tasks, with complementary profiles: TSDAE leads detection given a large in-domain corpus, while CSE leads retrieval, reaches its optimum with as few as 4-8k raw in-domain sentences-a few tens of seconds of training on a laptop GPU-and transfers across works and authors, including to noisy post-ATR text when retrained directly on it. UMAP atlases relate the geometric effect of each strategy to the measured gains, and the full pipeline-segmentation, fine-tuning, cross-corpus semantic search-is made available to non-specialists through the online tool Paraphrasis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种无监督策略（TSDAE和对比句嵌入CSE），用于将专门化的古语言词级语言模型适应为语料库特定的句子编码器，在教父文学中圣经引用的检测与检索任务上，显著优于多语言、专门化、蒸馏和监督微调基线模型，并在噪声数据（模拟HTR伪影和抄写缩写）上表现稳健。完整流程通过在线工具Paraphrasis提供给非专业用户。
AI.motivation: 自动文本识别（ATR）为数字人文学科提供了大量古语言文本，但下游语义分析（文本复用识别、对齐和语义搜索）依赖的句子嵌入方法在古语言上效果不佳：通用多语言编码器性能不足，专门语言模型产生各向异性的表示空间，且缺乏有标签的相似性数据。
AI.method: 研究了两种完全无监督的策略——TSDAE（基于去噪自编码的句子嵌入）和对比句嵌入（CSE），利用原始句子将专门化的词级语言模型适应为语料库特定的句子编码器。在拉丁语和古希腊语的教父文献（奥古斯丁、杰罗姆、阿塔纳修斯）中2,935个专家验证的圣经引用平行句对上，将文本复用识别分解为二分类检测和对应检索两个任务，并与多语言、专门化、蒸馏和监督微调基线对比，同时在模拟HTR伪影和抄写缩写的噪声数据上进行评估。
AI.result: 适应后的编码器在两个任务上均优于所有基线：TSDAE在拥有大规模领域内语料时在检测任务上领先，而CSE在检索任务上领先，且仅需4-8k条原始领域内句子（在笔记本GPU上训练几十秒）即可达到最优，并能在不同作品和作者间迁移。UMAP可视化揭示了每种策略的几何效应与性能提升之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 无监督适应策略能有效解决古语言句子嵌入问题，为数字人文学科提供了实用且高效的文本复用分析工具。完整的处理流程（分割、微调、跨语料库语义搜索）已通过在线工具Paraphrasis向非专业用户开放。

title: DOSA: A Tree-Guided, Self-Regressive Framework for Long Document Structure Analysis
summary: In visually-rich documents, information is encoded not only in individual page objects such as tables, headers, and text blocks, but also in the structural relations among them, making document structure analysis fundamental to information retrieval and document understanding. However, accurately inferring such relations remains challenging in multi-page documents with long-range dependencies and heterogeneous layouts. To address this, we propose a tree-guided and self-regressive framework, termed DOcument Structure Analyzer (DOSA), for inferring relations among page objects and reconstructing document-level semantic trees. DOSA processes documents chunk-by-chunk, fusing visual, textual, and layout features for each page object and predicting hierarchical and ordering relations. The predicted relations are used to incrementally construct a semantic tree, which is then leveraged as structural context to guide inference on subsequent chunks. Experimental results on five benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of DOSA, with improvements of up to 4 F1 points and 19 TEDS points on DocHieNet, the most challenging multi-page hierarchy benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出了DOSA，一种树引导的自回归框架，通过逐块处理多页文档并构建语义树来推断页面对象间的关系，在多个基准上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 多页文档中页面对象间存在长距离依赖和异构布局，准确推断结构关系非常困难，现有方法未充分利用已推断的结构信息来指导后续推理。
AI.method: 提出DOSA框架，逐块处理文档，融合视觉、文本和布局特征，预测层级关系和排序关系；利用预测关系增量式构建语义树，并将树结构作为上下文指导后续块的推理。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上验证了有效性，在最具挑战性的多页层级基准DocHieNet上F1提升4点，TEDS提升19点。
AI.conclusion: 树引导的自回归框架能有效利用已推断的结构信息改善多页文档的结构分析效果。

title: Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification with Prompt-S6 and Semantic-Aware Knowledge Guidance
comment: Accepted by IEEE TIP 2026. The version of record may differ slightly
summary: Multi-modal object Re-Identification (ReID) aims to retrieve specific objects by integrating complementary information from multiple modalities. However, existing multi-modal ReID methods do not effectively address background interference suppression or achieve tri-modal alignment, instead focusing on pairwise feature fusion. Moreover, many current aggregation approaches suffer from high computational complexity. To address these limitations, we propose PRISM, a novel multi-modal ReID framework built upon Prompt-S6 (PS6) and semantic-aware knowledge guidance. PS6 maintains the linear complexity and strong sequence modeling capability of Mamba while enabling efficient cross-modal interaction. Leveraging these advantages, we design two key components: Semantic-Driven Token Pruning (SDTP) and Progressive Fusion Network (PFN). Parsing semantic priors from the segmentation foundation models, the SDTP then leverages these priors and applies dynamic token pruning to suppress background noise and refine feature representations. The PFN progressively aggregates multi-modal features to achieve tri-modal alignment and fully exploit modality complementarity. With the proposed modules, PRISM generates more robust multi-modal representations under complex scenarios. Extensive experiments on four multi-modal object ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach. The source code is available at https://github.com/zw-absin/PRISM.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个基于Prompt-S6和语义感知知识引导的多模态目标ReID框架，通过语义驱动令牌剪枝（SDTP）抑制背景噪声，利用渐进融合网络（PFN）实现三模态对齐，在保持Mamba线性复杂度的同时实现高效跨模态交互，在四个基准数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法未能有效抑制背景干扰，未实现三模态对齐，仅聚焦于双模态特征融合，且许多聚合方法计算复杂度高。
AI.method: 提出PRISM框架，基于Prompt-S6（PS6）保持线性复杂度与序列建模能力；设计语义驱动令牌剪枝（SDTP）利用分割基础模型的语义先验动态剪枝令牌以抑制背景噪声；设计渐进融合网络（PFN）逐步聚合多模态特征实现三模态对齐。
AI.result: 在四个多模态目标ReID基准数据集上验证了方法的有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过SDTP和PFN生成了更鲁棒的多模态表征，有效解决了背景干扰和三模态对齐问题。

title: From Data to Device: ELMOD An Efficient German-First 2.7B Language Model for Mobile Inference
summary: We present ELMOD - Efficient Language Model for On-Device Deployment - a compact (2.7B) German language model designed for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. ELMOD was trained on a limited computational budget (55k H100 GPU hours) using exclusively publicly available data. We developed a suite of German-specific data pre-processing, which differ from English-oriented counterparts in their handling of morphological variation, compounding, and orthographic conventions.
