Furthermore, we introduced a quality filtering and rephrasing step, which increased the instructional quality of the data, improved performance during the annealing phase, and reduced overall compute requirements. Thanks to our architectural model and data choices, including prefiltering, our educational-quality filtering and rephrasal to raise the educational-quality, ELMOD is the strongest performer in its size class (<3B), matching the performance of 7B-parameter models in German.

AI.tldr: ELMOD是一个2.7B参数的高效德语语言模型，在有限计算预算下使用公开数据训练，通过德语专用数据预处理、质量过滤与改写技术，在<3B参数规模中表现最强，性能匹配7B模型。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的硬件上实现高效德语推理，弥补现有模型对德语形态变化、复合词和正字法惯例处理不足的问题。
AI.method: 1) 德语专用数据预处理管道（处理形态变化、复合词、正字法）；2) 质量过滤与改写步骤提升指令数据质量；3) 在55K H100 GPU小时有限预算下训练2.7B参数模型。
AI.result: 在<3B参数规模中表现最强，德语性能匹配7B参数模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对性的数据预处理和质量提升策略，可以在有限计算资源下训练出高效的小参数模型，在特定语言任务上超越更大模型。

title: A Vocabulary for Multi-Agent Automated Research Systems
summary:
We introduce a vocabulary for automated research systems built from one or more agents to make their design choices easier to describe and compare. The vocabulary specifies 1) who the agents are, 2) what operations are available in the system, 3) who may invoke them, 4) how agents communicate, 5) what information is visible within and across runs, 6) how the next action is chosen, 7) how a run begins, and 8) how outputs are evaluated. A trajectory records one run from the input task to the returned artifact. Because agents, operations, and initialization may be stochastic, repeated runs on the same task induce a distribution over trajectories rather than a single behavior.
  Our vocabulary turns structural design questions, such as when agents should communicate, gain or lose a capability, or carry information across runs, into testable choices. It also makes the evaluator a component of the system, since reported gains depend on how closely the proxy score matches true quality. That separation also splits the vague complaint that these systems lack taste into two failures with different solutions. Generative taste is the rate at which a system proposes novel trajectories before any score is observed, and evaluative taste is the gap between the proxy score and the quality it should match. We instantiate the vocabulary on recent autoresearch systems to illustrate that it covers designs that differ widely in structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套用于描述和比较自动化科研系统的统一词汇表，涵盖智能体、操作、通信、信息可见性、行动选择等8个关键维度，并区分了"生成品味"与"评估品味"两种失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化科研系统设计多样，缺乏统一的描述框架，导致不同系统间的设计选择难以进行比较和复现，阻碍了该领域的系统化发展。
AI.method: 定义了一个包含8个维度的词汇体系：1)智能体身份、2)可用操作、3)操作调用权限、4)智能体通信方式、5)信息可见性（运行内/跨运行）、6)下一步动作选择机制、7)运行初始化方式、8)输出评估方法。轨迹记录从输入任务到产出工件的完整过程，多次运行形成轨迹分布。
AI.result: 该词汇表将结构设计问题（如通信时机、能力增减、跨运行信息传递）转化为可检验的选择；将评估器纳入系统组件；揭示了"生成品味"（提出新轨迹的速率）和"评估品味"（代理分数与真实质量的差距）两种不同的失败模式；并在多种现有自动科研系统上验证了其覆盖能力。
AI.conclusion: 该词汇表为自动化科研系统的比较和设计提供了规范化框架，有助于将关于系统"缺乏品味"的模糊批评分解为可针对性解决的具体问题，推动该领域的系统化研究。

title: Robust 6-DoF Object Pose Tracking with Built-In Recovery under Occlusions and Rapid Object Motions
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Real-time 6-DoF object pose tracking is essential for many robotics applications, and several approaches exist. Yet even today's approaches remain unreliable under temporary full occlusions and rapid object motions. Once tracking is lost, most methods struggle to detect the failure and recover automatically, often requiring manual re-initialization. In this paper, we address the problem of robust model-based 6-DoF tracking of unseen objects from RGB-D data, especially in scenarios with occlusion and fast motion. We propose a novel method that combines efficient learning-based keypoint matching with optimization-based alignment and introduces a novel failure detection and recovery module. Our system monitors pose reliability, detects tracking divergence or occlusions, and performs a global re-detection and pose estimation step that robustly verifies recovery candidates before resuming tracking. Our evaluation on standard tracking benchmarks and on a new dataset of occluded and fast-moving scenes shows that our method matches state-of-the-art accuracy on easy tracking sequences, maintains high tracking speed at 57.6 frames per second, and provides the most robust tracking performance under challenging conditions. Thus, we believe that our approach is a relevant step forward in robust 6-DoF object tracking from RGB-D data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合学习型关键点匹配与优化对齐的RGB-D 6-DoF物体追踪方法，并引入故障检测与恢复模块，在遮挡和快速运动场景下实现了鲁棒追踪，速度达57.6 FPS。
AI.motivation: 现有6-DoF物体追踪方法在完全遮挡和快速运动下不可靠，一旦丢失轨迹难以自动检测和恢复，往往需要手动重新初始化。
AI.method: 结合高效的学习型关键点匹配与优化对齐，提出新颖的故障检测与恢复模块：监控位姿可靠性，检测追踪发散或遮挡，执行全局重检测与位姿估计，稳健验证恢复候选后恢复追踪。
AI.result: 在标准追踪基准和新的遮挡/快速运动数据集上，匹配最先进精度，保持57.6 FPS的高速追踪，在挑战性条件下提供最鲁棒的追踪性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法是在RGB-D数据上实现鲁棒6-DoF物体追踪的重要进步。

title: D-Score: A Spectral Hidden-State Signal for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models can produce fluent text that is false, unsupported by the available evidence, or inconsistent with information that appears to be internally represented by the model. We study hallucination detection from the geometry of hidden activations and introduce the D-Score, a simple spectral statistic computed from a single forward pass. For a fixed model, layer, and tolerance parameter, the D-Score counts how many singular directions of the hidden activation matrix have singular values that remain close to the leading one. We use this quantity as a hallucination score, classifying an input text as hallucinated when its D-Score is larger than a pre-defined quantity. The motivation is that, when a model processes a text that conflicts with information available in its own internal state, the hidden representation may encode both the asserted content and some form of counter-evidence, uncertainty, correction, or lack of support; this can make the hidden trajectory spread across additional singular directions. We formalize this intuition through a lightweight spectral argument and evaluate the resulting detector on FAVA-Annotation and RAGTruth. The experiments indicate that the D-Score is a strong hidden-state signal for hallucination detection, while requiring no external verifier, no retrieval step, and no multiple generations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D-Score，一种基于隐藏激活几何结构的谱统计量，用于单次前向传播中检测大语言模型的幻觉。当模型处理与其内部状态冲突的文本时，隐藏表示会沿额外奇异方向扩散，D-Score通过计算奇异值接近主导奇异值的奇异方向数量来量化这一现象，从而判别幻觉。实验在FAVA-Annotation和RAGTruth上验证了其有效性，无需外部验证器、检索步骤或多轮生成。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的流畅文本可能存在虚假、无证据支持或与模型内部表征信息不一致的问题（即幻觉），需要一种高效且不依赖外部资源的检测方法。
AI.method: 从隐藏激活的几何结构出发，定义D-Score：对于固定模型、层和容差参数，计算隐藏激活矩阵中奇异值接近主导奇异值的奇异方向数量。当模型处理与内部状态冲突的文本时，隐藏表征会沿额外奇异方向扩散，D-Score增大。通过轻量谱论证形式化该直觉，将D-Score作为幻觉分数（超过预设阈值则判定为幻觉）。
AI.result: 在FAVA-Annotation和RAGTruth数据集上的实验表明，D-Score是强有效的隐藏状态信号，用于幻觉检测。
AI.conclusion: D-Score作为一种基于单次前向传播的谱统计量，能有效检测幻觉，且无需外部验证器、检索步骤或多轮生成，具有高效性和实用性。

title: Imprompt: A Language Framework for Prompt Programming
summary: With the unprecedented success of Language Models (LMs), the science of Prompt Engineering has evolved the powerful idea of Prompt Programming, where prompts are treated as a programmable control surface for describing complex tasks and leveraging LM capabilities. However, existing prompt programming frameworks suffer from various complexities and inelegances, which make them hard to utilize in practice for effectively describing tasks. We propose Imprompt, a new language framework for the study and practice of prompt programming. We undertake a foundational investigation of prompt programming, and contend that prompt programs must contain only the task descriptions and must be decoupled from lower-level 'execution' details. We further develop this position by illustrating structured prompting as a combination of prompt programming and prompt program 'compilation'. We exemplify this view by formally defining two compilers for Imprompt programs. We then explore the idea of typing for prompt programs and draw a correspondence between type checking and constrained decoding. Finally, we implement our compilers and type checkers and evaluate them on a variety of case studies. We believe our work contributes programming-language foundations toward the emerging area of prompt programming.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Imprompt，一种新的提示编程语言框架，主张提示程序应仅包含任务描述并与底层执行细节解耦，通过结构化提示、编译和类型检查（对应约束解码）来实现，并通过案例研究验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的提示编程框架存在复杂性和不优雅性，难以在实践中有效描述任务，亟需更简洁、解耦的提示编程方法。
AI.method: 提出Imprompt框架，将提示编程与提示程序"编译"分离；形式化定义了两个编译器；将类型检查与约束解码建立对应关系。
AI.result: 实现了编译器和类型检查器，并在多个案例研究中进行了评估验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为提示编程领域贡献了编程语言基础，证明了提示程序应解耦任务描述与执行细节这一核心主张的有效性。

title: VIPER: Visual In-Context Physics Reasoning for Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: Modern video generation models can synthesize visually compelling and temporally coherent clips, yet controlling their physical behavior remains difficult with standard text and image conditions. The core challenge is a conditioning bottleneck: material response, contact interaction, deformation, and motion trajectory are continuous and relational physical cues that are hard to specify exhaustively in language but can be demonstrated naturally by video. We propose VIPER, a Visual In-Context Physics Reasoning framework for reference-guided image-to-video generation. Given a target image, a brief target prompt, and a reference video, VIPER treats the reference as a dense visual demonstration of the desired physical process rather than an appearance template. It uses a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to extract reference-derived physical cues and guide a pretrained image-to-video generator through a hierarchical training strategy, enabling physical behavior transfer while preserving the visual prior of the base generator. To support this setting, we construct VIPER-19K, a curated dataset with material, trajectory, and physical-impact annotations, together with filtered reference-target pairs. Experiments on an unseen validation set show that VIPER achieves stronger reference-video physical similarity and higher human preference than representative video generation and video-as-prompt baselines, while maintaining competitive general video quality. Qualitative results further demonstrate that VIPER can transfer reference-derived physical behavior to new target scenes without requiring carefully engineered prompts.

AI.tldr: VIPER是一个视觉情境物理推理框架，通过参考视频提取物理线索（材料、接触、变形、运动轨迹等），引导预训练图像转视频模型生成具有相同物理行为的视频，无需精心设计提示词。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能生成视觉连贯的片段，但控制其物理行为（如材料响应、接触交互、变形和运动轨迹）仍很困难。文本和图像条件存在"条件瓶颈"——这些连续且关系性的物理线索难以用语言详尽描述，但可通过视频自然演示。
AI.method: 提出VIPER框架：(1) 使用多模态大语言模型(MLLM)从参考视频中提取物理线索；(2) 通过分层训练策略将物理线索注入预训练的图像转视频生成器；(3) 构建VIPER-19K数据集，包含材料、轨迹和物理影响注释的参考-目标对。
AI.result: 在未见过的验证集上，VIPER在参考视频物理相似度和人类偏好方面均优于代表性视频生成和视频即提示基线方法，同时保持竞争性的通用视频质量。
AI.conclusion: VIPER能够将参考视频中的物理行为迁移到新的目标场景中，无需精心设计的提示词，有效解决了视频生成中物理行为控制难题。

title: PIVOT: Efficient Query-Group Indexing for Token-Level Sparse Attention
summary: Token-level sparse attention, as implemented by DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) in production systems, makes the downstream attention efficient but shifts the bottleneck to the indexer that feeds it. To select the top-k tokens for each query, the indexer must still score every preceding token, incurring a cost of O(L^2) per layer for a sequence of length L. We observe that this per-query scan is largely redundant: nearby queries select highly overlapping top-k tokens, and the indexer scores are long-tailed along the key axis. We exploit these properties in PIVOT, Proxy Indexing Via One full-prefix Traversal, a training-free, drop-in replacement for the DSA indexer that shares one prefix scan across a group of nearby queries. PIVOT aggregates a group into a single proxy query, performs one shared full-prefix scan to obtain a candidate set, and then selects a top-k for each query from that set. Two variants trade speed for fidelity: PIVOT-Reuse shares the proxy top-k across the group for maximum speed, whereas PIVOT-Refine re-scores the candidate set with the indexer of each query and then selects an individual top-k, matching the dense indexer at a small additional cost. A single algorithm covers both inference phases, differing only in how groups are formed: fixed-size groups of consecutive queries in prefill, and the queries decoded together in one multi-token prediction (MTP) step in decode. On DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 across LongBench and RULER, PIVOT matches the accuracy of the dense DSA indexer while accelerating it by up to 4x and reducing end-to-end latency by up to 1.6x at long context.

AI.tldr: PIVOT通过利用邻近查询共享前缀扫描的冗余性，用分组代理查询替代DSA索引器中逐查询的O(L²)全扫描，在保持精度的同时将索引器加速4倍、端到端延迟降低1.6倍，无需训练即可直接替换现有系统。
AI.motivation: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) 的token级稀疏注意力虽然使下游注意力计算高效，但索引器仍需为每个查询对所有前驱token进行评分，导致每层O(L²)的计算瓶颈。作者观察到邻近查询的top-k选择高度重叠，且索引器分数沿键轴呈长尾分布，因此希望利用这些冗余性来加速索引过程。
AI.method: PIVOT提出代理索引方法：将一组邻近查询聚合成一个代理查询，执行一次共享的全前缀扫描获得候选集，再从中为每个查询选择各自的top-k。包含两个变体：PIVOT-Reuse直接共享代理查询的top-k来最大化速度；PIVOT-Refine用每个查询的索引器重新评分候选集并选择个体top-k，以少量额外代价匹配密集索引器精度。在预填阶段按固定大小的连续查询分组，解码阶段则在多token预测步骤中分组。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-V3.2和GLM-5.1上，基于LongBench和RULER基准测试，PIVOT匹配了密集DSA索引器的精度，同时将索引器加速高达4倍，端到端延迟在长上下文场景下降低高达1.6倍。
AI.conclusion: PIVOT是一种无需训练、可直接替换DSA索引器的高效方法，通过利用查询间冗余和分数长尾分布，显著降低了稀疏注意力中索引阶段的计算开销，同时保持了模型精度。

title: Co-Harness: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Model Weights for LLM Agents
summary: Post-training agents for automated AI research requires optimizing not only model parameters, but also the runtime harness that shapes how research trajectories are generated, evaluated, and learned from. Existing pipelines typically train models under a fixed harness, including prompts, tools, skills, middleware, and memory, while leaving the data-generating process outside the optimization objective. This creates a mismatch between model updates and the static scaffolding that determines trajectory quality. We introduce Co-Harness, a framework that jointly optimizes the agent harness and model parameters during post-training. Co-Harness alternates between harness optimization and model optimization. An LLM-based HarnessCritic analyzes failed trajectories, identifies harness-level failure modes, and proposes validated local updates. The model is then fine-tuned on high-quality trajectories generated by the improved harness, distilling effective scaffolding into model parameters. A 200+ hour autonomous case study further shows that Co-Harness can recover from system crashes, improve inference efficiency, and discover ensemble strategies without human intervention. These results suggest that joint harness and model optimization is an effective way to improve agents beyond fixed-harness post-training.

AI.tldr: Co-Harness是一个在自动化AI研究智能体后训练中联合优化智能体框架（harness）和模型参数的框架，通过交替进行框架优化和模型优化，实现超越固定框架后训练的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练流程通常在固定框架（包括提示词、工具、技能、中间件和记忆）下训练模型，忽略了数据生成过程对轨迹质量的影响，导致模型更新与静态框架之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: Co-Harness采用交替优化策略：首先基于LLM的HarnessCritic分析失败轨迹，识别框架层面的故障模式并提出局部更新；然后模型在改进框架生成的高质量轨迹上进行微调，将有效框架知识蒸馏进模型参数。
AI.result: 200+小时的自主案例研究显示，Co-Harness能够从系统崩溃中恢复、提升推理效率、并无需人工干预地发现集成策略。
AI.conclusion: 联合框架与模型优化是提升智能体性能的有效方式，超越了固定框架后训练的效果。

title: PlanCraft: Sketch, Refine, and Furnish for Architect-Inspired Progressive 3D Residential Scene Generation
summary: Two structural insights have been overlooked in automated residential floor plan generation. First, design is inherently progressive. Architects begin with rough strokes and refine them over time, whereas existing methods typically require their conditioning representation to be fully specified before generation, a fundamental mismatch with how design actually works. Second, the 2D floor plan is not an optional intermediate but an irreplaceable spatial contract. Once room boundaries, doors, and windows are fixed, furnishing reduces from open-ended spatial reasoning to bounded constraint satisfaction. Bypassing this contract, as existing 3D systems do by delegating layout to language models, yields overlapping rooms and implausible proportions; directly calling general-purpose language models likewise produces geometrically invalid layouts. Guided by these insights, we present PlanCraft. SketchPlan supplies the missing training signal by replaying the architect's drawing process on 80K real floor plans, producing partial sketches at every completeness level. PlanCraft-Diff progressively sharpens an incomplete sketch into a geometrically precise, vectorizable floor plan through a coarse-to-fine strategy. With the spatial contract established, PlanCraft-Agent then furnishes the scene within well-defined room boundaries. Experiments show that PlanCraft achieves a 61.1\% lower FID than the best existing 2D method and surpasses existing 3D systems by 15 points in expert-rated spatial rationality, with a sketch at only 25\% completion already outperforming all fully specified baselines.

AI.tldr: PlanCraft提出了一种渐进式住宅 floor plan 生成方法，通过草图逐步细化的方式完成2D平面图设计，再基于确定的空间边界进行家具布局，在FID和专家评分上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化住宅 floor plan 生成方法忽略了两个关键洞察：一是设计本质上是渐进式的，而现有方法要求条件表示在生成前完全指定；二是2D平面图是不可替代的空间契约，绕过它会导致几何上无效的布局。
AI.method: 提出PlanCraft框架，包含三个组件：SketchPlan通过回放建筑师在8万张真实平面图上的绘制过程，生成不同完整度的部分草图作为训练信号；PlanCraft-Diff采用从粗到细的策略将不完整草图逐步优化为几何精确且可矢量化的平面图；PlanCraft-Agent在确定的空间边界内进行家具布局。
AI.result: PlanCraft的FID比最好的现有2D方法低61.1%，在专家评分空间合理性上比现有3D系统高15个百分点，仅25%完成度的草图就已超越所有完全指定的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 验证了渐进式设计和2D平面图作为空间契约这两个洞察的正确性，表明先完成精确的2D布局再进行家具布置是一种更符合设计实践且性能更优的范式。

title: Looping Is Not Reliability: State-Bound Evidence and Typed Revision Contracts for Agentic Code Repair
summary: Generate--test--revise loops are common in coding agents, but repetition alone provides no reliability guarantee. We study the gap between finding a correct patch and retaining, verifying, and submitting it. A sealed five-seed study over 30 HumanEval repairs produces 900 three-revision trajectories. Under forced revision, current correctness with current traces falls from 0.820 after one revision to 0.673 after two, although ever-correct rises to 0.847. Two common-state studies use 2,430 branches from identical frozen programs to remove post-treatment risk-set bias. In a prespecified 14B replication, stale traces harm 34/135 correct starts versus 4/135 with current traces, a 22.2-point increase (task-cluster 95\% CI $[8.9,37.0]$, exact Holm $p=0.0337$). A prospective 540-rollout policy eliminates observed correct-start harm but reduces wrong-start repair and fails its joint criterion. Repository experiments over 24 bugs and four coder stacks expose floor effects and component heterogeneity without Holm-significant effects. We therefore separate admission, preservation, grounded certification, competence, and liveness. We derive an evidence-bound typed loop contract and instantiate its mechanically enforceable subset in a reference implementation that binds verifier evidence to exact code states, preserves verified checkpoints, and emits auditable admission receipts. The implementation is an executable specification and conformance artifact, not evidence of improved repair competence or calibrated verifier dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了代码修复智能体中"生成-测试-修订"循环的可靠性问题，发现强制修订会导致正确率下降（从0.820降至0.673），但"曾经正确"率升至0.847。通过消除风险集偏倚的对照实验，证明了陈旧轨迹会显著损害正确启动的修复效果。最终提出一种基于证据绑定、带类型签名的循环合约，并实现了可审计的参考框架。
AI.motivation: 现有代码智能体依赖"生成-测试-修订"循环，但重复执行并不能保证修复的可靠性。研究者发现存在"找到正确补丁"与"保留、验证并提交它"之间的关键差距，即正确补丁可能在后续修订中被丢失或覆盖，这是一个未被充分研究的问题。
AI.method: 1) 在HumanEval的30个修复上运行密封的五种子实验，生成900条三修订轨迹；2) 采用两个共同状态研究，从相同的冻结程序生成2,430个分支，消除治疗后风险集偏倚；3) 进行预设的14B复制实验验证陈旧轨迹的损害效应；4) 实施前瞻性540次展开策略来验证修复效果；5) 在24个bugs和4个编码器栈上进行仓库级实验；6) 提出并实现一种基于证据绑定的循环合约参考实现。
AI.result: 强制修订下，当前正确率从一次修订后的0.820降至两次后的0.673，但"曾经正确"升至0.847。在预设14B复制实验中，陈旧轨迹损害34/135的正确启动（vs 陈旧轨迹的4/135），增量22.2个百分点（95% CI [8.9,37.0]，p=0.0337）。前瞻性策略消除了正确启动损害但降低了错误启动修复率且未能通过联合标准。仓库实验存在地板效应和组件异质性，无统计显著效应。
AI.conclusion: 应区分接纳、保留、基础认证、能力与活性五个概念。提出的循环合约通过将验证器证据绑定到精确代码状态、保留已验证检查点、发放可审计接纳收据来实现机械可执行子集。该实现是执行规范与合规性工件，而非改进修复能力或校准验证器依赖的证据。

title: Beyond Sequential Interaction: Benchmarking Parallel Execution and Coordination for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are systems powered by large multimodal models (LMMs). They perceive screen state and execute user instructions through GUI actions such as clicking, typing, and scrolling on desktops and mobile devices. However, current agents scale poorly to long-horizon tasks: actions incur costly LMM inferences, and performance degrades as context grows. Humans divide such workloads among collaborators who complete sub-tasks in parallel. Yet parallel coordination among GUI agents has received little attention. To close this gap, we introduce ParaGUIBench, to our knowledge, the first benchmark dedicated to parallel execution and coordination of multiple GUI agents on separate desktop instances. It consists of three components: a multi-device Docker infrastructure with a shared file system; a dataset of 233 tasks spanning six task categories; and an evaluation system with efficiency metrics, including step reduction ratio and token cost. We further introduce ParaGUI, a planner-worker agent that decomposes GUI tasks and dispatches sub-tasks to concurrent workers on separate desktop instances. On ParaGUIBench, ParaGUI reaches a 46.4% success rate, outperforming the strongest serial baseline (Claude Sonnet 4.6) by 12.9 points while using roughly half the steps and less than half the tokens. These results show that parallel execution can improve both success rate and efficiency on decomposable, long-horizon GUI tasks, pointing to a direction worth further study.

AI.tldr: ParaGUIBench是首个面向多GUI代理并行协调的基准测试，包含多设备Docker基础设施、233个任务和效率评估指标。提出的ParaGUI规划-工作者框架在任务上达到46.4%的成功率，比最强串行基线高12.9个百分点，同时步骤和令牌消耗减半。
AI.motivation: 当前GUI代理在长周期任务上表现不佳：动作推理成本高、上下文增长导致性能下降。人类通过并行协作解决问题，但多GUI代理的并行协调研究尚属空白。
AI.method: 提出ParaGUIBench基准测试（多设备Docker基础设施、233个六类任务、含步骤缩减比和令牌成本的效率指标），以及ParaGUI规划-工作者框架（分解任务并分派给并发工作者）。
AI.result: ParaGUI在ParaGUIBench上达到46.4%成功率，比最强串行基线Claude Sonnet 4.6高12.9个百分点，同时步骤和令牌消耗均减少约一半。
AI.conclusion: 并行执行能提升可分解长周期GUI任务的成功率和效率，值得进一步研究。

title: To Erase, or Not to Erase: Robust Training-Free Concept Erasure with Preservation aware Adaptive Ranked Subspace Expansion
summary: Concept erasure techniques (CETs) edit text-to-image diffusion models to erase undesired targets such as NSFW content or copyrighted styles, while preserving model utility on benign concepts. Current CETs face a trade-off between erasure robustness and utility: stronger edits erase the target more reliably but degrade utility on non-target concepts, and vice versa. This stems from how existing methods define what to erase and what to preserve. Many CETs rely on static concept banks specified manually, generated by LLMs, or selected by CLIP image-text similarity. Such banks do not model how prompts steer the model during denoising, leaving it vulnerable to triggers that reintroduce the target while suppressing nearby benign concepts. We present Preservation-aware Adaptive Ranked Subspace Expansion (PARSE), a training-free framework for robust concept erasure in latent diffusion models. Given a target, PARSE queries the diffusion model with classifier-free guidance to dynamically discover target-inducing erase concepts and nearby retain concepts in the model vocabulary. It then edits the cross-attention value space with a preservation-aware projection that removes target directions while leaving retain directions intact. For triggers beyond this vocabulary-indexed space, PARSE iteratively searches for re-emergence triggers by textual inversion and adaptively expands the erased subspace only when a new trigger direction does not conflict with retain semantics. We also introduce the Balanced Erasure Utility Score (BEUS), which combines robustness (ASR under multiple attacks) and utility preservation (FID) via bounded monotone transforms and harmonic mean aggregation. Experiments on NSFW, artistic style, and object erasure, with a large-scale robustness-utility analysis over many CET baselines, show that PARSE erases multiple concepts robustly without sacrificing post-edit utility.

AI.tldr: PARSE是一个无需重新训练的概念擦除框架，通过自适应扩展子空间动态识别擦除目标和保留概念，在隐扩散模型中实现稳健擦除的同时保持模型效用。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除技术面临擦除鲁棒性与模型效用之间的权衡困境：更强擦除虽能更可靠地移除目标，但会降低非目标概念上的效用。根本原因在于现有方法依赖静态概念库，无法建模提示词在去噪过程中引导模型的方式，易被触发器重新激活目标并抑制邻近良性概念。
AI.method: 提出PARSE框架：1) 利用无分类器引导动态发现目标诱导的擦除概念和邻近保留概念；2) 编辑交叉注意力值空间，构建保留感知投影移除目标方向但保留保留方向；3) 对超出词汇索引的触发器，通过文本反转迭代搜索重新出现触发器，仅在无冲突时自适应扩展擦除子空间。同时提出BEUS评估指标，结合ASR和FID进行综合评价。
AI.result: 在NSFW、艺术风格和物体擦除任务上，经过大规模鲁棒性-效用分析，PARSE能够稳健地擦除多个概念，且不牺牲编辑后的模型效用，优于现有多种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态感知和保留感知的子空间扩展策略，PARSE有效打破了擦除鲁棒性与效用保持之间的权衡，为概念擦除提供了一种无需训练、鲁棒且实用的解决方案。

title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
summary: We introduce Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104 billion activated parameters, native vision capabilities, and a 1-million-token context window. Kimi K3 is built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, which improve information flow across sequence length and model depth. Together with Stable LatentMoE, which effectively activates 16 of 896 routed experts per token, and refined training and data recipes, these advances yield an approximately 2.5x improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2. Post-training highlights reinforcement learning across general, agentic, and coding domains and multiple reasoning-effort levels, enabling compositional generalization and robust long-horizon execution. At 2.8T scale, Kimi K3 is supported by infrastructure advances in multiple areas: algorithm-system co-design for KDA, perfectly balanced expert-parallel training with efficient memory management, million-token agentic RL with persistent rollout and sandbox states, and deployment innovations. Extensive evaluations show that Kimi K3 achieves frontier-level performance across long-horizon coding, agentic, knowledge, reasoning, and vision tasks. While its overall performance still trails the most powerful proprietary models, namely Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3 consistently outperforms other open and proprietary models evaluated in our suite. We release the full Kimi K3 model weights to facilitate future research and accelerate the broader deployment and adoption of frontier intelligence.

AI.tldr: Kimi K3是一个2.8T参数的MoE模型（104B激活参数），具备原生视觉能力和百万token上下文窗口。通过Kimi Delta Attention和Attention Residuals改进信息流动，结合Stable LatentMoE（每token激活16/896个路由专家），在Kimi K2基础上实现了约2.5倍的扩展效率提升。后训练涵盖通用、智能体和编码领域的强化学习及多种推理难度级别。评测显示其在长程编码、智能体、知识、推理和视觉任务上达到前沿水平，虽仍落后于Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol，但优于其他开源和专有模型。已开源完整权重。
AI.motivation: 在现有模型基础上进一步提升扩展效率、增强长上下文处理能力、实现多模态融合，并推动开源前沿模型发展。
AI.method: 1) Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) + Attention Residuals：改进序列长度和模型深度上的信息流动；2) Stable LatentMoE：每token激活16/896个路由专家；3) 优化的训练和数据配方；4) 后训练采用跨通用、智能体和编码领域的强化学习及多种推理难度级别；5) 算法-系统协同设计、完美均衡的专家并行训练、百万token智能体RL、部署创新等基础设施优化。
AI.result: Kimi K3在长程编码、智能体、知识、推理和视觉任务上达到前沿性能，优于多数开源和专有模型，但整体表现仍落后于Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol。相较于Kimi K2，整体扩展效率提升约2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: Kimi K3通过架构创新（KDA、Attention Residuals、Stable LatentMoE）和基础设施优化，在大规模MoE模型上实现了显著效率提升和前沿性能，并开放完整权重以促进研究和部署。

title: LazyMem: Retrieve Broadly, Construct Selectively for Efficient Long-Term Agent Memory
summary: Long-term memory lets LLM agents reuse past interactions, but raw dialogue histories are verbose and information-sparse. Retrieving broadly improves evidence coverage yet overwhelms downstream reasoning with noise; compressing at write time reduces noise but irreversibly discards details the future query may need. We introduce LazyMem, which sidesteps this dilemma by deferring all memory construction to query time. A lightweight 4B model processes the retrieved candidate pool in overlapping parallel windows, selectively retaining and compressing only query-relevant content. The model is trained through supervised fine-tuning followed by group-based reinforcement learning with a format-gated composite reward that combines a rule-based action signal measuring selection accuracy with an LLM-judged quality signal measuring source faithfulness and query utility. On the LongMemEval benchmark, LazyMem-4B achieves an LLM-judge accuracy of 0.85 with only 213 memory tokens, 68.7$\times$ fewer than retrieval-only, and generalizes to LoCoMo (0.68) without target-domain training, while reducing mean latency over the prior query-time baseline. The 32B variant reaches 0.93, surpassing oracle-context references on aggregation-heavy question types. The code associated with this work is publicly available at https://github.com/allacnobug/LazyMem.

AI.tldr: LazyMem是一种在查询时构建记忆的方法，通过轻量级4B模型对检索到的候选池进行并行窗口处理，仅保留与查询相关的内容。在LongMemEval上达到0.85的LLM评判准确率，仅需213个记忆token，比纯检索减少68.7倍，32B变体达到0.93，在聚合型问题上超越oracle上下文参考。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM长期记忆方法面临两难：检索方式能提高证据覆盖率但引入噪声干扰推理；写入时压缩虽减少噪声但不可逆地丢弃未来查询可能需要的细节。LazyMem旨在通过将记忆构建延迟到查询时来解决这一困境。
AI.method: LazyMem在查询时利用轻量级4B模型对检索到的候选池进行重叠并行窗口处理，选择性保留和压缩仅与查询相关的内容。训练采用监督微调+基于组的强化学习，使用格式门控复合奖励，结合基于规则的动作信号（衡量选择准确性）和LLM评判的质量信号（衡量来源忠实性和查询实用性）。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval上，LazyMem-4B达到0.85 LLM评判准确率，仅213个记忆token（比纯检索减少68.7倍）；32B变体达到0.93，在聚合型问题上超越oracle上下文参考。在LoCoMo上泛化至0.68。延迟低于先前的查询时基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LazyMem通过查询时延迟构建记忆有效解决了长期记忆中的噪声与信息丢失困境，在极小记忆预算下实现高准确率，并展现出良好的跨域泛化能力。

title: Token-Region Guided Cross-Attention Fusion for Multimodal Affect Interpretation
summary: Automated analysis of multimodal content on social networks has become a critical task for understanding public sentiment and information diffusion in the digital age. However, classifying internet memes remains computationally challenging due to the intricate interplay between visual cues and embedded, often stylized, text, particularly in low-resource languages like Bengali Language. This paper addresses the detection of political intent in Bengali memes by introducing Multimodal Cross-Attention Fusion framework. We first leverage a Vision-Language Model to extract high-fidelity OCR text from noisy meme images. Subsequently, we encode visual and textual features and synthesize them through a cross-modal multi-head attention mechanism that aligns semantic tokens with visual regions. We also investigate the integration of a domain-specific political lexicon as a knowledge prior. Experimental evaluation on the PoliMemeDecode1 dataset shows that our attention-based fusion significantly outperforms unimodal baselines and standard concatenation methods, achieving a state-of-the-art Macro-F1 of approximately 0.94. Interpretability analyzes further confirm that the model effectively learns to ground textual semantics in visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态交叉注意力融合框架，用于检测孟加拉语政治迷因中的政治意图，通过视觉-语言模型提取OCR文本、跨模态多头注意力机制融合视觉与文本特征，并引入政治领域词典作为先验知识，在PoliMemeDecode1数据集上达到约0.94的Macro-F1，显著优于单模态和简单拼接方法。
AI.motivation: 社交网络中的多模态内容分析对理解公众情绪和信息传播至关重要，但互联网迷因分类因视觉线索与嵌入式文本（尤其是孟加拉语等低资源语言）之间的复杂交互而面临计算挑战。
AI.method: 1) 利用视觉-语言模型从噪声迷因图像中提取高保真OCR文本；2) 分别编码视觉和文本特征；3) 通过跨模态多头注意力机制对齐语义令牌与视觉区域；4) 引入领域特定的政治词汇表作为知识先验。
AI.result: 在PoliMemeDecode1数据集上，基于注意力的融合方法显著优于单模态基线和标准拼接方法，达到了约0.94的Macro-F1，创下最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 该模型能够有效将文本语义 grounding 到视觉证据中，为低资源语言的政治迷因检测提供了可行方案。

title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
summary: Pretraining data processing is critical to the downstream performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, many existing approaches define a fixed processing strategy at the corpus or domain level and apply it uniformly to many examples, without adapting to the needs of each example. We propose DataOrchestra, a framework that unifies different processing operations and orchestrates an example-specific pipeline for each example. Given a chunk of pretraining data, an orchestrator decides whether to drop, untouch, or clean it. For a chunk to be cleaned, it selects one or more downstream operations, ranging from programmatic editing to different forms of LLM-based rewriting. For each rewriting step, it further generates a concrete instruction, which is executed by the corresponding downstream tool model. We pretrain models from 0.5B to 7B from scratch on web data processed by DataOrchestra and observe stable average gains over individual data-processing methods across 11 benchmarks. DataOrchestra is also effective for math continued pretraining and outperforms stronger processing baselines, while reducing processing compute by skipping unnecessary downstream operations.

AI.tldr: DataOrchestra是一个统一数据预处理框架，能够为每个预训练数据样本动态定制处理流水线，通过编排器决定是否丢弃、保留或清理数据，并选择具体操作（程序化编辑或LLM重写），在0.5B到7B模型上取得了稳定的平均性能提升，同时降低了处理计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有数据预处理方法通常为整个语料库或领域定义固定的处理策略并统一应用，缺乏对每个样本具体需求的适应性，导致处理效果有限。
AI.method: 提出DataOrchestra框架，包含一个编排器，对每个预训练数据块决定三种操作：丢弃、保留或清理。对于需要清理的样本，进一步选择下游操作（程序化编辑或LLM重写），并为每个重写步骤生成具体指令，由对应工具模型执行。
AI.result: 在0.5B到7B的模型上从头预训练，DataOrchestra在11个基准测试上相比单一数据处理方法取得稳定的平均增益；在数学持续预训练中也优于更强的处理基线，并通过跳过不必要的下游操作减少了处理计算量。
AI.conclusion: DataOrchestra通过示例级别的自适应处理流水线有效提升了大语言模型的预训练数据质量，验证了细粒度、动态数据处理策略的优越性。

title: HiLLTS: Zero-Shot Hierarchical LLM-Guided Traffic Signal Control for Sustainable Transportation
summary: Urban traffic congestion significantly increases fuel consumption, greenhouse gas emissions, and commuter delays, resulting in substantial economic losses and environmental harm in modern cities. Traditional traffic signal control strategies such as fixed-time scheduling, actuated control, and reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods, offer different degrees of adaptability; however, RL-based methods can require extensive retraining, careful reward design, and substantial simulation data when transferred across networks or demand regimes. To address these challenges, we propose HiLLTS, an LLM-guided traffic signal control framework that employs a hierarchical three-layer architecture consisting of a central coordination agent, a district layer and multiple cluster-level intersection agents. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements in both congestion and environmental performance. Compared with the strongest non-LLM baseline in each scenario, HiLLTS reduces average waiting time by 36.73% under the low-congestion scenario and 14.71% under the high-congestion scenario, while reducing average CO2 emissions by 7.87% and 8.57%, respectively. Larger gains are observed against weaker baselines: under low congestion, HiLLTS achieves reductions of up to 18.00% in emissions and 62.07% in waiting time relative to Fixed-Time control; under high congestion, reductions of up to 28.89% in emissions and 40.36% in waiting time are observed relative to Max Pressure. The ablation study further validates the contribution of LLM-guided coordination over rule-based control

AI.tldr: 提出HiLLTS，一种基于大语言模型的三层分级交通信号控制框架，通过中央协调智能体、区域层和交叉口集群智能体协同工作，在低拥堵和高拥堵场景下分别减少36.73%和14.71%的平均等待时间，以及7.87%和8.57%的CO₂排放。
AI.motivation: 传统交通信号控制方法（如固定时间调度、感应控制和基于强化学习的方法）存在适应性不足、需要大量重新训练、奖励设计复杂和跨场景迁移困难等问题，导致经济损耗和环境损害。
AI.method: 提出HiLLTS框架，采用三层分级架构：顶层为中央协调智能体，中间为区域层，底层为多个交叉口集群智能体，利用大语言模型进行全局协调与决策指导。
AI.result: 与非LLM最强基线相比，低拥堵场景下平均等待时间降低36.73%，CO₂排放降低7.87%；高拥堵场景下等待时间降低14.71%，排放降低8.57%。相对于Fixed-Time控制，排放最多降低18.00%，等待时间最多降低62.07%；相对于Max Pressure，排放最多降低28.89%，等待时间最多降低40.36%。消融实验验证了LLM引导协调优于基于规则的控制的贡献。
AI.conclusion: HiLLTS在缓解交通拥堵和减少环境影响方面均取得一致性改进，验证了LLM引导的分级协调策略在交通信号控制中的有效性。

title: MemVLN: Episodic and Procedural Memory for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to maintain long-horizon visual history for trajectory consistency while executing actions with low latency. Existing video-based VLN approaches typically struggle to satisfy both demands simultaneously. To address these challenges, we propose MemVLN, a novel VLN framework that achieves state-of-the-art performance with real-time inference efficiency (14 FPS). MemVLN utilizes a visual encoder to process continuous observations and a Large Language Model (LLM) to interpret instructions and generate actions. Central to our approach is an Episodic Memory management that applies pyramidal resolutions. This mechanism concentrates computation on immediate percepts while retaining compressed long-term history. Complementing to this design, we introduce Procedural Memory for fast action with a compact vocabulary of atomic mid-level actions to bypass auto-regressive decoding latency. Experiments on VLN-CE show that MemVLN-4B surpasses the baseline Qwen3-VL-4B architecture by 5.8\% SR in R2R and 9.7\% SR in RxR, while achieving a 7$\times$ speedup in inference latency.

AI.tldr: MemVLN 提出了一种结合金字塔分辨率情节记忆和程序性记忆的 VLN-CE 框架，利用 LLM 实现实时导航，在 R2R 和 RxR 上分别提升 5.8% 和 9.7% 的成功率，同时推理速度达到 14 FPS（7 倍加速）。
AI.motivation: 现有视频 VLN 方法难以同时满足长程视觉历史保持（轨迹一致性）和低延迟动作执行的需求。
AI.method: 1) 使用视觉编码器处理连续观测，LLM 解释指令并生成动作；2) 金字塔分辨率情节记忆：集中计算于即时感知，压缩存储长期历史；3) 程序性记忆：使用紧凑的原子级中层动作词汇，绕过自回归解码延迟。
AI.result: 在 VLN-CE 上，MemVLN-4B 相比 Qwen3-VL-4B 在 R2R 上 SR 提升 5.8%，在 RxR 上 SR 提升 9.7%，推理延迟加速 7 倍，达到 14 FPS。
AI.conclusion: MemVLN 证明了通过精心设计的记忆管理机制，可以在保持实时推理效率的同时显著提升 VLN-CE 的导航性能。

title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
summary: Multi-turn long-horizon planning is critical for foundation model agents, yet how to fundamentally improve it remains unclear. Existing models are trained on uncontrollable and opaque Internet data, making it difficult to identify how planning ability is acquired, shaped, and integrated. To address this challenge, we introduce a unified and controlled multi-turn environment that enables precise control. It allows systematically study long-horizon planning across three stages. (1) Planning ability acquisition during pre-training. We study data format, distribution, and quality. Explicit world model construction through CoT state transition modeling yields stronger long-horizon generalization. Atomic skills alone are insufficient for compositional generalization, whereas a litte long-horizon data works. Moreover, suboptimal trajectories severely impair performance because errors amplify over long horizons. (2) Planning ability shaping via GRPO and OPD post-training. Through mutual information, we distinguish general planning patterns from task-specific planning knowledge. For planning patterns, we identify three application regions of post-training: unnecessary, effective, and unsupported. OPD has a broader effective region than GRPO under low-quality and long-horizon settings, as it provides more consistent update directions. For planning knowledge, distilling unseen procedures from a teacher with different knowledge may impair student's prior world modeling without fully establishing new knowledge. (3) Planning ability integration through MOPD post-training. We show that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates capabilities by converging to shared planning-pattern across environments. Compatible patterns enable cross-environment generalization, partially shared patterns support continual learning, while completely conflicting patterns cause severe interference.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过一个统一可控的多轮交互环境，系统研究了基础模型智能体在长期规划能力上的三个关键阶段：预训练阶段的能力获取（通过CoT状态建模、长程数据与次优轨迹的影响）、后训练阶段的能力塑造（GRPO与OPD的适用范围与差异）、以及能力集成（MOPD实现跨环境规划模式的共享与泛化）。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型在不可控且不透明的互联网数据上训练，难以识别规划能力是如何被获取、塑造和整合的，因此需要一个可控环境来系统性地研究长期规划能力。
AI.method: 构建统一可控的多轮交互环境，从三个阶段研究长期规划：(1)预训练中研究数据格式、分布和质量对规划能力获取的影响；(2)通过GRPO和OPD后训练方法研究规划能力的塑造；(3)通过多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)研究规划能力的整合。
AI.result: (1)显式世界模型构建(CoT状态建模)增强长程泛化；少量长程数据即可实现组合泛化；次优轨迹严重损害长程性能。(2)OPD在低质量数据和长程设定下比GRPO有更广的有效区域。(3)MOPD能通过收敛到共享规划模式实现跨环境泛化，兼容模式支持泛化，部分共享支持持续学习，完全冲突模式导致严重干扰。
AI.conclusion: 长期规划能力的获取依赖显式世界模型与长程数据，后训练中OPD在困难设定下优于GRPO，多教师蒸馏通过规划模式的对齐程度决定能力整合的效果。

title: Risk Governance for Generative AI Mental Health Support: A Multi-Turn Safety Architecture
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support despite lacking mechanisms to safely govern evolving mental health risk. Existing safety approaches primarily detect risk but rarely shape how models respond as conversational risk unfolds. We developed a model-agnostic safety governance architecture that combines contextual risk detection, reasoning-based verification, and protocol-guided response generation for multi-turn mental health interactions. Synthetic conversations grounded in real-world mental health narratives were used to evaluate the architecture's performance, tested with GPT-5-chat and Qwen3.5-27B, achieving high risk detection performance (specificity: 0.85 (95\%CI: 0.78;0.91), sensitivity: 0.92 (95\%CI: 0.88;0.95)) and increasing clinician-preferred escalation responses by 25.6--59.2pp while preserving rapport and connection. Performance remained stable across conversation length and generalized across both proprietary and open-source models. These findings demonstrate that clinically-grounded safety governance can extend beyond risk detection to improve how LLMs manage evolving mental health risk, providing a scalable framework for safer deployment across models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种模型无关的安全治理架构，结合上下文风险检测、推理验证和协议引导响应生成，用于多轮心理健康对话。在GPT-5-chat和Qwen3.5-27B上测试，风险检测特异性0.85、敏感性0.92，并将临床优先的升级响应提升25.6-59.2个百分点，同时保持 rapport 稳定。
AI.motivation: LLM在情感支持中缺乏安全管理机制，现有方法主要检测风险但很少在对话过程中塑造模型的响应方式。
AI.method: 开发了一种模型无关的安全治理架构，包含上下文风险检测、推理验证和协议引导响应生成三个模块；使用真实心理健康叙事构建合成对话进行评测。
AI.result: 风险检测特异性0.85 (95%CI: 0.78;0.91)，敏感性0.92 (95%CI: 0.88;0.95)；临床优先升级响应提升25.6-59.2个百分点；性能在对话长度上稳定且跨专有和开源模型泛化。
AI.conclusion: 临床导向的安全治理可以从风险检测扩展到改善LLM管理持续心理健康风险的方式，为模型安全部署提供可扩展框架。

title: MOJITO: Modal Joint Learning for Unified End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving systems commonly follow a cascaded two-stage pipeline where a perception stage compresses multi-modal sensor inputs into a compact context and a downstream planner predicts trajectories conditioned on this context. We argue that this one-way perception-to-planning interface forces sensor inputs into a compact representation, losing the fine-grained details critical for planning. Moreover, by constraining the planner to this compressed context, it is difficult to leverage the rich representations offered by modern vision foundation models. To address these issues, we propose MOJITO, a unified sensor-to-action framework for end-to-end autonomous driving built on modal joint learning. MOJITO removes the cascaded interface and instead performs block-wise Modal Joint Attention that simultaneously updates action, image, and LiDAR features, allowing the planner to directly access multi-modal features during action generation. MOJITO achieves 88.9 PDMS on the NAVSIM v1 dataset and 88.4 EPDMS on the more challenging NAVSIM v2 dataset, setting a new state-of-the-art. Extensive experiments further demonstrate strong scalability, instruction following, and diverse trajectory generation. Code and models are available at https://github.com/mumucc01/MOJITO.

AI.tldr: MOJITO提出了一种去除级联流水线的端到端自动驾驶框架，通过模态联合注意力机制让规划器直接访问多模态特征，在NAVSIM v1和v2数据集上达到SOTA性能（88.9 PDMS / 88.4 EPDMS）。
AI.motivation: 传统级联两阶段流水线（感知→规划）将多模态传感器输入压缩为紧凑表示，丢失了对规划至关重要的细粒度细节；同时限制了规划器利用现代视觉基础模型提供的丰富表示能力。
AI.method: 提出MOJITO框架，去除级联接口，采用分块模态联合注意力（Block-wise Modal Joint Attention），同步更新动作、图像和LiDAR特征，使规划器在动作生成时直接访问多模态特征。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1上达到88.9 PDMS，在更具挑战性的NAVSIM v2上达到88.4 EPDMS，均实现新SOTA。实验还展示了强可扩展性、指令跟随能力和多样化轨迹生成能力。
AI.conclusion: MOJITO通过端到端模态联合学习有效解决了级联流水线中的信息丢失问题，为自动驾驶规划提供了更丰富的多模态特征访问方式，验证了该范式的有效性和可扩展性。

title: Bayesian Repetition Penalty: A Principled Adjacent-Conditional Framework for Reversing Attention Collapse in Autoregressive Language Models
summary: Attention collapse in autoregressive language models -- manifested as repetitive token loops where the model becomes trapped in self-reinforcing attractors -- is a persistent pathology that existing decoding-time heuristics fail to address at its root cause. We present a principled framework that penalises or compensates anomalous confidence arising from collapsed generation patterns, by comparing a token's observed frequency against its corpus prior through an adjacent-conditional probability construction. The resulting self-normalising penalty ratio $R=f(m,n,p)/f(np,n,p)$ requires no ad hoc standardisation and admits a closed-form logit offset with zero approximation error. The correction is isolated from the loss gradient and accumulated into a frozen output-layer bias via exponential moving average, enabling deployment as a repair mechanism for models that have already collapsed without requiring intrusive modifications to standard training pipelines. Experimental validation on a 1.5B-parameter model demonstrates that the frozen-bias mechanism can rescue a model already trapped in a collapsed attractor, reducing 2-gram repetition from 0.073 to near 0 while preserving generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于相邻条件概率的自标准化惩罚比R，通过冻结偏置机制修正自回归语言模型中的注意力崩溃问题，在不修改训练流程的情况下将2-gram重复率从0.073降至接近0。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型存在注意力崩溃现象（表现为重复token循环），现有解码启发式方法无法从根源解决这一问题。
AI.method: 通过比较token的观测频率与其语料先验，构建相邻条件概率的自标准化惩罚比R=f(m,n,p)/f(np,n,p)，得到零近似误差的闭式logit偏移量；该校正与损失梯度隔离，通过指数移动平均累积到冻结的输出层偏置中。
AI.result: 在1.5B参数模型上验证，该方法能够拯救已陷入崩溃吸引子的模型，将2-gram重复率从0.073降至接近0，同时保持生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 该方法作为一种修复机制，无需侵入式修改标准训练流程即可部署，有效解决了已崩溃模型的注意力崩溃问题。

title: Real-Time Human-Centric World Modeling for Upper-Body Human-Object Interaction
summary: We present a real-time human-centric world model for upper-body interactive generation, aiming to synthesize coherent local world dynamics centered on a person, where coordinated body, hand, and facial motions evolve jointly with controllable human-object discrete interaction. To this end, we adopt a continuous-discrete joint control scheme with two complementary components: a continuous human state and a discrete interaction state. For continuous human-state control, we introduce a unified implicit representation based on multi-scale motion encoding, in which motion latents from the upper body, hands, and face are fused into a shared latent space. This multi-scale design improves expressiveness across different spatial scales, captures fine-grained human dynamics more effectively, and enables direct control without explicit retargeting. For discrete object interaction-state control, we represent object contact using a small set of language-encoded discrete interaction states, where text serves as an explicit interaction-state command, such as \emph{no contact} or \emph{grasp}, rather than an open-ended generation prompt, and we further construct a dedicated rendering pipeline for human-object interaction data to supervise such discrete interaction states. By combining continuous implicit human-state control with discrete interaction-state control, our model enables precise modeling of how a person moves and interacts with the local environment, including controllable changes to nearby scene states. Finally, we distill the model for efficient streaming real-time inference, achieving 25 FPS on two H100 GPUs. Experiments demonstrate improved fine-grained motion fidelity, more realistic hand-object coordination, and effective real-time interaction, establishing a practical step beyond motion reproduction toward real-time human-centric world modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向人机交互的实时以人为中心的世界模型，采用连续-离散联合控制方案，通过多尺度运动编码的隐式表示统一控制身体、手部和面部运动，并利用语言编码的离散交互状态控制物体交互，最终在双H100 GPU上实现25 FPS的流式推理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以同时实现人体细粒度运动（身体、手、面部）的连续控制与可交互物体的离散状态控制，缺乏能够实时生成以人为中心的局部世界动态的模型。
AI.method: 1）连续人体状态控制：基于多尺度运动编码的隐式表示，将上体、手、面部运动潜在特征融合到共享潜在空间；2）离散交互状态控制：用少量语言编码的离散交互状态（如"无接触"、"抓握"）表示物体接触，并构建专用渲染管线进行监督；3）通过知识蒸馏实现25 FPS实时推理。
AI.result: 在细粒度运动保真度、手-物体协调性和实时交互方面优于现有方法，在双H100 GPU上达到25 FPS的实时推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是从运动复现走向实时以人为中心世界建模的实用一步，实现了对人体运动和局部物体交互的精确可控生成。

title: PANOPTICON: A PII-Based Assemblage of Naturalistic Output Tokens for Investigating Privacy Leakage Within LLM Context Window
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE CARS 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are capable of generalizing human language for the completion of never-before-seen tasks, leading to widespread deployment. While this automation provides clear utility, completing these tasks often requires the insertion of Personally Identifiable Information (PII), strings of information that uniquely identify some individual, raising privacy concerns. However, ethics has prevented the curation of a public, authentic dataset of PII. Without an appropriate dataset, it is difficult to quantify privacy risks. Thus, we introduce the PANOPTICON pipeline and dataset. The dataset, generated by Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model, contains 67, 718 prompts, intended for the models context window, containing PII spans derived from 9,674 publicly available synthetic user profiles. We measure lexical diversity and S-BERT diversity of the created dataset to evaluate realism. Finally, we present a case study showcasing the utility of PANOPTICON data for understanding Prompt Inversion Attacks (PIAs). PANOPTICON thus emerges as the first benchmark dataset for studying PIAs over private corpora, providing a foundation for future LLM privacy research.

AI.tldr: PANOPTICON是一个由Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct生成的包含67,718条提示的流水线和数据集，每条提示包含来自9,674个公开合成用户档案的PII。该数据集旨在量化LLM中的隐私风险，并作为首个研究提示反转攻击（PIA）的基准数据集。
AI.motivation: LLM在完成任务时常需插入PII，引发隐私担忧。然而，伦理限制导致缺乏公开、真实的PII数据集，难以量化隐私风险。
AI.method: 利用Meta的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型生成包含67,718条提示的数据集，提示中包含来自9,674个公开合成用户档案的PII片段。通过词汇多样性和S-BERT多样性评估数据集的真实性。
AI.result: 生成了包含67,718条PII提示的数据集，通过词汇多样性和S-BERT多样性验证了数据的真实性。案例研究展示了PANOPTICON数据在理解提示反转攻击（PIA）中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: PANOPTICON成为首个研究私密语料库上提示反转攻击的基准数据集，为未来LLM隐私研究奠定基础。

title: ATCNet-CIAM for Multi-Session Motor Imagery EEG Signal Classification
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publication in the International Conference on Intelligence Systems and Robotics for Sustainable Development (ISRSD) 2026
summary: Motor imagery (MI)-based electroencephalography is widely used in non-invasive brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but robust decoding remains challenging due to inter-subject variability and cross-session non-stationarity. This work proposes ATCNet-CIAM, an enhanced attention temporal convolutional network that integrates a lightweight channel-integrated attention module (CIAM) into the ATCNet framework to improve channel-spatial feature representation for MI decoding. The proposed model is evaluated on BCI Competition IV-2a, BCI Competition IV-2b, and the multi-day WBCIC-MI dataset under standard, within-session, and cross-session protocols. Experimental results show that ATCNet-CIAM achieves 86.32% accuracy on BCI IV-2a and 87.96% on BCI IV-2b under the standard protocol, while reaching 89.46% and 83.64% in the within-session WBCIC-MI on 2C and 3C, respectively. The proposed framework consistently improves classification stability and robustness under session-varying conditions, and ablation study confirms the complementary contribution of the proposed architectural components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合轻量级通道集成注意力模块（CIAM）的增强型注意力时间卷积网络（ATCNet-CIAM），用于运动想象脑电解码，在BCI Competition IV-2a、IV-2b和多日WBCIC-MI数据集上分别达到86.32%、87.96%和89.46%（2C）/83.64%（3C）的准确率，显著提升了跨会话和跨被试的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 运动想象脑电解码面临被试间差异大和跨会话非平稳性的挑战，现有方法的鲁棒性不足，亟需更有效的特征表示方法。
AI.method: 在ATCNet框架中集成轻量级通道集成注意力模块（CIAM），增强通道-空间特征表示能力，并在标准协议、会话内协议和跨会话协议下进行评估。
AI.result: 在标准协议下，BCI IV-2a准确率86.32%，BCI IV-2b准确率87.96%；在WBCIC-MI会话内协议下，2C和3C分别达到89.46%和83.64%。消融实验验证了各组件的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: ATCNet-CIAM在跨会话和跨被试场景下持续提升了分类稳定性和鲁棒性，是运动想象解码的有效框架。

title: Test-Time Coverage: Test-Conditioned Data Curation for Deployment-Aware Learning
summary: Deployed AI systems are often trained from broad candidate data pools, necessitating data curation towards the deployment test distribution. However, standard data curation methods score training-side criteria rather than directly optimizing deployment match. We introduce TTCov (Test-Time Coverage), a data-level test-conditioned curation method that uses test-side information before training instead of updating model weights at inference. TTCov decomposes deployment-conditioned curation into coverage and distribution. To represent coverage, it builds a task Atlas, a collection of LLM-based atomic propositions (APs) describing deployment-relevant concepts, seeded from open task knowledge and expanded with unmatched APs extracted from unlabeled deployment samples. To represent distribution, it instantiates the matched deployment APs with their frequencies, yielding a Knowledge Atlas (K-Atlas) that operationalizes the deployment distribution as a curation target. TTCov then selects a budgeted training set whose deployment APs distribution approximates this target. We apply TTCov towards autonomous driving (AD), keeping adaptation off the inference path while selecting data with greater deployment-relevant coverage, closer K-Atlas matching, and stronger downstream end-to-end driving performance than data-curation baselines, including seamless adaptability to novel domains via city-to-city expansion.

AI.tldr: 提出TTCov方法，利用测试时覆盖信息（而非训练后或推理时）进行训练数据筛选，通过构建任务图谱和知识图谱来匹配部署分布，在自动驾驶场景中实现更优的数据筛选效果。
AI.motivation: 现有数据筛选方法通常基于训练侧标准评分，而非直接优化训练数据与部署测试分布之间的匹配，导致筛选出的数据可能无法很好地泛化到实际部署场景。
AI.method: TTCov将部署条件化的数据筛选分解为覆盖度和分布两部分。覆盖度通过构建任务图谱（Atlas）实现——基于开放任务知识种子和未标注部署样本的原子命题提取。分布通过在匹配的部署AP上赋予频率得到知识图谱（K-Atlas），作为筛选目标；再选择预算内训练集使其AP分布逼近该目标。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶场景下，TTCov在不增加推理路径开销的前提下，相比基线数据筛选方法，在部署相关覆盖度、K-Atlas匹配度以及下游端到端驾驶性能上均表现更优，并可通过城市间扩展实现对新领域的无缝适配。
AI.conclusion: 利用测试侧信息进行训练前的数据筛选是可行且有效的，能够在不修改推理过程的前提下提升模型在目标部署分布上的表现。

title: Geometry Meets Semantics: Fractional Gradient Stabilization for Semantic-Driven Bounding Box Optimization in Visual Detection Tasks
summary: Bounding boxes are fundamental for object localization in visual detection tasks. Among them, oriented bounding boxes are widely used in visual detection tasks, which provide a more precise directional representation. Generally, IoU-based losses are widely adopted to optimize box regression. However, we observed that IoU-driven box optimization suffers from two key issues: (1) it relies solely on geometric properties while ignoring semantic cues; (2) orientation optimization suffers from unstable gradients, causing oscillations in orientation convergence. In this paper, we propose a Fractional Semantic IoU loss to achieve unified semantic-geometric learning with gradient stabilization. First, we design a semantic similarity metric to guide IoU optimization, building a Semantic IoU loss (SIoU loss) with an adaptive gradient gating mechanism. Then, we revisit the gradient instability issue in oriented box optimization and extend the SIoU loss to a fractional-order formulation to build the \textbf{Fr}actional \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{IoU} \textbf{loss} (FrSIoU loss). The FrSIoU loss accumulates historical IoU states to regularize abnormal gradients during bounding box optimization process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves stable performance gains across different bounding box formulations and diverse visual detection tasks. The code will be available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FrSIoU损失函数，通过引入语义相似度度量和分数阶梯度正则化，解决传统IoU损失忽略语义信息及方向优化梯度不稳定的问题，在多种视觉检测任务上取得稳定性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于IoU的边界框回归损失仅依赖几何属性而忽略语义线索，且方向优化存在梯度不稳定导致收敛振荡的问题。
AI.method: 设计语义相似度度量引导IoU优化，构建带有自适应梯度门控机制的语义IoU损失（SIoU）；进一步将SIoU扩展为分数阶形式（FrSIoU），通过累积历史IoU状态来正则化异常梯度。
AI.result: 在不同边界框形式和多种视觉检测任务上均取得稳定的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 所提FrSIoU损失有效统一了语义-几何联合学习，并缓解了方向优化中的梯度不稳定问题。

title: Similarity All The Way Up: Multilingual Generalization in LLMs Relies on Language-Level Similarity Structures
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) grow more capable across diverse tasks, their (in)ability to generalize remains difficult to quantify and poorly understood beyond limited domains. In particular, LLMs are known to struggle generalizing multilingually, to languages outside of English, and that are poorly attested in their training data. To understand why this may be, and what enables some models to perform better than others, we turn to a long history of work across the cognitive sciences, arguing that successful generalization derives from appropriate representations in similarity space. We look at how well LLMs' representations capture the hierarchical similarity structure between distinct languages. Strikingly, we show LLMs' latent representations largely recover the hierarchical structure of the Indo-European language family tree -- grouping languages that are members of the same subfamily closely together in representation space. Furthermore, we show that the degree to which models reflect the similarity structure of languages correlates with their performance on XNLI, a multilingual natural language inference benchmark. This extends classic work on similarity-driven generalization at scale, showing how models that represent similar languages similarly generalize better from one language to another.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM在多语言任务中的泛化能力，发现其潜在表征能够恢复印欧语系的层次结构，且表征中语言相似性结构的保留程度与跨语言推理（XNLI）性能正相关，证实了基于相似性泛化的经典理论在大规模模型中的适用性。
AI.motivation: LLM在多语言泛化方面能力有限，尤其对非英语和训练数据中稀有的语言表现不佳。作者希望从认知科学中相似性驱动的泛化理论出发，探究LLM表征中语言之间的相似性结构是否影响其跨语言泛化能力。
AI.method: 分析了LLM潜在表征中语言之间的相似性结构，检验其是否能恢复印欧语系的语言层次树结构；并将表征中反映的语言相似性程度与模型在XNLI（多语言自然语言推理基准）上的性能进行相关性分析。
AI.result: LLM的潜在表征在很大程度上恢复了印欧语系的层次结构——同一子语系的语言在表征空间中紧密聚类。模型反映语言相似性结构的程度与XNLI性能呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 模型若能将相似语言在表征空间中表示得更接近，则能从一种语言向另一种语言更好地泛化。这扩展了基于相似性驱动的泛化经典理论在大规模模型中的适用性。

title: GaitFace: A Multimodal Dataset for Long-Range Person Identification
summary: Efficient border control is becoming a significant global challenge, mainly due to severe congestion and extended passenger waiting times. To mitigate these bottlenecks and facilitate passenger flow, biometric technologies are increasingly deployed to streamline identity verification and enhance crossing efficiency. Technical limitations frequently impede biometric identification, particularly in long-range surveillance, where systems must deal with adverse atmospheric conditions and degraded image quality. While high-quality frameworks like BRIAR exist, they are frequently restricted to specific government agencies. This paper introduces GaitFace, a new public dataset that contains face and gait data captured at long distances. To ensure that the research reflects authentic border scenarios, we use Pre-Enrollment data, where a traveler registers via a mobile device, and "In-the-Wild" captures, which records individuals at a distance across multiple viewing angles and different cameras. Benchmarking SOTA face and gait models reveals that current architectures fail under low-resolution and elevated viewpoints despite success with optical assistance. GaitFace exposes these critical vulnerabilities, providing a rigorous public benchmark to drive more robust, unconstrained biometric research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GaitFace，一个用于长距离边境管控场景的公开人脸与步态数据集，包含预登记和野外采集数据，揭示了现有SOTA模型在低分辨率和俯视角条件下的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 边境管控面临严重拥堵和等待时间过长的问题，生物识别技术被用于加速通关，但远距离监控中图像质量差、环境条件恶劣导致识别受限；现有高质量数据集（如BRIAR）仅限政府使用，缺乏公开的远距离生物识别基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建GaitFace公开数据集，包含两种数据：Pre-Enrollment（旅客通过移动设备预注册）和In-the-Wild（远距离多视角、多摄像头拍摄）；对SOTA人脸和步态模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: 现有SOTA模型在光学辅助下表现良好，但在低分辨率和俯视角条件下识别性能显著下降，暴露了当前架构在非受控远距离场景下的关键脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: GaitFace为远距离、非约束环境下的生物识别研究提供了严格的公开基准，驱动更鲁棒的生物识别技术发展。

title: RoleMix: Unifying Sequential and Non-Sequential Features via Semantic Tokenization for Post-Click Conversion Rate Prediction
summary: Post-click conversion rate (PCVR) prediction is central to industrial recommendation, but remains challenged by the structural mismatch between sparse, unordered multi-field features and long, domain-specific behavior histories. Existing models often process these signals through separate pathways and fuse them late, weakening semantic roles and limiting cross-signal refinement. We propose RoleMix, a unified interaction architecture that represents sequential and non-sequential evidence through a shared, role-preserving token interface. Non-sequential fields are converted into explicit semantic tokens that preserve user, item, pairwise, dense, contextual, and cross-feature roles, while long behavior domains are compressed into item- and context-aware sequence-query tokens through two-stage hierarchical window attention. The resulting global, semantic, and sequence-query tokens are jointly refined by stacked UniMixing-Lite blocks for PCVR prediction. On the large-scale KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge, RoleMix achieves 83.648% online AUC, outperforming the official industrial baseline by 1.953%. Ablation studies show that semantic tokenization yields the largest isolated gain, highlighting a key principle for large-scale PCVR modeling: preserving field semantics at the token-interface level is as important as scaling the interaction backbone.

AI.tldr: RoleMix提出统一的角色保留令牌接口，将稀疏多域特征和长行为历史融合为全局、语义和序列查询三类令牌，通过UniMixing-Lite模块联合精化，在KDD Cup 2026腾讯榜单上AUC达83.648%，比工业基线高1.953%。消融实验表明语义令牌化贡献最大，揭示保留字段语义与扩展交互骨干同等重要。
AI.motivation: 后点击转化率预测面临稀疏无序的多域特征与长行为历史之间的结构不匹配问题，现有模型通常分路径处理并晚期融合，削弱了语义角色并限制了跨信号精化。
AI.method: 提出RoleMix统一交互架构：1) 非序列字段转为显式语义令牌（用户、物品、成对、密集、上下文、交叉特征角色）；2) 长行为序列通过两阶段分层窗口注意力压缩为物品感知和上下文感知的序列查询令牌；3) 全局、语义、序列查询三类令牌通过堆叠UniMixing-Lite模块联合精化。
AI.result: 在KDD Cup 2026腾讯UniRec挑战赛上，在线AUC达83.648%，比官方工业基线高1.953%。
AI.conclusion: 保留字段语义的令牌化与扩展交互骨干同等重要，为大规模PCVR建模提供了关键设计原则。

title: D3O: Dynamic Distribution Distillation for Ordinal Regression
summary: Ordinal regression is widely used in scenarios where labels are discrete yet inherently ordered. In practice, however, ordinal labels are often obtained by discretizing underlying continuous semantics through subjective human judgment, resulting in ambiguous boundaries and annotation noise. Such uncertainty challenges existing methods that rely on fixed supervision targets, which may reinforce biased ordering under subjective annotations. To address this limitation, we propose D3O, a dynamic distribution distillation framework that replaces static supervision with training-driven evolution of ordinal label distributions via self-distillation. Specifically, we introduce a contrastive ordinal-aware label enhancement module that leverages vision-language alignment to recover refined label distributions capturing both inter-class ambiguity and instance-level uncertainty. Furthermore, we design a CDF-based cross-layer interaction distillation mechanism to propagate cumulative ordinal structure across network hierarchy, ensuring consistent ordinal geometry in intermediate representations. Extensive experiments on four general ordinal regression tasks demonstrate that our proposed D3O consistently outperforms existing approaches, particularly under severe class imbalance and noisy supervision. These results highlight the effectiveness of dynamic supervision in learning robust ordinal representations beyond fixed targets. The code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: D3O提出了一种动态分布蒸馏框架，通过自蒸馏将静态监督替换为训练驱动的序数标签分布演化，结合对比序数感知标签增强和基于CDF的跨层交互蒸馏，在四个序数回归任务中显著优于现有方法，尤其在类不平衡和噪声监督场景下表现突出。
AI.motivation: 传统序数回归依赖固定的监督目标，但实际中序数标签常通过主观判断离散化得到，存在边界模糊和标注噪声，固定目标会强化有偏的排序，因此需要更灵活的动态监督机制。
AI.method: (1) 动态分布蒸馏框架(D3O)：用自蒸馏实现训练驱动的序数标签分布演化；(2) 对比序数感知标签增强模块：利用视觉-语言对齐恢复细粒度标签分布，捕获类间模糊性和实例级不确定性；(3) 基于CDF的跨层交互蒸馏机制：在网络层级间传播累积序数结构，保持中间表示的序数几何一致性。
AI.result: 在四个通用序数回归任务上，D3O一致优于现有方法，尤其在严重类不平衡和噪声监督条件下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 动态监督能够学习超越固定目标的鲁棒序数表示，验证了D3O框架在处理不确定性和噪声标注方面的有效性。

title: MPR-CiteG: Enhancing RAG with Multi-Portfolio Retrieval and Citation-Grounded Generation
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. The 1st International Workshop on Retrieval-Driven Generative AI & ScienceON AI Challenge 2025@CIKM
summary: This paper presents the MPR-CiteG framework, which achieved second place in the ScienceON AI Challenge by addressing two fundamental challenges in generative AI: inefficient retrieval and the absence of source verification. We propose a dual-component system, termed MPR-CiteG, in which the Multi-Portfolio Retriever (MPR) efficiently retrieves diverse and relevant information, while the Citation-Grounded Generation (CiteG) module ensures that every generated output remains factually consistent and explicitly attributed to its source. MPR-CiteG represents a significant step toward building more trustworthy and accurate LLMs that are not only capable of generating information but also of grounding their responses in reliable evidence, thereby mitigating common issues like model hallucination. Extensive experiments on the challenge dataset validate the effectiveness and reliability of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/2noweyh/MPR-citeG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MPR-CiteG框架，在ScienceON AI挑战赛中获得第二名。该框架通过双组件系统（多组合检索器MPR和引文生成模块CiteG）解决了生成式AI中检索效率低下和缺乏来源验证两大问题，有效提升了LLM的可靠性和事实一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI存在两个根本性挑战：检索效率低下（无法高效获取多样且相关的信息）以及缺乏来源验证（生成内容无法追溯到可靠证据），这导致模型易产生幻觉。
AI.method: 提出双组件系统MPR-CiteG：(1) 多组合检索器（MPR）高效检索多样且相关的信息；(2) 引文生成模块（CiteG）确保每个输出都有事实依据并明确标注来源。
AI.result: 在ScienceON AI挑战赛数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法在有效性和可靠性方面的表现，最终获得第二名。
AI.conclusion: MPR-CiteG是构建更可信、更准确的LLM的重要一步，不仅能生成信息，还能将响应锚定在可靠证据上，从而缓解模型幻觉等常见问题。

title: Neuromorphic Object Detection: An In-Depth Study and Future Directions
comment: Accepted by Proceedings of the IEEE
summary: Conventional frame-based cameras face significant challenges in detecting objects under high-speed motion blur or in low-light environments. Neuromorphic cameras provide asynchronous visual streams with high temporal resolution and a wide dynamic range, offering a promising solution for object detection under challenging conditions. Despite the development of numerous models and the emergence of various applications in neuromorphic object detection, there is still a lack of deep understanding and standardized benchmarks to assess progress and address key challenges. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey and benchmark of existing neuromorphic object detection algorithms. Specifically, we first present a problem description, review the available datasets, and revisit the evaluation metrics. We then explore existing neuromorphic object detection approaches from various perspectives, including event representation, temporal modeling, multimodal fusion, asynchronous processing, low-latency processing, and energy-efficient computing. Furthermore, we evaluate a wide range of representative neuromorphic object detection models and offer detailed analyses of the comparative results. Finally, we discuss unresolved issues in neuromorphic object detection and propose potential future research directions. We hope this survey and benchmark will be a valuable resource for researchers and provide guidance for future advancements in neuromorphic object detection.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了神经形态相机在物体检测中的研究进展，包括问题描述、数据集、评价指标、现有方法（事件表示、时间建模、多模态融合、异步/低延迟/低能耗处理），并进行了广泛的模型基准测试，最后讨论了未解决问题和未来方向。
AI.motivation: 传统帧相机在高动态运动模糊或低光照环境下检测物体效果不佳，而神经形态相机虽具潜力，但该领域缺乏深度理解和标准化基准来评估进展和应对关键挑战。
AI.method: 首先给出问题描述、综述现有数据集和评价指标；然后从事件表示、时间建模、多模态融合、异步处理、低延迟处理和低能耗计算等角度梳理现有方法；最后对代表性神经形态物体检测模型进行广泛的比较评估和分析。
AI.result: 提供了对神经形态物体检测算法的全面综述与基准测试，包括详细的分析和比较结果。
AI.conclusion: 该综述和基准将为研究人员提供宝贵资源，并为神经形态物体检测的未来发展提供指导。

title: SEGRA: Structured Experience-Guided Graph Reasoning Agent for Gremlin Based Question Answering
summary: Enterprise IT support knowledge graphs capture rich relationships among cases, users, devices, symptoms, taxonomic categories, root causes, and historical resolutions. Yet querying them in Gremlin requires knowledge of graph schemas, traversal semantics, edge directionality, and property-graph-specific constraints, making them difficult for non-expert operators to use. We introduce SEGRA, an experience-guided agent for enterprise text-to-Gremlin question answering. SEGRA integrates intent routing, schema- and taxonomy-grounded query generation, multi-shot decomposition, execution-aware verification, and a curriculum-bootstrapped skill library that reuses verified query patterns. On an enterprise IT support benchmark, SEGRA achieves a $7.0\times$ higher mean judge score than backbone-only chain-of-thought prompting. Its skill library further reduces LLM calls by $20\%$ and dollar cost by $18\%$ relative to SEGRA without skills, while preserving answer quality. These results show that schema-grounded agent design and reusable execution experience improve both accuracy and efficiency for enterprise graph QA.

AI.tldr: SEGRA 是一个面向企业IT支持领域的文本转Gremlin问答智能体，通过意图路由、模式与分类树驱动的查询生成、多轮分解、执行感知验证以及课程引导的技能库复用机制，相比纯思维链提示方法提升了7倍的评测分数，并降低了20%的LLM调用次数和18%的成本。
AI.motivation: 企业IT支持知识图谱查询需要掌握Gremlin语法、图模式、遍历语义及边方向等专业知识，非专家操作员难以使用，亟需一种面向自然语言查询的自动化翻译方法。
AI.method: SEGRA 结合了意图路由（intent routing）、基于模式与分类树的查询生成（schema- and taxonomy-grounded query generation）、多轮分解（multi-shot decomposition）、执行感知验证（execution-aware verification），以及课程引导的技能库（curriculum-bootstrapped skill library）来复用已验证的查询模式。
AI.result: 在企业IT支持基准上，SEGRA 的评测分数比骨干模型+思维链提示高出7倍；技能库相比无技能版本减少20%的LLM调用次数和18%的美元成本，同时保持答案质量。
AI.conclusion: 模式驱动的智能体设计与可复用的执行经验能够显著提升企业图问答的准确性与效率。

title: SketchMamba: A Lightweight State-Space Model for Joint Progressive Sketch Classification and Stroke Auto-Completion
summary: Existing vector-sketch models treat recognition and generation as separate tasks, leaving a gap for streaming interfaces that must understand a drawing as it is being made. We present SketchMamba, a single causal sequence model that continuously classifies a sketch from any partial prefix while simultaneously generating its continuation. We achieve this by applying a dense per-step classification loss to a selective state-space backbone. Evaluated on a 58-class subset of the Quick, Draw! dataset, SketchMamba yields 94.93% final-step accuracy and a progressive-accuracy Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.706, crossing 90% of its final accuracy by the time 70% of the strokes are drawn. In a matched-budget comparison, the 1.55 million-parameter backbone ties a causal Transformer while outperforming recurrent and convolutional baselines. Ablations confirm that the dense supervision regime, rather than the architecture alone, drives the early-prediction capability. The results demonstrate that a single causal hidden state can unify progressive recognition and autoregressive generation without auxiliary encoders or task-specific branching.

AI.tldr: SketchMamba是一个单因果序列模型，通过在选择性状态空间骨干上应用密集逐步分类损失，实现了草图的渐进式分类与自回归生成统一，在Quick, Draw!数据集上达到94.93%的最终准确率和0.706的渐进准确率AUC。
AI.motivation: 现有向量草图模型将识别与生成视为分离任务，无法满足需要边画边理解的流式交互场景需求。
AI.method: 采用单一因果序列模型，以选择性状态空间模型（Mamba）为骨干，引入密集逐步分类损失(per-step classification loss)，实现任意前缀下的连续分类与自回归生成。
AI.result: 在Quick, Draw! 58类子集上，最终步准确率94.93%，渐进准确率AUC为0.706，在画出70%笔画时达到最终准确率的90%。1.55M参数的模型在匹配预算下与因果Transformer持平，优于RNN和CNN基线。
AI.conclusion: 单一因果隐状态无需辅助编码器或任务特定分支即可统一渐进式识别与自回归生成，密集监督机制是早期预测能力的关键驱动因素。

title: Spatial Reasoning in LLM Game Agents: Impact of Causal Context and Multi-Step Planning
summary: LLM-based game agents often perform poorly on more complex tasks. This work examines whether these failures are linked to limited spatial reasoning and evaluates whether causal prompt augmentation and multi-step planning can improve win-rates while managing response latency. Using the open-source Qwen3 model family, we conduct experiments across varying model scales, reasoning modes, and planning horizons. We further introduce a focused GVGAI benchmark consisting of three custom games with five difficulty levels to isolate spatial navigation. The evaluation follows two paradigms: an initial ``positioning experiment'' to test an agent's ability to find its exact coordinates, and a study of game-play success. Our results show that while larger models with an enabled thinking mode identify their positions more accurately, overall performance in coordinate matching remains limited for smaller models. Win rates decrease as game levels and layout complexity increase, validating the benchmark's difficulty scaling. Integrating causal context into the prompts tends to improve the agents' success rates, particularly for bigger models. While enabling thinking mode and longer planning horizons significantly improve performance, multi-step planning further reduces mean per-step response times, offering a practical trade-off between reasoning depth and execution speed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM游戏智能体在复杂任务中表现不佳的原因，聚焦于空间推理能力限制。通过使用Qwen3模型家族，在不同模型规模、推理模式和规划视野下进行实验，并引入定制的GVGAI基准测试（包含3个自定义游戏、5个难度级别）。结果表明：大型模型在开启思考模式时能更准确识别位置，但小型模型坐标匹配能力有限；游戏难度增加导致胜率下降；因果提示增强可提升智能体成功率（尤其对大型模型）；思考模式和更长规划视野显著提升性能，而多步规划能降低平均每步响应时间，在推理深度和执行速度之间实现实用权衡。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM游戏智能体在复杂任务中的失败是否与空间推理能力有限有关，并评估因果提示增强和多步规划能否在管理响应延迟的同时提升胜率。
AI.method: 使用开源Qwen3模型家族，在不同模型规模、推理模式和规划视野下进行实验；引入定制的GVGAI基准测试（3个自定义游戏、5个难度级别）；采用定位实验和游戏成功两种评估范式。
AI.result: 大型模型在开启思考模式时位置识别更准确，但小型模型坐标匹配能力有限；胜率随游戏层级和布局复杂度增加而下降；因果上下文提示可提升智能体成功率（尤其对大型模型）；思考模式和长规划视野显著提升性能，多步规划降低平均每步响应时间。
AI.conclusion: 因果提示增强和多步规划能在推理深度和执行速度之间实现实用权衡，有助于提升LLM游戏智能体在复杂空间任务中的表现。

title: JarvisHub: An Open Harness for Canvas-Native Multimodal Creative Agents
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Project page: https://www.jarvishub.site/ Code github: https://github.com/LYL1015/JarvisHub
summary: Creative AI is moving from single-step asset generation toward long-horizon multimodal production. Although recent generative models can synthesize high-quality images, videos, audio clips, UI elements, storyboards, slides, and other creative assets, real-world creative work requires more than isolated prompt-output interactions. It involves references, drafts, alternatives, edits, failed attempts, version relations, tool actions, evaluation signals, and human feedback, which together form an evolving project state. Existing prompt-based, chat-based, and node-based generation systems only partially support this state, as they often discard intermediate context, rely on linear conversations, or require manually specified workflows. Recent commercial systems indicate a shift toward agent-assisted creative production, but their closed architectures make it difficult to study how agents represent context, choose tools, revise artifacts, recover from failures, and maintain consistency over time. To address this gap, we introduce JarvisHub, a canvas-native creative agent harness for long-horizon multimodal creation. JarvisHub treats an editable canvas as the user workspace, the agent's external memory, action space, and shared project state, representing multimodal artifacts, dependencies, versions, and feedback as typed canvas nodes and links. Through a three-layer architecture of canvas state, protocol bridge, and agent runtime, JarvisHub enables agents to act within an inspectable and editable creative state. This design moves creative agents beyond isolated tool use toward sustained, human-steerable creative automation, where agents can progressively plan, generate, revise, and organize multimodal projects while users remain able to inspect, guide, and intervene throughout the process.

AI.tldr: JarvisHub 是一个画布原生的创意智能体框架，通过三层架构（画布状态、协议桥接、智能体运行时）将可编辑画布作为用户工作区、智能体外记忆、动作空间和共享项目状态，支持长期多模态创作中智能体的渐进式规划、生成、修订和组织，同时保持用户的可审查、引导和干预能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示、聊天和节点的生成系统仅部分支持创意工作所需的项目状态（包括参考、草稿、替代方案、编辑、失败尝试、版本关系、工具动作、评估信号和人类反馈），它们常丢弃中间上下文、依赖线性对话或需手动指定工作流；商业系统虽向智能体辅助创作转变，但封闭架构难以研究智能体如何表示上下文、选择工具、修订作品、从失败中恢复和保持一致性。
AI.method: 提出 JarvisHub，一个画布原生（canvas-native）的创意智能体框架，采用三层架构：1）画布状态层——将多模态产物、依赖关系、版本和反馈表示为类型化的画布节点和链接；2）协议桥接层——连接画布状态与智能体运行时；3）智能体运行时层——驱动智能体在可审查和可编辑的创意状态中执行动作。
AI.result: 实现了一种将可编辑画布同时作为用户工作区、智能体外记忆、动作空间和共享项目状态的设计，使智能体能够在持续、人类可控的自动创作中逐步规划、生成、修订和组织多模态项目。
AI.conclusion: 该设计将创意智能体从孤立的工具使用推进到持续的、人类可引导的创意自动化，用户在整个创作过程中能够审查、引导和干预智能体的行为。

title: Commitment To Cooperation With Self-Negotiated Contracts
summary: As AI agents operate with increasing autonomy in a multi-agent world, they will need to learn to cooperate with other agents and with humans to generate mutual benefits. However, cooperation is a challenge because the costs of cooperation are often incurred early on, but the benefits are only realized later, creating an incentive to defect. How can AI agents cooperate with commitment? Here, we draw on inspiration from legal institutions and contracting that human societies have used to solve principal-agent problems of this kind. Contracts provide observable representations of agreements that enable credible commitments through the enforcement of terms. We study the role of contract-based cooperation using LLM-based agents in \CT, a spatial-temporal game that combines bargaining with navigation towards a goal. We study a suite of contract representations that range from formal contracts that compile to code to natural contracts that require reinterpretation. We evaluate agents with a range of LLM backbones using different sizes and providers. We find that self-negotiated contracts can improve cooperative outcomes beyond what is possible with regular trading.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于合同的AI代理合作机制，通过让LLM代理在时空博弈中自我协商合同，发现合同能改善合作结果，尤其当合同具有可执行性（形式化合同优于自然语言合同）。
AI.motivation: AI代理在多智能体环境中需要学会合作以产生互惠利益，但合作存在早期成本与后期收益的时间错配问题，导致背叛激励。如何让AI代理实现可信承诺（commitment）成为核心挑战。
AI.method: 借鉴人类社会解决委托-代理问题的法律制度和合同机制，在\CT（结合谈判与导航的时空博弈）中，使用LLM代理研究合同基合作。探索从形式化合同（编译为代码）到自然语言合同（需要重新解释）的一系列合同表示形式，并使用不同规模和提供商的LLM骨干网络进行评估。
AI.result: 自我协商的合同能够改善合作结果，其效果优于单纯的交易机制。合同的可执行性（形式化程度）与合作效果正相关。
AI.conclusion: 合同机制（尤其是形式化合同）能有效促进AI代理间的可信承诺与合作，为多智能体系统中的合作问题提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Weakly Supervised Instance-Level Gleason Pattern Estimation Using Primary and Secondary Labels
summary: In prostate cancer histopathology, the Gleason Score is determined by the most frequent (Primary) and second most frequent (Secondary) Gleason patterns within a whole-slide image. Although these slide-level labels are routinely available in clinical practice, instance-level Gleason annotations are rarely provided, making patch-level learning challenging. We propose a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) framework that estimates instance-level Gleason patterns from slide-level Primary and Secondary labels. The proposed method formulates instance-level learning according to the clinical definition of the Gleason Score by aggregating instance predictions into class counts and explicitly modeling the Primary pattern, Secondary pattern, and their dominance. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed formulation enables effective instance-level learning and outperforms existing MIL approaches on the SICAP-MIL dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于多实例学习的Gleason评分框架，利用全切片图像中的Primary和Secondary标签进行实例级模式学习，在SICAP-MIL数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 临床实践中Gleason评分基于全切片级别的主/次要模式标签，但实例级（patch级）注释稀缺，导致patch级学习困难。现有方法难以从弱监督的幻灯片级标签有效推断实例级Gleason模式。
AI.method: 提出MIL框架，根据Gleason评分的临床定义，通过聚合实例预测为类别计数，显式建模Primary模式、Secondary模式及其主导关系，实现实例级Gleason模式学习。
AI.result: 在SICAP-MIL数据集上的实验表明，该公式能够有效进行实例级学习，并优于现有的MIL方法。
AI.conclusion: 该MIL框架利用临床可及的幻灯片级主/次要标签成功实现了实例级Gleason模式预测，验证了符合临床定义的建模策略的有效性。

title: Disentangling Multi-View Scanning in Mamba for Network Traffic Anomaly Detection
summary: Network Traffic Anomaly Detection (NTAD) is a critical task in cybersecurity, yet timely and accurate anomaly detection remains challenging. Mamba has emerged as a particularly promising backbone for NTAD due to its linear-time complexity for long-sequence modeling. It further incorporates a dedicated multi-view scanning mechanism to enhance detection precision through complementary contextual cues. However, we identify a previously overlooked structural deficiency in multi-view Mamba scanning for NTAD: redundancy accumulation. Specifically, distinct scanning branches capture substantial view-invariant information, which is repeatedly amplified during multi-view fusion; conversely, view-specific information is diluted or even suppressed, leading to representation homogenization and multi-view degradation. To address this problem, we propose DisenMamba, a novel disentangled multi-view Mamba framework. DisenMamba reformulates multi-view scanning as a two-stage disentangle-then-fuse process that explicitly separates view-invariant and view-specific components prior to fusion. This design prevents the invariant information accumulation while preserving complementary multi-view cues, yielding more discriminative representations for subtle traffic anomalies. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of DisenMamba, establishing a new disentangled multi-view Mamba paradigm. Code is available at https://github.com/ikun0124/DisenMamba.
