AI.tldr: DisenMamba提出了一种解耦多视图Mamba框架，通过将多视图扫描重构为"先解耦后融合"的两阶段过程，显式分离视图不变和视图特定信息，解决了Mamba在网络流量异常检测中存在的冗余积累问题，提升了检测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的多视图Mamba扫描机制存在结构缺陷：不同扫描分支捕获了大量视图不变信息，在多视图融合过程中被重复放大，而视图特定信息被稀释甚至抑制，导致表征同质化和多视图退化，影响了网络流量异常检测的准确性。
AI.method: 提出DisenMamba框架，将多视图扫描重新设计为两阶段"解耦-融合"过程：第一阶段显式分离视图不变组件和视图特定组件，第二阶段再进行融合，防止不变信息积累的同时保留互补的多视图线索。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了DisenMamba的有效性，建立了新的解耦多视图Mamba范式。
AI.conclusion: DisenMamba通过解耦机制有效缓解了多视图Mamba的冗余积累问题，为网络流量异常检测提供了更具判别力的表征，代码已开源。

title: ConFusion: Continuous Fusion Space Learning for Fine-Grained Controllable Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
summary: Controllable infrared-visible image fusion aims to integrate complementary thermal and structural information with flexible region-aware modulation, producing fused images that adapt to diverse user requirements and downstream tasks. However, existing methods typically rely on predefined discrete control conditions, leading to a sparse space that fails to support fine-grained modulation demands. To address this, we propose ConFusion, a novel framework that learns the continuous fusion space via Gaussian-conditioned spatial-aware modulation, enabling instance-level fine-grained controllable infrared and visible image fusion. ConFusion employs a dual-branch architecture to disentangle modality-invariant and modality-specific representations under joint reconstruction and text-guided semantic alignment. Gaussian-conditioned instance modulation variables coupled with Grounded SAM-based instance masks guide instance-level fine-grained modulation through the Mask-Guided Specific Feature Modulator, while the Text-Driven Invariant Feature Enhancer improves semantic consistency and enhances fusion. During inference, the multimodal large language model parses user intents into instance-level modulation variables to guide image fusion. Extensive experiments show that ConFusion achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics in both fusion quality and downstream tasks, while supporting fine-grained controllable image fusion. Our code is available at https://github.com/HeyufeiAnto/Confusion

AI.tldr: ConFusion提出了一种基于高斯条件空间感知调制的新型可控红外-可见光图像融合框架，通过实例级细粒度调制实现连续融合空间学习，在融合质量和下游任务上均达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有可控红外-可见光图像融合方法依赖预定义的离散控制条件，导致控制空间稀疏，无法支持细粒度调制需求。
AI.method: 采用双分支架构解耦模态不变与模态特定表征，通过联合重建和文本引导语义对齐进行学习；使用高斯条件实例调制变量结合Grounded SAM实例掩码，通过掩码引导特定特征调制器实现实例级细粒度调制；文本驱动不变特征增强器提升语义一致性；推理时利用多模态大语言模型解析用户意图为实例级调制变量。
AI.result: 在融合质量和下游任务的多项指标上均达到SOTA性能，支持细粒度可控图像融合。
AI.conclusion: ConFusion通过学习连续融合空间实现实例级细粒度可控融合，有效解决了离散控制条件稀疏的问题，代码已开源。

title: Coordinated Networking for On-Device Agent-Augmented Real-Time Communication
summary: AI agents are enabling a new paradigm of agent-augmented real-time communication (RTC), where humans focus on high-level collaboration, while agents autonomously retrieve, analyze, and generate information in real time to support their interactions. These apps enable new experiences across various domains: for example, when corporate employees co-author a legal document, their agents can discuss and draft on their behalf, sparing them the burden of manually reviewing each other's work. As existing cloud-based agents suffer from privacy risks and unscalable server costs, on-device agent-augmented RTC offers a promising alternative. However, this on-device paradigm introduces a new networking challenge: contention between concurrent traffic flows generated by humans (for live video streaming) and agents (for sending context files for analysis). We design HFS, a framework to ensure both high live video quality and low agent response latency in agent-augmented RTC apps. We achieve the goal through an app-guided multi-flow transport approach, where a unified app-layer orchestrator jointly controls the sending rates of live video and agent context flows based on their heterogeneous app requirements. Our prototype built atop WebRTC and llama.cpp demonstrates that HAFS outperforms baselines, achieving 1.5x higher video quality while reducing agent response time by 31%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HFS框架，通过应用层统一编排器联合控制实时视频流和智能体上下文流的发送速率，在端侧智能体增强的实时通信中兼顾高视频质量和低智能体响应延迟，原型系统在WebRTC和llama.cpp上实现，相比基线提升1.5倍视频质量并降低31%智能体响应时间。
AI.motivation: 现有基于云的智能体增强实时通信存在隐私风险和不可扩展的服务器成本，而端侧方案引入人机并发流量（视频流与智能体上下文文件流）之间的网络竞争问题，亟需一种能同时保证直播视频质量和智能体响应延迟的传输方案。
AI.method: 提出HFS框架，采用应用导向的多流传输方法，通过统一的应用层编排器，根据视频流和智能体上下文流异构的应用需求（视频流对实时性敏感，上下文流对完整性敏感）联合控制两股流的发送速率，实现资源感知的协同调度。
AI.result: 基于WebRTC和llama.cpp的原型系统实验表明，HFS相比基线方法提升了1.5倍视频质量，同时将智能体响应时间降低31%。
AI.conclusion: HFS框架有效解决了端侧智能体增强实时通信中人机并发流量竞争问题，验证了应用层多流协同调度在资源受限的端侧设备上的可行性，为隐私保护的实时智能体协作提供了新的网络基础。

title: Markerless Motion Capture in Routine Clinical Upper Limb Assessments: Validity and Insights Beyond Ordinal Scoring
summary: The Action Research Arm Test (ARAT) is a widely-used upper limb outcome measure in neurorehabilitation, but its ordinal scoring is subjective and suffers from limited sensitivity and specificity. We evaluated whether artificial-intelligence (AI)-based markerless motion capture (MMC), embedded into ARAT assessments during clinical routine, accurately reconstructs upper limb movement and yields valid, objective kinematic metrics carrying clinically meaningful information beyond the ordinal score. Across 47 sessions from 20 mixed-neurological patients (1,174 ARAT tasks), biomechanical reconstruction was accurate and robust across impairment levels, and kinematic metrics showed the discrimination pattern expected of a construct-valid measure. In longitudinal case studies, the metrics added the specificity and sensitivity the ordinal score lacks: a domain decomposition exposed patient-specific recovery profiles underlying equal ARAT gains (specificity), and kinematic improvement continued to be detected after the ARAT had saturated (sensitivity). MMC in clinical routine can thus provide valid, objective, sensitive, and specific kinematic measurement complementing ordinal scoring.

AI.tldr: 本研究将基于AI的无标记运动捕捉（MMC）嵌入临床常规ARAT评估，证明其能准确重建上肢运动，提供有效、客观的运动学指标，在纵向案例中展现出比传统ARAT序数评分更高的特异性（区分不同恢复模式）和敏感性（评分饱和后仍持续检测改善）。
AI.motivation: ARAT量表是神经康复中广泛使用的上肢评估工具，但其序数评分存在主观性强、敏感性和特异性有限的固有缺陷，亟需更客观、灵敏的量化评估方法。
AI.method: 对20名混合神经系统患者的47次评估（1,174个ARAT任务），采用AI驱动的无标记运动捕捉技术嵌入常规ARAT评估流程，进行生物力学重建并提取运动学指标。
AI.result: 生物力学重建在不同功能障碍水平患者中均准确且稳健；运动学指标展现出符合构造效度的区分模式；纵向病例分析中，运动学指标揭示了相同ARAT评分下不同的患者特异性恢复轨迹（特异性），并在ARAT评分饱和后仍能检测到运动学改善（敏感性）。
AI.conclusion: 将无标记运动捕捉技术整合到临床常规ARAT评估中，能够提供有效、客观、敏感且特异的运动学测量，可作为序数评分的有力补充。

title: What Can Be Enforced? A Theory of Certified Runtime Safety for Tool-Using Agents
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures. Extended version with complete proofs and additional experiments
summary: Runtime guardrails act before irreversible tool calls, but their guarantees depend on what policy state is representable, what a judge observes, and whether intervention changes future behavior. We separate three questions. First, relative to fixed oracle predicates, a deterministic gate enforces exactly the nonempty safety policies whose good prefixes its register model recognizes; policy nontriviality is undecidable with two decrementable counters but in PSPACE for a separable monotone fragment. Second, under a fixed exogenous law, Neyman-Pearson gives the exact false-block/miss frontier and conformal calibration gives a finite-sample marginal certificate, possibly via block-all. Third, once blocking changes future proposals, static scores and ungated trajectories need not identify the closed-loop frontier; a specified finite controlled model instead yields an occupancy program. Bounded representation attacks add a robustness margin, so benign calibration alone does not transfer. Experiments target these distinctions through static diagnostics, controlled-model enumeration, representation rewrites, and paired closed-loop reruns.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地解耦了运行时护栏（Runtime Guardrails）的三个核心问题：1）确定性门控在寄存器模型下的策略可表示性与可判定性；2）在固定外生规律下，Neyman-Pearson与共形校准提供的误拦/漏放边界与有限样本保证；3）当阻断改变未来提案后，静态评分与无门控轨迹无法刻画闭环边界，需用有限受控模型生成占用程序。实验通过静态诊断、受控模型枚举、表示重写和配对闭环重跑验证上述区分。
AI.motivation: 现有运行时护栏在不可逆工具调用前的干预机制缺乏对策略状态可表示性、裁决者观测能力以及干预行为对未来行为影响的形式化保证，导致其安全承诺不明确。作者旨在分离并形式化这三个维度的问题。
AI.method: 分别从三个正交问题入手：1）形式语言与自动机理论分析寄存器模型对安全策略的可识别性，给出非平凡性不可判定与可分离单调片段属于PSPACE的结论；2）采用Neyman-Pearson引理刻画假正/假负的最优边界，用共形校准提供有限样本边际保证；3）引入有限受控模型与占用规划处理闭环场景，并用有界表示攻击添加鲁棒性边界。
AI.result: 1）确定性门控在寄存器模型下精确识别非空安全策略的好前缀可识别子集；两个递减计数器下策略非平凡性不可判定，可分离单调片段在PSPACE内。2）Neyman-Pearson给出精确的误拦-漏放前沿，共形校准提供有限样本边际保证（可能退回全部阻断）。3）闭环场景下静态评分不可靠，需有限受控模型与占用程序；有界表示攻击表明仅靠良性校准不足以迁移。
AI.conclusion: 运行时护栏的安全保证依赖三个相互独立的因素（策略表示、观测与干预反馈），不能混为一谈；静态诊断与闭环设计需区分对待，实际部署需同时考虑表示攻击下的鲁棒性。

title: PathSelect: Sequential Token Selection for Whole Slide Pathology
summary: Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images (WSIs) present a fundamental computational bottleneck for vision-language models (VLMs) due to extreme sequence lengths. Existing approaches predominantly rely on spatial sampling or training-free pruning, which risk diluting weak but informative signals, leading to the loss of critical diagnostic evidence due to the spatially diffuse nature of pathological cues. We reformulate WSI token pruning as a sequential selection process, enabling the model to autonomously learn an optimal routing strategy rather than relying on static heuristics. We herein propose a decoupled routing framework integrated as an active plugin into the fully pre-trained SlideChat base model, leaving both the slide encoder and large language model frozen. To provide continuous gradients for the non-differentiable pruning operation during training, we introduce PathSelect. PathSelect employs a variance-preserving noise gate to modulate each patch's information flow via a differentiable Soft Top-K operator, paired with a diagonal-attention Denoiser that recovers the perturbed representations without semantic leakage. At inference, the PathSelect module is entirely detached. Relying solely on the trained Scorer, a deterministic Hard Top-K operator executes adaptive, data-dependent trajectory termination, significantly accelerating downstream generative processing with exceptionally low sequential token selection latency. Driven by an empirical average of only 44.86 tokens under a maximum constraint of K = 128, our framework achieves 74.00% overall accuracy on SlideBench (TCGA), representing an approximate 36.6x spatial token reduction relative to the uncompressed baseline average while consistently outperforming sampling-based counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PathSelect框架，通过可微分路径选择机制对全切片病理图像进行自适应token剪枝，在冻结编码器和LLM的条件下仅使用平均44.86个token即可在SlideBench上达到74.00%准确率，实现约36.6倍的空间token压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖空间采样或训练无关剪枝，这些静态策略难以捕捉病理信号在WSI中空间弥散分布的弱信号，易导致关键诊断证据丢失。作者希望让模型自主习得最优路由策略而非依赖固定启发式规则。
AI.method: 将WSI token剪枝重构为序列化选优过程，提出PathSelect作为可插拔模块集成到预训练SlideChat中。训练时采用方差保持噪声门控和可微Soft Top-K算子实现连续梯度传导，配合对角注意力去噪器恢复扰动表征；推理时完全移除该模块，仅用训练的Scorer执行确定性Hard Top-K剪枝。
AI.result: 在K=128最大约束下平均仅使用44.86个token，SlideBench(TCGA)总体准确率74.00%，相比未压缩基线实现约36.6倍空间token缩减，且一致优于基于采样的对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的解耦路由框架能有效解决WSI场景下视觉语言模型的序列长度瓶颈，通过可微分剪枝策略在极大压缩token数量的同时保持甚至提升诊断性能，验证了自主路由学习在病理图像分析中的有效性。

title: Physical AI Governance: From Theory to Practice Across Life Cycle
summary: With the emergence of Physical AI, artificial intelligence is extending beyond screen-based applications to embodied systems that perceive, interact with, and act in the physical world. Unlike traditional AI, Physical AI operates under real-time safety constraints, continuously interacts with dynamic environments, and coexists with humans, introducing governance challenges that existing AI governance frameworks do not explicitly address. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of Physical AI governance from both scientific and operational perspectives. We synthesize existing governance principles and organize them into a unified governance framework tailored to physical AI systems. Building on this foundation, we propose a five-stage Physical AI lifecycle comprising research, design, data, model development, and deployment, and demonstrate how governance can be operationalized across each stage through concrete implementation practices. By connecting governance principles with engineering workflows, this survey provides a structured reference for researchers, developers, and policymakers to build Physical AI systems that are safe, trustworthy, and aligned with societal values.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了Physical AI的治理问题，从科学和操作两个视角出发，提出了统一治理框架，并围绕研究、设计、数据、模型开发和部署五个阶段，详细阐述了如何将治理原则落实到具体工程实践中，旨在构建安全、可信且符合社会价值的Physical AI系统。
AI.motivation: Physical AI（物理人工智能）正从屏幕应用扩展到能够感知、交互和行动的具身系统，其在实时安全约束下运行、与动态环境持续交互并与人类共存，带来了现有AI治理框架尚未明确应对的治理挑战。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，综合现有治理原则并整合为针对Physical AI的统一治理框架；在此基础上提出Physical AI的五阶段生命周期（研究、设计、数据、模型开发、部署），并通过具体实施实践展示如何在每个阶段将治理操作化。
AI.result: 提出了一个面向Physical AI的统一治理框架，以及一个覆盖五个阶段的治理操作化方案，将治理原则与工程工作流相连接。
AI.conclusion: 本文为研究人员、开发者和政策制定者提供了结构化参考，以构建安全、可信且与社会价值观一致的Physical AI系统。

title: WGDnet: Wishart-guided Geometric-aware Deep Network for PolSAR Image Classification
summary: Polarimetric Synthetic Aperture Radar (PolSAR) classification underpins all-weather Earth observation. Conventional Wishart methods depend on rigid handcrafted operators with limited adaptability, while mainstream deep networks ignore PolSAR native Wishart scattering statistics. Additionally, fixed convolution windows fail to capture multi-scale, multi-directional terrain patterns, harming boundary detection and small-object characterization. To mitigate these drawbacks, we propose WGDNet, a Wishart-guided geometric-aware deep network. It integrates three core designs: (1) learnable Wishart convolutions with directional kernels for multi-scale statistical edge feature extraction; (2) an orientation-prior aggregation module that estimates dominant local directions and confidences to refine directional Wishart outputs adaptively; (3) GAnet, a scale-direction adaptive geometric-aware convolution that dynamically reshapes sampling grids to model anisotropic terrain and retain fine details. Our contributions lie in learnable Wishart statistical modeling, orientation-prior feature aggregation, and geometry-adaptive convolution. Evaluations across four real PolSAR datasets verify WGDNet surpasses existing state-of-the-art approaches in classification accuracy and boundary fidelity.

AI.tldr: WGDNet是一种结合Wishart统计建模与几何感知卷积的PolSAR分类网络，通过可学习Wishart卷积、方向先验聚合和自适应几何卷积三个核心模块，在四个真实数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统Wishart方法依赖刚性手工算子、适应性差，主流深度网络忽略PolSAR的Wishart散射统计特性，且固定卷积窗口无法捕获多尺度多方向地形模式，损害边界检测和小目标表征。
AI.method: 提出WGDNet，包含三个核心设计：(1) 可学习Wishart卷积，带方向核的多尺度统计边缘特征提取；(2) 方向先验聚合模块，估计局部主导方向和置信度以自适应细化方向Wishart输出；(3) GAnet，尺度-方向自适应几何感知卷积，动态重塑采样网格以建模各向异性地形并保留细节。
AI.result: 在四个真实PolSAR数据集上的评估验证WGDNet在分类精度和边界保真度方面均超越现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 可学习Wishart统计建模、方向先验特征聚合和几何自适应卷积是提升PolSAR分类性能的有效途径。

title: ConsistencyGate: Preventing Memory Contamination in LLM Agents via Self-Consistency Admission Control
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables, 1 algorithm; includes appendices
summary: LLM agents that operate over many turns accumulate facts in an external memory store and reuse them as premises for downstream reasoning. A hallucinated fact written at one step therefore persists as a false premise for every subsequent step, a failure mode we call memory contamination. Existing memory management addresses retrieval and capacity but not write-time correctness; this admission problem cannot be solved by utility- or recency-based criteria, and uncontrolled contamination compounds across long trajectories. We propose ConsistencyGate, a write-time admission gate that, before committing a candidate fact m extracted from context c, queries the LLM K times for a soft support score and admits m only when the average exceeds a threshold. The mechanism is model-agnostic, requires no fine-tuning, and reduces to a single forward pass in a log-probability variant for latency-sensitive deployments. To measure the effect on natural data, we construct two real-conversation benchmarks (LoCoMo-Contam and MSC-Contam) by planting controlled single-detail corruptions in long-term conversations from LoCoMo and MSC, and complement them with a structured synthetic corpus (MemContam) that isolates a near-oracle upper bound. Across four LLM backbones, ConsistencyGate reduces contamination on every benchmark relative to a write-everything baseline, with the cost concentrated on facts that are stated only implicitly in the source context. We release all three benchmarks together with the gate implementation.

AI.tldr: 提出ConsistencyGate，一种写入时准入机制，通过多次查询LLM获得支持分数，仅在平均分超过阈值时才将事实提交到外部记忆，从而防止记忆污染在长对话代理中累积。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在多轮交互中会将事实存入外部记忆并用作后续推理的前提，但写入的错误事实（记忆污染）会作为错误前提持续影响后续所有步骤，现有记忆管理方法关注检索和容量而非写入时的正确性，这一问题无法通过效用或时效性标准解决。
AI.method: ConsistencyGate：在将候选事实m从上下文c提交到记忆前，多次（K次）查询LLM获取软支持分数，仅当平均分超过阈值时才允许写入；提供对数概率变体以降低延迟；无需微调，模型无关。
AI.result: 在四个LLM骨干网络上，相比"全写入"基线，ConsistencyGate在LoCoMo-Contam、MSC-Contam和MemContam三个基准上均降低了记忆污染，代价主要集中在源上下文中仅隐含陈述的事实上。
AI.conclusion: ConsistencyGate有效解决了长对话代理中的记忆污染问题，是一种轻量级、模型无关的写时准入机制，可在不增加检索或容量开销的情况下提升长期推理的可靠性。

title: How Well Can AI Generate Backlogs from App Mockups?
comment: Accepted at the AIRE Workshop, IEEE 34th International Requirements Engineering Conference (RE) 2026
summary: Creating sprint backlogs requires considerable effort, as items such as epics, user stories, and tasks can be missed or inconsistently specified. We propose a multimodal approach to support backlog generation from visual app mockups, an artifact available at early project stages. We evaluate three prompting strategies on GPT-4o: a zero-shot baseline, Compositional Chain-of-Thought (CCoT) for vision-language reasoning, and a persona-driven prompt. We study seven app development projects across two countries and interview developers about the results. Overall, we observed that the baseline prompt favours recall over precision, whereas CCoT is more balanced, achieving average F1 scores of 52-66% for epics and user stories. Tasks were more challenging to generate accurately. Precision gains were most consistent when adding architectural context, particularly for backend tasks (precision gains up to 35%). Interviews with developers revealed that up to 26% of false positives were still considered useful, reflecting the creative and open-ended nature of backlog creation. To capture this, we propose a new measure called Revised Recall, which complements ground-truth evaluation with developer assessments. Our findings suggest that hybrid prompting with architectural context can assist backlog generation from early mockups, though results vary by item type and developer oversight remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多模态方法，利用视觉应用原型（mockups）自动生成Sprint待办列表（backlog），评估了三种GPT-4o提示策略（零样本基线、组合式思维链、角色驱动提示），发现CCoT在史诗和用户故事上F1达52-66%，引入架构上下文可提升后端任务精确度最高35%，并提出了考虑开发者评估的"修正召回率"新指标。
AI.motivation: 创建Sprint待办列表需要大量人工努力，其中的项目（如史诗、用户故事、任务）容易被遗漏或规格不一致，因此需要自动化方法来支持从早期项目阶段已有的视觉原型生成待办列表。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4o评估三种提示策略：零样本基线、组合式思维链（CCoT）用于视觉-语言推理、角色驱动提示。在横跨两个国家的七个应用开发项目上研究，并对开发者进行访谈评估结果。提出"修正召回率"（Revised Recall）新指标，结合真实标注与开发者评估。
AI.result: 基线提示偏向召回率而非精确率；CCoT更均衡，在史诗和用户故事上平均F1分数达52-66%；任务生成更具挑战性。引入架构上下文后精确率提升最稳定，后端任务精确率提升高达35%。开发者访谈显示高达26%的假阳性仍被认为有用。
AI.conclusion: 带有架构上下文的混合提示可以辅助从早期原型生成待办列表，但结果因项目类型而异，仍需开发者监督；反映了待办列表创建的创造性和开放性本质。

title: GRAPE: Graduated Routing for Articulated Portrait mesh Estimation
summary: Articulated portrait mesh estimation is fundamental to 3D understanding, avatar generation, and immersive interaction. Existing approaches primarily rely on 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs). However, face-centric models suffer from the "floating head" assumption, conflating head pose with global rotation due to the lack of neck kinematics. Conversely, body-centric models lack high-fidelity facial expression capabilities. Furthermore, current methods struggle to disentangle jaw articulation from expression blendshapes, often over-relying on expressions for mouth opening. These limitations make monocular portrait recovery difficult across representation, supervision, and anatomical parameter estimation. To address these limitations, we introduce GRAPE(Graduated Routing for Articulated Portrait mesh Estimation). We build a Portrait Parametric Model (PPM) with an explicit torso-to-head kinematic chain and a canonical injection step to merge FLAME and the SMPL-X torso. We propose a Progressive Anatomical Alignment (PAA) network, which is composed of a pretrained portrait encoder, a Graduated-Mask Router, and coarse-to-fine experts that follow the portrait anatomical prior. We then train this network with multi-source supervision that combines sparse anatomical keypoints, feature distillation, foreground mask constraints, and relative geometry constraints. Experiments show that GRAPE improves portrait mesh recovery quality, pose alignment, and jaw--expression disentanglement over prior methods. We also demonstrate that our method can benefit the downstream tasks of audio-driven talking-head generation and 3D portrait generation.

AI.tldr: GRAPE提出了一种面向肖像网格估计的渐进式解剖对齐方法，通过构建包含躯干-头部运动链的肖像参数模型（PPM）以及渐进式解剖对齐网络（PAA），实现了高精度的肖像网格重建、姿态对齐和下颌-表情解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在"漂浮头部"假设（缺少颈部运动学）、身体模型缺乏高保真面部表情能力、以及下颌关节与表情 blendshapes 难以解耦等问题，使得单目肖像恢复在表示、监督和参数估计方面面临困难。
AI.method: 1) 构建肖像参数模型（PPM），包含显式的躯干-头部运动链和标准注入步骤，融合FLAME与SMPL-X躯干；2) 提出渐进式解剖对齐网络（PAA），由预训练肖像编码器、渐进掩码路由器和遵循肖像解剖先验的粗到细专家组成；3) 采用多源监督训练：稀疏解剖关键点、特征蒸馏、前景掩码约束和相对几何约束。
AI.result: 实验表明GRAPE在肖像网格重建质量、姿态对齐和下颌-表情解耦方面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: GRAPE能够有效提升肖像网格恢复效果，并惠及音频驱动说话头生成和3D肖像生成等下游任务。

title: Agent Team Work Zone: An Automated, Persistent Workspace for Long-Lived Coding Agent Teams
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have significantly improved coding and programming workflows. Claude Code, in particular, is one of the most powerful LLM coding agents and is capable of conducting complex coding tasks. However, several drawbacks can undermine long-term agentic workflows. (1) Irrecoverable agent teams: The Agent Teams feature is powerful, but the working state accumulated by each teammate is lost and cannot be resumed once the process stops, for example, when a terminal is closed. (2) Compaction erodes working detail: Compaction condenses the conversation into a summary, causing an agent's working details to become vague. (3) Agentic "technical debt": Over time, a user's decisions and the agents' operations become trapped in compacted old chats, making the project increasingly difficult to maintain and review. (4) Heavy prompt writing: Assigning or handing off tasks requires users to repeatedly write long prompts to achieve the expected agentic performance. We propose ATWZ (Agent Team Work Zone), a filesystem-based operations layer built around Claude Code's native Agent Teams that addresses these problems. Its central design principle is to treat each agent and teammate as a human employee and preserve their important working state in files stored in a dedicated directory called a "workstation," together with the skills, hooks, and scripts that use and maintain these files. With ATWZ, an agent team can periodically back up its working state, allowing an agent's knowledge to be recovered after compaction. After a process ends, the team can be restored with a single command. These features also substantially mitigate the agentic "technical debt" described above. Moreover, within ATWZ, agent "employees" can send documents to one another, greatly reducing the effort required to write prompts.

AI.tldr: ATWZ 是一个基于文件系统的操作层，围绕 Claude Code 的原生 Agent Teams 构建，通过将代理和队友视为人类员工并将其重要工作状态持久化存储在专用目录中，解决了 LLM 编码代理在长期工作流中遇到的团队状态不可恢复、压缩导致细节丢失、技术债务累积和提示编写负担重等问题。
AI.motivation: LLM 编码代理（如 Claude Code）在长期工作流中存在四个关键缺陷：(1) 代理团队关闭后工作状态不可恢复；(2) 对话压缩导致工作细节模糊；(3) 代理"技术债务"随时间累积，项目难以维护；(4) 用户需反复编写冗长提示来分配任务。这些问题严重制约了长期、复杂的编码工作流效率。
AI.method: ATWZ 将每个代理和队友视为人类员工，将其重要工作状态以文件形式持久化存储在称为"工作站"的专用目录中，并配以技能（skills）、钩子（hooks）和脚本（scripts）来维护这些文件。代理团队可定期备份工作状态，压缩后仍可恢复知识；进程结束后可通过单条命令恢复团队；代理"员工"之间可通过文档传递实现任务交接，减少提示编写负担。
AI.result: ATWZ 实现了：(1) 代理团队状态的持久化备份与恢复；(2) 压缩后代理知识的可恢复性；(3) 单命令团队恢复；(4) 代理间文档传递大幅减少提示编写工作量；(5) 有效缓解代理"技术债务"问题。
AI.conclusion: ATWZ 通过文件系统级的持久化设计，将代理视为"员工"进行工作状态管理，系统性地解决了 LLM 编码代理在长期工作流中的状态丢失、细节退化、技术债务和提示负担四大核心问题，显著提升了大型编码项目的可维护性和工作效率。

title: XMatchAD: A Cross-Modal Matching Perspective on Reconstruction-based Anomaly Detection
comment: accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: The remarkable success of reconstruction-based methods in Unsupervised Anomaly Detection (UAD) lies in their ability to identify and localize anomalies by modeling discrepancies between input images and their reconstructed counterparts. However, these approaches often struggle to capture subtle anomalies and tend to produce blurred anomaly boundaries, which significantly limits their effectiveness, particularly in complex multi-class scenarios. To address these issues, we present XMatchAD, a novel UAD framework that reinterprets the task from a pseudo cross-modal matching perspective. Specifically, the input and reconstructed images are treated as two complementary modalities and their matching relationships are precisely exploited for anomaly detection. First, a pre-trained feature extractor is employed to encode discriminative representations. Second, an attention-guided cross-modal matching mechanism is introduced to match local inter-modal anomaly-related patterns while mutually refining the features. This enhances the sensitivity to anomalies with diverse shapes and subtle deviations and significantly improves the precision of anomaly detection and localization. Third, we design an adaptive frequency-aware fusion module that further delineates sharp anomaly boundaries through the coupling of high-frequency components from cross-modal multi-scale representations. Comprehensive evaluations on MVTec-AD, VisA, and MPDD benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently achieves superior performance, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in multi-class anomaly detection and localization. The code will be released at https://github.com/Mingxiu-Cai/XMatchAD.

AI.tldr: XMatchAD提出了一种基于伪跨模态匹配的无监督异常检测框架，通过将输入图像与重建图像视为互补模态，结合注意力引导的跨模态匹配机制和自适应频率感知融合模块，在MVTec-AD、VisA和MPDD基准上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 基于重建的无监督异常检测方法在捕捉细微异常和生成清晰异常边界方面存在不足，尤其是在复杂的多类别场景下效果受限。
AI.method: 1) 使用预训练特征提取器编码判别性表示；2) 引入注意力引导的跨模态匹配机制，将输入图像和重建图像视为两种互补模态，匹配局部跨模态异常相关模式并相互细化特征；3) 设计自适应频率感知融合模块，通过跨模态多尺度表示的高频分量耦合来刻画清晰异常边界。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD、VisA和MPDD三个基准数据集上 consistently 优于现有最先进方法，在多类别异常检测和定位任务中表现卓越。
AI.conclusion: 从伪跨模态匹配角度重新诠释UAD任务能有效提升对细微异常的敏感度和异常边界清晰度，该方法在复杂多类别场景下具有显著优势。

title: AgentOmnia: Scaling Agentic Models for Full-Scenario Applications
summary: Large language model agents have advanced rapidly, yet progress remains fragmented across domains, capabilities, task difficulty, and interaction settings. We frame this as full-scenario agentic scaling and present AgentOmnia, a framework coordinating task-space definition, data synthesis, post-training, evaluation, and improvement across To-Consumer (ToC), To-Business (ToB), and To-Employee (ToE) applications. An extensible Domain x Capability x Atomic Difficulty taxonomy aligns these stages and enables fine-grained diagnosis with OmniaBench. AgentOmnia combines bidirectional environment-task synthesis with tool-dependency, program-structured, and solver-based pipelines, constructing 5,018 stateful environments with 255,375 tools and 52,361 tasks. Programs, solvers, and verifiers provide correctness signals, while supervised fine-tuning, online agentic reinforcement learning, and a rollback curriculum support post-training. Evaluation failures translate into Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for targeted self-evolution. Starting from Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, AgentOmnia raises the pass rate on the OmniaBench challenging subset from 9.16% to 37.11% and the macro-average across OmniaBench, $τ^2$-Bench, DeepPlanning, and VitaBench from 22.86% to 41.69%. Under a unified protocol,it leads the evaluated agentic post-trained baselines on OmniaBench and retains the highest four-benchmark macro-average. It also surpasses Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 on all four benchmarks and exceeds Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on the macro-average. Gains span three application splits, ten capability dimensions, eight atomic-difficulty factors, and 76 of 90 level-1 domains, indicating broad rather than category-specific improvement. A one-round study provides initial evidence for PRD-guided self-evolution, motivating validation at larger scales and in industrial settings.

AI.tldr: AgentOmnia是一个全场景智能体扩展框架，通过领域-能力-原子难度分类法协调任务空间定义、数据合成、后训练、评估和改进，在ToC/ToB/ToE应用中显著提升智能体性能，构建了5,018个状态环境、255,375个工具和52,361个任务，将挑战子集通过率从9.16%提升至37.11%，四基准宏观平均从22.86%提升至41.69%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在多个维度（领域、能力、任务难度、交互设置）上进展碎片化，缺乏统一的框架来协调全场景的智能体扩展和系统化提升。
AI.method: 提出AgentOmnia框架，包含：(1) 可扩展的领域×能力×原子难度分类法；(2) 双向环境-任务合成与三类数据管道（工具依赖、程序结构、求解器）；(3) 监督微调、在线智能体强化学习和回滚课程的后训练策略；(4) OmniaBench细粒度诊断基准；(5) 评估失败转PRD的自进化机制。
AI.result: 基于Qwen3-30B-A3B，OmniaBench挑战子集通过率从9.16%提升至37.11%，四基准宏观平均从22.86%提升至41.69%。超越Qwen3-235B-A22B和Qwen3.5-35B-A3B。改进覆盖3个应用分片、10个能力维度、8个原子难度因子、76/90个一级领域。
AI.conclusion: AgentOmnia实现了广泛而非类别特异的性能提升，PRD引导的自进化机制在一轮实验中展示了初步可行性，为进一步的工业级大规模验证提供了基础。

title: SAGE: Safety-First Defense-in-Depth Guardrails for Verified Lifecycle Control of High-Impact Generative AI
summary:
High-impact generative AI makes catastrophic misuse a lifecycle-control problem, not merely a prompt-filtering problem. SAGE is a safety-first, authorization-separated architecture in which credible catastrophic-enablement risk constrains admissibility before utility, latency, or commercial objectives are considered. It combines signed release manifests, diverse detectors, robust risk envelopes, least-risk defaults, output checking, three-valued monitoring, protected audit chains, containment, and rollback. Formal results establish safety priority, conservative detector bounds, monotone release gating, tamper-evident records, and an authorization cut; two PRISM abstractions verify authorization separation and lifecycle invariants under explicit assumptions.
  A frozen, vendor-symmetric study sent 84 cases to each of four GPT, four Claude, and two Gemini snapshots: 840 calls yielded 794 target responses, 46 provider errors, and 449 successful judgments covering 375 responses. Eight snapshots had complete judged domain coverage. Harmful-compliance estimates were low; variation arose mainly from benign utility and safe redirection. Seven multiplicity-adjusted contrasts involving Claude, Gemini, or GPT-5 snapshots and the GPT-5 mini and GPT-5 nano snapshots were supported, while no tested contrast between the Claude or Gemini snapshots and GPT-5 or GPT-5.5 survived correction.
  The observed harmful-compliance range is a conservative, protocol-bound view from one generation per prompt with no tools, retrieval, history, or human adjudication; it is not an upper bound on operational assistance. A preregistered extension specifies how to test a wider best-worst gap using a locked split, repeated sampling, multi-turn and sandboxed-tool conditions, and domain-expert scoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE架构，将生成式AI的灾难性滥用视为生命周期控制问题而非简单提示过滤问题。该架构采用安全优先、授权分离的设计，通过签名发布清单、多样化检测器、稳健风险边界等机制实现全生命周期管控。实验评估了多个主流模型（GPT、Claude、Gemini）的有害合规率，结果显示有害合规率较低，差异主要来自良性效用和安全重定向。研究还提出了预注册扩展方案以测试更广泛的"最佳-最差"差距。
AI.motivation: 高风险生成式AI存在被滥用于灾难性场景的可能，而现有方法仅关注提示过滤，未能从全生命周期角度解决滥用问题。需要一种系统性架构来确保在考虑效用、延迟或商业目标之前，先以可信的灾难性赋能风险作为准入约束。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（安全优先、授权分离）架构，包含签名发布清单、多样化检测器、稳健风险边界、最小风险默认设置、输出检查、三值监控、受保护审计链、隔离与回滚机制。通过形式化结果建立安全优先级、保守检测器边界、单调发布门控、防篡改记录和授权切割。使用PRISM抽象验证授权分离和生命周期不变量。实验方面，对4个GPT、4个Claude和2个Gemini快照各发送84个案例，共840次调用，通过多重性调整对比分析有害合规率。
AI.result: 840次调用产生794个目标响应、46个提供者错误、449个成功判断覆盖375个响应。8个快照具有完整的判断域覆盖。有害合规率估计较低，变异主要来自良性效用和安全重定向。7个涉及Claude、Gemini或GPT-5快照及GPT-5 mini和GPT-5 nano快照的多重性调整对比得到支持，而Claude或Gemini快照与GPT-5或GPT-5.5之间的对比未通过校正。
AI.conclusion: 观察到的有害合规范围是保守的、受协议约束的结果（每提示单次生成、无工具、无检索、无历史、无人工裁决），并非操作协助的上限。预注册扩展方案提出通过锁定分割、重复采样、多轮和沙盒工具条件以及领域专家评分来测试更广泛的"最佳-最差"差距。

title: RRTrack: Robust and Recoverable Object 6D Pose Tracking for Dynamic Scenes
comment: 6D Pose Tracking, 10 pages, real-world experiments, training-free
summary: Robust object 6D pose tracking is critical for robotic systems operating in dynamic and occluded scenes. Per-frame estimators are accurate but computationally expensive, while current trackers struggle with fast motion and complete occlusion due to their reliance on continuous visibility. To address these challenges, we present RRTrack, an efficient, recoverable object 6D pose tracker that enables robust tracking through fast motion and target disappearance--reappearance. RRTrack introduces a 2D--6D closed-loop tracking strategy that integrates memory-based video object segmentation (VOS) with 6D pose refinement. The 2D branch maintains target localization, and the 6D branch verifies geometric consistency before memory updates. In addition, a DINOv2-based dual-bank template matching module is developed to recover lost targets by jointly exploiting offline synthetic templates and online observation anchors while maintaining real-time efficiency. We also introduce a synthetic RGB-D benchmark comprising three robotic scenarios with fast motion and full occlusion. Experimental results on the synthetic benchmark demonstrate that RRTrack improves equal-subset mean ADD-S AR by 66.3\% and ADD-S AUC by 65.7\% over FoundationPose while achieving 55.2 FPS. Real-world experiments further validate the robustness of RRTrack under noisy sensing conditions. Project page: https://github.com/7kevin24/RRTrack

AI.tldr: RRTrack是一种高效的、可恢复的物体6D姿态跟踪器，通过2D-6D闭环跟踪策略（结合记忆型VOS和6D姿态精化）以及基于DINOv2的双模板匹配模块，解决了快速运动和完全遮挡下的鲁棒跟踪问题。在合成和真实世界实验中，RRTrack比FoundationPose在ADD-S AR和AUC上分别提升66.3%和65.7%，达到55.2 FPS。
AI.motivation: 每帧估计器精度高但计算昂贵，现有跟踪器依赖连续可见性，在快速运动和完全遮挡场景下性能不佳。需要一种既高效又能从跟踪丢失中恢复的6D姿态跟踪方法。
AI.method: RRTrack提出2D-6D闭环跟踪策略：2D分支通过记忆型视频目标分割（VOS）维持目标定位，6D分支验证几何一致性后再更新记忆；采用DINOv2双模板匹配模块，联合利用离线合成模板和在线观测锚点来恢复丢失目标。
AI.result: 在合成基准上，RRTrack相比FoundationPose在ADD-S AR提升66.3%、ADD-S AUC提升65.7%，达到55.2 FPS。真实世界实验验证了在噪声传感条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RRTrack通过2D-6D闭环跟踪和DINOv2双模板匹配，在保持实时效率的同时，显著提升了快速运动和完全遮挡场景下的6D姿态跟踪鲁棒性和可恢复性。

title: Design Theater: A Benchmark for Generative UI
summary: Generative UI tools promise to democratize UI design by turning natural language descriptions into complete interfaces. Alongside the interface, these tools generate user-facing design rationales that explain their layout, accessibility, and design choices. However, it remains unclear whether these stated rationales are actually reflected in the interfaces they produce. We call this disconnect ``Design Theater'': plausible and confident design rationales that have little relationship to the actual implementation. To study this phenomenon, we introduce a benchmark and three metrics for measuring Design Theater. The benchmark includes 24 UI generation tasks spanning structural, styling, and functional design requirements. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 120 interfaces created by five generative UI tools. On average, over 25\% of user-facing design rationales are not implemented in the generated interface, and the implementation failure increases to 34\% for functional requirements. Tools recognize roughly half of the UX principles embedded in prompts (mean = 0.54), with four of five tools implementing 6\% or fewer functional principles. We also measure interface similarity across tools and find convergence in visual appearance and layout organization, with greater variation in color choices. Overall, we contribute: 1) the concept of Design Theater; 2) a benchmark with metrics for assessing whether the stated reasoning of generative UI tools is reflected in their implementations; 3) and findings from a systematic evaluation of these tools. We discuss what these findings mean for the design and evaluation of generative UI tools.

AI.tldr: 生成式UI工具声称能通过自然语言描述生成界面并附带设计理由，但研究发现这些理由与实现之间存在严重脱节——平均超过25%的设计理由未被实现，功能需求可达34%。作者将这种现象定义为"设计剧场"，并提出了评估基准和三项指标。
AI.motivation: 生成式UI工具在生成界面的同时会输出看似合理且自信的设计理由，但这些理由是否真正反映在实际界面中尚不清楚。作者旨在揭示并量化这种"说一套做一套"的现象。
AI.method: 构建包含24个UI生成任务的基准，涵盖结构、样式和功能三类设计需求；提出三项评估指标（理由实现率、UX原则遵循率、界面相似度）；对5种生成式UI工具生成的120个界面进行系统评估。
AI.result: 平均超过25%的设计理由未在界面中实现，功能需求中该比例达34%；工具对提示中UX原则的识别率仅约54%；五分之四的工具实现的功能原则不超过6%；各工具在视觉外观和布局组织上趋同，颜色选择差异较大。
AI.conclusion: 生成式UI工具存在严重的"设计剧场"问题，即设计理由与实际实现脱节。这对此类工具的设计和评估提出了警示，需要更严格地验证其输出与声称的一致性。

title: Contrastive Parameter Disentanglement for Multi-modal Remote Sensing Image Generation
summary: Existing remote sensing image generation methods are largely confined to single-modality synthesis and therefore fail to exploit the complementary information inherent in multimodal imagery. To address this limitation, we propose a contrastive parameter disentanglement framework for multimodal remote sensing image generation, which generates semantically consistent and structurally aligned images across multiple modalities, including optical, infrared, and synthetic aperture radar (SAR), from a single text prompt. Specifically, we introduce a contrastive parameter disentanglement module that disentangles shared semantics from modality-specific attributes at the parameter level within an orthogonal core subspace. Based on this module, we develop a disentangled optimization strategy that first constrains the parameter matrix A of the LoRA adapter to capture modality-invariant semantics through a multimodal contrastive objective and then guides multiple parameter matrices B to learn modality-specific attributes under text conditioning. This strategy enables the simultaneous generation of multimodal images with consistent semantic content and distinct modality characteristics. Furthermore, to ensure structural alignment across the generated images, we devise a query-key structure transfer mechanism that jointly models multimodal sampling trajectories during inference by transferring structural correlation priors from an anchor modality to the remaining modalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art remote sensing image generation approaches in terms of generation quality, semantic consistency, and structural alignment, while also achieving superior performance in the downstream object classification task.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种对比参数解缠框架，通过LoRA适配器的参数解缠和查询-键结构迁移机制，实现从单文本提示同步生成光学、红外和SAR等多模态遥感图像，在生成质量、语义一致性和结构对齐上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感图像生成方法局限于单模态合成，无法利用多模态图像中的互补信息。
AI.method: 1) 对比参数解缠模块，在正交核心子空间中将共享语义与模态特定属性在参数级解缠；2) 解缠优化策略，先用多模态对比目标约束LoRA适配器的参数矩阵A捕获模态不变语义，再引导参数矩阵B学习模态特定属性；3) 查询-键结构迁移机制，在推理时联合建模多模态采样轨迹，从锚定模态向其他模态迁移结构相关先验。
AI.result: 在生成质量、语义一致性和结构对齐方面优于最先进的遥感图像生成方法，并在下游目标分类任务中取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架有效实现了多模态遥感图像的一致生成，验证了参数级解缠和结构迁移机制在跨模态生成中的有效性。

title: Let AI Agents Translate Networks, Not Reason About Them
summary:
A formal model enables verifying reachability, localizing an outage, or anticipating the blast radius of a change. Yet, virtually no production network has one, since writing a model by hand demands rare expertise and is hard to keep current as the network changes frequently. At its core, network modeling is a typographical exercise: it translates network artifacts (e.g., configurations, topology, and routing state) into rules in formal logic. Translation of this kind is what large language models (LLMs) nowadays do well. Unlike free-form AI reasoning, such translation can be formally verified.
  Once modeling is no longer the bottleneck, trusting AI to reason over large, complex networks no longer makes sense. Our position therefore cuts against the prevailing race to put autonomous AI agents in charge end-to-end. We instead confine AI to translation and rely on a solver for reliable long-horizon reasoning, building a reusable formal model of general network behavior that can then be specialized to specific tasks, e.g., root-cause analysis (RCA). We build TypoNet that constructs and validates a symbolic model of an emulated production-scale WAN from the network's own artifacts. Our preliminary evaluation shows TypoNet helps in two ways. On its own, TypoNet answers operational questions (e.g., reachability verification and change-impact analysis) faster, more cheaply, and more reliably than an LLM. As a tool for an AI agent, TypoNet boosts fault localization at lower cost. The result makes the case for AI that builds verifiable network models and relies on a solver for reliable long-horizon reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TypoNet，利用大语言模型将网络配置等人工制品翻译为形式化逻辑模型，再通过求解器进行可靠的长期推理。该方法将AI的角色限定在翻译环节，而非端到端自主决策，在可达性验证、变更影响分析和故障定位等任务上比纯LLM方案更快、更便宜、更可靠。
AI.motivation: 目前几乎没有生产网络拥有形式化模型，因为手工编写模型需要稀缺专业知识且难以随网络频繁变更而更新；而网络建模本质上是一项"排版练习"——将网络配置、拓扑和路由状态翻译为形式逻辑规则，这类翻译任务恰好是LLM擅长的，且翻译结果可以被形式化验证。
AI.method: TypoNet利用LLM将网络人工制品翻译为符号模型，构建并验证可复用的通用网络行为形式化模型，然后针对特定任务（如根因分析）进行特化；将AI限制在翻译环节，依赖求解器进行可靠的长期推理。
AI.result: 在仿真生产级WAN上的初步评估显示：(1) TypoNet在回答运维问题（可达性验证、变更影响分析）上比纯LLM更快、更便宜、更可靠；(2) 作为AI智能体的工具，TypoNet以更低成本提升了故障定位效果。
AI.conclusion: 本文反对将AI自主智能体端到端置于管理地位的趋势，主张将AI约束在翻译任务上，依靠求解器进行可靠推理。AI应构建可验证的网络模型，而非直接进行不可靠的长期推理。

title: Perturbation-Aware Diffusion-Guided Hybrid Segmentation for Robust and Annotation-Efficient Plant Stress Phenotyping
summary: Semantic segmentation in agricultural imagery is often evaluated under in-domain protocols, yet practical deployment requires robustness to appearance perturbations, limited annotations, and cross domain shift. This paper presents a diffusion-guided hybrid segmentation framework in which U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer backbones generate coarse masks that are refined by Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM), latent diffusion, or semantic-guided diffusion. The framework is evaluated through a 3x3 architectural screening study on PlantSegV3, followed by boundary-constrained optimization, perturbation-guided retraining, low-data evaluation, constrained hyperparameter screening, and controlled cross-domain adaptation. On PlantSegV3, the best selected hybrid model achieves 71.83% refined mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) and 26.10% refined Boundary-F1, and the selected models remain stable under substantially reduced supervision, demonstrating strong annotation efficiency. Perturbation analysis identifies grayscale conversion, fog, coarse dropout, and shadow as the most disruptive appearance shifts, and the resulting augmentation policy substantially improves robustness during retraining. The adapted models further show effective transfer to external agricultural datasets under limited target supervision, indicating that diffusion refinement and boundary-aware optimization provide transferable structural priors. Overall, the results show that carefully matched backbone-refiner pairings, combined with perturbation-aware retraining, can improve structural delineation and robustness under realistic resource and distribution constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种扩散引导的混合分割框架，结合U-Net、DeepLabV3+、SegFormer骨干网络与DDPM、潜在扩散或语义引导扩散模型，在PlantSegV3数据集上通过3×3架构筛选、边界约束优化、扰动引导重训练、低数据评估等实验，最佳模型达到71.83% refined mIoU和26.10% refined Boundary-F1，在标注减少和跨域迁移下保持鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 农业图像语义分割在实际部署中面临外观扰动、标注有限和跨域迁移等挑战，现有方法多在域内协议下评估，缺乏对上述实际问题的系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出扩散引导混合分割框架：使用U-Net/DeepLabV3+/SegFormer生成粗掩码，再经DDPM、潜在扩散或语义引导扩散模型细化；结合边界约束优化、扰动引导重训练、低数据评估、约束超参数筛选和受控跨域适应。
AI.result: 最佳模型在PlantSegV3上达到71.83% refined mIoU和26.10% refined Boundary-F1；灰度化、雾、粗丢弃和阴影是最具破坏性的扰动；重训练后鲁棒性显著提升；模型在跨域迁移中有效传递结构先验。
AI.conclusion: 精心匹配的骨干-细化器组合结合扰动感知重训练，能在现实资源与分布约束下改善结构描绘和鲁棒性，扩散细化与边界感知优化提供可迁移的结构先验。

title: Share No More Than the Request Requires: Federated Disclosure for Perspective-Aware AI
summary: Modern AI systems bring societal risks such as mass surveillance, extreme concentrations of power, and loss of user autonomy---calling into question a model where third-parties collect and control massive amounts of user data. Users require a sovereign system to securely own, govern, and disclose their context while remaining compliant across regulated domains with strict provenance, interpretability, and policy adherence. Perspective-aware AI approaches this by transforming a user's aggregated personal data into a structured identity model called a \emph{Chronicle}: a temporal knowledge graph that represents and grows with the user. Chronicles support the secure disclosure of context across federated networks. A Chronicle holder may expose a queryable, authorized view that a third-party agent may consult without centralizing anyone's data. This paper explores the problem of minimum-necessary disclosure across domain boundaries: when a requester's agent queries a Chronicle, how can the system constrain its response to release only what the requester's relationship, stated purpose, and specific task require? We propose \textbf{Provenance Preserving Chronicles} (PPC), a federated protocol that compiles each holder's Chronicle into a compact \emph{authorized evidence subgraph} governed by one rule: \emph{share no more than the request requires}. Holders keep local sovereignty; an access controller projects relationship-aware views over domain-expert ontologies; and a two-phase flow returns provenance-linked text first, releasing raw artifacts only after explicit holder approval. We frame the problem, map gaps in blockchain, P2P, and holder-sovereign designs, define the core constructs, and sketch the protocol with an explicit threat model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Provenance Preserving Chronicles (PPC) 协议，通过将用户个人数据构建为时序知识图谱（Chronicle），支持联邦网络中最小必要的数据披露，确保用户主权、溯源合规和策略遵从。
AI.motivation: 现代AI系统带来大规模监控、权力集中和用户自主权丧失等社会风险，传统第三方集中收集和控制用户数据的模式存在问题，用户需要一种主权系统来安全地拥有、管理和披露其上下文信息。
AI.method: 提出PPC协议：1) 将用户聚合个人数据构建为Chronicle（时序知识图谱）；2) 通过授权证据子图约束仅披露请求所需的最少信息；3) 访问控制器基于领域本体投影关系感知视图；4) 两阶段流程：先返回溯源链接文本，经持有者批准后再释放原始工件。
AI.result: 框架化了最小必要披露问题，映射了区块链、P2P和持有者主权设计的现有差距，定义了核心构建，并给出了带显式威胁模型的协议草图。
AI.conclusion: PPC通过联邦协议和Chronicle结构，在保护用户主权的前提下实现了跨域最小必要数据披露，同时满足溯源、可解释性和策略遵从等合规要求。

title: Reality Monitoring in Large Language Models: Self-Knowledge That Transforms with Conversation Memory
summary: A conversational AI that cannot tell its own output from what a user said will treat its own mistakes as user-provided facts. In humans, this capacity is called reality monitoring, and its failures are linked to hallucinations, delusions, and confabulation, yet whether LLMs possess it remains untested. Here we show, across two experiments and six LLMs, that source attribution depends on how conversational memory is structured: ceiling accuracy for self-generated content under minimal memory demands reverses to a fragile external-item advantage once episodic delay removes that shortcut. Feedback exposes two failures: in some models, internal and external judgments swap; in others, accuracy improves while confidence decouples from correctness, dissociations invisible to existing benchmarks. Across models, this pattern implicates active, not aggregate, parameter count. This suggests that as AI systems take on autonomous, multi-turn roles, evaluating what they know is not enough: tracking where that knowledge came from may matter equally.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM对自我生成内容与用户输入内容的来源归因能力取决于对话记忆结构：低记忆需求下自我内容准确率最高，但经历延迟后转为脆弱的外部内容优势；反馈揭示内部与外部判断互换或准确率与置信度解耦等失败模式，且与活跃参数数（而非总参数数）相关。
AI.motivation: 检验大语言模型是否具备现实监控（reality monitoring）能力，即区分自身输出与用户输入的能力，这是人类避免幻觉、妄想和虚构的关键机制。
AI.method: 通过两个实验、六个LLM，操纵对话记忆结构（最小记忆需求 vs. 情节延迟条件），测试模型对自我生成内容和外部用户输入内容的来源归因准确性，并引入反馈机制观察内部/外部判断变化及准确率-置信度关系。
AI.result: 1) 最小记忆需求下自我内容归因准确率最高；2) 加入情节延迟后，外部内容优势变得脆弱且反转；3) 反馈导致两类失败模式：某些模型内部与外部判断互换，另一些模型准确率提升但置信度与正确性解耦；4) 上述模式与活跃参数数相关，而非总参数数。
AI.conclusion: 随着AI系统承担自主多轮对话角色，仅评估模型"知道什么"是不够的，追踪"知识来源"同样重要。

title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of SAM3 for Prompt-Driven Surgical Concept Segmentation
comment: Accepted by The 2nd MICCAI Workshop on Efficient Medical AI
summary: Efficient surgical segmentation empowers clinical diagnosis, intraoperative monitoring, and downstream robotic pipelines for reconstruction and simulation. Although prompt-driven foundation models like Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) achieve strong segmentation performance on natural images, surgical data exhibits domain gaps against its pre-training data, resulting in degraded segmentation accuracy. Furthermore, existing medical SAM methods require full-parameter fine-tuning, incurring heavy computational consumption and low efficiency. To address these limitations, this work proposes a parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adaptation of SAM3 for surgical concept segmentation. We inject low-rank adapters into the prompt encoder, detector and tracker while fully freezing the vision backbone, which only optimizes 0.98% of the total model parameters and supports training on a single consumer GPU. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms zero-shot SAM3 and other mainstream baselines, and the generated segmentation results can be directly deployed to support downstream robotic surgical scene reconstruction and physical simulation pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种参数高效的LoRA微调方法，将SAM3适配到手术概念分割任务中，仅优化0.98%的模型参数即可在单张消费级GPU上训练，显著优于零样本SAM3及其他基线方法，并能直接支持下游机器人手术场景重建与物理模拟。
AI.motivation: 手术数据与SAM3预训练数据之间存在领域差异，导致直接使用零样本SAM3在手术概念分割上精度下降；同时现有医学SAM方法需要全参数微调，计算开销大、效率低。
AI.method: 在SAM3的提示编码器、检测器和跟踪器中注入低秩适配器（LoRA），同时冻结视觉骨干网络，仅优化0.98%的总模型参数。
AI.result: 该方法在手术概念分割任务上持续优于零样本SAM3及其他主流基线方法，且分割结果可直接部署到下游机器人手术场景重建和物理模拟管线中。
AI.conclusion: 提出的参数高效LoRA适配方法能够有效弥合手术数据与SAM3预训练数据之间的领域差异，以极低的计算成本实现高质量的手术概念分割，并支持下游应用。

title: Do Current Retrievers Cover All the Evidence? A Controlled Study of Conjunctive Cross-Page Retrieval
summary: Finding a long document relevant to a multi-part request is not the same as establishing that it contains every requested piece of evidence. We study this gap for conjunctive document retrieval, where two or three explicit conditions must be supported on different pages of one document. We use n-Clue as a controlled measurement instrument: 1{,}000 queries over 2{,}021 documents pair all-condition golds with naturally occurring documents that satisfy only a subset, and a complete-first success requires a top-10 gold to precede every released subset qrel. Across 70 configurations, condition-wise decomposition improves two dense backbones by 6.8--7.3 points and lexical--visual fusion adds 8.7, while four generic rerankers all reduce Gold-NDCG; these directions replicate on a four-source stress set. Scaling one dense family from 0.6B to 8B changes complete-first success by 0.0 points. The strongest displayed hybrid illustrates the resulting gap: it finds a gold for 81.1\% of queries but succeeds complete-first on only 35.8\%, and the gap persists across condition count, target length, candidate density, query rendering, and the four-source stress set. Finally, page-aware visual systems surface stored support for every condition on only 5.1--5.3\% of queries. These results identify condition coverage, rather than gold discovery alone, as the central bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多条件合取文档检索中的条件覆盖瓶颈，发现传统检索方法虽有81.1%的查询能找到相关文档，但仅有35.8%能在同一文档中完整满足所有条件。通过条件分解（提升6.8-7.3点）和词汇-视觉融合（提升8.7点）可改善性能，而通用重排序器和模型规模扩展（0.6B→8B）均无效，页面感知的视觉系统仅对5.1-5.3%的查询能定位所有条件的证据。
AI.motivation: 现有检索研究多关注文档级相关性，忽略了多条件查询需在同一文档内多个页面上同时满足所有条件的挑战，本文旨在系统量化这一差距并探索缓解方法。
AI.method: 使用n-Clue作为受控测量工具，构建1000个查询和2021个文档的数据集，包含所有条件均满足的黄金文档和仅满足子集的自然文档；测试70种配置，包括条件分解策略、词汇-视觉融合、通用重排序器、模型规模扩展以及页面感知的视觉系统。
AI.result: 条件分解提升稠密检索6.8-7.3点，词汇-视觉融合提升8.7点；通用重排序器反而降低Gold-NDCG；稠密模型从0.6B扩展到8B无提升；最强混合系统81.1%查询能找到黄金文档，但仅35.8%实现完整优先成功；页面感知视觉系统仅5.1-5.3%查询能定位所有条件证据。
AI.conclusion: 多条件文档检索的核心瓶颈在于条件覆盖率而非黄金文档发现本身，现有方法在确保单个文档完整覆盖所有条件方面存在显著不足。

title: Reason Popper-ly: Patching In-Context Reasoning with Inductive Logic Programming
comment: Accepted at the 20th Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting enables large language models (LLMs) to tackle multi-step reasoning tasks, yet the generated intermediate steps are not guaranteed to be logically sound. We present Reason Popper-ly, a neurosymbolic framework that uses inductive logic programming (ILP) to learn relation composition rules from reasoning traces and deploys them as an online verifier for step-level correction. Given an LLM-generated trace, the method checks each inferred step against the learned rule table, diagnoses the violation type, rewrites incorrect steps with symbolically derived repairs, and regenerates the remaining suffix so that the model can produce its final answer conditioned on a verified trace. We evaluate on CLUTRR, a multi-hop kinship reasoning benchmark, using five language models over reasoning chains of 2 to 10 hops. Across all models, Reason Popper-ly consistently improves terminal accuracy over standard CoT, with gains of up to 48 percentage points for small models and 15 points for frontier models on the longest chains. Compared with a fully exogenous symbolic pipeline, our method performs better on harder instances by preserving the model's successful grounding while correcting only verifiable reasoning failures. In addition, step-level ILP verification yields a fine-grained error taxonomy that provides diagnostic insight beyond final-answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出Reason Popper-ly框架，利用归纳逻辑编程从推理轨迹中学习关系组合规则，作为在线验证器对CoT中间步骤进行符号修正，在多跳亲属推理基准CLUTRR上显著提升准确率，最高提升48个百分点。
AI.motivation: CoT prompting虽然能引导LLM进行多步推理，但生成的中间步骤不能保证逻辑正确性，缺乏有效的验证和纠错机制。
AI.method: 使用归纳逻辑编程(ILP)从推理轨迹中学习关系组合规则，构建规则表作为在线验证器；对LLM生成的每个推理步骤进行规则匹配，诊断违规类型，用符号派生修复替换错误步骤，并重新生成后续推理后缀。
AI.result: 在CLUTRR基准上，使用5种语言模型在2-10跳推理链上评估，Reason Popper-ly一致优于标准CoT；小模型最长链提升48个百分点，前沿模型提升15个百分点；相比全外生符号管线，在困难实例上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号结合的方法能有效纠正LLM推理中的逻辑错误，ILP验证提供细粒度错误分类，为诊断提供超越最终答案准确率的洞察。

title: DAP-Pose: Deep Temporal Alignment and Physics-aware Cross-modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Pose Estimation
summary: Robust and accurate pose estimation with multi-modal sensors is fundamental for autonomous vehicles and mobile robotic systems in complex environments. In this paper, we propose DAP-Pose, a unified end-to-end model for robust multi-modal pose estimation. DAP-Pose introduces a Bi-level Cross-modal Fusion (BCF) module that captures complementary semantic and geometric motion cues from visual, inertial, and GNSS measurements. To handle temporal offsets, we designed a Deep Temporal Alignment (DTA) module that explicitly aligns asynchronous streams in latent space, enabling coherent motion modeling without strict hardware synchronization. Furthermore, we incorporate physics-aware constraints via manifold geometry and GNSS-guided absolute metric scale, enforcing motion consistency and mitigating drift. Experiments upon the public KITTI benchmark dataset were conducted to evaluate the performance of DAP-Pose against existing methods. DAP-Pose achieved the state-of-the-art performance, with the lowest average translation error ($t_{rel}$) of 1.31% and rotation error ($r_{rel}$) of 0.46$^{\circ}$. Furthermore, it accurately estimates poses and maintains robust performance under severe artificially injected temporal misalignment.

AI.tldr: DAP-Pose是一个统一的端到端多模态位姿估计模型，通过双层跨模态融合、深度时间对齐和物理感知约束，在KITTI数据集上实现了最低平移误差1.31%和旋转误差0.46°的SOTA性能，并对时间错位具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 复杂环境下多模态传感器的鲁棒且精确位姿估计对于自动驾驶和移动机器人系统至关重要，现有方法在处理多模态数据融合和时间异步对齐方面仍存在挑战。
AI.method: 1) 提出Bi-level Cross-modal Fusion (BCF)模块，捕获来自视觉、惯性和GNSS测量的互补语义和几何运动线索；2) 设计Deep Temporal Alignment (DTA)模块，在隐空间中显式对齐异步数据流；3) 引入物理感知约束，利用流形几何和GNSS引导的绝对度量尺度来增强运动一致性并抑制漂移。
AI.result: 在KITTI数据集上，DAP-Pose取得了最低平均平移误差1.31%和旋转误差0.46°，并在严重人工注入的时间错位条件下仍保持鲁棒性能。
AI.conclusion: DAP-Pose通过端到端的多模态融合、时间对齐和物理约束，在准确性和鲁棒性上均达到SOTA，验证了其在实际复杂环境中的有效性。

title: Gubernaut: A Deterministic Homeostatic Controller for Affect-Regulated LLM Agents, Validated Across Independent Model Families
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Data, transcripts, and analysis scripts: https://github.com/thegubernaut/Gubernaut_Validation Project page: https://gubernaut.com (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21303518)
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents inherit reactive failure modes: escalation under provocation, sycophantic drift under flattery, perseveration when stuck. These are failures of propensity, not capability; they concern what a model does under sustained pressure, which training-time alignment reduces but does not eliminate at runtime. This research led to the Gubernaut Cognitive Controller (GCC), a model-agnostic runtime control layer in a Nelson--Narens monitoring--control loop: an object level reads and writes text, while a deterministic meta level reads only the numeric telemetry {intensity, valence, repetition} and returns a regulating posture. Because the meta level ingests zero tokens, no injection channel to the controller exists by construction (an architectural property, not yet adversarially tested); the text-exposed arbiter's compliance is measured, not assumed. We evaluate the GCC with a pre-registered, generate-once/judge-many protocol across a 4x4 matrix of four frontier models (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Grok 4.3), each serving as both a generator and a judge. The regulated arm is calmer in 13 of 16 cells at p<.05 and 15 of 16 by sign; the three sub-threshold cells, including a -0.04 null, all fall on the single near-saturated host. The effect survives a lineage-independent fourth judge family (xAI), strong evidence that it is no artifact of shared judge style. The clearest mechanism is the recovery signature: arousal that integrates under attack and then decays, valence-gated, on de-escalation, replicating across all four families. Transcripts and panels ship with SHA-256 provenance and are re-judgeable; five failure modes are pre-registered.
  No consciousness claims are made.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Gubernaut认知控制器（GCC），一种模型无关的运行时控制层，通过Nelson-Narens监控-控制环路调节LLM代理的倾向性故障（如升级、谄媚、固执）。该架构的元层级仅读取数值遥测（强度、效价、重复），不接触任何文本，因此控制器不存在注入通道。在4个前沿模型（GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Grok 4.3）的4x4矩阵评估中，受调控臂在13/16个单元中显著更平静（p<.05），15/16个单元符号一致，效果经独立评判家族验证，非评判风格伪影。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理继承了对冲性失败模式（激化、谄媚、固执），这些是倾向性故障而非能力不足。训练时对齐能减轻但无法消除运行时问题，因此需要运行时控制机制。
AI.method: 提出GCC，基于Nelson-Narens监控-控制环路：对象层级读写文本，确定性元层级仅读取数值遥测（强度、效价、重复）并返回调节姿态。元层级不摄入任何token，从架构上消除注入通道。采用预先注册的generate-once/judge-many协议，在4x4模型矩阵中评估。
AI.result: 受调控臂在13/16个单元中显著更平静（p<.05），15/16符号一致。3个亚阈值单元（包含一个-0.04零效应）均落在单个接近饱和的主机上。效应经xAI第四评判家族验证，非共享评判风格伪影。回收特征（ arousal在攻击下整合后衰减，效价门控的去升级）在四个模型家族中复制。
AI.conclusion: GCC能有效调控LLM代理的倾向性故障，提供了可验证的运行时控制方案。五个失败模式已预先注册，转录本和面板具有SHA-256来源可审计。不做意识主张。

title: Stress-testing large language model agents in a robotic chemistry laboratory
summary: AI is evaluated through knowledge, reasoning and plan generation, yet scientific agency requires reliable physical action and adaptation to evidence. Here, we use a robotic chemistry laboratory as a physical-world testbed to make scientific agency measurable. Its 45 modular workstations exposed as machine-readable skills enabled 4,608 trials. Only 3.3% of trials produced expert-assessed executable workflows under laboratory constraints; even the best system achieved 28.1%. Long-horizon planning remained a challenge: only three executable workflows exceeded 30 operations, although the longest contained 44. Across five rounds, experimental feedback prompted local adjustments but no workflow-level replanning or analytical-method redesign. By making physical executability and evidence-driven replanning measurable, our study provides an evidence-based assessment of deployment readiness and a diagnostic framework to guide closed-loop improvements towards physically grounded autonomous research.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器人化学实验室作为物理世界测试平台，通过45个模块化工作站和4,608次试验评估AI的科学代理能力。结果显示仅3.3%的试验产生可执行工作流，最佳系统达28.1%；长程规划仍具挑战，仅3个可执行工作流超过30个操作。实验反馈仅引发局部调整，缺乏工作流级重新规划。研究提供了物理可执行性和证据驱动重新规划的可量化评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评估多聚焦于知识、推理和计划生成，缺乏对物理世界中可靠行动和证据适应能力的度量，亟需建立科学代理在现实环境中的可量化评估方法。
AI.method: 将机器人化学实验室的45个模块化工作站暴露为机器可读技能，开展4,608次试验，通过专家评估衡量工作流在实验室约束下的可执行性，并分析多轮实验反馈对工作流规划的影响。
AI.result: 仅3.3%试验产生可执行工作流；最佳系统达28.1%；仅3个可执行工作流超过30个操作（最长44个）；实验反馈仅引发局部调整，无工作流级重新规划或分析方法重新设计。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了物理可执行性和证据驱动重新规划的可量化评估，为部署就绪性提供基于证据的评估，并建立指导闭环改进的诊断框架，推动物理具身自主研究发展。

title: RoadVGGT: Road-Structure-Aware Feed-Forward Road Surface Reconstruction
summary: Large-scale road surface reconstruction supports high-definition mapping, autonomous-driving perception, annotation, and simulation. Existing road-specialized optimization methods can produce high-quality road representations, but they typically require per-scene training and scene-dependent coverage design around the driving trajectory, limiting scalable reconstruction over newly collected roads. To address these limitations, we introduce RoadVGGT, a road-structure-aware feed-forward framework that reconstructs compact Gaussian road surfaces without test-time per-scene optimization. RoadVGGT uses a geometric foundation model to exploit multi-view images together with provided pose and depth observations, and predicts dense pixel-aligned Gaussian attributes through a learned Gaussian head. To make these dense predictions usable for large road surfaces, we align them into a consistent metric world coordinate system and fuse redundant Gaussians on the road-aligned XY plane through confidence-weighted grid fusion. Category-aware grouping and road--sidewalk junction protection further control fusion around vulnerable road structures. The resulting representation supports RGB and semantic bird's-eye-view maps, elevation estimation, and novel view synthesis. RoadVGGT eliminates the need for per-scene optimization in prior methods, reconstructs complete road surfaces with a compact Gaussian representation, and improves image quality, semantic mapping, and elevation accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the potential of geometric foundation models for scalable feed-forward road surface reconstruction.

AI.tldr: RoadVGGT提出了一种无需逐场景优化的前馈式道路表面重建框架，利用几何基础模型从多视图图像中预测稠密高斯属性，并通过置信度加权网格融合生成紧凑的高斯道路表示，支持RGB/语义鸟瞰图、高程估计和新视角合成，在图像质量、语义映射和高程精度上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有道路表面重建方法需要逐场景训练和围绕驾驶轨迹的场景依赖覆盖设计，限制了在新采集道路上的可扩展重建。为解决这一局限，作者提出一种无需测试时逐场景优化的前馈式框架。
AI.method: 利用几何基础模型（Geometric Foundation Model）处理多视图图像及位姿、深度观测，通过学习的Gaussian Head预测稠密的像素对齐高斯属性；将预测结果对齐到一致的度量世界坐标系，在路面对齐的XY平面上通过置信度加权网格融合（Confidence-Weighted Grid Fusion）合并冗余高斯；引入类别感知分组（Category-Aware Grouping）和路侧-人行道接合保护（Road-Sidewalk Junction Protection）来控制脆弱道路结构附近的融合过程。
AI.result: RoadVGGT无需逐场景优化即可重建完整道路表面；生成紧凑的高斯表示；在图像质量、语义映射和高程精度上均取得改进。大量实验证明了几何基础模型在可扩展的前馈式道路表面重建中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种前馈式、道路结构感知的道路表面重建方法，消除了对测试时逐场景优化的依赖，为大规模、可扩展的道路重建提供了新的范式。该方法支持RGB和语义鸟瞰图、高程估计及新视角合成，适用于高精地图、自动驾驶感知、标注和仿真等应用。

title: Bigger or Cheaper? Scale and Quantization Effects on Uncertainty Signals in Vision-Language Models Under Image Degradation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) deployed on consumer hardware must decide when to answer and when to defer, and that decision depends on having a confidence signal that tracks correctness. A practitioner with a fixed memory budget faces a choice between a small model at full precision, the same small model quantized, and a larger model quantized into the same footprint -- three configurations that push the confidence signal in opposing directions. We measure, on identical inputs, how model scale and 4-bit quantization affect two confidence signals in the Qwen2-VL family: the confidence a model states in natural language, and its own mean token probability over the answer it generates. Across 5,700 predictions spanning six realistic photographic degradations at three severities, we find that scale sharply improves the model's internal uncertainty signal (mean error-detection AUROC 0.80 to 0.98 from 2B to 7B) while its verbalized confidence stays weak and often at chance (mean 0.61 to 0.69): the gap between what the model knows and what it says widens rather than closes with size. We find that 4-bit quantization is nearly free for accuracy (-1.6 points) but expensive for the confidence signal (internal AUROC 0.95 to 0.80, and the verbalized-confidence parse rate collapses from 99% to 64%). For a fixed memory budget the recommendation is therefore to prefer a larger quantized model over a smaller full-precision one: 7B-4bit gives both the best accuracy and the best uncertainty signal (internal AUROC 0.98) of the three configurations that fit. We frame the results as selective-prediction operating points so they translate directly into a deployment recommendation, and we argue that error-detection AUROC, not calibration error, is the metric that exposes the difference between the two signals.

AI.tldr: 在固定内存预算下，大模型量化（7B-4bit）相比小模型全精度（2B-16bit）在准确率和不确定性信号上均更优；模型规模提升内部不确定性信号（AUROC从0.80到0.98），但对口头置信度改善微弱（0.61到0.69）；4-bit量化对准确性影响小（-1.6点），但严重削弱置信度信号（内部AUROC从0.95降至0.80，口头置信度解析率从99%降至64%）。
AI.motivation: 在消费者硬件上部署VLM时，需要在固定内存预算下选择模型配置（小模型全精度、小模型量化、大模型量化），但不同配置对置信度信号的影响方向相反，缺乏系统性的比较研究来指导部署选择。
AI.method: 在Qwen2-VL系列（2B和7B）上，对6种真实照片退化（各3个严重级别）共5,700个预测，测量两种置信度信号——模型自然语言表述的置信度（口头置信度）和生成答案的平均token概率（内部不确定性信号），比较全精度与4-bit量化在不同规模下的表现。
AI.result: 规模提升大幅改善内部不确定性信号（AUROC从0.80升至0.98），但口头置信度提升微弱（0.61至0.69），两者差距随规模扩大而增大；4-bit量化对准确率影响小（-1.6%），但严重损害内部置信度信号（AUROC从0.95降至0.80）和口头置信度解析率（99%降至64%）；7B-4bit在三种配置中兼具最高准确率和最优不确定性信号（内部AUROC 0.98）。
AI.conclusion: 固定内存预算下应优先选择大模型量化版本（7B-4bit）而非小模型全精度；错误检测AUROC比校准误差更能揭示两种置信度信号之间的差异；应将结果框架化为选择性预测的操作点以直接指导部署决策。

title: SymStep: Symbolic Step Verification for Logical Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting can fail severely on constraint-dense logical reasoning tasks, where unverified errors accumulate silently across steps. We introduce SymStep: an LLM makes one atomic claim at a time (DEDUCE: Alice, pet, Cat), then a lightweight constraint propagator checks the claim for consistency with prior accepted deductions, rejects contradictions, and cascades implied facts automatically. SymStep+G additionally provides MRV guidance after each accepted step, directing the LLM toward the most constrained unresolved variable. On a 35-puzzle retained subset of ZebraLogicBench, a benchmark of 1,000 Einstein-style logic puzzles, Direct and CoT both achieve 0%, while SymStep+G reaches 97%. On AR-LSAT analytical reasoning problems, SymStep achieves 100% vs. CoT's 87%. On LGP-14, SymStep+G achieves 100% vs. 0% for CoT and Logic-LM, the strongest prior symbolic+LLM baseline we compare against. Ablation studies reveal that MRV guidance is a key mechanism for reducing directionless cycling, while consistency checking provides a safety net against explicit contradictions. Across six benchmarks spanning five task domains, SymStep variants match or exceed every baseline on constraint-dense and arithmetic tasks. Experiments on AQUA-RAT algebra confirm the advantage is constraint-density-specific.

AI.tldr: SymStep是一种将LLM的原子化声明与轻量级约束传播器相结合的框架，通过逐步一致性检查和MRV引导，在约束密集的逻辑推理任务上显著超越传统CoT方法，在ZebraLogicBench上从0%提升至97%。
AI.motivation: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting在约束密集的逻辑推理任务中会因错误累积而严重失败，需要一种能防止错误传播并在推理过程中提供结构化约束的方法。
AI.method: SymStep框架包含两个核心机制：(1) DEDUCE——LLM每次只做一条原子性声明，随后轻量级约束传播器检查该声明与已有推导的一致性，拒绝矛盾并自动级联隐含事实；(2) SymStep+G——在每次接受步骤后提供MRV（最受约束未解析变量）引导，指引LLM关注约束最强的未解析变量。
AI.result: 在ZebraLogicBench的35谜题子集上，Direct和CoT均为0%，SymStep+G达97%；AR-LSAT上SymStep达100% vs. CoT的87%；LGP-14上SymStep+G达100% vs. CoT和Logic-LM的0%；在六个基准测试中，SymStep变体在约束密集和算术任务上匹配或超越所有基线。
AI.conclusion: MRV引导是减少方向循环的关键机制，一致性检查是防止显式矛盾的安全网。SymStep的优势具有约束密度特异性，在AQUA-RAT代数实验中得到验证。

title: PathScale-R1: Cross-scale Reasoning for Pathological Image Analysis
summary: Pathological diagnosis is inherently multi-scale, requiring the integration of global tissue architecture at low magnification with cellular morphology at higher magnification. However, existing pathology benchmarks and vision-language models (VLMs) are still largely developed under single-scale settings, limiting their ability to learn clinically meaningful multi-magnification reasoning. Moreover, naively constructed visual question answering (VQA) tasks may be susceptible to text-only or superficial visual shortcuts, leading to unreliable assessments of visual understanding. To address these limitations, we introduce a benchmark and training framework for shortcut-resistant cross-scale pathology reasoning. We design an Adversarial Text-only Screening strategy for semantic reasoning questions and a Structure-controlled Distractor Sampling strategy for visual grounding questions, encouraging models to rely on cross-scale visual evidence. Based on this pipeline, we construct PathScale-VQA, a high-quality cross-scale pathology VQA benchmark with 10,373 multiple-choice questions grounded in 1,368 diagnostic paths across multiple magnification levels. Building on the semantic reasoning set, PathScale-R1 is optimized through Difficulty-driven Reasoning Distillation supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with a Scale-aware Reasoning Structure reward, which encourages the use of evidence across magnifications. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of PathScale-R1 on cross-scale reasoning tasks and effective transfer to conventional single-scale pathology VQA. Our code is available at https://github.com/iMVR-PL/PathScale-R1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PathScale-VQA基准和PathScale-R1模型，用于解决病理视觉语言模型在多尺度推理中的不足。通过对抗性文本筛选和结构控制干扰采样策略构建抗捷径的跨尺度VQA数据集，并采用难度驱动推理蒸馏与尺度感知推理结构强化学习优化模型，在跨尺度和单尺度病理VQA任务上均达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有病理学基准和视觉语言模型主要在单尺度设置下开发，无法学习临床有意义的跨放大倍数推理；且简单构建的VQA任务容易受到仅文本或浅层视觉捷径的干扰，导致对视觉理解能力的评估不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 提出对抗性文本筛选策略和结构控制干扰采样策略，构建抗捷径的跨尺度病理VQA基准PathScale-VQA（10,373道多选题，1,368条诊断路径）；2) 提出PathScale-R1模型，采用难度驱动推理蒸馏监督微调，结合尺度感知推理结构奖励的强化学习进行优化。
AI.result: PathScale-R1在跨尺度推理任务上达到最先进性能，并能有效迁移到传统单尺度病理VQA任务。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度视觉证据的融合对于病理VQA至关重要，所提出的抗捷径训练框架和跨尺度推理优化方法能有效提升模型的临床推理能力。

title: Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels
summary: Reliable visual document understanding requires a model to attribute each answer to the evidence regions that support it. Recent benchmarks and systems express this step through a coordinate interface: the model outputs the coordinates of bounding boxes that mark the evidence regions in the document. Under this interface, vision-language models often fail to identify the right regions even when the answer is correct, a failure known as Attribution Hallucination. We present a study that investigates whether this failure is partially limited by what the model can express through coordinates. On a verified bilingual CiteVQA subset, we compare the coordinate interface with a language interface in which the model outputs only text, quoting its evidence verbatim, and a multimodal retriever returns the location of each quote as a page region proposed by a layout parser (tables and figures are quoted through their captions or notes); the comparison is repeated over six open vision-language models. Compared with the coordinate interface, evidence recall rises from at most 8 points to between 26 and 47 and the hallucination rate roughly halves, with little change in answer quality. Building on this comparison, we use the same quote-and-retrieve pipeline as a training scaffold: because region-level evidence labels are expensive to collect for long documents, we introduce a GRPO recipe whose reward is a judge's reading of the gold answer and crops of the retrieved regions, training the model to quote better evidence without any region labels and raising an 8B backbone's strict attributed accuracy from 22.4 to 33.8. These findings indicate a practical path to improve attribution"without a coordinate interface and without costly region-level supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在视觉文档理解中，使用坐标接口的视觉语言模型存在严重的归因幻觉问题。相比坐标接口，语言接口（模型引用原文证据，通过检索器定位）将证据召回率从最多8分提升至26-47分，幻觉率减半。基于此，作者提出无需区域标签的GRPO训练方案，将8B模型的严格归因准确率从22.4提升至33.8。
AI.motivation: 研究视觉文档理解中归因幻觉的根源，探索是否因坐标接口的表达限制导致模型无法正确标识证据区域，并寻找无需昂贵区域级标注的改进路径。
AI.method: 在双语CiteVQA数据集上，比较坐标接口与语言接口（引用原文+检索定位）在六个开源视觉语言模型上的表现；提出引用-检索流水线作为训练框架，使用GRPO算法以裁判对黄金答案和检索区域的阅读结果为奖励，无需区域标签训练模型生成更好的引用证据。
AI.result: 语言接口相比坐标接口，证据召回率从最多8分提升至26-47分，幻觉率减半，答案质量几乎不变。GRPO训练将8B模型的严格归因准确率从22.4提升至33.8。
AI.conclusion: 语言接口（引用+检索）是比坐标接口更有效的归因方式，结合GRPO训练可进一步提升归因表现，无需坐标接口和昂贵的区域级监督。

title: Structure over Depth: A Single-Block Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Multi-Entity Reasoning
summary: Modeling multi-entity temporal data requires capturing dependencies across entities, time, and their interactions. Transformer-based approaches perform well but often rely on deep stacks of layers to learn these heterogeneous dependencies implicitly, increasing computational cost. We revisit this problem from a structural perspective and decompose multi-entity temporal dynamics into three interaction types: spatial interactions among entities, temporal interactions across time, and cross interactions coupling the two domains. We propose a structured spatio-temporal transformer block that explicitly models all three within a single stage. It uses parallel spatial and temporal self-attention, followed by bidirectional cross-attention, and combines the outputs through learnable gated fusion. By directly encoding these complementary views, the model reduces the need for deep stacking. We evaluate the approach on video-based group activity recognition, skeleton-based human interaction analysis, and wearable sensor-based activity recognition. Despite its simplicity, the single structured Transformer block matches or outperforms deeper architectures with only 1.76M parameters. The results suggest that depth in prior models partly compensates for implicit and entangled interaction modeling, whereas explicit factorization offers a more efficient and transparent alternative. More broadly, this work supports a structure-first design principle: expressive multi-entity temporal reasoning can emerge by exposing interaction structure rather than relying on depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结构化时空Transformer模块，将多实体时序动态分解为空间、时间、交叉三种交互类型，通过并行时空自注意力与双向交叉注意力显式建模，以单层结构匹配或超越深层架构的性能，参数仅1.76M。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer方法依赖深层堆叠隐式学习多实体时序数据中的异构依赖关系，导致计算成本高昂。作者从结构视角出发，认为深度部分弥补了隐式纠缠建模的不足，因此希望显式分解交互类型以提供更高效、透明的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出结构化时空Transformer块：1) 并行空间自注意力和时间自注意力分别建模实体间和时域依赖；2) 双向交叉注意力耦合两个域；3) 通过可学习的门控融合合并输出。单一模块直接编码三种互补视图，减少对深层堆叠的需求。
AI.result: 在视频群体活动识别、骨架人体交互分析、可穿戴传感器活动识别三个任务上，单结构化Transformer块（1.76M参数）匹配或超越了更深的基线架构。
AI.conclusion: 深度在先前模型中部分补偿了隐式纠缠建模的不足，而显式分解交互结构提供了更高效、透明的方案。支持"结构优先"的设计原则：暴露交互结构而非依赖深度即可实现表达性多实体时序推理。

title: Beyond Appearance: A Multi-cue Framework and Large-scale Benchmark for Pedestrian Association and Tracking on Mobile Aerial-Ground Platforms
summary: Multi-view Multi-object Association and Tracking (MvMoAT) associates objects across camera views and tracks them over time, supporting identity persistence and forensic trajectory reconstruction in multi-platform cooperative perception. Unlike conventional multiple object tracking, MvMoAT faces frequent viewpoint shifts that distort appearance and undermine cross-view association and temporal tracking. We propose FUSION, a viewpoint-robust Feature Unification framework for multi-view aSsociation and IdentificatiON. Its Multi-cue Adaptive Combination (MAC) module adaptively integrates viewpoint-invariant cues with appearance features to improve cross-view association, while Online Multi-view Feature Synchronization (OMFS) aggregates pedestrian features across historical and cross-view frames for temporally consistent tracking. We also introduce RealMvMoAT, a large-scale benchmark featuring substantial inter- and intra-camera viewpoint variation. It contains 504.9K frames from 7 cameras (5 UAV and 2 ground views) across 10 scenes, with over 7.3M identity-labeled bounding boxes. All cameras exhibit random and substantial motion. To the best of our knowledge, RealMvMoAT is the largest MvMoAT dataset to date. Its scale, viewpoint diversity, complex platform motion, and realistic trajectories provide a comprehensive resource for future research. Experiments on RealMvMoAT and six public benchmarks show that FUSION achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FUSION框架，通过多线索自适应组合（MAC）和在线多视角特征同步（OMFS）解决多视角多目标关联与跟踪（MvMoAT）中视角变化导致的表观失真问题，并构建了包含504.9K帧、7个摄像机、超过730万标注框的大规模基准数据集RealMvMoAT，在多个基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多视角多目标关联与跟踪（MvMoAT）面临频繁视角变化导致目标表观失真，从而破坏跨视角关联和时序跟踪的问题，现有方法对此缺乏有效的鲁棒性处理。
AI.method: 提出FUSION框架，包含两个核心模块：1）多线索自适应组合（MAC）模块，自适应整合视角不变线索与外观特征以增强跨视角关联；2）在线多视角特征同步（OMFS）模块，聚合历史和跨视角帧的行人特征以实现时序一致的跟踪。
AI.result: 在RealMvMoAT和6个公开基准数据集上，FUSION达到最先进的性能。RealMvMoAT包含504.9K帧、7个摄像机（5个无人机视角+2个地面视角）、10个场景、超过730万个身份标注的边界框，所有摄像机均有随机大幅度运动。
AI.conclusion: FUSION通过视角鲁棒的特征统一框架有效解决了MvMoAT中的视角变化问题，RealMvMoAT作为目前最大的MvMoAT数据集，其规模、视角多样性、复杂的平台运动和真实轨迹为未来研究提供了全面资源。

title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) hold immense potential to revolutionize clinical practice, yet deploying them in the medical domain is fundamentally a vision-centric challenge: models must absorb knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images, and evaluation protocols must align with radiologists' clinical practice and provide an accurate, fine-grained and factualness-driven assessment. In this paper, we introduce ClinFusion, a vision-centric MLLM designed for holistic medical understanding that systematically addresses these limitations. We propose a compositional and cascaded vision encoder architecture featuring a Cascade Spatial-Aware Locality Fusion operator that unifies diverse 2D and native 3D medical image understanding within a fused encoder. We further introduce a vision-grounded evaluation framework, including MedIF-Bench for instruction-following assessment and a region-of-interest-grounded method for clinically aligned and factualness-driven report generation evaluation. We show that ClinFusion sets a new state-of-the-art across a comprehensive suite of 2D and 3D multimodal medical benchmarks---spanning visual question answering, report generation, and instruction following---as well as textual medical tasks, outperforming leading open-source medical MLLMs (\textit{e.g.}, Hulu-Med, Lingshu) on 20 out of 24 benchmarks and demonstrating multimodal capabilities better than powerful proprietary models such as GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3-Flash on 13 out of 16 benchmarks, and can be further augmented with agentic tool use for retrieval-augmented and tool-assisted clinical workflows. A blinded evaluation by board-certified radiologists confirms that ClinFusion produces the highest-ranked reports, and validates our RoI-grounded metric as achieving the strongest correlation with expert judgment among all automatic evaluation metrics examined.

AI.tldr: ClinFusion是一个面向医疗领域的视觉中心多模态大语言模型，通过级联空间感知局部融合架构统一处理2D和3D医学图像，并引入基于视觉的评估框架MedIF-Bench和RoI接地方法，在24个基准测试中20个达到SOTA，超越GPT-5.2等闭源模型，放射科医生盲评确认其报告质量最高。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在临床应用中面临根本性的视觉中心挑战：模型需要从异构的2D和3D医学图像中吸收知识，且评估协议必须与放射科医生的临床实践对齐，提供准确、细粒度且基于事实的评估。现有方法缺乏对这些系统性问题的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出组合式级联视觉编码器架构，包含级联空间感知局部融合算子，统一处理2D和原生3D医学图像理解；引入基于视觉接地的评估框架MedIF-Bench用于指令遵循评估，以及RoI接地方法用于临床对齐的、基于事实的报告生成评估；支持通过智能体工具使用实现检索增强和工具辅助的临床工作流。
AI.result: 在涵盖VQA、报告生成和指令遵循的2D/3D多模态医疗基准上，20/24个基准超越Hulu-Med、Lingshu等开源模型；13/16个基准超越GPT-5.2和Gemini-3-Flash等闭源模型；放射科医生盲评确认ClinFusion生成最高质量报告，RoI接地指标与专家判断的相关性最强。
AI.conclusion: ClinFusion通过视觉中心的架构设计和评估框架的统一创新，有效解决了MLLM在医疗领域的核心挑战，实现了对开源和闭源模型的双重超越，其RoI接地评估方法为临床报告评估提供了更可靠的自动指标。

title: Compiler-Grounded Hierarchical Diagnosis for LLM-Based Triton Kernel Optimization
summary:
Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled automated kernel generation and optimization, but most existing approaches rely on surface signals such as compilation feedback and profiling metrics. These signals reveal that a kernel is slow, but not why the backend compiler fails to realize a profitable optimization, especially on emerging accelerators such as NPUs. We therefore formulate kernel optimization as a progressive cross-layer diagnosis problem that links runtime symptoms to IR structure and compiler behavior before rewriting source. Based on this insight, we present our system, a compiler-grounded and hierarchical optimization framework for Triton kernels. the system escalates from lightweight pattern triage and profiling diagnosis to IR attribution and compiler-grounded analysis only when deeper evidence is needed, then proposes evidence-backed source-level rewrites.
  We implement the system on Triton for Ascend NPUs and evaluate it on 37 successfully converted entries from a standardized NPUKernelBench-derived Ascend 950 benchmark.
