Across these entries, the system attains a geometric-mean speedup of 4.35$\times$ and a median speedup of 2.73$\times$ from the initial to optimized Triton kernel; 22/37 exceed 2$\times$ and 13/37 exceed 5$\times$. The complete distribution ranges from near-baseline entries to large wins, motivating transparent reporting of the current system's scope and limitations.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种编译器引导的分层优化框架，通过从轻量级模式分类到IR归因的渐进式诊断，对Triton内核进行优化，在Ascend NPU上实现了平均4.35倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的内核优化仅依赖编译反馈和性能分析等表面信号，只能知道内核慢，但无法揭示后端编译器为何未能实现有利优化（尤其是在NPU等新兴加速器上）的根本原因。
AI.method: 将内核优化形式化为渐进式跨层诊断问题，从轻量级模式分类和性能分析诊断开始，只在需要更深层证据时才升级到IR归因和编译器接地分析，最终提出基于证据的源代码级重写。
AI.result: 在Ascend NPU上的37个基准测试中，几何平均加速比4.35倍，中位数加速比2.73倍；22/37超过2倍，13/37超过5倍。
AI.conclusion: 编译器引导的分层诊断方法能有效挖掘内核优化机会，但系统仍存在范围和局限性，需要透明报告。

title: Consistent Evidence, Robust Recognition: Faithful Attribution Regularization under Geometric Transformations
summary: Attribution methods are widely used to characterize the evidence underlying model predictions, yet their potential to improve model behavior remains underexplored. Attribution inconsistency under label-preserving geometric transformations may indicate transformation-sensitive evidence reliance, motivating attribution regularization. However, such supervision is valid only when attribution faithfully reflects the evidence driving predictions. Existing self-supervised methods typically align gradient-based maps such as Grad-CAM, whose limited faithfulness means that attribution consistency need not imply consistency of the underlying decision process, leaving transformation robustness unresolved. We propose an annotation-free attribution regularization framework based on submodular search over image regions. By measuring how candidate subsets affect model outputs, the search extracts compact, class-discriminative evidence as search-derived supervision. We further introduce a submodular ranking loss with path-consistency and termination-alignment terms that respectively align spatially corresponding candidate rankings along paired search trajectories and encourage the transformed trajectory to satisfy the stopping criterion at the target terminal step. The loss provides a differentiable surrogate for regularizing both final attributions and the otherwise discrete evidence-selection process. Experiments on ImageNet-100 show that our method substantially improves attribution stability, Insertion, and Deletion on ViT-B/16 with only a 0.28-point accuracy drop, with similar gains on ViT-L/16. On ImageNet-1K, it improves transformed-input accuracy on ResNet-50 and ConvNeXt-B while limiting the clean-accuracy drop to 0.30 points, demonstrating more consistent evidence reliance with minimal performance loss. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于子模搜索的无监督归因正则化框架，通过搜索图像区域提取紧凑、类别判别性的证据，并引入子模排序损失（含路径一致性和终止对齐项）来正则化归因过程和离散证据选择，在ImageNet-100和ImageNet-1K上显著提升归因稳定性和变换鲁棒性，仅带来极小的精度下降。
AI.motivation: 现有归因方法在标签保持的几何变换下存在不一致性，表明模型依赖的决策证据对变换敏感。然而，现有的自监督对齐方法（如Grad-CAM）保真度有限，归因一致并不代表决策过程一致，无法真正解决变换鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 提出无监督归因正则化框架：(1) 通过子模搜索在图像区域上寻找影响模型输出的候选子集，提取紧凑、类别判别性证据作为搜索导出监督；(2) 设计子模排序损失，包含路径一致性项（对齐配对搜索轨迹中空间对应的候选排序）和终止对齐项（鼓励变换后轨迹在目标终止步满足停止准则），为归因和离散证据选择提供可微的代理正则化。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-100上，ViT-B/16的归因稳定性、Insertion和Deletion显著提升，仅损失0.28个百分点的准确率；ViT-L/16取得类似改进。在ImageNet-1K上，ResNet-50和ConvNeXt-B的变换输入准确率提升，干净准确率下降仅0.30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法以极小的性能代价显著提升了归因稳定性和变换鲁棒性，证明了更一致的证据依赖关系可以仅通过归因正则化实现，无需额外标注。

title: SQBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Task Delivery by Language-Model Agents in Production-Oriented Workflows
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures. Code and aggregate results: https://github.com/shaqiu-ai/SQBench
summary: Existing evaluations of large language models cover knowledge, reasoning, coding, and tool use, but they rarely treat a verifiable deliverable produced within a constrained workflow as the unit of evaluation. We introduce SQBench, a benchmark for evaluating production-oriented task delivery by language-model agents. SQBench v1.0 contains 220 standardized tasks organized into L1 atomic capabilities, L2 composite skills, and L3 business scenarios. Each task requires an agent to process input assets, use available tools, and produce an explicitly specified deliverable. The evaluation first computes functional Completion and then derives Risk Penalty and Performance from independently evidenced triggers in a 10D Risk Matrix. A Strict Pass requires Completion = 1 and Risk Penalty = 0. We evaluate 27 model configurations under a common protocol, with one run per configuration-task pair. The highest prespecified Weighted Pass@1 is 60.5%. Mean Strict Pass@1 on L3 is 18.5%, and every configuration performs worse on L3 than on both L1 and L2, indicating that delivery under domain constraints is a shared weakness within the current task set. Of 2,348 results with Completion = 1, 113 (4.8%) fail the Strict Pass criterion because of risks such as unverifiable citations, inappropriate resource use, or format violations. These results show that functional completion alone does not fully characterize delivery quality and that risk determinations should be reported separately.

AI.tldr: SQBench是一个评估语言模型代理在生产导向任务交付中表现的基准，包含220个标准化任务（分为L1原子能力、L2复合技能、L3业务场景）。评估通过功能性完成度、风险惩罚和性能三个维度进行，严格通过要求完成度为1且风险惩罚为0。对27种模型配置的评估显示，最高加权通过率为60.5%，L3场景严格通过率仅18.5%，且4.8%的功能完成结果因风险问题未能通过严格标准。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型评估覆盖知识、推理、编码和工具使用，但很少将以可验证交付物为单位的受限工作流产出作为评估单元，缺乏对生产导向任务交付质量的系统性评测。
AI.method: 构建SQBench基准，包含220个标准化任务，分为L1原子能力、L2复合技能、L3业务场景三层。评估流程：先计算功能性完成度（Completion），再基于10维风险矩阵从独立证据触发点推导风险惩罚（Risk Penalty）和性能（Performance）。严格通过标准要求完成度为1且风险惩罚为0。
AI.result: 对27种模型配置评估，最高加权通过率60.5%；L3场景严格通过率仅18.5%，所有配置在L3上表现均差于L1和L2；在2348个完成度为1的结果中，113个（4.8%）因不可验证引用、不当资源使用或格式违规等风险未能满足严格通过标准。
AI.conclusion: 功能完成度不足以全面表征交付质量，风险判定应单独报告；领域约束下的交付是当前模型集的共同弱点。

title: STEER: Steerable Dyadic Head Avatars
summary: Facial movement and expression are central to face-to-face communication, conveying turn-taking, attention, agreement, and engagement alongside speech. While speech-driven facial animation has made strong progress in lip synchronization and audio-conditioned motion generation, most methods treat conversational behavior as an emergent byproduct of audio, or expose only coarse sequence-level affect control. As a result, key non-verbal channels such as gaze contact and aversion, rhythmic head motion, and emotion remain difficult to explicitly control. We present STEER, a controllable 3D dyadic motion prior for reactive conversational head avatars. STEER factorizes conversational behavior into explicit controls for gaze, head rhythm, and emotion, allowing users to steer how an avatar listens, reacts, and engages with a conversation partner. Since temporally aligned annotations for these behaviors are not available in public dyadic corpora, we introduce a tracking and annotation pipeline that recovers behavioral pseudo-labels from in-the-wild dyadic video. A causal flow-matching transformer then learns partner-aware target motion conditioned on audio, partner motion, emotion and the proposed behavioral controls. We further embed STEER in a photorealistic avatar pipeline by extending a Universal Gaussian Head-Avatar Prior with a learned mapping from tracked parametric motion into its avatar-driving space. This enables controllable animation of high-fidelity Gaussian head avatars without re-training the underlying avatar model. STEER outperforms recent dyadic motion baselines on motion quality, dynamics, and diversity, remains competitive on partner coupling, and enables gaze, head-rhythm, and emotion edits together with an interactive live deployment. We make our code and dataset annotations available at our webpage.

AI.tldr: STEER是一个可控的3D双人交互运动先验模型，通过分解对话行为中的凝视、头部节奏和情感为显式控制信号，结合因果流匹配Transformer和伪标签标注流程，实现了对反应式对话头部虚拟人的高保真可控动画生成。
AI.motivation: 现有语音驱动面部动画方法大多将对话行为视为音频的副产品，仅提供粗粒度的序列级情感控制，难以显式控制如视线接触/回避、节奏性头部运动和情感等关键非语言信号通道。
AI.method: 提出STEER框架，包含：1) 从野外双人视频中恢复行为伪标签的追踪与标注流水线；2) 因果流匹配Transformer，以音频、同伴运动、情感和行为控制为条件学习同伴感知的目标运动；3) 将STEER嵌入到通用高斯头部虚拟人先验中，通过参数运动到虚拟人驱动空间的映射实现可控动画。
AI.result: STEER在运动质量、动态性和多样性上优于近期双人运动基线，在同伴耦合上保持竞争力，且支持凝视、头部节奏和情感编辑以及交互式实时部署。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式分解对话行为控制信号，STEER实现了对反应式对话头部虚拟人的精细可控生成，弥补了现有方法在非语言信号控制上的不足。

title: OmniCache: Multidimensional Hierarchical Feature Caching For Diffusion Models
summary: High-resolution image and video diffusion models, including SD3, FLUX, and recent video diffusion transformers, have substantially improved generative quality but remain expensive at inference time because they repeatedly evaluate attention-heavy denoisers over many sampling steps. We address this inefficiency by exploiting redundancy in intermediate diffusion features rather than changing model weights or retraining. We identify four complementary redundancy sources in image and video generation: intra-frame, inter-frame, motion, and denoising-step redundancy. Based on this analysis, we propose OmniCache, a unified hierarchical caching framework that performs multidimensional feature reuse through Token Cache, Frame Cache, Block Cache, and Layered Cache. Unlike token-merging baselines that average matched features, OmniCache uses similarity matching to select cacheable features, skips redundant computation, and restores positionally consistent cached activations, preserving feature order and spatial-temporal structure. The resulting framework reuses spatial features in temporal layers and temporal features in spatial layers, while Layered Cache captures cross-step redundancy at the model-layer level. Across SD3, SVD-XT, and Latte, OmniCache reduces inference latency by up to 35%, 25%, and 28%, respectively, while maintaining visual fidelity and motion coherence in a training-free setting.

AI.tldr: OmniCache是一种无需训练的统一分层缓存框架，通过利用图像和视频扩散模型中四种互补的冗余（帧内、帧间、运动和去噪步骤冗余），使用Token Cache、Frame Cache、Block Cache和Layered Cache进行多维特征复用，在不改变模型权重的情况下，在SD3、SVD-XT和Latte上分别减少了最高35%、25%和28%的推理延迟，同时保持视觉质量和运动一致性。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像和视频扩散模型（如SD3、FLUX和视频扩散Transformer）在推理时计算开销极大，因为它们需要在大量采样步骤中重复评估注意力密集的去噪器。现有方法需要改变模型权重或重新训练，效率不高。
AI.method: 提出OmniCache统一分层缓存框架，识别四种冗余（帧内、帧间、运动和去噪步骤冗余），设计四种缓存机制：Token Cache、Frame Cache、Block Cache和Layered Cache。不同于token-merging基线对匹配特征做平均，OmniCache通过相似度匹配选择可缓存特征，跳过冗余计算，并恢复位置一致的缓存激活，保留特征顺序和时空结构，同时支持空间特征在时间层和时域特征在空间层之间的跨层复用。
AI.result: 在SD3、SVD-XT和Latte上，OmniCache分别将推理延迟降低了最高35%、25%和28%，同时保持了视觉保真度和运动一致性，无需训练。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用扩散模型中的多维特征冗余，OmniCache在无需训练的条件下实现了显著的推理加速，同时保持了生成质量，为高效扩散模型推理提供了一种有效且通用的框架。

title: CachedSearch: Training-Free Cached Exploration for Test-Time Search in Video Diffusion
summary: Test-time search lets small video diffusion models rival larger ones, but costs 2-10x more. All candidates are fully denoised, although most are discarded. Training-free caching makes each rollout 2-3x faster at near-lossless quality. Composition is safe only if lossy caching preserves verifier rankings. We present the first study of whether caching corrupts candidate ranking in video test-time search. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B with an adaptive caching wrapper (~2x per-candidate speedup), ImageReward scores seed-matched cached and full rollouts. Median per-prompt Spearman rank correlation is 0.905, with 72% top-1 agreement on the VBench suite. VBench-2.0 replicates this result on a harder suite. Recomputing the cached winner at full compute retains 90-94% of the full-search gain. Errors cluster among near-tied candidates, making corruption self-limiting. This finding leads to CachedSearch. It explores every candidate with aggressive caching, then re-generates only the winner at full compute. At N=8, it captures 94.7% of best-of-N's gain at 63% of the cost. Capture rises with width. At matched budget, it searches twice as wide for 38% more gain. The result holds from 1.3B-14B across six models and four families: Wan, LTX, CogVideoX, and Hunyuan. Wan2.1-14B matches the 1.3B model's fidelity. Mid-trajectory pruning multiplies the exploration saving to 3.11x at 88.6% capture. Ports to other model families require recalibrating a single parameter, showing that fidelity tracks architecture rather than parameter count. CachedSearch is training-free, verifier-agnostic, and orthogonal to the search algorithm, making it a plug-in multiplier for test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出CachedSearch方法，通过训练无关的缓存策略加速视频扩散模型的测试时搜索，以63%的成本捕获94.7%的best-of-N收益，支持1.3B-14B参数规模的六种模型。
AI.motivation: 测试时搜索虽能提升小视频扩散模型性能，但计算成本高达2-10倍；现有缓存加速方法在保持质量的同时可能破坏验证器排名，但尚无研究系统评估缓存对候选排序的影响。
AI.method: 1）首次系统研究缓存对视频测试时搜索中候选排序的影响，发现Spearman秩相关中位数为0.905，top-1一致率72%；2）提出CachedSearch：先用激进缓存探索所有候选，再以完整计算重新生成胜出者；3）引入轨迹中剪枝进一步降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在N=8时以63%成本捕获94.7%收益；等预算下搜索两倍宽度获得38%更多收益；轨迹中剪枝实现3.11倍加速且保持88.6%捕获率；跨6个模型、4个系列（Wan/LTX/CogVideoX/Hunyuan）验证有效。
AI.conclusion: CachedSearch是训练无关、验证器无关、搜索算法正交的即插即用乘数因子，可有效扩展测试时计算；缓存排序错误集中在几乎平局的候选中，具有自限性；性能跟踪架构而非参数量。

title: An Ontology for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate quantum-mechanical energies and forces---conventionally computed by density functional theory (DFT) or wave-function methods---at a fraction of the cost. The field encompasses a growing ecosystem of algorithms, training datasets, hyperparameters, and target materials, yet the metadata needed to systematically compare, reproduce, and build upon MLIP studies remains scattered across papers, scripts, and ad-hoc file formats. We present the MLIPs ontology, an OWL 2 DL ontology that captures the concepts needed to describe MLIP methods, their hyperparameters, training datasets with DFT provenance, and published benchmarks. The ontology is organized into three modules---Method, Training Data, and Benchmark---and connects existing ontologies in materials science (MDO, CMSO/ASMO) and machine learning (ML-Schema), complementing dataset-side schemas such as Croissant. It declares 27 formal axioms enforcing data completeness and consistency, including property chains that link trained models to their methods and training data. We demonstrate the ontology through a running example based on Moment Tensor Potentials and evaluate it through competency-question execution on a 20-paper seeded knowledge graph, OWL reasoning, and comparison with existing ontologies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MLIPs本体论，一个用于描述机器学习原子间势方法、超参数、训练数据集和基准测试的OWL 2 DL本体论，包含方法、训练数据和基准三个模块，并通过27个形式化公理确保数据完整性和一致性。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势领域快速发展，但描述MLIP研究所需的元数据分散在不同论文、脚本和临时文件格式中，缺乏系统性比较、复现和构建研究的标准化框架。
AI.method: 构建了基于OWL 2 DL的MLIPs本体论，包含方法、训练数据和基准三个模块，连接现有的材料科学本体论(MDO, CMSO/ASMO)和机器学习本体论(ML-Schema)，声明27个形式化公理（包括属性链），并通过矩张量势案例、20篇论文的知识图谱、OWL推理和本体论对比进行验证。
AI.result: 成功构建了MLIPs本体论，能够系统化描述MLIP方法的元数据，通过27个形式化公理确保数据完整性和一致性，并在20篇论文的知识图谱上通过能力问题测试验证了其实用性。
AI.conclusion: MLIPs本体论为机器学习原子间势领域的元数据标准化提供了可行框架，有助于促进该领域研究的系统性比较、复现和进一步发展。

title: Long-Tailed Medical Image Classification
summary: In this paper, we examine the difficulties of using standard techniques for medical image classification due to long-tailed distributions (wherein rarer conditions have very few samples) resulting in bias towards diagnosing common diseases and away from rarer diseases. We then discuss and implement deep learning models with techniques such as augmentation to minimize error, especially from rarer diseases. We evaluate various different models with AP, F1 score, AUROC, and loss (all on the validation set). We conclude with the promising results from our best model, and potential applications in the healthcare space.

AI.tldr: 本文针对医学图像分类中长尾分布导致的罕见病诊断偏差问题，采用深度学习和数据增强技术，在验证集上以AP、F1、AUROC和损失值评估模型，最终模型表现优异，具有医疗应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 标准医学图像分类技术在长尾分布（罕见病样本极少）下存在对常见病的诊断偏好，导致对罕见病的识别偏差，亟需解决该不平衡问题。
AI.method: 采用深度学习模型，结合数据增强等技巧，旨在降低模型误差（尤其是对罕见病的误判），并在验证集上通过AP、F1分数、AUROC和损失函数进行多维度评估。
AI.result: 最佳模型在验证集上取得了有前景的结果，各项指标表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法有效缓解了长尾分布带来的罕见病诊断偏差，最佳模型在医疗领域具有实际应用价值。

title: Characterisation of Density-based FM generation methods in the context of Information Fusion
summary: Fuzzy Integral (FI) based aggregation provides a powerful mechanism for nuanced aggregation, for example, in ensemble approaches or decision-level fusion more generally. The main challenge of this approach is the appropriate parametrization of the Fuzzy Measure (FM), which captures the worths of the individual components--and their combinations--which are being fused. Here, widely used approaches including the Sugeno-$λ$ and Decomposable FMs, parametrize the FM by extrapolating from the densities, i.e. the weights associated with individual sources, while respecting the FM's monotonicity constraint. This paper articulates that this information is, in general, insufficient to uniquely identify a discrete FM; but shows how an interval-valued FM can indeed be determined uniquely. We proceed to show how the incorporation of additional information beyond the above, such as the choice of a specific FI and a dataset, then allows for obtaining even more specific interval-valued FMs. In practice, establishing the quality of an empirically determined FM is not trivial. To help address this, we show how the likelihood with which a resulting interval FM encompasses the `ideal', i.e. the commonly intangible, best, or ground-truth numeric FM, can be determined, producing a confidence interval at a given confidence level. Finally, based on a series of experiments, we demonstrate empirically that the Choquet FI output based on this FM can also be regarded as the confidence interval for the `ideal' information fusion result, providing a novel means to characterize FI fusion outcomes a priori and charting a pathway for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文指出仅靠密度参数（单个来源权重）不足以唯一确定模糊测度（FM），但可以唯一确定区间值FM；进一步结合额外信息（如特定模糊积分和数据集）可获得更具体的区间值FM；并展示了如何确定所得区间FM包含"理想"数值FM的置信度，实验表明基于此FM的Choquet积分输出也可视为理想融合结果的置信区间。
AI.motivation: 模糊积分聚合的关键挑战在于模糊测度的适当参数化，而现有方法（如Sugeno-λ和可分解FM）仅从密度外推参数，但这一信息通常不足以唯一确定离散FM，需要更严谨的数学刻画和不确定性量化方法。
AI.method: 1) 理论证明仅靠密度信息无法唯一确定离散FM，但可唯一确定区间值FM；2) 引入额外信息（特定FI和数据集）进一步缩小区间值FM；3) 提出确定区间FM包含理想数值FM的概率方法，构建置信区间；4) 通过实验验证Choquet积分输出可作为理想融合结果的置信区间。
AI.result: 1) 密度信息不足以唯一确定离散FM；2) 区间值FM可被唯一确定；3) 额外信息可进一步细化区间值FM；4) 可计算区间FM包含理想FM的置信度；5) 实验表明基于此FM的Choquet积分输出可作为理想融合结果的置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 本文为模糊测度参数化提供了一种新的不确定性量化框架，通过区间值FM和置信区间刻画，为信息融合结果提供了先验表征手段，开辟了未来研究方向。

title: Embeddings based Anomaly Detection for Cleaning Global Crop Type Reference Datasets
summary:
High quality reference data remain a critical bottleneck for crop-type mapping at any spatial and temporal scale. Operational systems such as WorldCereal aggregate labels from heterogeneous sources such as parcel registers, national databases, field surveys, and map-derived products, each with their own biases, coverage gaps and unknown label noise. Simple global rules are inadequate, since crop phenology and observation conditions vary strongly across regions and seasons.
  In this study, we focus on a single, operationally relevant question: whether embeddings produced through geospatial foundation models are a viable basis for cleaning the reference data. We propose a practical, locality-aware, embedding-based anomaly (EBA) detection framework that operates on the embeddings of a pretrained Earth-observation encoder. We score each labelled sample against other samples of the same crop in the same area using a pretrained embedding, flag the ones that stand out, and test whether removing or down-weighting them before training yields a better model.
  We establish that the flagged points are genuinely mislabelled or misplaced in two independent ways: against synthetic ground truth, the detector concentrates injected label errors 2.5-5x above chance in its flagged set (detection AUROC up to 0.84); and on real data, a model-independent test shows that removing or confidence-weighting the flagged held-out points raises measured accuracy in trained models, for both crop type and land cover. Acting on the flags then improves the WorldCereal crop-type model across five macro-regions, evaluated on a fixed held-out split under three views. We find conservative cleaning helps while over-cleaning hurts.
  The EBA detector approach is designed to be reproducible and extensible, and can serve as a template for cleaning large, noisy Earth observation reference datasets beyond crop mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于地理空间基础模型嵌入的异常检测（EBA）框架，用于清洗作物类型映射中的噪声参考数据。通过在预训练编码器嵌入空间中检测同一作物在同一区域的异常样本，并移除或降权这些标记样本，可提升WorldCereal模型在五个宏观区域的分类精度。合成数据验证显示检测器集中注入标签错误的能力是随机水平的2.5-5倍（AUROC达0.84），真实数据上模型无关测试也证实了清洗的有效性，但过度清洗会降低性能。
AI.motivation: 高质量参考数据是作物类型映射的关键瓶颈。现有操作化系统（如WorldCereal）聚合的标签来自多种异构来源（地块登记、国家数据库、实地调查、地图衍生数据等），各自存在偏差、覆盖缺口和未知的标签噪声。简单的全局规则因作物物候和观测条件在不同区域和季节的强烈变化而不适用。因此，亟需一种有效的数据清洗方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种位置感知的、基于嵌入的异常检测（EBA）框架。该方法利用预训练的地球观测编码器生成的嵌入，对每个标注样本与同一区域同作物的其他样本进行比较打分，标记出异常样本。在训练前移除或降权这些标记样本，并评估模型性能变化。通过两种方式验证：1）合成数据上检测注入标签错误的能力；2）真实数据上模型无关的准确性测试。
AI.result: 合成数据上，EBA检测器集中注入标签错误的能力是随机水平的2.5-5倍，检测AUROC高达0.84。真实数据上，移除或置信度加权标记样本可提升作物类型和土地覆盖分类的准确性。在WorldCereal作物类型模型五个宏观区域的固定留出集上，保守清洗有效，过度清洗有害。
AI.conclusion: EBA检测器方法可复现、可扩展，可作为清洗大规模噪声地球观测参考数据的模板，应用范围可超越作物映射领域。适度的保守清洗有助于提升模型性能，但过度清洗会带来负面影响。

title: CAPT: A Multi-task Continuous Autoregressive Transformer enabling Cross-dataset and Cross-species Transfer for Calcium Population Dynamics
summary: Large-scale calcium imaging has created an opportunity to build foundation-style models for neural population dynamics, but a central question remains unresolved: \textbf{whether a model pretrained on one collection of recordings can generalize to new datasets, experimental paradigms, and even species.} Existing approaches are often designed for specific tasks and evaluated on a single dataset, making it unclear whether their learned representations are reusable for new calcium trace datasets. To tackle this gap, we present \textbf{CAPT}, a \textbf{C}ontinuous \textbf{A}utoregressive \textbf{P}opulation \textbf{T}ransformer for calcium population dynamics. CAPT models continuous calcium traces directly through a continuous patch tokenization strategy and is trained autoregressively, enabling end-to-end pretraining and adaptation to diverse downstream tasks. We first pretrain CAPT on a large-scale mouse calcium imaging dataset and evaluate its transferability across independent mouse, larval zebrafish, and \textit{C. elegans} datasets collected by different laboratories. In these transfer settings, the pretrained backbone is frozen and only adaptation modules are updated. Across neural population forecasting and behavior decoding tasks, CAPT consistently outperforms specialized and general-purpose baselines. Alongside predictive performance, multimodal analyses using NeuroPAL annotations in \textit{C. elegans} datasets show that CAPT embeddings form a shared functional space across datasets and capture anatomical cell-identity-related structure. These results suggest that the continuous autoregressive modeling opens up possibilities for a simple route towards general-purpose neural foundation models for calcium imaging, which can generalize across datasets, experimental paradigms, and species.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAPT，一个基于连续自回归的群体神经元Transformer模型，通过在大规模小鼠钙成像数据上预训练，能够泛化到不同物种（小鼠、斑马鱼、线虫）和实验范式的钙成像数据集，在神经活动预测和行为解码任务上超越专门模型，且其嵌入空间具有跨数据集的共享功能结构。
AI.motivation: 现有钙成像分析方法通常针对特定任务和单一数据集设计，缺乏可迁移的预训练模型。核心问题是：能否构建一个在多个数据集上预训练的模型，使其泛化到新的数据集、实验范式甚至不同物种。
AI.method: 提出CAPT（Continuous Autoregressive Population Transformer），采用连续patch分词策略直接建模连续钙成像迹线，通过自回归方式进行端到端预训练。预训练后冻结主干网络，仅更新适配模块以迁移到下游任务。
AI.result: 在跨小鼠、斑马鱼幼虫和线虫数据集的迁移场景中，CAPT在神经群体预测和行为解码任务上一致优于专门化模型和通用基线。利用线虫NeuroPAL注释的多模态分析表明，CAPT嵌入形成了跨数据集的共享功能空间，并捕捉了与解剖细胞身份相关的结构。
AI.conclusion: 连续自回归建模为构建通用神经基础模型提供了一条简单路径，所提模型能够跨数据集、实验范式和物种泛化，有望成为钙成像领域的通用基础模型框架。

title: SimBEV2X: A Large-Scale Dataset and Data Generation Tool for Multi-Task Vehicle-to-Everything Cooperative Perception
summary: Cooperative perception through vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication can overcome the inherent physical limitations of individual autonomous vehicles, such as occlusions and limited sensor range. However, the development of robust V2X algorithms, particularly those relying on unified spatial representations like bird's-eye view (BEV) representation, is hampered by the lack of large-scale, multi-modal, multi-task datasets. Moreover, collecting and annotating a large set of synchronized, real-world multi-agent data is prohibitively expensive. This has resulted in a landscape where existing V2X datasets are notably limited in both size and scope. To overcome this, we introduce SimBEV2X, an advanced synthetic data generation tool built on the CARLA simulator. SimBEV2X automatically creates randomized driving scenarios to collect multi-modal sensor data alongside various types of ground truth including 3D bounding boxes with unique track IDs, HD map information, BEV segmentation maps, and semantic occupancy voxel grids from both vehicles and RSUs. We also present the SimBEV2X dataset, the largest V2X perception dataset to date. The dataset comprises 258 scenes, each involving up to 8 connected vehicles and up to 4 RSUs across a variety of road networks. The SimBEV2X dataset is an order of magnitude larger than existing V2X datasets and contains 102,200 frames, 588,520 lidar point clouds, more than 3 million images, over 27 million bounding boxes, and a comprehensive set of other annotations. Finally, we establish a strong baseline on the SimBEV2X dataset using CoopDet3D and propose CoBEVFusion, a novel architecture that combines CoopDet3D with fused axial attention (FAX) for context-aware multi-agent feature aggregation, resulting in superior performance. SimBEV2X, the SimBEV2X dataset, and CoBEVFusion are available at https://simbev2x.org and https://github.com/GoodarzMehr/SimBEV2X.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SimBEV2X，一个基于CARLA模拟器的V2X协同感知数据生成工具，并创建了目前最大的V2X感知数据集（258个场景、102,200帧、超过2700万个3D边界框），同时提出了CoBEVFusion架构，通过融合轴向注意力机制实现上下文感知的多智能体特征聚合，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有V2X协同感知数据集在规模和范围上均存在显著不足，同时收集和标注真实世界多智能体同步数据成本过高，阻碍了依赖于统一空间表示（如BEV）的鲁棒V2X算法的发展。
AI.method: 基于CARLA模拟器构建SimBEV2X数据生成工具，自动创建随机化驾驶场景，采集多模态传感器数据及多种真值标注；并设计了CoBEVFusion架构，结合CoopDet3D与融合轴向注意力（FAX）实现上下文感知的多智能体特征聚合。
AI.result: SimBEV2X数据集是目前最大的V2X感知数据集，包含258个场景、最多8辆联网车辆和4个RSU、102,200帧、588,520个点云、超过300万张图像、超过2700万个边界框及多种注释。CoBEVFusion在数据集上取得了最优性能。
AI.conclusion: SimBEV2X有效解决了V2X数据集规模不足的问题，为协同感知研究提供了大规模、多模态、多任务的基准，CoBEVFusion证明了融合轴向注意力在协同感知中的有效性。

title: SeekJudge: A Practical Reward Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Computer-Use Agents
summary: Deciding whether a trajectory actually fulfills its instruction governs how we measure computer-use agents on long-horizon graphical-user-interface tasks and how we train them with reinforcement learning. This judgment has long relied on rule-based evaluation, which struggles to align with human intention and goes stale when an app updates or its online content drifts. Existing model-based judges attempt to address these problems but still leave a performance gap to the rule-based evaluation. We propose the \textbf{SeekJudge} framework, in which four role-specialized agents, a Condense, a Ground, a Seek and an Analyze agent, reach a verdict through a Seek--Analyze loop over the trajectory. A seed-calibrated distillation pipeline trains one specialized $9$B model to serve as the shared backbone for all four agents. Measured by downstream success rate on held-out RL test goals, SeekJudge is the first practical model-based reward to match or surpass native rule-based supervision in online RL. Beyond accuracy, SeekJudge provides step-level judgments, runs far cheaper than a closed-source large model, and keeps a small per-call context that scales to much longer trajectories. We further contribute a general architectural improvement to the reward server that speeds up judging in RL. Together these make model-based reward a practical drop-in for rule-based supervision in CUA reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeekJudge框架，通过四个角色专业化代理（Condense、Ground、Seek、Analyze）组成的Seek-Analyze循环来评判GUI智能体轨迹是否符合指令，并使用种子校准蒸馏管道训练一个共享9B模型作为所有代理的骨干。这是首个在在线强化学习中匹配或超越原生规则监督的实用模型奖励，同时提供步骤级判断、低成本运行和长轨迹扩展能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的规则评估方法难以与人类意图对齐，且在应用更新或内容漂移时失效；现有的基于模型的评判器与规则评估之间仍存在性能差距。需要一种更准确、灵活且实用的模型奖励来替代规则监督。
AI.method: SeekJudge框架包含四个角色专业化代理：Condense（压缩轨迹）、Ground（接地行为）、Seek（搜索相关信息）和Analyze（分析判断），通过Seek-Analyze循环达成裁决。使用种子校准蒸馏管道训练一个9B共享骨干模型。此外，对奖励服务器进行了通用架构改进以加速RL中的评判速度。
AI.result: 在下游RL测试目标的成功率上，SeekJudge是首个匹配或超越原生规则监督的实用模型奖励。它提供步骤级判断，运行成本远低于闭源大模型，且保持较小的每次调用上下文，能够扩展到更长的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: SeekJudge使基于模型的奖励成为CUA强化学习中规则监督的实用替代方案，解决了规则评估的对齐和过时问题，同时保持了实用性。

title: Gaze-to-text Generation: Beyond Categorical Decoding of Human Attention
comment: To appear in European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: We introduce a novel learning problem: decoding gaze into natural language descriptions of human goals across diverse visual tasks. Unlike prior work, which frames gaze decoding as a discriminative task over predefined categories, we formulate it as a generative learning problem: training a model to produce free-form descriptions that capture the rich nuances and open-ended nature of human intentions beyond fixed labels. To this end, we introduce Gazette, the first gaze-to-text decoding framework. Based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Gazette learns to decode gaze scanpaths into natural language for goals that may extend beyond categorical labels and require articulation in natural language. To help Gazette filter out individual differences in gaze behavior and learn the goal-specific spatiotemporal dynamics crucial for generating accurate natural language goal descriptions, we propose a novel strategy that leverages the encyclopedic knowledge and reasoning abilities of a large language model to synthesize natural language explanations of goal-directed attentional behavior called think-aloud transcripts. Instruction tuning on these synthetic narratives allows Gazette to achieve state-of-the-art performance in gaze decoding across multiple tasks, demonstrating its generalizability and versatility, thereby enabling gaze to serve as a powerful, non-intrusive cue for inferring human goals and intentions in diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的学习问题：将人类注视扫描路径解码为描述其目标意图的自然语言描述。为此，作者提出了Gazette框架——首个基于多模态大语言模型的注视到文本解码系统。通过合成"思维发声文本"进行指令微调，Gazette在多项注视解码任务上达到了最先进水平，展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有注视解码研究通常将其建模为预定义类别上的判别式分类任务，无法捕捉人类意图的丰富细微差异和开放式本质。作者希望将注视解码转化为生成式学习问题，使模型能够产生自由形式的文本描述，从而更好地表达人类目标的多样性和开放性。
AI.method: 1) 提出Gazette框架，基于多模态大语言模型将注视扫描路径解码为自然语言。2) 设计一种利用大语言模型的百科全书知识和推理能力来自动合成思维发声文本（think-aloud transcripts）的策略，用于解释目标导向的注意行为。3) 通过这些合成叙事进行指令微调，使Gazette学习过滤个体注视行为差异，捕捉目标特定的时空动态信息。
AI.result: Gazette在多项注视解码任务上取得了最先进的表现，证明了其泛化能力和多功能性，使注视能够作为推断人类目标和意图的强大非侵入性线索。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将注视解码从判别式分类任务转变为生成式自然语言描述任务，提出的Gazette框架有效利用大语言模型的知识来弥补数据不足问题，为基于注视的人类意图推断开辟了新范式。

title: TopoFE: topology-aware LLM-guided Automated Feature Engineering
summary: Automatic feature engineering (AutoFE) for tabular learning can be naturally formulated as a program synthesis problem, where the objective is to discover predictive feature transformations from an exponentially large search space. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded the expressiveness of AutoFE by enabling feature program generation beyond predefined operator libraries. However, existing LLM-based approaches remain fundamentally limited by stateless generation and homogeneous search: feature proposals are produced from static prompts without accumulating search experience, while single-population exploration quickly converges to dominant transformation patterns and rarely discovers complementary feature compositions across transformation families. We propose TOPOFE, a topology-aware multi-island evolutionary framework for LLM-guided feature engineering. TOPOFE combines family-specialized exploration, adaptive prompt memory, and topology-guided knowledge transfer to efficiently discover diverse and compositional feature programs. Experiments on 29 public tabular datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art AutoFE methods across classification and regression tasks. Beyond predictive performance, TOPOFE discovers more diverse and transferable feature programs that generalize across multiple downstream predictors and LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: TOPOFE是一个拓扑感知的多岛屿进化框架，利用LLM进行自动特征工程。它通过家族特化探索、自适应提示记忆和拓扑引导知识迁移，高效发现多样化的特征程序。在29个表格数据集上，TOPOFE在分类和回归任务中持续优于现有AutoFE方法，且发现的程序更具多样性和可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的AutoFE方法受限于无状态生成和同质化搜索：特征提案由静态提示生成，缺乏搜索经验的积累；单种群探索容易收敛到主导变换模式，难以发现跨变换家族的互补特征组合。
AI.method: 提出TOPOFE框架，结合三种核心机制：1) 家族特化探索——按变换家族分配子种群进行专业化搜索；2) 自适应提示记忆——动态积累搜索经验优化后续提案；3) 拓扑引导知识迁移——利用拓扑结构在种群间传递有益知识。
AI.result: 在29个公开表格数据集上，TOPOFE在分类和回归任务中均持续优于现有SOTA AutoFE方法。此外，TOPOFE发现的程序更具多样性和可迁移性，能泛化到多种下游预测器和LLM主干网络上。
AI.conclusion: TOPOFE通过拓扑感知的多岛屿进化框架有效解决了LLM引导AutoFE中的无状态生成和同质化搜索问题，实现了更高效、多样且可迁移的特征工程。

title: What Can I Edit? Open-Ended Strategy Discovery and the Emotion Editability Landscape
summary: Emotional image editing requires more than applying affective filters or modifying predefined visual factors: an effective edit must identify what a particular image can afford for a target emotion. Existing affective image manipulation methods, including recent agentic variants, largely operate within bounded strategy spaces based on predefined factor taxonomies, knowledge libraries, or conventional editing templates, and therefore often miss image-specific, context-grounded strategies. We introduce EmoScope, a multi-agent framework that reframes the task from "how should I edit?" to "what can I edit?" EmoScope first discovers an image-specific editable space through emotion-conditioned affordance reasoning, then uses a semantic hierarchy of anchors, variables, and context to balance content consistency and emotional expressiveness before executing and verifying the edit. Because its plans are expressed as image-specific affordances rather than retrieved templates, EmoScope also exposes the editing strategy as an interactive surface for user refinement at the plan level. In a large-scale human evaluation covering all eight Mikels emotion categories, with 4,693 valid responses across 1,824 pairwise questions, participants preferred EmoScope over two competitive baselines by 88.1% on average. Attribution analysis further shows that EmoScope selects target-emotion-adaptive strategies rather than applying a uniform template. The same affordance-level plan also supports lightweight user refinement in an interactive pilot. Finally, we show that classifier-based metrics exhibit emotion-conditional blind spots toward non-stereotypical, context-grounded edits, and present a relative content-emotion preference-affinity landscape showing that EmoScope's advantage varies systematically across image-emotion combinations.

AI.tldr: EmoScope是一个多智能体框架，通过情感条件式可供性推理发现图像特定的可编辑空间，而非依赖预定义模板或因子分类法。在大规模人类评估中，用户在88.1%的情况下偏好EmoScope胜过两个竞争基线，并且其规划策略具有情感自适应性，而非统一模板。
AI.motivation: 现有情感图像编辑方法局限于预定义因子分类法、知识库或传统编辑模板的策略空间，无法捕捉图像特定、上下文根植的编辑策略。问题在于从"我该如何编辑"出发，而非从"我可以编辑什么"出发。
AI.method: EmoScope采用多智能体框架：(1) 首先通过情感条件式可供性推理发现图像特定的可编辑空间；(2) 利用锚点、变量和上下文的语义层次结构在内容一致性和情感表现力之间取得平衡；(3) 执行并验证编辑。其规划以图像特定的可供性表达，而非检索模板，允许用户在规划层面进行交互式细化。
AI.result: 覆盖全部八种Mikels情感类别的大规模人类评估，包含1,824个配对问题和4,693个有效响应。用户偏好EmoScope胜过两个竞争基线平均达88.1%。归因分析显示EmoScope选择目标情感自适应策略而非统一模板。交互式实验支持轻量级用户细化。此外，发现基于分类器的指标对非刻板印象、上下文根植的编辑存在情感条件性盲点。
AI.conclusion: EmoScope通过可供性驱动的规划框架在情感图像编辑中显著优于现有方法，其优势在图像-情感组合间系统性地变化。同时揭示了现有评估指标在捕捉上下文根植的非刻板情感编辑方面的局限性。

title: RareLens: Towards End-to-End Rare Disease Care via Aligning Divergent Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Rare diseases collectively affect an estimated 3.5% to 5.9% of the population, yet more than 70% of patients are misdiagnosed and many endure years of evaluation before a diagnosis is reached, because early presentations are nonspecific and relevant expertise is scarce and unevenly distributed. Artificial intelligence could provide support, but existing systems address isolated stages of care, overwhelmingly diagnosis. They typically depend on the results of downstream investigations, and they treat the variability between models as noise to be eliminated. Here we present RareLens, a system that supports clinical decision-making across the entire rare disease trajectory by exploiting this variability. When heterogeneous large language models evaluate the same case, they generate divergent but complementary reasoning, which RareLens aligns and calibrates into a single convergent, actionable decision at each stage. Four coordinated modules perform primary-visit risk screening, diagnosis, treatment planning and prognosis. Developed and evaluated on RareBench, a real-world dataset of 157,525 cases spanning all 33 Orphanet categories and more than 7,000 conditions, RareLens outperformed every frontier model tested, including GPT-5, DeepSeek-R1, Claude-3.7-Sonnet and Gemini-2.5-Pro, at each stage. It achieved an area under the curve of 0.917 for screening and top-1 accuracies of 65.5% and 89.8% for diagnosis and treatment. In an external study spanning 1,287 cases and 23 physicians, autonomous RareLens and physicians assisted by RareLens both substantially outperformed unaided physicians. These findings indicate that aligning divergent model reasoning, rather than scaling a single model, offers a generalizable strategy for high-uncertainty clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: RareLens是一个利用大语言模型之间的分歧推理而非消除分歧来支持罕见病全诊疗流程（筛查、诊断、治疗、预后）的AI系统。在15.7万例真实数据上，它全面超越GPT-5等前沿模型，筛查AUC达0.917，诊断Top-1准确率65.5%，治疗准确率89.8%。外部研究显示，自主RareLens和医生辅助RareLens均显著优于无辅助医生。结果表明，对齐多样化模型推理而非扩大单一模型，是高不确定性临床决策的通用策略。
AI.motivation: 罕见病误诊率超过70%，现有AI系统仅覆盖孤立的诊疗环节（主要是诊断），依赖下游检查结果，并将模型间的变异性视为噪声加以消除，无法应对早期非特异性表现和专业知识分布不均的问题。
AI.method: 提出RareLens系统，包含四个协调模块（初诊风险筛查、诊断、治疗计划、预后），利用异构大语言模型评估同一病例时产生的发散但互补的推理，通过对齐和校准将这些分歧转化为单一会聚的可操作决策。在RareBench数据集（157,525例，覆盖33个Orphanet类别和7000+疾病）上开发和评估。
AI.result: 在筛查任务上AUC达0.917，诊断Top-1准确率65.5%，治疗Top-1准确率89.8%，全面超越GPT-5、DeepSeek-R1、Claude-3.7-Sonnet和Gemini-2.5-Pro。外部研究（1,287例，23名医生）显示，自主RareLens和医生+ RareLens辅助均显著优于无辅助医生。
AI.conclusion: 对齐多样化模型的分歧推理而非单纯扩大单一模型规模，为高不确定性临床决策提供了一种可泛化的策略。

title: DDVT: Dynamic Dual-level Vision Transformer Fusion Network for Answer Grounding in Visual Question Answering
summary: Answer grounding in visual question answering aims to locate the region from a given natural language question associated with the visual content of an image, which has garnered significant attention due to its practical applications. In this paper, we introduce the Dynamic Dual-level Vision Transformer Fusion Network (DDVT) for answer grounding in visual question answering. Specifically, we propose a question-guided dynamic regional-level module (QGDR) that combines complementary image context through ROI Align and text content, enabling precise localization of text-related visual content. Moreover, we present a cross-modal multi-scale aggregation module (CMA) that enhances feature fusion between pixel-level and region-level features, facilitating the effective localization of visual content associated with grounded answers. Furthermore, we fuse the located visual content with text features to locate the region and provide answers to questions posed about the image. Experimental results demonstrate that our DDVT outperforms state-of-the-art methods on several widely-used benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态双层级视觉Transformer融合网络（DDVT），通过问题引导的动态区域级模块（QGDR）和跨模态多尺度聚合模块（CMA）实现VQA中的答案定位，在多个基准测试上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 视觉问答中的答案定位需要从自然语言问题与图像视觉内容中定位相关区域，具有重要实际应用价值。
AI.method: 提出DDVT网络，包含两个核心模块：(1) 问题引导的动态区域级模块（QGDR），通过ROI Align融合图像上下文和文本内容；(2) 跨模态多尺度聚合模块（CMA），增强像素级与区域级特征的融合。最后将定位的视觉内容与文本特征融合进行答案定位和回答。
AI.result: 在多个广泛使用的基准数据集上，DDVT的性能优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的DDVT网络通过动态双层级视觉Transformer融合机制，有效提升了视觉问答中答案定位的准确率。

title: Ordered Network Analysis of Epistemic Emotions during Collaborative Problem Solving
summary: Investigating how affective states such as confusion and frustration persist and transition during co-situated collaborative problem solving (CPS) is important for understanding the dynamics of epistemic emotions. However, the accurate identification of affective states remain challenging as there is no gold-standard truth in this space. Here, we analyze affective states collected through retrospective cued-recall during an in-person CPS task. Using ordered network analysis (ONA), we examine (1) the overall ordered structure of affective states and how this structure differs across self-caught and probe-caught reporting methods, and (2) what aspects of this ordered structure are emphasized differently in slower and faster groups. We find that ONA reveals differences in persistence and transition patterns that are not apparent from descriptive summaries alone. In particular, we observe a stable epistemic core linking curiosity, optimism, and confusion, with different reporting methods emphasizing different connections among states. An analysis between faster and slower groups show that roles of confusion and disengagement also shift significantly during collaboration, particularly in their relationship to conflict. We interpret our findings in the context of collaboration and discuss their implications in developing AI systems that support CPS.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用有序网络分析（ONA）探讨协作问题解决（CPS）中困惑、沮丧等情感状态的持续与转换模式，发现自我捕捉与探针捕捉两种报告方法揭示了不同的情感连接结构，且快慢速小组在困惑与脱离等状态的角色上存在显著差异，为开发支持CPS的AI系统提供了启示。
AI.motivation: 理解困惑、沮丧等认知情感在合作情境下的动态变化对于揭示协作学习机制至关重要，但情感状态的准确识别缺乏黄金标准，因此需要新的分析方法来揭示情感状态间的有序结构。
AI.method: 采用有序网络分析（ONA）对通过回顾性线索回忆收集的情感状态数据进行分析，比较自我捕捉与探针捕捉两种报告方法下的情感结构差异，并分析快慢速小组在情感转换模式上的不同。
AI.result: ONA揭示了描述性统计无法体现的情感持续与转换模式差异；存在由好奇心、乐观和困惑构成的稳定认知情感核心；不同报告方法强调了不同的情感连接；快慢速小组在困惑和脱离与冲突的关系上呈现显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 有序网络分析能够有效揭示协作情境下认知情感的结构性特征，其发现对于设计支持协作问题解决的AI系统具有重要指导意义。

title: DuoAD: Leveraging [CLS] Dual Characteristics for Training-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Vision foundation models have enabled strong training-free anomaly detection (AD). However, most existing approaches rely primarily on independent local patch features, leaving the global contextual information encoded by Vision Transformers (ViTs) underexploited. In this work, we identify the dual characteristics of the ViT [CLS] token: its embedding provides anomaly-invariant global semantic representation, while its attention maps implicitly highlight spatially abnormal regions. Building on this observation, we propose a fully automated AD framework leveraging global context to remove manual tunings. Our framework introduces (1) an automatic augmentation selection strategy driven by [CLS]-level semantic consistency, and (2) an attention-guided feature reweighting mechanism that dynamically adjusts patch contributions according to [CLS] attention saliency. By integrating these components over multi-level features, our method achieves stable anomaly scoring and precise localization without training or parameter tuning. Under the one-shot setting, it achieves Image-AUC scores of 97.7%, 93.2%, and 84.5% on MVTec-AD, VisA, and Real-IAD. Using a single fixed configuration across categories, backbones, and datasets, the method establishes a new state-of-the-art for plug-and-play, training-free anomaly detection while maintaining strong robustness and practical scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种完全自动化的免训练异常检测框架，利用ViT的[CLS]令牌的双重特性（全局语义不变性和注意力图异常区域高亮），通过自动增强选择和注意力引导特征重加权，在多种数据集上实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉基础模型的异常检测方法主要依赖独立局部块特征，未能充分利用ViT编码的全局上下文信息，且通常需要手动调参。
AI.method: 提出一个全自动AD框架：(1) 基于[CLS]级语义一致性的自动增强选择策略；(2) 注意力引导的特征重加权机制，根据[CLS]注意力显著性动态调整块贡献；在多层特征上整合上述组件。
AI.result: 在一样本设置下，MVTec-AD、VisA和Real-IAD上分别取得97.7%、93.2%和84.5%的Image-AUC。在类别、骨干网络和数据集间使用单一固定配置，实现即插即用、免训练且鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 该方法建立了即插即用、免训练异常检测的新SOTA，同时保持强鲁棒性和实际可扩展性。

title: ESF-Bench: Benchmarking Challenging Slot-Filling Scenarios for Real-World Enterprise Applications
summary: The rapid rise of large language models (LLMs) has driven transformative adoption across enterprises. However, deploying these models in real-world settings presents unique challenges due to complex system constraints and unexpected user behaviors. Among these applications, slot filling is essential for converting unstructured input into structured, actionable data. In this work, we introduce ESF-Bench, a challenging Enterprise Slot Filling benchmark consisting of 810 multi-turn samples and 6530 slots over 8 unique domains. Curated using a taxonomy of the 57 most challenging slot-filling scenarios observed during real-world enterprise deployments, ESF-Bench exposes notable limitations in current state-of-the-art LLMs, with GPT-OSS-120b low successfully extracting slots for only 20.7% of benchmark samples. To support continued research in this area, we publicly release the benchmark dataset, taxonomy, and accompanying evaluation code on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ESF-Bench，一个包含810个多轮样本和6530个槽位的企业级槽位填充基准测试，涵盖8个领域和57种最具挑战性的场景。实验表明，当前最先进的LLM（如GPT-OSS-120b）仅能成功提取20.7%的样本槽位，揭示了现有模型在企业级槽位填充任务中的显著局限性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在企业实际部署中面临系统约束复杂和用户行为不可预期等挑战，而槽位填充作为将非结构化输入转换为结构化可操作数据的关键任务，其性能瓶颈尚未得到系统性的评估和基准测试。
AI.method: 基于真实企业部署中观察到的57种最具挑战性的槽位填充场景构建分类体系，并据此创建了涵盖8个独特领域、810个多轮样本和6530个槽位的ESF-Bench基准数据集。
AI.result: 当前最先进的LLM（GPT-OSS-120b）在ESF-Bench上仅成功提取了20.7%的样本槽位，表现显著不足。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在企业级槽位填充任务中存在明显局限性，ESF-Bench可作为推动该方向研究的重要基准。数据集、分类体系和评估代码已公开。

title: Manifold-Constrained Noise Optimization for Diverse Diffusion Sampling
summary: Few-step distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images quickly, but often lose per-prompt diversity, producing near-identical samples across random seeds. Optimizing the initial noise at inference time offers an appealing way to recover this diversity, yet existing methods directly update the initial noise in an unconstrained Euclidean space, ignoring both the geometry of the Gaussian prior and the model's sensitivity to noise frequencies. They therefore introduce auxiliary quality-control objectives to maintain generation fidelity, adding compute and weighting hyperparameters while still requiring conservative updates to prevent degradation. In this work, we propose MoNO, a training-free method that performs Manifold-constrained Noise Optimization on a low-dimensional, quality-stabilizing noise manifold. MoNO sequentially optimizes each new initial noise so that its predicted visual feature complements previous generations, while Riemannian updates on an affine low-frequency sphere preserve prior likelihood and fix unstable high-frequency components by construction. This enables large geodesic steps, removes the need for auxiliary quality-control objectives, and converges in far fewer iterations than prior noise-optimization methods. Experiments with multiple distilled text-to-image diffusion models show that MoNO consistently improves per-prompt diversity while maintaining image quality.

AI.tldr: MoNO是一种无需训练的方法，通过在低维、质量稳定的噪声流形上进行黎曼优化，为少步蒸馏扩散模型恢复每提示生成多样性，同时保持图像质量，无需辅助质量控制目标。
AI.motivation: 少步蒸馏扩散模型虽能快速生成高质量图像，但每提示多样性严重缺失，不同随机种子下产生近乎相同的样本。现有推理时噪声优化方法忽略了高斯先验的几何结构和模型对噪声频率的敏感性，需要引入辅助质量控制目标，增加了计算开销和超参数调优负担。
AI.method: MoNO：1) 构建一个低维、质量稳定的噪声流形（仿射低频球面）；2) 在该流形上进行黎曼优化，顺序优化每个初始噪声，使其预测视觉特征与前序生成互补；3) 黎曼更新天然保持先验似然并固定不稳定高频分量；4) 允许大步长测地线更新，无需辅助质量控制目标。
AI.result: 在多个蒸馏文本到图像扩散模型上的实验表明，MoNO一致性地提升了每提示多样性，同时保持了生成图像质量，且收敛所需的迭代次数远少于先前的噪声优化方法。
AI.conclusion: MoNO通过流形约束的噪声优化，在无需训练和无需辅助目标的情况下，有效恢复了蒸馏扩散模型的生成多样性，为推理时多样性增强提供了一种高效、简洁的解决方案。

title: Confidently Wrong: Exception Chain Collapse in Frontier LLM Rule Evaluation
comment: 43 pages, 9 figures. Working paper v3.13.0. Benchmark data, rule encodings and per-case result artefacts: https://github.com/Aethis-ai/confidently-wrong-benchmark
summary: We document a failure class in frontier large language models -- exception chain collapse -- observed in eligibility evaluation under nested conditional rules of the form "A is required UNLESS B applies, UNLESS C overrides B". The failure reproduces at first observation, but its empirical surface is unstable: between March and April 2026 several failure cells closed silently under the same model alias, with no version bump (GPT-5.4 on construction insurance moved from 96.6% to 100%, same prompt and harness). For regulated workflows, frontier-model accuracy is a moving compliance boundary that shifts without notice. We present the Aethis Eligibility Module, a neuro-symbolic architecture in which LLMs author rules from authoritative sources and an SMT-based layer executes them deterministically, consistent with the authored specification regardless of model drift, reasoning-effort defaults, or prompt format. Three evidence bases: (i) a controlled benchmark of 225 scenarios across four regulatory domains documents the pattern and, in replication, the drift that partially closed it; (ii) a 20-scenario adversarial extension on construction insurance, where the engine scores 20/20, as does one of four frontier configurations (GPT-5.4 at low reasoning effort), while the other three, including Anthropic's strongest model at evaluation time, fail the same coverage-gap edge case; (iii) external validation on nine peer-reviewed LegalBench tasks, 949 held-out cases, where the engine is significantly more accurate than all three frontier models (combined McNemar's p <= 0.003), with margins up to +41 points on the curated multi-prong tasks against the Anthropic models. The contribution is to relocate uncertainty from the inference boundary, where it is silent, to the specification boundary, where it is deliberate and audited. All scenarios, rule encodings, and results are public and reproducible.

AI.tldr: 本文发现前沿大语言模型在嵌套条件规则下的"异常链崩溃"故障，并提出Aethis Eligibility Module——一种神经符号架构，由LLM从权威来源编写规则、SMT层确定性执行，将不确定性从推理边界迁移到规范边界。在225个场景基准、20个对抗性测试及949个LegalBench任务上验证，该引擎显著优于三个前沿模型，最高领先41个百分点。
AI.motivation: 前沿大语言模型在嵌套条件规则（如"除非B适用，除非C覆盖B"）的资格评估中存在系统性的"异常链崩溃"故障，且模型精度会在无版本更新的情况下悄然变化（如GPT-5.4在建筑保险领域从96.6%升至100%），这对监管合规工作流构成了隐秘的合规边界漂移风险。
AI.method: 提出Aethis Eligibility Module神经符号架构：LLM从权威来源编写规则，SMT（可满足性模理论）层确定性执行规则，确保输出与编写规范一致，不受模型漂移、推理努力默认值或提示格式影响。
AI.result: 三个证据基础：(i) 225个场景的受控基准记录了故障模式及部分自愈的漂移；(ii) 20个对抗性场景中引擎得分20/20，仅一个前沿配置（GPT-5.4低推理努力）同样满分，其他三个前沿模型（含Anthropic最强模型）均失败；(iii) 949个LegalBench任务中引擎显著优于三个前沿模型（McNemar p<=0.003），最高领先41个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于将不确定性从沉默的推理边界迁移到可审计的规范边界，使不确定性变得可控、可审且可复现。所有场景、规则编码和结果均已公开。

title: TimePLE: Rethinking Temporal Representation for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Video temporal grounding (VTG) aims to localize the continuous video interval described by a natural-language query. However, current VLM-based methods typically produce this interval indirectly through two endpoint outputs, represented either as discrete timestamp tokens or continuous boundary coordinates. These formulations differ in how endpoints are encoded, but not in what is predicted: the event interval remains a derived object, while interval validity, duration, and interval-level similarity are handled only implicitly. We propose TimePLE, which reformulates VTG from endpoint prediction to interval-native grounding by predicting a single joint distribution over valid temporal intervals. TimePLE maps each interval to a point in a canonical position-duration square, where every support point corresponds to a valid span and neighboring points represent geometrically similar intervals. Given a video and query, the VLM generates a single latent <|TIMESPAN|> token whose hidden state is decoded into a joint interval distribution, refined through duration-aware coordinate correction, and converted into continuous boundaries. The same interval representation is used to encode input temporal anchors, aligning video-side temporal evidence with output-side span prediction. To reliably align the latent span representation with complete event intervals, we curate 90K-scale grounded samples and human-verify 3K-scale benchmark annotations. Experiments across four VTG benchmarks show that TimePLE consistently outperforms endpoint prediction baselines, achieving an average mIoU of 58.9, with clear gains on short-duration and medium-duration events.

AI.tldr: TimePLE提出了一种新的视频时间定位范式，将传统端点预测（输出起止时间戳或离散token）重构为直接预测完整时间间隔的联合分布。通过将区间映射到规范化的位置-持续时间二维空间，利用单个<|TIMESPAN|>隐层token解码为区间分布，并经过时长感知的坐标校正转换为连续边界。在四个VTG基准上平均mIoU达58.9，在短/中时长事件上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM方法通过预测两个端点（离散token或连续坐标）间接得到事件区间，但区间有效性、持续时间和区间级相似性仅被隐式处理，缺乏对完整时间间隔的直接建模。
AI.method: 1) 将每个时间间隔映射到位置-持续时间正方形空间中的点，相邻点对应几何相似的区间；2) VLM生成单个<|TIMESPAN|>隐层token，解码为联合区间分布；3) 通过时长感知的坐标校正进行精细化处理，转换为连续边界；4) 使用相同的区间表示编码输入时间锚点，对齐视频侧时间证据与输出侧区间预测；5) 构建90K规模的接地样本和人工验证的3K规模基准标注。
AI.result: 在四个VTG基准上，平均mIoU达58.9，一致优于端点预测基线方法，在短时长和中时长事件上增益明显。
AI.conclusion: 直接预测完整时间间隔的联合分布比间接预测端点更有效，该方法能够更好地捕捉区间有效性、持续时间和区间级语义相似性。

title: Key-Interval A*: Accelerating Grid Pathfinding via Structural Abstraction
summary: Existing exact methods for 4-connected grid pathfinding reduce online search, but often either retain fine-grained search states or require substantial preprocessing. This paper presents Key-Interval A* (KIA*), an optimal pathfinding algorithm that uses lightweight preprocessing to construct and search over a compact interval-level abstraction of free space. KIA* represents free space using intervals: maximal contiguous runs of traversable cells. It extracts key intervals that capture structural boundary changes and connects them through contiguous non-key regions. KIA* then performs A*-style search on the resulting key-interval graph and constructively reconstructs grid paths from interval chains, without cell-level local search. We prove the completeness and optimality of KIA* on 4-connected grids. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that KIA* preserves exact shortest-path lengths and achieves the fastest runtime on seven of eight benchmark groups, with the largest gains on structured and game maps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KIA*算法，通过轻量级预处理构建区间级抽象图，在4连通网格上实现最优路径规划，在多个基准测试中达到最快运行速度。
AI.motivation: 现有4连通网格路径规划的最优方法要么保留细粒度搜索状态导致搜索效率低，要么需要大量预处理开销，缺乏一种既能减少在线搜索又不过度依赖预处理的平衡方案。
AI.method: KIA*通过轻量级预处理将自由空间表示为最大连续通行单元格的区间；提取捕获结构边界变化的关键区间，并通过连续非关键区域连接它们；在关键区间图上执行A*风格搜索，从区间链构造性重建网格路径，无需细胞级局部搜索。
AI.result: 在八个标准基准测试组中的七个组上达到最快运行时间，在结构化和游戏地图上增益最大；保持了精确的最短路径长度。
AI.conclusion: KIA*在保持最优性的前提下，通过区间级抽象有效提升了4连通网格路径规划的在线搜索效率，证明了其完备性和最优性。

title: RODR: Riemannian Orthogonally Decoupled Regularization for Disentangled Manifold Representation
summary: Point cloud denoising is essentially a geometric recovery task that aims to reconstruct the intrinsic structure of a smooth 2D Riemannian manifold embedded in R^3 from noisy, discrete ambient-space samples. Despite the remarkable progress of modern manifold-aware encoders and generative transport models in geometric representation learning, a fundamental objective-geometry mismatch remains underexplored. Theoretically, we identified that this mismatched coupling leads to geometric gradient interference, where conflicting optimization objectives result in structural degradation and point clustering. We introduce Riemannian Orthogonally Decoupled Regularization (RODR) to reformulate the optimization trajectory by disentangling the normal (fitting) and tangential (distribution) components. Guided by a vector-attention and entropy-aware adaptive strategy, RODR effectively preserves high-fidelity geometric details while maintaining sampling uniformity. Experiments demonstrate that RODR reaches performance comparable to state-of-the-art baselines and suggests improved distribution regularity and reduced local aggregation effectively. Our work establishes a generic and interpretable framework for disentangled geometric optimization in point cloud processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出黎曼正交解耦正则化（RODR）方法，通过解耦法向（拟合）和切向（分布）优化目标，解决点云去噪中存在的目标-几何失配导致的梯度干扰问题，在保持几何细节的同时提升采样均匀性。
AI.motivation: 现有流形感知编码器和生成传输模型虽在几何表示学习上有进展，但存在目标-几何失配问题，导致几何梯度干扰，进而引发结构退化和点云聚集。作者旨在解决这一未充分探索的耦合失配问题。
AI.method: 提出黎曼正交解耦正则化（RODR），将优化轨迹分解为法向（拟合）分量和切向（分布）分量；结合向量注意力与熵感知自适应策略，实现高保真几何细节保持与采样均匀性的平衡。
AI.result: 实验表明RODR达到与最先进基线相当的性能，在分布正则性和局部聚集减少方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: RODR建立了一个通用且可解释的解耦几何优化框架，有效缓解了点云处理中优化目标冲突导致的几何退化问题。

title: Inference-Time Consensus for Mitigating Hidden Behaviors from LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on even a small amount of poisoned data can install targeted misbehavior, and ostensibly benign data can transmit hidden preferences that generalize broadly. Standard defenses, such as data filtering, mixing in harmless data, and regularization, attenuate these effects but do not eliminate them. We instead pursue robustness through redundancy: collecting multiple datasets from different sources and only learning what is common between them. Thus, if only a subset of sources are malicious, the misbehavior will be blocked. In order to implement this defense strategy, we fine-tune a separate reference model on each source's dataset and aggregate their next-token distributions at decoding time. We introduce two consensus decoders: a token-wise minimum, which caps each token at the lowest probability any source assigns, and a base-relative variant, which reverts to the base probability on any token the sources move in opposing directions. We further relax exact agreement to tolerate partial support across sources and different surface expressions of the same intention. Across controlled poisoning tasks, subliminal learning, and emergent misalignment, consensus decoding suppresses source-specific misbehavior while preserving shared desirable behavior, including cases where union training and weight averaging retain the unwanted behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于冗余的共识解码方法，通过从不同来源收集多个数据集并仅学习共同特征来防御数据投毒。在解码时聚合各来源参考模型的next-token分布，引入两种共识解码器（逐token最小值和基相对变体），有效抑制特定来源的不良行为而保留共享的期望行为。
AI.motivation: 现有防御方法（数据过滤、混合无害数据、正则化）只能减弱但无法消除针对语言模型的投毒攻击影响，需要更鲁棒的防御策略。
AI.method: 提出共识解码框架：(1) 从不同数据源分别训练参考模型；(2) 解码时聚合各模型的next-token分布，引入两种共识解码器——逐token最小值（取各来源最低概率）和基相对变体（当来源意见分歧时回退到基础概率）；(3) 进一步放宽完全一致要求，容忍部分支持和不同表面表达。
AI.result: 在受控投毒任务、潜意识学习和涌现性错误对齐等场景中，共识解码能抑制特定来源的错误行为，同时保留共享的期望行为；而联合训练和权重平均等方法仍会保留不良行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过多源冗余和共识解码可以有效防御数据投毒，即使只有部分来源被恶意控制，也能阻止错误行为的传播。

title: Development of Vision-Language Model-based GNSS Spoofing Detection for Autonomous Vehicle Navigation
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) depend on Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) for localization and navigation, making them vulnerable to spoofing attacks that can covertly redirect vehicles or induce unsafe maneuvers. In this paper, we develop the first Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based framework for GNSS spoofing detection for autonomous vehicles by fusing front-camera visual data with in-vehicle sensor readings (e.g., speed, acceleration, yaw rate) against GNSS-derived maneuvers. Our approach introduces a three-stage fine-tuning process that first grounds visual cues, and then calibrates sensor data within a shared semantic space to detect discrepancies between predicted and GNSS-derived maneuvers across three attack scenarios. We also generated an independent real-world dataset by driving an instrumented vehicle on public roads in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, equipped with time-synchronized GNSS, IMU, and camera logs to validate cross-regional generalization of our fine-tuned model on unseen data from training data. On this dataset, we then generated intelligent spoofing attacks, including trajectory mirroring with road-network snapping for wrong-turn attacks, position freezing for overshoot scenarios, and drift generation for stop attacks. On this validation dataset, the zero-shot VLMs baseline F1-score ranges from 23% to 32%, whereas our fine-tuned model achieves an F1-score ranging from 94% to 95%. Results show that our VLM-based approach correctly classified every wrong-turn and stop attacks, and attains 88%-93% accuracy for overshoot attacks. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive inference policy that reduces VLM invocations to 14% (~86% computational reduction) and yields 65ms-73ms per 4s window. These results point to a practical, on-road layer of defense that complements signal-level integrity checks with the use of VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于视觉-语言模型(VLM)的自动驾驶车辆GNSS欺骗检测框架，通过融合前摄像头视觉数据与车内传感器读数，采用三阶段微调流程检测GNSS导出 maneuvers与预测之间的差异。在真实道路数据集上，微调模型F1分数达94%-95%，相比零样本VLM基线(23%-32%)大幅提升，并引入自适应推理策略将VLM调用降至14%，计算量减少约86%。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆依赖GNSS进行定位导航，易受欺骗攻击（如轨迹镜像、位置冻结、漂移生成），传统信号级完整性检查不足以应对这些攻击。现有方法缺乏对多模态传感器数据的语义融合理解，亟需一种能够结合视觉场景理解与车辆动力学感知的轻量级检测框架。
AI.method: 提出三阶段VLM微调流程：(1)视觉线索接地阶段，对齐视觉特征；(2)传感器数据校准阶段，在共享语义空间中融合车速、加速度、横摆角速度等IMU数据；(3)检测阶段，对比预测与GNSS导出 maneuvers的差异。另设计自适应推理策略，根据检测置信度动态降低VLM调用频率。生成包含轨迹镜像（路网吸附+错误转弯攻击）、位置冻结（过冲场景）、漂移生成（停止攻击）三种智能欺骗攻击的真实道路数据集。
AI.result: 微调模型在验证集上F1分数94%-95%（零样本基线仅23%-32%）；错误转弯和停止攻击分类准确率100%，过冲攻击准确率88%-93%；自适应推理将VLM调用降至14%（计算量减少86%），每4秒窗口推理延迟65-73ms。
AI.conclusion: 基于VLM的多模态融合方法能有效检测GNSS欺骗攻击，自适应推理策略使其具备实际道路部署的可行性。该框架可作为信号级完整性检查的补充防御层，为自动驾驶车辆提供实用的对抗欺骗攻击方案。

title: NeurGO: Learning to Generate Elite Candidates for Meta-Black-Box Expensive Optimization
summary: Expensive black-box optimization is ubiquitous in science and engineering, where function evaluations are costly and the evaluation budget is limited. Traditional evolutionary algorithms and Meta-BlackBox Optimization (MetaBBO) approaches typically consume most evaluations on candidate selection, often wasting precious budget on inferior solutions. Although surrogate-assisted evolution and Bayesian optimization aim to reduce evaluations through surrogate models, constructing an accurate global model from limited data remains challenging, and model bias can easily trap the search in local optima. To overcome these limitations, we propose NeurGO, a generative MetaBBO framework that directly synthesizes elite candidates from historical population states. Specifically, we employ an attention-based encoder to capture the population-level search trend and condition a decoder on this representation to generate high-quality candidates, avoiding the expensive evaluation of large offspring pools. We then design a quality-diversity loss to maintain solution quality and population diversity throughout the search. Through extensive benchmarking on CEC 2008 and the COCO BBOB test suites, our method achieves better optimization performance under the same evaluation budget and exhibits faster convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeurGO，一种生成式元黑箱优化框架，通过注意力编码器学习种群搜索趋势并生成高质量候选解，避免了传统方法在候选评估上的浪费，在CEC 2008和COCO BBOB测试集上取得了更优的优化性能和更快的收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 昂贵黑箱优化中，传统演化算法和元黑箱优化方法将大部分评估预算浪费在次优候选解的选择上；代理模型辅助方法虽试图减少评估次数，但构建精确全局模型困难且易陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 提出NeurGO框架：1) 使用基于注意力的编码器捕获种群级别的搜索趋势；2) 基于该表征条件解码生成高质量候选解；3) 设计质量-多样性损失以同时保持解质量和种群多样性。
AI.result: 在CEC 2008和COCO BBOB测试集上，NeurGO在相同评估预算下取得了更优的优化性能，并表现出更快的收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: NeurGO通过直接合成精英候选解的方式，有效避免了昂贵评估的浪费，验证了生成式方法在元黑箱优化中的有效性。

title: Color Fundus Photography Analysis: Co-evolution of Data, Preprocessing, and Modeling toward Multimodal AI
summary: Color Fundus Photography (CFP) is a primary non-invasive imaging modality for large-scale screening of ophthalmic and systemic diseases. Existing surveys mainly summarize task-specific algorithms, datasets, or preprocessing techniques independently, lacking a unified perspective on their co-evolution with modern artificial intelligence. This review provides an integrated overview of CFP AI through the interplay of dataset evolution, preprocessing paradigms, and modeling frameworks. We show that CFP datasets have evolved from small single-center collections with task-specific labels to large multi-center resources featuring multimodal pairings and longitudinal clinical records. Preprocessing has progressed from conventional image enhancement to neural data-engineering pipelines, hardware-aware token optimization, and self-supervised imputation for incomplete electronic health records (EHRs). Meanwhile, modeling has advanced from convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to vision foundation models, state space models (SSMs), and multimodal expert architectures. At the multimodal frontier, CFP is increasingly integrated with EHRs and longitudinal patient information, enabling more comprehensive clinical reasoning beyond isolated image analysis. We conclude that future progress depends on the collaborative optimization of datasets, preprocessing, and multimodal modeling, providing a roadmap toward robust clinical deployment, improved cross-domain generalization, and resource-efficient edge intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了彩色眼底摄影（CFP）与人工智能协同发展的历程，涵盖数据集从单中心小规模到多中心多模态的演进、预处理从传统图像增强到神经数据工程的升级，以及建模从CNN到视觉基础模型、状态空间模型和多模态专家架构的转变，指出未来需数据集、预处理和多模态建模协同优化以实现稳健临床部署。
AI.motivation: 现有综述孤立地总结任务特定算法、数据集或预处理技术，缺乏从统一视角审视三者与现代人工智能协同演进的全局性分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 以数据集演进、预处理范式、建模框架三者间的相互作用为主线，对CFP AI进行集成性综述。
AI.result: CFP数据集从单中心小规模任务特定标注演变为多中心大规模多模态配对及纵向临床记录；预处理从传统图像增强发展为神经数据工程管道、硬件感知令牌优化及面向不完整电子健康记录的自我监督插补；建模从CNN演进至视觉基础模型、状态空间模型和多模态专家架构。
AI.conclusion: 未来进步依赖于数据集、预处理和多模态建模的协同优化，为稳健临床部署、跨域泛化提升及资源高效的边缘智能提供路线图。

title: Separating Capability from Permission: A Governance Framework for Agentic AI Autonomy Levels
summary: As AI systems increasingly exhibit agentic behavior, discussions of autonomy often conflate what systems are technically capable of doing with what they should be permitted to do in practice. This paper introduces a governance framework that explicitly separates Allowed Autonomy Levels (AAL), which define the degree of autonomy an AI agent is authorized to exercise given risk, oversight, and accountability considerations, from Autonomous Capability Levels (ACL), which characterize an agent's inherent technical abilities. We present a structured set of autonomy levels spanning reactive execution, decision support, supervised action, goal-directed autonomy, and delegated operational authority, and describe how control, reversibility, and accountability change as autonomy increases. To operationalize this framework, we propose a risk-aware decision process for assigning allowed autonomy, analyze how risk and accountability evolve across autonomy levels, and demonstrate its application through a deployed enterprise data engineering agent, illustrating how a system assessed at a high capability level can be deliberately constrained to a lower allowed autonomy based on risk, reversibility, and organizational readiness. By distinguishing authorization from capability, this work provides practical guidance for the design, deployment, and governance of Agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个AI治理框架，明确区分了"允许自主级别"（AAL，基于风险、监督和问责的授权程度）和"自主能力级别"（ACL，技术能力水平），并通过企业数据工程代理的案例展示了如何将高能力系统约束到更低的允许自主级别。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统日益表现出代理性行为，但关于自主性的讨论常常混淆了技术能力与应被允许的操作范围，缺乏明确的治理区分。
AI.method: 提出了AAL与ACL分离的治理框架，定义了从反应式执行到委托操作权限的自主性级别，并描述了控制、可逆性和问责性在各级别中的变化。在此基础上设计了风险感知的决策流程来分配允许自主性。
AI.result: 通过一个实际部署的企业数据工程代理案例，展示了系统在评估为高能力级别时如何基于风险、可逆性和组织准备度被有意约束到较低的允许自主级别。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分授权与能力，该框架为Agentic AI系统的设计、部署和治理提供了实践指导。

title: Mutual Modality Trust with Lightweight Reconstruction Regularization for Fine-grained Tire Pattern Recognition
summary: Visual tire recognition serves as a core supporting technique for vehicle safety monitoring, autonomous driving perception and automated automotive maintenance. Existing fine-grained tire recognition techniques suffer from three prominent limitations. They tend to depend on only one visual source, lack the capacity to jointly model spatial and frequency cues for minute tread texture extraction, and suffer severe overfitting given limited annotated tire imagery. This paper proposes a lightweight fine-grained tire pattern recognition method incorporating dual-branch independent inference and enhanced feature fusion to boost recognition performance. The framework employs two task-specialized branches dedicated to tire surface and tread indentation, respectively, to extract modality-specific discriminative features. Each branch conducts independent prediction, while cross-branch feature fusion exploits Mutual Modality Trust (M$^2$T) to realize complementary feature enhancement across two modalities. Besides, a frequency-domain hierarchical guidance module is devised, which leverages bandpass filters to decompose feature maps into high- and low-frequency components and enables fine-grained cross-layer feature modulation. Furthermore, a Lightweight Reconstruction Regularization (LR$^2$) is introduced to retain abundant intrinsic information within feature embeddings, substantially improving feature stability and recognition robustness under limited labeled training data. In addition, we establish a surface-indentation multi-source dataset namely MTire299 for fine-grained tire tread recognition, which covers 299 categories with a total of 14795 paired image samples. Extensive experiments conducted on two public tire datasets validate the superiority and efficacy of the proposed algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级细粒度轮胎花纹识别方法，采用双分支独立推理架构（胎面与胎纹凹痕）、互信模态融合（M²T）、频域分层引导模块及轻量重建正则化（LR²），并在自建多源数据集MTire299上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度轮胎识别技术存在三大局限：仅依赖单一视觉源、缺乏联合建模空间与频率线索的能力、在有限标注数据下严重过拟合。本文旨在解决这些问题，提升轮胎识别性能。
AI.method: 提出轻量级双分支独立推理框架：1) 两个任务专用分支分别处理胎面和胎纹凹痕，提取模态特定判别特征；2) 跨分支特征融合采用互信模态融合（M²T）实现互补增强；3) 频域分层引导模块利用带通滤波器分解高低频分量，实现细粒度跨层特征调制；4) 轻量重建正则化（LR²）在有限标注下保持特征稳定性。
AI.result: 构建了MTire299数据集（299类别，14795对图像），在两个公开轮胎数据集上的大量实验验证了算法的优越性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 双分支独立推理结合多维度特征增强（频域调制、模态互信融合、重建正则化）能有效提升细粒度轮胎识别性能，同时保持模型轻量化。

title: Do LLMs Know Their Vulnerable Scenarios?
summary: Safety-aligned large language models are trained to refuse harmful requests, yet embedding the same requests in particular scenarios can bypass their safeguards. Existing red-teaming methods empirically identify effective scenarios through observed attack outcomes, but why particular scenarios weaken refusal remains mechanistically unclear. Meanwhile, mechanistic interpretability studies have characterized both refusal directions and jailbreak-associated features, without explaining the relationship between the two representations. In this work, we show that scenario-wrapped prompts activate internal scenario directions whose causal steering consistently reduces refusal scores. Building on this finding, we propose \textsc{Concept2Scenario}, a concept-based attribution framework for vulnerable scenario discovery. It instantiates a broad concept space with a sparse autoencoder, attributes refusal suppression to individual concepts, translates the identified concepts into interpretable natural-language scenarios, and identifies synergistic scenario combinations through interaction attribution. Across three open-source models, two safety benchmarks, and six black-box jailbreak methods, the discovered scenarios serve as reusable priors that improve average attack success rates by up to $18.2$ percentage points. They also transfer to GPT-5, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and Gemini-3-Flash, suggesting that some scenario-level refusal vulnerabilities are shared across model families. Moreover, the identified combinations outperform their individual constituents and enable iterative attacks to succeed in fewer turns.

AI.tldr: 本文发现安全对齐的LLM在面对特定场景包裹的请求时，其内部会激活场景方向（scenario directions），这些方向会因果性地抑制拒绝（refusal）响应。作者提出Concept2Scenario框架，利用稀疏自编码器将概念空间实例化，通过归因识别导致拒绝抑制的概念，将其转化为可解释的自然语言场景，并通过交互归因发现场景组合。在三个开源模型、两个安全基准和六种黑盒越狱方法上，发现的场景可将平均攻击成功率提升最高18.2个百分点，且泛化到GPT-5、Claude-Haiku-4.5和Gemini-3-Flash等闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有红队测试方法虽然能经验性地发现有效攻击场景，但缺乏对场景为何削弱拒绝机制的因果理解。同时，机械可解释性研究分别刻画了拒绝方向（refusal directions）和越狱相关特征，但未解释这两种表征之间的关系。本文旨在填补这一空白，从因果机制层面理解场景包裹如何抑制模型的拒绝行为。
AI.method: 1）发现场景包裹提示会激活内部场景方向，其因果干预可降低拒绝分数；2）提出Concept2Scenario框架：利用稀疏自编码器实例化宽泛的概念空间，通过概念归因识别拒绝抑制概念，将概念翻译为可解释场景，并通过交互归因发现协同场景组合。
AI.result: 在三个开源模型、两个安全基准和六种黑盒越狱方法上，发现的场景作为可重用先验，将平均攻击成功率提升最高18.2个百分点，且这些场景能迁移到GPT-5、Claude-Haiku-4.5和Gemini-3-Flash等不同模型家族的闭源模型。场景组合优于单个场景，并能减少迭代攻击所需轮数。
AI.conclusion: 场景级别的拒绝漏洞在跨模型家族间具有共享性，本文从因果机制层面揭示了场景如何抑制模型拒绝行为，并提供了可泛化的场景发现方法论。

title: Multimodal Semantic-Probabilistic Objectness for Open World Object Detection
summary: Open-world object detection (OWOD) requires a detector to recognize known categories, discover unnamed objects from unseen categories, and incrementally learn newly annotated classes. PROB improves unknown discovery by modeling class-agnostic probabilistic objectness in the decoder-query space. However, visual objectness alone cannot determine whether an object-like query corresponds to a hard known instance, an unseen-category object, or background clutter, resulting in an ambiguous known-unknown decision boundary. We propose MSPO, a lightweight semantic calibration framework that augments PROB with task-aware known-category language priors while preserving its detector architecture and incremental learning protocol. For each currently known category, MSPO constructs an extended text description covering category attributes, visual appearance, typical scenes, and functional usage, and encodes it using a frozen CLIP text encoder. Decoder query features are projected into the same semantic space to estimate their support from the current known-category semantics. This semantic evidence is fused with PROB's visual objectness to calibrate known and unknown predictions without turning OWOD into open-vocabulary classification. Importantly, MSPO never uses future-category names, and all unseen categories remain unnamed during evaluation. Experiments on M-OWODB and S-OWODB show that MSPO improves the strong PROB baseline on the main aggregate metrics while retaining competitive unknown recall. It also improves early unknown-confusion metrics and raises PASCAL VOC final mAP by up to 2.7 points. These results demonstrate that known-category language semantics provide an effective calibration signal for probabilistic objectness under the standard OWOD setting.

AI.tldr: MSPO通过轻量级语义校准框架，利用已知类别的语言先验（由CLIP文本编码器构建），增强PROB的类不可知概率目标性，从而改善开放世界目标检测中已知与未知类别的区分边界，而无需将OWOD转化为开放词汇分类。
AI.motivation: PROB方法仅依赖视觉目标性（visual objectness）来判断未知目标，但无法区分硬已知实例、未见类别目标和背景杂波，导致已知-未知决策边界模糊。MSPO旨在通过引入已知类别的语言语义先验来校准这一边界。
AI.method: MSPO为每个已知类别构建扩展文本描述（涵盖属性、外观、场景、功能），用冻结的CLIP文本编码器编码；同时将解码器查询特征投影到相同语义空间，估计其与已知类别语义的支持度；然后将语义证据与PROB的视觉目标性融合，以校准已知/未知预测，不改变原始检测器架构或增量学习协议。
AI.result: 在M-OWODB和S-OWODB数据集上，MSPO提升了PROB基线的主要聚合指标，保持了有竞争力的未知召回率，改善了早期未知混淆指标，并将PASCAL VOC最终mAP提升最多2.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 已知类别的语言语义可以为开放世界目标检测中的概率目标性提供有效的校准信号，且无需使用未来类别名称，所有未见类别在评估中保持未命名状态。

title: Delegation Intelligence in Deep Search: A Controllable Framework for Disentangled Capability Diagnosis
summary: Deep search is becoming a core capability of modern agent systems, yet it is typically evaluated solely based on end-to-end answer accuracy. This coupled evaluation paradigm entangles retrieval quality, long-context comprehension, evidence verification, and tool-use decisions, making it difficult to determine whether a model truly knows when and how to delegate information seeking to search. To this end: (1) We formalize this meta-capability as Delegation Intelligence in deep search and decompose it into complementary dimensions-Search Decision-Making (recognizing information insufficiency and deciding whether, when, and how to search) and Information Synthesis and Verification (aggregating evidence from multiple sources, judging source reliability, and synthesizing information under noisy, potentially adversarial conditions). (2) To enable disentangled and reproducible measurement, we develop a controllable synthesis pipeline built on document-grounded reverse engineering. This yields a general recipe for constructing controlled deep-search evaluations rather than a single fixed dataset. (3) As a concrete instantiation, we construct DelegSearchBench, together with a disentangled evaluation protocol that isolates each capability dimension by varying document composition and tool access. (4) Across representative models, we demonstrate that deep-search competence cannot be adequately characterized by final-answer accuracy alone...

AI.tldr: 本文提出了深度搜索中的"委托智能"概念，将其分解为搜索决策与信息综合验证两个维度，并构建了可控合成流程DelegSearchBench及解耦评估协议，证明仅靠最终答案准确率无法充分刻画深度搜索能力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度搜索评估仅依赖端到端答案准确率，将检索质量、长上下文理解、证据验证和工具使用决策纠缠在一起，无法判断模型是否真正知道何时以及如何将信息获取委托给搜索。
AI.method: (1) 形式化定义委托智能，分解为搜索决策制定和信息综合验证两个互补维度；(2) 开发基于文档逆向工程的可控合成流程，生成可控的深度搜索评估方案；(3) 构建DelegSearchBench基准测试及解耦评估协议，通过变化文档组成和工具访问来隔离各能力维度。
AI.result: 在多个代表性模型上验证了深度搜索能力无法仅通过最终答案准确性充分表征。
AI.conclusion: 深度搜索评估需要解耦为多个维度进行独立衡量，而非仅依赖端到端准确率，DelegSearchBench为这一目标提供了可行的评估框架。

title: Effective Receptive Field Ordering Matters for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: In this work, we investigate a previously unexplored architectural dimension for infrared small target detection: the organization of effective receptive fields (ERFs) during feature refinement. Unlike existing approaches that primarily improve individual feature operators, we argue that ERF organization constitutes an architectural dimension independent of receptive field design itself, and formulate deep feature transformation as a progressive residual correction process, from which a theoretical framework for ERF scheduling is established. Specifically, we reveal that ERF refinement is governed by two fundamental properties: scale-frequency correspondence, which aligns different ERF scales with distinct residual frequency characteristics, and nonlinear non-commutativity, which makes different ERF orderings produce fundamentally different refinement trajectories. Together, these properties show that ERF organization, rather than ERF scale alone, governs refinement dynamics. Guided by these principles, we propose Receptive Field Ordering Network (RFONet), which realizes hierarchical ERF scheduling through a multigrid-inspired V-cycle strategy using only standard $3\times3$ convolutions. RFONet achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks with only 1.16M parameters and over 157 FPS inference speed. Beyond empirical performance, our theoretical analysis provides theoretical guarantees for stable residual refinement under perturbations, frequency shifts, and partial occlusions, which are consistently reflected in superior noise robustness and cross-dataset generalization. Finally, our framework reformulates ERF organization as a task-dependent optimization objective, providing a principled foundation for future adaptive receptive field scheduling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出感受野组织是红外小目标检测中一个被忽视的架构维度，通过建立尺度-频率对应和非线性非交换性两个基本属性，揭示了感受野组织（而非感受野尺度）主导特征精化动力学；基于此提出RFONet，采用多网格启发的V-cycle策略仅用标准3×3卷积实现层次化感受野调度，以1.16M参数和157+FPS速度达到SOTA，并提供扰动、频移和遮挡下的稳定残差精化理论保证。
AI.motivation: 现有红外小目标检测方法主要改进单个特征算子，但忽视了特征精化过程中有效感受野（ERF）的组织方式这一独立于感受野设计本身的架构维度。
AI.method: 将深度特征变换形式化为渐进残差校正过程，建立ERF调度的理论框架；揭示ERF精化的两个基本属性（尺度-频率对应和非线性非交换性）；提出RFONet，采用多网格启发的V-cycle策略实现层次化ERF调度，仅使用标准3×3卷积。
AI.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA性能，仅1.16M参数和157+FPS推理速度；在噪声鲁棒性和跨数据集泛化方面表现优异。理论分析提供了扰动、频移和部分遮挡下稳定残差精化的理论保证。
AI.conclusion: ERF组织是独立于感受野尺度的关键架构维度，ERF组织（而非ERF尺度）主导精化动力学；所提出的框架将ERF组织重定义为任务依赖的优化目标，为未来自适应感受野调度提供了理论基础。

title: ObsDriveBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Understanding under Adverse Weather with Observability Awareness
summary: Autonomous driving under adverse weather remains a critical challenge, yet existing vision-language benchmarks mainly evaluate under standard conditions, synthetic corruptions, or single modality. As a result, it remains unclear how vision-language models behave under real-world adverse weather with multi-modal inputs. We argue that a key difficulty lies in degraded environmental observability: under fog, rain, snow, and low illumination, multi-modal observations become unreliable and cross-modally inconsistent, posing challenges to scene understanding, and subsequent decision-making. To study this, we introduce \textbf{ObsDriveBench}, a real-world multi-modal benchmark for adverse-weather autonomous driving. Our benchmark is designed with three capability dimensions: \textbf{observability awareness}, \textbf{spatial reliability}, and \textbf{risk-aware decision-making}, enabling fine-grained diagnosis of model behavior under degraded observations. We construct the benchmark through observability meta-annotation, scene description, and capability oriented multiple-choice tasks over synchronized camera, LiDAR, and radar inputs, forming a benchmark with over 14k training and 13k test questions. Experiments reveal consistent performance degradation of existing vision-language models. We further introduce \textbf{ObsDrive} model with normal-weather supervised fine-tuning and adverse-weather reinforcement learning, improving robustness across all three capabilities.
