The dataset and evaluation code will be released at \href{https://github.com/russellyq/ObsDriveBench}{\texttt{ObsDriveBench}}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ObsDriveBench，一个面向恶劣天气下自动驾驶的真实多模态基准，包含可观测性感知、空间可靠性和风险感知决策三个能力维度，并引入ObsDrive模型通过正常天气微调和恶劣天气强化学习提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言基准主要在标准条件、合成损坏或单一模态下评估，缺乏对真实恶劣天气下多模态输入时模型行为的研究。作者认为核心难点在于环境可观测性退化：雾、雨、雪和低光照下多模态观测变得不可靠且跨模态不一致。
AI.method: 通过可观测性元标注、场景描述和能力导向的多选题任务构建基准，基于同步的相机、LiDAR和雷达输入，形成超过14k训练和13k测试问题。ObsDrive模型采用正常天气监督微调加恶劣天气强化学习的方法。
AI.result: 实验表明现有多模态视觉-语言模型在恶劣天气下性能持续退化，而ObsDrive模型在三个能力维度上均提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 恶劣天气下多模态观测的退化是影响模型场景理解和决策的关键因素，通过针对性训练可有效提升模型在退化条件下的鲁棒性。

title: Low-light Image Enhancement via Multi-scale Attention combined with Fourier Transform
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to improve image quality and clarity in diverse and demanding low-illumination environments. However, existing deep learning-based LLIE methods struggle to accurately capture real-world illumination and restore texture details, largely because their algorithmic strengths remain underutilized. To address these issues, we present a supervised frequency domain deep learning network for LLIE, named multi-scale attention combined with the Fourier transform (MSFT) which adopts a U-shaped, one-stage architecture that infuses guidance from low-light images into the network by channeling it through multi-scale attention. We further fuse the amplitude information from priori channels with that of the low-light image in MSFT's self-created module, and carry out multi-scale guidance along with the network. Subsequently, to better enhance the faint feature, such as fine content and textures, and to better fuse global context confidence in the decoding stage, we separately introduce a multi-shape synergistic attention and a lightweight network that effectively integrate information in high-dimensional space to embed into the superlative feature space channel containing rich texture information. Extensive experiments conducted on LOL, SID, SMID, and SDSD datasets demonstrate that MSFT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art competitors. For example, compared with Retinexformer, our method achieves a peak signal-to-noise ratio of up to 41.76 decibels on the SDSD-outdoor dataset with an increase of 11.92 decibels and a structural similarity index of 0.988 with a 13.80% improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为MSFT的监督频域深度学习网络，通过多尺度注意力与傅里叶变换结合，在低光图像增强任务上显著超越现有方法，在SDSD-outdoor数据集上PSNR达到41.76dB，SSIM达0.988。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的低光图像增强方法难以准确捕捉真实光照和恢复纹理细节，算法的优势未被充分利用。
AI.method: 采用U形单阶段架构，包含多尺度注意力引导、傅里叶变换融合振幅信息、多尺度协同注意力和轻量级网络嵌入高维空间特征，以及多形状协同注意力机制。
AI.result: 在LOL、SID、SMID和SDSD数据集上显著优于现有方法，在SDSD-outdoor上PSNR为41.76dB（提升11.92dB），SSIM为0.988（提升13.80%）。
AI.conclusion: MSFT在低光图像增强任务上取得了state-of-the-art的性能，验证了频域学习和多尺度注意力机制的有效性。

title: Verification-Notebook Learning for Source-Aware Multimodal Misinformation Detection
summary: Multimodal misinformation verification is challenging because misleading signals may come from different parts of a post and require different forms of evidence. LVLMs are well suited to this task, but their verification performance often depends on the inference procedure applied to each instance. Existing methods improve this procedure through stronger prompting, retrieval, or deliberation, but rarely retain the verification patterns learned from previous examples. We propose Verification-Notebook Learning (VNL), a non-parametric framework that learns an external verification procedure for a frozen LVLM before inference. VNL builds a compact notebook of decision principles, evidence cues, and recurring pitfalls from prior verification experience. The notebook remains fixed during inference and guides the verification of new examples. Rather than updating model parameters or storing demonstrations, VNL records learned knowledge in an artifact that can be inspected directly. Experiments show that VNL consistently outperforms a range of competitive baselines. Further analyses show that the Verification Notebook improves fine-grained source attribution while remaining compact and interpretable, providing an effective way to accumulate verification knowledge without model training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出验证笔记本学习（VNL）框架，为非参数化方法，通过从先前验证经验中构建紧凑的决策原则、证据线索和常见陷阱笔记本，在不更新模型参数或存储演示的情况下，引导冻结的大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）进行多模态虚假信息验证，实验表明该方法持续优于多个强基线，并提升细粒度来源归因能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态虚假信息验证面临挑战，因为误导信号可能来自帖子的不同部分，需要不同形式的证据。现有方法虽通过更强的提示、检索或推理过程改进验证，但很少保留从先前例子中学到的验证模式，缺乏知识积累机制。
AI.method: 提出验证笔记本学习（VNL）框架，这是一种非参数化方法。在推理前，从先前的验证经验中构建一个包含决策原则、证据线索和常见陷阱的紧凑笔记本。笔记本在推理期间保持固定，用于指导新例子的验证，而不更新模型参数或存储演示。
AI.result: 实验表明VNL持续优于多个强基线。进一步分析显示，验证笔记本在保持紧凑和可解释性的同时，提升了细粒度来源归因能力。
AI.conclusion: VNL提供了一种无需模型训练即可积累验证知识的有效途径，通过可直接检查的外部知识工件来引导LVLM的验证过程，实现了性能提升与可解释性的兼顾。

title: Structural Loss Metrics for Tensor Approximation via Matrix Low-Rank Approximation
summary: Matricized low-rank approximation via SVD is a standard surrogate for tensor decompositions, but entry-wise reconstruction error fails to capture multiway geometric degradation. Under an orthogonal Tucker model, we characterize this degradation using two metrics: cross-mode Direction Loss, measuring geometric subspace deviation from rank truncation and noise rotation, and Interaction Loss, quantifying multilinear interaction distortion in the core tensor. We prove that squared relative reconstruction error orthogonally decomposes into interaction loss and out-of-subspace energy, and derive a Wedin-type bound establishing the stability of a plug-in Direction Loss estimator. Experiments on synthetic and hyperspectral datasets demonstrate that nearly identical reconstruction errors can yield markedly different structural-loss profiles; hyperspectral patches with comparable reconstruction errors exhibit up to a 4.6-fold difference in Direction Loss, correlating with severe visual blurring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在正交Tucker模型下，通过方向损失（衡量子空间偏差）和交互损失（衡量核张量多线性交互扭曲）两种指标来表征张量分解的几何退化，证明了平方相对重建误差可正交分解为交互损失与子空间外能量，并推导了Wedin型界以保证方向损失估计器的稳定性。实验表明相近的重建误差可能对应显著不同的结构损失轮廓，高光谱补丁中方向损失差异可达4.6倍，与严重视觉模糊相关。
AI.motivation: 标准SVD矩阵化低秩近似作为张量分解的替代方法时，逐元素重建误差无法捕捉多路几何退化，需要新的度量指标来刻画这种退化。
AI.method: 在正交Tucker模型框架下，定义交叉模方向损失（几何子空间偏差）和交互损失（核张量多线性交互扭曲）；推导平方相对重建误差的正交分解形式；建立方向损失估计器的Wedin型稳定性界；在合成数据和真实高光谱数据集上验证。
AI.result: 重建误差相近时结构损失轮廓可差异显著；高光谱补丁中方向损失最大差异达4.6倍，与严重视觉模糊相关。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的两种损失指标能有效揭示张量低秩近似中隐藏的几何退化，弥补了传统重建误差的不足，对高光谱图像等结构化数据的张量处理具有指导意义。

title: Are You Still the Agent I Authorized? Earned Authority under a Fixed Ceiling for Evolving Agents
summary:
Long-lived AI agents increasingly evolve after deployment by retaining experience, acquiring skills and tools, revising workflows, delegating work, and moving across task phases. This improves adaptation but creates a distinct authorization problem. Tool-enabled agents can turn model errors and prompt injections into consequential external actions; when evolution occurs under a live grant, the subject exercising that authority or the context in which it acts may no longer match what the user evaluated. Evolution can change both the effects reachable under an old grant and the authority required by the task, which may rise, fall, or become incomparable. Existing tool policies constrain actions but do not determine when a grant survives this change.
  We formulate authorization continuity: when does an existing grant remain valid, how may active authority change, and what boundary must never move? Our state-bound model fixes a transition envelope and an immutable effect ceiling at grant time. The envelope determines whether the grant survives a mutation; below the ceiling, authority may contract freely and expand only under specified evidence conditions. We distinguish requested from realized effects and prove that, under complete mediation, sound effect abstraction, attenuating delegation, and monitor integrity, mutation cannot amplify protected effects beyond the user-issued ceiling. Agent-produced evidence may allocate authority below the ceiling but cannot raise it. Finally, we map six mutation classes to their authorization consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了授权连续性（authorization continuity）框架，解决长期运行AI智能体在部署后演化（如获取技能、修订工作流、委派任务等）时产生的授权问题。通过状态边界模型（state-bound model）固定转换包络和不可变效果上限，确保智能体演化不会突破用户设定的保护效果边界。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的AI智能体在部署后不断演化（保留经验、获取技能工具、修订工作流、委派任务、跨阶段移动），提高了适应性但带来了授权问题：当演化发生在已有授权下时，行使权力的主体或上下文可能与用户最初评估的不再匹配，旧授权可能不再适用。
AI.method: 提出状态边界模型（state-bound model），在授权时固定转换包络（transition envelope）和不可变效果上限（immutable effect ceiling）。包络决定授权是否在突变后继续有效；效果上限之下，授权可自由收缩，但仅在指定证据条件下才能扩展。区分请求效果与实现效果，在完全中介（complete mediation）、声音效果抽象（sound effect abstraction）、衰减委派（attenuating delegation）和监控完整性（monitor integrity）条件下证明突变无法将受保护效果放大到用户设定的上限之上。
AI.result: 证明了在完全中介、声音效果抽象、衰减委派和监控完整性条件下，智能体突变不会将受保护效果放大超过用户设定的效果上限；智能体产生的证据可在上限之下分配授权但无法提升上限；将六类突变映射到其授权后果。
AI.conclusion: 现有工具策略虽能约束行动但无法确定授权何时在智能体演化后仍然有效；本文的授权连续性框架填补了这一空白，为长期运行演化式AI智能体的安全授权管理提供了理论基础。

title: AptAvatar: Fast and Vivid Long-Form Audio-Driven Video Generation for Production-Ready Avatars
summary: Production-ready audio-driven avatar generation requires efficient inference without sacrificing fidelity or motion expressiveness. However, existing acceleration methods often compromise quality through restrictive architectural choices, such as causal attention and short temporal horizons, or by reducing model capacity and resolution. Without such compromises, we propose AptAvatar, a 14B-parameter long-form audio-driven avatar generation framework that delivers fast and expressive inference. For efficiency in production-level applications, AptAvatar addresses the extreme two-step generation challenge. To bridge the gap between the multi-step teacher model and the two-step student model, we introduce Endpoint-Anchored Distribution Distillation. It augments vanilla distribution matching with a dedicated Anchor Score Estimator trained on the trajectory-endpoint distribution defined from a frozen pretrained 4-step bridge generator. This provides an attainable endpoint-level anchor for the evolving two-step student. To improve long-horizon consistency, we further introduce Self-Generated History Replay, which reuses cached outputs from earlier generator checkpoints as history conditions during chunk-wise training. This approximates inference-time conditioning on self-generated histories without costly online rollouts, mitigating quality degradation from accumulated history errors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AptAvatar generates vivid 720p long-form avatar videos with only 2 NFEs, achieving a 60x speedup while preserving visual fidelity and long-horizon identity. Code is available at https://github.com/TaoLiveAIGC/AptAvatar

AI.tldr: AptAvatar是一个140亿参数的高效语音驱动虚拟人生成框架，通过端点锚定分布蒸馏和自生成历史回放两项核心技术，在仅需2步推理的条件下生成720p长视频，实现60倍加速且不损失视觉质量和动作表现力。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动虚拟人生成方法在加速推理时往往通过因果注意力、短时间窗口或降低模型容量等限制性设计来妥协质量，无法同时满足生产级应用所需的高效、高保真和高动作表现力。
AI.method: 1) 端点锚定分布蒸馏：在预训练的4步桥接生成器的轨迹端点分布上训练锚定分数估计器，为2步学生模型提供可实现的端点级锚点，弥补多步教师与两步学生之间的差距。2) 自生成历史回放：在分块训练中重用早期生成器检查点的缓存输出作为历史条件，模拟推理时基于自生成历史的条件化，无需昂贵的在线 rollout，缓解累积历史误差导致的质量退化。
AI.result: AptAvatar仅需2次神经函数评估即可生成生动的720p长时虚拟人视频，实现60倍加速，同时保持视觉保真度和长时身份一致性。
AI.conclusion: AptAvatar证明了在不牺牲质量的前提下实现极速音频驱动虚拟人生成的可行性，为生产级应用提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Hybrid Advantage Estimation with Unified Critic for VLM Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) now act as agents in interactive environments, where success requires coherent reasoning and decision-making across turns. Although end-to-end training in agentic environments can improve such multi-turn decision-making abilities, current methods mainly rely on either token-wise optimization over concatenated token trajectories or turn-wise optimization with uniform within-turn credit. In this work, we establish theoretical formulations for the two levels of optimization and derive a hybrid advantage that serves both objectives. Furthermore, with an appropriate choice of discount factor and learning target, we prove that a unified critic model can estimate values for both turn-wise and token-wise. As such, we propose HyGAE, an actor-critic framework that jointly optimizes token- and turn-level objectives with the hybrid advantage and unified critic. We conduct extensive evaluations of HyGAE across five multi-turn decision-making environments, where it achieves an average success rate of 91% and a significant improvement of 10% over other methods. Furthermore, we provide an in-depth analysis showing that the exact analytic form of the hybrid advantage and return is crucial for optimization. Project Page: https://wx-zhang.github.io/hygae-web/.

AI.tldr: 提出HyGAE框架，通过混合优势函数和统一评论家模型，联合优化视觉语言模型在多轮决策中的token级和turn级目标，在五个环境中平均成功率达91%，比现有方法提升10%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM多轮决策优化方法要么对拼接token轨迹进行逐token优化，要么对整轮进行均匀信用分配的turn级优化，缺乏同时兼顾两个粒度优化的理论框架。
AI.method: 建立token级和turn级优化的理论公式，推导出混合优势函数；证明通过适当选择折扣因子和学习目标，可用统一评论家模型同时估计两个粒度的价值；提出HyGAE演员-评论家框架，联合优化两个层级的目标。
AI.result: 在五个多轮决策环境中平均成功率达91%，比现有方法提升10%。
AI.conclusion: 混合优势函数和回报的精确解析形式对优化至关重要，HyGAE有效提升了VLM在多轮交互环境中的决策能力。

title: DailyBench: A Unified Benchmark for AI-Generated and Manipulated Images from Modern Generative Models
summary: Recent advances in generative models have shifted AI-generated image detection from identifying easily distinguishable, fully synthetic images to identifying highly realistic content generated by both modern generation and manipulation pipelines. However, existing detection benchmarks are often built with outdated generative models and primarily emphasize full-image synthesis, creating a growing mismatch between benchmark data and the images encountered in real-world generation and editing scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce DailyBench, a high-quality unified benchmark for evaluating whether AI-generated image detectors can generalize across both modern full-image synthesis and object-level manipulation. DailyBench contains two complementary subsets: FakeBench, which includes high-quality images synthesized by recent open-source and commercial generative models, and ManipulationBench, which introduces challenging object-level edits applied to real images using advanced image-conditional models. This design makes DailyBench a realistic testbed for studying both generator-level generalization and manipulation-aware detection under subtle local edits. Experiments on DailyBench reveal substantial robustness gaps in current detectors: methods reporting 91-96% balanced accuracy on GenImage drop to 60-76% on FakeBench and 54-66% on ManipulationBench. These results show that existing detectors remain poorly generalized to realistic synthesis and manipulation, highlighting DailyBench as a rigorous testbed for developing robust and manipulation-aware AI-generated image detection methods. The project is available at https://dailybench.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出DailyBench，一个用于评估AI生成图像检测器在现代全图合成与局部编辑场景下泛化能力的高质量统一基准，实验表明现有检测器性能大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测基准多基于过时生成模型且侧重全图合成，与现实世界中遇到的生成和编辑场景存在日益严重的错配。
AI.method: 构建DailyBench，包含两个子集：FakeBench（使用最新开源和商业模型生成的高质量全图）和ManipulationBench（对真实图像进行高级局部编辑），用于评估生成器级泛化和操控感知检测能力。
AI.result: 在DailyBench上，声称在GenImage上91-96%平衡准确率的方法在FakeBench上降至60-76%，在ManipulationBench上降至54-66%。
AI.conclusion: 现有检测器对真实场景中的合成和操控泛化能力很弱，DailyBench可作为一个严格的测试平台推动鲁棒且具操控感知能力的检测方法发展。

title: SpecAHD: Localize to Specialize for Automated Heuristic Design in Large-Scale Routing Problems
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, and 3 tables. Supplementary material included
summary: LLM-based automated heuristic design (AHD) typically scores executable programs on complete instances or within fixed solver components. In large-scale routing problems, localized reconstruction reduces the size of each optimization task, but repair regions within the same incumbent can exhibit substantially different structures. One construction rule must therefore compromise across them. In this paper, we propose SpecAHD, a coupled bilevel framework for within-instance specialization. An upper-level search learns where to expose bounded repair regions, while a lower-level search evolves a complementary repertoire of executable heuristics for the induced repair tasks. The upper-level program determines the repair tasks seen by the lower level, while checked repair outcomes determine how upper-level programs are evaluated. The lower-level objective favors heuristics that perform well on average or solve tasks that the current repertoire handles poorly. For the repair tasks induced by a fixed upper-level program and a fixed lower-level candidate pool, this objective is monotone submodular, allowing greedy repertoire selection with a (1-1/e) approximation guarantee. Across four routing problems and multiple LLM backbones, SpecAHD reduces held-out objective cost by up to 57.7% against the strongest competing AHD baseline and outperforms the per-instance baseline envelope on most public instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpecAHD，一种用于大规模路径问题中局部修复区域专用化的双层框架：上层搜索决定修复区域位置，下层演化针对不同修复任务的启发式程序库。该方法利用子模单调性保证贪婪选择策略的(1-1/e)近似比，在四个路径问题上相比最强基线降低高达57.7%的目标成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动启发式设计（AHD）在完整实例或固定求解器组件上对可执行程序进行评分。在大规模路径问题中，局部重构虽能缩小每个优化任务的规模，但同一当前解中的不同修复区域结构差异显著，单一构造规则难以兼顾所有区域。
AI.method: 提出SpecAHD耦合双层框架：上层搜索学习暴露有界修复区域的位置，下层搜索演化一组互补的可执行启发式程序库以应对不同修复任务。上层程序决定下层所见修复任务，修复结果反馈评估上层程序。下层目标偏好平均性能好或能解决当前库处理不佳任务的那些启发式。对于固定上层程序和固定下层候选池所诱导的修复任务，该目标是单调子模的，允许贪婪选择具备(1-1/e)近似保证。
AI.result: 在四个路径问题和多个LLM骨干网络上，SpecAHD相比最强竞争AHD基线降低高达57.7%的留出目标成本，并在大多数公开实例上超越每实例基线包络线。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的实例内专用化双层框架能有效应对大规模路径问题中修复区域的异质性，通过上下层协同搜索实现优于现有方法的性能。

title: Disentangling Semantic Attention from Structural Bias in the Attention Manifold
summary: The empirical success of attention mechanism in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often obscures its inherent, subtle flaws. Specifically, MLLMs consistently exhibit disproportionate attention toward certain semantically uninformative visual tokens, a phenomenon termed "register" or "Visual Attention Sinks." While existing inference intervention methods attempt to identify these sink tokens and redistribute their attention weights, such approaches typically treat these tokens in isolation and suffer from computational inefficiency. Instead, we reframe this phenomenon as a generalized textual bias exerted over visual features that extends beyond isolated sink tokens. From this perspective, a pervasive structural bias leads to the dilution of the semantic visual signal, precipitating multimodal hallucinations as the model prioritizes linguistic priors over valid visual evidence. To address this limitation, we introduce Saliency-guided Purification and Adaptive Redistribution (SPAR), a training-free, plug-and-play intervention. SPAR mitigates this generalized textual bias by purifying structural noise and subsequently redistributing the reclaimed attention budget to the most informative visual regions. Comprehensive evaluations across a diverse spectrum of hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that SPAR effectively restores authentic visual grounding with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPAR方法，通过识别和重分配多模态大语言模型中视觉注意力沉没问题，无需训练即可有效缓解多模态幻觉。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型中的注意力机制存在"视觉注意力沉没"现象，即模型对语义无关的视觉token分配过高注意力，导致视觉信号被稀释、多模态幻觉加剧。现有干预方法将沉没token孤立处理且计算效率低。
AI.method: 提出SPAR（Saliency-guided Purification and Adaptive Redistribution），一种无需训练、即插即用的干预方法。通过显著性引导净化结构噪声，并将回收的注意力预算自适应地重新分配到最具信息量的视觉区域。
AI.result: 在多种幻觉基准测试上的全面评估表明，SPAR能够有效恢复真实的视觉基础，且计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 视觉注意力沉没本质是语言先验对视觉特征的广义文本偏差，SPAR通过净化结构噪声与自适应重分配有效缓解了这一问题，提升了多模态大语言模型的视觉真实性。

title: Focus Is All You Need: Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration for Multi-Agent Graph Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) enable autonomous agents for reasoning, planning, and tool use. Recent systems increasingly organize these agents as graphs of specialized, interconnected nodes. Although graph-based orchestration supports flexible decomposition and coordination, it creates a key challenge: \textbf{attention allocation}. As workflows grow, existing approaches often execute graph components uniformly, wasting resources on irrelevant or low-impact tasks. We introduce \textbf{Attention Orchestration}, a paradigm that extends Transformer-style attention from token representations to workflow-level agent coordination. Our framework, \textbf{Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration (AGAO)}, dynamically estimates agent importance based on user objectives, graph dependencies, and computational constraints. AGAO combines three components: (1) goal-aware attention, measuring semantic relevance between user goals and agent capabilities; (2) topology-aware attention, modeling structural dependencies in agent graphs; and (3) resource-aware attention, allocating budgets and execution priorities across heterogeneous agents. Together, these mechanisms transform static agent graphs into adaptive systems that focus computation on goal-critical reasoning paths. Experiments across diverse multi-agent workloads show that AGAO improves task effectiveness while reducing unnecessary computation, latency, and token consumption compared with existing graph-based execution strategies. Our work establishes \textbf{Attention Engineering} as a direction for scalable, intelligent multi-agent systems. Code: https://github.com/MingzhouFan97/AGAO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出**自适应目标感知注意力编排（AGAO）**框架，将Transformer风格的注意力机制扩展到工作流级别的多智能体协调中。AGAO通过目标感知、拓扑感知和资源感知三种注意力组件，动态评估智能体重要性，将静态智能体图转化为自适应系统，在提升任务效果的同时减少计算浪费、延迟和token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图结构的多智能体编排系统在流程增长时采用均匀执行策略，导致计算资源被浪费在低相关或低影响的任务上，缺乏对关键推理路径的注意力分配机制。
AI.method: 提出AGAO框架，包含三个组件：(1) 目标感知注意力——衡量用户目标与智能体能力间的语义相关性；(2) 拓扑感知注意力——建模智能体图中的结构依赖关系；(3) 资源感知注意力——跨异构智能体分配预算和执行优先级。三者协同将静态智能体图转化为动态自适应系统。
AI.result: 在多样化的多智能体工作负载实验中，AGAO相比现有基于图的执行策略，在提升任务有效性的同时，减少了不必要的计算量、延迟和token消耗。
AI.conclusion: 本文开创了**注意力工程**这一研究方向，为构建可扩展、智能的多智能体系统提供了新范式。

title: A Unified Stereo Geometry Estimation Framework for Disparity and Surface Normal
summary: Stereo matching and surface normal estimation are fundamental tasks in 3D vision. However, existing feed-forward stereo methods still struggle to produce reliable predictions in challenging regions, mainly due to the lack of strong geometric priors. In this paper, we propose $\textbf{GeoStereo}$, a unified stereo geometry estimation framework that leverages powerful diffusion priors to jointly predict disparity and surface normals. Specifically, GeoStereo couples a feed-forward stereo matching pipeline with a diffusion-based normal estimation branch. To enable effective interaction between the two tasks, we introduce a disparity to normal initialization strategy and construct a warp to left-view condition for the diffusion process. This coupled design allows the diffusion branch to provide strong structural priors that enhance disparity estimation in ill-posed regions, while the feed-forward branch offers reliable geometric guidance for accurate normal prediction. Extensive experiments show that GeoStereo performs reliably in challenging scenarios, including low-light environments, highly reflective surfaces, and transparent objects. Under zero-shot settings, it achieves Rank-1 disparity estimation on multiple benchmarks, including KITTI and NYUv2, and delivers the best normal estimation accuracy on many real indoor benchmarks, such as iBims-1 and ScanNet. Project page: https://qz-wei.github.io/GeoStereo.github.io/

AI.tldr: GeoStereo是一个统一的双目几何估计框架，通过将前馈立体匹配与扩散先验的表面法线估计相结合，共同预测视差和表面法线，在挑战性场景（低光、高反射、透明物体）中表现优异，在KITTI、NYUv2等多个零样本基准上达到Rank-1视差估计和最佳法线精度。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈立体匹配方法在挑战性区域（低光、高反射、透明物体）缺乏强几何先验，导致预测不可靠。
AI.method: 提出GeoStereo框架，将前馈立体匹配流水线与基于扩散先验的法线估计分支耦合；引入视差到法线的初始化策略，构建左视图变形条件用于扩散过程；两个分支相互增强。
AI.result: 在零样本设置下，在KITTI和NYUv2等多个基准上达到Rank-1视差估计，在iBims-1和ScanNet等室内基准上取得最佳法线估计精度。
AI.conclusion: 扩散先验能有效增强立体匹配在病态区域的表现，而前馈分支则提供可靠的几何指导用于法线预测，两者协同提升了挑战场景下的几何估计可靠性。

title: Compute Globally, Materialize Locally: The Memory Contract of Sparse Event-KV
summary: Long-horizon agents increasingly reuse their KV cache as memory: a serving system keeps a subset of cached entries and drops the rest. Eviction and episodic-memory schemes therefore rest on a premise rarely tested directly, that a retained event is still informative once the observations that produced it are gone. We test it by omitting one earlier observation from what is served, across otherwise identical agent histories. Among items sensitive to that observation, the answer overwhelmingly follows the omitted value, though no served span says which value is correct. We call this semantic materialization: a downstream event's cached rows act as an independently servable view of computation whose inputs are gone. It can also be written on purpose. A deliberately phrased, answer-free event raises donor-aligned recovery from 6% to 51% on Qwen3-8B without ever naming the value, whereas passively harvesting natural mentions from long-term dialog yields no detected advantage. What such a row carries is specific and bounded. Compact state survives, larger payloads decay toward chance, and whether a construction writes at all turns on phrasing rather than on meaning alone, so two phrasings the model comprehends equally well can diverge sharply. The result is a memory contract for sparse event-KV serving: what to write, where it lands, and what survives once the source is gone. For anyone who evicts the corollary is that dropping a source event and observing no accuracy loss does not show the source was unnecessary.

AI.tldr: 本文发现长时程智能体的KV缓存存在一种“语义物化”现象：即使原始观测已被丢弃，缓存中的下游事件仍然能独立恢复被删除的信息。实验表明，这种携带的信息是特定且有界的——紧凑状态得以保留，较大负载会衰减至随机水平。通过精心构造无答案事件，可将同向恢复率从6%提升至51%，而自然对话中的被动捕获则无此效果。
AI.motivation: 验证长时程智能体在重用KV缓存作为记忆时的一个核心假设——被保留的事件在产生它的观测被丢弃后是否仍然具有信息量。现有驱逐和情景记忆方案普遍依赖这一前提，但缺乏直接检验。
AI.method: 在完全相同的历史中省略某个早期观测，观察下游事件对该缺失信息的恢复能力。进一步通过构造刻意措辞的无答案事件和采集自然对话中的被动提及进行对比实验。
AI.result: 1) 对于对被省略观测敏感的问题，答案主导性地遵循被删除的值；2) 刻意构造的无答案事件可将同向恢复率从6%提升至51%；3) 自然对话中的被动捕获无明显优势；4) 紧凑状态幸存，较大负载向随机衰减；5) 写法而非语义决定能否写入。
AI.conclusion: KV缓存中存在语义物化现象，这一发现对稀疏事件KV服务提出了"记忆契约"——什么能写入、写入何处、删除源后什么能幸存。对于使用驱逐策略的系统，仅观察无精度损失并不能证明被删除的源信息是不必要的。

title: Sol-Attn: Accelerating Video Generation Inference via On-the-Fly Attention Sparsification
summary: Diffusion transformers are essential for high-fidelity video generation, but long token sequences make attention a dominant inference bottleneck. Training-free dynamic sparse attention alleviates this bottleneck by computing only selected key-value blocks, yet existing methods struggle to sparsify attention both efficiently and accurately for two reasons: (1) Rigid, unpredictable, and costly routing: selecting a fixed fraction of top-ranked blocks by proxy score imposes fixed budgets, whereas retaining blocks to reach a target cumulative proxy probability mass yields dynamic but potentially imbalanced budgets; both incur non-negligible overhead from computing and materializing proxy scores. (2) Lossy keep-or-drop sparsification: unselected blocks are discarded entirely, degrading accuracy under aggressive sparsity. These limitations motivate cheaper dynamic-budget routing while limiting accuracy degradation. In this paper, we introduce training-free Sol-Attn (Sparsifying online attention), which unifies dynamic routing, sparse computation, and approximation correction in a single online-softmax pass, achieving a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off in sparse attention. The core of Sol-Attn is on-the-fly block thresholding with proxy-score reuse, which selects critical blocks by comparing block proxy scores against a threshold during online softmax. This design enables dynamic yet controllable block budgets without materializing the proxy map, while directly reusing the proxy scores of unselected blocks to approximate their contribution. Experiments across image and video generation tasks show that Sol-Attn advances the quality-efficiency frontier of training-free sparse attention, delivering 2.1 times and 2.3 times end-to-end speedups for video generation and editing, respectively, while preserving visual quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sol-Attn，一种训练无关的在线稀疏注意力机制，通过在线softmax中统一动态路由、稀疏计算和近似校正，在视频生成中实现2.1倍、编辑中实现2.3倍端到端加速，同时保持视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散transformer中长序列注意力成为推理瓶颈，现有训练无关动态稀疏注意力的方法存在两个问题：(1) 路由机制刚性、不可预测且代价高——固定分数路由预算固定，累积概率路由预算动态但不平衡，两者均需计算代理分数产生额外开销；(2) 丢弃式稀疏化导致精度下降。因此需要更廉价的动态预算路由方法并限制精度损失。
AI.method: Sol-Attn在单次在线softmax中统一动态路由、稀疏计算和近似校正。核心是在线softmax过程中进行逐块阈值比较，通过代理分数复用实现动态可控的块预算，无需物化代理映射图，并直接复用未选择块的代理分数近似其贡献。
AI.result: 在图像和视频生成任务上，Sol-Attn推进了训练无关稀疏注意力的质量-效率前沿，视频生成实现2.1倍端到端加速，视频编辑实现2.3倍端到端加速，同时保持视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: Sol-Attn通过在线阈值化和代理分数复用的统一设计，在稀疏注意力中实现了更好的精度-效率权衡，有效解决了现有方法的预算刚性和丢弃式稀疏化问题。

title: Offline-to-Online Creative Optimization with Generative Models and Adaptive Testing
summary: Ad creative optimization is increasingly constrained by evaluation rather than generation. Generative models can produce many plausible creatives, but reliable evaluation requires online experiments, in which only a limited slate can be tested. We study how to use data from historical A/B tests to generate and select the candidates in that slate. We developed and deployed a performance-driven offline-to-online workflow that guides creative generation with a predictive model as an inference-time critic. In the offline phase, we use a predictive model trained on historical experiments to rank and refine variants created by a generative model. A final test slate is then deployed in an online adaptive experiment. In a 50-arm field experiment, we found that the best creative generated with this method yielded 45.1% higher engagement than the best human-authored creative. Two additional experiments showed the same upper-tail pattern, with lifts of 46.7% and 36.2%. We found that despite the predictive model being too noisy to directly identify the best creative offline, it effectively guides the generative model toward creating strong candidates that can be efficiently evaluated in an adaptive experiment. The results suggest a design principle for creative optimization with generative models: use predictive models to guide generation of a slate to test, judge the slate by whether it contains high-performing candidates at a feasible test size, and use adaptive experiments to select among candidates while limiting traffic lost to weak arms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种离线到在线的创意优化工作流：利用历史A/B测试数据训练预测模型，在推理阶段作为评判器指导生成式模型产生创意候选集，再通过在线自适应实验从候选集中选出最优创意。在50臂实地实验中，该方法产生的最佳创意相比人类作者创作的创意提升了45.1%的参与度，并在另外两个实验中分别获得46.7%和36.2%的提升。
AI.motivation: 创意优化的瓶颈正从生成转向评估——生成式模型能产生大量看似合理的创意，但可靠的评估需要在线实验，而每次实验只能测试有限数量的候选方案。因此，如何利用历史A/B测试数据来高效地生成和筛选候选创意集是核心问题。
AI.method: 1) 离线阶段：使用基于历史实验训练的预测模型作为推理时的评判器，对生成式模型产生的变体进行排序和优化。2) 在线阶段：将最终选定的测试集部署到在线自适应实验中，高效筛选最优创意。核心思想是用预测模型引导生成，而非直接依靠预测模型选出最优方案。
AI.result: 1) 50臂实地实验中，该方法产生的最佳创意比人类最佳创意提升45.1%的参与度。2) 另外两个实验分别获得46.7%和36.2%的提升。3) 预测模型虽然噪声太大无法直接离线识别最优创意，但能有效引导生成模型产生强候选方案，这些候选方案可在自适应实验中被高效评估。
AI.conclusion: 创意优化的设计原则：使用预测模型指导生成测试集，通过测试集是否包含可行测试规模下的高性能候选方案来评判其质量，利用自适应实验在候选方案中进行选择，同时限制流量在弱势方案上的浪费。

title: PointCHR: Point Cloud Analysis via Curvature-Aware Hyperbolic Rectification
summary: High-curvature regions in 3D point clouds encapsulate critical fine-grained geometric semantics yet exhibit a distinct long-tail sparsity in their spatial distribution. The inherent limitations of polynomial volume growth in Euclidean space frequently render these intricate geometric features challenging to adequately resolve within a uniform-scale feature space. Consequently, these regions are frequently overshadowed by smooth global features dominated by low-curvature regions, thereby limiting the discriminative capacity of the network. To address this issue, we propose PointCHR, a curvature-aware hyperbolic rectification (CHR) for point cloud analysis. Utilising the property of exponential volume expansion in the vicinity of hyperbolic manifolds, CHR presents a learnable curvature-guided radial rectification mechanism. By adaptively projecting high-curvature points towards boundary regions endowed with larger effective embedding capacities, PointCHR effectively mitigates the representation crowding problem inherent in Euclidean settings. Extensive experimentation has demonstrated that PointCHR significantly enhances the ability of backbone to capture fine-grained geometric details, achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: PointCHR提出了一种曲率感知的双曲矫正机制，通过将高曲率点自适应投影到具有更大嵌入容量的边界区域，有效缓解了欧氏空间中高曲率区域因长尾分布导致的表示拥挤问题，显著提升了3D点云细粒度几何语义的捕获能力。
AI.motivation: 3D点云中高曲率区域包含关键细粒度几何语义，但其空间分布呈长尾稀疏特性，而欧氏空间的多项式体积增长限制导致这些区域在均匀尺度特征空间中被低曲率区域主导的平滑全局特征所掩盖，限制了网络的判别能力。
AI.method: 提出PointCHR，利用双曲流形附近指数级体积扩张的特性，设计了一种可学习的曲率引导径向矫正机制，将高曲率点自适应投影到具有更大有效嵌入容量的边界区域。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PointCHR显著增强了骨干网络捕获细粒度几何细节的能力，在多个基准数据集上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: PointCHR通过双曲空间矫正有效解决了欧氏空间中高曲率区域的表示拥挤问题，为点云分析中细粒度几何特征的学习提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: Offline-Online Curriculum RL for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models exhibit capabilities on reasoning tasks, yet often produce flawed intermediate steps while yielding correct final answers. This behavior undermines interpretability and reliability, suggesting reliance on spurious shortcuts rather than faithful reasoning. Although efforts have explored step-level supervision, distinguishing decisive steps from redundant ones remains challenging. We propose $O^2$-CritiCuRL, a novel curriculum reinforcement learning framework that introduces critical-step awareness through an iterative offline-online paradigm. In the offline stage, $O^2$-CritiCuRL conducts multi-rollout analysis over step-annotated trajectories to estimate step-level importance, allowing the framework to distill critical reasoning steps and filter out redundant ones. In the online stage, we employ a progressive step-level reinforcement learning strategy, where truncated chains guide the model to infer missing steps and refine its reasoning, thereby sharpening its focus on critical steps and overcoming the limitations of static supervision. Extensive experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while delivering superior training and inference efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/kk0013/CritiCuRL.

AI.tldr: 提出O²-CritiCuRL框架，通过离线-在线课程强化学习识别关键推理步骤，在多模态推理任务上达到SOTA性能并提升训练和推理效率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在推理任务中常产生有缺陷的中间步骤却得出正确结果，表明模型依赖虚假捷径而非忠实推理，现有步级监督难以区分关键步骤与冗余步骤。
AI.method: 提出O²-CritiCuRL框架：离线阶段通过多轮 rollout 分析步级标注轨迹，评估步骤重要性并过滤冗余步骤；在线阶段采用渐进式步级强化学习，利用截断链引导模型推断缺失步骤并优化推理。
AI.result: 在多模态推理基准上达到SOTA性能，同时实现更优的训练和推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过课程强化学习与关键步骤感知机制，有效提升多模态推理的忠实性与效率。

title: MarineEVT: Advancing Event-Centric Marine Video Understanding via Visual Tool Reasoning
comment: Accepted to The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success in visual understanding, driven by the growing availability of high-quality image-text pairs. However, the performance of VLMs often degrades in the video domain due to the essential need for temporal understanding and the scarcity of large-scale annotated video data. In this work, we focus on marine video understanding, which brings further challenges: first, it requires substantial domain expertise; and video VLMs usually struggle with localizing and interpreting critical information from marine videos, as the informative events are typically sparse, unpredictable, and unevenly distributed. To address these challenges, we carefully curate the first event-centric marine video understanding dataset called MarineEVT, which features 20K multi-task, video-level visual question-answering pairs spanning multiple dimensions of marine understanding and analysis. Meanwhile, based on MarineEVT, we decompose marine video understanding as an Event-centric Visual Tool-integrated Reasoning process EVT-R1 for short, where we leverage powerful visual tools to drive the model to localize and interpret critical information aligned with visual questions and human intent. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we compare EVT-R1 against 11 SOTA VLMs in different settings. EVT-R1 outperforms the top open-source and top commercial models by 5.22 and 11.09, respectively. MarineEVT and EVT-R1 lay the foundation for ecological discovery and marine education, fostering the development of VLMs capable of interpreting marine dynamics, reasoning about ecological interactions, and supporting sustainable ocean video understanding and analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向海洋视频理解的事件中心数据集MarineEVT（含20K多任务问答对），并基于该数据集设计了事件中心视觉工具集成推理方法EVT-R1，通过视觉工具引导模型定位和解释关键信息。在11个SOTA VLM对比中，EVT-R1分别超越最优开源和商业模型5.22和11.09个点。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型在视频领域表现下降，主要源于时序理解需求与大规模标注视频数据的匮乏。而海洋视频理解更具挑战性：需要领域专业知识，且信息事件稀疏、不可预测、分布不均匀，视频VLM难以定位和解释关键信息。
AI.method: 1) 构建MarineEVT数据集：首个事件中心海洋视频理解数据集，含20K多任务视频级视觉问答对；2) 提出EVT-R1方法：事件中心视觉工具集成推理，利用强大的视觉工具驱动模型定位和解释与视觉问题和人类意图一致的关键信息。
AI.result: 在11个SOTA VLM的对比实验中，EVT-R1超越最优开源模型5.22个点，超越最优商业模型11.09个点。
AI.conclusion: MarineEVT和EVT-R1为生态发现和海洋教育奠定基础，推动了能够解释海洋动态、推理生态交互、支持可持续海洋视频理解与分析的方向发展。

title: E-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-Step Tool-Use Agents in Real-World Product Scenarios
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that interact with stateful environments over multiple steps: gathering hidden information, composing tool calls, and committing state changes. We refer to this capability as multi-step tool use. Existing benchmarks have advanced tool-use agent evaluation, but often focus on isolated API calls, short trajectories, or settings that are difficult to scale or control. We introduce E-Bench, a fully synthetic benchmark with 323 state-changing tasks across three product domains: Honor of Kings, QQ Music, and Tencent Meeting. E-Bench decouples environment synthesis from task synthesis: graph-guided database filling builds reusable, orphan-free product environments, while generator-solver asymmetry creates tasks with both an information gap and a tool gap, requiring agents to discover hidden data and compose multiple tool calls before changing state. Outcomes are graded deterministically by database-state diffs. Since both environments and tasks are synthetic, E-Bench is controllable at the environment level and scalable at the task level. Benchmarking 11 cutting-edge LLMs shows that multi-step tool use remains challenging: Pass^3 stays below 60% for the strongest models, and even with code execution in the E-Bench-Code extension, reliability (Pass^3) remains below 70%.

AI.tldr: E-Bench是一个全合成基准，包含323个多步骤工具使用任务，涵盖三个产品领域。通过图引导的数据库填充和生成器-求解器不对称机制创建任务，对11个前沿LLM的评估显示，最强模型在Pass^3指标上低于60%，多步骤工具使用仍然具有挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多聚焦于单步API调用或短轨迹，缺乏可扩展、可控的多步骤工具使用评估，难以真实反映LLM在与状态化环境交互时的能力。
AI.method: E-Bench采用全合成方案：图引导的数据库填充构建可复用、无孤项的产品环境；生成器-求解器不对称机制创建同时存在信息鸿沟和工具鸿沟的任务；通过数据库状态差异进行确定性评分。
AI.result: 11个前沿LLM在E-Bench上的Pass^3指标均低于60%，E-Bench-Code扩展下也低于70%，表明多步骤工具使用仍是LLM面临的重大挑战。
AI.conclusion: 多步骤工具使用对当前最强LLM仍具挑战性，E-Bench可作为该能力的有效评估基准。

title: When Low CER is Not Enough: An Analysis of Hallucinations in Vision-Language OCR Systems on Historical Uruguayan Documents
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is a key component in the digitization of historical archives. Recently, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have emerged as strong alternatives to traditional OCR systems, achieving state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. However, their suitability for archival transcription remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we benchmark traditional OCR systems and VLM-based approaches on the Berrutti dataset, a challenging collection of Uruguayan dictatorship-era documents derived from microfilm scans. While VLMs consistently outperform traditional methods in terms of Character Error Rate (CER) and Word Error Rate (WER), we show that these improvements hide a more complex picture. Through a detailed qualitative analysis, we uncover systematic failure modes that are invisible to standard metrics, including orthographic normalization, spurious content generation, and semantic substitutions that preserve fluency while altering meaning. Errors affecting named entities are particularly critical, as they can introduce substantial semantic distortions with minimal impact on CER and WER. These findings reveal a critical gap between quantitative OCR performance and transcription fidelity in real-world archival settings, and highlight the need for evaluation frameworks that go beyond character-level accuracy to capture the semantic reliability of generated transcriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文在乌拉圭独裁时期档案数据集Berrutti上对比了传统OCR系统和视觉语言模型（VLM）的转录表现。尽管VLM在字符错误率（CER）和词错误率（WER）上优于传统方法，但定性分析揭示了VLM存在正字法规范化、虚假内容生成和语义替换等系统性错误模式，这些错误对标准指标不敏感，尤其影响命名实体，导致语义扭曲。研究表明定量OCR性能与转录保真度之间存在显著差距，需建立超越字符级精度的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在OCR标准基准上取得了最先进性能，但其在真实历史档案转录场景中的适用性尚未得到充分理解，尤其是定量指标可能掩盖关键的错误模式。
AI.method: 在Berrutti数据集（乌拉圭独裁时期微胶片扫描文档）上，对比传统OCR系统与VLM方法的字符错误率（CER）和词错误率（WER），并进行详细的定性错误分析。
AI.result: VLM在CER和WER上持续优于传统方法，但定性分析发现其存在正字法规范化、虚假内容生成和流畅性保持的语义替换等系统性失败模式；命名实体错误虽对CER/WER影响小，却导致严重语义扭曲。
AI.conclusion: 定量OCR性能与转录保真度之间存在关键差距，需要建立超越字符级准确率、能够捕捉转录语义可靠性的评估框架。

title: Training Language Models to Cooperate with Inference-Time Controllers
summary: Large language model (LLM) performance increasingly depends not only on the base model, but also on the inference-time controller used to organize reasoning. Existing post-training methods, however, typically optimize for a single fixed interaction pattern, despite real deployments relying on diverse controllers such as Chain-of-Thought, self-consistency, debate, planning, and verification pipelines. This creates a training--deployment mismatch and limits transfer to new workflows. We introduce CALM (Controller-Aware Language Models), a post-training framework that explicitly places controllers in the training loop. We formulate controller-aware post-training as multi-task reinforcement learning over controller-induced interaction protocols, where controllers are compositions of reusable local reasoning modules. This structure also induces a module-level decomposition of mixed-controller training under a turn-level GRPO objective, enabling a systematic study of controller and module-aware training strategies. We evaluate CALM on held-out controller compositions and broader controller shifts, showing that controller-aware post-training improves generalization across inference-time workflows beyond single-controller optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出CALM框架，通过在训练循环中显式引入控制器（如CoT、self-consistency、debate、planning等），利用多任务强化学习和模块级分解，解决后训练阶段单一控制器与部署阶段多样化控制器之间的不匹配问题，提升跨推理工作流的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练方法通常针对单一的固定交互模式进行优化，而实际部署中需要使用多样化的推理控制器（如Chain-of-Thought、self-consistency、debate、planning、verification等），导致训练与部署之间的不匹配，限制了模型向新工作流的迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出CALM（Controller-Aware Language Models）后训练框架，将控制器显式纳入训练循环。将控制器感知的后训练形式化为控制器诱导交互协议上的多任务强化学习问题，其中控制器是可复用的局部推理模块的组合。利用模块级分解在轮次级GRPO目标下实现混合控制器训练，系统研究控制器和模块感知的训练策略。
AI.result: 在保留的控制器组合和更广泛的控制器迁移场景上评估，表明控制器感知的后训练相比单一控制器优化，能够提升跨推理工作流的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式考虑推理控制器的多样性进行后训练，可以有效缓解训练-部署不匹配问题，使LLM更好地适应多样化的推理工作流。

title: Cascade Forgery Mining Network for Fingerprint Presentation Attack Detection
summary: Fingerprint Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) is a critical component of fingerprint identification systems, serving as a protective measure against unauthorized access. In this paper, we observe that different regions of a fingerprint image can exhibit varying Artifact Extraction Difficulty (AED), with high-AED regions requiring more sophisticated extraction mechanisms to capture more subtle discriminative evidence. To address this issue, we propose to quantify AED using local Gabor feature certainty and partition fingerprint images into multiple regions based on their respective AED values. We then propose an AED guided Cascade Forgery Mining Network (CFM-Net) that employs an adaptive-depth feature extraction architecture to detect more precise and comprehensive artifact evidence across regions with heterogeneous AED values. Furthermore, we introduce an Orientation Guided Adversarial Training (OGAT) module to filter out identity information from PAD features while preserving the integrity of original artifact evidence. Experimental evaluations on LivDet datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our approach compared to state-of-the-art methods and achieve significant improvement in the classification ability of high AED fingerprints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于人为提取难度（AED）引导的级联伪造挖掘网络（CFM-Net）用于指纹呈现攻击检测，通过局部Gabor特征确定AED并分区，结合自适应深度特征提取和方向引导对抗训练（OGAT），在LivDet数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 指纹图像不同区域呈现不同的人为提取难度（AED），高AED区域需要更精细的提取机制才能捕获微弱的鉴别证据，现有方法缺乏针对区域异质性的处理策略。
AI.method: 1) 使用局部Gabor特征确定度量化AED；2) 根据AED值对指纹图像进行区域划分；3) 提出AED引导的级联伪造挖掘网络（CFM-Net），采用自适应深度特征提取架构；4) 引入方向引导对抗训练（OGAT）模块，滤除身份信息并保留原始伪造证据的完整性。
AI.result: 在LivDet数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法优于现有最先进方法，并在高AED指纹的分类能力上取得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过AED引导的区域自适应特征提取和身份信息过滤，有效提升了指纹呈现攻击检测性能，尤其在高难度伪造样本的识别上表现突出。

title: From RLVR to RLSVR: Task Transformation Induces Self-Verifiable Rewards for Open-Ended LLM Self-Improvement
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has driven recent progress in reasoning-oriented large language models (LLMs) by enabling large-scale optimization. However, its applicability remains largely limited to domains such as mathematics and coding, where correctness can be deterministically verified. Open-ended tasks instead often rely on human preferences, reward models, or LLM-based judges, introducing evaluation bias, judge capability bottlenecks, and additional inference costs.Drawing on the principle of self-supervised learning, which constructs pretext tasks to derive supervision from the data itself, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Self-Verifiable Rewards (RLSVR), a task-transformation-based training paradigm for extending RLVR to open-ended tasks. RLSVR transforms open-ended tasks into verifiable proxy environments whose internal rules and interaction outcomes automatically generate reward signals. We instantiate RLSVR with SpyRL, a multi-agent self-play environment inspired by Who Is the Spy?. Agents receive asymmetric information, complete the same target task, and vote to identify a designated spy. Because the spy identity is predetermined, voting outcomes provide fully verifiable rewards, while successful identification remains closely related to output quality. Experiments on text summarization, creative writing, and mathematical reasoning show that SpyRL outperforms existing self-improvement methods on non-verifiable tasks and yields consistent gains on verifiable reasoning tasks. These results demonstrate that task transformation can extend scalable RLVR-based self-improvement beyond inherently verifiable domains. Models and code have been released at https://github.com/wangqinsi1/SpyRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLSVR框架，通过任务转换将开放式任务转化为可验证的代理环境，并实例化为SpyRL多智能体自博弈方法，在文本摘要、创意写作和数学推理任务中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的RLVR方法仅适用于数学和编程等可确定性验证的领域，而开放式任务依赖人类偏好、奖励模型或LLM评判器，存在评估偏差、评判能力瓶颈和额外推理成本等问题。
AI.method: 提出RLSVR（Reinforcement Learning with Self-Verifiable Rewards），基于自监督学习思想，通过任务转换将开放式任务转化为可验证的代理环境。具体实例化为SpyRL，一种受"谁是卧底"游戏启发的多智能体自博弈框架：智能体接收不对称信息，完成相同目标任务后进行投票识别卧底，投票结果提供完全可验证的奖励信号。
AI.result: 在文本摘要、创意写作和数学推理任务上，SpyRL在非可验证任务上优于现有自我改进方法，在可验证推理任务上也有持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 任务转换可以将可扩展的基于RLVR的自我改进扩展到超越固有可验证领域的范围，为开放式任务的强化学习优化提供了新范式。

title: ReflexTrack: A Feedback-Driven Agent for Training-Free Referring Video Object Segmentation
summary: Referring video object segmentation (RVOS) requires segmenting a target specified by natural language throughout a video. Recent agentic approaches combine multimodal large language models with promptable segmentation models to perform RVOS without task-specific training. However, most pipelines rely on one-shot spatial grounding followed by mask propagation, leaving both the initial prompts and temporal predictions largely unverified. We introduce ReflexTrack, a training-free, feedback-driven agent that closes this loop at both spatial and temporal levels. Mask-guided Spatial Refinement evaluates the mask induced by the current keyframe prompt and iteratively updates the bounding box together with positive and negative points, yielding a more reliable initialization. Video-level Mask Reflection assesses the complete mask sequence, localizes unreliable intervals, selects complementary repair keyframes, and generates candidate predictions through mask-guided re-propagation. Only candidates that provide a verified improvement are used to update the affected intervals, preserving reliable predictions elsewhere. All components remain frozen during inference. ReflexTrack achieves an overall $\mathcal{Q}$ score of $69.7$ on Ref-VPS and a $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ score of $67.2$ on ReasonVOS. These results demonstrate that prediction-level feedback substantially improves the reliability of training-free RVOS.

AI.tldr: ReflexTrack是一种无需训练、基于反馈的智能体方法，通过空间级遮罩引导细化（Mask-guided Spatial Refinement）和时间级视频遮罩反思（Video-level Mask Reflection）两个闭环反馈机制，显著提升了无训练RVOS的可靠性，在Ref-VPS和ReasonVOS上取得了领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于智能体的RVOS方法依赖单次空间定位加遮罩传播，初始提示和时间预测均未得到验证，导致可靠性不足。作者希望在不进行任务特定训练的前提下，通过反馈机制闭环验证和修正空间定位与时间预测，提升无训练RVOS的可靠性。
AI.method: ReflexTrack包含两个核心模块：(1) 遮罩引导空间细化（Mask-guided Spatial Refinement）：基于当前关键帧提示生成的遮罩，迭代更新边界框及正负点，获得更可靠的初始化；(2) 视频级遮罩反思（Video-level Mask Reflection）：评估完整遮罩序列，定位不可靠区间，选择互补修复关键帧，通过遮罩引导重新传播生成候选预测，仅采纳经验证改进的候选结果更新受影响区间。
AI.result: 在Ref-VPS上总体Q分数达69.7，在ReasonVOS上J&F分数达67.2。
AI.conclusion: 预测级反馈机制能显著提升无训练RVOS的可靠性，验证了闭环反馈在无训练视频目标分割中的有效性。

title: ACM: Agentic Context Management for Long Horizon Tasks
summary: Agentic tasks are inherently long-horizon and multi-turn, constantly accumulating context through interactions with the environment. Existing context compression methods inevitably incur information loss and are triggered by rigid heuristic rules, leaving them misaligned with the agent's evolving reasoning focus. We propose Agentic Context Management (ACM), a framework that equips agents with purpose-built context editing tools for lossless context management. Inspired by the interaction between short-term and long-term human memory, the agent autonomously decides when to compress its context, offloads discarded content to an external memory system, and queries it on demand for later retrieval. Building on this framework, we further develop a post-training pipeline that constructs high-quality demonstrations of context management and improves model performance on both agentic search and coding tasks. Further analysis reveals that effective context management reduces peak token pressure, enables extended explorations, and yields more consistent solutions across independent trials. Code, data, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/lixiaochuan2020/agentic-context-management.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic Context Management (ACM)框架，让智能体像人类记忆那样自主管理上下文：无损压缩、外部存储、按需检索，并通过后训练管道提升搜索和编码任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文压缩方法存在信息损失，且依赖僵化的启发式规则，无法与智能体不断演化的推理焦点对齐，导致长程、多轮交互的智能体任务中上下文管理效率低下。
AI.method: 受人类短时/长时记忆交互启发，ACM赋予智能体自主的上下文编辑工具：1) 自主决定何时压缩上下文；2) 将丢弃内容无损卸载到外部记忆系统；3) 按需查询检索。此外构建后训练管道，生成高质量的上下文管理示范数据来微调模型。
AI.result: 在智能体搜索和编码任务上性能提升；有效降低峰值token压力；支持更长的探索轨迹；在独立试验中产生更一致的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: ACM通过类人记忆机制实现了无损、自适应的上下文管理，为长程智能体任务提供了高效且稳定的解决方案。

title: LU-500: A Logo Benchmark for Concept Unlearning
summary: Concept unlearning is increasingly used to limit the reproduction of protected or unsafe visual concepts in text-to-image models. Existing evaluations, however, mostly study targets that dominate the whole image, such as styles, broad object categories, or portrait-like identities, leaving company logos comparatively underexamined. Logos create a different failure mode: a small localized mark can carry the entire protected concept, must be visually precise to remain recognizable, and can be triggered implicitly by products, storefronts, packaging, or advertisements even when the word ``logo'' is absent. We introduce LU-500, a logo-unlearning benchmark built from Fortune Global 500 companies to study this localized and semantically entangled setting. LU-500 contains nearly 10,000 curated text-query and logo-image pairs, with an explicit track (LUex-500) and an implicit contextual track (LUim-500). To avoid reducing the task to a binary detector score, we define a multi-grained protocol that evaluates both local logo removal and global image preservation in pixel and latent spaces. Experiments on representative inference-time methods, including NP, SLD, and SEGA, and compatible fine-tuning-based methods such as ESD and Forget-Me-Not, show that the evaluated methods struggle to remove logo evidence without changing non-target content. We further analyze ProLU, a prompt-space multi-agent baseline: it improves local erasure by removing logo-inducing semantics, but also illustrates why prompt filtering is not a substitute for weight-level disentanglement. Correlation analyses over logo area, location, and structural complexity suggest that future logo unlearning may need spatially aware controls, such as SSIM-guided constraints, rather than purely global concept suppression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LU-500，一个基于财富世界500强公司标识的徽标去学习基准数据集，包含近10,000个图文对，分为显式（LUex-500）和隐式上下文（LUim-500）两个轨道。实验表明现有方法难以在去除徽标的同时保持非目标内容不变，未来需要空间感知控制而非全局概念抑制。
AI.motivation: 现有概念去学习评估主要针对主导整幅图像的目标（如风格、物体类别、肖像），而对公司徽标这类局部化、小尺寸、语义纠缠的受保护概念研究不足。徽标具有局部标记承载完整概念、需视觉精度保持可识别性、可通过产品/店面/包装等隐式触发等独特失效模式。
AI.method: 构建LU-500基准数据集，包含显式轨道（LUex-500，提及"logo"）和隐式上下文轨道（LUim-500，通过产品/品牌等间接触发）；设计多粒度评估协议，在像素和潜空间中同时评估局部徽标移除和全局图像保持效果；对推理时方法（NP、SLD、SEGA）和微调方法（ESD、Forget-Me-Not）进行实验，并分析ProLU提示空间多智能体基线。
AI.result: 现有方法难以在去除徽标证据的同时不改变非目标内容；ProLU通过移除徽标诱导语义改善了局部擦除，但提示过滤无法替代权重级解纠缠；徽标面积、位置和结构复杂度与去学习效果存在相关性。
AI.conclusion: 未来徽标去学习可能需要空间感知控制（如SSIM引导约束），而非纯粹的全局概念抑制。

title: Do Visual Features Improve Other-Initiated Repair Detection? A Dyadic Multimodal Approach
comment: Accepted to ICMI 2026 (International Conference on Multimodal Interaction), October 5-9, 2026, Napoli, Italy
summary: Other-initiated Self-repair, or in short Other-initiated Repair (OIR), is an essential mechanism in conversational interaction, whereby a recipient signals a problem in speaking, hearing, or understanding, prompting the previous speaker to resolve it. In the case of conversational agents, it is essential to accurately identify these repair initiation strategies to address communication breakdowns efficiently. While conversational analysis studies have shown that OIR initiation is accompanied by both verbal and non-verbal signals such as gaze shifts, facial expressions, body postures, and hand gestures, existing computational approaches rely mainly on text and audio. This paper introduces a novel multimodal model for OIR detection and classification, incorporating a set of visual features drawn from conversation analysis. We evaluate our approach on two corpora with distinct languages and interaction settings. Results demonstrate that visual information consistently improves performance over text and audio baselines, and provide insights into cross-modal feature contributions across two corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合视觉特征的多模态模型用于检测和分类他人引发的自我修复（OIR），在两个不同语言和交互场景的语料库上验证了视觉信息能够持续提升基于文本和音频的基线性能。
AI.motivation: 现有计算方法主要依赖文本和音频，忽略了对话分析研究中发现的视觉信号（如注视转移、面部表情、身体姿势和手势）在OIR识别中的重要作用，因此需要引入多模态方法以更准确地识别修复启动策略。
AI.method: 基于对话分析提取的视觉特征，构建多模态模型用于OIR检测与分类，在两种语言和交互场景不同的语料库上进行评估。
AI.result: 视觉信息在文本和音频基线之上持续提升了OIR检测与分类的性能，揭示了跨模态特征在不同语料库中的贡献差异。
AI.conclusion: 多模态（特别是视觉信息）对OIR检测与分类任务具有显著价值，为会话智能体更高效地处理沟通障碍提供了新思路。

title: BeyondFusion: Self-Aligned Latent Diffusion for Calibration-Free Infrared Super-Resolution and Infrared-Visible Fusion
summary: Mobile infrared-visible imaging typically pairs a compact infrared sensor with a high-resolution visible camera for complementary perception. While cross-sensor misalignment caused by different optics, viewpoints, fields of view, and exposure timings hinders practical deployment. In this paper, we propose BeyondFusion, a unified latent diffusion framework for calibration-free visible-guided infrared super-resolution and infrared-visible fusion tasks. The proposed framework supports both task-specific training and joint training where two tasks are optimized and executed as two readouts of the same generative process. Instead of relying on explicit registration or geometric warping, BeyondFusion introduces a cross-modal self-aligning (CMSA) module into the denoising U-Net. CMSA reorganizes infrared and visible latent tokens into a shared attention space to learn content-adaptive cross-modal correspondence during the denoising process. Together with misalignment augmentation module, the model is facilitated to exploit visible structural and semantic cues while preserving thermal consistency, enabling high-frequency infrared reconstruction and informative fused-image generation under uncalibrated conditions. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and a mobile infrared-visible imaging system show strong performance across aligned inputs, low-resolution infrared observations, synthetic misalignments, and real mobile captures with unsynchronized sensors. Ablation studies, unified training analysis, and downstream pedestrian detection further validate the effectiveness of BeyondFusion for calibration-free multimodal imaging.

AI.tldr: BeyondFusion提出了一种统一的潜扩散框架，通过交叉模态自对齐模块，无需显式配准即可实现无校准的可见光引导红外超分辨率和红外-可见光融合任务。
AI.motivation: 移动红外-可见光成像中，不同传感器因光学、视点、视场和曝光时间差异导致的交叉传感器未对齐问题严重阻碍了实际部署，现有方法依赖显式配准或几何校正，缺乏无校准的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出BeyondFusion统一潜扩散框架，包含：(1) CMSA模块，在去噪U-Net中将红外和可见光潜特征重组到共享注意力空间，学习内容自适应跨模态对应关系；(2) 未对齐增强模块，帮助模型利用可见光结构和语义线索同时保持热一致性；(3) 支持单任务训练和联合训练两种模式。
AI.result: 在公开基准和移动红外-可见光成像系统上，对对齐输入、低分辨率红外、合成未对齐和真实未同步传感器数据均表现出强性能；消融实验、统一训练分析和下游行人检测进一步验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: BeyondFusion实现了无需校准的多模态成像，能有效处理未对齐条件下的高频红外重建和信息融合，为移动红外-可见光系统提供了实用解决方案。

title: Understanding Human-like Solutions in Combinatorial Optimization via Learning and Search
summary: Humans often find good solutions to combinatorial optimization problems that are computationally hard even for advanced computer algorithms. In the Euclidean traveling salesman problems (TSP), people rapidly produce tours that are near-optimal, despite severe limits on time and computation. What makes a tour human-like, and how might such solutions be learned? Here we address these questions through a large-scale behavioral and computational investigation of human performance in Euclidean TSP. We sampled a broad space of TSP instances, collected human solutions, and compared them with neural policies based on Pointer Networks, which are recurrent neural networks with an attention-based pointing mechanism that define probability distributions over valid tours. We trained these networks under multiple objectives, including reinforcement learning (RL), supervised learning from optimal tours, supervised learning from human tours, and RL fine-tuning after optimal-supervised pretraining. Human tours were not identical to optimal tours, but occupied a near-optimal geometric basin: they shared many structural properties with optimal solutions while preserving systematic human-specific deviations. The best account of human tours was not direct imitation of optimal tours, but a model pretrained on optimal tours, fine-tuned by RL, and decoded through $\text{Best-of-}N$ sampling. These findings suggest that human-like solutions may emerge from a combination of structured supervised learning, RL, and test-time search, echoing computational principles underlying many modern artificial intelligence systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模行为与计算研究，分析了人类在欧几里得旅行商问题（TSP）中表现出的近优解。人类产生的路线虽非最优，但共享了最优解的结构特性，同时存在系统性偏差。研究发现，最能解释人类路线的模型是先通过最优解进行监督预训练、再经强化学习微调、并在解码时采用Best-of-N采样的Pointer Networks，表明人类求解过程可能结合了结构化监督学习、强化学习和搜索机制。
AI.motivation: 探究人类在求解欧几里得TSP这类计算困难组合优化问题时，为何能快速产生近优解；以及什么样的人类求解模式可以被学习，从而揭示人类智能与AI系统之间的计算原理联系。
AI.method: 大规模采样TSP实例，收集人类解并与基于Pointer Networks的神经策略进行比较；训练策略时使用多种目标：强化学习（RL）、从最优解监督学习、从人类解监督学习、以及最优监督预训练后RL微调。
AI.result: 人类解并非最优解，但处于近优几何盆地，与最优解共享结构特性同时存在系统偏差。最优监督预训练+RL微调+Best-of-N解码的模型最佳解释了人类行为，而非直接模仿最优解或人类解。
AI.conclusion: 人类求解过程可能融合了结构化监督学习、强化学习和测试时搜索，这与现代AI系统的计算原理相呼应。

title: ViDS: Video Diffusion Shader using 3D Face Tracking
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, and 8 tables. Project page: https://fusheng-ji.github.io/ViDS/
summary: We introduce ViDS, a Video Diffusion Shader that leverages 3D face tracking for expressive and identity-preserving portrait animation. We first reconstruct the identity-specific 3DMM mesh from the reference image, and then animate it using expression and pose parameters from a driving video. Leveraging dense geometric cues from 3DMM normal maps, we employ a video diffusion model as a neural shader to synthesize lifelike portrait animations while preserving the appearance and identity of the reference image. We find that more accurate 3DMM tracking enables finer-grained expression control. We also introduce an autoregressive diffusion sampling process that extends generation beyond the model's native window while reducing discontinuities between adjacent clips. Compared with prior diffusion-based approaches for portrait animation that rely on landmark-based conditioning or implicit motion latents, our method achieves more detailed and consistent expression and pose control while faithfully preserving identity and appearance. Detailed ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our design choices. Project page: https://fusheng-ji.github.io/ViDS/

AI.tldr: ViDS是一种基于3D人脸跟踪的视频扩散着色器，用于表情丰富且身份保持的肖像动画生成，通过3DMM网格重建、法线图密集几何线索和自回归扩散采样，实现了比基于地标或隐式运动潜变量的方法更精细的表情和姿态控制。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的肖像动画方法多依赖于地标（landmark）条件或隐式运动潜变量，难以实现精细的表情和姿态控制，同时在身份和外观保持方面存在不足。
AI.method: 1) 从参考图像重建身份特定的3DMM网格；2) 用驱动视频的表情和姿态参数驱动网格；3) 利用3DMM法线图的密集几何线索，将视频扩散模型作为神经着色器合成逼真动画；4) 引入自回归扩散采样过程，扩展生成长度并减少相邻片段的不连续性。
AI.result: 相比基于地标条件或隐式运动潜变量的扩散方法，ViDS在表情和姿态控制上更精细、更一致，同时更好地保持了身份和外观。消融实验验证了各设计选择的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 更精确的3DMM跟踪能够实现更细粒度的表情控制；结合3DMM法线图作为几何条件的视频扩散模型是肖像动画的有效范式。

title: Cost-Aware Recovery-Pathway Identification and Bayesian Optimization for Autonomous Materials Discovery
summary: Autonomous laboratories automate experimental execution, but a campaign must also decide which recovery pathway merits optimization. We formulate this as a sequential decision problem with a discrete pathway-identification stage and a continuous within-pathway optimization stage under heterogeneous experimental costs. Our implementation, Coactive learning, combines a cost-sensitive Bayesian hypothesis-discrimination policy motivated by EC2 (Golovin et al., 2010) with Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization (Srinivas et al., 2010). Under explicitly stated assumptions, the expected spend of one fixed-budget campaign attempt is bounded by the expected pathway-identification cost plus the capped within-pathway optimization budget. We evaluate the method on synthetic benchmarks constrained by selected results reported for PNNL's CICERO selective-precipitation study (Ritchhart et al., 2026). The method performs comparably to an oracle-pathway Bayesian-optimization reference and to a strong split-plate baseline that discriminates pathways with its first plate, without receiving an oracle label for the correct pathway. It is given a candidate hypothesis space and a diagnostic likelihood model. On an NdFeB-inspired instance, it avoids the simulated penalty of a commit-first baseline that initially selects a plausible but inferior hydroxide pathway. This hypothetical wrong-first-commitment scenario is motivated by the hydroxide-oxalate performance contrast reported by CICERO. We characterize the sensitivity of these conclusions to the assumed cost model. The code and benchmark are open source.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Coactive Learning方法，将自主实验室中的实验流程优化建模为两阶段序贯决策问题（离散通路识别+连续通路内优化），结合成本敏感的贝叶斯假设鉴别（EC2）和高斯过程贝叶斯优化，在固定预算下实现可比拟Oracle方法的性能，并成功避免了“先承诺后优化”策略在错误通路上的惩罚。
AI.motivation: 自主实验室不仅需要自动化执行实验，还需要决策哪条回收路径值得优化。现有方法多关注单一路径内的优化，缺乏对多条潜在路径进行成本有效的通道路径识别与优化的统一框架。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为具有离散通路识别阶段和连续通路内优化阶段的序贯决策问题，提出Coactive Learning，结合EC2的代价敏感贝叶斯假设鉴别策略与高斯过程贝叶斯优化，在明确假设下给出固定预算的期望开销上界。
AI.result: 在PNNL CICERO选择性沉淀研究的合成基准上，该方法性能与通路已知的Bayesian优化参考及强split-plate基线相当；在NdFeB场景中成功避免先承诺氢氧化铈通路的惩罚。
AI.conclusion: Coactive Learning在无需Oracle提供正确通路标签的条件下，能够有效权衡通路识别与通路内优化的成本，其结论对成本模型假设的敏感性进行了分析，代码与基准已开源。

title: LoTA-N2N: Local Trace Adaptation for Zero-Shot Self-Supervised Image Denoising
summary: Single-image self-supervised denoising replaces unavailable clean targets with surrogate targets constructed from noisy observations. Its effectiveness therefore depends on how closely the surrogate objective remains aligned with supervised denoising, especially when noise is correlated, spatially nonstationary, or unknown. We express the discrepancy between a broad class of MSE-based self-supervised objectives and supervised MSE as a parameter-independent constant and a trace interaction between the surrogate-target residual and the prediction error. The corresponding gradient discrepancy is determined by the gradient of this interaction. This formulation provides a common view of paired-noise, blind-spot, weak-noise, re-corruption, and sub-image methods, while revealing that a small global interaction may conceal substantial positive and negative regional interactions through spatial cancellation. Building on these observations, we propose LoTA-N2N, a two-stage zero-shot adaptation framework. Stage 1 trains a denoiser on complementary sub-image pairs and freezes it to construct detached clean-sub-image proxies. Stage 2 estimates the residual--prediction interaction using these proxies and suppresses its patch-wise absolute magnitude. We show that the local construction prevents spatial cancellation and upper-bounds the magnitude of the corresponding global interaction. Experiments across natural, confocal, and X-ray images, complemented by iteration-matched controls, controlled noise shifts, and gradient diagnostics, show consistent gains over MSE-only adaptation under IID, spatially varying, and mixed noise. Overall, LoTA-N2N demonstrates that estimated local interaction and spatial cancellation control provide effective design principles for single-image self-supervised denoising without paired clean targets, repeated acquisitions, or a predefined re-corruption model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoTA-N2N，一种两阶段零样本自适应去噪框架，通过构造局部残差-预测交互项并抑制其逐块绝对值来消除空间抵消效应，从而提升单图像自监督去噪在相关、非平稳及未知噪声下的性能。
AI.motivation: 单图像自监督去噪依赖从含噪观测构造的代理目标，但当噪声相关、空间非平稳或未知时，代理目标与有监督去噪目标之间存在偏差。现有方法缺乏对这种偏差的统一刻画，且空间抵消效应可能导致全局交互小但局部交互大的问题。
AI.method: 首先将基于MSE的自监督目标与有监督MSE之间的差异形式化为参数无关常数与代理目标残差-预测误差迹交互项之和。基于此分析，提出LoTA-N2N两阶段框架：阶段1在互补子图像对上训练去噪器并冻结，构造分离的干净子图像代理；阶段2利用这些代理估计残差-预测交互，并抑制其逐块绝对值大小。
AI.result: 在自然图像、共聚焦显微镜图像和X射线图像上，通过迭代匹配对照、受控噪声偏移和梯度诊断实验，LoTA-N2N在IID、空间变化和混合噪声下均一致优于纯MSE自适应方法。
AI.conclusion: 估计局部交互并控制空间抵消效应为单图像自监督去噪提供了有效的设计原则，无需配对干净目标、多次采集或预定义重污染模型。

title: GOTS: Greedy Orthogonal Token Selection for High-Resolution Vision-Language Models
summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on dynamic or high-resolution visual encoding, producing thousands of visual tokens that substantially increase downstream language-model inference cost. Existing token-reduction methods assess token utility through token-wise importance, query relevance, coverage, pairwise diversity, or subset-level objectives. Our key insight is to view visual token reduction through selected-span complementarity: instead of scoring a token in isolation or through pairwise relations, we assess how much of its feature is orthogonal to the span of the already retained subset. Based on this perspective, we propose Greedy Orthogonal Token Selection (GOTS), a training-free and query-agnostic method. At each step, GOTS selects the token with the largest residual energy orthogonal to the current retained span. This rule exactly maximizes the one-step augmented Gram determinant among candidate additions, giving each greedy step a precise local geometric guarantee for subset expansion. Across five high-resolution VLM backbones from the Qwen-VL and InternVL families and eleven diverse benchmarks, GOTS achieves higher average performance retention than the strongest evaluated baselines, and a controlled OCRBench study shows that it reduces model-side time-to-first-token after accounting for selection overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/newLLing/GOTS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Greedy Orthogonal Token Selection (GOTS)，一种无需训练、不依赖查询的视觉token缩减方法。它基于正交补空间视角，每次贪心选择与已保留子集张成空间正交残差能量最大的token，从而最大化一步Gram行列式增量。在Qwen-VL和InternVL系列共5个高分辨率VLM骨干及11个基准上，GOTS的平均性能保持率优于最强基线，且OCRBench实验表明其可降低模型侧首次输出延迟。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率VLM产生大量视觉token（数千个），显著增加下游语言模型推理成本。现有token缩减方法基于token重要性、查询相关性、覆盖度、成对多样性或子集级目标来评估token效用，但缺乏从所选子集补空间的正交性角度进行全局几何优化的视角。
AI.method: GOTS将视觉token缩减建模为选择补空间正交性最大化问题。核心规则是：每一步选择与已保留token张成空间正交残差能量最大的token，该规则等价于最大化候选token加入后Gram行列式的一步增量，保证局部几何最优性。方法无需训练，不依赖查询，为纯贪心几何选择策略。
AI.result: 在5个高分辨率VLM骨干（Qwen-VL和InternVL系列）和11个多样化基准上，GOTS的平均性能保持率优于所有对比基线。OCRBench的受控实验显示，计入选择开销后，GOTS仍能降低模型侧首次输出时间。
AI.conclusion: GOTS通过正交补空间视角为视觉token缩减提供了新的几何思路，其贪心策略具有明确的局部最优保证，在多个高分辨率VLM上实现了更好的性能-效率权衡。

title: Image Inpainting via Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Image inpainting aims to recover missing regions while preserving structural consistency. We propose a non-parametric method without network training based on data-guided stochastic dynamics. Starting from a masked image, the missing pixels are evolved through a reverse-time stochastic differential equation with a kernel-weighted correction estimated directly from a reference dataset. This empirical correction guides the reconstruction toward high-density regions of the data distribution without training a neural network or fitting a parametric density model. Experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and MVTec show that the proposed method outperforms Mean Fill, Telea, and Navier-Stokes inpainting in PSNR, SSIM, and visual quality. On CelebA, it remains competitive and produces plausible completions for structure-sensitive occlusions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of empirical reference statistics as a non-parametric prior for image inpainting.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需网络训练的非参数图像修复方法，基于数据引导的随机微分方程，利用参考数据集的核加权校正来恢复缺失区域。
AI.motivation: 现有图像修复方法通常依赖深度学习网络训练，计算成本高且需要大量标注数据。本文旨在探索无需训练的非参数化先验，仅利用参考数据的统计信息引导修复过程。
AI.method: 从带掩码图像出发，通过逆时随机微分方程演化缺失像素，其中校正项直接从参考数据集估计得到，使用核函数加权的方式引导重建结果趋向数据分布的高密度区域。
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和MVTec上，PSNR、SSIM和视觉质量均优于Mean Fill、Telea和Navier-Stokes方法；在CelebA上表现具有竞争力，能对结构敏感遮挡产生合理补全。
AI.conclusion: 经验参考统计量可作为有效的非参数先验用于图像修复，证明了无需网络训练的随机动力学方法在实际应用中的可行性。

title: UniGen-AR: Unifying Visual Generation with Auto-Regressive Modeling
summary: Modern computer vision pipelines remain fragmented, with tasks such as text-to-image generation, editing, restoration, and classical perception handled by separate models. We study Unified Visual Generation (UVG), where a single model produces diverse image-valued outputs through a unified multimodal interface. While diffusion-based systems dominate UVG due to strong quality and controllability, their iterative sampling incurs substantial inference latency, limiting practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose UniGen-AR, a framework that pairs a general-purpose multi-modal language model (MLLM) with an efficient next-scale visual auto-regressive (VAR) decoder. This design retains the flexibility of MLLM-based conditioning while leveraging the sampling efficiency and latent unification properties of VAR models. In our framework, the MLLM encodes free-form instructions and control signals into a unified sequence, which guides the VAR decoder to generate image-valued outputs for over 15 tasks spanning four families. Empirically, UniGen-AR achieves up to $19 \times$ lower inference latency than diffusion-based baselines while maintaining or improving output quality. Our ablations further reveal that VQ-VAE tokenizer design, particularly codebook size and hierarchy, is a critical factor for VAR scalability in UVG. These results establish visual auto-regressive modeling as a compelling and efficient backbone for unified visual generation. Our project page is at https://zpbao.github.io/projects/unigenar.

AI.tldr: UniGen-AR 提出了一种结合多模态语言模型（MLLM）和下一尺度视觉自回归（VAR）解码器的统一视觉生成框架，在15+任务上实现高达19倍推理加速，同时保持或提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 当前计算机视觉管线碎片化严重，不同任务（如文本到图像生成、编辑、修复、感知）由分离模型处理；扩散模型虽有高质量和高可控性，但迭代采样导致推理延迟大，限制了实际部署。
AI.method: 提出UniGen-AR框架，采用通用多模态语言模型（MLLM）编码自由形式指令和控制信号为统一序列，配合高效的下一尺度视觉自回归（VAR）解码器生成图像输出。MLLM提供灵活的条件控制，VAR模型提供采样效率和潜在统一性。
AI.result: 在超过15个任务（涵盖四个家族）上实现统一生成；相比扩散基线模型，推理延迟降低高达19倍，同时生成质量保持或提升；消融实验表明VQ-VAE令牌化器设计（特别是码本大小和层级结构）对VAR在UVG中的可扩展性至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 视觉自回归建模可作为统一视觉生成的强大且高效的骨干架构。

title: MemTX: Transactional Belief Commit for Stateful Agent Memory
summary: LLM agents increasingly coordinate through persistent shared memory: one agent's write becomes another agent's premise, and eventually a tool call with real side effects. Current agent memory systems treat every accepted write as immediately actionable truth, so a polluted tool result, a stale update, or a teammate's half-finished note can silently drive an irreversible action. We argue that a memory write is not a belief commit. We present MemTX, a transactional belief-commit protocol. Each record carries evidence, permissions, provenance, and validity. Writes are staged inside snapshot-isolated transactions and admitted by a validate-and-commit pipeline, irreversible tool calls are gated on in-flight belief state, and retracting a belief triggers typed cascading repair of its derived records and tool side effects. Two invariants, action-safety gating and cascade-repair completeness, are machine-checked by property-based testing and bounded exhaustive enumeration of 5.5 million protocol states, with zero violations. Across five backbones from three model families, MemTX leads all eight baselines with paired-McNemar significance on four backbones and statistically ties the best baseline on the fifth and strongest, while remaining the only method with zero downstream harm on every backbone. Backbone capability does not substitute for commit discipline.

AI.tldr: MemTX提出了一种事务性信念提交协议，将内存写操作视为可验证的事务而非直接采信的事实，通过快照隔离、验证提交流水线和级联修复机制，实现多智能体协作中的行动安全，在5个骨干模型上以零下游危害超越8个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体的共享内存系统将每次写入立即视为可信事实，导致被污染的工具结果、过时更新或不完整笔记可能驱动不可逆的实际操作，缺乏对写入内容正确性的验证机制。
AI.method: MemTX采用事务性信念提交协议：每条记录携带证据、权限、来源和有效性信息；写入在快照隔离的事务中暂存，通过验证-提交流水线接纳；不可逆工具调用受事务中的信念状态门控；撤回信念时触发类型化级联修复以处理派生记录和工具副作用。
AI.result: 通过基于属性的测试和有界穷举枚举对550万协议状态进行机器检查，零违规。在3个模型家族的5个骨干上，MemTX在8个基线中全部领先，其中4个骨干上达到配对McNemar显著性，在第5个最强骨干上统计持平最优基线，且是唯一在所有骨干上实现零下游危害的方法。
AI.conclusion: 骨干模型的能力不能替代提交纪律，将内存写操作视为可验证的事务而非直接采信的事实，是实现多智能体系统安全协作的必要条件。

title: From Cognitive Architectures to Language Agents: A Mechanism-Level Review of Lineage, Convergence, and Migration Gaps
summary: Memory, planning, reflection, and tool use are often compared as feature labels, obscuring the control semantics that determine how an agent actually runs. This review connects ten historical cognitive architectures, eight language-agent runtime families, and forty-two mechanism-focused modern systems. We reconstruct each mechanism through state, control, transition, persistence, failure, learning, and resource governance, then code evidence relation (E1-E4) separately from migration depth (D0-D4). The resulting landscape is uneven. Modern agents have operationalized substantial parts of adaptive memory, failure recovery, dynamic team selection, workflow search, skill induction, resource scheduling, and uncertainty-conditioned action, although often through independent convergence rather than documented inheritance. The strongest remaining opportunities lie in couplings among mechanisms. Closest-baseline screening closes one proposed gap: GraSP already combines calibrated multi-skill selection, typed compilation, verification, bounded repair, and replanning or ReAct fallback. Five residual bundles remain: activation with latency and action utility; typed impasse with isolated substates and resolution compilation; bounded content competition with broadcast and admission learning; persistent intention with reconsideration and live method authority; and uncertainty with resource allocation, interruption, and stopping. We contribute a distinctive-mechanism catalog, an auditable evidence-depth framework, and a falsifiable agenda for testing these bundles as composable runtime invariants.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了十种经典认知架构、八种语言智能体运行体系以及四十二种现代机制驱动系统，通过状态、控制、转换、持久性、失败、学习和资源治理七维度重构每个机制，并结合证据关系（E1-E4）和迁移深度（D0-D4）编码。研究发现现代智能体已实现自适应记忆、失败恢复、动态团队选择等核心能力，但多为独立趋同而非继承发展。最大的机遇在于机制间的耦合，并揭示了五种未解决的关键机制捆绑，最终贡献了独特机制目录、可审计证据深度框架及可证伪的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常以记忆、规划、反思、工具使用等模糊特征标签来描述智能体系统，忽略了决定智能体实际运行方式的控制语义。本文旨在通过统一的分析框架，系统比较历史认知架构与现代语言智能体系统，揭示机制层面的真实进展与差距，并识别出最具潜力的研究方向。
AI.method: 本文采用机制重构与编码方法：从状态、控制、转换、持久性、失败、学习和资源治理七个维度重构每个系统的运行机制；同时使用证据关系（E1-E4）和迁移深度（D0-D4）两个维度进行编码分析；通过最近基线筛选（如对比GraSP系统）来识别已解决的机制缺口；最后通过跨系统比较归纳出尚未解决的五种机制捆绑。
AI.result: 现代智能体已在自适应记忆、失败恢复、动态团队选择、工作流搜索、技能归纳、资源调度和不确定性条件动作等方面取得了实质性进展，但这些进展多为独立趋同而非继承发展。通过最近基线筛选发现GraSP已结合了校准多技能选择、类型化编译、验证、有界修复和重规划/ReAct回退。五种未解决的机制捆绑包括：（1）激活与延迟和动作效用；（2）类型化僵局与隔离子状态和分辨率编译；（3）有界内容竞争与广播和准入学习；（4）持久意图与重新考虑和实时方法权威；（5）不确定性与资源分配、中断和停止。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了独特机制目录、可审计证据深度框架以及可证伪的研究议程，即测试上述五种机制捆绑作为可组合运行时不变量的有效性。这些捆绑代表了未来智能体架构设计中最有前景的研究方向。

title: LCMamNet: A Lightweight Cross-scale Mamba Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) is important for low-altitude perception, unmanned-system warning, and security monitoring. However, weak targets in infrared imagery usually occupy only a few pixels and are easily submerged by cloud clutter, ground edges, and bright noise, making it difficult for lightweight segmentation-based methods to preserve local target structures while suppressing background interference. To address these challenges, we propose LCMamNet, a lightweight cross-scale Mamba network that progressively enhances local target structures, interacts cross-scale context in a latent space, and restores spatial details with background suppression. Specifically, a compact hierarchical encoder with cross-shaped directional bottleneck residual (CDBR) blocks strengthens direction-sensitive target structures under a small computation budget. A latent dense cross-scale fusion (LDCF) module then performs dense all-level interaction through bidirectional Mamba modeling and reorganizes the interacted features into stable hierarchical semantics. Finally, a progressive decoder selectively recovers shallow spatial details while suppressing irrelevant background textures. Extensive experiments on IRSTD-1k, NUAA-SIRST, and NUDT-SIRST show that the proposed network achieves mIoU scores of 71.25\%, 79.60\%, and 95.58\%, respectively, with only 1.175M parameters and 6.91 GFLOPs. It also runs with a mean inference latency of 6.62 ms, and deployment results on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16G SUPER further demonstrate its practical potential for real-time edge inference. The code and checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/Haoyu096/LCMamNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LCMamNet，一个轻量级跨尺度Mamba网络，用于红外小目标检测。通过紧凑编码器、潜在密集跨尺度融合模块和渐进解码器，在仅1.175M参数和6.91 GFLOPs下，在三个数据集上分别达到71.25%、79.60%和95.58%的mIoU，推理延迟6.62ms，支持边缘端实时部署。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标检测中，弱目标仅占少数像素，易被云杂波、地面边缘和亮噪声淹没，轻量级分割方法难以在抑制背景干扰的同时保留局部目标结构。
AI.method: 提出LCMamNet，包含三个关键模块：1）紧凑层次编码器，使用十字形方向瓶颈残差（CDBR）模块增强方向敏感目标结构；2）潜在密集跨尺度融合（LDCF）模块，通过双向Mamba建模实现密集全层级交互；3）渐进解码器，选择性恢复浅层空间细节并抑制无关背景纹理。
AI.result: 在IRSTD-1k、NUAA-SIRST和NUDT-SIRST上分别达到71.25%、79.60%和95.58%的mIoU，仅1.175M参数和6.91 GFLOPs，平均推理延迟6.62ms，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上验证了实时边缘推理潜力。
AI.conclusion: LCMamNet在极低的参数量和计算量下实现了优异的检测性能，并具备边缘端实时部署能力，代码已开源。

title: DICA: Dual-Indicator Guided Contrastive Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Human visual reasoning typically follows a coarse-to-fine attention process, starting from global scene understanding and gradually focusing on question-relevant regions. However, multimodal large language models may deviate from this pattern due to attention drift and the underutilization of visual evidence, which can lead to hallucinations.
