To mitigate these issues, this study proposes a Dual-Indicator Guided Contrastive Alignment (DICA), which tracks two information-theoretic indicators during inference: Visual Attention Entropy (VAE), which reflects the concentration of visual attention, and Output Image Correlation (OIC), which measures the dependence of generated outputs on the visual input. An abnormal increase in VAE or a decrease in OIC corresponds to different failure modes, which trigger targeted contrastive alignment to restore visual grounding. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DICA consistently outperforms existing approaches and substantially reduces hallucinations, highlighting the effectiveness of indicator-driven intervention in improving multimodal inference reliability. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/BGWH123/DICA/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双指标引导对比对齐方法（DICA），通过追踪视觉注意力熵（VAE）和输出图像相关性（OIC）两个信息论指标，在推理过程中检测视觉注意力漂移与视觉证据利用不足，并触发针对性对比对齐以恢复视觉基础，从而减少多模态大语言模型的幻觉。
AI.motivation: 人类视觉推理遵循从粗到细的注意力过程，但多模态大语言模型常因注意力漂移和视觉证据利用不足而产生幻觉，与人类认知模式存在偏差。
AI.method: 提出DICA方法，在推理过程中追踪VAE（衡量视觉注意力集中程度）和OIC（衡量生成输出对视觉输入的依赖程度）两个指标；VAE异常升高或OIC异常降低分别对应不同失败模式，触发相应的对比对齐机制来恢复视觉基础。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，DICA consistently优于现有方法，并显著减少了幻觉现象。
AI.conclusion: 基于信息论指标的干预策略能有效提升多模态推理的可靠性，验证了指标驱动的视觉对齐方法的有效性。

title: Face Age Verification Vulnerabilities Under Simple Appearance Manipulations
summary: Online platforms increasingly rely on automated age estimation systems to enforce minimum-age policies. Focusing on vision-based models designed for this task, concerns arise regarding their robustness to simple appearance changes that underage individuals may use to bypass such systems, such as drawing a mustache or applying lipstick. In this work, we present a systematic study of age verification robustness by simulating visual alterations that can be easily achieved by underage individuals. We evaluate seven models, including vision, vision-language, and multimodal large language models, across three datasets and four manipulation types. Interestingly, under drawn beard stubble, up to 61% of True Negatives are flipped into False Positives. Furthermore, we investigate how different demographics are affected by such manipulations, finding that Indians are more affected by beard stubble manipulations, while females are more affected than males across all manipulations. Finally, we explore how these biases can be mitigated using bias mitigation methodologies in lightweight linear probe settings.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于视觉的年龄估计系统在面对未成年人可能使用的简单外观改变（如画胡子、涂口红等）时的鲁棒性问题。实验覆盖7个模型、3个数据集和4种操作类型，发现画胡渣可使高达61%的真阴性样本变为假阳性，且不同人群受影响程度不同（印度人更受胡渣影响，女性相比男性受所有操作影响更大），最后探讨了轻量级线性探测设置下的偏差缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 在线平台依赖自动年龄估计系统执行最低年龄政策，但现有系统对未成年人可能使用的简单外观改变（如画胡子、涂口红）的鲁棒性缺乏系统研究，因此需要评估这类视觉变化对年龄验证模型的影响。
AI.method: 通过模拟未成年人易实现的视觉改变（画胡渣、涂口红等），系统评估7个模型（包括纯视觉、视觉-语言和多模态大语言模型）在3个数据集上的表现，分析4种操作类型下的误分类情况，并进一步研究不同人口统计学群体受影响的差异，最后尝试使用偏差缓解方法在轻量级线性探测设置下进行改进。
AI.result: 在画胡渣操作下，高达61%的真阴性样本被翻转为假阳性；印度人群受胡渣操作影响更大；女性相比男性在所有操作类型下受影响更大。
AI.conclusion: 年龄估计系统对简单外观改变缺乏鲁棒性，且存在人口统计学层面的偏差，但可通过轻量级偏差缓解方法在一定程度上改善。

title: EviBack: Search-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Evidence-Constrained Teacher Backoff
summary: Reinforcement learning enables Agentic RAG systems to learn multi-turn search from verifiable outcome rewards, but all- zero rollout groups provide no comparative signal and may hide useful search behavior. We present EviBack, an evidence- constrained Teacher backoff that supplies auxiliary super- vision to such groups while preserving verifiable Actor re- wards. It separates evidence assessment from answer refine- ment, preventing reference answers from overriding evidence- insufficiency judgments. A fully automated, end-to-end GPT- 5.5-assisted APE pipeline starts from a manually authored single-prompt dual-task Teacher, automatically partitions and labels rollout data, and performs ablation, task decomposition, evaluation, and selection to produce a gated two-stage Teacher. Compared with the manual design, the resulting Teacher im- proves downstream F1 and valid-answer rate while reduc- ing search, duplicate queries, and forced termination. Across seven open-domain QA benchmarks and three Qwen3 scales, EviBack improves F1 over Search-R1 and raises both single- and multi-hop macro F1. We guarantee that the code will be made publicly available at a later stage.

AI.tldr: EviBack是一种证据约束的Teacher回退机制，通过分离证据评估与答案精炼，为强化学习驱动的Agentic RAG系统提供辅助监督，解决零奖励组缺乏比较信号的问题。结合自动化的GPT-5.5辅助APE流水线生成门控两阶段Teacher，在多个QA基准上提升了F1和有效回答率，同时减少了搜索次数和强制终止。
AI.motivation: 强化学习驱动的Agentic RAG系统中，全零奖励的rollout组缺乏比较信号，可能掩盖有用的搜索行为，需要额外的监督信号来引导学习。
AI.method: 提出EviBack机制：将证据评估与答案精炼解耦，使用证据约束的Teacher回退为零奖励组提供辅助监督；构建全自动GPT-5.5辅助的APE流水线，从手动编写的单提示双任务Teacher出发，通过自动分区、标注、消融、任务分解、评估和选择，生成门控两阶段Teacher。
AI.result: 在7个开放域QA基准和3种Qwen3规模上，EviBack相比Search-R1提升了F1和单跳/多跳宏F1；相比手动设计，下游F1和有效回答率提升，搜索次数、重复查询和强制终止减少。
AI.conclusion: EviBack通过证据约束的Teacher回退和自动化的Teacher生成流水线，有效改善了Agentic RAG系统中零奖励组的学习信号，提升了检索问答性能。

title: Reasoning to Regulate: Chain-of-Thought for Traffic Rule Understanding
summary: Understanding and complying with traffic regulations is a safety-critical requirement for autonomous driving, yet remains challenging due to the diversity and context dependence of traffic signage. Importantly, regulation understanding is not a simple recognition task, but a reasoning problem: whether a rule applies depends on interpreting the sign in relation to the spatial layout of lanes and scene context. To support such reasoning, MapDR provide fine-grained annotations that link each traffic sign's regulatory rules to the specific lanes they govern. Existing methods, however, largely treat this as direct sequence prediction, ignoring the underlying reasoning that connects sign semantics and map structure. To address this limitation, we explicitly incorporate reasoning into this task and propose a framework that equips vision-language models (VLMs) with chain-of-thought (CoT) capabilities. We first design a scalable CoT curation pipeline that bootstraps rationales from a strong LLM through a two-round strategy and employs a VLM-based verifier to filter out incorrect cases, yielding a high-quality set of (CoT, answer) pairs. Building on this foundation, we adopt a two-stage training scheme: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to teach rationale-to-answer generation, followed by GRPO reinforcement learning with answer-grounded, fine-grained rewards to further improve final answer accuracy. Extensive experiments on MapDR show that our approach significantly improves both interpretability and accuracy, establishing the first reasoning-based framework for regulation-aware autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于推理的框架，通过链式思维（CoT）增强视觉语言模型（VLM），用于自动驾驶中的交通法规理解与遵从。该方法设计了可扩展的CoT整理流程（两轮策略+验证器过滤），并采用两阶段训练（SFT + GRPO强化学习），在MapDR数据集上显著提升了可解释性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将交通法规理解视为简单的序列预测任务，忽略了将交通标志语义与车道地图结构连接起来的推理过程，而法规理解本质上是需要结合空间布局和场景上下文的推理问题。
AI.method: 1) 设计可扩展的CoT整理流程：通过两轮策略从强LLM引导出推理过程，并使用VLM-based验证器过滤错误案例；2) 两阶段训练方案：先进行SFT教授从推理到答案的生成，再采用GRPO强化学习（以答案为锚点的细粒度奖励）进一步提升最终答案的准确性。
AI.result: 在MapDR数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在可解释性和准确性上均显著优于现有方法，建立了首个基于推理的法规感知自动驾驶框架。
AI.conclusion: 将显式推理（CoT）引入交通法规理解任务能有效提升VLM在该安全关键任务上的表现，两阶段训练策略（SFT+GRPO）结合高质量推理数据是关键。

title: Grokking on the Weight-Decay Clock: A Rate Hierarchy from Softly Broken Symmetries
summary: Delayed generalization, or grokking, remains poorly understood despite extensive empirical study. We identify an exactly solvable late-time relaxation mechanism for grokking in linear models trained with full-batch heavy-ball optimization and weight decay, together with a locally quadratic extension to nonlinear neural networks. Our analysis reveals a distinguished population-active component of the empirical null space, which we call the grokking subspace. Along this subspace, the training predictions remain unchanged, leaving weight decay as the sole restoring force and giving rise to a slow dissipative relaxation governed by an exact discrete-time and continuous-time law. We show that only this subspace contributes to the slow asymptotic decay of the population risk and derive explicit iteration-scale predictions for the grokking time, recovering the familiar $(1-β)/(ηλ)$ scaling in the weak-regularization regime. The theory further predicts distinct effects of optimizer choice, distinguishing coupled $L_2$ regularization from decoupled weight decay, and yields causal predictions for interventions that modify the grokking component. We verify all theoretical identities without fitted parameters in a synthetic model where every subspace and relaxation rate is computable in closed form. We further observe genuine delayed generalization in modular addition, where the measured delay follows the predicted scaling and the late-time relaxation agrees closely with the theoretical clock.

AI.tldr: 本文在线性模型和神经网络中识别出一个可精确求解的“延迟泛化（grokking）”晚时间弛豫机制，揭示了由权重衰减驱动的“grokking子空间”及其慢弛豫动力学，并给出了grokking时间的显式尺度化预测，在模加法任务中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量实证研究，延迟泛化（grokking）现象在理论上仍未被充分理解，缺乏可解析求解的机制来解释其为何需要大量训练轮次才能突然泛化。
AI.method: 在线性模型中采用全批次重球优化（heavy-ball optimization）与权重衰减，推导出精确的离散时间和连续时间弛豫规律；并通过局部二次扩展将分析推广到非线性神经网络。识别出“grokking子空间”——一个训练预测保持不变的经验零空间中的群体活跃分量，该子空间仅受权重衰减驱动，产生慢耗散弛豫。
AI.result: 推导出grokking时间的显式迭代尺度化预测，在弱正则化区恢复熟悉的(1-β)/(ηλ)标度律；区分了耦合L₂正则化与解耦权重衰减的优化器选择效应；在合成模型中所有理论恒等式无拟合参数地得到验证；在模加法任务中观测到真实的延迟泛化，测量延迟符合预测标度，晚时间弛豫与理论时钟高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个grokking现象的精确可解理论框架，揭示了慢弛豫的根源在于权重衰减对grokking子空间的唯一驱动力，并能因果预测改变grokking成分的干预效果，为理解和控制延迟泛化提供了理论基础。

title: Effect of User-Prompted Priors on Semi-Automated Cancer Lesion Segmentation in Whole-Body Computed Tomography
comment: Accepted at MIUA (Medical Image Understanding and Analysis). To appear in Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS). 12 pages, 2 figures
summary: In clinical oncology studies, metastatic cancer is commonly evaluated using "Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors" (RECIST), in which the diameter of up to five lesions is measured and followed over the course of treatment. However, RECIST shows limited correlation with overall survival. Total tumour volume (TTV) is a stronger predictor but typically relies on manual ground-truth segmentation of all lesions, which is time-consuming and requires expert domain knowledge. Semi-automated approaches leveraging user-prompted priors, such as bounding boxes and single-slice contours, as inputs to automated segmentation methods can facilitate the generation of ground-truth segmentations. This work investigates the impact of different user-prompted priors on semi-automated cancer lesion segmentation performance in whole-body computed tomography. Across 3-fold cross-validation and external testing, more complex spatial priors consistently improved performance, with contour priors from three orthogonal planes (axial, coronal and sagittal) achieving the best results. On the external test (n=3865 lesions), this approach achieved a mean Dice score of 0.882, compared to a mean Dice score of 0.671 for the baseline model with no spatial prior. These findings suggest that the use of multi-plane orthogonal user-prompted priors can improve semi-automated tumour lesion segmentation and support efficient generation of high-quality volumetric ground-truth data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在全身CT扫描中，不同用户提示先验（如边界框、单层轮廓、多平面正交轮廓）对半自动癌灶分割性能的影响。实验表明，使用三维正交平面（轴位、冠状位、矢状位）的轮廓先验效果最佳，在包含3865个病灶的外部测试集上平均Dice得分为0.882，显著优于无空间先验的基线模型（0.671）。该方法可有效支持高质量容积地面真值数据的生成。
AI.motivation: RECIST标准与总生存期相关性有限，而肿瘤总体积（TTV）是更强的预测因子，但全病变手动分割耗时且依赖专家知识。因此需要探索半自动方法中不同用户提示先验对分割性能的影响，以提高生成高质量地面真值数据的效率。
AI.method: 采用3折交叉验证和外部测试，比较了无空间先验的基线模型与不同复杂度空间先验（边界框、单层轮廓、三维正交平面轮廓）对半自动癌灶分割性能的影响。在全身CT图像上进行实验，外部测试集包含3865个病灶。
AI.result: 三维正交平面（轴位、冠状位、矢状位）轮廓先验达到最佳性能，外部测试集平均Dice得分为0.882；而基线模型（无空间先验）平均Dice得分为0.671。更复杂的空间先验一致地提升了分割性能。
AI.conclusion: 多平面正交用户提示先验可有效提升半自动肿瘤病灶分割性能，支持高效生成高质量容积地面真值数据，有望替代耗时的手动全病变分割方法。

title: Plato-Bio: verification-first biological novelty screening with temporal rediscovery and structural benchmarks
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Companion code and data: https://github.com/Eldergenix/Plato-Scientific-Research-Autonomous-Agent. This fork-specific validation study cites, but does not duplicate, arXiv:2510.26887
summary: Large language model research agents can connect literature retrieval, analysis code, and manuscript preparation, but coherent output does not establish scientific validity. We developed Plato-Bio, a biology-routed extension of the open Plato/Denario architecture that couples explicit workflow states with provenance records, citation checks, claim-to-evidence links, scoped file writes, and publication gates. A source audit identified and repaired three defects that could distort evaluation: loss of task domain in the default factory, omission of declared method signals from scoring, and evidence sidecars that lacked the drafted-claim denominator. On the current clean revision, the full Python suite completed with 931 passes, six skips, and no failures or errors; targeted biology, genomics, evidence/citation, and adversarial-safety suites likewise completed without failure. We evaluated two narrow use cases. In a frozen historical rediscovery task, independent pre-1986 literature bridges ranked the later-studied relation between fish oil and Raynaud phenomenon first; TF-IDF ranked it second and corpus frequency third. This single curated task measures retrospective ranking, not prospective discovery. In a separate comparison of AlphaFold models with experimental structures for 15 human proteins, 11 targets had high-confidence-core C-alpha RMSD below 1 Angstrom (median 0.501 Angstrom). Four targets exceeded 2 Angstrom, and confidence masking reduced the SUMO1 discrepancy from 16.61 to 2.58 Angstrom over 74 residues. The workflow emitted 27 traceable discrepancy regions, all retained as unvalidated hypotheses. Plato-Bio therefore provides reproducible software contracts and auditable screening baselines; broader claims of agent efficacy or biological novelty require preregistered evaluation, independent review, and prospective validation.

AI.tldr: Plato-Bio是一个基于开源Plato/Denario架构的生物学研究智能体系统，通过显式工作流状态、溯源记录、引用检查、证据链接和作用域文件写入等机制确保可复现性和可审计性。系统通过源代码审计修复了三个评估缺陷，在多项测试套件中无失败运行。在两项狭窄用例评估中，历史文献重发现任务中文献桥接排名优于TF-IDF和语料频率；AlphaFold模型评估中11/15个靶标蛋白核心Cα RMSD低于1Å，所有27个差异区域均作为未验证假设保留。作者强调该系统提供的是可复现的软件契约和可审计的筛选基线，而非已验证的科学发现。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型研究智能体可串联文献检索、分析代码和稿件撰写，但其连贯输出并不能建立科学有效性。因此需要一种能够保证可复现性、可审计性和科学可靠性的研究智能体系统架构。
AI.method: 基于开源Plato/Denario架构构建Plato-Bio，引入生物学路由扩展：耦合显式工作流状态与溯源记录、引用检查、声明到证据的链接、作用域文件写入和发布门控。通过源代码审计识别并修复三个评估缺陷（任务域丢失、方法信号遗漏、证据侧车缺少声明分母）。在多个测试套件（完整Python套件、生物学/基因组学/证据引用/对抗安全套件）上验证。
AI.result: 完整Python套件931次通过、6次跳过、零失败/错误；历史文献重发现任务中文献桥接排名第一，TF-IDF第二，语料频率第三；AlphaFold评估中11/15靶标蛋白核心Cα RMSD低于1Å（中位数0.501Å），4个超过2Å，置信度掩码将SUMO1偏差从16.61降至2.58Å（74残基），输出27个可追溯差异区域。
AI.conclusion: Plato-Bio提供了可复现的软件契约和可审计的筛选基线，但更广泛的智能体效能或生物学新颖性声明需要预注册评估、独立评审和前瞻性验证。

title: TreeAdapter: Hierarchical Taxonomy-Guided Adapter Composition for Fine-Grained Species Image Generation
summary: Although general text-to-image models excel in open-domain generation, their performance degrades significantly in specialized downstream domains, particularly when generating images of rare biological species. Hindered by long-tailed distributions, general models struggle to capture subtle fine-grained details, while per-species fine-tuning methods over-isolate individual species and consequently ignore the shared visual features among closely related taxa. To address this, we propose TreeAdapter, a novel framework that explicitly leverages hierarchical taxonomic data. Rather than using a monolithic model or independent per-species modules, TreeAdapter attaches lightweight adapters to every node of the taxonomic tree. Specifically, leaf-node adapters capture species-specific visual traits, while internal-node adapters encapsulate shared semantics among descendant taxa. We introduce a two-stage training paradigm where ancestor adapters are optimized to model only the residual visual features unexplained by their descendants. This model architecture and training paradigm enable the model to fully leverage hierarchical information, ensuring the accurate generation of visual features for each species. Extensive experiments across three large-scale biodiversity benchmarks demonstrate that TreeAdapter achieves state-of-the-art fine-grained generation quality, outperforming both general-purpose and domain-specific baselines.

AI.tldr: TreeAdapter通过利用层级分类数据，在分类树每个节点附加轻量适配器，采用两阶段训练范式让祖先适配器仅建模后代未解释的残差视觉特征，在三个生物多样性基准上实现了最优的细粒度生成质量。
AI.motivation: 通用文生图模型在稀有生物物种等专业下游领域表现不佳，受长尾分布限制难以捕捉细微的细粒度特征，而逐物种微调方法又过度孤立各物种，忽略了近缘类群间的共享视觉特征。
AI.method: 提出TreeAdapter框架，在分类树的每个节点上附加轻量适配器：叶节点适配器捕获物种特异性视觉特征，内部节点适配器封装后裔类群间的共享语义。采用两阶段训练范式，先优化祖先适配器仅建模后代未解释的残差视觉特征。
AI.result: 在三个大规模生物多样性基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TreeAdapter实现了最先进的细粒度生成质量，超越了通用和领域特定的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该模型架构和训练范式使模型能够充分利用层级信息，确保各物种视觉特征的准确生成，验证了层级分类数据在细粒度图像生成中的有效性。

title: Exploring Budgeted Image Classification with Content-Sensitive Resource Allocation
summary: The ever-growing adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) creates the need to deploy Deep Neural Networks in a variety of computational environments. We consider dynamic environments, where computational requirements are subject to change, and we pose the following question: How do we adjust the complexity of an AI classification system, in order to maximize its accuracy, while meeting changing computational constraints? We call this problem Budgeted Image Classification, and we formally formulate it as a resource allocation integer program. Given a computational budget, a batch of images, and a classification system that can make decisions with varying complexity (it has multiple decision points), we explore strategies to allocate images to decision points, in order to maximize accuracy within the available budget. The original integer program is NP-Hard, so, we propose a continuous relaxation, leading to a content-agnostic allocation strategy which assigns images to decision points without considering their particular content. We address this issue by proposing a content-sensitive strategy, that we experimentally show it leads to superior performance. We theoretically study the behavior of our strategies, deriving conditions that must be satisfied by decision points to be suitable for budgeted classification. We analyze fails cases, offering insights for future research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了预算约束下的图像分类问题（Budgeted Image Classification），即在动态计算环境下，如何调整AI分类系统的复杂度，在满足计算预算限制的同时最大化分类准确率。作者将问题形式化为资源分配整数规划，并提出一种内容感知的分配策略，相比内容无关策略性能更优，并理论分析了决策点需满足的条件。
AI.motivation: 随着AI的广泛应用，深度神经网络需要部署在各类计算环境中。在动态环境下，计算需求会发生变化，因此需要一种方法能够在计算资源受限的情况下，调整分类系统的复杂度以最大化准确率。
AI.method: 将预算图像分类形式化为资源分配整数规划（NP-Hard），提出连续松弛得到内容无关的分配策略，并进一步提出内容敏感（content-sensitive）的分配策略，将图像分配到不同的决策点。
AI.result: 实验表明内容敏感策略优于内容无关策略；理论分析了决策点需满足的适用条件，并分析了失败案例。
AI.conclusion: 为动态计算环境下的AI分类系统提供了预算分配的理论框架和实用策略，指出了未来研究方向。

title: MATS: A novel multi-modality multi-task learning framework for 3D perception in autonomous driving
summary: Multi-modality data from different sensors provides rich complementary information for 3D perception, becoming an essential component in reliable autonomous driving systems. Current research typically designs intricate and complex fusion strategies to integrate information from multimodal data on a unified bird's-eye-view (BEV) feature map for the joint learning of multiple perception tasks. However, such a single feature map hardly carries sufficient information to simultaneously meet the requirements of various perception tasks, leading to a very limited perception performance. To mitigate this limitation, this paper proposes MATS, a novel multi-modality multi-task learning approach with modality-adaptive BEV fusion and task-specific Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) for 3D perception. Specifically, a simple modality-adaptive BEV fusion module is designed to adaptively recalibrate the BEV features by modeling the global cross-modality dependencies, generating diverse BEV feature maps for various perception tasks. For joint multi-task learning, this paper proposes a task-specific MoE module to decouple the tasks and enable the network to automatically choose the appropriate BEV feature candidates for each specific task. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, we conduct extensive experiments on the large-scale benchmark nuScenes. With the camera- and LiDAR-modality input data, the proposed approach outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) by a significant margin. Furthermore, the experimental results on the single tasks show that the proposed approach significantly outperforms the baselines. The code and trained models will be available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MATS，一种多模态多任务3D感知方法，包含模态自适应BEV融合和任务特定混合专家（MoE）模块，以解决单一BEV特征图难以同时满足多种感知任务需求的问题，在nuScenes基准上显著超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态融合方法通常将多传感器数据融合到统一的BEV特征图上进行多任务联合学习，但单一特征图难以同时承载足够信息以满足不同感知任务的需求，导致感知性能受限。
AI.method: 提出MATS框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 模态自适应BEV融合模块，通过建模全局跨模态依赖关系自适应地重新校准BEV特征，为不同感知任务生成多样化的BEV特征图；(2) 任务特定混合专家（MoE）模块，解耦多任务并让网络自动为每个任务选择最合适的BEV特征候选。
AI.result: 在nuScenes大规模基准上，使用相机和LiDAR多模态输入，MATS以显著优势超越现有最先进方法。在单任务实验中，该方法也显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过模态自适应BEV融合和任务特定MoE机制，有效缓解了单一BEV特征图的信息承载限制，提升了多模态多任务3D感知的整体性能。

title: Self-Supervised Consistency Enhanced Disentangled Learning for Neural Decoding Generalization in Brain-Machine Interface
summary: Brain-Machine Interfaces (BMIs) provide a direct communication pathway between the brain and external devices, enabling humans to control assistive and robotic technologies, with potential applications in rehabilitation, human motor augmentation, and human-centered robotics. However, due to neural drift, the performance of BMIs decreases over time, posing challenges for long-term viability, particularly for invasive BMIs (iBMIs). Existing solutions suffer from two main drawbacks: (i) difficulty in learning robust neural representations, and (ii) neglecting that neural drift varies across motor parameters (e.g., velocity, direction, and speed). To overcome these limitations, we propose Self-Supervised Consistency enhanced Disentangled Learning (SSCDL), a neural decoding generalization framework built on two key innovations. We first design a backbone model named Consistency enhanced Neural Decoder (CND), using a novel teacher-student consistency constraint with simulated neural signal perturbations to learn robust representations invariant to neural drift. Then, we employ three dedicated CNDs under the Complementary-Disentangled Generalization (CDG) mechanism, which disentangles motor signals into velocity, direction, and speed with inspiration from neural preference theory. This disentangled learning enables SSCDL to capture invariant neural representations from diverse neural preference perspectives, significantly enhancing cross-day generalization. Extensive experimental results show that SSCDL delivers state-of-the-art decoding performance, exhibiting high robustness and cross-day stability. These capabilities underscore its strong potential for long-term interaction in human-centric robotic and fine-grained assistive applications.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督一致性增强解耦学习（SSCDL）框架，通过教师-学生一致性约束和神经偏好理论启发的互补解耦泛化机制，解决脑机接口中神经漂移导致的跨天性能下降问题，实现鲁棒的神经解码。
AI.motivation: 脑机接口因神经漂移导致长期性能下降，现有方法难以学习鲁棒的神经表征，且忽视了神经漂移在不同运动参数（速度、方向、速率）上的差异性。
AI.method: 设计一致性增强神经解码器（CND）作为骨干模型，通过教师-学生一致性约束和模拟神经信号扰动学习漂移不变表征；进一步提出互补解耦泛化（CDG）机制，基于神经偏好理论将运动信号解耦为速度、方向和速率三个维度，分别由三个专用CND处理。
AI.result: 实验结果表明SSCDL在解码性能上达到最先进水平，具有高鲁棒性和跨天稳定性。
AI.conclusion: SSCDL框架有效解决了神经漂移问题，在长期人机交互、精细辅助应用和以人为中心的机器人技术中展现出强潜力。

title: FilmBench: A Film-Grade Benchmark for Cinematic Video Generation
summary: Progress in video generation keeps narrowing the visual gap between AI-generated and professionally produced footage, yet most benchmarks still draw prompts from web sources or LLM templates and score them with untrained, generic multimodal models. More fundamentally, their evaluation taxonomies remain rudimentary (overall visual quality, coarse text alignment and temporal smoothness) rather than the professional Cinematic Language criteria by which films are actually made and judged, so they assess basic video plausibility rather than film-grade craft. We introduce FilmBench, a text-to-video (T2V) and reference-to-video (R2V) benchmark grounded in the professional Cinematic Language of the film- academy tradition and co-developed with directors and faculty from the Beijing Film Academy and the Hujing Digital Media & Entertainment Group film studio. It rests on three choices. First, prompts are reverse-engineered from clips of award-winning films spanning 20 cinematic genres and chosen by professional directors, so every prompt is anchored to a verified live-action reference; the prompts follow real shot lists, and most script multiple shots (1,056 of the 1,169 prompts are multi-shot), unlike prior single-clip benchmarks. Second, evaluation follows a three-level Cinematic taxonomy of 3 axes, 12 components and 35 (T2V) +3 (R2V-only) sub-metrics. Third, we develop an in-house expert-grade automatic evaluation agent and open-source its core suite of Cinematic Language operators (FilmOps). Benchmarking leading video generation models (9 for T2V, 7 for R2V), the evaluator reproduces the human model ranking at model-level Spearman \r{ho} = 0.95 (T2V) and 0.96 (R2V). Scores fall well below prior web-style benchmarks, with two consistent gaps in dynamic aesthetics and a marked single- to multi-shot performance drop that widens for weaker models.

AI.tldr: FilmBench是一个基于专业电影语言体系的文生视频和参考视频生成基准，包含1,169个源自获奖影片的多镜头prompts、三层级电影评价指标（3轴12组件35+子指标），以及自研的专家级自动评估工具。在9个T2V和7个R2V模型上的评估显示，该评估器与人类排名的Spearman相关系数达0.95/0.96，且发现了现有模型在动态美学和多镜头生成方面存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成基准存在三个根本缺陷：prompts来源（网络或LLM模板）缺乏专业电影参照；评价指标停留在基础视觉质量、文本对齐和时间平滑性等粗粒度层面，而非专业电影制作所依据的电影语言标准；评估模型多为未经过专业训练的通用多模态模型。因此需要建立一个基于专业电影语言体系、由电影行业专家参与的基准来真正衡量视频生成的电影级工艺水平。
AI.method: 1) 从20种电影类型的获奖影片中反向工程提取prompts（1,169个，其中1,056个为多镜头），由专业导演和北京电影学院教师协作选取；2) 构建三层级电影评价体系：3轴（叙事、视觉、时间）、12组件、35个T2V子指标+3个R2V专用子指标；3) 开发自研专家级自动评估工具并开源核心电影语言算子集（FilmOps）。
AI.result: 在9个T2V模型和7个R2V模型上的评估结果显示：自动评估器与人类排名的模型级Spearman相关系数达0.95（T2V）和0.96（R2V）；整体得分显著低于现有网络类基准；存在动态美学方面的两个持续差距；从单镜头到多镜头的性能明显下降，且该下降在较弱模型中更为显著。
AI.conclusion: FilmBench通过引入专业电影语言评价体系，提供了比现有基准更准确反映视频生成电影级质量的评估方法，揭示了当前先进模型在动态美学和多镜头叙事能力方面的显著不足，为视频生成研究提供了更专业的评价方向。

title: A Cyclic Adaptation-Generalization Framework with Uncertainty-Guided Self-Paced Learning for Long-Term Brain-Machine Interfaces
summary: Brain-Machine Interfaces (BMIs), which link the brain to external devices, hold great potential in rehabilitation, human performance augmentation, and human-centered robotics. However, invasive BMIs face a critical challenge for long-term deployment due to neural drift, which degrades decoding performance over time and necessitates frequent recalibration. Existing methods designed to mitigate neural drift typically rely on either domain adaptation (DA) or domain generalization (DG) alone and often fail to capture fine-grained distribution shifts across neural subdomains, resulting in limited performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose Uncertainty-guided Self-paced Cycling (UnSPC), a robust framework that synergizes DA and DG for target domain refining under an Uncertainty-guided Self-paced Pseudo-labeling (UnSPL) mechanism. To handle subdomain neural drift across domains, UNSPL is proposed to iteratively mine reliable pseudo-labeled samples with a noise-robust ranking strategy for further fine-tuning. Leveraging these high-quality samples, we introduce a novel Cycling Adaptation and Generalization (CycAG) strategy, which integrates DA and DG within an iterative cycle to progressively mitigate both global and subdomain drift. This cyclic process enables effective alignment to evolving target distributions while preserving robust and transferable representations, thereby mitigating performance degradation under long-term neural drifts. Extensive experiments on multiple neural decoding datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of UnSPC. To our knowledge, our proposed UnSPC is the first to cyclically integrate DA and DG with pseudo-labeling, paving the way toward stable long-term BMI controls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Uncertainty-guided Self-paced Cycling (UnSPC)框架，通过循环整合领域自适应（DA）和领域泛化（DG）策略，并引入不确定性引导的自步伪标注（UnSPL）机制，有效应对脑机接口中神经漂移导致的解码性能退化问题，在多个神经解码数据集上验证了其鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 侵入式脑机接口在长期部署中面临神经漂移（neural drift）这一关键挑战，该漂移会导致解码性能随时间的推移而退化，需要频繁重新校准。现有方法仅单独依赖领域自适应（DA）或领域泛化（DG），难以捕捉神经子域间的细粒度分布偏移，性能有限。
AI.method: 提出UnSPC框架：(1) Uncertainty-guided Self-paced Pseudo-labeling (UnSPL)机制，通过噪声鲁棒的排序策略迭代挖掘可靠伪标注样本；(2) Cycling Adaptation and Generalization (CycAG)策略，在迭代循环中整合DA和DG，逐步缓解全局和子域漂移，实现对演化的目标分布的有效对齐，同时保持鲁棒且可迁移的表征。
AI.result: 在多个神经解码数据集上的大量实验表明，UnSPC在有效性和鲁棒性方面均优于现有方法，能够有效缓解长期神经漂移下的性能退化问题。
AI.conclusion: UnSPC是首个循环整合DA、DG与伪标注的框架，为稳定长期脑机接口控制铺平了道路。

title: SILICA: Repurposing Diffusion Priors for Joint Glass Segmentation and Depth Estimation
comment: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2026
summary: Standard depth sensors systematically fail on transparent surfaces, creating corrupted 3D maps and severe navigation hazards. While specialized hardware sensors can detect glass, they lack modularity and have extensive hardware dependencies. Consequently, learning-based monocular depth estimation has emerged as a compelling alternative. However, domain-specific glass-aware monocular depth estimators struggle with unfamiliar indoor layouts; restricted by the severe scarcity of real-world glass depth annotations, they fail to generalize zero-shot to new settings. This motivates us to explore whether the extensive priors of text-to-image diffusion models can enable generalizable perception of transparent surfaces. We introduce SILICA, a unified pipeline leveraging these priors to jointly predict glass segmentation and glass-aware depth. This mutual information exchange establishes a robust spatial hierarchy, entirely eliminating the need for paired real-world glass depth annotations. Subsequently, we use the predicted segmentation mask to explicitly filter incorrect glass depth points from standard sensors, recovering accurate metric glass depth for downstream 3D mapping and autonomous collision avoidance. Supported by our novel Mirage 18k dataset, extensive experiments demonstrate that SILICA achieves remarkable zero-shot transfer across diverse, unseen environments, outperforming state-of-the-art models by almost 20% and setting a new benchmark for transparent surface perception.

AI.tldr: SILICA利用文本到图像扩散模型的先验知识，通过联合预测玻璃分割和深度估计，无需真实玻璃深度标注即可实现透明表面前所未有的零样本泛化性能，在多个未见环境中比SOTA提升近20%。
AI.motivation: 标准深度传感器在透明表面系统性地失效，而现有的玻璃感知单目深度估计器因缺乏真实玻璃深度标注，无法零样本泛化到新场景。作者探索能否利用文本到图像扩散模型的强大先验来实现透明表面的泛化感知。
AI.method: 提出SILICA统一流水线：利用文本到图像扩散模型的先验，联合预测玻璃分割和玻璃感知深度；通过互信息交换建立稳健的空间层次结构，完全消除对配对真实玻璃深度标注的依赖；利用预测的分割掩码显式过滤标准传感器中的错误玻璃深度点，恢复准确的度量玻璃深度。
AI.result: 基于Mirage 18k数据集，SILICA在多样未见环境中实现显著的零样本迁移，比SOTA模型提升近20%，树立了透明表面感知的新基准。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的先验知识能够有效赋能透明表面的泛化感知，联合分割与深度估计的互信息交换策略可以替代昂贵的真实深度标注，为下游3D建图和自主避障提供了可行方案。

title: The Half-Lives of Generative-AI Evidence: A 40-Record Audit, a Claim-Currency Framework, and a Reflexive Case of Frontier-Model-Assisted Research
comment: 20 pages, 6 tables, 1 figure, 1 appendix. Ancillary file corpus_coding.csv contains the record-level coding. Data cutoff: 17 July 2026; submission-stage frontier note: 27 July 2026
summary: Generative-AI evaluations can become historical before publication, yet calendar age does not affect every conclusion equally. This paper has two linked purposes. First, it audits a maximum-variation purposive corpus of 40 empirical records appearing between 18 July 2025 and 17 July 2026. The audit coded publication route, execution timing, model identity, age of the newest named generation or immutable snapshot, same-family supersession and refresh behaviour. At appearance, the newest named model was a median 281 days old (middle 50%: 75-478; range: 11-939). Median age was 395 days for 25 journal articles, 56 days for 14 preprints and 49 days for one laboratory report. Thirty-five records included a superseded family, seven supplied a precise dated identifier, three clearly refreshed model evidence, and one added a late sensitivity test. All 40 included an OpenAI system, a feature of this corpus rather than a prevalence estimate. The paper distinguishes model age from claim currency and proposes six reporting practices. Second, it treats its own two-day production process as a reflexive case of frontier-model-assisted research creation. GPT-5.6 Sol Pro in ChatGPT supported candidate discovery, source reconciliation, calculations, drafting and critique; the author checked sources, made all substantive decisions and accepts responsibility. This is a proof-of-practice, not a controlled estimate of productivity or quality. By applying its own Model Facts and model-currency statement, the paper shows how rapid AI-assisted research can be made inspectable without treating model output as independent validation. The title uses half-lives metaphorically; no universal decay rate is estimated.

AI.tldr: 本文对2025-2026年间40篇生成式AI评估文献进行审计，发现模型在发表时中位年龄已达281天，并提出了六项报告实践建议；同时以自身2天生产流程为例，展示了在AI辅助下如何保持研究可审查性。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI评估论文在发表时往往已过时（模型年龄大），但"时效性"对不同结论的影响程度不同。本文旨在系统性地审计这一现象，并提出改进报告实践的方案。
AI.method: 对40篇最大变异有目的抽样语料进行编码分析，变量包括发表途径、执行时间、模型身份、最新命名模型或快照的年龄、同族模型更替及刷新行为；同时以自身2天的AI辅助生产流程作为反思性案例研究。
AI.result: 模型发表时中位年龄281天（IQR: 75-478，范围11-939天）；期刊论文中位395天，预印本56天，实验室报告49天；35篇包含已更替的模型族，仅7篇提供精确日期标识，3篇明确刷新了模型证据；所有40篇均包含OpenAI系统。
AI.conclusion: 区分了模型年龄与主张时效性，提出六项报告实践；展示了AI辅助研究在保持可审查性的同时快速产出的可行性，但强调这并非对生产力或质量的受控评估。

title: Superpixel-Based QUBO for Scalable Quantum-Enhanced Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) has emerged as a powerful framework for medical computing problems. Binary decision variables naturally represent clinical choices, making QUBO formulations well-suited for quantum annealing hardware. However, a fundamental scalability challenge limits practical deployment: problem size grows rapidly with input dimensionality, creating computational bottlenecks that restrict applications to simplified scenarios. This paper addresses this challenge through hierarchical problem reduction, as demonstrated in medical image segmentation, where pixel-level QUBO formulations create over 65,000 variables for a 256x256 image, forcing existing approaches to downsample to 42x42 resolution and discard 97% of pixel information. A superpixel-based QUBO framework is proposed using simple linear iterative clustering (SLIC) to group pixels into perceptually meaningful regions, then formulate segmentation as QUBO over a region adjacency graph (RAG) combining min-cut and smoothness objectives. Validation on INbreast mammography breast cancer images demonstrates a 4.2% improvement in segmentation quality (mean IoU 0.76 vs 0.73) with 33 computational speedup (0.67s vs 21.97s) and a 97.3% reduction in problem size (1764 to 48 variables), all achieved while processing full-resolution images rather than downsampled versions. The reduced problem size also fits well within current quantum annealer connectivity limits, removing the embedding overhead that has historically blocked direct deployment of pixel-level QUBO segmentation on quantum hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于超像素的层次化QUBO框架，通过SLIC聚类将像素分组为感知上有意义的区域，并在区域邻接图上构建分割目标函数。在INbreast乳腺图像分割任务中，该方法在保持全分辨率处理的同时，将问题规模从1764变量降至48变量（减少97.3%），分割质量提升4.2%（mIoU 0.76 vs 0.73），计算速度提升33倍（0.67s vs 21.97s），且变量规模适配当前量子退火器连接限制。
AI.motivation: 现有像素级QUBO公式在处理高分辨率医学图像时面临严重可扩展性瓶颈：256x256图像产生超过65,000个变量，迫使现有方法降采样至42x42分辨率，丢弃97%的像素信息，严重限制实际临床应用。
AI.method: 提出超像素级QUBO框架：首先使用SLIC算法将像素聚类为感知一致的超像素区域，然后在区域邻接图（RAG）上构建结合最小割和平滑性目标的QUBO公式，从而实现问题规模的层次化降维。
AI.result: 在INbreast乳腺X光乳腺癌图像上：分割质量mIoU 0.76 vs 0.73（提升4.2%），计算时间0.67s vs 21.97s（加速33倍），问题规模从1764变量降至48变量（减少97.3%），且支持全分辨率图像处理。
AI.conclusion: 超像素级层次化约简有效解决了QUBO在医学图像分割中的可扩展性瓶颈，降低的问题规模使其能够直接部署在现有量子退火硬件上，无需嵌入开销，为QUBO在医疗计算中的实际应用开辟了可行路径。

title: Quantum-Inspired Evolutionary Neighborhood Search for Arrival-Departure Track Utilization Adjustment under Short-Term Disturbances
summary: Short-term disturbances at major passenger railway stations alter train arrival and departure times as well as the release sequence of station resources. Effective recovery therefore requires coordinated adjustment of arrival-departure track allocation, station resource occupation, and train retiming. This study represents the station resources involved in train arrival, track occupancy, and departure operations as zone-level resource-occupation intervals. An arrival-departure track allocation adjustment model is formulated. Resource compatibility is imposed as the feasibility condition, while train delays and resource reassignment costs are jointly considered. A quantum-inspired evolutionary algorithm combined with neighborhood search (QEA-NS) is proposed to solve the model. Perturbation instances are constructed using GTFS timetable data from Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof, Germany. QEA-NS is compared with CP-SAT under the same candidate resource set and feasibility criteria. Both methods generate solutions satisfying the modeled resource compatibility constraints. QEA-NS yields a total delay of 388 min, compared with 519 min for CP-SAT, representing a reduction of 25.2\%. The mean delay of delayed trains decreases from 4.99 to 3.73 min, although QEA-NS requires a longer solution time. Across 10 random perturbation instances, QEA-NS achieves lower total delay in every case. Its mean total delay and standard deviation are 390.5 min and 35.945 min, respectively, compared with 673.8 min and 105.739 min for CP-SAT. The results indicate that, under the adopted resource representation and constraints, QEA-NS improves the delay performance of recovery plans. Its computational efficiency, however, requires further improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究铁路客运站受短期扰动后的到发线分配与时刻表协同调整问题，提出基于量子启发进化算法与邻域搜索（QEA-NS）的优化方法，在德国法兰克福总站实例上相比CP-SAT总延误降低25.2%，平均延误从4.99分钟降至3.73分钟，但求解时间更长。
AI.motivation: 大型客运站的短期扰动会导致列车到发时间与资源释放顺序紊乱，现有方法难以同时协调到发线分配、站内资源占用与列车时刻调整，因此需要建立联合优化模型并设计高效求解算法。
AI.method: 将列车到达、股道占用和出发等站内资源操作表示为区段级资源占用区间；构建到发线分配调整模型，以资源兼容性为可行性约束，以列车延误与资源重分配成本为联合目标；提出量子启发进化算法与邻域搜索混合算法（QEA-NS）进行求解。
AI.result: 基于法兰克福总站GTFS数据构建扰动实例，QEA-NS总延误388分钟，CP-SAT总延误519分钟，降低25.2%；延误列车平均延误从4.99分钟降至3.73分钟；在10个随机扰动实例中QEA-NS均优于CP-SAT，平均总延误390.5分钟（标准差35.945）对比673.8分钟（标准差105.739）。
AI.conclusion: 在所采用的资源表示与约束体系下，QEA-NS能显著提升恢复计划的延误性能，但计算效率仍需进一步改进。

title: UMI3D: Robust 3D Generation on Unconstrained Multi-Image Inputs via Simultaneous Focus Cross-Attention Routing
summary: Recent 3D foundation models can generate high-quality assets from a single image, but degrade markedly on unconstrained multi-image inputs, often producing distorted geometry, over-smoothed textures, and chaotic colors. We argue that this failure stems not from limited model capacity, but from a mismatch between single-image cross-attention and the multi-image setting: existing models lack a principled way to decide which image each 3D voxel should trust at each denoising step. Revisiting recent single-image 3D foundation models, we show that explicitly routing each voxel to its most informative image is sufficient to unlock strong performance on inconsistent multi-image inputs. Based on this observation, we propose UMI3D, a training-free and plug-and-play framework that restructures cross-attention for unconstrained multi-image 3D generation. Its core, Simultaneous Focus Cross-Attention (SFC-Attn), activates all conditioning images at each denoising step while allowing each voxel to focus on the single image that best explains it. To enable this routing, we derive the Voxel Reference Score (VRS), a model-intrinsic metric for voxel--image affinity that requires no external matching, segmentation, or correspondence models. Extensive experiments show that UMI3D unlocks the multi-image potential of single-image 3D generation frameworks across diverse tasks. Project Page: UMI3D-Project.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UMI3D，一种无需训练、即插即用的框架，通过重构交叉注意力机制（SFC-Attn）和引入体素参考分数（VRS），使单图像3D基础模型能够处理无约束多图像输入，有效解决多视角不一致导致的几何扭曲、纹理过平滑和颜色混乱问题。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像3D基础模型在处理无约束多图像输入时性能严重下降，产生扭曲几何、过平滑纹理和混乱颜色。作者论证这一问题并非源于模型容量限制，而是单图像交叉注意力机制与多图像设置之间的不匹配——现有模型缺乏原则性的方式来决定每个3D体素在每个去噪步骤中应该信任哪张图像。
AI.method: 提出UMI3D框架，核心为Simultaneous Focus Cross-Attention (SFC-Attn)，在每个去噪步骤中激活所有条件图像，但允许每个体素聚焦于最能解释它的单一图像。为实现这一路由，提出Voxel Reference Score (VRS)，一种模型固有的体素-图像亲和度度量，无需外部匹配、分割或对应模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，UMI3D能够在多种不同任务中解锁单图像3D生成框架的多图像潜力，有效处理无约束多图像输入。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式地将每个体素路由到其信息最丰富的图像，足以在无约束多图像输入上释放强大的性能。UMI3D是训练免费、即插即用的框架，为多图像3D生成提供了简洁有效的解决方案。

title: Success Is Not Self-Explanatory: Auditing Success Provenance in Agent Evaluation
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/luojingkun22/acquabench
summary: A correct answer can conceal why an agent succeeded. Once agents change their information state during evaluation, correctness no longer distinguishes intended reasoning from answer acquisition. Outcome evidence and exposure detection do not establish whether success depended on an acquired target; we call this missing evaluation object success provenance. AcquaBench audits it through matched CLEAN, GOLD, and SHAM value substitution on four standardized surfaces with joint qid-clustered analysis. CLEAN retains benchmark-authorized information. GOLD makes the correct target available. SHAM preserves source structure and exposure opportunity but substitutes a matched incorrect value. GOLD minus CLEAN measures the total score response to correct-target availability; GOLD minus SHAM tests whether that response tracks target correctness beyond matched source exposure. In D0, GOLD exceeds SHAM by 19.1 to 25.9 percentage points, showing that success follows the correct value. In D2, GOLD still exceeds SHAM under distributed sufficiency while coloc no longer transfers as a high-score marker, with AUROC 0.376 and 0.142. Behavioral dependence can thus persist beyond this probe's intended observation unit. In model comparison, a supported 5.0-point CLEAN score gap compresses to a raw GOLD difference of -0.6 points without establishing rank inversion. Agent benchmarks should report success together with whether the evaluated information state supported it.

AI.tldr: 针对模型评估中因信息状态变化导致正确性无法区分"预期推理"与"答案获取"的问题，提出AcquaBench审计框架，通过CLEAN、GOLD、SHAM三种值替换和联合qid聚类分析，量化成功对正确目标的可溯源依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅依赖正确性无法区分模型是否真正推理出答案还是通过获取目标信息（如上下文泄露）成功，存在"成功溯源缺失"问题，即无法判断成功是否依赖于获取到的目标值。
AI.method: 提出AcquaBench审计框架：(1) 在四个标准化表面上进行CLEAN（保留基准授权信息）、GOLD（提供正确目标）、SHAM（保留结构但替换为匹配的错误值）三种值替换；(2) 采用联合qid聚类分析；(3) 通过GOLD-CLEAN测量对正确目标可用性的总得分响应，GOLD-SHAM测试该响应是否追踪目标正确性而非匹配源曝光。
AI.result: D0条件下GOLD比SHAM高出19.1-25.9个百分点，表明成功追随正确值。D2条件下分布式充分性下GOLD仍超过SHAM，但coloc不再作为高分标记传递（AUROC分别为0.376和0.142），行为依赖可超出探测预期观察单元。模型比较中，5.0分CLEAN差距压缩至-0.6分原始GOLD差异，未产生排名反转。
AI.conclusion: 评估基准应同时报告得分和得分所依赖的信息状态是否支持该成功，以提供更全面的模型能力评估。

title: Multiview Multi-Person Human Mesh Recovery Under Large Scenes with Occlusions
summary: Human mesh recovery (HMR) aims to recover 3D human meshes from images. Most existing HMR benchmarks and methods focus on either multi-person reconstruction from a single view or single-person reconstruction from multiple views, where the number of subjects and the scene scale are relatively limited. Such settings are insufficient for real-world applications with large scenes and severe inter-person occlusions. To address this limitation, we introduce a large-scale synthetic benchmark for multiview multi-person HMR, termed MVMP-HMR. The proposed dataset contains 15 complex scenes with up to 50 camera views and 30 interacting persons, featuring large spatial coverage and severe occlusions, which significantly increases the difficulty of human mesh recovery. Based on this benchmark, we further propose a multiview multi-person whole-body human mesh recovery model, referred to as MVMP-HMR model. The model first fuses multiview features into a scene-level 3D feature volume, and then leverages pelvis joints predicted by a 3D pose estimation network to extract person-specific queries from the 3D feature volume. These human queries are cross-attended with the 3D feature volume and integrated to decode each person's 3D mesh. Moreover, we introduce two novel losses--the orientation loss and the 3D joint density loss--to alleviate orientation and pose ambiguities under severe occlusions. Experiments demonstrate that existing state-of-the-art HMR methods struggle on the proposed MVMP-HMR benchmark, while our method consistently outperforms prior SOTAs in large-scale scenes with severe occlusions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MVMP-HMR，一个大规模多视图多人人体网格恢复的合成基准数据集（含15个复杂场景、最多50个相机视角和30个交互人物），并提出了相应的多视图多人全身网格恢复模型，通过多视图特征融合为场景级3D特征体积、利用骨盆关节提取人物查询、以及引入朝向损失和3D关节密度损失来缓解严重遮挡下的歧义问题，实验表明现有方法在该基准上表现不佳而所提方法持续超越先前最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有HMR基准和方法要么聚焦于单视图多人重建，要么聚焦于多视图单人重建，场景规模和人数有限，无法应对真实世界中大场景和严重人际遮挡的应用需求。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模合成基准MVMP-HMR，含15个复杂场景、最多50个相机视角和30个交互人物；2) 提出MVMP-HMR模型，先将多视图特征融合为场景级3D特征体积，再通过3D姿态估计网络预测的骨盆关节提取人物查询，与3D特征体积进行交叉注意力并解码每个人体网格；3) 引入朝向损失和3D关节密度损失缓解遮挡下的朝向和姿态歧义。
AI.result: 现有SOTA HMR方法在MVMP-HMR基准上表现不佳，而所提方法在具有严重遮挡的大规模场景中持续优于先前SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: MVMP-HMR基准有效推动了多视图多人HMR在复杂大场景中的研究，所提模型通过多视图特征融合和专用损失设计显著提升了严重遮挡下的重建性能。

title: The Cost of Knowing: A Resource-Aware Protocol for Benchmarking Hallucination Beyond Static Leaderboards
summary: On standard factuality tasks, frontier models now cluster near the top of the scale. The question is therefore shifting from how factual a system is toward how much compute that factuality costs. Static leaderboards score factuality in isolation and treat compute as free, so they cannot tell a genuinely better system apart from one that simply spends more. Consider a ranking reversal. A brute-force Best-of-4 agent posts the higher raw factuality score (H-Score 0.9169 vs 0.9103) and would top a static leaderboard, but once cost is counted it is the worse system, losing on Q-Score (0.5169 vs 0.5217) at roughly four times the tokens and latency, under a reported cost weight whose sensitivity we sweep. So the system that tops a static leaderboard can be the worse one to deploy. To make this trade-off visible, we introduce MAS-HQ (Multi-Agent System Hallucination Quest), a resource-aware evaluation protocol. It wraps any factuality detector and normalizes for cost, and it pits systems against each other rather than scoring them in isolation. The Q-Score measures factuality minus normalized cost under a competitive match. Across summarization and open-domain QA, single-agent baselines drift into resource-heavy over-optimization, while competition elicits more resource-efficient policies. These gains are small but consistent, and stable across 100 trials. The axis stays discriminative for frontier systems (Gemini-2.5-Pro, and GPT-5 in simulated preview) whose raw factuality scores are already bunched near the ceiling. MAS-HQ provides a reproducible way to measure how much a factual answer costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAS-HQ评估协议，将事实性与计算成本联合考量，发现静态排行榜上得分高的系统可能在考虑成本后表现更差，而MAS-HQ通过竞争机制和成本归一化，能更真实地反映系统的资源效率。
AI.motivation: 现有事实性评估仅关注事实性分数而忽略计算成本，静态排行榜无法区分"真正更好的系统"和"单纯耗费更多算力的系统"，导致排名反转问题——高成本系统可能因更多计算资源获得更高事实性分数，但在部署时却是更差的选择。
AI.method: 提出MAS-HQ（多智能体系统幻觉探索），一种资源感知的评估协议：1）封装任意事实性检测器并进行成本归一化；2）采用对抗性竞争机制而非孤立评分；3）Q-Score指标衡量事实性减去归一化后的成本。通过在摘要和开放域QA任务上对单智能体基线与竞争策略进行比较，并扫描多组成本权重进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 1）暴力Best-of-4智能体虽原始事实性得分更高（H-Score 0.9169 vs 0.9103），但考虑成本后Q-Score更低（0.5169 vs 0.5217），且消耗约4倍的token和延迟；2）单智能体基线在资源耗尽时倾向于过优化，而竞争机制能激发更资源高效的策略；3）收益虽小但一致，在100次试验中保持稳定；4）该评估轴对前沿系统（如Gemini-2.5-Pro和GPT-5模拟预览版）仍具区分度。
AI.conclusion: MAS-HQ提供了一种可复现的评估方法，用于衡量"事实性答案的成本"，揭示了静态排行榜的局限性，推动事实性评估从孤立的事实性分数向资源感知的竞争性评估范式转变。

title: PRISM: Prompt Refinement via Image-grounded Self-rewarding Mechanism for Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image generation models can synthesize high-quality images from natural language descriptions, but their performance remains highly sensitive to prompt formulation. Existing prompt optimization methods mainly rely on text-side rewriting, prompt expansion, or external reward signals, offering limited image-grounded diagnosis and weak support for learning reusable optimisation policies. In this paper, we propose PRISM, a Prompt Refinement framework via Image-grounded Self-rewarding Mechanism. PRISM closes the prompt-image-feedback loop by interpreting generated images with structured visual diagnosis and scoring them along semantic consistency, aesthetic quality, and human preference alignment. It first initializes a unified VLM through multi-task supervised fine-tuning, and then improves the prompt policy via self-rewarding optimization with a hybrid ideal-point and Chebyshev reward. Extensive experiments show that PRISM improves holistic image quality and fine-grained semantic alignment, while providing interpretable feedback for targeted prompt refinement. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PRISM-FF81.

AI.tldr: PRISM提出了一种基于图像自反馈的提示词优化框架，通过视觉诊断和多任务VLM实现闭环优化，提升了图像生成质量与语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像生成模型对提示词高度敏感，而当前的提示词优化方法主要依赖文本侧改写、提示扩展或外部奖励信号，缺乏基于生成图像的诊断能力，且难以学习可复用的优化策略。
AI.method: PRISM框架包含两个阶段：首先通过多任务监督微调初始化一个统一的视觉语言模型（VLM），使其具备结构化视觉诊断能力；然后通过自奖励优化（结合理想点与切比雪夫奖励）改进提示策略，形成提示-图像-反馈的闭环。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PRISM在整体图像质量和细粒度语义对齐方面均有提升，同时能提供可解释的反馈用于针对性提示优化。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过图像级自反馈机制有效解决了提示词优化中缺乏诊断能力的问题，实现了可复用的优化策略，代码已开源。

title: MiSS: A Logic-Driven Explanation of Minimal Sufficient Coalitions for Point Cloud Classifiers
summary: We present MiSS, a black-box, query-based framework for explaining 3D point cloud classifiers through perturbation-relative sufficiency reasoning. MiSS treats a superpoint partition as an interpretable abstraction layer and asks whether the original prediction can be certified from a minimal coalition of geometric regions under a specified perturbation distribution. Unlike abductive explainers that require Boolean feature spaces or white-box logical encodings of the predictor, MiSS separates candidate proposal from verification: a weighted MaxSAT procedure proposes coalitions using a heuristic adaptive cardinality floor, certified exact-size fallback, a safely tightened upper bound, blocking clauses, and a surrogate acquisition heuristic learned from previous oracle evaluations, while a blackbox statistical oracle decides sufficiency from prediction queries. The system returns a statistically verified sufficient coalition as a binary attribution, with minimum cardinality guaranteed when certified search completes. Experiments on ModelNet40 and ShapeNet with PointNet and PointMLP classifiers show higher precision and coverage than rule-based baselines in most settings, with lower explanation time than exhaustive search.

AI.tldr: MiSS是一个黑盒、基于查询的3D点云分类器解释框架，通过超点分区和扰动相关的充分性推理，结合加权MaxSAT候选生成与统计验证，返回最小基数保证的二元归因，在ModelNet40和ShapeNet上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D点云解释方法要么需要白盒访问分类器逻辑，要么局限于布尔特征空间，缺乏对黑盒分类器在连续几何空间中进行充分性推理的能力。
AI.method: 将超点分区作为可解释抽象层，采用候选生成与验证分离的双阶段框架：加权MaxSAT过程（含自适应基数下限、精确回退、安全上界、阻塞子句和代理获取启发式）生成候选子集；黑盒统计验证器通过查询原始分类器判定充分性。
AI.result: 在ModelNet40和ShapeNet数据集上，使用PointNet和PointMLP分类器，MiSS在多数设置下比基于规则的基线方法具有更高的精度和覆盖率，且解释时间低于穷举搜索。
AI.conclusion: MiSS通过将可满足性推理与统计验证相结合，有效实现了对3D点云黑盒分类器的最小充分性解释，在精度、覆盖率和效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: TaoMate: Anchor-Guided Memory Bridging Evolving and Reference States for Real-Time Audio-Video Digital Human Generation
summary: Real-time long-form digital-human generation relies on causal models to extend audio-visual content while preserving subject appearance and audio-video synchronization across successive segments. A bounded cache retains local motion and phonetic context but discards older evidence, whereas attending to the complete generated history is computationally expensive and can propagate accumulated errors. We present \method, an anchor-guided persistent-memory framework for few-step joint audio-video generation. The framework preserves an immutable visual anchor, compresses completed video and audio blocks into fixed-capacity dynamic states, and retrieves those states through modality-specific residual attention without extending the active cache. A reference-aware modulation method additionally conditions video features on dynamic and anchor appearance statistics. Anchor-preserving causal-context distillation varies rollout horizon, prefix provenance, and cache-history reliability while keeping the immutable visual anchor unperturbed. By separating persistent memory from stage-local denoising dependencies, \method further admits stage-parallel execution across blocks, accelerating autoregressive inference without pipeline-specific retraining. We evaluate long-form video continuations with appearance, temporal, synchronization, facial, and speech diagnostics. Results show that \method preserves stable appearance across prompt-conditioned segments and strong audio-visual synchronization under autoregressive generation. Our project page is https://taoliveaigc.github.io/TaoMate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TaoMate，一种基于锚点引导的持久记忆框架，用于实时长序列数字人生成。通过不可变视觉锚点、压缩动态状态和参考感知调制，实现少步联合音视频生成，并支持阶段并行执行以加速自回归推理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理长序列音视频生成时面临困境：有限缓存丢失早期上下文，而完整历史注意力计算成本高且会传播累积误差。需要一种既能保持长期一致性又兼顾计算效率的因果生成框架。
AI.method: 1) 锚点引导持久记忆：保持不可变视觉锚点，将已完成视频和音频块压缩为固定容量动态状态；2) 模态特异性残差注意力：通过残差注意力检索状态而不扩展活跃缓存；3) 参考感知调制：以动态和锚点外观统计量调节视频特征；4) 锚点保持因果上下文蒸馏：变化展开长度、前缀来源和缓存可靠性，保持锚点不变；5) 阶段并行执行：分离持久记忆与局部去噪依赖，实现跨块并行。
AI.result: 在长序列视频延续任务上，以外观保持、时序一致性、音视频同步、面部质量和语音指标进行评估。TaoMate在自回归生成中保持了稳定的外观和强音视频同步。
AI.conclusion: TaoMate通过锚点引导持久记忆机制有效解决了长序列数字人生成中的外观保持和音视频同步问题，且阶段并行设计加速了推理。

title: Towards High-Level Semantic Intelligence
summary: Recent advances in AI have substantially expanded its cognitive and reasoning capabilities. From the perspective of semantic complexity, the development of AI reveals a clear trajectory from simple to complex semantic processing. While early AI systems mainly addressed tasks involving direct and literal semantic perception or expression, contemporary systems are increasingly expected to perform more sophisticated cognitive reasoning, enabling the understanding and generation of High-Level Semantics (HLS). A similar trajectory can also be observed in human cognitive development. We define this transition as the shift from Basic-Level Semantic Intelligence (BLSI) to High-Level Semantic Intelligence (HLSI). However, this issue has not yet been systematically and comprehensively examined in prior work. Motivated by this gap, this survey reviews the development of AI semantic intelligence from the perspective of semantic complexity. We systematically survey existing research on HLS tasks, including humor, sarcasm, metaphor, empathy, persuasion, narrative, and other general HLS phenomena, across text, speech, vision, and multimodal scenarios. Specifically, we summarize data construction methods, modeling and optimization strategies, and evaluation methodologies for both understanding and generation. HLS is essential for advancing AI toward genuinely human-like intelligence. By synthesizing existing methods and insights from the perspective of semantic intelligence, this survey aims to support the continued development of AI toward HLSI.

AI.tldr: 本文从语义复杂性角度系统综述了AI从基本语义智能（BLSI）向高级语义智能（HLSI）的转变，涵盖幽默、讽刺、隐喻、共情、说服、叙事等高级语义任务在文本、语音、视觉和多模态场景下的数据构建、建模优化与评估方法，旨在推动AI实现真正类人智能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏从语义复杂性角度系统审视AI语义智能发展的全面综述，特别是从基本语义智能（BLSI）向高级语义智能（HLSI）的转变尚未被系统深入地探讨。
AI.method: 采用系统性综述方法，从语义复杂性视角梳理AI语义智能的发展轨迹；总结高级语义（HLS）任务在文本、语音、视觉及多模态场景下的数据构建方法、建模与优化策略、理解与生成的评估方法论。
AI.result: 系统梳理了幽默、讽刺、隐喻、共情、说服、叙事等高级语义任务的研究现状，归纳了各类任务在不同模态下的数据、模型和评估方法。
AI.conclusion: 高级语义智能是实现类人智能的关键；通过从语义智能角度综合现有方法与洞见，本综述旨在支持AI向高级语义智能方向的持续发展。

title: HistoGPA: A Context-Conditioned Gene-Prior Attention Framework for Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images provides a practical complement to experimental spatial transcriptomics. Existing approaches focus on local or multi-scale visual features and often treat pretrained gene representations as fixed priors, although the interpretation of local morphology and the relevance of gene priors depend on tissue context. We propose HistoGPA, a context-conditioned gene-prior attention framework that uses a shared slide-level representation in two parallel pathways: one modulates local morphological features, whereas the other conditions pretrained gene embeddings and retrieves gene-prior information through cross-attention. This design enables each spatial location to retrieve context-adapted gene-prior information using its local morphology, position, and slide context. Across ten cancer types in HEST-1k, HistoGPA achieves the highest macro-averaged gene-wise Pearson correlation coefficient among the compared methods under the same evaluation protocol for both the top-50 and top-1,500 highly variable gene sets. Additional analyses show that HistoGPA better recovers the spatial expression patterns of cancer-associated genes and yields greater agreement between clusters derived independently from predicted and ground-truth expression profiles. Together, these findings motivate a context-dependent view of histology-to-expression prediction, in which local morphological representations and gene priors are jointly adapted to the broader tissue context.

AI.tldr: HistoGPA是一种上下文条件的基因先验注意力框架，通过共享的幻灯片级表示并行调制局部形态特征和基因嵌入，在HEST-1k数据集上跨十种癌症类型实现了最高的基因-wise皮尔逊相关系数，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖局部或多尺度视觉特征，并将预训练基因表示视为固定先验，忽略了局部形态的解释和基因先验的相关性依赖于组织上下文这一事实。
AI.method: 提出HistoGPA框架，使用共享的幻灯片级表示在两个并行路径中运行：一条路径调制局部形态特征，另一条路径通过交叉注意力从预训练基因嵌入中检索上下文适应的基因先验信息。
AI.result: 在HEST-1k的十种癌症类型中，HistoGPA在top-50和top-1,500高变基因集上均实现了最高的宏平均基因-wise皮尔逊相关系数；更好地恢复了癌症相关基因的空间表达模式；预测与真实表达谱的聚类结果一致性更高。
AI.conclusion: 组织学-基因表达预测需要采用上下文依赖的观点，局部形态表示和基因先验应共同适应更广泛的组织上下文。

title: MemChain: Learning Interpretable Memory Traces for Memory-Augmented LLM Agents
summary: Memory-augmented LLM agents typically answer queries by retrieving relevant memories and feeding them directly to an answer model. This retrieval-as-evidence paradigm assumes retrieved memories are already suitable for reasoning, leaving the answer model to resolve redundancy, conflicts, and weak relevance while incurring substantial context overhead in long-term memory tasks. We propose MemChain, a trainable post-retrieval memory policy that transforms retrieved candidates into answer-facing active memory, represented as a compact and grounded evidence context. Given a user query and retrieved candidates, MemChain first generates a question-conditioned evidence plan, then constructs an ordered grounded evidence trace that organizes retrieved memories according to their semantic roles and dependencies, and finally executes explicit memory actions to produce a concise evidence context for answer generation. To train the mediator, we introduce a two-stage learning framework. Supervised trace learning first teaches the policy to generate structurally valid plans, traces, actions, and evidence contexts. We then propose Trace-Guided Memory Policy Optimization (TMPO), a reinforcement learning objective that optimizes the memory policy using downstream answer quality while jointly encouraging trace grounding, evidence support, structural validity, and answer stability across multiple rollouts. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S demonstrate that MemChain consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across both closed-source and open-weight frozen answer models while substantially reducing the memory context passed to the answer model.

AI.tldr: MemChain提出一种可训练的后检索记忆策略，通过生成问题条件化的证据计划、构建有序的接地证据轨迹并执行显式记忆操作，将检索到的候选记忆转化为紧凑且可支撑的主动记忆上下文，在多个长时记忆任务上实现SOTA性能并显著减少传递给答案模型的上下文长度。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强型LLM智能体采用"检索即证据"范式，直接将检索到的记忆喂给答案模型，假定检索结果已适合推理，但忽略了检索结果中存在的冗余、冲突和弱相关性问题，同时造成长时记忆任务中严重的上下文开销。
AI.method: 提出MemChain，包含三个步骤：(1) 生成问题条件化的证据计划；(2) 构建有序的接地证据轨迹，按语义角色和依赖关系组织检索记忆；(3) 执行显式记忆操作生成简洁证据上下文。训练采用两阶段学习框架：监督轨迹学习 + 轨迹引导的记忆策略优化（TMPO，基于强化学习，联合优化下游答案质量、轨迹接地性、证据支撑性、结构有效性和答案稳定性）。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S数据集上，MemChain在使用闭源和开源冻结答案模型时均实现了SOTA性能，同时显著减少了传递给答案模型的记忆上下文长度。
AI.conclusion: 通过可训练的后检索记忆策略，可以系统性地将检索记忆转化为更符合答案生成需求的主动记忆形式，既提升答案质量又降低上下文开销，验证了超越"检索即证据"范式的有效性。

title: Ambient pressure compensation and robust position control of oil-filled electric joint systems for underwater manipulators
summary: Electric joint systems are significant elements of an underwater manipulator for its actuation, drive, and control. Working in an underwater environment, the joints suffer huge ambient pressure. To withstand it, the pressure compensation method is usually deployed, whereas the pressurized oil introduces sealing problems as well as parametric uncertainties and unknown disturbances for the dynamic model of the joint. To tackle these issues, this study proposes a design framework for the underwater oil-filled electric joint. The dynamics of the pressure compensation module is analyzed and the structure of the joint is optimized to seal the internal hydraulic oil. An uncertainty dynamic model of the oil-filled joint is established and a robust position controller is designed based on the structured singular value synthesis (mu-synthesis). Experimental results validate the feasibility of the proposed methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对水下电动关节在压力补偿中油液引入的密封问题、参数不确定性和未知扰动，提出了油液填充式水下电动关节的设计框架，包含压力补偿模块动力学分析、结构优化密封、不确定性动态建模及基于μ-synthesis的鲁棒位置控制器设计，实验验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: 水下机械臂的电动关节面临巨大环境压力，现有压力补偿方法引入的油液会导致密封问题，并给关节动态模型带来参数不确定性和未知扰动，亟需解决。
AI.method: 分析了压力补偿模块的动力学特性，优化关节结构实现液压油密封；建立油液填充关节的不确定性动态模型；基于结构化奇异值合成（μ-synthesis）设计鲁棒位置控制器。
AI.result: 实验验证了所提设计框架及控制方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的油液填充电动关节设计框架能有效应对水下高压环境下的密封与不确定性控制问题。

title: Scaling GUI Agents with Visual State Transitions
summary: We introduce State Transition Pretraining (STP) as a new scaling axis for GUI agents. During the STP stage, we continually pretrain a unified multimodal model on visual state transitions by jointly optimizing inverse dynamics (predicting actions from state changes) and forward dynamics (predicting next states from current states and actions). This optimization equips the model with better action-grounded visual representations and an internal world model of GUI dynamics. When subsequently fine-tuned on trajectories with task instructions, our STP-trained models consistently outperform baselines trained solely via direct trajectory fine-tuning across agent benchmarks in both desktop and mobile GUI scenarios (AgentNetBench, AndroidControl, and GUIOdyssey). Further empirical studies show that joint dynamics optimization yields stable improvements over single-objective training, and downstream performance scales steadily with the volume of transition data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出状态转移预训练（STP），通过在GUI状态转移数据上联合优化逆动力学（从状态变化预测动作）和正动力学（从当前状态和动作预测下一状态）来预训练多模态模型，使模型获得更好的动作接地视觉表示和GUI动态世界模型。在多个桌面和移动GUI基准测试中，STP显著优于传统直接轨迹微调方法，且性能随转移数据量稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的GUI智能体主要依赖直接轨迹微调，但该方法未能充分利用GUI环境中的状态转移信息，模型缺乏对动作与状态变化间因果关系的深入理解，限制了其在复杂GUI任务中的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出State Transition Pretraining (STP)方法，在预训练阶段联合优化两个目标：1）逆动力学：从状态变化预测动作；2）正动力学：从当前状态和动作预测下一状态。该方法在统一的多模态模型上持续预训练，然后再在下游任务指令轨迹数据上进行微调。
AI.result: 在AgentNetBench、AndroidControl和GUIOdyssey三个基准上，STP训练模型在桌面和移动GUI场景中均一致优于直接轨迹微调的基线方法。联合动力学优化稳定优于单目标训练，下游性能随转移数据量增加而稳定扩展。
AI.conclusion: STP为GUI智能体提供了一种新的可扩展训练轴（scaling axis），通过状态转移数据的预训练显著提升了模型的动作接地表示和内部世界模型，从而在多种GUI场景中取得更优的泛化性能。

title: GenSplatCodec: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting Compression via One-Step Diffusion
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables scalable scene reconstruction without per-scene optimization, yet produces dense Gaussians that are costly to store and transmit. Existing feed-forward Gaussian compression methods formulate decoding as deterministic representation recovery, which becomes inadequate at low bitrates when high-frequency textures and view-dependent appearance are discarded. Although generative models offer a promising alternative, using them as standalone post-processing decouples generation from the transmitted scene structure, thereby compromising cross-view consistency. To address these limitations, we propose GenSplatCodec, a unified feed-forward Gaussian codec that reformulates low-bitrate Gaussian compression as geometry-guided generative decoding. We present a detail-aware feed-forward Gaussian coding scheme within a dual-stream formulation, where the resulting compact Gaussian structural stream is complemented by a lightweight reference appearance stream. We further introduce a geometry-guided one-step generative decoding approach that jointly exploits decoded structural and appearance cues through hierarchical geometry control to reconstruct high-fidelity and view-consistent novel views. Finally, we develop a three-stage optimization strategy that stabilizes the learning of the unified codec and adapts the generative decoder to codec-derived structural and appearance cues. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that GenSplatCodec consistently achieves superior rate-distortion (RD) performance over existing methods.

AI.tldr: GenSplatCodec是一种统一的馈送式3D高斯编解码器，通过几何引导的生成式解码实现低比特率下的高效场景重建，在多个数据集上实现了优于现有方法的率失真性能。
AI.motivation: 现有馈送式3DGS压缩方法在低比特率下因丢弃高频纹理和视角相关外观而导致重建质量下降；而生成模型作为独立后处理会破坏跨视图一致性。因此需要一种统一编解码框架来解决低比特率下的高质量、视图一致重建问题。
AI.method: 提出双流式馈送高斯编码方案（紧凑高斯结构流+轻量参考外观流），以及几何引导的单步生成式解码方法（通过层次化几何控制联合利用解码后的结构和外观线索），并采用三阶段优化策略稳定训练。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，GenSplatCodec在率失真性能上持续超越现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 几何引导的生成式解码能够有效弥补低比特率下的信息损失，实现高保真且视图一致的新视角合成。

title: Grading the Narrators: An Isnad-Rijal Framework for Claim-Level Provenance in Multi-Agent Knowledge Systems
comment: 25 pages. Code, data, and analysis: https://github.com/alizahidraja/isnad (v2.0.4). Software archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21216873
summary:
Modern multi-agent knowledge systems increasingly accumulate knowledge through chains of autonomous transformations rather than direct retrieval. Existing provenance work records what happened - execution traces, tool calls, evidence links - and source-reliability estimation is long established (truth discovery, reputation systems). What is missing is an operational framework that attaches graded, per-domain transmitter reliability to claim-level transmission chains, with completeness semantics, transformation-typed aggregation, decoupled content criticism, and serve/review/quarantine routing.
  Classical Islamic hadith science confronted a structurally similar problem: deciding whether knowledge transmitted through chains of human narrators should be accepted. Over centuries it developed a rigorous methodology - isnad (a complete transmission chain attached to every claim), rijal (systematic grading of each narrator's integrity and precision), weakest-link chain evaluation, corroboration through independent chains, and matn criticism (content evaluated independently of chain quality). This paper transfers that methodology to AI system design.
  We contribute a formal mapping from hadith-science concepts to multi-agent pipelines, a relational schema implementing claim chains and a graded narrator registry, a decision matrix combining chain grade with content criticism, and an evaluation on 20,000 claims from real physics textbooks. The evaluation validates weakest-link quarantine and independent-chain corroboration; reports a partial failure of the grade-recovery loop, which missed the highest-fault narrator; and reports two analyses as inconclusive, including a matched-coverage comparison the framework could not reach with the reference content critic. The paper is explicit throughout about which claims the evidence does and does not yet support.

AI.tldr: 本文借鉴伊斯兰圣训学（hadith science）的传述链（isnad）、评鉴人（rijal）、最弱环节评估、独立链佐证、文本批评（matn criticism）等方法，建立了多智能体知识系统中按领域分级的传述者可靠性框架，支持完整性语义、转换类型聚合、解耦内容批评以及serve/review/quarantine路由。在20,000条物理教科书命题上的评估验证了最弱环节隔离和独立链佐证的有效性，但暴露了等级恢复循环的局部失败（遗漏了最高故障率的传述者），以及两项分析尚无定论。
AI.motivation: 现有知识溯源工作仅记录执行轨迹、工具调用和证据链接等"发生了什么"的信息，以及传统的真值发现和声誉系统等源可靠性估计方法，但缺乏一个操作化的框架来为每条声明传递链附加按领域分级的传述者可靠性，且需要包含完整性语义、转换类型化的聚合、解耦的内容批评以及serve/review/quarantine路由决策。
AI.method: 将伊斯兰圣训学的方法体系映射到多智能体流水线：isnad（每条声明附加完整传递链）、rijal（对每个传述者的诚信和精确性进行系统分级）、最弱环节链评估、通过独立链进行佐证、matn批评（独立于链质量评估内容）。具体贡献包括形式化映射、实现声明链和分级传述者注册表的关系模式、结合链等级与内容批评的决策矩阵。
AI.result: 在20,000条物理教科书声明上的评估中：验证了最弱环节隔离和独立链佐证的有效性；报告了等级恢复循环的局部失败——未能捕获最高故障率的传述者；两项分析尚无定论，包括一个匹配覆盖比较（框架无法达到参考内容批评者的覆盖范围）。
AI.conclusion: 跨学科知识验证范式迁移是可行的，但存在局限：等级恢复循环可能遗漏高风险传述者；框架在内容批评覆盖范围上尚有不足。全文对哪些声明有证据支持、哪些尚不支持均保持明确透明。

title: Mixture-of-Thought-Tokens: Unifying Perception and Reasoning for Free-form Multimodal Grounding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models have made great progress in grounding tasks, yet existing methods still struggle to unify precise localization and complex reasoning. For one thing, text-based methods rely on coordinates or index prediction, severely limiting the perceptual capabilities of the model for dense visual objects. Meanwhile, latent token-based methods employ special tokens without inherent spatial references and use a decoding mechanism that lacks thinking steps, weakening high-level reasoning capabilities. Consequently, developing a unified framework that excels in both perception and reasoning remains challenging. To address this, we propose Mixture-of-Thought-Tokens (Motto), a new free-form multimodal grounding method that bridges the perception-reasoning gap, enabling MLLMs to empower diverse, arbitrary grounding queries. Specifically, we introduce Spatially-Grounded Thought Tokenization to explicitly align special tokens with spatial locations for clear spatial correspondence and visual interpretability. We further design a Context-Adaptive Chain-of-Tokens that dynamically switch grounding modes within an interleaved reasoning chain, achieving robust grounding across tasks of varying complexity. In addition, we construct PR-Bench, a new referring expression comprehension benchmark to evaluate the perception-reasoning gap. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Motto achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse free-form grounding tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mixture-of-Thought-Tokens (Motto)，一种新的大规模多模态自由形式定位方法，通过空间化思想标记分词和上下文自适应标记链，弥合多模态大语言模型在感知与推理之间的差距，在多种自由形式定位任务上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在定位任务中难以统一精确的视觉定位和复杂推理：基于文本的方法依赖坐标或索引预测，限制了密集视觉对象的感知能力；基于潜在标记的方法使用缺乏空间参考的特殊标记且解码缺少思考步骤，削弱了高层推理能力。因此亟需一个在感知和推理方面都表现出色的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 空间化思想标记分词(Spatially-Grounded Thought Tokenization)：将特殊标记与空间位置显式对齐，建立清晰的空间对应关系和视觉可解释性；2) 上下文自适应标记链(Context-Adaptive Chain-of-Tokens)：在交错的推理链中动态切换定位模式，实现跨不同复杂度任务的鲁棒定位；3) 构建PR-Bench基准来评估感知-推理差距。
AI.result: 在多种自由形式定位任务上达到最先进性能，实验充分验证了Motto框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Motto通过将空间感知与推理链融合的自由形式多模态定位方法，有效弥合了感知与推理之间的差距，为MLLM的多样化任意定位查询提供了统一的解决方案。

title: A Motion-Aware Vector Quantization Framework with Centroid Reuse for Efficient VLA Inference
summary:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong potential for embodied AI, yet their high inference latency on GPUs limits real-time deployment. Existing accelerators, such as Dadu-Corki, improve efficiency but treat VLA models as full-precision workloads, leaving substantial redundancy in both memory and computation underexploited.
  In this paper, we propose VQVLA, an algorithm-hardware co-design framework that accelerates VLA inference by exploiting weight similarity and execution dynamics. We first introduce MotionVQ, a motion-aware vector quantization scheme that dynamically adjusts quantization precision based on the robot's execution state, reducing memory access while preserving task success rate. We then propose a merged-centroid vectorized GEMM paradigm that operates on the codebook-index representation, eliminating redundant multiplications through spatial aggregation and temporal reuse of centroids. To realize these optimizations, we design an accelerator that efficiently supports dynamic precision selection and centroid-reuse computation. Experimental results show that VQVLA achieves 6.5x, 2.8x, 1.9x, 3.3x, and 4.3x speedup over the A100 GPU, Dadu-Corki, LUT-DLA, CodeGEMM, and ShiftAddLLM, respectively, with negligible accuracy degradation.

AI.tldr: VQVLA是一个算法-硬件协同设计框架，通过运动感知向量量化（MotionVQ）和合并质心向量化GEMM范式，利用权重相似性和执行动态性加速VLA模型推理，在A100 GPU、Dadu-Corki等基准上实现1.9x-6.5x加速比，且精度损失可忽略。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在GPU上推理延迟高，难以满足实时部署需求；现有加速器（如Dadu-Corki）将VLA视为全精度负载，未充分利用内存和计算中的冗余。
AI.method: 提出MotionVQ（运动感知向量量化，根据机器人执行状态动态调整量化精度）和合并质心向量化GEMM范式（在码本-索引表示上操作，通过空间聚合和时间复用消除冗余乘法），并设计支持动态精度选择和质心复用计算的加速器。
AI.result: 在A100 GPU、Dadu-Corki、LUT-DLA、CodeGEMM、ShiftAddLLM上分别实现6.5x、2.8x、1.9x、3.3x和4.3x加速比，精度退化可忽略。
AI.conclusion: VQVLA通过算法-硬件协同设计有效发掘VLA模型中的冗余，显著加速推理，为具身AI实时部署提供可行方案。

title: Accuracy potential of visual localization exploiting high-end street-level imagery
summary: Accurate and reliable pose information with respect to a reference frame is increasingly demanded across applications such as autonomous navigation, surveying, robotics, and augmented and mixed reality. Visual localization can serve as a complementary positioning modality to GNSS, whose applicability and accuracy are often limited. Yet, the accuracy potential of visual localization has not been systematically investigated against survey-grade demands. This is mainly due to the lack of publicly available, large-scale outdoor datasets with ground-truth poses in the sub-centimeter range. In this work, we address both gaps. We introduce a scalable visual localization pipeline that employs precisely georeferenced, high-resolution street-level imagery directly as the scene representation. It combines prior-guided reference candidate selection with on-the-fly local Structure-from-Motion reconstruction and PnP-based pose estimation. We further present the FHNW Muttenz dataset, a real-world dataset covering a contiguous 10 km street network mapped in two mobile mapping campaigns approximately 1.5 years apart. It consists of high-resolution reference imagery and query sequences acquired by four different cameras across five representative scenes. All images are precisely co-registered, yielding 6-DoF ground-truth poses in the sub-centimeter range. Using this dataset, we evaluate the accuracy potential of visual localization. Our experiments demonstrate median pose accuracies in the range of 1-5 cm for translation and 0.05-0.1° for rotation, reaching as low as 1 cm and 0.03° under favorable conditions. These results show that visual localization can complement survey-grade GNSS positioning, paving the way for 3D geospatial data acquisition using consumer devices and fully automated georeferencing approaches. The dataset is publicly available at: https://fhnw-muttenz-vl-dataset.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于高分辨率街景图像的视觉定位流水线，并发布了涵盖10公里街道网络的FHNW Muttenz数据集（亚厘米级真实位姿）。实验表明，视觉定位在平移1-5厘米、旋转0.05-0.1°的中值精度，可媲美测量级GNSS定位。
AI.motivation: 视觉定位的精度潜力尚未针对测量级需求进行系统评估，主要缺乏公开可用的、带有亚厘米级真实位姿的大规模户外数据集。
AI.method: 采用精确地理参考的高分辨率街景图像作为场景表征，通过先验引导的参考候选选择、即时局部SfM重建和PnP位姿估计相结合的流水线实现视觉定位。
AI.result: 在FHNW Muttenz数据集上，平移中值精度1-5厘米，旋转0.05-0.1°；有利条件下可达1厘米和0.03°。
AI.conclusion: 视觉定位可以补充测量级GNSS定位，为使用消费级设备进行3D地理空间数据采集和全自动地理配准铺平道路。

title: Agent-UCT: Upper Confidence Bounds Applied to Trees for Agentic Workflow Optimization with Cost-Awareness
summary: Optimizing agentic workflows, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, requires navigating a combinatorial space of discrete component choices under tight evaluation budgets. Existing approaches - heuristic search, black-box optimization, and standard tree search methods - do not explicitly exploit the compositional structure of these workflows, leading to redundant computation and inefficient budget allocation. We introduce Agent-UCT (Agent-based Cost-Aware Upper Confidence Bounds Applied to Trees), a tree search algorithm that extends UCT with a reuse-aware regularization term derived from a bipartite prefix reuse graph. Agent-UCT biases selection toward branches that leverage previously materialized configuration prefixes, reducing redundant execution while maintaining effective exploration. Our framework, RAGSpace, unifies heterogeneous RAG components from LongRAG, LightRAG, and Self-RAG into a five-dimensional configuration space, enabling systematic cross-framework recombination. WTB (Workflow Test Bench) provides deterministic replay, content-addressable caching, and transactional consistency, ensuring that intermediate states are materialized once and reused across the search. Experiments on HotpotQA and UltraDomain demonstrate that Agent-UCT identifies configurations with the highest out-of-sample performance among the evaluated fixed framework presets. Under full-pool evaluation, bipartite prefix reuse reduces logical search cost by 73.6% relative to the no-prefix-sharing cost upper bound. Compared with full-pool evaluation, sampling-based evaluation further achieves a 4.2x wall-clock speedup. Agent-UCT, RAGSpace, and WTB together provide a unified framework for cost-aware, reproducible, and compositionally efficient agentic workflow optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent-UCT算法，通过二分前缀重用图引导树搜索，在RAG工作流组合优化中减少冗余计算；结合RAGSpace统一配置空间和WTB测试平台，实现73.6%的逻辑搜索成本降低和4.2倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（启发式搜索、黑箱优化、标准树搜索）未能显式利用工作流的组合结构，导致冗余计算和低效的预算分配。
AI.method: 提出Agent-UCT算法，在UCT基础上引入基于二分前缀重用图的重用感知正则化项，偏向利用已实现配置前缀的分支；构建RAGSpace统一五维配置空间整合LongRAG/LightRAG/Self-RAG组件；设计WTB测试平台提供确定性重放、内容寻址缓存和事务一致性。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA和UltraDomain上，Agent-UCT识别出优于固定框架预设的配置；二分前缀重用降低73.6%逻辑搜索成本；采样评估实现4.2倍加速。
AI.conclusion: Agent-UCT、RAGSpace和WTB共同构成了一个成本感知、可重复、组合高效的智能工作流优化统一框架。

title: IJCB-AFMFR 2026: Competition on Adapting Foundation Models for Face Recognition Using Synthetic Training Data
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics 2026 (IJCB 2026)
summary: This paper presents a summary of the Competition on Adapting Foundation Models for Face Recognition Using Synthetic Training Data (AFMFR), held at the 2026 International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB 2026). The competition received a total of eight valid submissions from four distinct teams across two complementary tracks: a Full Data Track, in which participants adapt the CLIP ViT-L/14 foundation model using large-scale synthetic identity data, and a Limited Data Track, designed to reflect more resource-constrained adaptation regimes. All training data was generated exclusively using IDPERTURB. Submitted solutions are ranked based on verification and identification performance across a diverse suite of benchmarks, including LFW, CFP-FP, AgeDB-30, CALFW, CPLFW, IJB-B, IJB-C, and TinyFace, using the Borda count method. Fairness evaluation is additionally conducted on the RFW dataset across four demographic groups. The results demonstrate that adaptation of the CLIP foundation model with synthetic training data substantially improves over the off-the-shelf model and, in several cases, surpasses the baseline. Notably, full fine-tuning with Sub-Center ArcFace (DMSTI-Neurotechnology) leads the Full Data Track, while rank-stabilized LoRA adaptation (Idiap-BSP) proves most effective under limited-data conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了IJCB 2026上举办的竞赛（AFMFR），该竞赛聚焦于使用合成训练数据（由IDPERTURB生成）适配CLIP ViT-L/14基础模型进行人脸识别。竞赛设全数据赛道和有限数据赛道，8个有效提交来自4个团队。全数据赛道中，Sub-Center ArcFace全微调（DMSTI-Neurotechnology）表现最佳；有限数据赛道中，秩稳定LoRA适配（Idiap-BSP）最为有效。结果表明，合成数据适配显著提升性能，部分情况超过基线。
AI.motivation: 探索使用合成训练数据适配基础模型（如CLIP）进行人脸识别的可行性，解决真实数据获取的成本和隐私问题，并通过竞赛形式推动该方向的发展。
AI.method: 竞赛设置两个赛道：全数据赛道（大规模合成身份数据适配CLIP ViT-L/14）和有限数据赛道（资源受限场景）。所有训练数据由IDPERTURB生成。排名采用Borda计数法，基于LFW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30、CALFW、CPLFW、IJB-B、IJB-C、TinyFace等多个基准的验证和识别性能，并在RFW数据集上进行四个种族群体的公平性评估。
AI.result: 全数据赛道：Sub-Center ArcFace全微调（DMSTI-Neurotechnology）领先；有限数据赛道：秩稳定LoRA适配（Idiap-BSP）最有效。适配后模型显著优于原始CLIP模型，部分情况下超越基线。
AI.conclusion: 使用合成数据适配CLIP基础模型能够显著提升人脸识别性能，在不同资源条件下均有有效方案，证明了合成数据替代真实数据训练基础模型的潜力。

title: Falsifiable Commitment Planning for Self-Correcting Web Agents
summary: Long-horizon web agents often go off track before final failure: a trajectory can remain locally plausible even after the current state, reused skill, or plan assumption no longer supports the user instruction.
